Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
 
 
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
 
 
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
 
 
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
 
 
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program

#BuildingEnvelope
 
 
**Amrize is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**
*We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.*

role.title: Executive Director, Corporate Quality
role.description:
**About This Role**
The Head of Corporate Quality is responsible for creating and managing the Global Biogen Quality Management System (QMS). The main areas of focus include Quality Systems, internal and external audits for cGMP compliance (including external vendors and CMOs), IT Quality, Technical Product Complaints, and Central Knowledge Management (including documentation).
 
 
This role is central to Quality and PO&T, managing risk, compliance performance, staying compliant with regulatory changes, and seeking opportunities to gain efficiency and effectiveness in the administration of PO&T’s cGMP systems. Additionally, the role is accountable for preparing semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS and informing Executive Management of potential business risks due to a changing regulatory environment or systemic issues within the company. This role also serves as the principal liaison with the R&D Clinical Compliance organization and provides guidance for ICH conformance. Oversight includes biologic products, ASOs, small molecule products, gene therapy, devices, digital, and combination products.
 
 
*This role is hybrid- RTP or hybrid- Cambridge based.*
**Travel requirements**
: 25% – 50% depending on location. More travel required if not located in RTP.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Implement integrated quality systems, policies, and standards applicable to all Biogen U.S. and international manufacturing sites and PO&T locations, including Baar, Cambridge, Netherlands, Solothurn, and RTP.
* Develop and maintain a risk assessment process for evaluating and monitoring all cGXP systems.
* Ensure regulatory inspection responses are assessed holistically.
* Establish clear goals and effective metrics that provide insight into industry benchmarks and applicable trends regarding cGMP compliance.
* Oversee external monitoring of regulatory updates (domestic and international) and incorporate changes into Biogen’s QMS as needed.
* Internal and external GxP and ISO audit programs, including risk management and audit program oversight.
* Ensure Biogen’s internal manufacturing sites, Quality Systems, and vendors operate in a state of cGMP compliance, with any risks appropriately communicated and escalated.

**IT QA Department**

* Oversee GxP IT computerized systems across Biogen, including underlying infrastructure.
* Define appropriate standards and manage lifecycle documentation and supporting processes to ensure compliant implementation and management through retirement.

**Lifecycle Management**

* Oversee process and compliance-related content (specifically documentation, including governing policies, process documents, and other similar GxP documents) in the electronic document management system.
* Protect, index, classify, and archive GXP records, digitally preserve vital records, manage records lifecycle, and translate GMP content needed in multiple languages.
* Oversee the PO&T training program, providing global guidance and standards to ensure appropriate GxP training is conducted.

**Technical Product Complaint Department**

* Develop and maintain policies and procedures to manage complaints in line with industry and regulatory standards.
* Identify strategy and provide direction to team members regarding complaint investigation, root cause analysis, CAPAs, regulatory responses, and launch readiness for new products.
* Ensure trending and reporting of complaint cases and metrics, including appropriate escalation and response to significant events.

**Global Management Review (GMR)**

* Act as the chair for the GMR, ensuring ongoing management review and awareness of Biogen Quality and compliance performance (in accordance with cGMP and ICH expectations).
* Prepare semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS based on GMR outcomes.
* Establish short and long-term goals, objectives, and strategies for the Global Corporate Quality organization.
* Ensure appropriate policies and procedures are in place to measure, monitor, and report "actual" versus "planned" results.
* Drive major projects and programs for the Organizational Unit or Function to completion within schedule and budget.
* Manage multiple cost centers and determine the development of overall objectives and long-range goals of the organization.
* Interact directly with senior representatives of regulatory agencies, including the FDA and EMEA.
* Manage direct reports and managers of managers to increase their performance and effectiveness.

**Who You Are**
You are a seasoned leader in the pharmaceutical industry with an expert understanding of both U.S. and international regulatory requirements. Your influence within an organization is felt through consistent execution and strong leadership competencies. With excellent communication and change management skills, you're adept at leading and implementing change. You thrive in a highly regulated environment and have comprehensive knowledge of the pharmaceutical product development process.
 
 
**Qualifications**
**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field with a minimum of 15 years of leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience leading a Quality Assurance, Regulatory, or Corporate organization at the Director+ level in a highly regulated environment, preferably in biotech, pharmaceutical, or similar industry.
* Experience with the FDA, EMEA, and preferably multiple additional regulatory agencies in other foreign countries.
* Experience in clinical and commercial products as well as both large and small molecule programs, device, and combination products is strongly preferred. ASQ or other auditing certification is beneficial.
* Quality and Compliance experience consistent with worldwide regulatory requirements.
* Expert knowledge of US and International cGxPs, ISO, ICH, and Device regulations.
* Ability to hire and retain top talent with a track record of developing leaders.
* Excellent knowledge of the pharmaceutical product development process, ICH, and device regulations.
* Ability to influence the organization through consistent execution of Biogen leadership competencies.
* Strong leadership abilities required to effectively manage highly capable and high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and implement change, including excellent communication and change management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Advanced degree (PharmD, PhD)

Job Level: Management
 
 
**Additional Information**
The base compensation range for this role is: $281,000.00-$397,250.00
 
 
Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.
 
 
Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.
 
 
**Benefits**
In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families
*physical, financial, emotional,*
and
*social well-being*
; including, but not limited to:
 
 

* Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
* Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
* Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
* A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
* Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
* 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
* Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
* 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
* Employee Resource Groups participation

**Why Biogen?**
We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.
 
 
At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.
 
 
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E-Verify Employer in the United States.

Senior Director Manufacturing
role.description:
Founded over 35 years ago, First Quality is a family-owned company that has grown from a small business in McElhattan, Pennsylvania into a group of companies, employing over 5,000 team members, while maintaining our family values and entrepreneurial spirit. With corporate offices in New York and Pennsylvania and 8 manufacturing campuses across the U.S. and Canada, the companies within the First Quality group produce high-quality personal care and household products for large retailers and healthcare organizations. Our personal care and household product portfolio includes baby diapers, wipes, feminine pads, paper towels, bath tissue, adult incontinence products, laundry detergents, fabric finishers, and dishwash solutions. In addition, we manufacture certain raw materials and components used in the manufacturing of these products, including flexible print and packaging solutions.

Guided by our values of humility, unity, and integrity, we leverage advanced technology and innovation to drive growth and create new opportunities. At First Quality, you’ll find a collaborative environment focused on continuous learning, professional development, and our mission to Make Things Better®.

We are seeking a
**Senior Director, Manufacturing Operations**
for our
**First Quality Baby Products, LLC**
location in
**Macon, GA.**
This position will have operational oversight for the Macon, GA production facility and will be responsible for strategic manufacturing operations leadership for the site. The role will collaborate with Division and site leadership to drive the long-range strategic planning process, including production planning, scheduling, and resource allocation. The role will collaborate with the key business unit partners to drive actions that have a favorable impact on the P&L while focusing on long-term growth. Additionally, the role is responsible for driving a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* Foster a culture of health, safety, and quality.
* Develop, implement, and monitor day-to-day operational systems and processes to provide visibility into the goals, progress, and obstacles of key initiatives.
* Manage and mentor staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Drive continuous improvement of manufacturing processes and management methods to generate improved plant performance, workflow optimization, yields and efficiencies, and budget commitments.
* Develop and execute manufacturing strategies that align with the company’s overall goals and objectives.
* Implement and enforce quality control processes to ensure products meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Monitor production processes to ensure efficiency, productivity, and profitability targets are consistently met or exceeded.
* Identify areas for process improvement and implement strategies to optimize production workflows and reduce costs.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless coordination and communication throughout the manufacturing process.
* Direct, inspire and hold leaders accountable to ensure engagement of all functional areas to drive business performance and deliver results.
* Ensure adherence to state and federal regulations regarding all business components.
* Manage operations in support of business growth by ensuring the introduction of new equipment and systems meet safety, quality, cost, consumer, customer, and security requirements.
* Drive recruiting, training and retention efforts in collaboration with Human Resources to ensure training, employee development, and work systems enable all employees to maximize their contribution to business success.
* Consult with and support sales and product development resources to ensure customer and consumer requirements are met or exceeded.

**The ideal candidate should possess the following:**

A strong leader as well as technical problem solver of production processes. This person will be expected to meet high expectations and demonstrate a strong sense of urgency, strive for collaboration but dictate when necessary while possessing unquestioned integrity. Characteristics include:

* Strong demonstrated leadership, communications, and analytical skills.
* Highly collaborative and team oriented.
* Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision, effectively work in a fast-paced environment, strong decision-making skills.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Job Description**
**Summary:**
The Plant Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the entire manufacturing facility including safety, quality, efficiencies and meeting customer expectations. This includes driving strategic plans that ensure that production goals are met in the most cost-effective manner delivering expected financial results.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Ensures that the facility provides the highest quality products produced in the most efficient manner within budgeted costs. Implements systems to effectively manage production schedules properly supporting the business.
* Leads the effort and drives Lean Manufacturing tools and techniques fostering continuous improvement within the facility.
* Acts in a proactive fashion regarding problem resolution.
* Manages profit and loss for the facility and drives Plant performance and reviews KPIs regularly (Daily, weekly and monthly).
* Leads the overall strategic planning efforts for the location which include cost reduction initiatives, capital planning and resources as well as in other areas.
* Manages the overall safety, quality, scheduling, production, shipping, maintenance and other administrative functions for the facility.
* Leads the effort in maintaining a safe, clean and efficient operation working within all company guidelines and local/state/federal regulations.
* Strives to improve the plant’s safety accident record year over year in creating a positive safety culture for all employees. Conducts safety walks of the facility on a weekly basis.
* Conducts talent reviews. Trains, develops and motivates staff in an effort to optimize the workforce. Delivers performance reviews and any feedback to the team as needed.
* Conducts weekly staff meetings which focus on key operative measurements.
* Schedules and conducts plant communication meetings for all employees.
* Interfaces with customers and suppliers. Visits both as necessary.
* Works as necessary to establish positive community relationships.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Minimum of a high school diploma. Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Operations or Business Management preferred
* Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in operations, maintenance, engineering and/or process Improvement roles including managing teams of people
* Previous experience working in a Lean environment.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification a plus
* Proven experience and record of successes in a high-speed manufacturing environment. Experience with plastic injection molding environment, and metal processing/metal forming strong preferred
* Experience in a commercial role with direct customer contact
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with process development and business process design.
* Experience managing to the ISO or equivalent quality standards
* Experience implementing and/or managing to an Operating System (example: the Toyota Production Systems)
* Bilingual English/Spanish a plus, but not required

**About Us**
Do you want to work with people who are dedicated to innovation and making the world a better place? Do you want to build a career with a company that provides opportunities for growth and development?
 
 
Mauser Packaging Solutions is that company.
 
 
Our mission is to help our customers achieve better sustainability with their packaging. And we do that by giving our people the opportunity to do important work, solve interesting problems and be part of a diverse, forward-looking team.
 
 
At Mauser Packaging Solutions, you can be proud to work for a company that’s always striving to innovate and serve customers better—and help them be better stewards of the environment.
 
 
Whether you’re a seasoned professional—or just beginning your career—there’s a place where you can help make a difference at Mauser Packaging Solutions. Join us!
 
 
Mauser Packaging Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

role.title: Director, NPI Operations Engineering
role.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.
 
 
**About The Role**
The NPI Operations Engineering leader builds and leads the team responsible for making Skydio's next generation of autonomous robotics, including drones, docks and accessories, at our internal manufacturing facility in Hayward. You’ll deliver the process, manufacturing know-how and technology needed to build the most capable flying robots on the planet. The team combines Manufacturing Design Engineering and Supply Base Engineering into one organization that is 100% focused on new product development.
 
 
You will own the manufacturability of every new product: assembly time, assembly yield and the processes, fixtures, equipment and supplier readiness needed to hit them. You and your team will engage with Product Engineering from early architecture, carry products through EVT, DVT and PVT, and hand them to Process Engineering for sustaining once they meet clear production-readiness criteria.
 
 
This is a leadership role with significant scope to shape how Skydio develops hardware. You'll set the team's direction, hire and grow engineers, and be the single operations voice in product development. Sustaining engineering for products already in production sits with Process Engineering, so this team stays focused on getting new products right before they reach the line.
 
 
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Own manufacturability of new products**

* Own the operations engineering development for NPI programs across supply chain and in-house manufacturing
* Drive design-for-manufacturing, assembly and serviceability (DFx) input from early architecture onward
* Set and commit to assembly time and assembly yield targets for each new product, and track them at every build
* Own operations sign-off at product development gates, and escalate manufacturability risks with clear trade-offs
* Use PFMEA, DFM reviews and prototype yield, quality and process data to align product design with manufacturing strategy
* Identify manufacturing risks early and drive mitigation plans to closure before production ramp

**Lead NPI execution through production readiness**

* Own the manufacturing plan for new products and major design changes, from prototype through PVT
* Define assembly flow, line layout, fixtures and equipment for new products, with labor, cost and capacity estimates that sharpen at each build
* Coordinate engineering, design and production validation builds with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Test and Quality
* Define production-readiness and handoff criteria, and lead manufacturing readiness reviews
* Develop and continuously improve Skydio's NPI process
* Transfer products to Process Engineering with complete documentation, released tooling, and yield and cycle time at target

**Develop processes, fixtures and assembly equipment**

* Own development and validation of assembly processes, including mechanical assembly, electronics integration, adhesive bonding, fastening, soldering and calibration
* Own design and qualification of assembly fixtures, error-proofing, and assembly equipment such as dispense systems and torque-controlled drivers
* Own the capital budget for new-product assembly fixtures and equipment. Capital for the running production line stays with Manufacturing
* Develop process specifications, control plans, component and assembly CTQs, inspections, inline tests, work instructions and manufacturing BOMs, all complete before handoff
* Use statistical process control (SPC), capability studies and structured experiments to establish robust process windows

**Develop core manufacturing technologies**

* Build a roadmap of core process technologies that future products depend on, such as waterproofing and ingress protection, conformal coatings, sealing and advanced bonding
* Partner with material suppliers, equipment vendors and technology partners to develop, qualify and industrialize these processes ahead of product need
* Serve as the technical owner for these technologies after production launch

**Lead supply base engineering for new products**

* Drive supplier selection, part qualification and supplier process readiness for new products
* Own NPI automation at the process level during development, and partner with the Factory Automation team for production handoff
* Work with suppliers on component DFM, process capability, capacity and quality before production launch
* Partner with Supply Chain and Quality on make-versus-buy decisions, supplier development and capital business cases

**Lead and build the team**

* Set the vision, strategy and execution plan for NPI Operations Engineering
* Lead, hire and develop a team of manufacturing design engineers and supply base engineers, acting as the team's lead technical expert and mentor
* Integrate MDE and SBE into one team with shared programs, goals and ways of working
* Set priorities and staffing across multiple concurrent programs and SKUs at different stages, working with leaders across the company to understand build targets and focus the team on hitting them
* Protect the team's focus on new products, with a clean handoff to Process Engineering for sustaining
* Build an inclusive, diverse, engaged and high-performing team through a mix of external hiring and developing internal talent, with regular coaching and growth opportunities
* Build a culture of technical rigor, ownership and close partnership with design engineering

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Engineering leaders on airframes, propulsion, cameras, sensors, batteries, gimbals and payloads
* Align with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Test Engineering and Automation Engineering on capacity, equipment and handoff plans
* Communicate program status, risks and manufacturability trade-offs clearly to executive leadership

**What Makes You a Good Fit**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial or Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering, NPI or production engineering for complex electromechanical products, ideally including high-volume production.
* [4+] years leading engineering teams, including hiring and developing engineers [and managers].
* A track record of taking multiple complex hardware products from early development into high-quality production.
* Deep expertise in DFM/DFA and a history of influencing product design early, not only fixing problems at the build.
* Hands-on fixture design experience, and a strong understanding of factory lines, assembly flow and how to optimize them.
* SPC, Lean and Six Sigma experience.
* Experience working with suppliers on part qualification, process capability and production readiness.
* Strong data skills: you set yield, cycle-time and cost targets, measure them and use the data to drive decisions.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, working collaboratively with people at every level, from technicians to executive leadership.
* Strong project management, analytical skills and attention to detail, with sound independent judgment on complex, broad-scope problems.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving products, and willingness to be on the floor during critical builds.
* Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with drones, aerospace, robotics, autonomous systems or consumer electronics.
* Experience developing waterproofing and ingress-protection solutions (IP-rated products), conformal coating, sealing or adhesive processes.
* Experience with PCBAs, cameras and optics, gimbals, inertial sensors, motors, batteries or composite structures.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers or managing NPI across in-house and outsourced production.

**Compensation:**
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $229,500 - $302,500\*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.
 
 

* Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.
 
 
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.
 
 
For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

role.description:
At WK Kellogg Co, we exist to create joy and connection to inspire Gr-r-reat days. We believe that doing good is always good for business and we have stood for this since Kellogg Company was founded more than 120 years ago. We are passionate about doing our part to make nutritious foods, create social connectivity and respect natural resources. Together, these actions create positive progress for people and the planet – today and for years to come. We have big plans for how we are going to accomplish this, and we would love for you to join us in this effort.
 
 
**The most compelling leadership opportunities aren’t always about stepping into something already built. Sometimes they’re about helping shape what comes next.**
The
**Senior Manager, Plant Operations**
leads the strategic and operational direction of multiple business units within a high-performing, large-scale, 24/7 manufacturing operation, and line-centric manufacturing platform.
 
 
This role drives excellence across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development by empowering Operations Managers, Supervisors, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
 
 
**You won’t simply inherit an operation. You’ll have the opportunity to help build what comes next.**
**Working Relationships Include**

* Reports to: Plant Director
* Supervises: Operations Managers and Supervisors
* Peer Relationships: KSUM, Quality Manager, Sr. RM Manager, HR Manager, EHS Manager, E& F Manager, KIWS Coach
* Key Contacts: Internal – Plant Leadership Team, Corporate Operations, Engineering, KIWS, HR; External – Vendors, Contractors, and Corporate Support Functions

**Here’s What You Will Be Doing**

* Strategic Leadership: Set direction and priorities for assigned business units, ensuring alignment with plant goals and corporate strategy.
* Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Supervisor to build high-performing teams and future leaders.
* Operational Oversight: Ensure consistent execution of production plans and consistently deliver strong results across key plant KPIs, including safety, quality, food safety, cost, and service.
* Innovation & Project Execution: Lead the excellent execution of innovation and projects entering the plant, ensuring effective planning, cross-functional alignment, and successful implementation.
* Budgeting & Planning: Own the business planning and budgeting process for assigned units, including cost containment and resource allocation.
* Lean & CI Deployment: Champion and sustain lean manufacturing principles and WK Kellogg Integrated Work Systems (KIWS) across all units.
* Culture & Engagement: Drive a culture of safety, accountability, and engagement, promoting continuous learning and recognition.
* Compliance & Standards: Ensure compliance with all regulatory and internal standards related to safety, food safety, sanitation, and labor relations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with support functions and external stakeholders to optimize performance and resolve complex challenges.

**Work Environment**

* This role is based within a 24/7 union manufacturing facility.
* Must be flexible to work any shift and travel up to 25%
* Regular presence on the production floor required
* Frequent interaction with internal teams and external partners

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing
* Proven success in leading large teams and managing multiple production lines
* Strong understanding of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement systems
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others and build effective teams
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Experience in union environments preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and SAP
* Experience with budget creation and performance management
* Experience working within a 24/7 manufacturing environment is preferred

***Salary Range:***

*$164,160 - $205,200*
*Salary pay ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, certifications, qualifications, relevant education or training, and local market conditions.*
*At WK Kellogg Co, our success depends on our most vital asset — our people. That’s why we’re committed to providing you with benefits and programs that support your Total Health and your journey to be and feel your best — physically, financially, emotionally, and socially.*
*Although subject to change, the below are the benefits currently offered in association with this position:*

* Incentive Plan bonus eligibility
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Savings and Investment Plan with Company match and contribution
* Paid Time Off (includes paid sick time)
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Life Insurance, AD and D Insurance and STD/LTD
* Tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance for eligible employees
* Employee recognition program

*The above offerings are subject to the terms of WKKC policies, which will control in the event of a conflict with the above descriptions*
*Our comprehensive and competitive benefits not only deliver value to you and your family, but also offer choice to meet your unique needs and knowledge to empower confident decision-making.*
**About Wk Kellogg Co**
*At WK Kellogg Co, we bring our best to everyone, every day through our trusted foods and brands. Our journey began in 1894, when our founder W.K. Kellogg reimagined the future of food with the creation of Corn Flakes, changing breakfast forever. Since then, we have embraced the same spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship in everything we do, channeling our founder’s passion and commitment to creating high quality and delicious products while fostering communities. Our iconic brand portfolio includes Frosted Flakes, Rice Krispies, Froot Loops, Kashi, Special K, Raisin Bran, Frosted Mini Wheats, and Bear Naked. With a presence in the majority of households across North America, our brands play a key role in enhancing the lives of millions of consumers every day, promoting a strong sense of physical, emotional and societal wellbeing. Our beloved brand characters, including Tony the Tiger and Toucan Sam, represent our deep connections with the consumers and communities we serve. For more information, visit*
*www.wkkellogg.com*

Senior Manager of Quality
role.description:
****What Success Looks Like (Objectives):****
**Candidates must be willing to participate in at least one in-person interview.**
The Senior Manager of Quality leads the design, execution, and continuous improvement of quality management processes across all Manufacturing and Distribution (M&D) facilities. Operating across multi-site locations, this role resolves operational risks, standardizes compliance, and mitigates quality failures to maximize overall efficiency and customer satisfaction. The position serves as the primary driver for maintaining annual ISO 9001:2015 certification while building high-performing quality teams. Additionally, this role aligns quality operations with executive strategy by delivering data-driven ROI insights and performance metrics to C-level stakeholders.
 
 
****What Success Looks Like (Objectives):****

* Lead the strategy, implementation, and maintenance of the annual ISO 9001:2015 certification across all manufacturing and distribution facilities
* Oversee multi-site quality operations to optimize process compliance, supplier qualifications, failure analysis, and first article inspections
* Establish data-driven quality procedures and performance metrics aligned with organizational goals and departmental OKRs
* Partner with Hardware, Software, Operations, and C-level executive leadership to communicate project progress, risks, and financial ROI
* Direct and mentor a cross-functional team of quality engineers, technical writers, and quality analysts through comprehensive performance management
* Evaluate and integrate AI application tools to enhance predictive risk analysis, statistical process control, and automated quality reporting

**Core Skills, Competencies, and Key Experiences (What you’ll bring)**
****Core Skills And Competencies (What You’ll Bring):****

* Proven critical experience leading end-to-end Quality Management System (QMS) administration and complex operational risk mitigation across multi-site environments
* Advanced proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC), data interpretation, and quantitative decision-making
* Demonstrated strength in strategic cross-functional collaboration, executive presentation, and C-level stakeholder management
* High-level leadership expertise in team development, capacity planning, resource allocation, and supervisory oversight
* Applied AI literacy to identify and deploy emerging technologies that optimize root-cause failure analysis and quality workflows
* Strong problem-solving capabilities utilizing structured quality frameworks to define issues, establish facts, and execute sustainable solutions

****Additional Qualifications:****

* Active professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality, IPC-A-610, or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt
* Experience reading, analyzing, and interpreting scientific journals, legal documents, and financial reports

****Minimum Requirements:****

* Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Supply Chain, Quality Management, Operations, or a related field
* Minimum Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in quality management or manufacturing operations
* Required Technical Skills: Must have experience with:

+ ISO 9001:2015 standards and QMS implementation
+ IPC-A-610 standards
+ Statistical Process Control (SPC) and quality engineering tools

Visa sponsorship not available for this position
 
 
**Salary Range**
Compensation: $127,050.00/Year - $181,500.00/Year
 
 
****About Our Department****
Our Manufacturing teams are the gatekeepers who ensure our groundbreaking products meet the standards of innovation and performance we pride ourselves on. From the engineers who design large-scale production systems and cutting-edge quality assurance tools to the hands-on associates who manage our massive inventory flow, they make up a diverse group of behind-the-scenes team members dedicated to the success of our organization.
 
 
****About Our Company****
EchoStar is reimagining the future of connectivity. Our business reach spans satellite television service, live-streaming and on-demand programming, smart home installation services, mobile plans and products.
 
 
Today, our brands include Boost Mobile, DISH TV, Gen Mobile, Hughes and Sling TV.

Senior Manager, Pixel Buds Product Operations
role.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience managing hardware new product introduction (NPI) processes, factory ramp, and consumer electronics manufacturing operations.
* Experience leading and managing cross-functional technical teams (e.g., Operations Program Managers, Technical Program Managers, Supply Chain Program Managers).
* Experience partnering with external original design manufacturers (ODMs) and electronics manufacturing services (EMS) partners through Ok2Ship.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience delivering high-volume audio, wearables, or miniaturized consumer electronics hardware products.
* Experience driving Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Cost (DFC) initiatives across international agreement manufacturing sites.
* Experience managing engineering operations programs with executive-level stakeholder reporting and cross-functional hardware lifecycle alignment.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
 
 
The Head of Pixel Product Operations (Buds) will be responsible for the development and launch of Pixel Buds through the New Product Introduction (NPI) process through Ok2Ship, across the portfolio of Pixel Buds. You will be responsible for identifying and evolving best practices, and sustaining an organization that has scaled with execution.
 
 
You will lead a global team of various manufacturing teams - Operations Program Managers, System Technical Program Managers, Mechanical Technical Program Managers and Supply Chain Program Managers directly. As the Primary Manager from the Global Operations and Supply Chain organization responsible for the launch of the Pixel Buds programs, several other cross-functional teams rely on your leadership to guide the programs and products to success. You will need to balance engineering, operations, and quality processes and take into account the competitive dynamics to surpass the rate of innovation in the consumer electronics industry. This will encompass supporting large volume products and first generation products within the Pixel portfolio.
 
 
Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.
 
 
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
 
 
US: $236000 - $329000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Learn more about benefits at Google .
 
 

* Design, execute, and implement end-to-end factory and manufacturing solutions and processes and associated strategies that take into account the engaged dynamics of the Google hardware business.
* Lead a team of Operations professionals across both technical and non-technical domains to drive rapid time to market at immediate scale, with no compromise to Product Quality..
* Direct cross-functional teams across other business functions and initiatives in close partnership with key stakeholder groups like Hardware Engineering, Supplier Development Engineering, Software Engineering, Sourcing and Procurement, and Logistics.
* Create a culture that balances agility and flexibility with the expectation of new products that can scale.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

role.title: Director of Manufacturing and Operational Excellence
Director, Continuous Improvement
role.description:
Join Reynolds Consumer Products…and Drive Your Career across a world of opportunities!
 
 
We currently have an opportunity for a
**Continuous Improvement Director**
at our
**Lake Forest Corporate Headquarters**
plant in
**Lake Forest, IL**
. This position will support our Malvern, AK, Louisville, KY, Bellwood, VA, and Wheeling plants with up to 75% travel. This position could also be located at our Malvern, AK, or Louisville, KY locations.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
The
**Continuous Improvement Director**
will be responsible for driving continuous improvement and demonstrating maximum efficiency and delivery productivity for the entire Business Unit (BU) with disciplined process and world class measures. The Continuous Improvement Director will be a key creator of the Continuous Improvement and Digital Factory strategy for the BU, leveraging best practices across our manufacturing sites as we continue to develop our Boundless operating system across Reynolds Consumer Products (RCP). We embrace and accept individual experiences and backgrounds to achieve a diverse and inclusive workplace.
 
 
**You Will Have the Opportunity to Make Great Things Happen!**
**Strategy & Business Transformation**

* Develop plans, schedules, and budgets for tactical projects to improve existing processes; ensure cost-benefit evaluation for all assigned projects are completed to define potential financial, business and industry impacts of initiatives.
* Support the business leaders in the development of intermediate and long-term CI strategies to assure delivery of the projected CI Saving Budget.
* Create the digital manufacturing (IoT) strategy and coach plant teams on implementation and sustained performance enhancement as a result.
* Advise and influence senior leadership on business transformation topics that include organizational effectiveness, performance results, and change management in the terms of complexity and impact on the business.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Manage a CI Savings Budget across the Business Unit that represents an achievable value to deliver back to the business.
* Act as the subject matter expert for the core pillars of the Boundless operating system to assure sustained results, including assisting in training and plant acclimation to the new PEPS process.
* Drive the improvement of processes and systems in the plants and implement programs that will have continuing long-term benefits.
* Continuously evaluate and measure program or initiative performance and progress against goals and serve as a change agent within the organization.
* Monitor existing processes to make sure they continue to perform at optimal levels of efficiency achieving lowered conversion costs year-over-year.
* Direct all CI activities to include Kaizen events in 5S, SMED, TPM, VSM, PDCA or equivalent, A3 Problem Solving.
* Ensure adherence to Lean Methodology, including Kaizen, 5S, Standard Work, Daily Management, Layered Audit Process and Business Plan development to eliminate waste.
* Confer with management, engineering, and other staff regarding manufacturing capabilities, production schedules, and other considerations to facilitate production process improvements.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Effectively lead, manage, develop, coach, and evaluate team members and associates at various levels of experience.
* Develop and deliver Lean Training at all levels of the organization while driving Operational Excellence standards.

**You Will Love It Here If…**

* You listen, learn, and evolve
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment
* You put safety first, always
* You are passionate about collaboration, teamwork, and achieving shared goals
* You believe in treating all people with respect, operating ethically, and growing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
* You are committed to improving our impact on local communities and creating positive experiences

**Qualifications**
**Education/Experience**
**Required**

* BA/BS degree in Business, Supply Chain or related field.
* 10+ years of related professional Manufacturing with experience in Continuous Improvement and Operations.
* 3+ years in a leadership role focused on continuous improvement or operational excellence.

**Preferred**

* MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt strongly preferred.
* Previous experience with Automation and SAP strongly preferred.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Proficient in MS Office with advanced Excel Skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation skills and the ability to communicate and influence at all levels within the organization.
* Self-directed with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple accountabilities and multiple internal customers.
* Strong analytical skills as well as organizational skills with high attention to detail.
* Solid project management capabilities with the ability to organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously from origin through execution.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule during key business deadlines.
* Must be team oriented with the ability to work on high collaboration and performance teams.

**Competencies**

* Results Driven – Ability to focus on organizational growth, financial performance and achieving results.
* Critical Decision Maker – Clear, critical thinker that engages in thoughtful, data-driven decisions and has the ability to summarize and draw appropriate conclusions from complex data.
* Strategic Orientation – Ability to balance short-term goals with long-term organizational and functional strategic priorities.
* Innovative Thinking – A forward thinker who offers new, creative and often unconventional thoughts, opinions and methods for solution generation and problem solving.
* People Leadership – Ability to develop employees through coaching and feedback and holds team members accountable through modeling appropriate behavior.
* Compelling Communication – Effective written and verbal communicator that clearly and succinctly conveys information across all levels.

Want to know more? Check out our website or connect with us on LinkedIn!
 
 
**Apply today to join a fast-growing innovative company!**
Not a good fit but know someone who is? Please refer them!
 
 
**No unsolicited recruiter or agency inquiries, please.**
RCP affords equal employment opportunities to applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, disability status, sex, marital status, protected veteran status, pregnancy, national origin, genetics, genetic information, parental status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. RCP conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.
 
 
**Posted Salary Range**
USD $144,100.00 - USD $214,350.00 /A
 
 
**Bonus Eligibility**
Role is eligible for 25% annual incentive provided the business meets financial goals and the individual meets their performance goals, subject to plan administration guidelines.

Director of Quality-Operations
role.description:
**About Us:**
BW Papersystems, part of the Barry-Wehmiller Group, builds capital equipment that transforms paper into products for consumers - every day, around the world. We offer innovative technologies, service and parts, and years of global experience in corrugating, finishing; slitting and packaging; stationery; bookbinding and security documents. Customers rely on our machines to produce and convert items such as corrugated boxes, folding cartons, passports, notebooks, copy paper, board, and coated and other specialty papers. For more information, visit bwpapersystems.com.
 
 
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
 
 
**Job Description:**
The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy. In this critical role, the Director of Quality will be the leader in developing and maintaining a quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction, and to increase profitability in a safe working environment.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the management team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy.
* Develop and maintain a business/quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction and increase profitability in a safe working environment within the local business.
* Continuously assess the overall Quality Management System, Quality Plan and Quality Organization to determine priorities for quality improvement.
* Establish the key improvement priorities, and using a strategy deployment approach, develop and execute a cross-functional, strategic action plan to drive improvement.
* Identify the leading sources of customer dissatisfaction.
* Determine the underlying causes and develop/execute strategies to eliminate those causes.
* Determine the true, systemic root causes of internal failure and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Execute a strategy consisting of well-planned and executed preventive actions that reduce COPQ and other forms of waste.
* Drive improvements in process quality, production efficiency, and the elimination of the factors that drive variability and unforeseen disruptions.
* Drive a strategy that incorporates standard work, effective training, and recurring process audits to ensure process discipline.
* Establish and maintain appropriate KPIs that provide objective evidence of improvement
* Participate in training and coaching teams in the standard quality improvement approach and quality management standard requirements to develop organizational capability.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, quality, continuous improvement, or related field.
* 10+ years of professional experience leading a Quality Organization in capital equipment manufacturing environment.
* Experience with the execution of continuous improvement methodology such as Operational Excellence, Lean Manufacturing, Strategy Deployment, etc.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:**

* Requires the ability to independently resolve complex problems.
* Requires ability to manage a skilled and diverse staff, communicate effectively, represent the organization, act decisively, and influence decisions of senior managers and customers.
* Requires foresight to anticipate problems and recognize opportunities for cost-effectively improving operations.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Customer Focus – Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Instills Trust – Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* Drives Results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* Optimizes Work Processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Ensures Accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Collaborates – Building partnerships and collaborating with others to meet shared objectives.
* Decision Quality – Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

*The approximate pay range for this position is $155,000 to $210,000 base salary. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position.*
*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*
Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.
 
 
Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments.

BW Papersystems

role.title: Director of Quality
role.description:
**SUMMARY:** The Quality Director is responsible for the overall quality of the products manufactured or sourced for our customers.

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:**

* Evaluates production operations from a strategic level to ensure products meet quality, integrity, functionality and other specifications and requirements.
* Ensures quality system processes, procedures and records are maintained and effectively implemented. Supports IATF16949 efforts, ensuring the timely follow-up on open issues related to the Quality System.

* Develops and communicates quality goals and performance metrics to achieve company objectives.
* Interacts directly and indirectly with customers to resolve complex issues.

* Collaborates with management and senior staff across departments to develop and maintain quality standards to address internal and external quality requirements.
* Facilitates and oversees the effective implementation of quality controls and risk assessments in new product introductions and change management using established methodologies.
* Oversees quality problem investigations and the implementation of corrective and/or preventative action when the product or process does not conform to stated requirements. Reviews the implementation of effective preventative action based upon the regular review of quality assurance data to reduce variation and waste and meet company goals and objectives. Ensures the timely disposition of non-conforming materials.
* Develops and maintains the warranty and product return process and ensures processes are in place to identify opportunities, create action plans, and to provide feedback for product and process improvements.
* Responsible for the ongoing management and development of assigned employees to produce a high performing quality organization. Determines staffing and skill requirements to meet organizational needs and implements plans to satisfy those requirements.
* Monitors the use and effectiveness of the Quality system process. Reviews metrics and results on a regular basis to identify trends and/or potential problem areas.
* Other duties as assigned.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Quality Systems: ISO 9001/IATF 16949, Internal Auditor, Customer Specific Requirements
* Documentation: Quality inspections, submission change forms, DMS, BOM/Routing, Quality Metrics
* APQP: PPAP, MSA, SPC
* Problem Solving: Corrective Action, Preventive Action, 8D, Root Cause Analysis
* Computer Skills: O365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams), Minitab, SAP (or other ERP system)
* Demonstrated leadership ability
* Ability to interact with all levels of customers

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* B.S. Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
* Minimum 10 years of Quality Engineering experience

* Two years’ work experience managing a quality assurance department in a manufacturing setting.
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Lifting of product containers from assembly line to inspection point.

role.title: Quality Director
role.description:
**Quality Director**
--------------------

Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control

Reports To: Executive Leadership

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: INOX SOLAR Manufacturing Facility

**Job** **Summary**
-------------------

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading and overseeing all quality assurance and quality control activities at INOX SOLAR USA. This position ensures that solar modules, manufacturing processes, raw materials, and finished products meet established quality standards, customer requirements, applicable regulatory requirements, and company specifications.

The Quality Director develops and implements quality management systems, drives continuous improvement initiatives, leads quality investigations, and partners with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to reduce defects, improve product reliability, and maintain consistent manufacturing performance.

**Essential** **Duties** **and** **Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------------------

### **1.** **Quality** **Leadership** **and** **Strategy**

* Develop and implement the company's overall quality strategy, objectives, policies, and procedures.
* Establish quality performance metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and departmental goals.
* Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, including inspectors, technicians, engineers, and supervisors.
* Establish accountability for quality performance across all manufacturing departments.
* Provide regular quality performance reports, trend analyses, and improvement recommendations to executive leadership.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

### **2.** **Quality** **Management** **Systems** **and** **Compliance**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with applicable ISO standards, customer specifications, industry requirements, and internal quality procedures.
* Maintain controlled quality documentation, inspection records, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
* Lead internal audits, support external audits, and coordinate corrective actions resulting from audit findings.
* Maintain appropriate records to support product traceability, quality investigations, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate quality certification activities and customer or third-party audits as applicable.

### **3.** **Solar** **Module** **Manufacturing** **Quality**

* Oversee quality throughout the solar module manufacturing process, from incoming materials to final product release.
* Establish and maintain inspection standards for incoming materials, in-process production, and finished solar modules.
* Monitor manufacturing quality at critical production stages, including cell handling, stringing, layup, lamination, framing, junction box installation, EL testing, final inspection, and packaging.
* Ensure effective implementation of electroluminescence (EL) testing, visual inspections, electrical performance testing, and other required quality verification activities.
* Investigate manufacturing defects, process deviations, nonconforming products, and recurring quality issues.
* Work with Production and Engineering to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish procedures for product identification, traceability, nonconforming material control, and final product release.

### **4.** **Quality** **Control** **and** **Performance** **Improvement**

* Establish and monitor quality KPIs, including defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap rates, rework, customer complaints, and corrective action closure.
* Analyze quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead root cause analysis using appropriate methodologies, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Implement corrective and preventive action processes to prevent recurrence of quality issues.
* Partner with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce variation, and minimize manufacturing losses.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

### **5.** **Supplier** **and** **Incoming** **Quality** **Management**

* Establish supplier quality standards and incoming material inspection requirements.
* Collaborate with Purchasing, Supply Chain, and Engineering to evaluate supplier quality performance.
* Lead supplier corrective action requests and investigations involving defective or nonconforming materials.
* Monitor supplier quality trends and recommend supplier improvement plans when necessary.
* Support supplier audits, qualification activities, and ongoing supplier performance reviews.

### **6.** **Customer** **Quality** **and** **Product** **Reliability**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for significant customer quality concerns and escalations.
* Oversee investigations into customer complaints, product defects, and warranty-related quality issues.
* Coordinate corrective action responses and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Prepare quality reports and technical documentation for customers and executive leadership.
* Collaborate with relevant departments to identify opportunities to improve product reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Support product testing, validation, and quality requirements associated with new products and manufacturing process changes.

### **7.** **Leadership** **and** **Team** **Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate Quality Department employees.
* Establish clear departmental responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Provide training on quality standards, inspection procedures, documentation, and problem-solving methods.
* Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, and resources to support production quality requirements.
* Collaborate with department leaders to address quality issues and strengthen cross-functional communication.
* Encourage employees to identify quality risks and take appropriate action to prevent defects.

### **8.** **Risk** **Management** **and** **Continuous** **Improvement**

* Identify and evaluate risks that could affect product quality, reliability, safety, or customer satisfaction.
* Implement preventive controls to reduce the likelihood of manufacturing defects and product failures.
* Review quality risks associated with new equipment, process changes, materials, and product designs.
* Support change management processes to ensure changes are properly reviewed, validated, documented, and approved.
* Monitor emerging quality concerns and recommend appropriate preventive measures.
* Ensure lessons learned from quality incidents are incorporated into manufacturing procedures and employee training.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field required.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or Business Administration preferred.

### **Experience**

* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality control, or manufacturing quality management.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing quality teams or departments.
* Experience in solar module manufacturing, photovoltaic production, electronics manufacturing, or a related manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining quality management systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits, root cause investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing customer quality concerns, supplier quality issues, and manufacturing process improvements.

### **Technical** **Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ISO 9001 requirements.
* Familiarity with applicable photovoltaic module standards, such as IEC 61215 and IEC 61730, as relevant to the company's products and markets.
* Knowledge of manufacturing inspection methods, product testing, defect analysis, and quality documentation.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA, FMEA, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality reporting or manufacturing data systems.
* Ability to analyze complex quality data and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.

**Core** **Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strategic leadership and decision-making
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Effective communication and presentation skills
* Employee development and team management
* Risk assessment and corrective action management
* Continuous improvement and process optimization
* Customer focus and accountability

**Performance** **Measures** **(KPIs)**
---------------------------------------

The Director of Quality will be evaluated based on performance against established departmental and company goals, including:

* First-pass yield and overall production yield
* Manufacturing defect and nonconformance rates
* Scrap and rework reduction
* Customer complaints and warranty-related quality trends
* Corrective and preventive action closure rates
* Supplier defect rates and supplier corrective action performance
* Internal and external audit results
* Quality documentation accuracy and compliance
* Employee training completion and team performance
* Progress toward continuous improvement and product reliability goals

**Working** **Conditions**
--------------------------

* Work is performed in both an office and manufacturing environment.
* Regular presence on the production floor is required to monitor quality performance and support investigations.
* Must be able to work collaboratively with production personnel, engineers, technicians, suppliers, customers, and executive leadership.
* May require occasional extended hours or schedule flexibility to address significant quality issues, production concerns, audits, or customer escalations.
* Must comply with applicable company safety policies and manufacturing facility requirements.

**Equal** **Employment** **Opportunity**
----------------------------------------

INOX SOLAR is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
