role.description:
**Plant Manager – Furniture Manufacturing**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on, and results-driven **Plant Manager** to lead our furniture manufacturing operations. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to take ownership of plant performance, develop a strong leadership team, improve production processes, and make a direct impact on the success and growth of the facility.

The Plant Manager will oversee all aspects of plant operations, including production, safety, quality, scheduling, cost management, and employee development. This individual will provide leadership and oversight to department supervisors across the facility, ensuring all departments work together to achieve production, quality, safety, and operational goals.

The ideal candidate is a strong, people-focused leader with a solid manufacturing background who knows how to motivate teams, develop supervisors, improve processes, solve problems, and create a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Direct and oversee daily manufacturing operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, and delivery expectations are consistently met.
* Coordinate activities across departments to maximize productivity, efficiency, and workflow.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce waste, control labor costs, and increase operational efficiency.
* Develop and monitor production goals, performance metrics, and operational procedures.
* Oversee equipment needs, maintenance coordination, and resource planning to support production demands.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Provide overall leadership, direction, and oversight to department supervisors across all areas of the manufacturing plant.
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors to ensure effective management of their respective departments and teams.
* Establish clear performance expectations, goals, and accountability for department supervisors.
* Monitor departmental performance and work with supervisors to address challenges, improve productivity, and achieve production goals.
* Oversee employee training and development initiatives to build a skilled, productive workforce.
* Promote teamwork, communication, and collaboration between departments to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations.
* Foster a positive work environment focused on employee engagement, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Cost Management & Financial Performance**

* Develop and manage plant budgets while maintaining effective cost controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce labor and production costs without sacrificing quality or safety.
* Implement and maintain production cost tracking systems to evaluate manufacturing performance.
* Monitor labor utilization, productivity, and operating expenses to support profitability.

**Safety & Quality**

* Promote a safe working environment and ensure employees follow established safety procedures.
* Maintain high standards for product quality and accuracy throughout the manufacturing process.
* Monitor production processes and implement improvements to reduce defects, waste, and product returns.
* Ensure the facility has the necessary supplies, equipment, and resources to maintain safe and efficient operations.

**Systems & Process Improvement**

* Work closely with office personnel to improve administrative processes, reporting systems, and documentation.
* Establish and maintain effective production records and reporting procedures.
* Stay current with manufacturing technology, equipment, and industry best practices.
* Support improvements to systems and processes that enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and customer service.
* Perform other duties as needed to support the success of plant operations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing, production, scheduling, or operations experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership or supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supervisors and teams, manage performance, and drive operational results.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5–7 years of manufacturing operations or production management experience.
* Previous Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager, or similar leadership experience.
* Experience in furniture manufacturing or a similar production environment.
* Experience managing multiple departments and supervising department leaders.
* Experience managing production costs, labor efficiency, budgets, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field is a plus, but equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Employee development and performance management.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong time management and organizational abilities.
* Manufacturing and operational knowledge.
* Results-oriented mindset.
* Problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Attention to detail and accountability.

**What We Offer**

We value our employees and offer a benefits package designed to support their health, financial well-being, and work-life balance.

* Health Insurance available after 90 days.
* 401(k) retirement plan available after one year.
* Paid vacation.
* Additional company benefits.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This position operates in a furniture manufacturing facility. The work environment may include exposure to airborne particles, fumes, moving mechanical equipment, vibration, and elevated noise levels.

The position requires frequent standing, walking, reaching, and use of hands. Occasional sitting, climbing, balancing, bending, kneeling, crouching, and crawling may be required.

The ability to regularly lift or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds is required. Specific vision requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**About Justrite Safety Group**

At **Justrite Safety Group**, we're more than just a collection of industrial safety companies; we're a dynamic organization dedicated to protecting people, property, and the planet. Our ever-growing portfolio of companies collaborates to deliver advanced industrial safety solutions that set the standard for excellence.

As our business continues to grow, we continue to look for top talent to join our team as we lead the charge in revolutionizing industrial safety, ensuring that every worker returns home safe, every workplace remains secure, and our environment thrives for generations to come. With Justrite Safety Group, safety isn't just a priority—it's our passion.

**The Contribution You'll bring to this Role:**

The Plant Manager is a strategic plant leadership role accountable for the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of one of the Justrite sites responsible for metal fabrication. This role leads daily execution across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People (SQDCP) and ensures finished goods are produced to plan to support customer service and inventory targets.

The Plant Manager partners closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, and EHS to stabilize schedules, improve throughput, reduce scrap and rework, and sustain standard work. While there is no centralized warehouse, the Plant Manager ensures effective on-site staging, WIP control, and shipping coordination to support on-time delivery.

**About the Team:**

As a member of our **Operations** team, you will be dedicated to driving efficiency and excellence across all aspects of our business. With a focus on streamlined processes and innovative solutions, they ensure that our operations run smoothly and effectively. Comprised of skilled professionals who are leaders in their field, the team is committed to optimizing performance and delivering high-quality results. Their expertise is key to maintaining our competitive edge and supporting the growth and success of our company.

**What You'll Do at Justrite:**

**Safety, Environmental, and Compliance**

* Own site safety performance: eliminate hazards, strengthen near-miss reporting, and ensure timely corrective action closure.

* Ensure compliance with OSHA/local regulations, required training, PPE, and audit readiness.

* Lead incident investigations and implement sustainable countermeasures.

**Operations and Delivery Performance**

* Deliver daily and weekly production plan attainment while maintaining schedule stability and rapid issue escalation.

* Manage labor and staffing plans (shift coverage, overtime, cross-training) to meet output and service-level targets.

* Coordinate shipping priorities and finished goods readiness with Customer Service and Supply Chain.

**Quality and Process Control**

* Ensure product conformance to specifications; partner with Quality on containment, root cause, and corrective actions.

* Reduce scrap and rework through process controls, mistake-proofing, training, and layered process audits as applicable.

role.description:
The Howmet engines business produces world-class aerospace engine components, including investment castings, fasteners, rings and forgings. Our vacuum melted superalloys, machining, performance coatings and hot isostatic pressing for high performance parts enable the next generation of quieter, cleaner and more fuel-efficient aerospace engines. Able to supply more than 90% of structural and rotating aerospace engine components. 
 

Howmet Engines seeks an experienced professional to join our team! The **Continuous Improvement Director** at Howmet Aerospace is responsible for driving the implementation and sustained use of Lean principles, enhancing operational efficiency and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across the business segment This role serves as a teacher, coach and mentor, working closely with employees at all levels to build long-term adoption of CI practices. The Continuous Improvement Director partners with Senior Leadership to align improvement initiatives with business objectives, ensuring measurable impact on productivity, capacity and overall business segment performance.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead the continued development and enhancement of the Howmet Business System journey, including accelerating the Lean Execution Systems Assessment process and progress, working with plant teams on gap closure plans in support of advancing the CI culture across the business segment.
* Facilitate the Howmet Business System “HBS” journey best practice sharing within the location and across teams through a sustainable electronic system that allows users to search for common issues or problems.
* Lead OEE improvement actions deep dive with leaders and provide avenues for best practice sharing.
* Lead Howmet Business System implementation of continuous improvement initiatives and drive waste reductions utilizing Lean principles (JIT, Autonomation, Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S, Standard Work, Line/Cell Design, Single Piece Flow, Material Flow, Visual Management, SMED, TPM, Root Cause Problem Solving, etc.)
* Facilitate Hoshins, Kaizens, problem solving, and rapid improvement process events with internal personnel at all levels of the organization, consultants, customers, and suppliers as needed. This includes providing support to sustain all follow-throughs required to sustain the improvements initiated during those events, especially those concentrated on local improvement.
* Understand and analyze Profit and Loss (P&L) statements to identify opportunities for cost reduction, revenue enhancement, and margin improvement. Lead and collaborate with cross functional internal teams focused on shop floor factory improvements, which could include CAPEX.
* Assist team leaders in team skill and knowledge development to support meeting management goals, project management, improvements, results measurements, problem solving and related team skills.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress and measure the impact of improvement initiatives.
* Drive change management efforts to ensure successful implementation and sustainability of process improvements.
* Identify and share best practices, lessons learned, and success stories to promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the organization.
* Provide coaching and mentorship to team members across the organization to drive the Continuous Improvement mindset.
* May participate or lead other targeted initiatives or kaizens as directed by the BU, as defined by the Segment Vice President.
* Role may support other sites’ continuous improvement activities, as needed (e.g., training, project-based work, best practice support, etc.)

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in manufacturing environments in areas such as: Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, or Operational Excellence
* Minimum of 7 years in leadership roles in Operations or Continuous Improvement
* Previous experience in an aerospace, automotive or other manufacturing environment requiring significant lean strategies to maintain wins and propel the organizations’ success through Continuous Improvement
* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution
* Must be willing to travel up to 50% of the time, including domestic and international travel
* Strong working knowledge and understanding of Continuous Process Improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* This position is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) which requires U.S. person status. ITAR defines U.S. person as an U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee
* Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and Master's Degree from an accredited institution in Engineering or Supply Chain field of study highly desired
* Project Management certification or earned certificate
* Experience developing operations leadership development programs in a manufacturing environment
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing improvement techniques, including hoshin, flow principles, Jidoka, Kanban, 5S, and “plan for every part” (PFEP).
* Strong skills in value stream mapping and associated improvement methodologies.
* Understanding of pillars of Toyota production system (JIT, Jidoka).
* Experience evaluating TAKT time vs. cycle time, determining work area constraints (i.e. cycle time constraint, periodic work constraints, downtime constraints).
* Experience on the shop floor, working with employees, and enhancing manufacturing processes.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills require the ability to resolve conflicting interests and obtain cooperation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: able to develop and use structured approaches to identify root causes and recommend resolutions.
* Demonstrated experience in project leadership and project management skills, with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

If a pay range is identified for this job, it is based on a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Actual compensation is subject to variation due to factors such as education, experience, skillset, market/business considerations, and/or location.

Howmet Aerospace offers a competitive benefits package to support the health, financial well-being, and professional growth of our employees. Benefits include:

* Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision benefits coverage, including FSA and HSA account options
* Pre-tax and Roth 401(k) retirement savings plans offering employer matching funds and a separate employer retirement contribution
* Paid holidays and vacation time (eligibility, accrual, and usage are discretionary and governed by applicable policies)
* Paid parental leave and adoption assistance programs
* Life insurance and disability coverage plans
* Optional coverage plans for auto, home, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance

Howmet Aerospace Inc. (NYSE: HWM), headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. Our primary businesses focus on jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems, titanium structural parts and forged wheels. With $8.3 Billion in revenue in 2025, our products play a crucial role in enabling fuel efficiency and lightweighting, contributing to our customers’ success and making a positive impact on the world. role.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering (Burnet, TX)
role.description:
**Job Title:**

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering (Burnet, TX)

**Job Description:**

**THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering is responsible for leading manufacturing quality across two Entegris manufacturing sites in Texas and translating global quality standards and quality priorities into consistent site execution. This role provides multi-site leadership to reduce risk, strengthen process capability, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver measurable quality improvements across the two-site footprint. 
 
The Senior Manager partners with site Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, Customer Quality, Product Quality and Quality Systems teams to embed quality ownership into daily operations. This leader is accountable for site quality performance, consistent implementation of quality standards, compliance with applicable regulatory, industry, and customer requirements, and the development of capable site quality teams. The role leads through site quality leaders and teams, establishes clear ownership and follow-through, and escalates risks and resource needs to North America quality leadership.

The hired individual will work on-site at our Burnet, TX location with some travel to our Decatur, TX location.

 

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Translate global quality standards and quality priorities into coordinated execution plans for the two Texas sites, with clear owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead manufacturing quality across all two sites through site quality leaders and teams; clarify responsibilities, prioritize resources based on risk, and maintain regular on-site engagement.
* Ensure consistent implementation of global quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices; maintain audit readiness and timely closure of findings at each site.
* Partner with site Operations leaders to establish quality roadmaps, objectives, and common key performance indicators (KPIs); conduct routine cross-site reviews and drive recovery plans where performance falls short.
* Own quality improvement plans that reduce defects, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality (COPQ), customer complaints, and manufacturing escapes, with site-level accountability for results.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve process capability, product conformity, yield, and manufacturing performance through effective process controls and proactive risk management.
* Lead targeted continuous improvement and change implementation across the two sites; standardize effective practices and verify that improvements are sustained.
* Ensure timely containment, disciplined root cause analysis, corrective/preventive action, and effectiveness verification for significant quality issues; deploy lessons learned across all two sites.
* Ensure practical, sustained application of SPC, MSA, FMEA, control plans, APQP, PPAP, 8D, A3, and DMAIC methodologies, as applicable to site processes and customer requirements.
* Serve as the quality escalation leader for the two Texas sites; communicate risk, containment status, recovery plans, and decisions needed, and escalate significant issues to Quality leadership.
* Partner with Customer Quality and Product Quality teams to resolve customer issues through timely, evidence-based investigations, effective corrective actions, and proactive communication.
* Develop site quality leaders and teams through coaching, clear expectations, technical capability building, and succession planning; identify staffing and resource needs across the two sites.
* Foster shared quality ownership across functions, reinforce accountability for commitments, and promote collaboration and continuous improvement across the two sites.
* Travel requirements will be a minimum of 25%, including regular presence across the two Texas sites.

**WHAT WE SEEK**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including leadership responsibility for quality teams and manufacturing quality outcomes.
* 5+ years of quality management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead through site leaders or cross-functional teams; multi-site leadership experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success implementing quality systems and delivering sustained improvements in manufacturing quality, process capability, and cost of poor quality.
* Ability to coordinate priorities, standardize practices, and maintain effective leadership presence across two manufacturing sites in Texas.
* Experience supporting customer and supplier quality requirements, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable regulatory and industry requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence site leaders, resolve competing priorities, and communicate risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience coaching quality leaders, developing technical capability, and building team depth and succession readiness across sites.
* Demonstrated ability to lead practical change, establish clear ownership, and sustain common quality practices in partnership with Operations and Engineering.
* Strong problem-solving, data analysis, and business acumen, with practical application of quality tools to prioritize risk, improve manufacturing processes, and deliver measurable results.

**WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS?** 
Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. 
 
Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.

**WHAT WE OFFER** 
Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.

* Compensation: The salary range for this position is $134,000- $196,500 per year. Final compensation will depend on the candidate's overall skills and qualifications for the role.
* Annual bonus eligibility
* Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge
* Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting
* Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs
* Education assistance to support your learning journey
* A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence

*Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.*

*At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.*

role.description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's **Quality & Regulatory Affairs** function, a team that ensures our products are in compliance with global, local, and internal regulations and meet the strictest standards of quality as we help people see brilliantly.

The **Sr. Manager, Quality Control Labs** is primarily responsible for leading laboratory operations, ensuring compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), and Good Documentation Practice (GDP), and managing personnel qualifications and equipment validation. You will supervise Out of Specification (OOS), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and Out of Trend (OOT) investigations, implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and oversee Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE), budget, and Quality Assurance (QA) functions at our **Manufacturing Facility in Houston, TX.** Specifics Include:

 

* Lead multiple teams in quality control labs to ensure product and raw material compliance with specifications and standards.
* Guide and supervise team activities, make key decisions, approve projects, and allocate resources.
* Oversee Microbiology, Analytical Science and Technology (AS&T), Incoming Inspection, and Calibration / Metrology for quality and customer compliance.
* Ensure adherence to GxP regulations, SOPs, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Promote rigorous quality control and complete all required training.
* Encourage associates to meet job requirements and contribute to organizational compliance.
* Develop strategies and provide directions to the Quality Control team to ensure they are meeting customer deadlines, metrics/KPI reporting, timely completion of CAPAs/Action items.
* Develop and improve QA programs, policies, processes, procedures, and controls to ensure that product performance and quality conform to established standards and agency guidelines.
* Provide support for internal and external audit inspections.
* Provide strategic leadership to the Quality Control team to establish metrics to monitor, improve, and sustain performance.
* Allocate resources to lead, plan, and execute project activities in alignment with site initiatives and budgetary requirements.
* Review and approval of quality documents, change controls related to Quality Control, and deviation management records.
* All associates must adhere to GxP regulations by strictly following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintaining accurate and complete documentation, ensuring rigorous quality control, and completing all required training.
* Compliance with regulatory requirements and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential to our operations.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +15 yrs; Assoc.+11 yrs; M.S.+4 yrs; PhD+3 yrs)
* The ability to fluently read, write, understand and communicate in English

* 5 years of demonstrated leadership

role.title: Senior Manager, Flight Line Quality Control
role.description:
**Job Description:**

**Summary of Position****:**

The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line Quality Control Management, and Execution of Helicopter Flight Line of an FAA part 21 approved Quality System. The Senior Manager, Quality Control of Flight Line will ensure compliance and safety, balanced with cost in alignment with operations to safely bring aircraft to pre-flight, ground test, and flight testing. Driving the finalization process to the delivery and acceptance intent on ZERO defect aircraft being presented to customers. Provide technical leadership, leaning on knowledge of FAA P21 requirements, AS9100, and aerospace knowledge. The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line, will also focus on personnel management and development, ensuring competencies equal to the business and market requirements. The Senior Manager will have a Continuous Improvement approach to processes while executing to the business plan.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities****:**

* Safe and on time actions bringing Production Helicopters to Operation, Ground Run, Flights, Acceptance & Delivery to Customer
* Resource Management, deployment of resources, training and building out Competencies of resources to meet customer and market demand
* Ensure compliance of Quality System with all relevant, FAA guidelines, procedures and policies.
* Represents QC as the prime contact for customer delivery activities
* Proactive measures in the planning and execution of aircraft operations, customer Acceptance and Delivery activity
* Continuous Improvement: using methods like DMAIC, statistical analysis to understand and improve processes and contributing to the efficiency of the Flight Line Operation

**Qualifications for Position****:**

**A. Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aviation Management, or a related technical discipline

**B. Experience**

* 5+ years of management and Quality experience or Equivalent

**C. Competencies & Attributes**

The successful candidate will have a working knowledge of AS9100 QMS and FAA requirements. Experience in Lean/Six Sigma, and a demonstrated approach to the job is a must. Must be a Leader and Change Agent with sound fundamentals in Quality Principles in Aerospace and Continuous Improvement. This Leader must demonstrate the ability to engage with partners and shareholders to find solutions, in execution and process. The candidate mut also demonstrate the ability to engage with stakeholders at Executive levels, internally, and externally including customers from the commercial and defense sectors.

**D. Licensure/Certification**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt desired, Green belt required
* ASQ Certification highly desired
* FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) License or verified military equivalent desired

**Primary Location:**

US - Philadelphia

role.title: Senior Director of Quality, Compliance and Risk
role.description:
**New England Village**

**Position:** Senior Director of Quality, Compliance and Risk

**Location:** Pembroke, MA 02359 (on-site)

**Salary:** $105,000-$120,000 annually

**Position Summary**

New England Village is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Quality, Compliance & Risk to provide organization-wide leadership for quality management, regulatory compliance, risk management, accreditation readiness, policy governance, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior leadership role for a professional with substantial prior experience in quality management and regulatory compliance within a complex, highly regulated environment. The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience leading quality and/or compliance functions and building systems that translate regulatory requirements, organizational findings, data, and risk into measurable and sustainable improvement.

The Senior Director works across programs and support departments to promote consistent standards, effective monitoring, clear accountability, regulatory readiness, and continuous improvement. Department leaders remain responsible for the quality, compliance, and performance of their respective areas, while the Senior Director provides the organizational framework, oversight, consultation, analysis, and escalation necessary to support enterprise accountability.

The Senior Director serves as New England Village's designated Compliance Officer, directly supervises the Director of Program Improvements & Supports and the Director of Program Implementation & Practice, and serves as a member of the Senior Leadership Team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and continuously strengthen the organization's quality management framework, including the Quality Management Plan, performance indicators, monitoring systems, trend analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the organization's Compliance Officer and lead the continued development, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of a formal enterprise compliance program.
* Maintain organizational readiness for licensing, accreditation, regulatory reviews, audits, surveys, investigations, inspections, and other external reviews.
* Establish and oversee effective approaches to internal quality and compliance review, risk assessment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, monitoring, and verification that improvements are sustained.
* Develop and maintain an organizational approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, monitoring, and escalating significant regulatory, service, health and safety, privacy, financial, operational, and organizational risks.
* Analyze incidents, complaints, investigations, audit findings, corrective actions, regulatory findings, performance measures, and other data to identify patterns, systemic concerns, recurring issues, and emerging risks
* Lead and support effective policy and procedure governance, ensuring regulatory and organizational requirements are translated into practical and sustainable operations.
* Ensure significant findings result in meaningful corrective and improvement actions, with assigned accountability, measurable outcomes, follow-up, and evidence of effectiveness.
* Provide leadership and professional development to functions responsible for quality assessment, compliance monitoring, program improvement, implementation support, training, and practice fidelity.
* Work collaboratively with program and support leaders while maintaining the independence and objectivity necessary to identify concerns, challenge practices, and escalate significant or unresolved risk.
* Monitor changes in applicable regulatory and funding requirements and coordinate appropriate changes to policies, procedures, systems, training, monitoring, and organizational practices.
* Provide clear analysis, reporting, and recommendations regarding significant quality, compliance, regulatory, and risk matters to senior and executive leadership and designated Board committees.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in human services, healthcare administration, quality management, compliance, public administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience in human services, healthcare, behavioral health, Medicaid-funded services, or a comparable highly regulated environment, including at least five years with significant responsibility for quality management, regulatory compliance, risk management, accreditation, or related organizational assurance functions.
* At least three years of progressive leadership experience, preferably including supervision of managers, senior professionals, or multidisciplinary functions.
* Knowledge of Massachusetts DDS and MassHealth requirements, with direct experience in IDD or comparable Massachusetts human services strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading a quality and/or compliance function, with responsibility for activities such as regulatory monitoring, internal review or audit, corrective action, quality improvement, investigations, risk assessment, or accreditation/licensing readiness.
* Demonstrated experience developing and operating formal quality or compliance systems, including monitoring plans, audit/review processes, corrective-action systems, quality measures, risk tracking, policies and procedures, and reporting to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience preparing an organization for licensing, accreditation, regulatory audits, surveys, investigations, or external reviews, including responding to findings and monitoring corrective actions through resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze quality, compliance, incident, and operational data; identify systemic or recurring issues; conduct or guide root-cause analysis; and translate findings into measurable improvement.
* Experience presenting significant quality, compliance, and risk findings and recommendations to executive leadership, Boards or Board committees, regulators, auditors, accreditation bodies, or other external reviewers.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Excel, SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Forms, and Teams, and experience using technology to improve monitoring, reporting, workflow, and accountability.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a related field.
* Direct professional experience supporting services regulated by Massachusetts DDS and/or MassHealth.
* Direct experience in IDD or comparable Massachusetts human services.
* Previous experience serving as a Compliance Officer or in a significant leadership role within a formal organizational compliance program.
* Experience developing or administering confidential reporting, complaint, investigation, and non-retaliation processes.
* Experience with CARF accreditation, Massachusetts DDS licensing, MassHealth audit readiness, or comparable accreditation and regulatory-review processes.
* Professional certification such as CPHQ, CHC, CCEP, Lean Six Sigma, PMP, or another relevant quality, compliance, risk, or improvement credential.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, or comparable technology used to support monitoring, workflow, reporting, and organizational accountability

role.description:
Sun Life U.S. is one of the largest providers of employee and government benefits, helping approximately 50 million Americans access the care and coverage they need. Through employers, industry partners and government programs, Sun Life U.S. offers a portfolio of benefits and services, including dental, vision, disability, absence management, life, supplemental health, medical stop-loss insurance, and healthcare navigation. We have more than 6,400 employees and associates in our partner dental practices and operate nationwide.

 

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 

Visit our website to discover how Sun Life is making life brighter for our customers, partners and communities.

*DentaQuest manages dental and vision benefits for more than 33 million Americans. Our outcomes-based, cost-effective solutions are designed for Medicaid and CHIP, Medicare Advantage, small and large businesses, and individuals. With a focus on prevention and value, we aim to make quality care accessible to improve the oral health of all.*

**Job Description:**

**Location:** Sun Life embraces a hybrid work model that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility of virtual work. Our team members and leaders are expected to foster connection and teamwork by being present in the office at least 2 days per week.

 

**The opportunity:**

The Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance leads the Quality Assurance function within Dental Shared Services and is accountable for the consistent execution of quality monitoring, audit, calibration, reporting, and improvement activities across supported operations. This role manages quality teams and programs, translates performance data into actionable recommendations, and partners with Operations, Compliance, Training, Workforce Management, Client Engagement, Technology, and Business Process Outsourcing partners to strengthen controls, address risk, and improve member, provider, client, and business outcomes.

 
 

**How you will contribute:**

* Manage the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of quality assurance programs across Dental Shared Services and supported operational functions, including Contact Center, Claims, Utilization Management, Provider Operations, Complaints and Grievances, Member Enrollment, Intake and Digital Services, and Vision operations.

* Establish and maintain audit procedures, sampling approaches, quality standards, calibration routines, and reporting practices aligned with contractual, regulatory, client, and internal control requirements.

* Lead, coach, and develop quality leaders and professionals by setting clear expectations, balancing workloads, monitoring productivity and accuracy, and supporting engagement, accountability, and career development.

* Analyze quality results, disputes, appeals, re-audits, and operational trends to identify root causes, emerging risks, and practical opportunities for improvement.

* Partner with Operations, Training, Workforce Management, Compliance, Client Engagement, Technology, and BPO leadership to develop and monitor corrective actions, coaching plans, training updates, and sustainable performance improvements.

* Manage client audit and calibration activities, including call and case selection, audit review, documentation preparation, meeting participation, follow-up, and timely response to client or regulatory inquiries.

* Coordinate quality support for internal, external, regulatory, and client audits; prepare evidence, contribute to management action plans, validate remediation, and track findings through closure.

* Implement quality improvement and technology initiatives, including automation, speech analytics, AWS Contact Lens, end-to-end review models, enhanced reporting, and expanded quality monitoring capabilities.

* Assess staffing, capacity, audit volumes, and competing priorities; recommend resource adjustments that support required coverage, service commitments, and cost-effective delivery.

* Maintain enhanced oversight for high-risk, high-profile, and penalty-impacting clients through targeted audit criteria, clear escalation paths, and proactive communication routines.

* Represent Quality Assurance in cross-functional forums, operational readiness activities, transformation projects, vendor discussions, compliance meetings, and leadership reviews.

* Prepare and present quality results, risks, recommendations, and improvement plans to business leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners.

* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, continuous improvement, collaboration, and client-focused service delivery.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

 
 

**What you will bring with you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in quality assurance, healthcare operations, dental operations, contact center operations, claims, compliance, or related business operations.

* Three or more years of leadership or people management experience, preferably in a quality assurance, operations, or shared services environment.

* Experience supporting government, commercial, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, or other regulated healthcare programs preferred.

* Strong knowledge of quality monitoring, audit methodology, calibration, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, internal controls, and performance improvement practices.

* Experience working with BPO partners, client audits, regulatory audits, and cross-functional operational teams preferred.

* Experience with reporting, dashboards, quality analytics, speech analytics, call recording tools, contact center platforms, or AWS Contact Lens preferred.

* Sound business judgment with the ability to connect quality performance to client, compliance, operational, and financial outcomes.

* Strong people leadership, coaching, performance management, and talent development skills.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend practical solutions.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings, risks, and recommendations to leaders, clients, and cross-functional audiences.

* Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and build effective partnerships across Operations, Compliance, Training, Technology, Client Engagement, and vendor teams.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through change, implement standardized processes, and support technology-enabled transformation.

* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, confidentiality, and ethical business practices.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.

 

**Salary:** $76,000 - 115,000

At our company, we are committed to pay transparency and equity. The salary range for this role is competitive nationwide, and we strive to ensure that compensation is fair and equitable. Your actual base salary will be determined based on your unique skills, qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. role.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 9 Nov 2026 
 

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Working closely with leaders across Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, and Digital organizations globally, you will establish and scale capabilities in root cause investigation, reliability engineering, advanced analytics, and quality intelligence. You will play a key role in driving investigation excellence, accelerating problem resolution, improving CAPA effectiveness, and enabling a more predictive and proactive quality organization. This role requires a leader who can influence across organizational boundaries, develop technical capability, and guide the resolution of the most complex quality and reliability challenges facing the business. The role aligns with the organization's vision of connecting customer experience, field performance, analytics, reliability, and quality intelligence to improve business decisions and quality outcomes.
 
 
As Senior Director, Quality Strategy & Investigation Excellence, you will be accountable for building and sustaining capabilities across Reliability Engineering, Statistics & Analytics, and Root Cause Excellence. You will lead multiple strategic workstreams including investigation methodology, Quality Reliability Engineering capability development, advanced analytical approaches, and critical quality event support. You will partner across a global matrix to strengthen investigation effectiveness, improve organizational learning, and ensure quality decisions are increasingly data-driven, risk-based, and customer-focused. role.title: Sr. Director Operations Engineering - C&I
role.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

**Sr Director, Operations Engineering**
=======================================

The Sr Director, Operations Engineering is responsible for leading the enterprise Operations Engineering function with a focus on New Product Launches, Operations Integrations, Product Moves, and Operations Standards. This role ensures that new products, newly integrated operations, and transferred products are launched and sustained in manufacturing safely, on time, at quality, and at target cost. Through the development and deployment of enterprise standards, best practices, and the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS), the Director drives consistent, world-class execution across the Order-to-Cash process (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver & Service). The role partners closely with Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, HR, and Business Unit leadership, and supports Generac's global manufacturing portfolio.

**Major Responsibilities**
--------------------------

### **New Product Launches (NPI)**

* Lead and coordinate the successful launch of New Product Introductions (NPI) within operations, from early design involvement through production ramp and sustained performance.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new products, including process design, PFMEA, line layout, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and capacity planning.
* Partner with Product Engineering to drive design for manufacturability and assembly so new products launch with optimal cost, quality, and delivery.
* Establish launch gates, readiness criteria, and success metrics, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to them.
* Lead and support the introduction of new and revised processes and technologies that support cost reduction and competitive advantage.

### **Operations Integrations**

* Lead the operational integration of new sites, acquisitions, and expanded capacity into the Generac manufacturing network, aligning processes, systems, and performance expectations.
* Lead and contribute to facility transformation, including layout, mixed-model lines, value stream design, and deployment of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS).
* Assess integrated facilities, infrastructure systems, and technology against best-in-class capability and develop roadmaps to close gaps.
* Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with HR, Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and senior leadership to ensure integrations meet business objectives.
* Incorporate workplace optimization, space planning, and long-term facility planning into integration plans.

### **Product Moves & Transfers**

* Lead the planning and execution of product moves and technology transfers between facilities and with external supply chain partners, ensuring continuity of supply, quality, and cost.
* Own and continuously improve the product transfer procedure, and support the Operations Product Transfer Steering Committee to ensure alignment and adherence to the procedure.
* Develop transfer plans that include capacity validation, equipment and tooling relocation, process validation, training, and inventory bridge strategies.
* Partner with Business Unit and Manufacturing Strategy leaders to support footprint, rebalancing, and new capacity decisions with sound operations engineering analysis.

### **Operations Standards**

* Develop with corporate Advanced Manufacturing, deploy, and sustain enterprise operations engineering standards, policies, procedures, and process documentation that drive consistent execution across all facilities.
* Drive significant contributions to the implementation of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS) across the Order-to-Cash process.
* Develop and implement operating methodologies designed to maximize floor space utilization, asset uptime and utilization, eliminate waste, and reduce operating cost.
* Champion lean principles and continuous improvement, and ensure the ongoing success of process improvement initiatives.
* Establish and monitor KPIs to evaluate productivity, engineering output, launch performance, and facility efficiency, using data to drive improvement.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards, and incorporate sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

### **Project Management & Financial Stewardship**

* Drive and project manage major cost, quality, and delivery initiatives, with a strong focus on breakthrough process and technology improvements.
* Facilitate project flow through regular engagement with engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams, managing shifting priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Oversee capital projects related to launches, integrations, and product moves, and provide budgetary figures for future fiscal year planning.
* Manage the operations engineering budget and support reduction of the operating cost of each facility consistent with company objectives.

### **Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead the Operations Engineering team, including project planning, technical guidance, and resource allocation across sites and initiatives.
* Select, coach, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and project managers, setting objectives that align with company strategy.
* Manage organizational talent through performance management, succession planning, and development, ensuring feedback is consistently delivered and performance is systematically improved.
* Provide guidance to cross-functional teams and leadership on key decisions related to investment in core manufacturing technologies, processes, and systems.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial) or Industrial Technology.
* **Work Experience:** 10+ years of related experience in Operations Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, including leading new product launches and product transfers.
* **Leadership Experience:** 5+ years of increasing responsibility for project and/or people management involving a broad range of operational technologies and processes.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of New Product Development, PFMEA, and operations engineering principles.
* Knowledge of lean principles, continuous improvement, and end-to-end supply chain principles.
* Experience operating in both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume, low-mix production environments.
* Ability to assess and manage end-to-end processes and to manage strategic and tactical issues by being hands-on.
* Ability to develop and deploy standards and best practices across multiple sites.
* Ability to attract, develop, and manage an impactful team.
* Demonstrated skills in problem solving, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leadership.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple projects with shifting priorities and moving deadlines.
* Proficiency in a CAD platform (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and/or ProE), MS Office, and ERP platforms.

**Preferred Job Requirements**
------------------------------

* Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.
* Project Management certification (e.g., PMP).
* Experience deploying processes and standards at an enterprise level, both internally and with external supply chain partners.
* Experience leading operations integrations, facility transformations, and multi-site product transfers.
* Experience working in an international company and in matrix organizations, with multi-site support experience.
* Previous experience using SAP or an equivalent ERP.
* Experience with facilities engineering and with using and/or implementing CMMS systems.
* Large-scale project management experience.

The Director of Operations is responsible for supporting the mission, vision and values of First Watch through all that he/she does in their role every day. The DO’s primary purpose is to develop General Managers and restaurant management teams to build and increase sales over the previous year and improve profitability, while ensuring employee and guest satisfaction, without compromising the integrity or You First culture of the concept. The Director of Operations is responsible for the success of all First Watch operations within their span of control (5-8 direct reports and 200-300 employees).

**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads operational activities for a group of First Watch Restaurants by performing the following in accordance with Company guidelines regarding management development, sales, and profitability, planning and customer and employee relations
* Trains, coaches and develops General Managers and Operations Managers, through timely performance and observation feedback and evaluations
* Follows up on training of MIT's/CAFE’s and hourly employees. Works closely with the Training General Manager to monitor progress
* Ensures development of Operations Managers within compliance of the FW management development programs
* Through effective manpower planning executes the continuous development of the management team and ensures timely and cost effective recruitment of restaurant level management and their training within First Watch
* Ensures the maintenance of a safe and harassment free workplace in all restaurants
* Takes quick and responsible action in solving problems and able to uses reason when dealing with individual or staff performance based issues to include personality conflicts
* Develops for prior approval and then meets or exceeds the area’s budget, including capital investments, General and Administrative expenses
* Promotes First Watch outside the restaurant

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent – concentration in food & beverage, business, marketing or management is preferred
* Five to seven years of progressive leadership experience in multi unit restaurant industry operations
* Proven track record of achieving results and building & maintaining successful teams
* Passion for providing excellent service and quality
* Ability to partner and build relationships while demonstrating leadership and integrity and promoting team success
* Extensive knowledge of the principles, procedures, and best practices in the industry
* Ability to work well under pressure in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel frequently within assigned market

This role serves as a cross-functional operational leader, working collaboratively across the organization to define, optimize, and standardize business processes and operating procedures. It involves partnering with system end-users to design efficient workflows, implement cross-functional process improvements, and documenting operational policies. The role actively contributes to system and operational enhancement efforts by collaborating with Product, Technology, and Clinical leadership, ensuring technology is effectively leveraged to support business needs. It requires strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills to influence operations across departments, foresee enterprise-level implications of changes, and manage risks and issues through resolution. With strong organizational and time management abilities, this individual provides operational expertise to market leadership, supports execution of P&L goals, and serves as a subject matter expert and guide to peers and teams across the enterprise.

Salary Range: $110,000 - $175,088

* Dyad partner to the CMD bringing together operational and clinical excellence to lead the community.
* Work collaboratively across the business to define, optimize, and evolve standard operating procedures and business process standardization across the enterprise
* Work with system/technology end-users to develop optimal system workflows to enable desired business process; Identify and implement cross-functional process improvements
* Document operational policies and procedures
* Working collaboratively with Product leadership, leverage understanding of business process to participate in future requirements gathering for system or operational enhancements or selection, across the enterprise
* Collaborate with Product, Technology and Clinical leadership to optimize and maximize use of selected technology
* Lead, persuade, influence, and negotiate with respect to market operations, as well as within Operations Department and among other supporting departments
* Understand and foresee enterprise/company implications of subtle detail changes
* Track issues/risks and follow through on resolution with departmental leads; Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, including demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and tactfully to internal and external stakeholders
* Possess highly effective time management and organizational skills to independently manage self to achieve multiple objectives and meet deadlines
* Work and collaborate effectively within a team environment; Contribute to organization’s growth and profitability by providing operational expertise to market leadership

role.title: Director, Operations
role.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! 
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Does the thought of joining one of the fastest-growing, privately held data center companies sound exciting to you? Do you enjoy collaborating with team members to drive and operate some of the industry’s leading and most innovative infrastructure solutions?

At **Aligned Data Centers**, not only do we celebrate success across our platform, we celebrate the very teams that drive and support that success! Our culture is founded in passion, engineered from innovation, and driven by the pursuit of operational excellence. We are a company dedicated to driving positive change in the industry through continuous data center innovation, diversity and inclusion, and corporate sustainability.

We realize not only is providing a comprehensive benefits package important, but we also provide a generous 401k match with immediate vesting, free membership to Gympass which provides our employees a rich health and wellness benefit and competitive time off plan. Giving back and having fun is important to our team whether it be serving our communities or employee and customer events. ***Our Aligned DNA is what makes us unique and successful!***

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The Director Operations is responsible for leading and executing all aspects of the campus operations to include safety, security, reliability, network environment, customer relations, the critical environment, and P&L. This role will strategize, manage, and operate multiple Datacenter facilities for Aligned. 
The Director of Operations will ensure all Datacenter facility systems meet or exceed industry standards for critical maintenance resulting in 100% uptime, ensures the building engineering and security teams follow all reporting and documentation processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and meets all customer service level agreements and compliance audits. The Director of Operations will serve as the liaison for all 24x7 operational activities across their managed facilities with executives and department heads to ensure appropriate communications with all interested and vested parties. They will lead and direct the staff in their market to optimize employee potential and maximize Aligned’s continued growth in existing and new markets. This role reports to the SVP of Operations or their designee.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provides senior leadership to drive strategic vision for Aligned’s datacenters, including Critical Facilities Operations, Preventative Maintenance, Commissioning, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Security, Logistics, and Safety on a Senior level.
* Manages Campus operations of the 24x7 Datacenter environment. Identifies and implements critical metrics necessary to manage and monitor the performance of overall operations including, but not limited to, capacity, availability, budget, and inventory. Oversees all electrical and mechanical infrastructure such as UPS systems, generators, fire suppression systems, BMS, and HVAC systems Has responsibility for meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Ensures that all work performed within the Datacenter is done to high quality and without impact to any internal/external customers.
* Oversees requirements and delivery of services provided by Operations, Security, and Safety. Drives maximum potential of these functions to provide exceptional services to clients and employees.
* Oversees and supports the level 5 commissioning, operations, and maintenance of all Datacenter mission critical infrastructure in order to achieve 100% availability. Manages Datacenter facility expansion and consolidation.
* Manages, coaches, and develops management team performing Datacenter operations.
* Manages and leads vendor relationship to maintain day to day operations and strategic goals for Datacenter Operations SLA’s and deliverables. Works with current vendor stakeholders and partners to develop and deliver strategic plans. Oversees all Datacenter vendor contracts, streamlining services required and optimizing overall costs.
* Will work closely with all strategic supply chain vendors to ensure Aligned’s lean management strategies and continuous innovation and process improvement are fully implemented.
* Evaluates and mitigates risk on new and existing programs within datacenter program governance.
* Develops opportunities for cross-team effectiveness and remove organizational barriers for strong teamwork, collaboration, and excellent service delivery.
* Drives Aligned’s Sustainability Strategy and creates a program to improve the efficiency of the Datacenter operations.
* Engages in improvement projects, which often requires reaching out to a variety of support teams and driving them from conception to completion.
* Manages budgeting and forecasting, planning, deployment, incident and problem management, change management.
* Maintains documentation and diagrams capturing all essential parameters of Datacenter operations.
* Defines policies, procedures, and standards related to performance, capacity, availability, continuity, and security.
* Creates and delivers presentations to leadership team, company meetings, and conferences.
* Will meet all customer service levels and power utilization efficiency commitments and take an active role in on-going customer interaction. Participate in customer service review discussion and various ad-hoc meetings related to Datacenter management issues.
* Manages customer service orders and remote hand requests.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors, and customers.
* Ensure compliance with all safety procedures as well as utilization of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Respond quickly and appropriately to emergency situations (i.e., fire, evacuation, equipment failure etc.) and any customer concerns.
* Ensures inventory control programs/purchase parts and supplies are maintained.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, requisitions, government agencies and AE directives as relates to building and critical environment operations.
* Operational Roles may also apply as necessary.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred with 10 years’ experience or minimum of 12-15 years of related experience in lieu of degree.

* Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex project documents, AutoCAD, Visio, and PDF documents.
* Ability to project and time manage effectively.
* Ability to develop operational standards, project tracking, and management documents.
* Ability to effectively respond, verbally or written, to sensitive issues, complex inquiries, or complaints.
* Ability to make effective presentations and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the public.
* Requires a high level of commitment to customer service, whether co-workers or clients.
* Requires in-depth knowledge of all applicable rules, laws, codes, regulations, and ordinances in performing data/communications and MEP projects.
* Ability to estimate cost of client installations and other assigned projects. Cost tracking for all projects.
* Knowledge of Purchase Order Requests process and invoice tracking.
* Develops appropriate RFP processes in addition to development of operating and capital budgets.
* Ability to analyze and solve problems involving several options with limited information.
* Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form and to work independently.
* Demonstrate ability to work well under pressure with a proactive approach to unusual occurrences.
* Requires good organizational skills, attention to detail and an openness to new ideas and procedures.
* MSOffice applications. i.e., Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Occasional travel will be required for training and meetings.

**BENEFITS & PERKS:**

Aligned Data Centers is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Eligible employees have access to:

* **Health Coverage**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* **Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts:** HSA with employer contribution for eligible participants. FSA's offered for health and dependent care to increase tax savings.
* **Retirement Savings**: 401(k) plan with company match
* **Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay**
* **Company-Sponsored Insurance**: Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability (with medical election)
* **Optional Benefits**: Voluntary life, critical illness, legal, and additional disability coverage
* **Wellness Programs**: Employee assistance program (EAP), Wellhub gym membership, and other wellness initiatives

role.description:
**Position Purpose**

The Senior Manager leads the global Advanced Manufacturing Technology (AMT) organization and converts long-range technical direction into an executable three-to-five-year portfolio of technology, automation, equipment, and factory-transformation initiatives.

The role owns people leadership, portfolio execution, global capital-process stewardship, strategic vendor and technical-equipment vendor portfolio management, deployment, adoption, and business results.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Strategy and Portfolio Leadership**

Translate enterprise strategy and technical direction into an executable AMT roadmap.

Prioritize initiatives using business value, readiness, risk, capacity, and strategic alignment.

Drive results across functions, regions, and multiple levels.

**Global Capital Process Custodianship**

Serve as custodian of the global capital process, including standard work, governance, review cadence, documentation quality, portfolio transparency, and continuous improvement.

Develop and quality-review investment plans, business cases, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).

Provide the Vice President portfolio analysis and recommendations supporting global capital strategy and prioritization.

Manage assigned capital and operating budgets and ensure financial adherence.

**Global Vendor and Technical Equipment Portfolio**

Lead strategic relationships with key global manufacturing-technology and equipment vendors.

Create and maintain the technical equipment vendor portfolio, including preferred capabilities, technology coverage, performance, quality, delivery, risk, capacity, lifecycle support, and regional applicability.

Lead supplier development, technical reviews, commercial alignment, long-term service strategies, and executive escalation.

Use global portfolio leverage to improve standardization, innovation access, total cost, delivery, and support.

**Technology Deployment and Results**

Lead programs from concept approval through industrialization, qualification, deployment, adoption, and benefits realization.

Establish accountability for scope, schedule, budget, risk, and measurable outcomes.

Remove organizational barriers and ensure consistent execution across regions.

**Organization and Talent**

Lead, coach, and develop.

Build morale, productivity, innovation, learning, succession, and accountability.

**AMT Expansion Playbook**

Create and maintain the AMT expansion playbook covering organizational, people, technical, process, specification, vendor, equipment, installation, qualification, training, and readiness requirements.

Own the AMT workstream for expansion programs and ensure equipment and technology readiness at each stage gate.

**Nature and Scope**

The Senior Manager leads the global AMT organization with broad accountability for organizational capability, global capital-process stewardship, key vendor relationships, the technical-equipment vendor portfolio, technology investment execution, deployment, and measurable business outcomes across regions.

**Knowledge & Skills**

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor degree in Engineering required; advanced degree preferred.

12+ years in manufacturing technology, automation, industrialization, or related fields.

5+ years leading technical teams and complex cross-functional programs.

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

Manufacturing technologies, automation, controls, robotics, digital manufacturing, industrialization, equipment-vendor management, capital governance, and portfolio management.

Strong working knowledge of Lean and high-variation, low-volume manufacturing.

**Leadership & Business Competencies**

Compelling vision, stakeholder mobilization, financial acumen, talent development, change leadership, and three-to-five-year strategic planning.

**Working Conditions**

Office and manufacturing environments.

Standing and walking up to 50 percent; occasional lifting up to 30 pounds.

Domestic and international travel up to 30 percent.

role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.
