JR2889

**Advancing medicine to save lives. Together.**

Thanks to many decades of experience and our passion for what we do, we make an essential contribution to the global availability of biopharmaceuticals, especially for patients with rare and serious diseases.

Rentschler Biopharma SE is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) focused exclusively on client projects. We offer customized full-service solutions for bioprocess development and the production of complex biopharmaceuticals. As a German family-owned company with an international footprint and global reach, we combine experts, expertise and years of experience to develop best-in-class solutions – together with our clients.

Rentschler Biopharma has approximately 1,400 employees and is headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, with a site in Milford, MA, USA. In 2024, we joined the United Nations Global Compact, underlining our commitment to sustainability.

As an independent family-owned company, we live by the motto: Many hands, many minds - ONE TEAM! Open, respectful cooperation characterizes our working environment, where quality awareness, diligence and responsibility are our top priorities. With all the diversity of our talents in the Rentschler team, we pursue one vision together: advancing medicine to save lives.

As a member of the QC leadership team in Milford, the Director, Quality Control Technical Services will manage and oversee a Quality Control team responsible for maintaining GxP systems and processes that support site business objectives; within QC this will be from Clinical Development to Clinical Supply and/or Commercial manufacture at a Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). The candidate will work in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Supply Operations, Process Sciences and Quality Assurance to support continual improvement and cGMP compliance. The Director will work functionally as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team to support the development and approval of our clinical development programs, commercial operations, and implement strategic imperatives within a fast-paced environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

 

* Will manage teams of professionals within Quality Control encompassing raw materials testing, microbiology, QC LIMS master data and electronic systems, analytical equipment lifecycle management, documentation and data integrity
* Hire and develop employees within the department through coaching and mentorship while setting clear expectations for success
* Leads and manages the Milford Site QC Leadership team meetings and follow up action plans
* Establish and maintain Quality Control systems and processes at Milford, MA site
* Develops and maintains department budgets (expense and capital) in alignment with overall organizational goals for profitability

* Acts as portfolio manager for QC project work including scheduling, prioritizing and resource planning to ensure client contract deliverables are met
* Represents QC at the project team level and interacts with Rentschler clients as needed
* Ensure timely execution of client projects and clear communications to clients
* Identify and initiate improvements to Quality Control Systems and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring compliance with all relevant quality standards and regulatory requirements
* Verify & establish department readiness for audits by both internal and external authorities, serve as primary Quality Control contact for regulatory inspections and client audits
* Analyze regulatory authorities’ programs, guidance documents and activities in areas relevant to testing biological products
* Consistently advise site and Quality management of potential and actual actions that could adversely affect the business; represent quality exposures or represent opportunities to be pursued
* Collect and report quality control metrics via Quality Management Reviews and the Quality Council
* Promotes a strong Quality Culture based on the Rentschler core values

**Qualifications and Key Characteristics**

 

* BS required, MS preferred in a scientific/technical discipline with 15+ years of experience in a QC position within the biological and/or CDMO industry
* 10+ years in a management/leadership role(s)
* PhD in a scientific/technical discipline a plus
* Experience in microbiological methods and contamination control
* Subject matter experiment in laboratory equipment qualification and data management
* Ability to apply GMP regulations and international guidelines to all aspects of the position
* Experience with regulatory inspections and client audits specifically within a startup/early phase and commercial QC laboratories
* Extensive experience with writing and managing investigations and risk assessments
* Proficient in MS Office application suite as well GMP electronic applications such as LIMS
* Outstanding leadership abilities with demonstrated analytical and critical thinking skills while managing high performing teams
* Proven leader, delegator, and decision maker with the ability to interact with all levels
* Executive presence with strong interpersonal and communication skills, verbal and written

**Working Conditions**

 

* Manufacturing environment with potential chemical, electrical and physical hazards
* Personal protective equipment must be worn in the laboratories according to Rentschler safety requirements
* Exposure to cool/hot storage conditions
* May be working in a loud area at times, that requires hearing protection and other protective equipment to be worn
* Working around chemicals such as solvents, acids, bases and reactive or flammable materials
* May require immunization before performing work within the manufacturing area
* Pace may be fast and job completion demands may be high
* Some international travel (no more than 5% time)

**Physical Requirements**

 

* May be required to stand for long periods of time while performing physical duties
* May be required to lift up to 10 lbs
* Must be able to work safely with materials and equipment
* PPE as required

Base Pay Range 
 
$180,000 - $220,000 
 
Disclosure Statement 
 
Rentschler Biopharma, Inc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base pay range listed for this position is the anticipated annual base salary range the organization reasonably, and in good faith, expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other application factors permissible by law. The annual base salary is just one component of our Total Rewards package, which also includes our annual discretionary bonus program, medical insurance, our generous 401K program, plus a host of other benefits to aligned to support our employees’ personal and professional wellness. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.

 

### **Brauchen Sie Hilfe?**

role.title: Senior Manager of Digital Quality Systems
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril’s Quality organization is seeking a Senior Manager, Digital Quality Systems to lead the team responsible for our digital quality platform and analytics infrastructure. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success. We are growing rapidly across multiple product lines and sites, and this role will own the quality workflows inside Forge, our homegrown Manufacturing Execution System, and the Quality Intelligence Hub, our centralized analytics and compliance layer built on Databricks. The right person for this role lives at the intersection of software and quality engineering, someone who can design a data model, review code, ship in sprints, and understand how nonconformance, CAPA, and inspection processes work on a real factory floor. If you want to build the digital quality backbone for the next generation of defense manufacturing, this is the seat.

 This role is subject to ITAR. Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Platform architecture. Own the design of quality workflows in Forge: inspection routings, data capture points, decision logic and audit trails. Keep them version-controlled and audit-ready.

 Core quality workflows. Build NC, disposition, containment, CAPA, SCAR and inspection instructions into production flow, not bolted on after it.

 Quality Intelligence Hub. Direct the data models and dashboards behind FPY, DPU, escape rates, CAPA aging, NC Pareto, supplier scorecards and SPC trending.

 Operator experience. Make sure floor operators and quality engineers get fast, error-resistant tools they actually want to use.

 Team leadership. Lead developers, data engineers, analysts and quality SMEs: set sprint priorities, review designs and code, and unblock decisions.

 Cross-functional alignment. Keep the platform in step with product development, supplier quality, reliability and manufacturing as programs and sites scale.

 
 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on software experience.

 10+ years building or leading enterprise software, manufacturing systems or quality systems, with 5+ years leading engineers or analysts.

 Hands-on software credibility: you can sketch an architecture, challenge a schema, read a pull request and make build-vs-buy calls.

 Working knowledge of enterprise quality processes: NC, CAPA, SCAR, disposition, containment, inspection and document control, and how each translates into data capture and workflow.

 Data and analytics fluency: SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or similar.

 Experience running agile delivery: sprint planning, backlog grooming, CI/CD and iterative releases with a cross-functional team.

 Comfort making architecture decisions with imperfect information in a fast-scaling environment.

 U.S. citizenship is required pursuant to contractual obligations.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Experience with a homegrown or heavily customized MES, not only out-of-the-box SAP QM or Windchill.

 Aerospace, defense, medical device or other regulated manufacturing background (AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485).

 Practical AI/ML use in production workflows or strong personal fluency with AI tooling.

 Statistical methods in practice: SPC, MSA and process capability analysis.

 IoT-enabled inspection data capture, automated optical inspection or machine vision integration.

 APQP/PPAP or FMEA tied into digital quality systems.

 ASQ certification (CQE, CMQ/OE or Six Sigma Black Belt).

 US Salary Range
 $191,000 — $254,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: Director of Manufacturing, Operations & Assembly
role.description:
**Application Close Date**
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
 
 
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
 
 
This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.
 
 
**About Blue Origin**
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. These positions will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.
 
 
We are looking for senior leaders to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required.
 
 
**About This Opportunity**
Blue Origin is actively building its senior manufacturing and operations leadership team across multiple sites. We are seeking experienced Directors and Senior Directors with a strong aerospace background to lead high-performing teams in support of rocket engine and spacecraft production programs.
 
 
By expressing interest in this opportunity, you will be considered for current and future openings aligned to your experience and location preference. Roles span the following functional areas:
 
 
**Manufacturing**
 
 
Provides senior leadership across production operations including assembly, machine shop, heat treat, welding, and component fabrication for space systems and propulsion programs. Accountable for establishing and maintaining process controls, driving production efficiency, and ensuring safe, repeatable spaceflight hardware delivery at all stages of the product lifecycle.
 
 
**Test**
Provides leadership across test operations supporting engine, component, and system-level testing. Accountable for ensuring test processes are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with program requirements. Drives continuous improvement in test throughput, first-time quality, and the feedback loop between test results and production processes.
 
 
**Fabrication**
Provides leadership across fabrication operations including machining, welding, composites, additive manufacturing, cleaning, and post-processing of flight hardware. Accountable for the development, qualification, and continuous improvement of fabrication processes and capabilities that meet the demanding quality and schedule requirements of space and propulsion programs.
 
 
**Integration**
 
 
Provides leadership across integration operations supporting the assembly and verification of complex space systems, launch vehicles, and propulsion hardware. Accountable for coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure the safe, on-time integration of hardware in alignment with engineering requirements, mission assurance standards, and program milestones.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Leaders across these functional areas are expected to:
 
 

* Lead and develop teams of Managers, Senior Managers, and Directors driving manufacturing and operations execution across space and propulsion programs
* Champion a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all functional teams
* Own departmental KPIs, budgets, staffing plans, and capital project portfolios
* Partner with Program Management, Site Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to meet production schedules and customer expectations
* Drive process definition, development, deployment, and improvement initiatives including Lean Manufacturing and root cause analysis
* Collaborate with engineering teams to advance Design for Manufacturability principles and accelerate the transition from development to production
* Implement and mature production frameworks that support world-class manufacturing capabilities
* Communicate and enforce mission assurance and safety principles throughout the organization
* Recruit, develop, coach, and mentor talent at all levels of the organization

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 15 or more years of progressive experience in aerospace manufacturing or a closely related industry, such as launch vehicles, aircraft, spacecraft systems, or defense
* 5 or more years in a senior leadership role managing managers and large, cross-functional teams
* Demonstrated experience leading manufacturing and operations teams in fast-paced, complex environments
* Proven ability to manage budgets, schedules, and capital projects at a department or program level
* Strong quality mindset with expertise in root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies
* Experience with process definition, development, deployment, measurement, and continuous improvement
* Effective communicator across all levels of an organization, including executive leadership
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, MBA, or advanced degree in a relevant engineering or business field
* Prior experience in aerospace environments supporting space hardware, rocket propulsion, or other mission-critical, high-value components
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, the Toyota Production System, or Six Sigma; Black Belt certification preferred
* Experience transitioning manufacturing capabilities from development and prototyping into full-rate production
* Knowledge of fabrication processes including machining, welding, composites, additive manufacturing, cleaning, and non-destructive testing
* Experience with facility activation, new production line startup, or multi-site manufacturing operations
* Proficiency with MRP/ERP, PLM, and Manufacturing Execution Systems

**Base Pay Range For**
WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30
 
 
**Other Site Ranges May Differ**
**Culture Statement**
Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
 
 
**Export Control Regulations**
Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
 
 
**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
* Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
* Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.
 
 
**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**
Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

role.title: Senior Manager Production
role.description:
**Career Area**
Manufacturing
 
 
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
 
 
Caterpillar is seeking a
**Senior Manager Production**
to provide senior leadership for production operations at our Griffin Engine Packaging Plant. This role serves as a key production leader responsible for overseeing genset and power module manufacturing operations in a fast-paced, high-velocity production environment.
 
 
As the leader of a team consisting of seven direct-report supervisors and multiple indirect reports, you will drive operational performance across safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives while creating an environment focused on employee development and operational excellence.
 
 
This position offers the opportunity to lead large-scale power systems production operations, overseeing products ranging from approximately 400 kVA to 4 MW. The successful candidate will champion a safety-first culture, support lean manufacturing initiatives, and provide leadership for day-to-day operational execution and continuous improvement efforts.
 
 
How You Will Make an Impact
 
 

* Safety-Driven Culture - Lead with a safety-first mindset and drive a culture where safety is the top operational priority.
* Operational Excellence - Deliver strong manufacturing performance through effective management of safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* People Leadership and Development - Develop, coach, and support leaders while building organizational capability across the production team.
* Lean Manufacturing Leadership - Champion lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance.
* Large-Scale Power Systems Production - Provide leadership for genset and power module production operations supporting a complex manufacturing environment.

**Responsibilities Include**

* Leading production operations within a high-velocity manufacturing environment.
* Driving safety performance and fostering a safety-first culture throughout the organization.
* Managing competing priorities related to safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
* Leading employee development activities and performance management processes.
* Resolving day-to-day operational escalations and manufacturing challenges.
* Supporting lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Overseeing genset and power module production operations.; emphasis on NPI operational support (i.e headcount, capacity planning, etc...)

Degree Requirement
 
 
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
 
 
**What Skills You Will Have**
**Production Training:**
Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools and techniques for delivering formal and informal training on the safe and efficient operation of production machinery; ability to conduct effective formal and situation-specific training.
 
 
**Problem Solving:**
Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations
 
 
**Influencing:**
Extensive knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.
 
 
**Flexibility and Adaptability:**
Extensive knowledge of successful approaches and techniques for dealing with change; ability to adapt to a changing environment and be comfortable with change.
 
 
**Performance Management:**
Extensive knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance.
 
 
**Analytical Thinking:**
Extensive knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
 
 
**Planning and Organizing:**
Extensive knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
 
 
**Effective Communications:**
Extensive understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
 
 
**Leadership & People Management:**
Extensive understanding of the techniques and skills needed to lead in the production environment; with the demonstrated ability to develop talent using performance management techniques
 
 
Top Candidates Will Also Have
 
 

* Experiences as a leader of leaders; specifically in cross-functional teams with support staff
* Manufacturing experience in the product producing environment; preference for heavy equipment, automotive, aerospace, rail, or other closely related industries.
* Examples of contributing to or leading manufacturing process transformation
* LEAN/Six Sigma Certification.

Additional Information
 
 

* Location: Griffin, Georgia
* Work Arrangement: Onsite
* Relocation: Available
* Travel: Less than 10%
* Sponsorship: Not available

**Summary Pay Range**
$147,760.00 - $221,640.00
 
 
Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.
 
 
**Benefits**
Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.
 
 

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits\*
* Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\*
* 401(k) savings plans\*
* Health Savings Account (HSA)\*
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\*
* Health Lifestyle Programs\*
* Employee Assistance Program\*
* Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\*
* Career Development\*
* Incentive bonus\*
* Disability benefits
* Life Insurance
* Parental leave
* Adoption benefits
* Tuition Reimbursement
* These benefits also apply to part-time employees

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
 
 
Relocation is available for this position.
 
 
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
 
 
**Posting Dates**
November 11, 2026 - November 18, 2026
 
 
Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.
 
 
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.
 
 
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

role.title: Senior Director, Manufacturing Sciences & Technologies
role.description:
Description:

**Transforming Cancer Therapy Together**

At ADC Therapeutics, we are passionate about revolutionizing cancer treatment. When you join our team, you become part of a mission-driven group of talented individuals dedicated to making a difference in patients' lives.

**Why ADC Therapeutics?**

ADC Therapeutics (NYSE): is a commercial, global leader and pioneer in the field of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) with specialized capabilities from clinical through commercialization. Our CD-19-directed ADC for relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma, ZYNLONTA® (loncastuxamab tesirine lpyl) has received accelerated approval in the United States, conditional approval from the European Commission and conditional approvals in other countries. ZYNLONTA is also being evaluated in combination with other agents and in earlier lines of DLBCL therapy as well as indolent lymphomas including follicular lymphoma and marginal zone lymphoma with the potential to reach significantly more patients through expanded use.

We are a team of approximately 150 patient-focused, purpose-driven employees with a shared mission to transform the treatment paradigm for patients. If you’re interested in making a difference in the lives of patients worldwide with a team of like-minded colleagues, operating in a flexible work environment, come join us on our journey! To learn more about ADC Therapeutics, our values, and our exceptional culture, please visit us at https://adctherapeutics.com/ and LinkedIn.

**Job Summary****:**

The Senior Director of Manufacturing Sciences & Technologies (MSAT) is a senior technical leader responsible for end-to-end process ownership, technical oversight, and lifecycle management of drug substance intermediates, ADC drug substance, and ADC drug product manufactured through a global network of external CDMOs.

This role ensures robust, scalable, and compliant manufacturing processes that support commercial manufacturing, process development projects and clinical development, while serving as the senior-level technical support for internal Production Management Teams and external manufacturing partners.

The position plays a critical role in process validation, technology transfer, continued process verification (CPV), change management, technical and regulatory support across antibody, linker-payload, conjugation, formulation, fill/finish, and packaging operations.

This position reports to the Vice President, Global Supply & Operations. The role is remote based, with a preference for candidates located on the U.S. East Coast.

**What You'll Do****:**

MSAT Strategy and Leadership

* Lead and develop the MSAT function covering ADC end-to-end manufacturing across clinical and commercial stages.
* Define MSAT strategy for external manufacturing aligned with corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor a high-performing MSAT team with deep expertise in biologics, highly potent payloads, and aseptic operations.
* Serve as a key member of the Operations Management Team to contribute to long-term supply, risk mitigation, and operational excellence initiatives.

Manufacturing Process Oversight (External Manufacturing)

* Accountable for overall manufacturing process stewardship, ensure robust process knowledge management and align process understanding within ADCT and at the CDMO partners.
* Partner with Quality and Supply Chain to ensure ADCT’s Production Management Teams effectively interface and manage CDMO performance.
* Oversee and guide: MSAT activities at CDMOs, process characterization, validation (PPQ), process monitoring and CPV programs.
* Ensure consistent process understanding and control across global manufacturing partners.
* Drive effective issue resolution for manufacturing deviations, CAPAs, and change requests.
* Support CDMO selection, technical due diligence, and onboarding for new manufacturing partners.

Process Lifecycle Management

* Provide scientific and technical oversight across the full ADC manufacturing lifecycle.
* Assess and implement post approval changes, comparability strategies, and process optimization initiatives.
* Oversee and endorse process improvements to enhance process robustness, yield, cost, and supply reliability.

Regulatory & Quality Support

* Serve as the senior-level accountable MSAT person for regulatory submissions and inspections, including INDs, BLAs, MAAs, supplements to these filings.
* Author, review, and approve CMC regulatory sections and responses.
* Support health authority inspections and technical audits of CDMOs.
* Partner closely with Quality to ensure compliance with cGMP, ICH, and global regulatory expectations.
* Ensure sound scientific justifications for process control strategies, specifications, and lifecycle changes.

Cross Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supply Chain and CMC Regulatory
* Provide MSAT input into development programs, commercial readiness, and long range supply planning.
* Participate in internal governance forums, change control boards, and technical review committees.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

* Establish and track critical process parameters (CPPs) and CPV metrics.
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical and operational risks within ADC Therapeutics’ external manufacturing network.
* Drive lessons learned, standardization, and continuous improvement across CDMOs and Production Management Teams.

Requirements:

**Who You Are****:**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or related field; BS with significant industry experience considered.
* 12+ years of relevant experience including biologics manufacturing, CMC operations, and CDMO management.
* Extensive experience in commercial GMP manufacturing operations, process validation, CPV, and regulatory submission preparation.
* Strong scientific problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Proven ability to lead through influence in external or remote environments.
* Excellent communication skills for executive, regulatory, and partner interfaces
* Strategic thinker with strong execution focus.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, commercial-stage organization.
* Deep knowledge of relevant bioconjugate technologies is preferred (antibody, high potency linker-payload, conjugation, aseptic fill and lyophilization).
* Strong track record of building and leading technical and cross-functional teams.
* Visionary leadership with a strategic mindset.
* High standards of excellence, urgency, and accountability.
* Collaborative, team-oriented approach.
* Strong organizational and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to mentor, influence, and drive change across a remote organization.
* Domestic and international travel up to 20%, primarily to CDMOs.

role.title: Seating Plant Manager
role.description:
**Seating Plant Manager**

**Position Summary**
====================

DARRAN is a family-owned furniture manufacturer based in High Point, North Carolina, creating thoughtfully designed furniture for 50 years. Our work brings together craftsmanship, innovation, and a commitment to quality, supported by people who take pride in what they build.
===================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

We are seeking a Production Manager over our Seating Operations to guide our seating manufacturing operation and support its continued growth. This leadership role brings together people, processes, and craftsmanship to build a strong team and deliver exceptional products. The ideal candidate leads by example, develops others, and creates an environment where accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.


**Management and People Leadership**
====================================

* Direct and supervise seating department employees, assign work, communicate daily priorities, and hold employees accountable for meeting expectations.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, quality, attendance, conduct, and safe work practices. Ensure employees understand their responsibilities and department goals.
* Monitor individual and team performance daily, including output, work quality, efficiency, attendance, and adherence to established procedures. Identify concerns and address them promptly.
* Provide ongoing coaching and timely feedback. Establish improvement expectations, document follow-up, and verify that required improvements are achieved and sustained.
* Administer and document disciplinary actions in partnership with HR and in accordance with company policy. Clearly communicate the concern, required correction, and consequences of continued issues.
* Complete annual performance reviews and provide accurate, specific feedback supported by documented performance observations.
* Partner with HR on hiring and employee matters. Coordinate onboarding and training, assess employee skills, and identify development and cross-training needs.
* Apply company policies consistently, address employee concerns respectfully, and maintain clear communication with employees, HR, and senior operations leadership.

**Production**
==============

* Lead daily production startup and ensure teams, materials, and priorities are ready at the beginning of each shift.
* Manage production flow across frame building, cutting, sewing, upholstering, and final assembly to keep work on schedule.
* Partner with senior operations leadership to review daily objectives, constraints, and priorities.
* Drive results across output, delivery performance, labor utilization, overtime, quality, and production flow.
* Develop and improve standard operating procedures and processes that increase throughput and reduce bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with outside and original-equipment suppliers to maintain production capacity and quality standards while expanding internal capabilities.
* Collaborate with engineering and product development on patterns, production readiness, and the launch of new seating collections.
* Establish, maintain, and enforce quality checks and corrective actions.
* Coordinate maintenance needs, execute safety programs, and reinforce safe work practices throughout the operation.
* Advance shop-floor organization and housekeeping practices that support a structured, clean, and efficient workplace.

**How Success Is Measured**
===========================

Success is measured by consistent people leadership and department results against goals established with senior operations leadership. Performance is evaluated through production and quality reports, employee performance records, training progress, and completion of corrective actions.

* People management and accountability: Employees understand their goals and responsibilities. Performance and attendance concerns are addressed promptly, company policies are applied consistently, and coaching and disciplinary actions are documented with HR.
* Performance improvement: Individual and team results are monitored regularly. Employees receive specific feedback, improvement expectations and follow-up dates are documented, and progress is verified. Annual reviews are completed on time.
* Employee development: New employees complete assigned training, demonstrated skills meet job requirements, and cross-training improves coverage across seating operations.
* Production and delivery: Actual output and on-time completion meet established targets. Bottlenecks and schedule delays are identified early, communicated, and addressed.
* Quality: Products meet established standards. Defects, rework, and recurring quality issues are tracked, and corrective actions produce sustained improvement.
* Labor and operational efficiency: Labor utilization and overtime remain within established expectations. Process improvements reduce avoidable downtime and improve production flow.
* Safety and workplace organization: Safe work practices and housekeeping standards are consistently enforced. Hazards and incidents are reported promptly, and assigned corrective actions are completed by their due dates.
* Communication and follow-through: Priorities, staffing concerns, and production risks are communicated promptly to the appropriate partners. Assigned actions and production readiness milestones are completed on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

* 10+ years of upholstery, pattern, and assembly experience and 5+ years of running an upholstery operation.
* High school diploma or GED required.
* Strong reading, writing, math, analysis, comprehension, administrative, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to set clear priorities, manage and hold people accountable, monitor performance, document personnel matters, and collaborate across operations, HR, engineering, product development, and suppliers.
* A practical, continuous-improvement mindset with a strong commitment to safety, quality, delivery, and respectful people leadership.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**
==============================================

This is an on-site role in an active manufacturing environment. The position requires excellent vision, hearing/listening, and clear speech; hand and finger dexterity; lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds; pushing and pulling; local driving; color perception; touch/feel; and the ability to move within and between facilities. Work includes frequent face-to-face and verbal interaction with others and may involve dirt or dust, fumes or odors, moving objects, and work at heights.

**Benefits**
============

401(k), dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, paid time off, retirement plan, and vision insurance.

role.title: Senior Manager of Digital Quality Systems
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Quality organization is seeking a Senior Manager, Digital Quality Systems to lead the team responsible for our digital quality platform and analytics infrastructure. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success. We are growing rapidly across multiple product lines and sites, and this role will own the quality workflows inside Forge, our homegrown Manufacturing Execution System, and the Quality Intelligence Hub, our centralized analytics and compliance layer built on Databricks. The right person for this role lives at the intersection of software and quality engineering, someone who can design a data model, review code, ship in sprints, and understand how nonconformance, CAPA, and inspection processes work on a real factory floor. If you want to build the digital quality backbone for the next generation of defense manufacturing, this is the seat.

**This role is subject to ITAR. Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.**

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Platform architecture.** Own the design of quality workflows in Forge: inspection routings, data capture points, decision logic and audit trails. Keep them version-controlled and audit-ready.
* **Core quality workflows.** Build NC, disposition, containment, CAPA, SCAR and inspection instructions into production flow, not bolted on after it.
* **Quality Intelligence Hub.** Direct the data models and dashboards behind FPY, DPU, escape rates, CAPA aging, NC Pareto, supplier scorecards and SPC trending.
* **Operator experience.** Make sure floor operators and quality engineers get fast, error-resistant tools they actually want to use.
* **Team leadership.** Lead developers, data engineers, analysts and quality SMEs: set sprint priorities, review designs and code, and unblock decisions.
* **Cross-functional alignment.** Keep the platform in step with product development, supplier quality, reliability and manufacturing as programs and sites scale.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on software experience.
* 10+ years building or leading enterprise software, manufacturing systems or quality systems, with 5+ years leading engineers or analysts.
* Hands-on software credibility: you can sketch an architecture, challenge a schema, read a pull request and make build-vs-buy calls.
* Working knowledge of enterprise quality processes: NC, CAPA, SCAR, disposition, containment, inspection and document control, and how each translates into data capture and workflow.
* Data and analytics fluency: SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or similar.
* Experience running agile delivery: sprint planning, backlog grooming, CI/CD and iterative releases with a cross-functional team.
* Comfort making architecture decisions with imperfect information in a fast-scaling environment.
* U.S. citizenship is required pursuant to contractual obligations.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with a homegrown or heavily customized MES, not only out-of-the-box SAP QM or Windchill.
* Aerospace, defense, medical device or other regulated manufacturing background (AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485).
* Practical AI/ML use in production workflows or strong personal fluency with AI tooling.
* Statistical methods in practice: SPC, MSA and process capability analysis.
* IoT-enabled inspection data capture, automated optical inspection or machine vision integration.
* APQP/PPAP or FMEA tied into digital quality systems.
* ASQ certification (CQE, CMQ/OE or Six Sigma Black Belt).

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

 

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
 + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
 + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: Director, Support Operations
role.description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.
 
 
Job Summary
 
 
Position is responsible for Customer Relationship Management (CRM) for patients, families, and physicians at the hospital level. This position includes development and implementation of initiatives to drive behavior change, process improvement and environment changes based on customer wants and needs. This position works closely with the CEO and the Memorial Hermann CRM team, develops objectives and goals, specific to the facility, to achieve best-in-class customer satisfaction.
 
Job Description
 
 
Minimum Qualifications
 
**Education:** Bachelors degree
 
**Licenses/Certifications:** (None)
 
 
**Experience / Knowledge / Skills:** 

* One (1) year of education, customer service or process improvement experience
* Experience in leading and managing multi-functional teams to improve processes
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and listening)
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills
* Experience in using both qualitative and quantitative consumer information to drive customer satisfaction

Principal Accountabilities
 
 

* Plans and coordinates overall program to assure excellent customer service in all areas; develops improvement programs based on identified customer service needs; analyzes and interprets customer service surveys’ works with directors, managers, and front line staff to achieve desired outcomes; reports regularly at departmental meetings, hospital and medical staff committees and service lines.
* Works in collaboration with the Memorial Hermann CRM department in developing and implementing initiatives designed to improve the customer experience either through behavior change, process improvement or environmental factors.
* Accountable for making measurable improvements in customer satisfaction measures and achievement of Memorial Hermann targets and goals with respect to customer opinion and services.
* Collaborates with administrative, medical, nursing, ancillary, and legal/risk management staff on problem investigation, resolution, response, and prevention. Provides education to staff on complaint management, patient rights, and customer service.
* Resource for leadership in hospital for customer satisfaction surveys and process improvement around the patients and families and physicians experience.
* Leads and participates in cross-functional teams to manage initiatives related to the customer experience.
* Demonstrates organizational agility to keep CRM initiatives moving forward.
* Ensures hospital customer service projects are completed on time and on budget.
* Present to various audiences ranging from customer service modules for employees to presentations for hospital leadership.
* Works with performance improvement techniques to proactively implement systems (people, processes, and technology) to enhance the customer’s experience.
* Acts as a resource to the Clinical effectiveness department to ensure accurate measurement of our customer survey process.
* Facilitates hospital level coordination for membership programs and 222-CARE.
* Assures that revenue, expenses, contribution margin and FTE’s meet or exceed budget; prepares and submits budget and related reports; forecasts and accurately projects expenses; takes corrective action to address negative variances; identifies and proposes capital budget items appropriately.
* Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.
* Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education, skills competency, supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor, and resource to less experienced staff.
* Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.
* Other duties as assigned.

role.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing
role.description:
Umoja Biopharma is an industry-leading biotech with locations in Seattle, WA and Louisville, CO, focused on transforming the treatment of cancer with a novel integrated immunotherapy platform. Our vision is to develop off-the-shelf therapies capable of treating any tumor, any time. We are a diverse and growing team working in brand-new facilities in downtown Seattle, Washington and Louisville, Colorado, and we are looking for innovative thinkers who are excited by groundbreaking science and technology, and passionate about squaring up to the challenges inherent to cutting-edge drug development. We are committed to our core values and principles that support our overall mission and strongly invite applications from enthusiastic individuals who share our commitment and help position Umoja to deliver on our goals. We at Umoja believe in the importance of stories; we are looking for great people to join our team to help us create more stories for ourselves, for you, and most importantly for patients and their families.
 
 
Umoja Biopharma – Your Body. Your Hope. Your Cure.
 
 
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Manager of Manufacturing who has strong leadership capabilities and extensive manufacturing experience to lead our Drug substance fill and Drug product Manufacturing team. This is a newly created position reporting into the head of Manufacturing at our Louisville, Colorado GMP cell/gene Manufacturing facility. This person will play a critical role helping lead the manufacturing team through a period of growth and change as we advance our clinical pipeline to later phases of development.
 
 
Primary job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, commercial launch readiness planning and project leadership, DS/DP fill process and material improvements identification and implementation management, ensuring staff is fully trained and qualified to execute aseptic fills and DP visual inspection, ensuring high aseptic technique standards, and assisting with tech transfers both internally and externally. They will also be expected to lead continuous improvement initiatives and provide strategic planning to ensure a high operational success rate. Success is measured by successful outcomes of drug substance film and drug product manufacturing operations.
 
 
This role will interact with internal process engineers, Process sciences, facilities, warehouse/supply chain, EHS, Quality Assurance, and Quality Control on a regular basis. Strong communication and risk-based strategic leadership skills are essential to effectively work in this matrix environment. This is an opportunity to be part of an excellent team working in an exciting environment, focused on realizing the challenge of targeting solid tumors successfully with novel cell/gene therapies.
 
 
This role will be fully onsite at our Louisville, CO facility. This person will need to be able to work weekends, holidays, or evenings when needed.
 
 
**Core Accountabilities**

* Lead successful completion of the drug product fill process, the final step in ensuring product safety and efficacy for patients.
* Strategizes and coordinates the execution and continuous improvement of compliant and technically sound programs and systems in support of Drug substance fill and Drug product GMP manufacturing operations (e.g., aseptic process simulations, drug product process continuous improvement and validation)
* Authors and reviews-controlled documents and standard operating procedures on behalf of Manufacturing Operations
* Partners with Process Science to co-lead both internal and external technology transfer of drug product manufacturing processes at various scales.
* Supports manufacturing process execution through on the floor escalation troubleshooting and risk-based, patient focused decision making
* Supports deviation investigations in the drug substance fill, drug product process area to correct root cause and appropriate corrective actions.
* Ensures adherence to Standard Operating Procedures, good manufacturing practices, and good documentation practices
* Identify, strategize, and lead commercial launch readiness initiates in the DP area in partnership with collaborating functions (e.g., Process sciences, Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Supply chain)
* Manage material quality issues to improvements by partnering with external QA and supply chain to implement new materials or higher supplier specifications
* Ensures DP manufacturing operational excellence and run success rates by driving continuous improvement initiatives and holding high execution standards
* Manage, mentor, and develop DP manufacturing team members, including creation of thorough and clear training content/expectations
* On-the-floor Manufacturing support as needed approximately 25% of time
* Other duties as needed

**Required Qualifications**

* Manager Level: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related life sciences field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Desired qualifications include 10+ years of cGMP manufacturing experience in the pharmaceutical or biologics industry and a minimum of 4 years of people management experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Senior Manager Level: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related life sciences field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Desired qualifications include 12+ years of cGMP manufacturing experience in the pharmaceutical or biologics industry and a minimum of 6 years of people management experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Ability to make critical decisions and exercise sound judgment to mitigate significant risks to the company. Aseptic drug product expert and trainer (drug product filling, visual inspection, process validation)
* Experience hiring, training, and managing individual employee and team performance by setting expectations, giving feedback, and monitoring progress.
* Demonstrated results-oriented experience leading a team through successful DP commercial launch

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience leading external technology transfer is strongly preferred
* Proficient in computer applications such as word processing, spreadsheets, and web-based applications
* Self-motivated with strong organization and communication skills and can work independently or as part of a multi-disciplinary matrixed team.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to aseptically gown into lentiviral clean-room environments (ISO5, ISO7, ISO8, ISO9)
* Must have the ability to work around manufacturing areas and equipment
* The ability to be on the manufacturing floor during operation
* The ability to periodically lift up to 50lbs
* Ability to work holidays, nights and weekends as needed

**Manager Salary Range: $125,000 - $155,000**
**Senior Manager Salary Range: $147,000 - $182,000**
Benefits Offerings
 
 
*Umoja Biopharma offers its employees competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans. Additionally, we offer Umojians access to a 401k plan through Fidelity, with a 100% match up to their first 4% deferral. Umoja also provides a generous Paid Time Off policy, employee commuter benefits, and cell phone stipend. For a full breakdown of our benefits offerings, please see the
**Benefits**
section of our website.*

role.description:
**Job Details:**

**Summary**

This position is responsible for all functional areas of a poultry processing plant, including the efficient operation of three production shifts, maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement. The role also includes motivating managers to provide guidance and development programs that enhance employee skill levels, resolving issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods, and reviewing cost and performance data to identify areas for improvement.

Additional responsibilities include compiling monthly expense and efficiency reports, promoting and explaining Total Quality Management (TQM) philosophy to employees, and obtaining approval for and executing all plant capital improvement projects. This position is responsible for facilitating Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs and supporting retention initiatives. The role is also accountable for food safety, food quality, and product legality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Direct and oversee all functional areas of a poultry processing plant.
* Ensure the efficient operation of three production shifts, including maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement activities.
* Motivate and support managers in providing guidance and development programs to enhance employee skills and performance.
* Resolve issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods.
* Analyze cost and performance data to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* Compile and present monthly expense and efficiency reports.
* Promote and communicate the principles of Total Quality Management (TQM) throughout the facility.
* Obtain approval for and execute all plant capital improvement projects.
* Facilitate Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs.
* Support employee retention initiatives.
* Maintain accountability for food safety, food quality, and product legality.
* Initiate and implement improvements across all phases of production.
* Assist in identifying, evaluating, and correcting operational problems.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as needed.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, typically acquired through four years of college-level study in a general professional or technical field.

**Experience**

* Eight (8) or more years of progressive leadership experience required.
* Experience in the poultry industry or the food processing industry preferred.

**Computer Skills**

* General knowledge of computer applications used in plant operations, including Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Outlook
* Working knowledge of SAP systems preferred.

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Travel**

* Ability to travel approximately 6 to 11 times per year.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Responsible for managing multiple groups of personnel performing diverse tasks and activities across more than one department.

All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes.

**Relocation Assistance Eligible:**

Yes

role.title: Sr. Director Data Engineering and Operations - Erlanger, KY
role.description:
**Sr. Director Data Engineering and Operations - Erlanger, KY**
 
 
**Role Summary**
 
The Head of Data Engineering & Operations leads data engineering as a capability at ADM: the talent, engineering standards, and delivery quality of the data engineers who work inside data product and digital product teams. You are one of the builders of the enterprise data foundation, working in partnership with Platform & Architecture and the Product teams. Engineers from the ADM Capability Center (ACC) are part of the team from day one.
 
Operations sits within this role, including the managed-services partner relationship. You will lead its integration into the product model, so that running data products and building them are owned together rather than by a separate organization.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
 
**Scope & Parterships**

**What you lead**

* Data engineering as a capability across data product and digital product teams, including ACC engineers: talent, standards, and delivery quality.
* Operations, including the managed-services partner relationship, as part of a planned path to full integration into the product model.
* Managing budgets, capacity, sourcing strategy, and vendor performance.
* Lead and partner with globally distributed teams across North America, EMEA, LATAM, APAC, and the ADM Capability Center, overseeing employees and contractors, including data engineers embedded within Data Product and Digital Product teams, as well as Data Operations.
* Communicating strategy, progress, risk, and value to executives, product leaders, and business partners.
* Measure and report the value of the capability including productivity, cost, quality, retention, and innovation output.

**Who you partner with**
------------------------

* Platform & Architecture, who own the data platform and architectural direction. You make sure engineers build well on them and bring what teams need back to them.
* Product teams, who own product priorities and roadmaps. You make sure they have the engineering talent and delivery quality to meet them.
* Data Governance and MDM teams, on data quality, metadata, lineage, and validation.
* Advance Analytics and AI teams to ensure data is trusted, accessible and AI ready.

**Outcomes You Will Deliver**
=============================

**1. Data products the business trusts and uses**
-------------------------------------------------

Production-grade, reusable data products, built and run by product teams, that are adopted across the enterprise.

* Secure, scalable pipelines and data products with clear ownership, defined data contracts, and service levels for availability, freshness, quality, and resolution time.
* Production health visible by design: observability, incident and problem management, and release readiness built into every product, with Operations performance reported against agreed service levels.

**2. ACC leverage**
-------------------

The ADM Capability Center is a fully integrated global engineering team

* ACC engineers work as full members of product teams, under the same standards, expectations, and career paths.
* Depth, ownership, and scope in ACC across design, build, and operations, will be measured through productivity, quality, retention, and innovation output.

**3. Engineering practices**
----------------------------

Consistent, modern engineering practices in every data and digital product team.

* Engineering standards and patterns adopted by teams, including testing, CI/CD, code review, security, privacy, and ITGC and SOX controls, as guardrails that speed delivery rather than gates that slow it.
* AI-assisted engineering and other emerging capabilities evaluated through disciplined pilots, then operationalized where they work.

**4. Talent for both product models**
-------------------------------------

A deep bench of data engineering talent that grows and moves across data product and digital product teams.

* Hiring, development, retention, and succession for a global team, supported by a strong team culture, clear communication rhythms, and knowledge-sharing across regions and time zones.
* Capacity, sourcing, and partner mix matched to the demands of both product models, with budgets and partner performance managed to plan.

**5. Data readiness**
---------------------

Enterprise data that is trusted, governed, and ready for analytics, operations, and AI.

* Data quality, metadata, lineage, and validation built into engineering work in partnership with Data Governance, MDM, and Platform & Architecture.
* Integration across applications, files, APIs, and operational and IoT sources following shared patterns, so analytics and AI use cases move from pilot to production.

**Qualifications** 
**Required**
================================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* Minimum 12 years in data engineering, data platforms, or data operations, with 5+ years leading large, global teams.
* Experience leading engineering talent embedded in product teams, and partnering effectively with platform, architecture, and product leaders.
* Experience building global teams in which capability center engineers work as full members of product teams.
* Proven delivery of production-grade data products on enterprise-scale cloud data platforms (Lakehouse/data lake, Data warehousing, ETL, batch and streaming ingestion).
* Experience setting and driving adoption of engineering standards and practices across multiple teams.
* Experience running production data operations with SLAs, observability, incident management, and ITGC/SOX-type controls, ideally within a product-aligned operating model.
* Experience managing managed-service partners alongside internal teams.
* Experience contributing to large-scale technology transformation and aligning data capabilities to enterprise strategy.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen.

Preferred
---------

* Hands-on exposure to AI/ML or generative and agentic AI enablement, including AI-assisted engineering.
* Background in a global, regulated, or manufacturing/supply-chain enterprise, including operational technology (OT) or IoT data.
* Familiarity with enterprise application data landscapes (e.g., ERP).
* Relevant cloud or data platform certifications.

Excited about this role but don’t think you meet every requirement listed? We encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings.
 
 
ADM requires the successful completion of a background check.
 
 
REF:114765BR
