* Liase as needed with local site Risk/Safety/PFR leader to create prospective solutions and performance improvement as a result of safety events. Partner with safety team as needed prospectively to create performance improvement in pursuit of harm avoidance.

 

* Senior local site manager responsible for Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement QAPI planning and documentation, and updates as needed for board quality committee/patient care assessment committee.

 

* Serve as the senior local site administrative manager covering compliance activities at local site, ensuring adherence to local site standardized processes around tracer activity, site level preparedness activities, and measuring/monitoring compliance.

 

* Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices and culture to identify areas of opportunity for improvement as well as communicate to the system areas which are at risk.

 

* Provides strong bi-directional communication between the system and the site, with accountability for distribution of organization communication (including pertinent data and analytics) from MGB to local site and vice versa.

role.title: Sr. Manager Operations
role.description:
**Job Description**

**Ingram Content Group (ICG)**is hiring a **Sr. Manager Operations** to support our **Distribution** team in **Jackson, TN**. The Sr. Manager, Operations manages the daily operations of an assigned area within the Distribution Center and serves as a key partner to the Director, Operations. This role collaborates with the Director on hiring, safety and security, maintenance and repairs, non-product purchasing, and strategic planning to ensure customer service levels and commitments are achieved, while maintaining a zero-error environment.

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization. We ensure that our distribution centers and manufacturing facilities function at maximum efficiency. Safety is a core value in our operations environment. We emphasize this through training, education, and accident prevention programs. Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways. If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

**Schedule:**

* Monday-Friday, first shift, with flexibility to work weekends, additional hours, and provide on-call support as business needs require.

**What You’ll Need:**

* College degree OR HS diploma or GED with directly related year-for-year experience
* 6 years’ experience in a high-volume distribution center OR production/manufacturing facility with a clear track record of success
* 5 years’ experience supervising at least 25 or more employees

**What You’ll Do:**

* Achieve and maintain full working knowledge of all aspects of the assigned operation
* Implement a fast-paced, lean distribution system; drive the delivery of products and orders on time.
* Oversee KPIs, goals, and objectives for the management team; set clear goals and expectations for Managers and Area Managers, measure performance, provide feedback, and hold leaders accountable.
* Build a passionate team with a positive, inclusive, results-oriented culture; mentor and develop leaders and staff; manage staff selection and development, ensuring associates are fully trained and cross-trained on systems and procedures.
* Develop, manage, and lead continuous process improvement strategies and initiatives; leverage Lean, Six Sigma, and Performance Improvement tools to enhance productivity.
* Provide strategic-level/long-term planning (3, 6, and 12 months out), including labor planning, rate forecasting, and peak season planning.
* Work closely with support functions (HR, Maintenance/Engineering, Safety, IT, and other leaders) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives.
* Ensure customer service levels exceed requirements and standards; works with management to improve cost-per-unit (CPU)/cost-per-line (CPL) while providing outstanding customer service.
* Collaborate with Senior Management in the planning, development, and launch of processes and strategies for the site; review competitive information and visit other companies to bring in new ideas on operations.
* Oversee the supervision of the operations area, ensuring the timely and accurate movement of materials into and out of the facility.
* Monitor and execute company policies and procedures for HR-related issues, including associate attendance, timekeeping, and performance reviews.
* Control and manage budget costs for all assigned departments/areas.

**Essential Physical Demands:**

* Ability to walk and stand as needed
* Ability to grip/grasp as needed
* Ability to lift/carry in full range of motion up to 60lbs as needed
* Ability to push/pull in a warehouse environment up to 70lbs force to push as needed
* Ability to bend, squat/kneel, twist/turn, climb, crawl, reach above shoulder, and type/keyboard frequently
* Ability to work a flexible which could include nights and weekends
* Ability to travel as needed
* Exposure to wide range of temperatures

*Hiring Salary Range: $113,201k - $143,945k. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. It will be determined by factors including but not limited to: the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, geographic location, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.*

 **Additional Information**

**Perks/Benefits:**

* A highly competitive compensation package with generous benefits beginning first day of employment for Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA.
 + 15 vacation days & 12 sick days accrued annually and 3 personal days
 + 401K match, Life and AD&D, Employee Assistant programs, Group Legal, & more
* Encouraged continued education with our tuition reimbursement program
* Financial and in-kind opportunities to engage with non-profits in your community
 + Company match program for United Way donations
 + Volunteer opportunities and in-kind drives for non-profits throughout the year
* Casual Dress Code

The world is reading, and Ingram Content Group (“Ingram”) connects people with content in all forms. Providing comprehensive services for publishers, retailers, libraries and educators, Ingram makes these services seamless and accessible through technology, innovation and creativity. With an expansive global network of offices and facilities, Ingram’s services include digital and physical book distribution, print-on-demand, and digital learning. Ingram Content Group is a part of Ingram Industries Inc. and includes Ingram Book Group LLC, Ingram Publisher Services LLC, Lightning Source LLC, Ingram Library Services LLC, Tennessee Book Company LLC, Ingram Content Group UK Ltd. and Ingram Content Group Australia Pty Ltd.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, work related mental or physical disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetic information.*

* *EOE-Race/Gender/Veterans/Disabled*
* *We participate in EVerify.*
* *EEO Poster in English*
* *EEO Poster in Spanish*

role.title: Regional Director of Operations
role.description:
Circle of Life is growing, and we have an opening for a Regional Director of Operations to join our team. This position will oversee and manage our New Mexico branches; Albuquerque, Gallup, Kirtland, Shiprock, and Zuni.

**Good for employees**

Circle of Life’s focus is creating a workplace where respect, appreciation and teamwork are the shared experiences of our team. We do good for our employees by collaborating on scheduling, a focus on wellbeing, a client-first directive, respecting and valuing every team member, having fun along with top industry compensation and benefits.

**Good deeds**

We also do good in our work. Our team of office and field staff care about each other and the clients we serve. We help one another. We care and provide for a wide range of patients with a focus on serving the underserved.

**Position duties include**

* Participate in the hiring and training of managers
* Organize and oversee the work and schedules of managers
* Conduct performance evaluations
* Handle discipline of employees as needed following company policy
* Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics, guidelines, and standards by which the company's efficiency and effectiveness can be evaluated (identify opportunities for improvement)
* Implement policies and procedures that will improve day-to-day operations
* Oversee office operations, ensuring each branch is reaching goals set by departmental and company leadership
* Monitors budget and revenue in each office to achieve financial objectives
* Communicates and explains new directives, policies/procedures to manager for change and meets with staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale
* Improve customer service and satisfaction
* Market current products to potential clients, families, case workers and potential referral sources
* Leads coordination and integration of efforts among homecare teams to produce smoother workflow and more cost-effective business processes
* Traveling is required

**Qualifications**

Qualified applicants will have 3 years of management experience, excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal and customer service skills. Healthcare and/or home care experience preferred. The Regional Director of Operations oversees the day-to-day activities for their assigned branches, ensuring the organization is managed and performing efficiently and effectively. While carrying out the responsibilities of the position, ensure the values of servant-leadership, empathy, altruism, and integrity are evident in all actions and encounters.

**How good?**

* Positively change the lives of individuals and families in our communities
* Serve the underserved providing access to care for those who have been traditionally overlooked by the health care system
* Support a talented team of administrative and clinical professionals and be a part of a team that supports each other

**Full Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental, 401K, Paid Holidays, Top PTO Plan, Mileage, Flexible Schedules, Vision, Year-End Bonus

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority | Lakeville, New York**

**Salary:$110,000-$130,000 | First Review: December 4, 2026**

**Lead Essential Operations. Develop the Workforce. Prepare for Growth.**

The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority (LCWSA) is seeking an experienced water and wastewater operations professional to help guide its operations through a period of significant growth and expansion.

Over the past five years, the Authority has expanded its water system by 20% while assuming responsibility for additional treatment facilities. With further growth anticipated, LCWSA is investing in its infrastructure, operations, and workforce to meet increasing demands.

The Director of Operations oversees the Authority's water distribution and sewer collection systems, including maintenance activities, field resources, staff development, regulatory compliance, and a $3.5 million operating budget.

**The Opportunity**

The next Director of Operations will help prepare LCWSA for continued expansion while strengthening daily operations and developing its workforce. Priorities include preventive maintenance, infrastructure planning, effective use of operational resources, and training and mentoring employees as experienced team members approach retirement.

LCWSA seeks a collaborative, hands-on leader who combines practical field experience and technical expertise with sound judgment, organizational skills, and a commitment to staff development. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with employees, Authority leadership, municipal partners, contractors, and regulatory agencies while ensuring safe, reliable service to the communities LCWSA serves.

**Qualifications**

Candidates must meet **one** of the following education and experience requirements:

● A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction, or environmental science, plus four years of qualifying experience; or

● An associate's degree in water/wastewater technology or a related field, plus six years of qualifying experience; or

● A high school diploma or equivalent, plus eight years of qualifying experience.

Qualifying experience must be in water treatment, water distribution, sewer collection or treatment, or construction of water and sewer facilities.

All candidates must have at least three years of cumulative supervisory or leadership experience, which may include employee supervision, project management, operational oversight, or coordination of work activities. A valid driver's license and safe driving record are required.

An engineering background may be beneficial but is not required.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The salary range is **$110,000-$130,000**. Benefits include fully paid health insurance, employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA), participation in the New York State Retirement System, and paid time off.

This is an on-site position based in Lakeville, New York. Livingston County residency is preferred but not required. Relocation assistance may be negotiated.

**Ready to Explore the Opportunity?**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. A first review of candidates will be 12/4/26.

To apply, submit a resume and cover letter through the Pracademic Partners Recruitment Portal:

https://www.pracademicpartners.com/current-recruitments

**Questions or confidential inquiries:**

Dr. Ian M. Coyle, ICMA-CM 
President & Founder, Pracademic Partners 
ian@pracademicpartners.com | 585.943.0589

*The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply.*

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $110,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Geneseo, NY 14454 (Required)

Work Location: In person

role.title: Head of Quality Assurance Operations
role.description:
About David AI
David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.


About our Data Operations team
Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale. This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.


About this role
As Head of Quality Assurance Operations, you'll own quality for every dataset David AI ships including but not limited to conversational, TTS, and transcription data, and manage David AI’s relationships with the global contingent workforce, comprising independent contractors and vendor-supplied contributors. You'll report to the Head of Operations and be located in the US.


In this role, you will

 - Own the quality bar across all data ops, including quality standards, calibration, consistency and on-time delivery of datasets

 - Design the quality review structure, organized by language and region, so every dataset gets consistent quality coverage

 - Audit and review the quality of delivered work product across languages, keeping quality benchmarks consistent globally

 - Run quality in languages you don't speak through deliverables from native-speaker and cross-language gold sets

 - Plan capacity against production ramps and own contingent workforce sourcing across many countries, ensuring each engagement is structured and classified correctly under local law

 - Build and own dashboards for quality, throughput, and cost efficiency

 - Manage David AI’s relationships with staffing vendors, service providers, and employer-of-record partners
 

Your background looks like

 - 7 to 10+ years in operations, including 3+ in senior leadership roles

 - You've run quality operations for large contingent workforce networks across multiple countries

 - You've owned quality at scale, across calibration, capacity planning, and spend efficiency

 - You built the system yourself, from tooling to contingent workforce sourcing at scale

 - Speech, audio, or linguistic data experience is a strong plus


VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

role.title: Sr. Manager, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
MicroAire Surgical Instruments LLC 
 
 As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway— you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. 
 
 
Leads Advanced Manufacturing initiatives across supply chain, sustaining engineering, manufacturing engineering, and process development for existing and new mechanical and electromechanical products. Serves as a technical advisor in researching and implementing manufacturing technology and is responsible for assigned elements of new product development under MicroAire Design Controls Procedures. Manages the technical and personnel aspects of facilities maintenance and provides technical leadership in areas critical to MicroAire’s success. 
 
 + Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 • Drives the planning and execution of critical Advanced Manufacturing projects for insourcing, automation, and continuous improvement, including cost savings, delivery, and quality.
 • Leads or coaches critical continuous improvement, Lean, kaizen, and Blue Belt projects. Coordinates corporate CI tracking and planning, drives the site CI calendar, and tracks and reports savings.
 • Supports Supply Chain in the technical aspects of insourcing, alternative sourcing, supplier quality, and supplier continuous improvement. Supports business initiatives such as repairs and service programs.
 • Participates and makes recommendations regarding departmental quarterly plans and performs all essential duties and responsibilities within the company’s mission, vision and values.
 • Develops career paths for direct reports.
 • Provides guidance to manufacturing engineering for new highly critical products and oversees facilities maintenance activities within cross-functional teams consistent with departmental goals and objectives.
 • Oversees Engineering activity around investigation and root cause analysis for failures observed in the field that needs Engineering support.
 • Serves as the specialized technical expert resource for all project teams for manufacturing engineering projects.
 • Provides leadership by taking initiative for existing product modifications.
 • Provides guidance on Design For Manufacturing during New Product Development process.
 • Interfaces with all departments within the company as well as consultants, vendors, surgeons, and others as required to ensure quality, efficacy, and timely completion of directed projects.
 • Proactively works with team members to achieve established goals, budgets and timelines.
 • Monitors department budgets closely and takes all necessary actions to ensure budget alignment.  Identifies capital needs for production and facilities to provide CapEx recommendations.
 • Collaborates with department heads to develop and update engineering standard operating procedures.
 • Ensures project compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, especially U.S. FDA regulations and EU Medical Device Regulation supporting Regulatory group.
 • Researches and analyzes facility requirements and manufacturing capabilities / capacities around potential acquisition opportunities.
 • Provides technical training for engineering and operations personnel. Provides systems training to other functional areas as necessary.
 • Identifies Advanced Manufacturing Engineering needs and communicates these needs to Senior Management.
 • Manages facilities maintenance activities through prioritization of safety, health and production needs.
 • Identifies safety issues in the immediate work environment and other work areas and recommends solutions for improvement.
 • Ensures engineering and facilities maintenance activities are in compliance with Quality System requirements.
 • Ensures facility maintenance activities are also in compliance with OSHA and other applicable health and safety standards.
 • Performs other related duties as required.
 Authority and supervision: Directly manages Facility Maintenance and mentors junior engineers. Reviews and approves project team work and exercises sound business judgment, recognizing that errors may significantly affect the company.

 + Education and Experience 

 Education Requirements: Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering or applicable degree.
 Experience Requirements:  8-10 years of Engineering (Manufacturing & Design) experience supporting products in post market phases of product lifecycle.  3- 5 years of leadership experience.  Five years in medical device industry desirable.

 Job knowledge skills and abilities 

 • Proficiency in 2D drafting and 3D modeling, preferably AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
 • Knowledge of ANSI Y14.5 drafting standards.
 • Expertise in properties of various materials, such as stainless steel, aluminum and plastics.
 • Expertise in part fabrication techniques, such as machining and injection molding.
 • Expertise in the factors that affect the life of re-usable surgical instruments, such as corrosion, wear and thermal cycling.
 • Thorough understanding of part tolerancing and tolerance stack-up analysis.
 • Thorough understanding of mechanical stress analysis.
 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Project and other job associated software.
 • In depth understanding of regulatory requirements for medical device design control and manufacturing.
 • In depth understanding of various surgical techniques as related to surgical instruments.
 • Ability to apply scientific reasoning and to develop test methodologies to resolve complex technical problems.

 + Competencies 

 Advanced Manufacturing and Technical Leadership 
 Skills: Automation, insourcing, manufacturing processes, design for manufacturing, mechanical analysis, and root cause investigation. 
 Behaviors: Leads manufacturing initiatives from planning through implementation; guides technical decisions and resolves complex product and process issues using evidence. 

 Program Execution and Business Acumen 
 Skills: Project planning, risk and milestone management, budget control, CapEx evaluation, and cost savings analysis. 
 Behaviors: Sets priorities, coordinates resources, anticipates risks, and delivers projects within agreed budgets and timelines; connects investment decisions to business results. 

 People Leadership and Cross Functional Collaboration 
 Skills: Coaching, delegation, career development, technical training, communication, and stakeholder alignment. 
 Behaviors: Sets clear expectations, develops direct reports and junior engineers, holds teams accountable, and aligns Operations, Supply Chain, 
 Quality, and Engineering around shared goals. 

 Continuous Improvement and Lean Execution 
 Skills: Lean tools, kaizen and Blue Belt project coaching, CI planning, savings tracking, and process improvement. 
 Behaviors: Leads and coaches improvement initiatives, maintains a prioritized CI calendar, and verifies measurable gains in cost, quality, and delivery. 

 Quality Regulatory and Safety Stewardship 
 Skills: FDA and EU MDR requirements, design controls, Quality Systems, OSHA standards, and facilities maintenance prioritization. 
 Behaviors: Embeds compliance in engineering and maintenance work, identifies and addresses safety and quality risks early, and prioritizes maintenance based on safety, health, and production needs. 

 + Work Environment, Physical Demands and Protective Equipment 

 Minimal physical demands, primary work in an office or lab environment.  May be required to do some travel, and to stand for periods of time during work or viewing surgeries.
 Works primarily in an office or manufacturing environment, with periodic work in the engineering lab and prototype machine shop. Occasional travel may be required.
 Follows protective equipment procedures for each department.  Adheres to medical facility precautions during cadaver labs and surgical procedures.  Hep B. vaccine series provided, documentation of vaccination or signed declination required.
 Confidentiality: Access to the engineering CAD database, trade secrets, and information about new products requires maintaining confidentiality.

 + Schedule, Travel Responsibility, Special Conditions or Requirements 

 Occasional travel may be required, including visits to medical facilities, cadaver labs, or surgical procedures.
 Training and certification requirements: See the individual training matrix in the Training Management System.

 Pay Range: $125,000 - $155,000

If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

role.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Spaulding Rehabilitation Network
role.description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated 
 
 Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.
 
 
 Job Summary 
The Senior Manager, Quality reports to the MGB AMC Quality Director within the Office of the Chief Medical Officer (OCMO) and is responsible for the success of a broad quality program across the Spaulding Rehabilitation Network (SRN). The role provides leadership across SRN’s four sites and diverse care settings, including IRF, LTCH, and SNF, with responsibility for quality strategy, performance measurement, and Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) planning, execution, and governance. 

The Senior Manager partners closely with Spaulding executive, clinical, and operational leadership to identify priorities, interpret performance, address emerging risks, and advance improvement strategies. The role also serves as an important connection between SRN and the broader MGB OCMO structure to ensure alignment with system priorities, standards, and improvement approaches. 

Success in this role requires strong leadership, sound judgment, clear and concise executive communication, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed health system. The individual must be comfortable working across multiple care settings and adapting as organizational priorities and the scope of the quality portfolio evolve. 
 
 Qualifications 







 Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

 Quality Strategy & Portfolio Leadership 
 Execute the MGB quality strategy across the network, working with site and executive leaders to translate priorities into measurable goals, coordinated action, and sustained follow-through.
 Partner with Spaulding executive, clinical, and operational leaders to identify quality priorities, interpret performance trends, assess emerging risks, and develop actionable improvement strategies.
 Maintain a comprehensive view of quality performance across all four SRN sites, identifying meaningful site variation, opportunities for standardization, shared learning, or targeted intervention.
 Provide longitudinal leadership for established quality priorities, including initiatives such as acute readmissions and hand hygiene, while identifying and advancing new areas of improvement.
 Understand quality and performance data in the context of SRN’s patient populations, care settings, and clinical practices, and translate findings into clear priorities and recommended actions.
  
 Quality Governance & Performance Improvement 
 Lead QAPI planning, execution, documentation, and reporting across SRN, including support for executive and board-level quality governance.
 Establish clear ownership, escalation, follow-up, and accountability for identified quality priorities and performance concerns.
 Lead proactive and reactive performance improvement initiatives from current-state assessment through intervention design, implementation, measurement, sustainment, and accountability.
 Apply sound improvement science, high-reliability principles, and change-management approaches to design, implement, and sustain effective improvement efforts.
 Partner with MGB data and analytics teams to support accurate, timely, and meaningful quality reporting for regulatory, benchmarking, governance, and performance-management needs.
 Prepare concise, accurate, and executive-ready presentations, reports, recommendations, and updates for Spaulding and MGB leadership.
 
 Cross-Functional Partnerships 
 Partner with the SRN Associate Chief Medical Officer (ACMO) and other physician leaders to advance quality strategy, clinical performance priorities, and quality governance.
 Partner with SRN Nursing Leadership to advance quality priorities, support frontline implementation, and address opportunities identified through performance data or patient safety events.
 Partner with the Senior Manager, Clinical Compliance to support regulatory readiness, accreditation activities, site visits, and response to identified or emerging compliance risks.
 Partner with Senior Manager, Patient Safety/Risk/Patient Family Relations to support improvement arising from safety events and proactively identify opportunities to reduce harm.
 Partner with Infection Prevention and site leadership to monitor infection-related performance and advance improvement strategies as needed.
 Build effective partnerships across clinical, operational, and frontline teams to ensure quality priorities are understood, coordinated, and advanced effectively.
 Maintain strong communication and alignment between SRN and MGB Quality leadership, ensuring system priorities and expectations are translated locally and that SRN risks, needs, and performance are appropriately escalated.
  
 Team Leadership & Management 
 Provide direct and shared leadership of approximately 3-6 staff supporting Quality/PI, Patient Safety/Risk/PFR, and Clinical Compliance, in partnership with respective functional leaders.
 Establish clear expectations and priorities, provide regular coaching and feedback, assess workload and capacity, and coordinate with other Senior Managers to align staff responsibilities and resources.
 Conduct staff performance evaluations and support professional development and growth.
 Manage multiple priorities and workstreams across the four-site portfolio, ensuring effective planning, execution, follow-through, and accountability.
 Manage the department budget effectively and provide input into staffing and resource needs.
 Support local education and training related to quality measurement, performance improvement, and regulatory requirements as needed.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
  
 Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required for the Position
   
 Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required 
   
 Undergraduate degree required. Master’s degree in Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, Public Administration, Health Services Administration, or a related field strongly preferred.
 Minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare quality, performance improvement, or a related field, including experience managing staff.
 Experience in rehabilitation, post-acute care, specialty hospitals, or another complex multi-site healthcare environment strongly preferred.
 Clinical background preferred but not required.
 Demonstrated expertise in healthcare quality, quality measurement, performance improvement, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to translate identified risks and opportunities into measurable and sustained improvement.
 Strong familiarity with rehabilitation and post-acute quality performance, including the ability to interpret relevant clinical and operational KPIs, understand differences across IRF, LTCH, and SNF settings, identify the outcomes most meaningful to a rehabilitation network, and translate performance insights into improvement strategies.
 Strong background in improvement science, implementation, high reliability, and change management, with experience in current-state assessment, process mapping, workflow analysis, stakeholder engagement, measurement, and sustainment.
 Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex problems, structure the work, identify the appropriate stakeholders, and move priorities forward with sound judgment and limited direction.
 Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex quality and performance information into clear priorities, recommendations, and concise, polished, executive-ready communications and presentations.
 Strong knowledge of QAPI, quality governance, regulatory and accreditation requirements, and performance reporting relevant to rehabilitation, post-acute, or specialty care settings.
 Ability to work effectively in a complex, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with key stakeholders.
 Strong judgment, organization, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines across multiple sites.
 Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to analyze and synthesize data from disparate sources, apply quality measurement methodologies and basic statistical concepts, and create clear and polished materials. 
 Familiarity with Epic or another electronic health record is strongly preferred.
 
 Special Requirements
 Must be available to support hospital-declared emergencies as needed.
 Must be available to support regulatory and accreditation reviews.
 Must be able to travel among SRN sites as needed.

role.title: DIRECTOR OF QUALITY & COMPLIANCE
role.description:
**Director of Quality & Compliance**
====================================

**Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**

[Full-Time)

$95,000 To $120,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance- AFTER 30 DAYS
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As the Director of Quality & Compliance, you will:

Oversees compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer contracts and Joint Commission standards.

* Reviews and approves corrective action plans for regulatory, payer, and accreditation findings before routing them for final approval. Verifies implementation and sustained compliance.
* Works with Quality and Compliance Specialist and Program Directors to prepare for licensing inspections, Medicaid and managed care reviews, and accreditation surveys.
* Serves as a compliance liaison with CDHS and applicable Regional Accountable Entities (RAEs) and other payers. Reviews provider manuals and contract changes and translates requirements into program procedures.
* Conducts program and follow-up audits, including reviews of admissions, assessments, treatment plans, service documentation, discharge planning, and continuity of care.
* Provides technical assistance to Quality and Compliance Specialists and trains program staff on licensing, payer, and accreditation requirements.
* Develops monitoring tools with Quality and Compliance Specialists to verify compliance and consistent implementation of program policies.
* Analyzes audit findings, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization or denial trends. Reports findings and tracks improvement actions with program leaders.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to oversee utilization management, including prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, medical necessity and level-of-care documentation, and responses to denials and appeals.
* Develops and reviews policies and procedures, supports the annual review process, and verifies that programs maintain current policy and procedure manuals.
* Participates on various internal and external committees as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Master's degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and five years of quality and compliance experience or bachelor’s degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and seven years quality and compliance experience

* Ability to effectively supervise employees.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is critical.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Proven ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

role.title: Director - Quality Assurance
role.description:
**Overview**

Westchester Jewish Community Services (WJCS) is an award-winning nonprofit human services organization founded in 1943. Today, it has grown to be the largest provider of licensed outpatient community behavioral health services and one of the largest human service agencies in Westchester County. WJCS delivers innovative programs and services and compassionate care to more than 20,000 people of all ages and backgrounds throughout the county.

We are currently seeking a full-time Director of Quality Assurance to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for investigations, clinical compliance, implementation of quality initiatives, incident information collection and monitoring, and other duties as assigned.

The salary range for this full-time position is $110,000.

**Responsibilities**

As a valued member of our team, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* Investigates reportable incidents and notable occurrences within clinics, satellite programs and trauma division.
* Maintains records related to incidents; chairs required meetings as needed.
* Provides required incident information to be entered into NIMRS (OMH Incident Reporting and Management Application).
* Monitors required data metrics that are reported to regulatory bodies (i.e. OMH/OASAS/SAMHSA)
* Implements and tracks annual quality improvement initiatives.
* Identifies, implements and monitors staff trainings necessary for CCBHC licensure.
* Reviews and makes necessary changes to clinic policies and procedures.
* Investigates clinic compliance issues as assigned.
* Develops, distributes, and tabulates responses for the annual Consumer Satisfaction Surveys
* Conduct annual audit as requested.
* Completes necessary documents related to CBCHC and OMH/OASAS recertification and audit requests as needed.
* Acts as liaison with Utilization Review process.
* Attends Clinic Leadership, Clinic Transformation, compliance and other required meetings.

**Requirements**

We are seeking candidates who possess the following qualifications:

* Master’s Degree in Social Work or PhD in Psychology preferred
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience working in community behavioral health settings, with leadership skills preferred
* Knowledge of OMH, OASAS and SAMHSA regulations
* Ability to investigate incidents, including allegations of abuse
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to work closely with members of the executive staff ( i.e. CMO, CCO) and direct service staff
* Strong leadership skills
* Excellent critical thinking & writing skills
* Excellent computer skills
* Excellent knowledge of OMH, OASAS, OPWDD, SAMHSA & CCBHC regulations
* Excellent clinical and diagnostic skills

**What WJCS has to offer you**

In addition to meaningful work and a supportive team environment, we offer a competitive benefits package, including:

* Generous paid time off
* Comprehensive Health Benefits, Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and a Healthcare Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
* 403(b) Plan and an Agency-Paid Pension Plan
* Ongoing Professional Development and Training
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition, day-care, and personal emergency reimbursements
* Disability and life insurance
* Staff appreciation events and employee mental health and wellness initiatives

**WJCS INC. IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

role.title: Director of Quality, Regulatory & Improvement
role.description:
***Title:*** ***Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**
----------------

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:****Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**
----------------------------

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

role.title: Director of Manufacturing
role.description:
Director of Manufacturing

**POSITION SUMMARY**
====================

Weaver Popcorn is seeking an experienced manufacturing leader to direct the **Malden, Missouri** operation and strengthen safety, quality, service, cost performance, throughput, and associate development. The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and hands-on leadership for plant operations, maintenance, sanitation, scheduling, grower partnership, and continuous improvement while ensuring reliable execution of annual operating priorities.

This leader will establish clear performance expectations, develop plant leadership and frontline capability, optimize equipment and labor effectiveness, and partner across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement to deliver sustainable operational and financial results.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Manufacturing & Operational Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead the Malden manufacturing operation with accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, sanitation, labor effectiveness, and overall plant performance.
* Establish clear operational standards, performance goals, equipment expectations, and operating cost objectives aligned with the annual plan.
* Drive reliable production output and efficient growth by ensuring the right equipment, staffing, operating systems, and performance measures are in place.
* Lead regular operating reviews with plant leadership to evaluate productivity, downtime, quality, staffing, schedule attainment, and corrective actions.
* Ensure manufacturing systems, procedures, and policies are consistently deployed, understood, and followed across assigned operations.
* Align internal manufacturing capabilities with customer needs, production schedules, raw-material availability, and growth expectations.

**Safety, Quality & Food Manufacturing Compliance**
---------------------------------------------------

* Provide visible leadership for a safe workplace and hold leaders accountable for proactive hazard identification, corrective action, training, and compliance.
* Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure compliance with food safety and quality requirements, including HACCP, GMPs, sanitation standards, product controls, and applicable regulatory and customer requirements.
* Support disciplined investigation and sustainable corrective action for safety events, quality deviations, operational failures, customer concerns, and recurring performance issues.
* Ensure plant practices support audit readiness, traceability, sanitation effectiveness, and consistent production of safe, conforming product.
* Reinforce the authority and responsibility to stop or correct work when safety, food safety, quality, or regulatory requirements are not being met.

**Continuous Improvement, Reliability & Capital**
-------------------------------------------------

* Deploy Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, yield, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost performance.
* Identify operational failures and constraints, establish root causes, implement corrective actions, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain meaningful manufacturing KPIs and equipment-efficiency measures that support timely, fact-based decisions.
* Partner with Maintenance and plant leaders to improve equipment reliability, preventive maintenance effectiveness, space utilization, and production capacity.
* Jointly establish capital expenditure priorities and lead effective execution of approved capital and process-improvement projects.
* Challenge existing practices, standardize successful improvements, and build continuous-improvement capability throughout the operation.

**Grower, Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Partnership**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Field Operations to support grower relationships, contracted acreage plans, raw-material supply, and growth objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain and plant scheduling teams to balance customer requirements, inventory, capacity, labor, and raw-material availability.
* Work with Finance and Information Technology to strengthen business processes, operating data, management reporting, budgeting, and decision-support tools.
* Contribute the manufacturing perspective to companywide initiatives led by Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Quality, and other functional leaders.
* Communicate operational risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop plant leaders and assigned functional leaders; establish clear goals, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build a culture of excellence, ownership, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement at every level of the operation.
* Develop internal talent, strengthen succession readiness, and partner with Human Resources to recruit and retain a capable workforce.
* Build associate competency through effective training, qualification, coaching, and skills-development programs.
* Use a visible, participative leadership style that communicates direction, listens for understanding, addresses conflict directly, and earns followership.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 10 years in a Plant Manager or comparable senior manufacturing leadership role; food or agricultural processing experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success applying Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, equipment efficiency, labor productivity, yield, and cost performance.
* Experience leading workplace safety, food manufacturing quality systems, sanitation, GMPs, HACCP-based programs, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Proven financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L accountability, capital prioritization, and analysis of manufacturing KPIs and cost drivers.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, strengthening organizational capability, managing change, and building accountability in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to travel regionally approximately 15% and remain available outside normal business hours when operational needs require support.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Leadership experience in popcorn, corn, grain, ingredient, food processing, or a related agricultural manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading capital projects, technical teams, maintenance-reliability programs, and high-engagement employee relations.
* Formal training or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, safety, continuous improvement, or project leadership.
* Experience partnering directly with growers or agricultural supply networks.

**WHERE & WHEN WILL YOU WORK?**
===============================

This role operates across office, agricultural, warehouse, and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Manufacturing must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when safety, quality, customer, staffing, equipment, or other operational needs require support. Regional travel of approximately 15% is expected, with additional travel based on business needs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Strong, sustained performance in safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, and customer satisfaction.
* Improved equipment reliability, operating efficiency, labor effectiveness, yield, and cost performance supported by clear KPIs.
* Consistent execution of manufacturing, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operating standards.
* Disciplined problem solving that reduces recurring failures and produces measurable, sustained improvement.
* A capable and accountable plant leadership team with clear goals, stronger bench strength, and active development plans.
* Effective partnership across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement.
* Credible, visible leadership that builds ownership, engagement, and confidence throughout the Malden operation.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document.*

role.description:
***Join Nicopress — a stable, successful Cleveland-based global manufacturer with nearly 125 years of innovation in connectivity solutions.***

**Lead People. Improve Processes. Make an Impact.**

*Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives on improving operations, developing people, and getting results?* Nicopress is looking for an experienced **Director of Plant Operations** to lead our manufacturing operations and help take our performance to the next level.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact in a stable, established manufacturing company where your ideas, leadership, and contributions will be noticed and valued.

What You'll Do

* Lead daily manufacturing operations, ensuring safety, quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery.
* Coach and develop production supervisors while building a culture of accountability and teamwork.
* Champion the effective use and optimization of our MRP system to strengthen production planning and inventory management.
* Drive continuous improvement, reduce waste, and improve operational performance.
* Partner closely with senior leadership, engineering, and quality teams to solve problems and move the business forward.

What We're Looking For

* 8–10+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Proven success leading production teams and developing supervisors.
* Strong hands-on experience with MRP/ERP systems, production planning, and process improvement.
* A practical, solutions-oriented leader who is equally comfortable on the production floor and collaborating with leadership.
* Experience in precision manufacturing, metalworking, or machining is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

What we offer:

* Competitive salary of $50-60k based on experience.
* Work/life balance with a Mon-Fri 8:15 to 4:45 work schedule & no overtime required.
* Full benefits package, including generous paid time off.

**Why Nicopress?**

At Nicopress, you'll enjoy the opportunity to make meaningful improvements without layers of corporate bureaucracy. We're a close-knit manufacturing organization of approximately 50 employees that values quality, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, lead a great team, and make a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you!**

Full job description available upon request or interview. Work with us!

*Nicopress is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance

role.title: Director of Operations - Rockwall, TX
role.description:
**Why Build Your Career with Prysmian?**

**Your work at Prysmian helps power and connect the world.**

Prysmian, the world leader in solutions for energy and digital connections, strengthen its global team with the 2025 addition of Channell, now part of Prysmian. Founded by the Channell family in 1922, Channell brings a long‑standing legacy of innovation in outside plant infrastructure, serving Telecommunications, Municipalities, Internet Service Providers, Wireless, Water, Power, and CATV markets. Together, Prysmian and Channell team members are combining expertise, craftsmanship, and shared values to deliver a broader portfolio, from advanced cable systems and fiber connectivity solutions to enclosures and below‑grade vaults which support resilient infrastructure, the energy transition, and the growth of digital networks around the world.

When you join Prysmian, you become part of a global team whose work touches millions of lives every day. You’ll help support the energy and digital infrastructure that keeps communities, businesses, and industries moving forward.

For more than 140 years, Prysmian has helped shape the infrastructure that powers progress. From helping illuminate the Statue of Liberty in 1886 and delivering power from Hoover Dam to Los Angeles in 1935, to supporting New York City's rebuilding efforts after September 11, our cables and connectivity solutions have played a role in some of history's most significant milestones.

**What You’ll Bring:**

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, business administration, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience, including 5+ years leading multiple sites or a multi-plant network.
* Proven track record managing P&L, capital budgets, and operational KPIs across geographically dispersed facilities.
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous improvement methodologies; certification (Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt) preferred.
* Strong experience with ERP/MES systems and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others, build high-performing teams, and manage change across a diverse, multi-site organization.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental regulations, and quality systems (ISO 9001 or equivalent).
* Experience in electronics, cable/connector, or precision component manufacturing a plus.
* Familiarity with thermoplastic molding - low and high pressure injection molding, rotational molding, and blow molding
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly (up to 40–50%) between facilities, including international travel as applicable.
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and the board.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost analysis.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, multi-site manufacturing environment.

**What You'll Do:**

The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across the company's multi-site manufacturing network. This role is accountable for driving safety, quality, productivity, cost, and delivery performance at every facility while building a consistent operating system, talent pipeline, and culture of continuous improvement across locations.

The Director partners closely with Plant Managers, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and HR to ensure each site operates at world-class levels and that capacity, capital, and talent decisions support the company's growth and customer commitments.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop and execute the multi-site manufacturing operations strategy in alignment with overall business goals, growth plans, and customer demand.
* Establish and standardize a common operating system (KPIs, daily management, tiered accountability meetings) across all plants to ensure consistent execution and visibility.
* Set annual operating and capital budgets for all locations; own P&L accountability for manufacturing operations.
* Drive productivity, throughput, and cost-reduction initiatives while maintaining or improving quality and service levels.
* Lead capacity planning, footprint strategy, and capital investment decisions across the network, including new equipment, line expansions, or facility consolidations.
* Directly manage and develop Plant Managers/Site Leaders at each location, setting clear performance expectations and holding sites accountable to targets.
* Build bench strength and succession plans for critical operations roles across all sites; partner with HR on talent acquisition, development, and retention strategies.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement; conduct regular site visits and gemba walks.
* Standardize best practices across facilities and lead cross-site knowledge sharing to eliminate performance variability between plants.
* Champion an EHS-first culture; ensure all locations meet or exceed OSHA and applicable regulatory requirements, with measurable reduction in incident rates.
* Ensure consistent adherence to quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) and customer quality requirements across all sites.
* Oversee compliance with environmental, labor, and applicable trade/export regulations at each facility.
* Lead deployment of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and/or Continuous Improvement methodologies across all locations.
* Drive standardization of processes, work instructions, and systems (ERP/MES) to improve consistency, data integrity, and decision-making across sites.
* Identify and lead major process improvement, automation, and cost-savings projects with measurable ROI.
* Partner with Supply Chain/Planning to align production schedules with demand, inventory targets, and on-time delivery goals.
* Collaborate with Engineering on new product introductions, process qualifications, and manufacturability improvements.
* Work with Finance on cost accounting, standard costs, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Partner with HR on workforce planning, labor relations, compensation strategy, and organizational design across sites.
* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, reporting operational performance and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and/or the board as needed.

**You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact, build strong partnerships, and grow your career in a business that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.**

**Total Rewards Designed for You:**

We believe great people deserve great rewards. That’s why Prysmian offers a total rewards package designed to support your financial, physical, and personal well-being now and as your career grows.

* **Competitive salary** that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions
* **Performance-based incentives** that reward your results and impact *(where applicable)*
* **Comprehensive health coverage** with medical, dental, and vision plan options to fit your needs
* **401(k) retirement savings plan** with a competitive company match to help you invest in your future
* **Paid maternity and bonding leave, plus adoption assistance** to support you and your growing family
* **Generous paid time off and company holidays** so you can rest, recharge, and spend time on what matters most
* **Life and disability insurance** for added peace of mind
* **Wellness programs and supplemental insurance options** to support your overall health and well-being

**At Prysmian, you’ll be supported at work, at home, and throughout every stage of your career.**

role.title: Head of Manufacturing - Promotional Products & Custom Manufacturing
role.description:
**Job Description - Head of Manufacturing- Promotional Products & Custom Manufacturing Company: Stealth Mode Three Department: Operations Location: Richmond, TX (On-site) Employment type: Full-time Compensation: $80,000–$120,000 per year Original apply URL: https://www.stealthmodethree.com/careers/job\_a46ed593ff5e48d59c33 About the Role We are seeking an experienced Head of Manufacturing to lead and scale our production operation in Richmond, Texas. This is not a traditional general-manufacturing management role. We are looking for a leader who understands the unique demands of the promotional products and custom merchandise industry — where every day can involve changing order volumes, customized products, tight deadlines, multiple production methods, material constraints, and constantly shifting priorities. The ideal candidate has experience leading production in promotional products, decorated apparel, custom merchandise, commercial printing, signage, embroidery, DTF/DTG, screen printing, heat transfer, or a similar high-mix production environment. You will own the operational performance of the manufacturing organization and work closely with leadership and other departments to build a reliable, scalable, high-performing production operation. As Head of Manufacturing, you will be responsible for translating customer demand into an efficient production operation. You will lead the people, processes, equipment, materials, and systems required to consistently deliver orders on time, at the expected quality, and at the right cost. You will be expected to identify bottlenecks before they become problems, establish clear accountability across the production team, and continuously improve how work moves through the facility. The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing a print shop or production environment and be comfortable taking ownership of production performance from start to finish. Responsibilities Production & Operations - Own daily production operations and overall manufacturing performance. - Plan and prioritize production based on order volume, deadlines, capacity, materials, and available labor. - Establish production schedules and adjust priorities as demand changes. - Monitor throughput, turnaround time, capacity utilization, labor efficiency, quality, and waste. - Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective actions. - Ensure orders move efficiently from intake through production, quality control, and fulfillment. People Leadership - Lead, develop, and hold production employees and supervisors accountable. - Establish clear expectations and performance standards. - Build a culture centered on ownership, urgency, quality, and continuous improvement. - Recruit and train production talent as the organization grows. - Develop cross-training and workforce-flexibility strategies to reduce production disruption. - Address performance issues quickly and fairly through coaching, documentation, and accountability. Promotional Products Manufacturing - Understand the operational requirements of customized and made-to-order products. - Coordinate different production methods, equipment, materials, and workflows. - Optimize production sequencing and batch similar work where appropriate. - Understand the impact of artwork, materials, production methods, finishing, and fulfillment on turnaround time and quality. - Work closely with other departments to ensure production requirements are understood before orders reach the floor. Quality & Continuous Improvement - Establish and maintain quality standards and production controls. - Identify root causes of defects, rework, delays, and production failures. - Develop SOPs, work instructions, checklists, and visual standards. - Implement process improvements that increase throughput while reducing waste and errors. - Establish meaningful KPIs and use data to drive operational decisions. Inventory, Equipment & Materials - Maintain appropriate inventory levels and production material availability. - Partner with purchasing and supply chain to anticipate material requirements. - Monitor material usage, waste, and production costs. - Coordinate equipment maintenance and respond quickly to equipment failures. - Develop contingency plans for equipment downtime and capacity constraints. Cross-Functional Leadership - Partner with Sales, Customer Service, Purchasing, Warehouse, and company leadership. - Establish clear communication around production capacity, deadlines, shortages, and delays. - Help ensure sales commitments align with actual production capacity. - Provide leadership with visibility into production performance and constraints. Requirements The strongest candidates will have: - 5+ years of production or manufacturing leadership experience. - Direct experience in promotional products, custom merchandise, decorated apparel, printing, signage, or a closely related industry. - Experience managing high-volume, customized or made-to-order production. - Experience managing production teams and supervisors. - Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, and capacity management. - Experience using KPIs to manage throughput, quality, labor, turnaround, waste, and cost. - Strong understanding of inventory and material planning. - Experience with equipment maintenance, downtime, and production contingencies. - Demonstrated process-improvement experience. - Experience creating and implementing SOPs. - Strong employee-management and accountability skills. - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. - A hands-on leadership style and willingness to spend significant time on the production floor. Preferred Industry Experience Experience with any of the following is highly valuable: - Promotional products - Branded merchandise - Custom apparel - DTF printing - DTG printing - Screen printing - Embroidery - Heat press / heat transfer - Digital printing - Large-format printing - Sign manufacturing - Custom merchandise production - Fulfillment of personalized or made-to-order products Schedule Ability to work full-time, Monday through Friday, on-site in Richmond, Texas. Benefits - $80,000–$120,000 annual salary - Leadership position with significant ownership and responsibility - Opportunity to help scale and improve a growing manufacturing operation - Collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment - Opportunity for long-term growth within the organization**

Pay: $80,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future? (Yes/No)
* Are you currently located in or willing to relocate to Richmond, TX for an on-site role? (Yes/No)
* Do you have professional experience with promotional products, DTF, DTG, screen printing, or embroidery? (Yes/No)
