role.title: Operational Excellence Director
role.description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We're adding to our team! We are seeking an **Operational Excellence****Director** to lead the optimization of workflows and play a key role in the continuous improvement across all projects and operations. This role ensures alignment with industry best practices, including CSIA Best Practices, while driving consistent, high-quality delivery in automation and integration projects.

**You will:**

* Ensure workflows meet E Tech Group and Business Unit quality policies, procedures, CSIA Best Practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct internal audits to evaluate adherence to standards, practical efficiency of associated tools, assess root-cause failure modes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
* Business Unit representative for E Tech's Continuous Improvement Committee, providing practical suggestions and solutions, communicating with Business Unit leadership.
* Analyze project execution workflows to identify and remove bottlenecks, directly improving project lead times and margin predictability.
* Identify and champion the use of digital tools and AI to automate repetitive administrative tasks, reducing 'process friction' for engineering teams.
* Represent the Business Unit for Customer and third party audits, including audit preparation, participation, response coordination, and follow up.
* Foster quality, consistency, and ongoing improvement across cross-functional teams.
* Support Corporate Continuous Improvement initiatives including development and review of policies and procedures.
* Lead Business Unit continuous improvement activities.
* Provide necessary supplemental training and guidance to the Business Unit on quality standards, procedures, and expectations.
* Provide support to improve the quality and effectiveness of the Learning Management System (LMS)
* Encourage collaboration, shared learning, and knowledge transfer across teams throughout the Company
* Collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, and the Project Management Organization to support project risk assessments, and quality planning.
* Attend project reviews, as needed, and provide guidance to project teams for compliance with Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and other procedures during project execution.
* Interface with clients and third parties on quality related topics, including audits, vendor qualification, and compliance inquiries.
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical or Systems), or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Over seven years of experience in process improvement and engineering performance within technical, project-driven settings. Proven track record in supporting process optimization, waste reduction, quality assurance, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives in engineering or project environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence technical teams and stakeholders
* Experience working in automation, life sciences or other regulated industries, prefer knowledge of ISO 9001, GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Assurance (CSA).
* Experience supporting automation and control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI).
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

 

**Benefits & Perks:**

* 401k + match + prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
* Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
* Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

Salary Range: $150,000-$170,000

*E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.*

role.title: Plant Manager – Commercial Laundry
role.description:
**Overview**

**Plant Manager – Commercial Laundry** 
**Premier Linen Services | Fort Myers, FL | Full-Time | $85,000 – $125,000 per year**

**About us** 
Premier Linen Services runs an advanced, state-of-the-art commercial laundry facility serving large and luxury hospitality properties across Florida. We’re a growing, owner-led company with a modern, high-volume plant, and we’re looking for a hands-on leader to keep it running safely and efficiently every day.

**About the role** 
The Plant Manager runs daily operations across our production facility. You’ll keep production moving through washing, drying, finishing and packaging, work with maintenance and logistics, and lead a team focused on quality, safety and on-time delivery.

What you’ll do

* Oversee day-to-day plant operations and make sure production goals are met
* Supervise and develop department supervisors, shift leads and production staff
* Carry out production plans, adjusting schedules and staffing to meet customer demand
* Watch real-time output, quality and downtime, and fix problems quickly
* Work with maintenance and logistics to keep equipment running and production uninterrupted
* Build a strong safety culture through inspections, training and quick action on hazards
* Help control labor, material and utility costs while keeping quality high
* Track and report KPIs for productivity, quality and safety to leadership
* Lead continuous improvement and lean initiatives on the plant floor

**What we’re looking for**

* 3–5+ years of experience as a plant manager, production manager or similar leader, preferably in commercial laundry, manufacturing or textiles
* Proven ability to lead and motivate teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
* Strong organizational, communication and problem-solving skills
* Calm and decisive under pressure, able to handle emergencies
* Comfortable with Microsoft Office and production software
* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred
* Fluent in English and Spanish (Preferred)

**Working conditions** 
This is a plant-floor role in an industrial laundry, with heat, humidity, noise and chemicals. It requires long periods of standing and walking, and the ability to lift and push up to 50 lbs. The schedule is flexible and based on production needs.

What we offer

* Salary of $85,000 – $125,000, based on experience
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* A leadership role with a growing, owner-led company

***Premier Linen Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

Pay: $85,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Description:

**Signia Aerospace** is built on decades of proven performance and partnership in the aircraft systems industry. The proven brands that operate under the Signia Aerospace ecosystem lead the field in thermal management and mission-specific equipment. They are the brands of choice for pilots, maintenance directors, ground crews, and supply chain professionals worldwide, in commercial, private, and military applications. Our depth of expertise and unique pool of resources allows us to act as an integrated, nimble partner in the design, manufacture, delivery, and service of highly specialized aircraft systems and components.

**Company Name:** Plane Exhaust Corp. (A Hartzell Aerospace Welding division).

Founded in 2002, Plane Exhaust Corporation. is backed by over 24 years of experience in aircraft exhaust system repair, overhaul and modification. We provide a large variety of services on any aircraft exhaust system made by any aircraft company with great customer support.

**Our Culture**

We are a team that prides ourselves on a culture that supports shared values of empowerment, accountability, drive, integrity, and respect. Our team shares a deep commitment to safety and collaboration. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance, 401(K) plans with employer match, company provided Growth Participation Units (GPU) and so much more.

Our GPU benefit is unique to the industry and encourages all employees to think like owners and receive future financial reward for contributions to business growth. Join our team to be part of a culture that encourages growth and development and celebrates our success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Manages operations within a smaller or less complex manufacturing facility while overseeing production, maintenance, materials, logistics, safety, quality, and operational performance activities. Ensures plant operations meet production, cost, delivery, safety, and quality objectives while supporting workforce development, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives.

All roles at Signia are expected to support the company’s operating model (SOAR) and contribute to the organization’s business value drivers, Profitable New Business, Productivity, Precision M&A, and Value-Based Pricing, through operational excellence, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer focus.

Requirements:

**Key Deliverables of the Position**

1) Achievement of plant production, safety, quality, and delivery objectives

2) Efficient operation of manufacturing, maintenance, and support functions

3) Compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements

4) Effective management of plant budgets, operational costs, and resources

5) Reliable operational scheduling, staffing, and production execution

6) Continuous improvement of operational efficiency and plant performance

7) Effective leadership and development of plant personnel and supervisors

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Typically requires 6+ years of manufacturing or operational leadership experience
* Previous supervisory or management experience required

**Technical Competencies**

1) Manufacturing and plant operations management

2) Production planning and operational execution

3) Safety, quality, and regulatory compliance

4) Budgeting and cost management

5) Workforce leadership and employee development

6) Continuous improvement and operational efficiency

7) Cross-functional operational coordination

8) KPI monitoring and operational reporting

9) Maintenance and facility oversight

10) Proficient Computer Skills – Microsoft Office and ERP/manufacturing systems

11) Excellent Communication Skills – both verbal and written

**Behavioral Competencies – Demonstrates behaviors consistent with our values**

**1)** **Thinks and acts like an owner**

o Uses company resources wisely & cost-effectively

o Shows pride in the organization and a commitment to its long-term success

o Takes full responsibility for their actions

o Holds self to high standards of performance and integrity

**2)** **Demonstrates high integrity**

o Consistently acts with honestly, transparency and high ethics

o Makes decisions based on what is morally right

o Owns their actions and holds self-accountable

**3)** **Puts team above self; in it together**

o Prioritizes team and company over personal gain

o Collaborates with team members within the department and across all functions

Contributes to a positive, inclusive work environment

**4)** **Innovates and improves**

o Actively supports or initiates continuous improvement efforts

o Shares ideas and suggests solutions that enhance team or business performance

o Stays open to feedback and embraces changes

o Demonstrates a bias towards action

**5)** **Honors commitments**

o Consistently follows through on project timelines, meeting and deliverables

o Takes ownership for responsibilities and delivers results

o Makes and holds commitment

o Communicates proactively when challenges arise and adjusts plans to stay on track

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability/E-Verify**

role.title: Director of Operations - Aiken, SC
role.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

role.title: Director of Technical Operations
role.description:
### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
 
 
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.

role.title: Senior Manager of Lab Operations & Fermentati
role.description:
**Purpose:**

The Senior Manager of Lab Operations & Fermentation Development is responsible for leading efficient, safe, and compliant laboratory operations that ensure accurate testing, support fermentation and manufacturing processes, maintain product quality, and drive continuous improvement through reliable data, standardized procedures, and effective resource management.

**Role Accountabilities:**

* Balance quality, productivity, and safety to achieve results to continuously improve in all areas
* Leads the microbiological support and preparations to assist fermentation process in the microbial lab ensuring performance of microbiological media preparations
* Become proficient with testing in the analytical lab (i.e. protein, fat, fibers, HPLC, HPIC, ICP, and GC)
* Maintain adequate laboratory testing supplies within budget
* Assist with assuring all consumable materials inventory is adequate to operate the laboratory in an efficient manner, while staying on budget
* Maintains automated and digitized record keeping and proper documentation for all laboratory testing and analysis
* Conduct finished product quality control analysis including microbial streak plating, serial dilution and spread plating for cell counts, light microscopy, enzyme testing, etc.
* General laboratory maintenance and organization related to cleaning glassware and workspace sanitation, including keeping workspace free from clutter at all times
* Lead proficiency with testing in the analytical lab (i.e. protein, fat, fibers, HPLC, HPIC, ICP, and GC)
* Become proficient with data analysis and data entry into Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
* Ensures timely completion and accuracy of all COA’s
* Ensure leadership and documentation in all sampling & testing efforts
* Maintain and ensure full operation of analytical lab and equipment: calibration and validation of data, organization of data (LIMS), HPLC (US-VIS, RID, MS), GC-FID, Leco, Ankom fat and fiber, UV-VIS, ICP, off-gas analyzer, water analysis equipment)
* Perform or assist in ensuring real time monitoring techniques (DO, pH, off-gas, temp, etc.) for successful fermentation and blending manufacturing
* Ensure there is data in a structured system and then ensuring its visibility to the CEO through an online report that updates monthly
* Working non-standard hours to support fermentation monitoring
* Lead the creation and follow through on all standard operating procedures as well as requirements set by SFSF, NASC, SGF and FAMI-QS
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in laboratory operations, analytical testing, microbiology, or fermentation processes, with leadership experience preferred
* Strong knowledge of microbiological testing, sample preparation, and quality control procedures
* Experience with analytical laboratory equipment, including HPLC, GC, ICP, UV-VIS, and protein, fat, and fiber analysis
* Ability to manage laboratory budgets, inventory, supplies, and resources effectively
* Ability to work flexible or non-standard hours to support fermentation monitoring and manufacturing operations
* Familiarity with SFSF, NASC, SGF, and FAMI-QS standards is preferred

**Required Skills:**

* Strong leadership, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Experience with equipment calibration, validation, troubleshooting, and laboratory maintenance
* Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensure regulatory compliance
* Proficient in aseptic techniques, environmental monitoring programs (EMP), microorganism culturing and the maintenance and propagation of organism libraries
* Familiarity with LIMS, HPLC, LC-MS, and other analytical methods such as ash, fiber and fat analysis is a plus
* Strong understanding of laboratory safety regulations and quality management systems
* Commitment to workplace safety, quality assurance, continuous improvement, and accurate reporting

role.title: Sr. Manager Operations
role.description:
**General Summary:**

Oversees and gives direction to company production operations, including assembly, test, and integration departments. Develops and implements programs to ensure that finished products meet all engineering specifications and quality standards. Establishes standards and measurement systems to monitor production performance. Monitors the loading and execution of production assembly and test departments to meet company schedule and revenue requirements. Directs the transition of new products from engineering to production, working with test engineering to achieve effective test solutions. Reviews and approves the testing and evaluation methods of standard and special devices, monitoring and ensuring the conformance to all Astronics quality processes and procedures.

 

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manages production teams engaged in electronic or electro-mechanical assembly of precision components, subassemblies and finished products.
* Develops new or improved manufacturing processes and conducts manufacturing feasibility studies for proposed new product designs.
* Ensures the efficient flow of products through all phases of production.
* Collaborates with the finance organization in assuring the proper cost accounting procedures for production operations.
* Prepares and presents status reviews to Operations management on key production objectives such as reduction in defective assemblies and on-time delivery.
* Acts as liaison with the production planning organization regarding prioritization of production schedules and product delivery commitments.
* Supports the transition of new products from engineering to production, working with test engineering to achieve effective test solutions.
* Coordinates with the procurement organization to ensure that specialized parts, components, and materials acquired through subcontractors conform to technical specifications, quality standards and master project schedules.
* Performance management of direct reports. Develops and manages employee development goals and related training opportunities. Completes annual performance reviews of direct reports and recommends appropriate merit increases.
* Works with the customer service department to assure shared resources are allocated appropriately to meet all schedule demands.
* Performs corrective action investigations for both ICARS and CARS that have been issued to the production floor.
* May serve on cross-functional teams to address key operational issues.
* Responsible for ensuring all laws, regulations, and other applicable obligations are observed wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.
* Responsible for ensuring work is accomplished in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.

 

**Job Qualifications:**

* Typically requires a bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field as well as 8–15+ years in manufacturing operations, with demonstrated P&L ownership and management responsibilities. Equivalent professional experience may be substituted in lieu of education. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, MBA, or equivalent is a plus.
* Demonstrates expertise in the application of operational principles, concepts, theory, and practice as well as project management and leadership skills including organization, planning, scheduling, and coordinating workloads to meet established deadlines and delivery schedules.
* Must possess the ability to resolve complex operational and production problems.
* Strong communication, leadership, presentation, and interpersonal skills are required to enable an effective interface with other departments, all levels of management, professional and support staff, customers, potential customers.
* Customer focused, must be able to work on a self-initiated basis and in a team environment, and able to work extended hours and travel as needed.

 

**Compensation:**

For individuals hired to work in California, Astronics Test Systems (ATS) is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to California. Any offer extended to a candidate will be based upon their unique set of knowledge, skills, education, and experience, as well as internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the range for this position is $145,000 - $160,000 annually.

 

**Employment Eligibility Requirements:**

* An offer of employment is contingent on successfully passing a drug test and background check
* This position may involve access to items subject to U.S. export-control laws. Employment is contingent upon the employee's authorization to access such items under applicable law. The company does not guarantee and is under no obligation to seek such authorization if it would be necessary.

 

**Astronics Test Systems offers a competitive benefit package including:**

* **Stay Healthy**- Health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, FSA, HSA, as well as voluntary life/AD&D, voluntary critical illness, accident prevention and hospital indemnity
* **Save for the Future** - 401K & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* **Find Balance**- Employee Assistance Program & Wellness Program
* **Time for You**- Generous Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays and Paid Parental Leave
* **Professional Growth**- Tuition Reimbursement Program

**Accommodation Request:**

Astronics Test Systems is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or an accommodation while seeking employment, please e-mail ats-ml-humanresources@astronics.com or call: 407.381.6062. We will make a determination regarding your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

Astronics Corporation (Nasdaq: ATRO) serves the world's aerospace, defense, and other mission critical industries with proven, innovative technology solutions. Astronics works side-by-side with customers, integrating its array of power, connectivity, lighting, structures, interiors, and test technologies to solve complex challenges. For over 50 years, Astronics has delivered creative, customer-focused solutions with exceptional responsiveness. Today, global airframe manufacturers, airlines, militaries, completion centers and Fortune 500 companies rely on the collaborative spirit and innovation of Astronics. The Company's strategy is to increase its value by developing technologies and capabilities that provide innovative solutions to its targeted markets. 
 
For more information on Astronics and its solutions, visit www.Astronics.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

role.title: Director, Assembly & Test Operations — Advanced Semiconductor Capital Equipment
role.description:
**Lead the Build of Breakthrough Semiconductor Tools**
------------------------------------------------------

We’re partnering with an established, innovation‑driven manufacturer of advanced semiconductor capital equipment to hire a Director of Manufacturing Operations. You’ll own factory execution from sub-assembly through final test, elevating output, quality, and delivery performance for sophisticated, low‑volume/high‑mix systems.

### **What You’ll Lead**

* Oversee daily operations across sub-assembly, full system build, integration, and final acceptance test.
* Own on‑time shipments, first‑pass yield, product quality, and adherence to production schedules and customer commitments.
* Translate business goals into a scalable manufacturing strategy aligned to demand and growth.
* Remove bottlenecks, balance resources, and resolve operational constraints to maintain consistent throughput.
* Institutionalize performance metrics and structured problem-solving to drive accountability and decisive action.
* Align capacity, staffing, and material readiness to production plans.

### **How You’ll Drive Performance**

* Build and manage operating budgets, labor utilization models, and production cost targets.
* Report on output, shipment-driven revenue performance, overhead, OpEx, and capacity utilization with clear narratives and data.
* Present factory results, risks, and corrective roadmaps to senior leadership.
* Continuously identify cost, resource, and productivity improvements.
* Support strategic planning through capacity assessments, operational forecasting, and data‑driven recommendations.

### **Team & Culture**

* Lead and develop managers, supervisors, engineers, technicians, and operations support.
* Foster a culture of ownership, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Assess organizational capability, close leadership gaps, and implement development plans.
* Make timely decisions to resolve performance issues and operational challenges.
* Champion a high‑performance culture grounded in safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Partner effectively with engineering, quality, supply chain, and the executive team.

### **Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Model proactive safety practices and compliance with relevant manufacturing and quality standards.
* Improve product quality, consistency, first‑pass yield, and customer outcomes.
* Lead root-cause and corrective action using 8D, Lean, Six Sigma, and SPC.
* Execute CI roadmaps focused on cycle‑time reduction, efficiency, waste elimination, and scalability.
* Drive upstream quality to catch and fix issues earlier in the process.
* Maintain ISO certifications and the quality management system.

### **Manufacturing Engineering & Process Optimization**

* Collaborate with engineering to enhance manufacturability, assembly flow, and test effectiveness.
* Advance test strategies: modular testing, parallel execution, and automation.
* Cut final system test cycle times while safeguarding stringent quality standards.
* Enable NPI, engineering changes, and production transitions with robust readiness plans.
* Work with global suppliers and contract manufacturers to meet demand and performance targets.
* Lead insourcing/outsourcing and production transfers when needed.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Physics, Operations Management, or related technical field.
* 5+ years total in manufacturing/operations and 5+ years leading manufacturing operations within the semiconductor capital equipment sector.
* Hands‑on leadership over assembly, integration, testing, and shipment of complex capital equipment.
* Direct accountability for factory output, schedule adherence, shipment performance, and quality.
* Financial acumen across budgets, labor/overhead, capacity planning, and production financials.
* Executive‑level communication of results, risks, and strategy.
* History of building high‑performing teams in demanding environments.
* Expertise in Lean, structured problem‑solving, QMS, and data‑driven improvement.
* Decisive leader who drives accountability and effective decision‑making.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in semiconductor processing or precision capital equipment manufacturing.
* Leadership experience over ~100‑person organizations with multiple manager direct reports.
* Proven Lean/Six Sigma/Value Stream Mapping and CI program implementation.
* Experience with SAP, MES, and advanced manufacturing analytics.
* Demonstrated cycle‑time reduction, throughput improvement, and automated/modular final test deployment.
* Applied DfM in partnership with engineering/product development.
* Experience with international supply chains, global suppliers, and contract manufacturing.
* Familiarity with NPI, manufacturing transfer, and scaling production.

### **Ideal Profile**

A results‑oriented operations leader who blends deep technical manufacturing knowledge with operational discipline and sound business judgment. You thrive in low‑volume/high‑mix environments, elevate factory performance, and develop accountable teams. You’re equally effective on the floor and in the boardroom—communicating results, solving issues, and coaching leaders.

### **Location & Travel**

* Onsite leadership role in San Jose, California.
* Occasional domestic/international travel.

### **Core Strengths**

* Leadership/People Management; Bachelor’s Degree
* Cost Accounting; Cost Allocation; Financials; Revenue
* Lean Manufacturing Principles; Value Stream Mapping; Cycle‑Time
* Production Planning & Scheduling; Factory Ownership; Operations
* Supply Chain Management; Sourcing & Procurement
* Assembly; Capital Equipment; Complex Equipment; Semiconductor Experience; Test; Tooling; Physics
* SAP; Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)

### **Tools & Technologies**

* Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
* Capital Equipment
* SAP
* Complex Equipment

role.title: home health director of operations
role.description:
**Benefits:**

* 401(k) matching
* Competitive salary
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

**About the Role:**

Caring Heart Hospice Inc is looking for a passionate and experienced Home Health Director of Operations to lead and grow our mission-driven team in Brentwood, CA. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact by overseeing the delivery of compassionate, high-quality home health services to patients and families who need it most.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily operations of home health services to ensure compliance, efficiency, and quality patient care
* Lead, mentor, and manage clinical and administrative staff across all departments
* Develop and implement operational policies, procedures, and performance improvement initiatives
* Monitor regulatory compliance with state, federal, and Medicare/Medicaid guidelines
* Collaborate with clinical leadership to maintain and improve patient outcomes and satisfaction
* Manage budgets, staffing, and resource allocation to meet organizational goals
* Build and maintain relationships with referral sources, physicians, and community partners

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, or a related field (Master's preferred)
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in home health or hospice operations management
* Strong knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid regulations and home health compliance standards
* Proven leadership and team-building skills in a clinical or healthcare setting
* Experience with budgeting, staffing, and operational planning
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills
* Active RN license or relevant clinical licensure is a plus

**About Us:**

Caring Heart Hospice Inc is a dedicated provider of compassionate home health and hospice care serving the Brentwood, CA community and surrounding areas. Our patients and families trust us to deliver dignified, personalized care during life's most challenging moments. Our team is united by a shared commitment to excellence, empathy, and making every day count for those we serve.

role.title: Director of Quality
role.description:
Responsible to manage, promote, and continuously maintain a compliant quality management system by effectively managing the quality department that consist of validation, quality inspection, document control, change control, customer complaints, metrology, CAPA management, nonconforming product, calibration, receiving inspection and product release activities. As a quality manager you will ensure that the manufacturing site meets and applies the Global Quality Policies and Guidelines relating to, ISO 9001 & 13485 standards, FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations, customer requirements and comply with necessary local and international regulations.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities****:**

* Responsible for , leading developing, implementing and manage an effective quality management systems that supports the company-wide quality policy, ISO 9000, ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations for medical devices with a continuous improvement programs.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain quality systems for controlling product quality using process capability, inspection, auditing and statistical analysis.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain an effective quality system for preventing nonconforming product and/or its recurrence using quality planning, material review, corrective action and quality reporting.
* Responsible for selection, interviewing and onboarding of new hires and develop a relevant training program and plan for all site personnel.
* Responsible for leading, driving and enforcing quality programs in collaboration with manufacturing team.
* Resolve customer concerns, complaints and provide feedback on quality issues.
* Analyze daily and monthly quality reports and develop tests to improve product quality.
* Manage day to day department activities.
* Support company quality policy and objectives.
* Ensure products produced meets customer expectations (approve quality specifications) and regulatory requirements
* Lead customer audits, ISO audits and Internal audits
* Achieve financial objectives (maintain department salaries within budget, prepare the Quality budget, schedule the expenditures)
* Follow and report of the site quality performances from a quality standpoint and ensure alignment with Business Unit and manage continuous improvement for product quality
* In cooperation with the Sites Quality Coordinator, develop and implement Quality Objectives in line with objectives of the business unit
* Lead and influence a quality mindset to quality and operations to maintain, improving and maintaining quality system requirements.
* Continually improve quality through analyzing, identifying, and eliminating root causes. Such improvements include reducing defects, decreasing scrap, reducing waste, and improving outputs.
* Apply and evaluate testing and inspection methods; including the identification of requirements for improvements.
* Develop and implement quality cost reduction concepts and techniques.
* Manage department resources, including work assignments, training, cross training, personnel issues, hiring decisions, performance appraisals, motivation, efficiency, capacity and accuracy of work.
* Ensure shift-to-shift communication.
* Provide a safe work environment and resolve any safety issues that arise.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies:**

* Facilitation
* Conflict Management
* Fostering Learning
* Information Gathering & Processing
* Interactive Communication
* Partnering
* Relationship Building
* Research
* Teamwork
* Writing Skills
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
* Concern for Safety
* Proactive and self-motivated
* Strong time management with priority setting skills
* Client focused

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Expert knowledge and interpretation of ISO 13485, ISO 9000 standards, 21 CFR 820 and cGMP compliance.
* Ability to lead, implement quality management systems as applicable to ISO and 21 CFR regulations.
* Demonstrate understanding of industry standard validation tools and techniques.
* Demonstrated ability of metrology and basic inspection tools, metrology and injection molding workmanship standards.
* Ability to develop/conduct quality related training programs.
* Effectively communicate in both verbal and written.
* Good organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal).
* Fluency in Spanish a plus.
* Understanding and use of metrology equipment.
* Ability to read drawings and good understanding of geometric tolerancing.
* Knowledge of processing engineering polymers is a plus.
* Exceptional leadership skills which include ability to prioritize, lead, direct, train, and motivate staff.
* Ability to influence peers.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills.
* Good analytical, problem-solving and math skills. Six Sigma and Lean knowledge a plus.
* Understanding and use of sampling plans, Gauge R&R, statistical techniques and SPC.
* Ability to use personal computer and Windows-based software (Outlook, Word and Excel preferred). Use of PC-DMIS metrology software, IQMS manufacturing software and Minitab a plus.

**Education and/or Experience**:

* Bachelor’s degree desirable, four-year college degree (preferably in a sciences chemical, pharmacy, plastics or engineering field) or equivalent combined college/work experience.
* At least 5 years of leading and implementing quality systems in a pharmaceutical or medical device environment
* Manufacturing experience in injection molding plastics industry (or equivalent industry) is a plus.

role.title: DIRECTOR OF QUALITY COMPLIANCE
role.description:
**Director of Quality Compliance** 
 **Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**
======================================================================

[Full-Time)

$75,000 To $90,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As a Director of Quality Compliance, you will:

Monitors compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer and Joint Commission requirements.

* Works with program leaders to draft corrective action plans for Director review and approval. Tracks deadlines, verifies completion, and escalates overdue or ineffective actions.
* Coordinates preparation for licensing inspections, payer reviews, and accreditation surveys. Organizes evidence and tracks follow-up requests.
* Tracks updates to Health First Colorado (Colorado Medicaid) and Regional Accountable Entity (RAE) requirements and works with program leaders to update procedures and audit tools.
* Conducts chart and program audits covering intake, assessments, treatment planning, service documentation, and discharge planning. Shares findings and conducts follow-up audits.
* Supervises assigned Quality and Compliance staff, coordinates audit assignments, and coaches staff on applying regulatory, payer, and accreditation standards.
* Maintains monitoring tools and trains program staff on policy changes, documentation expectations, and recurring audit findings.
* Analyzes audit results, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization and denial trends. Reports results to program leadership and the Director and tracks improvement actions.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to monitor prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, and documentation of medical necessity and level of care. Tracks denials and appeals.
* Drafts and updates procedures for Director review. Maintains current policy manuals and tracks required staff education.
* Prepares compliance reports and supporting records for leadership and board review.
* Coordinates documentation and follow-up for annual licensed independent practitioner peer review at Joint Commission accredited programs.
* Supports PREA training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up for assigned programs where applicable.
* Participates in quality and compliance committees and follows up on assigned actions.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Required:

Bachelor's degree in social sciences, healthcare, behavioral health or related field and five years related experience OR Master’s degree and three years of experience.

* Knowledge of Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is required.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Ability to supervise and coach staff, assign work, and follow up on performance expectations.
* Ability to develop and teach methods for auditing, monitoring, and improving program operations.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for periodic travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
Description:

**Spartronics, LLC**

**Career Opportunity: Site Director of Operations**

**Location:** North Logan, Utah 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Salaried | Exempt 
**Work Arrangement:** On-Site 
**Schedule:** Full-Time, Monday–Friday 
**Reports To:** Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader

**Who We Are**

At **Spartronics**, we build more than electronics. We build the technology that powers critical applications across aerospace and defense, medical devices, life sciences, and industrial markets.

As a leading provider of electronic manufacturing services (EMS), Spartronics specializes in complex, high-reliability products, including printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), electromechanical assemblies, integrated systems, and complete product manufacturing solutions.

**Career Opportunity: Director of Operations**

Spartronics is seeking an experienced **Director of Operations** to lead manufacturing operations and drive operational excellence at our North Logan, Utah facility.

This senior leadership position is responsible for the overall performance, execution, and continuous improvement of the site's operational functions, including **Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning**, while providing indirect operational oversight and cross-functional partnership with Program Management.

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader, the Director of Operations will establish operational priorities, develop high-performing teams, optimize manufacturing processes, and ensure the organization consistently achieves its safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability objectives.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader with strong business acumen, experience managing multiple operational disciplines, and a proven ability to drive results in complex, highly regulated manufacturing environments.

**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for the facility, translating organizational objectives into actionable plans, performance expectations, and measurable results.
* Direct Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning functions, ensuring effective coordination, accountability, and alignment with site and corporate objectives.
* Provide indirect operational oversight and strategic partnership to Program Management, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, program execution, operational capacity and business objectives.
* Direct manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, and resource allocation, balancing changing customer demand, product complexity, and manufacturing constraints to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Establish operational priorities, evaluate performance against key metrics, and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps and emerging risks.
* Provide leadership and oversight of engineering activities, including process optimization, technical problem resolution, manufacturing readiness, new product introduction, and product transfers.
* Ensure the effectiveness of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, and corrective and preventive action processes while preserving Quality's independent authority over product acceptance and compliance decisions.
* Oversee supply chain and materials planning activities, including procurement, supplier performance, inventory management, material availability, and production support.
* Partner with Program Management and other customer-facing functions to address delivery commitments, operational concerns, customer escalations, and changing business requirements.
* Develop operational budgets, resource plans, capital expenditure priorities, and cost improvement initiatives in collaboration with Finance, supporting achievement of site financial objectives and profitability targets..
* Evaluate operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities to improve profitability, reduce waste, control costs, and optimize resource utilization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and other structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Ensure manufacturing processes, product traceability, configuration and change control, and supporting documentation comply with applicable customer, industry, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure operational compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements.
* Establish and maintain structured operational performance management systems, including KPI reviews, cross-functional accountability, issue escalation, and corrective action follow-through to support timely, data-driven decision-making.
* Build, coach, and develop operational leadership teams, establishing clear performance expectations, succession plans, and workforce competency and development priorities.
* Collaborate with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing requirements, employee performance, organizational development, and retention strategies.
* Coordinate with Facilities, Security, and other support functions to address infrastructure needs, operational continuity, physical security requirements, and business risks.
* Evaluate manufacturing capacity, technology, equipment, and infrastructure needs to support business growth, operational scalability, and capital investment decisions.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with production disruptions, supplier constraints, quality concerns, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
* Represent site operations in corporate leadership discussions, customer interactions, audits, and strategic planning activities, communicating performance, priorities, and resource requirements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity overseeing multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations with accountability for production, engineering, quality, supply chain, and cross-functional business objectives.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, materials management, and operational performance improvement.
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing engineering principles, process controls, technical problem resolution, and new product introduction activities.
* Working knowledge of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, corrective action processes, and applicable manufacturing standards.
* Proven ability to develop and execute operational strategies, establish performance objectives, and achieve measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience utilizing financial metrics, cost management practices, capital planning processes, and profitability analysis to drive operational decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable cross-functional management teams while promoting collaboration and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience applying Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving methodologies to complex operational challenges.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate competing priorities, manage operational risks, and resolve complex business issues.
* Advanced proficiency with business and manufacturing information systems, including ERP/MRP platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and data analysis and reporting tools. Demonstrated ability to interpret operational and financial data, evaluate performance trends, and leverage technology to support strategic planning and informed decision-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, senior leadership, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage sensitive business information, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality in accordance with company and applicable security requirements.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and comprehend English sufficiently to interpret technical documentation, communicate operational requirements, and perform essential job responsibilities.
* Ability to work full-time on-site at the assigned company facility in Logan, UT.

**Security Clearance Requirement**

Candidates must possess current, verifiable eligibility for a U.S. Government Secret-level security clearance or be willing and able to complete the necessary documentation to initiate the company-sponsored clearance process within 60 days of hire. The ability to obtain and maintain the required security clearance eligibility is a continuing condition of employment. Employment may continue while an appropriately initiated clearance application is pending, subject to company authorization and applicable security restrictions. A final determination of ineligibility, denial, or loss of required clearance eligibility will result in disqualification from the position and may result in termination of employment, subject to applicable law and company policy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Leadership experience within electronics manufacturing services (EMS), printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), or high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environments.
* Experience with surface mount technology (SMT), through-hole assembly, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing test, and related electronics manufacturing processes.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable IPC standards, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Knowledge of ITAR, controlled technical information, and security requirements applicable to defense-related manufacturing.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or other recognized continuous improvement credentials.
* APICS/ASCM certification, such as CPIM or CSCP, or equivalent supply chain management credentials.
* Experience leading operational transformations, facility expansions, production transfers, or significant manufacturing improvement initiatives.
* Experience utilizing business intelligence platforms, advanced reporting tools, and integrated manufacturing systems to monitor operational performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships, operational escalations, and cross-functional business challenges.

**Key Metrics and Focus Areas**

* Workplace safety performance and regulatory compliance.
* On-time delivery performance and production schedule attainment.
* Manufacturing efficiency, throughput, and capacity utilization.
* Product quality, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Inventory accuracy, material availability, and inventory turns.
* Supplier delivery, quality, and overall performance.
* Operating cost performance, budget adherence, and profitability.
* Engineering responsiveness, manufacturing readiness, and successful new product introductions.
* Program execution support and fulfillment of customer commitments.
* Continuous improvement results, waste reduction, and operational efficiency.
* Quality management system effectiveness, audit performance, and corrective action closure.
* Workforce productivity, employee development, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Operational risk management, business continuity, and capacity readiness.

**Why This Role Matters**

As **Director of Operations,** you will play a critical role in shaping the performance, operational capabilities, and continued growth of our North Logan manufacturing facility. Your leadership will directly influence how effectively we deliver complex, high-reliability electronic products to customers operating in some of the world's most demanding industries. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams, strengthen operational performance, implement meaningful improvements, and contribute to the long-term success of a growing manufacturing organization.

**Benefits – Why Join Spartronics?**

At Spartronics, we recognize that our employees are essential to our success. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, and professional development of our team members.

Benefits may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan.
* Paid time off and company-paid holidays.
* Company-paid life insurance and disability benefits.
* Employee assistance and wellness resources.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Opportunities to contribute to innovative products supporting mission-critical industries.

*Specific benefits and eligibility are subject to applicable plan documents and company policies.*

**Physical Requirements and Work Location**

* Ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments, including regular movement throughout production, warehouse, and operational areas.
* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, with occasional bending and reaching.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to operate computers and standard office equipment.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when entering designated manufacturing areas.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Work Authorization & ITAR Requirements**

Due to the nature of certain products, technologies, and customer requirements, this position may involve access to export-controlled technical data or defense-related information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and other applicable export control laws. Candidates must meet applicable U.S. export control authorization requirements and be eligible to access controlled technical information as required by the position. For this position, additional U.S. Government security clearance eligibility requirements apply, as described above.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

*Spartronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled 41 CFR 60-1.4. We comply with federal Affirmative Action guidelines in all employment opportunities for qualified employees and applicants.Employment at Spartronics is considered at-will, meaning that either the employee or Spartronics may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without prior notification.*

role.description:
**Site Operations Director, Concrete Pipe Production**
======================================================

**Pay:** $210,000 (DOE)

**Why join Thompson Pipe Group – Los Angeles?**
-----------------------------------------------

Family-founded. Engineer-led. Builder-trusted. From Rialto, CA, we deliver precast concrete solutions that keep communities moving. Step into a role where your operational rigor sets the pace for safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

**Is this you?**
----------------

* Do you energize large teams and develop leaders who deliver results?
* Do you turn KPIs into action—closing gaps in productivity, quality, and cost?
* Do you love orchestrating manufacturing, distribution, maintenance, QA, and safety into one cohesive operation?
* Do you navigate C-suite conversations as comfortably as you coach front-line supervisors?

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Direct end-to-end TPG–Los Angeles operations to enhance efficiency and reliability.
* Design and deploy policies, procedures, and operating mechanisms that scale.
* Set targets, collect and analyze metrics, and present insights and plans to stakeholders.
* Lead budget creation and ownership of P&L results; manage costs and drive data-based decisions.
* Build capability: clear goals, continuous feedback, and development plans for leaders and teams.
* Ensure compliance with regulations and strengthen plant safety, processes, and training.
* Partner closely with EHS, HR, Maintenance, Logistics, and other support functions.
* Research the market and identify growth opportunities to advance the company’s objectives and reputation.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 3+ years of manufacturing operations management, spanning people, products, resources, budgets, change, and quality.
* Industrial manufacturing experience; construction/building materials preferred.
* Commercial mindset with experience engaging all levels up to C-level.
* Proven ability to structure large operations and delegate effectively through leaders.
* Demonstrated ownership of product quality and a proactive approach to issue prevention and resolution.
* Fluency in operations, sales, and project management.
* Exceptional communication; strong organization and multi-initiative execution discipline.
* Financial leadership (budgets, P&L, cost control) with analytical decision-making.
* MS Office, MS Project, Visio, or equivalent proficiency.

**Benefits and development**
----------------------------

* Medical, Vision and Dental, Life Benefits
* Life & Supplement Life
* Company Matched 401K retirement plan
* Vacation & Sick Leave
* Training and Development
* Career Opportunity!
* $1,000.00 Referral Bonus

**Where you’ll work**
---------------------

3009 N Laurel Avenue, Rialto, CA 92377

Not a warehouse position—this is hands-on precast concrete pipe manufacturing.

**Notes**
---------

* This description outlines the role’s general scope and may evolve as business needs change.
* Responsibilities may be reassigned to meet operational requirements.

**Compliance**
--------------

Must pass Pre-employment Physical and drug test.

* Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions upon request.

* Thompson pipe group is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer that welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic data, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion or another legally protected status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

* Drug-free workplace.

EOE/AA – M/F/Vet/Disability
