role.title: Sr. Manager Quality Sterility Assurance
role.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
 
 
**Environmental Conditions**
Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards
 
 
**Title: Senior Manager Quality Sterility Assurance**
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
**Division/Site Specific Information**
Role reports to the Ridgefield, NJ site and reports to the Drug Product Division within the Pharma Services Group.
 
 
**Discover Impactful Work:**
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
 
 
A Day in the Life:
 
 

* In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers.
* You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches.
* Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
* As a member of the Quality Leadership Team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives.
* You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.

**Keys to Success:**
**Education/Experience**

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry required.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Proficiency with quality management software systems

**Benefits**
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.
 
 
**Compensation And Benefits**
The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $143,200.00–$214,900.00.
 
 
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:
 
 

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

role.title: Senior Manager, LCML Fulfillment Operations
role.description:
**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About the Job**
-----------------

The Senior Manager, LCML Fulfillment Operations leads the end-to-end order fulfillment and distribution execution operating model for Carrier's Light Commercial (LCML) HVAC business within Climate Solutions Americas (CSA). Reporting to CSA Logistics & Supply Chain leadership, this role balances customer service reliability, on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery performance, inventory allocation governance, and fulfillment cost-to-serve productivity across North America.

This leader directs a team of fulfillment operations planners, order management specialists, and execution coordinators, steering initiatives in order backlog reduction, multi-site distribution throughput, order consolidation, and peak seasonal readiness. Working collaboratively with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Operations, Distribution Center (DC) Operations, Transportation, and Commercial Sales leadership, the Senior Manager establishes fulfillment KPIs and SLAs, enhances ERP/WMS/TMS data integrity, and champions continuous improvement across the order-to-delivery ecosystem.

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid: 3 days in office at the Atlanta Digital Hub, 2 days remote per week.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Fulfillment Execution & Planning Governance:** Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of fulfillment planners and execution coordinators managing day-to-day order allocation, scheduling, and customer delivery execution across North American distribution networks.
* **Network Throughput & Cost-to-Serve Productivity:** Drive order consolidation programs, warehouse/fulfillment cycle-time reductions, avoidable expedite elimination, and measurable cost-to-serve efficiencies across LCML distribution hubs.
* **Order Backlog & SLA Performance Management:** Own fulfillment scorecard reviews, OTIF delivery metrics, order-to-ship cycle times, and aged backlog governance. Partner with DC Operations and Transportation to optimize fulfillment capacity and SLA compliance.
* **Exception Management & Disruption Recovery:** Lead proactive operational recovery for critical customer delivery delays, inventory allocation constraints, capacity crunches, and seasonal demand surges.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner strategically with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Plants, Customer Service, and Commercial Sales leadership to align inventory positioning, product launch (NPI) fulfillment readiness, and customer lead-time commitments.
* **Digital Fulfillment & Systems Enhancement:** Enhance ERP, WMS, and TMS workflow standardization, end-to-end order visibility, automated milestone tracking, and digital executive KPI dashboards.
* **Continuous Improvement & Standard Work:** Implement standardized operating procedures (SOPs), daily tier accountability cadences, and root-cause problem solving (Lean, DMAIC, 5-Why) to sustain fulfillment gains and customer satisfaction.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or a business discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment operations, order management, distribution center operations, or domestic supply chain logistics.
* 5+ years of direct people leadership experience managing fulfillment planners, supervisors, dispatchers, or operations analysts.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Enterprise ERP, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), or Transportation Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP, Oracle, Blue Yonder/JDA, or Manhattan.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Professional supply chain or continuous improvement credentials such as APICS (CSCP, CPIM, CLTD) or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.
* Background in commercial/light commercial HVAC, industrial equipment manufacturing, or high-SKU seasonal distribution environments.
* Strong analytical aptitude with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel) and data-driven executive presentations.
* Willingness to travel domestically (approximately 15–25%) to regional distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and logistics operational hubs.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $117,500.00 - $234,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position is entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short-term and long-term disability
* **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment**
* **Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
* **Tuition Assistance**

**To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here** **Work with us | Carrier Corporate****.** The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**Carrier EEO Statement and Accommodations Process**

Carrier is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status or any other applicable state or federal protected class. Carrier provides affirmative action in employment for qualified individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with section 503 of Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.

Applications will be accepted for at least 3 days from Job Posting Date: 13 November 2026

role.location: US-CT-EAST HARTFORD-OBG ~ 400 Main St ~ BLDG OBG
role.description:
Date Posted: 
2026-11-13

 Country: 
United States of America

 Location: 
US-CT-EAST HARTFORD-OBG ~ 400 Main St ~ BLDG OBG

 Position Role Type: 
Hybrid

 U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements: 
U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract.

 Security Clearance Type: 
None/Not Required

 Security Clearance Status: 
Not Required 
 
 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. 

 Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

 What You Will Do : 
 We are in search of a 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief who will be managing, reviewing, and approving Engineering Change Industrialization. The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be key team member within our 17/24K EC Industrial Team of the 17/24K Production Chief Office. 

 Reporting to the Deputy Production Chief, 17/24K EC Industrialization Associate Director, the role will be focusing on program management, industrialization of engineering changes, business process development, and detailed analysis to support program needs. 

 The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be instrumental in the achievement of Program milestones through alignment of Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain organizational plans and initiatives to Program and Customer priorities and commitments. 

 Deliver executive presentations and program reporting on deliveries, risks, and industrial initiatives. 
 Support communications, cross-functional alignment, industrial risk identification, and risk mitigation efforts for 17/24K programs. 
 Participate in GTF PIPTs on behalf of the 17/24K programs. 
 Collaborate with Mod Center, GSC, and cross-functional leaders on planning and execution of critical industrial actions to rate readiness for our programs. 
 Leading continuous improvement activities to improve key processes; coordinate, organize, and lead critical industrial initiatives for engineering changes to minimize disruption to OEM and MRO operations 
 Support MIPT and IPMT meetings for key engineering changes; present and align industrial content for critical customers 
 Track and realign block changes for 24k program 
 Champion MRL progression and productivity tasks 
 Serve as the primary liaison for the Production Chiefs, ensuring effective communication and smooth execution across the PCIR process 
 Partner closely with CAT 1 supplier to maintain alignment and drive successful incorporation planning  
 Role involves travel up to 10% 
 
 Qualifications You Must Have 
 Bachelor's degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment OR a Master's degree and minimum 5 years experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
 Experience working in a fluctuating environment with constantly shifting priorities 
 Demonstrated ability to critically assess industrial production schedules, qualification requirements and develop risk mitigations to drive successful program execution. 
 
 Qualifications We Prefer 
 Experience using SAP
 Knowledge of the PCIR process
 Working knowledge of continuous improvement principles (e.g. lean manufacturing, CORE, QCPC)  
 
 Learn More & Apply Now: 
 Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

 Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
 
 
 As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote. 
 
The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills. 
 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance. 
 
This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply. 
 
RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window. 
 
 RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

role.title: Director, Continuous Improvement Business Partner
role.description:
**Life Unlimited.**
At Smith+Nephew we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living. This role does not currently have direct reports but works across the global matrixed teams (across functions and regions) to grow the adoption of 'Our Way to Win' Conitnuous Improvement Strategy for maximum impact and cultural transformation. This role works with leadership teams to align and execute against our strategy, and enables the leadership teams to create a continuous improvement culture that routinely achieves its business goals. This person will own the development of continuous improvement capabilities throughout the organization, driving all business KPIs aligned with revenue, SG&A expenses, marketing, R&D driving overall profitable growth.
 
 
**What will you be doing?**
Partners with Wound leadership team to identify/develop and deliver key performance indicators (KPIs) throughout the organization aligned to the overall functional objectives Respectfully cultivates an action-biased culture of continuous improvement to advance business and functional KPI’s aligned to Smith + Nephew’s corporate goals. Responsible for leading through facilitating/enabling the implementation of 'Our Way to Win' throughout all of the Wound business. Establish and mature a Lean Management System (Tiered Accountability, Visual Management, Gemba Walks, and Leader Standard Work) and other coaching tools to transform the culture. Works with teams to streamline processes to improve business and functional objectives, with a specific focus on customer experience and end-to-end optimization. Provides support to develop Continuous Improvement expertise and capability within the organization at all levels. Improves the decision-making model and problem-solving capabilities within high performance teams to increase the autonomy and pace of change. Provides regular, ongoing reporting and communications to Wound leadership regarding status of implementation and maturity. Collaborates with Continuous Improvement teammates to leverage and share standard methodologies, and drive improvements to the company level 'Way to Win' Roadmap, tools, and technology.
 
 
**What will you need to be successful?**

* Four-year university degree required (business, marketing, or engineering, preferred); Master’s Degree required.
* Leadership roles from disciplines such as Sales, Marketing, Strategy Development and Deployment, Lean/Operating System/Business System
* Proven track record for developing, training, and coaching teams across cultures
* 12 years in process improvement and/or lean related experience
* Minimum of 8+ years of experience and “hands on” track record of implementing successful lean based business systems including elements such as:

+ Strategy Deployment and A3 Thinking
+ Lean Management Systems (Tiered Accountability, Visual Management, Gemba Walks, Leader Standard Work)
+ Value-Stream Mapping
+ Kaizen events
+ Expertise in problem solving utilizing a formal program/process
+ Implementation of KPI Management across functions and businesses

* Med-Tech or Healthcare experience a plus
* Experience in Change Management, and able to act as an influential change agent
* Microsoft Office expertise

**KNOWLEDGE SKILLS & ABILITIES:**

* Broad knowledge of multi-functional, multi-site, global organizational processes and financial business methods
* Demonstrated skill and confidence in proactively building relationships with top tier partners/leaders both internally and externally
* Demonstrated experience and leadership in managing comprehensive continuous improvement approaches/methodologies to advance an organization’s strategy and goals
* Strong ability to anticipate future needs of the organization and make decisions in a changing environment

role.description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.
 
 
Freudenberg Performance Materials is part of the Freudenberg Group and a leading global supplier of innovative technical textiles for a broad range of markets: From apparel, automotive, building materials, civil engineering, energy, filter media, healthcare and to building interiors and more. Join our team and shape the future of innovation with us! Discover our world at www.freudenberg-pm.com.

### **Some of your Benefits**

#### **401K Match**

**401K Match:** Save for retirement with the company's help.

#### **Diversity & Inclusion**

**Diversity & Inclusion:** We focus on providing an inclusive environment and recognize our diversity contributes to our success.

#### **Performance Related Bonus**

**Performance Related Bonus:** When you have an impact, you can reap the rewards.

#### **Personal Development**

**Personal Development:** We offer a variety of trainings to ensure you can develop in your career.

#### **Safe Environment**

**Safe Environment:** We strive to ensure safety remains a top priority, and provide a stable environment for our employees.

You support our team as

**Head of Quality**
===================

### **Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality team, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
* Maintain the **Quality Management System (QMS)** and ensure compliance with **ISO and IATF standards**.
* Drive continuous improvement using **Lean, Six Sigma, and quality tools** to improve product and process performance.
* Partner cross-functionally to integrate quality standards across product development and operations.
* Identify and mitigate quality risks while ensuring regulatory and internal compliance.
* Serve as the key quality contact for customers and internal stakeholders, resolving concerns and supporting customer satisfaction.
* Monitor **quality KPIs and performance metrics**, providing insights and recommendations to leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* Based in **Durham or Asheville, NC**, with ability to travel to the sister location **one week per month**.
* 3+ years of **quality experience**, including hands-on technical quality and quality systems management.
* 3+ years of **people leadership experience**.
* **Proven experience managing and overseeing operations across two or more sites.**
* IATF experience/certification and Lead Auditor qualification are strong pluses.
* Strong communicator with confidence, urgency, and the ability to influence others.
* Experience in nonwovens/textiles, medical, pharmaceutical, or automotive manufacturing preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering or Business preferred.

role.title: Senior Director - Reactor Operations
role.description:
**Hiring Department**
---------------------

 

MRR Reactor Operations

A life-saving operation in the middle of America — the University of Missouri Research Reactor (MURR) — needs you to help guide its future. MURR is expanding its critical cancer-fighting and medical isotope production.

 

MURR’s reactor is the highest-power university research reactor in the United States, operating at 10 megawatts, 6.5 days a week and 52 weeks a year. The MURR facility enables research across many disciplines – From investigating ancient cultures and how plants respond to their environment, to analyzing industrial materials and developing radiopharmaceuticals that have lifesaving clinical applications. The MURR facility is a reliable resource for researchers, scientists, engineers and students across the country.

Be a part of the future of fighting cancer and saving lives.

Be a part of MURR

**Job Description**
-------------------

 

The University of Missouri Research Reactor (MURR) is seeking a reactor operations leader with experience ensuring the safe, compliant, efficient, and reliable operation of a nuclear reactor. This individual will direct all aspects of MURR reactor operations, establish and execute a vision of reactor operations excellence, and maintain a strong operational focus. This is a position that prioritizes nuclear safety, engages and develops the workforce, creates an environment of teamwork, trust and cooperation, drives for sustainable results, and builds technical and leadership capability throughout the reactor operations division. The incumbent also will ensure operational alignment with peer divisions throughout the organization in support of research, innovation, and product/services goals. The Senior Director of Reactor Operations position will report directly to the Executive Director of MURR. Candidates must be committed to excellence and embrace the university’s mission of being a world-class research institution.

Key Responsibilities:
 

* Establish strategic goals for the reactor operations division. Monitor progress through establishing and monitoring meaningful performance metrics.
* Plan and direct reactor operations in a manner that supports organizational mission and priorities.
* Serve as member of the MURR senior leadership team, providing input to operational and strategic activities in support of the organization’s mission.
* Develop workforce and staffing initiatives for reactor operations to ensure timely and professional execution of division goals.
* Embrace, demonstrate, and lead for organizational culture goals, including regulatory goals such as a Safety Conscious Work Environment.
* Set expectations and model behaviors that promote civil, professional behavior among the division.
* Actively pursue interdisciplinary collaboration and cooperation throughout MURR.
* Develop and monitor annual divisional expense/revenue budgets.
* Ensure regulatory compliance as applicable to reactor operations.
* Maintain expert-level and current professional/industry knowledge in nuclear operations.
* Effectively represent the organization in internal and external interactions and communications.
* Develop and maintain a broad understanding of the organization and its divisions and mechanics.
* Mentor and develop staff for succession and depth.
* Commit to ongoing continuous improvement activities focused on efficiency and effectiveness of reactor operations.
* Direct site security activities.
* Participate and represent MURR in industry organizations.

Successful candidates will be persuasive communicators with exceptional leadership, organizational, and time management skills. They must demonstrate the following durable skills: leadership, character, collaboration, communication, creativity, critical thinking, growth mindset, public speaking and presentation, and energy. Additionally, customer service, confidentiality, integrity, and commitment to the university’s values.

Must be available for reliable and consistent onsite work.

**Shift**
---------

 

Monday – Friday 8am – 5pm. Weekends and nights as needed

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

 

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience and at least 10 years of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired is necessary.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

 

* Has held or currently holds a Nuclear Reactor Operator license issued by the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
* BS in Nuclear Engineering or Health Physics
* Strong nuclear sector leadership experience
* Nuclear regulatory training and/or experience
* Radiological leadership training and/or experience
* Strong ability to manage projects and teams
* People leader with experience leading transformation and inspiring others

**Anticipated Hiring Range**
----------------------------

 

Salary Range: $169,000.00 - $303,000.00 per year

Grade: GGS M17

University Title: MURR Senior Director

Internal applicants can determine their University title by accessing the Talent Profile tile in myHR.

**Application Materials**
-------------------------

 

Resume/CV and Cover Letter

**Community Information**
-------------------------

 

Columbia offers small-town friendliness with big city features and a high quality of life for people of all ages and interests. Founded on education and known as an ideal college town, its location also makes it an attractive spot for businesses and travelers. Located on Interstate 70 and U.S. Highway 63, Columbia is right in the middle of the state and the nation. Just a couple hours’ drive from St. Louis and Kansas City, Columbia is Boone County’s largest population center offering big-city culture, activities, and resources with a low cost of living. Columbia is home to a variety of restaurants and entertainment venues and hosts more than a dozen festivals each year. If you want to grow your career, continue your education, raise a family, and retire, Columbia is a good place to be!

**Benefit Eligibility**
-----------------------

 

This position is eligible for University benefits. As part of your total compensation, the University offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, retirement, paid time off, short- and long-term disability, paid parental leave, paid caregiver leave, and educational fee discounts for all four UM System campuses. For additional information on University benefits, please visit the Faculty & Staff Benefits website at https://www.umsystem.edu/totalrewards/benefits.

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

The University of Missouri is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 

To request ADA accommodations, please call the Director of Accessibility and ADA at 573-884-7278.

role.title: Director, Aseptic DP Process Engineering
role.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
 
 
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
**Job Function**
Supply Chain Engineering
 
 
**Job Sub Function**
Process Engineering
 
 
**Job Category**
People Leader
 
 
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Wilson, North Carolina, United States of America
 
 
**Job Description**
**About Innovative Medicine**
Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.
 
 
Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
 
 
Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine
 
 
Learn more and apply to this exciting new role!
 
 
As part of the Global Process Engineering team, the Director, Aseptic DP Process Engineering, is the technical expert and will provide overall E2E process engineering leadership to equipment and facility design of a new DP aseptic manufacturing node. They will be accountable for all technical aspects of process engineering areas (warehouse, laboratories, clean utilities, preparation, compounding/filling, optical inspection, and device assembly and packaging) ensuring the efficient design and operational readiness and start-up of the new site in compliance to cGMP and industry standards.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Development and delivery of all process engineering specifications (user requirements, data sheets, technical specifications
* Assess vendor competency and capabilities, review and discuss bid documents, and be held accountable for project development and execution, including performance of the process systems
* Technical issue resolution on the system during C&Q testing and the readiness of the system to start C&Q activities
* Helping to identify and expedite key activities across multiple business functions (Manufacturing, Facilities, MSAT, Quality, Procurement, E&PS (Engineering & Property Services), and EHS
* Ensure alignment across evolving business needs and require strong partner management and leadership skills to collaborate across these multiple business partners.
* Maintaining a solid understanding of industry trends and benchmarking against internal/external practices
* Actively participate in inclusion initiatives to build a well-rounded, high performing engineering team
* Cultivate a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and innovation to enable multi-functional learning and standard methodology sharing
* Develop and mentor engineering team members to ensure a strong talent pipeline
* Apply data-driven insights and market intelligence to advise future decision making, stay informed on industry and regulatory trends, and adapt strategies accordingly to achieve excellent portfolio performance.
* Ensure compliance with policies, procedures, government regulations, and customer specifications
* Collaborate with an engineering firm to advance the facility design

**Qualifications**
**Education:**

* Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in engineering required (Mechanical or Chemical Engineering preferred), MS or MBA preferred.

**Experience And Skills**
**Required:**

* A minimum 15 plus years in drug product experience in a biotherapeutics cGMP environment (preferably in process engineering or capital project execution)
* A minimum 5 plus years of people leadership experience
* Shown success in building and developing high performing team
* Track record of developing and maintaining strong partnerships at all levels within the organization, including key stakeholders
* Ability to lead and motivate multicultural teams and remote customers
* Excellent problem-solving skills when handling potential conflicts
* Understanding sophisticated technical/regulatory issues impacting facility/equipment design

**Solid Understanding Of The Following**

* cGMP’s for aseptic manufacturing of multiple regulatory bodies (EU, FDA), including fluency in the understanding of new EU Annex 1 guidelines and its impact on facility/equipment design
* EHS requirements, with particular focus on EHS by design and construction safety
* Start-up processes and Commissioning & Qualification
* Principles for Engineering Design for drug products in the Biotherapeutic industry
* Construction & Procurement process
* Project Controls processes
* Project scheduling
* Strong technical process engineering knowledge and experience and has a great passion for solving highly complex technical problems
* Strong problem solving, communication, and decision-making skills to drive impact in a fast-paced evolving business landscape
* Ability to drive process engineering innovation for equipment and facilities ensuring technical knowledge is maintained and expanded throughout the team

**Preferred**

* Consistent track record on leading capital projects in the range of 250 – 500 MM$ (preferred)
* Strong process engineering expertise in conceptual design through C&Q (commissioning & qualification) to ensure efficient operational readiness within a biotherapeutic drug product environment.
* Leadership experience in a greenfield project(s)

**Other**

* This position will be located in Wilson, North Carolina, and will require full time on-site support. However, the design of the facility will occur at an Engineering firm with frequent travel (> 75%) required until the project shifts to the plant site of Wilson, NC

If you are under 18 years of age, you (the candidate) may need to obtain the necessary working papers or other documentation required by state law to start the assignment, as well as get a parent’s consent for the background check.
 
 
For more information on how we support the whole health of our employees throughout their wellness, career and life journey, please visit www.careers.jnj.com.]
 
 
Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.
 
 
Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers, internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.
 
 
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Agile Decision Making, Consulting, Crisis Management, Developing Others, Disruptive Innovations, Emerging Technologies, Inclusive Leadership, Leadership, Lean Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Standards, Process Control, Process Engineering, Process Improvements, Product Costing, Program Management, Project Schedule, Resource Planning, Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM) Application, Stakeholder Engagement, Technical Research

role.title: Director of Quality Improvement & Corporate Compliance
role.description:
Description:

**Help strengthen the quality, integrity, and impact of behavioral healthcare.**

Monadnock Family Services (MFS) is seeking an experienced, thoughtful, and collaborative **Director of Quality Improvement and Corporate Compliance** to provide organization-wide leadership for quality improvement, regulatory compliance, and organizational accountability.

This is an important opportunity for someone who believes quality improvement should be more than audits and reports. At MFS, this position will help turn data, feedback, and identified concerns into meaningful improvements that strengthen services, protect consumer rights, support employees, and promote organizational effectiveness.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Director will work closely with executive leadership, program directors, clinical leaders, and the Board of Directors to ensure that quality and compliance are integrated into the way the organization operates.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead Quality Improvement**

* Direct the agency's quality improvement program and establish meaningful measures of organizational and program performance.
* Analyze performance data, audit findings, consumer feedback, and service outcomes to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with program leaders to develop, implement, and evaluate quality improvement initiatives and corrective action plans.
* Report quality findings, organizational trends, and improvement progress to executive leadership and the Board.

**Oversee Corporate Compliance**

* Develop, maintain, and monitor the agency's Corporate Compliance Plan.
* Monitor compliance with applicable federal and New Hampshire regulations, licensing standards, payer requirements, and contractual obligations.
* Coordinate the review of potential compliance concerns and support appropriate investigations and corrective actions.
* Communicate regulatory changes and compliance expectations to agency leadership.

**Strengthen Consumer Rights and Risk Management**

* Oversee the agency's complaint and grievance processes and serve as an escalation resource for complex or sensitive concerns.
* Lead the critical incident review process and monitor trends, recommendations, and follow-through.
* Work with clinical and program leadership to identify risks and implement strategies that improve safety and service quality.

**Support Documentation, Privacy, and Regulatory Readiness**

* Oversee clinical recordkeeping standards and quality monitoring activities.
* Support agency compliance with HIPAA and applicable confidentiality requirements.
* Coordinate preparation for licensing reviews, audits, accreditation activities, and external monitoring.
* Support staff education related to documentation, privacy, compliance, incident reporting, and consumer rights.

**Lead and Develop the Quality Improvement Team**

* Supervise and develop Quality Improvement staff, including the Complaint Manager and Medical Records Specialist.
* Establish clear expectations, priorities, and performance standards.
* Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous professional development.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate brings a combination of analytical ability, regulatory knowledge, leadership experience, and sound professional judgment. They are comfortable examining complex issues, asking difficult questions, and working collaboratively to develop practical solutions.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a clinical, behavioral health, healthcare administration, public health, business administration, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience in quality improvement, corporate compliance, healthcare administration, behavioral health operations, or a related field.
* Experience interpreting and applying regulatory, licensing, contractual, or payer requirements.
* Experience developing or monitoring quality improvement initiatives, performance measures, audits, or corrective action plans.
* Experience supervising employees or leading cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a Community Mental Health Center or other regulated healthcare setting.
* Familiarity with New Hampshire behavioral health regulations and licensing requirements.
* Experience with accreditation, external audits, regulatory reviews, or compliance program administration.
* Training or experience in quality improvement methodologies such as PDSA, Lean, Six Sigma, or root cause analysis.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means building a quality and compliance program that is active, useful, and respected throughout the organization. The Director will help ensure that:

* Quality measures inform decisions and lead to measurable improvements.
* Compliance concerns are identified, appropriately addressed, and monitored through resolution.
* Complaints and critical incidents result in meaningful review and follow-through.
* Leadership and the Board receive clear, timely information about organizational performance and risk.
* Program leaders and employees understand their shared responsibility for quality and compliance.

**Why Join Monadnock Family Services?**

MFS is committed to providing timely access to safe, high-quality, results-driven, and sustainable mental healthcare for our communities rooted in best practices, respect, and compassion.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute at an organizational level, work directly with senior leadership, and help shape the systems and practices that support quality behavioral healthcare throughout the communities we serve.

If you are a strategic thinker who values accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we invite you to consider joining our team.

**Apply today to be part of the work that strengthens behavioral healthcare in our communities.**

Monadnock Family Services is an equal opportunity employer.

role.description:
**Job Title: Director of Mobile Operations - Skilled Trades**

**Department:** Operations / Field Services

**Reports To:** Chief Operating Officer (COO)

Are you a skilled trades leader ready to take your career beyond managing the day-to-day? At **TDG Facilities**, we're building something exceptional, and we're looking for a leader who wants to be part of it. If you're passionate about the trades, energized by developing talented people, and motivated by the opportunity to shape a growing organization, we want to meet you. This isn't just another management position. It's an opportunity to bring your expertise, influence how we operate, build a team you're proud of, and play a meaningful role in our future. **If you're ready to lead, grow, and make your mark, let's talk.**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Director of Mobile Operations - Skilled Trades is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational performance, and continuous improvement of all skilled trades field service teams across the organization (electrical, plumbing, HVAC). This role oversees multiple technicians and technical leads and is accountable for service delivery (KPI), workforce utilization, financial performance, safety compliance, customer satisfaction, and operational standardization across all mobile service lines. This is a critical role heavily involved in overseeing service delivery expectations in each of the skilled trades disciplines.

The Director ensures that the electrical, plumbing, and HVAC teams consistently deliver high-quality, compliant, and cost-effective IFM services while aligning field operations with company growth objectives, service standards, and technology platforms. Success in this role will be measured by: mobile team utilization and productivity; delivery efficiency; quality; SLA compliance; safety performance and incident reduction; budget adherence and margin performance; workforce retention and development; operational consistency across regions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Leadership**

* Work closely with Account management teams for client expectations and problem solving
* Provide direct leadership to all skilled trades technicians, technical leads, and service coordination
* Standardize mobile service delivery processes, SOPs, and performance expectations across all markets.
* Ensure consistent execution of preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and on-demand services.
* Support the development of repair estimates in each of the skilled trades disciplines with support from senior mobile technicians
* Drive operational discipline in scheduling, dispatching, documentation, and close-out procedures

**Workforce & Resource Management**

* Optimize technician utilization, service quality, and labor productivity.
* Oversee workforce planning, staffing levels, skill coverage, and training programs.
* Ensure proper certification, licensing, and competency alignment for all mobile technicians.

* Coordination engagement with field technicians for continuity of workflow

**Financial & Performance Management**

* Monitor KPIs including response times, first-time fix rates, utilization, backlog, and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure that all service and repair quotes are delivered on time as committed to meet TDG quality expectations
* Identify cost-reduction opportunities while maintaining service quality.

**Customer & Account Support**

* Serve as an escalation point for technical service issues in electrical, plumbing, and HVAC services
* Partner with departmental stakeholders to ensure service alignment.

**Safety, Compliance & Risk**

* Enforce safety programs, training, and field compliance standards.
* Ensure adherence to OSHA, NFPA, local codes, and contractual requirements.

**Technology & Process Improvement**

* Champion the use of Field Service System for notes, time, and documentation related to service work orders
* Drive adoption of mobile tools, asset data standards, and reporting dashboards.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, and visibility.

**Direct Reports**

* Skilled Trades supervisors and superintendants

* Operations coordination (co-managed)

**Required Qualifications**

* 4-7+ years of experience in facilities management, field service, construction services, or similar operational environments
* 5+ years in a senior leadership role managing multi-site or mobile operations
* Strong understanding of IFM service lines (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, general maintenance, etc.)
* Proven experience leading managers and large technician workforces
* Financial acumen with labor cost control and operational budgeting
* Experience with FSS systems and mobile workforce platforms
* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or related field
* Lean, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence training
* Experience in scaling mobile service teams in a growing company

**Core Competencies**

* Technical Service Management
* Project / Repair / Construction Estimation Competency
* Operations Leadership
* Workforce Optimization
* Financial Management
* Safety & Compliance
* Customer Relationship Management
* Process Standardization
* Change Management
* Technology Enablement

role.title: Director Quality
role.description:
Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson
 
Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in
 
new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through
 
subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering,
 
manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance
 
data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective
 
actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information.

We are 40 000 men and women who meet the challenges faced by our automotive, aviation, defence and industry customers every day. Our passion for challenge and our enthusiasm encourage us to imagine, design and produce high performance and innovative fluid, sealing system and anti-vibration solutions. Working at Hutchinson means being curious about everything, contributing to the evolution of mobility and reducing carbon emissions.
 
 
Join us and show what drives you!
 
 
A French company with an international presence (25 countries): 170 years of history and passing on our know-how.
 
5 billion in turnover, with 5% invested in R&D.

**SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information. The incumbent is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets in accordance with company policies and customer requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as quality performance, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, customer quality trends, and quality planning of new products for consideration by other members of the management team.
* Presents and evaluates alternative methods and procedures to establish standardized quality systems based on best practices.
* Participates with other top management personnel in formulating and establishing company policies, operating procedures, and goals.
* Participates in review of product development activities and APQP milestones.
* Conducts Quality System Management review meetings with top management to assess performance and compliance to customer quality requirements.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or changes in procedures.
* Confers with engineers and managers about quality assurance of new products and process to improve manufacturing capability.
* Reviews technical publications, articles, and abstracts to stay abreast of technical and quality system developments in industry.
* Travel required on a frequent basis to suppliers and customer facilities as well as other Hutchinson facilities.
* Provides internal quality system audit of Hutchinson Sealing Systems locations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or four to ten years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Qualifications may be waived by management. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

None.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Manages subordinates in department. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complains and resolving problems.

**TEAM SKILLS:**

Hutchinson is built around teamwork. This position requires the use of good team skills such as cooperation, information sharing, task sharing, timely completion of assignments, good listening and communication skills and overall respect for other team members.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or boards of directors.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

Ability to use word processing, spreadsheet applications. Must be familiar with internet research, Microsoft Office software, and the use of e-mail.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**HEALTH AND SAFETY:**

Must actively support our Health Safety and Environmental policy, immediately report all Safety hazards and correct them when able to safely do so, participate in all required Safety Training, meetings, inspects, and use all required PPE.

role.title: Director, Operational Excellence
role.description:
**Job Description**
**Company Overview**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company focused on investing in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. Across our organization, we work with urgency, rigor, and collaboration to deliver therapies that improve patient outcomes and create long-term value.
 
 
**General Summary**
The Operational Excellence team serves as the process improvement and performance enablement backbone of CMTO, providing the improvement discipline, management systems, and change capabilities required to run, grow, and optimize Vertex’s commercial manufacturing network.
 
 
The Director, Operational Excellence leads the development and execution of CMTO’s Operational Excellence strategy and improvement portfolio. The role identifies and prioritizes performance improvement opportunities, leads structured problem-solving and transformation initiatives, and ensures improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, performance monitoring, and leadership accountability.
 
 
The Director also leads and develops the Operational Excellence team, building organizational capability, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. The role partners closely with Business Analytics, Network Performance, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Business Operations Leads, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to use performance insights to identify improvement priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
 
 
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**

* Operational Excellence Strategy & Initiative Execution
* Contribute to setting CMTO's operational excellence strategy, priorities, and success measures, aligned to enterprise and functional priorities
* Identify, prioritize, and drive execution of a portfolio of commercial manufacturing improvement and transformation initiatives — partnering with sites and functions while avoiding ownership of routine operations
* Lead initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield, and manufacturing success-rate improvements and COGM reduction through structured problem definition, root-cause analysis, options analysis, and ROI calculation
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and structured problem-solving initiatives across technical and business processes
* Develop clear business cases, recommendations, and implementation plans for Operational Excellence initiatives, including expected benefits, resource requirements, risks, and measures of success.
* Manage and Lead the Operational Excellence Team
* Establish and communicate a clear vision, mission, and strategic direction for the Operational Excellence team, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and stakeholder expectations
* Partner with senior leadership to define team priorities, continuously reassessing and adjusting focus based on evolving business needs, operational risks, and strategic objectives
* Set clear performance expectations, goals, and development plans for team members; monitor progress, provide timely feedback, and hold the team accountable for results
* Remove organizational barriers and resolve escalated issues that impede team performance or delivery of key initiatives
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, innovation, and accountability by coaching and mentoring team members in problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills
* Build organizational capability by identifying skill gaps, developing talent, and implementing training and succession plans that strengthen Operational Excellence competencies
* Communicate team objectives, progress, achievements, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment across organization
* Promote cross-functional collaboration and strong stakeholder relationships to enable successful execution of Operational Excellence initiatives and sustainable business improvements
* Continuous Improvement & Change Execution
* Embed structured problem-solving, continuous improvement, and change execution into CMTO governance and operating rhythms, using performance insights provided by Business Analytics, Network Performance, and functional teams.
* Ensure improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, control plans, performance monitoring, and clear process ownership.
* Identify and deploy digital tools, automation, and process solutions that improve operational performance and the scalability of Operational Excellence practices.
* Community of Practice & Capability Building
* Operate as a community-of-practice leader for manufacturing operational excellence across internal manufacturing and supply chain, driving common standards, methods, and ways of working
* Mentor teams on Lean methods, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement practices, and benchmark industry best practices to inform innovative approaches

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and team building
* Proven ability to motivate teams and build team unity
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, FMEA, Hoshin Kanri, and Change Management methodologies in GMP environments
* Proven experience leading improvement initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield improvement and COGM/COGs reduction
* Experience using operational data and performance insights to identify, prioritize, and measure improvement opportunities.
* Hands-on proficiency in data analysis, root-cause analysis, process analysis, and structured problem-solving
* Ability to quantify the operational and financial benefits of improvement initiatives and communicate clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience implementing and sustaining performance management systems, visual management, Standard Work, and Leader Standard Work.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with process mapping, statistical analysis, and Lean Six Sigma tools preferred.
* Ability to translate complex operational problems into clear improvement priorities, recommendations, and implementation plans.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment with strong role clarity, partnering across Network Performance, Business Operations, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* Typically requires 8–12 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, regulated manufacturing, supply chain, MS&T, Operational Excellence, or business transformation environments.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading Operational Excellence, transformation, continuous improvement, or complex process-improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt required

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.
 
 
**Pay Range**
$181,900 - $272,900
 
 
**Disclosure Statement**
The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
 
 
At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.
 
 
**Flex Designation**
Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible
 
 
**Flex Eligibility Status**
In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
 

* Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
* On-Site: work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.
 
 
**Company Information**

role.title: Head of Quality Engineering
role.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Group Research Portfolio Manager

\_\_

**Mission of the Role**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to conceptualize, identify, explore, and implement world-leading technologies, products, and systems within and across product groups/divisions/business areas. Each day, you will ensure delivery of results, foster innovation, and strategically develop and secure Research and Development (R&D) capabilities with a cost-effective footprint. You will also showcase your expertise by coordinating at various management levels as well as with external partners to enhance and secure ABB´s global position and profitability in the medium and long term.

**This role is contributing to the Automation Process Control Platform (AUPCP) globally. Main stakeholders are PCP R&D management team.**

**The work model for the role is: hybrid or remote.**

**Responsibilities**

* Provide **reliable and scalable shared capabilities** for building, integrating, testing and assessing products and product lines across Solution Trains (SLTs) and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
* Own **shared quality engineering infrastructure and practices**.
* Be responsible for the **independent qualification** of product and product line deliveries across PCP.
* Lead the **quality engineering team**, including test engineering, DevOps and configuration management.
* Drive the shift from **release-based system testing to continuous testing** integrated into development.

**Requirements**

* **M.Sc. or higher degree** in Software Development, Engineering or a related field.
* **15+ years of progressive leadership experience in R&D** or a related field.
* Proven experience **leading a complex, global organization** with accountability for verification and validation of products and quality compliance.
* **Proven experience implementing continuous testing / quality engineering transformations** in one or more companies.
* Understanding of products, product lifecycle and quality, with the ability to connect technical excellence with business and customer value.
* Understanding of **software verification methodologies, automated pipelines and infrastructure management**.
* **Financial, stakeholder and people leadership skills**, with experience managing resources and developing high-performing teams across cultures and geographical locations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux and Kubernetes environments (mandatory).
* Proven experience driving Quality Engineering (QE) transformation, including leading organizational and process change.
* Strong communication and cross-cultural collaboration skills, with **fluent written and spoken English**.

**About ABB's Process Control Platform (PCP)**

Process Control Platform (PCP) is the technological foundation of Automation's business area, delivering world-class Distributed Control Systems (DCS). Combining proven expertise with innovation, PCP shapes the future of automation and enables industrial digital transformation. by developing safe and reliable control systems.

Its portfolio includes leading systems: ABB Ability™ System 800xA®, ABB Ability™ Symphony® Plus, Freelance and Aprol, along with safety, industrial edge and PLC automation solutions. It also covers a broad base of heritage systems, including Advant Master, MOD 300, Harmony INFI 90 and Melody. Building on this installed base and deep automation expertise, PCP is advancing the next generation of automation through Automation Extended and digital offerings including ABB Ability™ Edgenius and ABB Ability™ Field Information Manager. By expanding the traditional boundaries of automation and building a broader process automation ecosystem, PCP helps customers improve operational performance, extend system lifecycles and outrun their challenges. As a value-generating partner, PCP ensures that its portfolio remains comprehensive and competitive, supports previously released systems and evolves with market demands through close collaboration with the divisions. The organization also manages Quality and Operations and provides essential support in product training, sales enablement and marketing communications.

At its core, PCP fosters a diverse and inclusive environment where employees are empowered to innovate, grow and make a lasting impact on customers, industry and society.

*This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.*

*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

role.title: BCBA Quality Assurance Director
role.description:
**BCBA Quality Assurance Supervisor**
=====================================

**Little Champs ABA**

Little Champs ABA is seeking a highly organized, motivated, and compassionate **BCBA Quality Assurance Supervisor** to join our growing team. This full-time leadership position will work directly under the Clinical Director to ensure clinical excellence, staff compliance, training quality, and operational support across multiple states.

The ideal candidate is a licensed BCBA with strong leadership, organizational, and multitasking skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about supporting both clients and clinical staff.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The BCBA Quality Assurance Supervisor will oversee quality assurance processes for clinical services, monitor BCBA and RBT compliance and hours, coordinate trainings and orientations, and provide ongoing support to clinical teams. This role plays a critical part in maintaining high standards of care and ensuring compliance with company policies, insurance requirements, and state regulations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Clinical Quality Assurance**

* Conduct quality assurance reviews for BCBA and RBT documentation
* Monitor clinical compliance and ensure adherence to ABA best practices
* Review treatment plans, supervision logs, session notes, and authorizations
* Assist in maintaining company-wide clinical standards and procedures
* Support implementation of quality improvement initiatives

### **Staff Oversight & Support**

* Track and manage BCBA and RBT supervision hours and requirements
* Monitor staff credentialing and compliance deadlines
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to BCBAs and RBTs
* Collaborate with clinical leadership to address staff performance concerns
* Help ensure clinical teams are supported across multiple states

### **Training & Orientation**

* Oversee all staff trainings and new hire orientations
* Coordinate onboarding processes for clinical staff
* Assist with development and implementation of training materials
* Ensure staff remain current with required certifications and trainings
* Support continued professional development initiatives

### **Administrative & Leadership Duties**

* Work closely with the Clinical Director on company-wide initiatives
* Assist with audits, compliance reviews, and operational processes
* Maintain organized records and tracking systems
* Communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams
* Participate in leadership meetings and support company growth initiatives

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Active and unrestricted **BCBA certification required**
* Master’s degree in ABA, Psychology, Education, or related field
* Minimum of 2 years of BCBA experience preferred
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Experience working across multiple states preferred
* Excellent communication and leadership skills
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive full-time salary
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) with company match
* Supportive leadership team
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

**About Little Champs ABA**
---------------------------

Little Champs ABA is dedicated to providing high-quality ABA services to children and families, including underserved and rural communities. We are committed to clinical excellence, compassionate care, and supporting our team members in making a meaningful impact.

**Join our team and help us continue making a difference in the lives of children and families.**
