role.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

 

Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below:

**Corporate Social Responsibility** (https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/)

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

role.title: Director of Operations, Service Delivery
role.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission.

We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company.

One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar.

**The Role**

This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time.

New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down.

**What makes this role different:**

* You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas.
* You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer.
* You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here.

**What You'll Own**

* **Service Delivery, from the ground up.** Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation.
* **Raising customer & Pro retention rates.** When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally.
* **Whatever comes next.** New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners.

**Problems to Solve**

**Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet.** Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field.

**Move metrics.** Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome.

**Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems.** Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results.
* At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs.
* Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI.
* The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it.

 
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**

**An elite AI builder.** You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here.

**A zero-to-one operator.** You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined.

**Marketplace-tested.** You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here.

**A finisher.** Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's.

**A partner who can help drive strategy collaboratively.** You work well with people who don't report to you and are a savvy cross-departmental collaborator on priorities and sequencing. If you need formal authority to effect change, this role isn't for you.

**Data-driven by reflex.** You'd rather build the query or the dashboard than argue from a hunch. This is unlikely to be a good fit if, when ambiguity hits, your first move is to guess and move on instead of digging for the number.

**At home in unresolved ambiguity.** Scope shifts as priorities do, and problems arrive unframed more often than not. That's the norm here, not an exception.

**Degree** in analytics, business or related field, with **7+ years of experience** in marketplace operations or equivalent roles.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A people-management role.** There's no team to build or manage, at least not to start.
* **A strategy-only seat.** You'll execute what you recommend, not hand it off to someone else to run.
* **A fit for anyone who isn't already an elite AI builder.** The AI bar on this team isn't aspirational; it's the baseline we hire against.

 
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base salary**: $175,000 to $200,000.
* **Equity component**: We want the person who takes this role invested in LawnStarter delivering excellent service, and in how far AI-first operating carries this company.
* **Healthcare**: Medical, dental, and vision.

role.title: Rendering Plant Manager
role.description:
UniSea is looking for an experienced Rendering Plant Manager to lead and manage operations of UniSea’s fish rendering plant in Dutch Harbor, Alaska. The Rendering Plant Manager will be working at our Dutch Harbor, Alaska operations.

The Rendering Plant Manager is responsible for managing all elements of production of Fish Meal, Bone Meal, Fish Oil, and other by-products at UniSea’s Meal Plant to achieve continuous operations and maximum profitability. Maintain efficient operations of Main Sump operation in compliance with all State and Federal requirements.

**Essential Duties**

1) Organize and manage production staff and manage activities of the Meal Plant processing operation and maintain operational performance of equipment in the Main Sump. Coordinate production based on G1 and G2 operations.

2) Work with the Maintenance department in proposing and making design changes in processing facilities and equipment to maximize plant efficiency. Submit work orders to maintain proper repair of processing facility on repair or installation work that the Meal Plant does not perform.

3) Counsel and train employees according to UniSea policies and procedures. Coach and motivate employees to achieve maximum performance and maintain high morale. Evaluate employee performance and take necessary steps to assist employees in improving performance. Administer discipline to employees as appropriate, including terminations.

4) Recommend capital equipment needs, methods of improvement, and tools and materials to maintain and improve competitive production efficiency.

5) Maintain knowledge about internal and external influences affecting the future of the industry and company.

6) Review and assure the accuracy of scale reports, production reports, shipping tallies, inventories and quality control reports.

7) Coordinate with machinery manufacturers in updating current technology as appropriate.

8) Assist safety personnel and promote good safety and hygiene procedures throughout the plant.

9) Maintain open communication with the Quality Assurance department to ensure product specification, micro, and labeling requirements are maintained.

10) Perform other duties as directed.

**Position Requirements**

· High School or equivalent is required.

· Vocational education in a skilled trade like Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC, or Welding is preferred.

· Must have a minimum of 6 years of experience working in a rendering plant.

· Must have 2 years of experience in managing and supervising employees.

· Must have excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.

· Must be able and willing to work in a rendering plant and supervise employees’ work performance in the plant.

· Working proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Teams.

· Must be able to pass a post offer drug screen and criminal background check.

**This is a salaried exempt position located in Dutch Harbor, Alaska with a starting salary within the range of $96,754 - $116,122 per year.**

UniSea offers a rich benefits package including:

- Free company provided housing and utilities for employees in Dutch Harbor, Alaska.

- Free meals for employees in the company galley. Discounted meals are available for family members living in Alaska.

- Annual travel allowance benefit

- Relocation assistance

- Medical/Dental/Vision insurance available after 60-day eligibility period is satisfied

- A variety of different voluntary coverages are offered – including AFLAC policies and additional life insurance for self and family members

- Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Accounts are available after 60-day eligibility period is satisfied

- 401(k) plan and additional 3% employer contribution – after 6-month eligibility period is satisfied. UniSea matches 100% of your contributions up to the first 5%, plus makes an additional 3% employer contribution.

- Employer paid life insurance

- Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays

UniSea is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Pay: $96,754.00 - $116,122.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* rendering plant: 6 years (Required)
* Supervising: 2 years (Required)

Ability to Relocate:

* Dutch Harbor, AK 99692: Relocate with an employer provided relocation package (Required)

Work Location: In person

role.description:
**Job Details:**

Summary: This position is responsible for supporting overall plant operations and performance, including controlling expenses, ensuring compliance with federal meat inspection, OSHA, food safety, and company requirements, and consistently interpreting and enforcing company policies. The position partners with HR and plant leadership to support effective Team Member and labor relations in a union environment, including adherence to the collective bargaining agreement. Responsibilities include assisting in determining staffing needs; maintaining accurate records and reports; effectively resolving operational issues with appropriate follow-up; and partnering with department leaders to achieve production, quality, yield, labor, cost, and performance goals. The position is also responsible for maintaining high standards in safety, sanitation, housekeeping, security, and food safety; leading, developing, evaluating, and coaching production leaders; overseeing designated shift operations; and performing other responsibilities as assigned by the Plant Manager.

 

REQUIREMENTS:

 

Education:

High School diploma with equivalent experience or college degree preferred.

 

Experience:

5 plus years of related industry; 5 plus years supervisory experience in a meat processing facility pork or beef preferred ; and knowledge of OSHA USDA and HAACP regulations.

 

Computer Skills:

Standard computer skills.

 

Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must be capable of communicating well both verbally and in writing with all levels of Team Members from hourly to upper management as well as government officials.

 

Special Skills:

Leader problem solver team player.

 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Manage subordinate General Foreman supervisors who supervise team members in the plant; carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws; interview hire and train team members; plan assign and direct work; monitor and appraise work performance; reward, coach, counsel, and discipline team members; address complaints and resolve problems.

 

Travel:

0-20

 

Other Requirements:

Lead people by example, accept and delegate responsibility, display sound judgment and decision-making skills; problem solve in an efficient manner with sound follow up; strong managerial skills necessary; excellent safety and attendance records. Ability to work with department leaders to meet safety production and quality yields and meet goals. All Tyson Team Members are responsible for safety. This includes but is not limited to personal safety and food safety. This position is responsible for food safety food quality and legality.

 
 

Must attach a resume for consideration.

 
 

This position is slated for candidates who are currently working at this facility and displaced team members. Priority consideration will be provided to these applicants first. If local Team Members are not selected, external candidates will then be reviewed for consideration.

 
All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes.

**Relocation Assistance Eligible:**

No

**Work Shift:**

A Shift (United States of America)

**Pay Range/Rate:**

**Incentives:**

Annual Incentive Plan:

No

Long-Term Incentive Plan:

No

**Certain roles at Tyson require background checks. If you are offered a position that requires a background check you will be provided additional documentation to complete once an offer has been extended.**

Any listed amounts represent the base pay range. Additional compensation may be available for this position based on various factors such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonuses. Pay is just one part of Tyson’s total compensation package.

 
 

***Tyson will develop an offer based on a candidate's or team member’s relevant skills and capabilities, the market data for the role described in this requisition, internal equity, and other information relevant to the candidate and role.***

 

Hourly Applicants ONLY -You must complete the task after submitting your application to provide additional information to be considered for employment.

 
 

The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

 
 

Tyson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, national origin, color, religion, age, genetics, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.

role.title: Director, Site Operations
role.description:
**The Role**
------------

The Director, Site Operations leads all aspects of our plant operations ranging from the cultivation of cannabis through distribution and everything in between. As the Director, Site Operations, you'll direct all the daily processes and long-term targets for the facility. You'll grind away at the details of managing internal resources to maximize safety, compliance, efficiency, productivity and culture. You'll also blaze the path toward creating and developing the multilevel professional team, and you'll work closely with your management team to keep every detail of the facility up to standards.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

* Oversee all strategic planning and vision for facility plant operations for cultivation, processing, packaging, maintenance, quality and logistics/fulfillment
* Manager all facility activities working closely with departmental managers ensuring wholesale objectives are accomplished on time and budget
* Own the facility budget; Analyze facility data, including efficiency metrics, labor variance analysis, defect rates, cost drivers, volume and capacity planning, etc. to make recommendations on optimal quality and efficiency improvements and capital expenditures
* Develop and produce reporting to clearly illustrate the trends of the business
* Manage and maintain a company culture consistent with the culture established at Green Thumb corporate of accountability, transparency and enjoyment
* Participate in developing and implementing rules, regulations, policies, and procedures to advance Green Thumb's mission, vision, goals and objectives
* Continuously improve the skills, knowledge and morale of all employees; create an environment where the entire team does the same
* Implement and maintain wholesale facility and equipment preventative maintenance program; replace, or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal billing or licensing requirements
* Will be required to be on-call and to respond to emergency situations at any time. This may include scheduling issues, potentially covering a vacant shift, facility issues and/or human resources requirements
* Other duties as assigned

**Safety & Compliance**
-----------------------

* Be aware of hazards in the workspace.
* Retain and understand department specific training.
* Be compliant with area safety requirements, state regulations and PPE requirements while at GTI sites.
* Follow GMP, biosecurity, sanitation or other quality and compliance requirements.
* Perform record keeping accurately and completely as directed by a lead or supervisor.
* Report and escalate safety & quality concerns.

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to perform reaching, grasping, bending, stooping, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing, and challenging environment
* Work involves daily exposure to allergens (such as cannabis, tree nuts, and coconut oil).
* Travel up to 10% may be required

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Business required; MBA or similar preferred
* 10+ years of management experience in manufacturing environment; direct management of 100+ individuals in a manufacturing setting required
* Consumer Packaged Good experience required
* In-depth knowledge & understanding of Lean, Six Sigma, certifications a plus
* Exposure to horticulture and/or plant science and/or lab processing, a plus
* Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience managing a P&L required
* Can-do attitude and ability to adapt quickly; business is experiencing tremendous growth so previous operational experience in growth environment is substantially preferred
* Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgement, common sense and resourcefulness
* Adapts and thrives in a demanding, fast-paced environment
* Possesses a high level of critical thinking
* Operates with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information
* Must understand and comply with the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of Green Thumb
* Must have a solid understanding of the Cannabis laws, rules and regulations and passion to further their understanding and knowledge of the industry and the laws.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* Must be at a minimum of 21 years of age.
* Must possess valid state ID.
* Must be able to obtain, and maintain, state badging requirements to work in the cannabis industry (requires background check and state review)

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Overview**

The Operations Director will play a critical leadership role in the transformation and growth of Sterling Pharmaceutical Services. This individual must be a results-driven leader capable of accelerating operational excellence, strengthening organizational accountability, and improving financial performance while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and safety. The successful candidate will possess a strong sense of urgency, a hands-on leadership style, and a demonstrated track record of leading operational improvements, driving profitability, and delivering measurable results during periods of significant change and growth. The Operations Director will partner closely with executive leadership and regularly communicate progress, strategy, and performance metrics to key stakeholders, including ownership and the Board of Directors.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operational and organizational initiatives to improve profitability, cash flow, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and execute strategic plans that align operational performance with company financial objectives.
* Establish a culture of accountability, urgency, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Identify, prioritize, and implement operational efficiencies that reduce costs and improve margins.
* Drive cross-functional execution against key business objectives and recovery plans.
* Monitor and report operational metrics to executive leadership and the Board of Directors.
* Prepare and deliver presentations to executive leadership, Board members, lenders, investors, and external stakeholders.
* Partner closely with the CEO and COO to develop operational strategies and communicate progress against strategic initiatives.
* Lead change management efforts and effectively manage resistance during transformation initiatives.
* Ensure rapid decision-making and execution while maintaining compliance, quality, and safety standards.

**Requirements**

* B.S. in Engineering or Science discipline
* 10+ years of Operations Leadership experience. GMP aseptic manufacturing experience a plus.
* Demonstrated experience leading business transformation, operational turnarounds, restructurings, or significant performance improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, cost reduction programs, EBITDA improvement, and working capital initiatives.
* Experience presenting to Boards of Directors, private equity firms, investors, lenders, or ownership groups.
* Track record of building high-performing teams and holding leaders accountable to performance metrics.
* Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.

**Additional Information**

* Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sterling Pharmaceutical Services does not sponsor employment visas now or in the future for this position.
* Relocation assistance is not available for this role. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the facility or be willing to relocate at their own expense.
* Sterling Pharmaceutical Services is conducting this search directly and is not engaging external recruiting or search firms for this position. We respectfully request that agencies and recruiters refrain from contacting us regarding candidate submissions.

Pay: $140,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Are you a strategic operational leader passionate about driving franchise success and organic sales growth? Poolwerx is looking for a dynamic Director of Operations to lead our field operations team, coach franchise partners, and champion operational excellence across our network.

**About the Role**

You will deliver high-value support service spanning business coaching, leadership, salesmanship, and operational execution—all while fostering a positive brand and sales culture among our Franchise Partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Drive Growth:** Deliver planned organic sales growth projections for franchise partners and regions while optimizing tracking, measurement, and reward systems.
* **Network Expansion:** Partner with franchise development to facilitate the introduction of new partners, stores, and acquisition opportunities.
* **Leadership & Team Management:** Manage and empower Field Operations, Franchise Business Coaches (FBCs), Onboarding Specialists, Technical Trainers, and Customer Experience Teams.
* **Technical & Field Excellence:** Lead Technical Trainers to ensure technicians master cleaning, maintenance, service, and repair standards; spend time in-field conducting site visits with partners.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Commercial (B2B), Supply Chain, and Marketing teams to unlock local and regional growth opportunities.
* **Operational Alignment & Innovation:** Act as Operations Advisor for Innovation/Evolution programs to drive standard practices across the entire network.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Education:** Undergraduate degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* **Experience:** Extensive field or sales management experience in a franchise, multi-site, or retail environment (pool industry experience highly desired).
* **Financial Acumen:** Strong business acumen with proven ability to analyze and report on P&L and manage departmental budgets.
* **Tech Savvy:** Proficient with Google Workspace, MS Office, CRM systems, and modern business improvement platforms.
* **Communication & Mindset:** Strong, influential communicator with a proactive, resilient, and collaborative "can-do" attitude.

If you're ready to take your leadership career to the next level with a growing industry leader, submit your application today or reach out directly to learn more!

role.description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 
 
**Group Summary**
Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Electronics, and we do it by creating world-class Electronic systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex Electronic systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Electronics.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**
**Role Summary**
The Regional Quality Director will be responsible for QM systems with regard to Product Portfolio, Programs and Projects to secure quality according to effective internal and external standards such as QS 9000, ISO/TS 16949/IATF, 14001, 18001, VDA, MQS, etc. to meet Legal, Company and Customer requirements and standards.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure effectiveness of the Magna Electronics Quality Management (QM) System.
* Managing all QM activities with regards to execution and achievement of corporate Quality goals.
* Executing the global quality strategy and goals, in particular the achievement of certified QM systems in the Division and Engineering Centers.
* Track and maintain data analysis of key metrics and performance data as it relates to the global quality strategy and results.
* Support Division management in executing quality policies; improve the sense of quality ownership in employees by corresponding measures, including establishing standards.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers to achieve site targets and ensure Lessons Learned / Best Practice in respect of Quality.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers in cases of containments, customer and warranty claims; executing root cause analysis, corrective actions and verification of effectiveness.
* Ownership in change management systems with respect to all quality-system related subjects.
* Engage in internal Program and Project reviews of Program Management and customer meetings in aspects of Quality.
* Interact with Division Quality, Production Operations, Product Development and Program Quality to meet or exceed internal and external customer quality performance targets.
* Support the sales and purchasing team in customer negotiations and supplier quality relevant topics.
* Engage in Quality advance planning and execution and support launch activities to meet timing and quality standards.
* Promote quality performance improvement throughout the organization.

role.title: Plant Manager - BCV
role.description:
**Plant Manager**
**Why Byrne**
At Byrne, we foster a culture built on teamwork, excellence, and professionalism. Our greatest strength lies in the exceptional talent and dedication of our team members across every part of the organization. We value their contributions and ensure they’re recognized, rewarded, and compensated in ways that reflect their impact and expertise.
 
 
**Pay And Benefits**

* Salary Range – $125,000 - $152,500 per year
* Competitive bonus programs
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits available day 1 of employment
* Supplemental benefits available on day 30 of employment
* Eligible for 401 (k) with a company match available on day 90 of employment
* Educational Support via tuition reimbursement and scholarship program

**Work Shift and Location**
3156 Byrne Hollow Crossing Cortland, NY 13045
 
 
Monday – Friday normal business hours. This may require evening, night and weekend availability based on business needs.
 
 
**Job Overview**
The Plant Manager plays a key role in executing assigned Production tasks. This includes leading various teams in production efforts in addition to performing the duties as needed to efficiently facilitate plant operations. The Plant Manager is also responsible for ensuring that the plant products manufactured conform to company-defined product quality standards, as well as Federal, State, and local standards of product identity, safety, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the plant; coordinate and direct plant operations in the achievement of production, cost, quality, and safety objectives.
* Ensure an appropriate volume of production and raw inventories for each product produced to maximize machine efficiencies and minimize down time and stock outs.
* Manage plant budget and expenses to fall within, or better than plan. Manage all plant variances to meet or exceed plan including, but not limited to, headcount, overtime, and spending.
* Ensure that the quality of products produced at the facility is consistent with intended design and desired image.
* Coordinate with Plant Production Scheduler, Warehouse Management and Supply Management to ensure needed dry goods are on-hand as required.
* Establish and administer mechanisms for being alerted when suppliers are going to be late for delivery or cut items on a delivery. Take action to minimize impact on production schedules and alert appropriate sales and logistics personnel.
* Provide planning assistance with physical inventories and provide staffing to perform these activities; ensure accuracy of all inventories at all times.
* Ensure reporting mechanism regarding KPI are in-place and functioning; ensure monthly reporting of critical KPI to company leadership and plant staff.
* Monitor intake procedures of raw dairy products to assure quality standards are met and production shortages are avoided.
* Contributes to the development of budgets and cost controls. Ensure direct reports analyze, budget, and control spending for their respective line accounts.
* Facilitate the development of strategies and corrective actions to resolve quality issues as necessary.
* Implements and maintains manufacturing policies, procedures, and production control programs.
* Must ensure full compliance with all quality assurance standards.
* Provide for the development, prioritization, and execution of capital improvement projects within the facility.
* Provide leadership for effective employee relations through positive communication, coaching, training, problem resolution/corrective actions, and floor time, work cooperatively with Human Resources.
* Coordinate production activities with purchasing, sales, warehousing, distribution, maintenance, and quality control activities to obtain optimum production and utilization of staff and equipment.
* Provide for the personal and professional growth of team through coaching, feedback, and opportunity.
* Foster participation of the workforce to enhance awareness and cooperation.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and all government regulations; Ensure compliance and enforcement of all work rules and regulations to plant operations and all applicable employees.
* Ensure proper GMP and sanitation procedures are followed plant-wide in collaboration with the quality unit.
* Communicate with Human Resource Department on needs of the facility.
* Rigorously assess your leadership and technical team in terms of values, adherence to SOPs/GMPs, and actual results.
* Foster an “open door” policy for all employees to maintain an open line of communication between direct reports and management staff.
* Promote and provide excellent customer service for all customers.
* Promote a safe and harmonious work environment and adherence to company policy and procedures.
* Responsible for ensuring direct reports assigned duties and responsibilities are covered during planned and unplanned absence from work, including acting as a backup as necessary.

**Min. Qualifications**

* BA/BS in Business Administration or related field, with an MBA preferred.
* Minimum 5-7 years in the role of Managing a Production facility.
* Related experience in the dairy food industry.
* Certifications to include but not limited to CPT, HACCP, OSHA 10-hour, First Aid, CPR and AED.

**Byrne**
Headquartered in LaFayette, Byrne is a Central New York-based dairy company with a legacy spanning over 90 years. Its operations include an extended shelf-life (ESL) and ultra-high temperature (UHT) pasteurization plant in DeWitt, as well as an ESL manufacturing facility in Cortlandville. Byrne also maintains warehouse facilities in Syracuse and East Syracuse, along with a dedicated ice cream center in Syracuse. As a recognized industry leader, Byrne continues to drive innovation at the forefront of dairy processing and product development.

role.title: Director of Quality
role.description:
*Reports To: SVP and General Manager, Business Operations*

**About Luminary Hospice:**
---------------------------

At Luminary Hospice, we are a mission-driven organization that empowers our team members to shape our culture in order to allow them to provide the highest quality support to patients and families throughout their entire end-of-life journey.

Our mission is to deliver personalized care that radiates compassion and preserves dignity for all that we are honored to serve on their end-of-life journey. We are centered on caring for the whole person – with expert medical care, pain management as well as emotional and spiritual support along with resources, information, and emotional support for families and caregivers.

### **About the role:**

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading, designing, and continuously improving the organization's Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) program. This role ensures compliance with all federal, state, and accrediting body requirements while driving a culture of safety, accountability, and high-quality patient care. The Director of Quality partners closely with clinical, operational, and executive leadership to translate quality data into meaningful improvements that enhance patient outcomes, regulatory readiness, and organizational performance.

This leader serves as the organization's subject-matter expert on quality, survey preparedness, and performance improvement, balancing regulatory rigor with practical, frontline-focused solutions.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Quality & Performance Improvement**

* Lead and oversee the organization's QAPI program, ensuring alignment with CMS Conditions of Participation, state regulations, and accreditation standards.

* Develop, implement, and monitor performance improvement initiatives based on data trends, adverse events, and regulatory requirements.

* Analyze quality metrics, patient outcomes, and incident reports to identify risks, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.

* Ensure corrective action plans are developed, implemented, and sustained across departments and markets. (Let's discuss with Nicole)

**Regulatory Compliance & Survey Readiness**

* Serve as the primary owner of regulatory readiness, including CMS, state surveys, and accrediting body reviews.

* Lead mock surveys, tracer activities, and ongoing readiness assessments to ensure continuous compliance.

* Coordinate survey responses, plans of correction, and follow-up activities in partnership with agency leadership.

* Stay current on regulatory changes and proactively educate leaders on impact and expectations.

**Patient Safety & Risk Management**

* Oversee patient safety initiatives, including incident reporting, investigations, and follow-up actions.

* Lead root cause analyses (RCAs) and failure mode assessments as needed.

* Partner with clinical leadership to reduce risk, prevent harm, and improve safety outcomes for patients and staff.

**Data, Reporting & Insights**

* Develop and maintain quality dashboards and reports for executive leadership, agency leaders, and governing bodies.

* Translate complex quality and compliance data into clear, actionable insights.

* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of required quality measures and outcomes.

**Leadership, Education & Collaboration**

* Partner with Executive Directors, Clinical Leaders, and Medical Directors to embed quality expectations into daily operations.

* Educate and coach leaders and frontline staff on quality standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements.

* Support a culture of transparency, continuous learning, and accountability.

* Participate in leadership meetings and provide strategic guidance on quality-related decisions.

**Job Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse (RN) with active, unrestricted license

* Minimum 5 years of hospice or home health experience

* Minimum 3 years in quality, compliance, or clinical leadership

* Strong knowledge of CMS Hospice Conditions of Participation

* Experience with surveys and regulatory audits

* Strong analytical and communication skills

**Preferred**

* Hospice or quality certification (CHPN, CPHQ, or similar)

* Experience with accreditation organizations (CHAP, ACHC, Joint Commission)

### **Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit or stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity:**

Luminary Hospice is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation's space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.

Lead manufacturing operations across Karman's El Monte and Corona locations, aligning machining, fabrication, and downstream processing with business objectives. In this role, you will drive safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability by providing operational leadership, strengthening cross-functional collaboration, and advancing continuous improvement initiatives across complex manufacturing environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Leads and coordinates manufacturing operations across the El Monte and Corona locations, establishing accountability, performance expectations, and operating rhythms for operations managers and functional departments.
* Develops and executes operational plans that align production performance, capacity, and investment priorities with company strategy.
* Oversees machining, fabrication, forming, finishing, and assembly operations to improve throughput, schedule attainment, labor productivity, and profitability.
* Drives operational excellence by implementing procedures and standards that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and regulatory compliance.
* Champions Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement through 5S, Kaizen, flow and lead-time improvements, cycle-time and setup reduction, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and preventative maintenance.
* Analyzes financial and production data, including overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), spindle utilization, and labor efficiency, to manage budgets, inventory, spending, and cost performance.
* Ensures equipment readiness, maintenance execution, and manufacturing capacity align with production requirements.
* Partners with human resources on workforce planning, recruiting, organizational structure, labor utilization, work scheduling, leadership development, performance evaluation, and succession planning.
* Coordinates closed-loop communication and escalation across operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and program management.
* Manages the administration and performance of subcontracted and temporary labor services.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience that includes a minimum of 10 years of relevant manufacturing leadership experience.
* At least 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including oversight of complex production environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Science (MS), or another advanced degree.
* Operational leadership experience in precision manufacturing supporting aerospace or defense production.
* Leadership experience in a computer numerical control (CNC) machining environment producing large, tight-tolerance metallic components.
* Experience machining aluminum using 3-axis and 5-axis milling and large gantry equipment.
* Experience with automated or semi-automated manufacturing equipment.
* Experience managing multi-step manufacturing routings and complex production flows.
* Working knowledge of deburring, finishing, forming, welding coordination, heat treatment, and assembly operations.
* Experience building high-performance manufacturing teams and leading Lean transformation.

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequently sits, uses a computer, and communicates.
* Occasionally stands, walks, reaches, or stoops.
* Uses close vision and works with screens for extended periods.
* The essential functions of this position must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

role.description:
**Confidential Search: ESL Processing Manager – Dairy Manufacturing** 
**Location:** Greater Philadelphia, PA Area 
**Industry:** Dairy / Food & Beverage Manufacturing 
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Onsite 
**Compensation:** Competitive Base + Bonus + Full Benefits 
**Confidential Role – Qualified candidates only will be contacted directly**

### **Position Summary**

A well-established dairy manufacturer in the Philadelphia region is conducting a confidential search for an experienced **ESL Processing Manager**. This role will oversee operations related to extended shelf life milk and dairy beverage processing, with a strong focus on product quality, plant performance, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience with **HTST, UHT, or ESL pasteurization systems**, a deep understanding of **fluid dairy processing**, and a proven ability to lead production teams in a **fast-paced, SQF-certified environment**.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead daily operations of the ESL processing department, ensuring product quality and production efficiency.
* Manage HTST/UHT equipment, CIP/SIP procedures, and aseptic processing protocols.
* Oversee batch formulation, temperature and flow controls, and compliance with state and federal regulations.
* Coordinate production schedules, sanitation cycles, and preventative maintenance in conjunction with QA and maintenance teams.
* Lead, train, and supervise ESL line operators and processing staff; enforce safety, GMP, and food safety practices.
* Monitor and improve KPIs related to yield, run efficiency, downtime, and loss.
* Collaborate with R&D, Quality Assurance, Packaging, and Distribution teams on process improvement initiatives.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of dairy or beverage processing experience, with at least 2 years in an ESL, HTST, or UHT operation.
* Strong understanding of fluid milk or dairy-based beverage production and regulatory compliance (FDA, PMO).
* Supervisory or leadership experience in a food manufacturing plant.
* Familiarity with CIP/SIP systems, flow schematics, and thermal processing validation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Dairy Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Experience working in SQF-certified or similar food safety environments.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with aseptic packaging lines or ESL bottled products.
* Pasteurizer or processing certifications (e.g., HACCP, SQF Practitioner).
* Knowledge of automation systems (e.g., PLCs, SCADA) used in fluid processing.

**To Apply Confidentially:** 
Please send your resume and brief cover note to **laws@henpencorp.com** 
Or text **408-755-5423** to express interest.

*Only qualified applicants with relevant dairy or ESL processing experience will be contacte*

role.title: Director of Quality Improvement Strategy
role.description:
**About CCNC:**

From the mountains to the coast, from large cities to small towns, Community Care of North Carolina is transforming health care. Informed by statewide data and predictive analytics, community-based care-managers work with local physicians and diverse teams of health professionals to develop whole-person plans of care that connect people to the right local resources and increase equity and access to high quality care.

**CCNC Mission Statement**

To improve the health and quality of life for all North Carolinians by building supporting better community-based healthcare delivery systems.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy is responsible for setting the vision for the organization’s Quality Improvement strategy, in collaboration with the Population Health Division and aligned with CCNC’s mission and strategic goals. The aim of the QI strategy is to ensure the CCPN member practices deliver high - quality health care that drives successful performance of the Clinically Integrated Network (CIN).

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy in coordination with the Clinical Performance and Practice Engagement teams, will direct, plan, implement, monitor, coordinate, and evaluate all aspects of the QI strategy and oversee daily operations to ensure that CCNC’s strategic plan is implemented. implements and informs process improvement to create standardized and streamlined processes, workflows, and education. The Director of QI Strategy provides direct supervision of the QI Specialist and the Value Based Care Program Specialist.

Responsibilities include outreach, education, training, hands-on participative leadership, and development of an increased capacity to successfully execute performance improvement across the organization. Working directly with others across the organization, The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy ensures that the elements of the QI strategy allow for coordination and collaboration of multifaceted initiatives with practices that serve our covered populations with consideration of resources, cost savings and quality. This includes providing strategic input on the development of organizational goals, to include measurement criteria and interventions for achieving the goals.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

**Operationalize QI Strategy**
------------------------------

* Direct the implementation of Quality Improvement efforts to support CCPN practices and CCNC programming in accordance with the strategic plan.
* Establish and implement the process for how PRRs utilize the QI plans to drive performance with CCPN practices.
* Facilitate the development of programs, systems, workflows, and integration efforts in alignment with CCNC and CCPN’s contractual, regulatory and quality requirements.
* Apply QI methodology, change management strategies, team facilitation, and coaching principles to achieve program effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Mentor and train on QI methodology, change management, and coaching principles (e.g. Model for Improvement, PDSA, Lean,).
* Demonstrate subject matter expertise and knowledge of payment models and their associated quality measures.
* Serve as the subject matter expert and lead for key projects and initiatives; including developing detailed work plans, assigning responsibilities, monitoring project progress and ensuring spread and sustainability.
* Assist CCPN and CCNC with future program development, creation or delegation of accountability and ownership for program roles and continuous process improvement.
* Develop annual Quality Plans with the Value Based Care Program practices in coordination with key focus areas identified by Clinical Performance.
* Represent and demonstrate our QI strategy in monthly Joint Operating Council meetings with the Value Based Care Program practices.
* Support the Practice Based Care Coordination (PBCC) program through data mining, identification of opportunities for improvement, regular practice monitoring, and ongoing training & support for the QIPS team.
* Engage and maintain collaborative relationships with the health care community, including but not limited to primary care providers, practice managers & practice team members, health departments, FQHCs and other community partners.
* Serve as Liaison on local, regional and state workgroups and collaborative efforts.
* Partner with the QI leaders for payers to establish collaborative and effective working relationships.
* Actively participate in payer meetings to represent and demonstrate our QI strategy

***Data Management, Analytics and Presentation***

* Lead QI efforts to positively impact performance and quality measures.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Performance team to use data to evaluate the effectiveness of projects across departments
* Advise leadership on project-specific data and information needs in support of staff.
* Identify areas of opportunity for CCPN practices through clinical data analysis, interpretation, & presentation.
* Lead the QI PS team to provide excellent training and support to member practices that facilitate effective use of the organization’s value-based care data platform
* In coordination with the Clinical Performance team, train on data definitions, data interpretation and data analysis
* Support all programs in achieving program goals through data analytics and quality improvement support.
* Adhere to CCNC privacy and security policies to ensure that patient and company data are properly safeguarded.

***Staff Management and Supervision***

* Provide effective leadership with respect to recruitment, selection, training, evaluation, compensation, staff development, and advocacy for the QI Strategy Team.
* Provide oversight and guidance to staff through a team approach that allows for coordinated handoffs, communication, and workflow across provider-facing staff
* Develop strategies for allocating QI resources to meet program goals and to control costs through effective use of personnel.
* Identify staff training needs and provide appropriate training opportunities.
* Complete performance evaluations.
* Utilize conflict resolution and problem-solving skills to manage issues in a timely manner.

**Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse (BSN required; MSN preferred); Social Worker (BSW required; MSW and LCSW preferred); or master's in public health or health care administration. If RN: Active, unrestricted RN license to practice in North Carolina.
* At least 5 years of Quality Improvement or relevant health care experience with responsibilities in the following areas: operational leadership, process improvement, project management, systems analysis, data analytics, and team facilitation.
* At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in health care.
* NAHQ Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ)
* Lean / Six Sigma certification a plus.
* Maintain a valid NC driver’s license with current auto liability insurance.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

Excellent communication skills

* - oral, written and public speaking
* Knowledge of government, private sector and community resources
* Knowledge of and compliance with federal and state regulations applicable to the position
* Critical thinking skills, effective clinical judgment, independent decision making, and problem- solving abilities
* Skilled in establishing rapport with providers, community partners, and members
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Ability to work independently and function as an integral part of the team
* Expertise with Microsoft Office suite of products and comfort with database software and the internet
* Strong competence in quality improvement methodologies, principles, and recognition programs
* Ability to take “deep dives” into multiple sources of data to drive improvement
* Ability to stimulate innovative thinking & serve as a change agent
* Able to shift strategy or approach in response to the demands of a situation

**Working Conditions**

* Multiple contacts are required with providers, members, health systems and community partners to ensure effectiveness of QI and PS work; exposure to general office conditions, as well as communicable disease could occur.
* Potential for minor physical inconveniences or discomforts in the work setting, including sitting for moderate periods of time.
* Repetitive wrist motion and occasional lifting/carrying of up to 25 pounds.
* Travel required within the region and/or the state.

----------------

* Make a meaningful impact on youth and families across North Carolina
* Work with a supportive and collaborative care team
* Competitive Benefits Package effective first day of employment
* Opportunities for growth, training, and bonus incentives\*
