role.title: Quality Systems Project Sr Manager
role.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

Leads the Quality Management System (QMS) integration of acquired medical device businesses and/or products into Zimmer Biomet (ZB) network. Plans, manages and executes the QMS Integration Project Plan (IPP) to update, harmonize and transition the acquired site’s QMS to ZB Global Quality requirements and applicable regulations; to remediate and transfer the site’s QMS and medical device product quality documentation and records from legacy systems into ZB global enterprise IT applications; and to ensure the site obtains and/or maintains certifications and establishment registration. Partners cross-functionally with Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Operations, Supplier Quality, Post-Market Surveillance, Servicing, IT, the Integration Management Office (IMO) and acquired-site leadership to complete integration on schedule and within budget while maintaining continuous regulatory compliance, product supply and in-process regulatory submissions.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

* Leads cross-functional, multi-workstream QMS integration projects for newly acquired medical device businesses, from post-close planning through harmonization, documentation transfer, verification of effectiveness and integration closure.
 + Serves as the ZB Quality Integration Lead / QMS Project Leader for assigned acquisitions; accountable for the integration plan, schedule, budget, resources and deliverables.
 + Proposes corporate-wide process and issue solutions; resolves conflicts and escalates risks and roadblocks to Quality leadership and the IMO.
 + Coaches and mentors ZB and acquired-site team members on ZB Global QMS requirements; may supervise or direct team members, contractors and consultants.
 + Reviewer and approver of integration plans, gap assessments, migration protocols/reports and document-controlled forms.
 + Serves as Global SME for the QMS integration process and as site SME for multiple QMS sub-systems during transition.
 + Represents Quality in external and internal (global, site, IMO and executive) meetings, and during regulatory inspections and certification audits related to integration.
 + Strategic project planning for projects of all scale and complexity (plan, resources, budget).
* QMS Integration Planning and Project Management:
 + Translates due diligence findings into integration scope, risk-based priorities and workstreams; authors and maintains the QMS Integration Project Plan (IPP) per ZB global integration guidance and M&A procedures, and obtains cross-functional approval of the plan and its revisions.
 + Establishes and leads integration workstreams (e.g., Management Controls; Document & Record Controls & QMS Software; Design & Development Controls & Risk Management; Servicing; Purchasing, Production & Process Controls; CAPA / Quality Systems; Post-Market Surveillance; Regulatory and Clinical Affairs), assigning ZB and site owners, milestones and target dates.
 + Maintains detailed integration action plans, schedules and risk/issue logs (e.g., SharePoint, Smartsheet); leads recurring integration project meetings and reports status, budget, timeline, risks and roadblocks to Quality leadership, the IMO and site senior leadership.
 + Manages the integration budget and resource plan (including incremental headcount and external support) and revises the IPP when scope changes (e.g., new markets, new NPI projects, new product registrations).
* QMS Harmonization and Transition:
 + Leads gap assessments of site QMS procedures, processes and records against the ZB Global Quality Manual, global procedures (GBL/GBLW), and applicable regulations and standards; documents the harmonization approach and remediation actions.
 + Drives revision, adoption or retirement of the site Quality Manual, Quality Policy, procedures and work instructions; defines interim controls, “hybridized” processes, workstream decision forms and design control transition memoranda to maintain compliance until full adoption of global requirements.
 + Coordinates implementation of management controls, including Management Representative designation, organization charts and job descriptions, global KPIs and Global Quality Report, management review, and internal/external audit programs.
 + Establishes stakeholder-agreed cutover / go-live dates for each QMS sub-system (e.g., document control, CAPA, nonconformance, product holds, HHE/field actions, complaints, supplier controls, calibration, servicing) and ensures open legacy records are completed and closed under legacy procedures.
 + Coordinates intercompany quality agreements between the acquired site and ZB sites (e.g., complaint handling units, distribution and service centers) and contract manufacturers.

**How You'll Create Impact (cont.)**
------------------------------------

* Documentation Remediation and Transfer to ZB Enterprise Applications:
 + Plans and leads the transfer of QMS and product quality documentation and records from the acquired site’s legacy eQMS/document management system into ZB global enterprise applications (e.g., Windchill, OpenText LiveLink, WOW, Codebeamer, EtQ Reliance, iLearn, ServiceMax).
 + Develops data migration / transfer protocols, data mapping, acceptance criteria, verification and summary reports; ensures migrated and archived records remain complete, accurate, retrievable and compliant with record retention and electronic records/signature requirements.
 + Assesses and remediates product quality documentation, including Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files (RMF), Device Master Records, labeling, specifications and drawings, validations (process, software, test method) and supplier files (e.g., ASL, SPPA, SCN, SCAR), to ZB global requirements before or during transfer.
 + Coordinates with R&D and Regulatory Affairs to sequence documentation transfer so that ongoing NPI, design transfer and regulatory submissions (e.g., 510(k)) are not disrupted.
 + Partners with IT and global system owners on site set-up (e.g., site codes, user access, configuration), system training for site personnel, training curricula mapping to the ZB learning management system, and legacy system archival and decommissioning.
* Compliance, Effectiveness and Closure:
 + Ensures continued compliance and inspection readiness throughout the transition; initiates IE, CAPA or equivalent when gaps represent substantial noncompliance to regulatory requirements.
 + Supports site certification readiness (e.g., ISO 13485, MDSAP) and preparation for the post-integration corporate QMS audit.
 + Plans verification of effectiveness of integration activities (e.g., internal or independent QMS audit), drives closure of resulting nonconformances, and authors the IPP closure summary.
 + Captures lessons learned and continuously improves the ZB global QMS integration process, templates and playbook.

*This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.*

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

* Expert knowledge of medical device QMS requirements: FDA 21 CFR Part 820, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR, MDSAP and other global regulations.
* Broad working knowledge of all QMS sub-systems: document and record control, design controls, risk management, CAPA, nonconformance, complaints/MDR, HHE/field actions, supplier controls, process and software validation, calibration, servicing and post-market surveillance.
* Proven program/project management of complex, multi-workstream, cross-functional projects (scope, schedule, budget, resources, risk and change control).
* Experience with M&A integration, site transfers/consolidations, or QMS harmonization and remediation.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise eQMS/PLM applications (e.g., Windchill, EtQ, OpenText, Codebeamer, Greenlight Guru), data migration and computer system validation.
* Strong knowledge of DHF, RMF, DMR and technical documentation content and structure.
* Ability to lead and influence without direct authority and to manage organizational change and cultural transition at acquired sites.
* Excellent executive-level communication, facilitation and status reporting.
* Sound risk-based judgement, problem solving and decision making in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Proficient with project management and reporting tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, SharePoint, Tableau/Power BI).

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of relevant experience, or Associate's Degree and 7 years of relevant experience, or High School Diploma or Equivalent and 9 years of relevant experience required.
* B.S. in Engineering, Life Sciences or related field preferred.
* Advanced degree (M.S./MBA) preferred.
* 10+ years in medical device Quality / Quality Systems or equivalent experience, including 5+ years leading cross-functional projects highly preferred.
* Experience leading QMS integration, harmonization or remediation for acquisitions, site transfers or eQMS/PLM implementations strongly preferred.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred.
* ASQ CQA, CQE or CMQ/OE, or ISO 13485 / MDSAP Lead Auditor certification preferred.
* Lean / Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred.
* Experience with SiMD/SaMD, robotics or capital equipment preferred.

**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------

* Up to 30% (domestic and international travel to acquired sites and ZB locations)

**Expected Compensation Range**
-------------------------------

$128,000 - $160,000 USD Annually

role.title: Senior Director, Engine & Plant Solutions Strategy
role.description:
**Job Description**
===================

This role defines how the GE Vernova Gas Power portfolio should evolve over a 5-year horizon and leads the front end of the hardware portfolio and NPI funnel. The leader converts shifts in customer needs, energy markets, technology, policy, competition, and adjacent value pools into an integrated portfolio architecture, prioritized opportunity pipeline, and decision-ready investment recommendations across heavy-duty gas turbines, aeroderivative gas turbines, steam turbines, generators, heat-recovery and balance-of-plant systems, equipment controls, and integrated engine and plant architectures.

 
 

The role matures outyear hardware and engine-solution opportunities until customer value, strategic fit, architecture, technical feasibility, economics, risk, ownership, and execution pathways are sufficiently defined for a Product Management decision. At that point, accountability transitions through a formal tollgate to Product Management, which owns funded commercialization, product roadmap execution, lifecycle performance, quality, delivery, and product cost.

 
 

Expected to work in a high intensity, sprint-based model, with high exposure to Power SLT on business-defining recommendations.

 
 

**Scope boundaries within the Strategy & Product Management team**
------------------------------------------------------------------

**Joint seams:** Data centers, distributed generation, hybrid systems and other cross-portfolio opportunities require a named lead by value proposition. This role leads when the core question is engine, equipment, controls or plant architecture; Software & Services Strategy leads when the core question is digital/services value capture; New Business Industrialization leads when the opportunity requires venture incubation or formation of a new business.

**Owned by New Business Industrialization:** Startup-like opportunities, external or emerging technologies requiring venture-style incubation, new business models, sandbox or stand-alone operating structures, early commercialization, and industrialization pathways outside the established hardware portfolio. This role may identify or sponsor a signal, but transfers venture incubation accountability.

**Owned by Software & Services Strategy:** Software products, industrial data and AI, digital platforms, recurring-revenue models, software-enabled services, services transformation, installed-base service strategy, and the enterprise value proposition that combines software, controls and services. This role supplies hardware and controls-interface requirements but does not own that strategy.

**Owned by this role:** Long-range hardware portfolio architecture; heavy-duty and aeroderivative engine platforms; steam, generator and balance-of-plant hardware; equipment controls and controls interfaces; new centerlines and derivatives; physical plant and power-island architectures; hardware competitiveness; and transition of defined opportunities into Product Management/NPI.

 
 

**Organizational scope**
------------------------

* Reports directly into the VP Power Strategy, with a formal operating interlock to the head of Product Management and the Power executive leadership team.

* Leads 4-6 direct reports plus cross-functional opportunity teams formed around priority initiatives.

* Global scope across new units, installed base, services, software and controls, digital offerings, engine and plant-system solutions, and selected adjacencies.

* Owns portfolio recommendations and incubation governance, not engineering line management, product P&Ls, commercial execution, or lifecycle delivery after transition.

* Decision rights include opportunity admission, evidence requirements, incubation funding recommendations, gate-readiness certification, and stop/pivot recommendations. Final investment approvals remain with designated business governance.

 
 

Required Qualifications

 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, economics, finance, computer science, or a related discipline.

* Typically 15+ years of progressively responsible experience across portfolio strategy, product management, engineering, technology commercialization, services, commercial strategy, or corporate/business strategy in complex industrial markets.

* Demonstrated leadership of enterprise-scale portfolio choices, new-platform evaluations, or integrated solution development involving material investment and multi-year uncertainty.

* Deep understanding of industrial product economics, lifecycle value, R&D/NPI governance, customer buying processes, and commercialization.

* Fluency in financial modeling, scenario analysis, business cases, capital allocation, and option-based decision making.

* Evidence of leading through influence across senior stakeholders with competing incentives and no direct reporting authority.

* Exceptional written and verbal executive communication, including the ability to simplify complex technical and market choices without losing rigor.

* Ability and willingness to engage customers globally and travel as required.

 
 

For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $248,000 and $341,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus

role.title: Operations Director
role.description:
Job Overview

The Operations Director will oversee the company's day to day operations and work closely with leadership to ensure that business objectives are being met. This role is responsible for managing operational performance, supporting department managers, improving internal processes, and making sure teams have the direction and resources they need to do their jobs effectively.

You will work across finance, sales, customer service, and project management to keep business activities organized and running smoothly. The right person understands how to manage people and resources, keep an eye on financial performance, and address operational problems before they affect the business.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and work with department managers to establish priorities, assign responsibilities, and maintain consistent performance across teams.

Monitor profit and loss performance, review operating expenses, and work with finance to manage budgets and improve financial results.

Use financial reports, operational data, and Microsoft Excel to evaluate performance, identify problems, and support day to day business decisions.

Manage operational projects and process improvement initiatives, looking for practical ways to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen service delivery.

Work with sales, business development, and customer service teams to coordinate activities and ensure that operational priorities support the company's business goals.

Review existing procedures and introduce improvements where needed, including the use of lean management principles to improve workflow and resource utilization.

Manage and support department managers, provide clear direction, and follow up on operational responsibilities and performance.

Work with senior leadership on business planning, resource allocation, and decisions that affect the company's operations and long term development.

Address operational challenges, resolve internal coordination issues, and ensure that important projects and business activities stay on track.

Experience and Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, or a related management position, with a strong record of supervising teams and overseeing daily business activities.

Experience managing department managers, coordinating multiple business functions, and maintaining accountability across an organization.

Strong understanding of financial management, profit and loss oversight, operating budgets, and financial performance analysis.

Ability to interpret financial reports, analyze operational data, and use Microsoft Excel to support business decisions.

Experience with strategic planning, project management, process improvement, and operational performance management.

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide managers, develop employees, and address business challenges.

A practical understanding of sales operations, business development, and customer service.

Familiarity with lean management principles and continuous improvement practices is valuable.

Good organizational skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while keeping teams focused on results.

Pay: $158,200.00 - $222,200.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chandler, AZ 85226

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Director of Operations**

At **MPE** we are dedicated to making a difference in the world through cutting-edge medical technology. Our mission is to be the global leader in design, engineering, and manufacturing solutions for the medical and technology industries. We are committed to creating impactful solutions that improve lives and fostering an environment where our team members can thrive, grow, and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the medical field.

**A better career for you. Creating medical technology for all.**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**We are seeking a dedicated Director of Operations to join our team.**

In this vital role, you will be responsible for all of the Company’s Manufacturing and Maintenance activities related to all MPE sites. The Director of Operations will plan, direct, coordinate, and oversee operations activities in the organization, ensuring development and implementation of efficient operations and cost-effective systems to meet current and future needs of the organization.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where precision and teamwork matter, we’d love to hear from you!

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a key member of the Leadership Team that develops, establishes, communicates and executes the strategic direction of operations while aligning with overall business goals and objectives and supporting customer requirements.
* Work closely with President/CEO to drive manufacturing plans, goals and future innovations including Lean, Six Sigma, Quick Response Manufacturing techniques and Continuous Improvement to evolve our World Class Organization.
* Ensure that, as the Company grows, our manufacturing capabilities meet or exceed industry and customer requirements for cost, quality, responsiveness, lean, efficiencies, safety and best practices.
* Develop, recommend and manage budgeting and budget execution within functional area with a focus on costs savings, productivity improvements and quality assurance. Manage within the budgetary constraints. Analyze and report on variances between actual and budgeted expenditures
* Oversee all manufacturing engineering, production control, production process development, and preventive maintenance.
* Develop and implement processes, procedures and controls to promote efficient operations of the organization and ensure all Operations teams remain compliant to the processes, procedures and controls.
* Work closely with the Quality Team to ensure manufacturing processes are meeting customers’ requirements and required scorecard levels.
* Monitor and understand our customers’ and other outside agencies regulatory and quality system requirements and incorporate into our manufacturing processes while maintaining compliance.
* Ensure the training of new and present employees in the processes and methods required to achieve the organization’s standards for quality, quantity, and safety, consistent with the companies compliance and operational needs. Identifies additional training needs and ensures proper training is developed and provided.
* Oversee the Company’s environmental, health and safety efforts in manufacturing to remain in compliance OSHA, EPA, State and local regulations and provide a safe working environment for our employees.
* Establish and maintain best practices for Manufacturing and Preventive Maintenance to develop and run a world-class manufacturer for medical devices. Ensure the maintenance of departmental housekeeping standards.
* Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in operations management.
* Presents periodic performance reports and metrics to the Chief Executive Officer and Leadership Team.
* Leader and Ambassador for MPE Cultural Values internally and externally.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field or equivalent experience

**Experience and Training:**

* At least 10 years of manufacturing and continuous improvement experience in a leadership role
* Experience in capital equipment and ROI analysis
* Experience low-volume, high product mix manufacturing
* Experience in Lean, Six Sigma and/or Quick Response Manufacturing techniques

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Physical and Mental Demands:**

* Regularly required to analyze, interpret data and documents, read and write business correspondences, present information, and problem solve.
* Must be able to read, write, apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Why Join Us?**

* **Mission-Driven Work:** Help deliver medical products that change lives.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We support career development and internal promotions.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:**
 + Medical (HSA-qualified and traditional plans), dental, and vision—coverage starts the first of the month after hire.
 + 401(k) with company match.
 + Nine paid holidays and vacation time from day one.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**If you're detail-oriented, team-driven, and ready to contribute to life-changing medical technology, apply today and grow your career at MPE.**

**No relocation or sponsorship available for this role.**

role.title: Director Practice Operations Community Cardiology
role.description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Cardiovascular Service Line and serves as a key leader at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across multiple community cardiology clinics in the Boston metro area.

Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the cardiology service line

This role plays a critical part in shaping the cardiovascular ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery of exceptional care across all cardiology sites.

Travel required to practice locations**:**

* Framingham (Heart Center Metro West)
* Melrose
* Merrimack Valley
* Norwood

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

3. Experience in Cardiovascular Service Line.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and monthly one-on-one meetings with each practice manager at each practice location to provide individual support and leadership.

6. Initiates and maintains all policy and procedure manuals. Develops and implements standardized processes for practices to ensure consistency throughout the physician network. Works with practice operations managers to ensure practices meet required compliance and clinical competency thresholds.

7. Works collaboratively with the physician recruitment team on the provider enrollment onboarding activities related to new practice acquisitions or new employed providers. Works closely with the provider recruitment team, practice operations manager and provider(s) throughout the onboarding life cycle to ensure timeliness and deliverables are met for a seamless transition and successful implementation.

8. In collaboration with the Vice President of Physician Services, implements the transition plan for newly acquired physician practices. Acts as liaison to physicians, support staff, operations team, hospital departments, and hospital administration. Responsible for the human resources, payroll, finance, and purchasing components of the acquisitions.

9. Works collaboratively with representatives from the physician organizations to ensure that our practices and providers are achieving a high level of performance under managed risk contracts as we transition to a value-based model. Commitment to transformation and innovation in care delivery through the Practice of the Future work will also be a measure of success.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Work environment: professional office environment with typical office requirements such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate and exchange information.

3. Able to see and read computers displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

5. Ability to work in confined or open environments.

6. Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

7. Ability to travel to various locations both within the state and outside the state.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Demonstrates leadership style that emphasizes openness, visibility and connectivity.

2. Ability to convey the organization’s enthusiasm, confidence, goals, and mission and inspire those things in others.

3. Ability to connect with people in a meaningful way at all levels within the organization in keeping with the culture of the senior leadership team.

4. Demonstrates forward thinking and creativity with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image while fostering collaboration and building consensus to achieve collective objectives.

5. Ability to make tough choices that serve the best interests of the organization. Proven creative problem-solving skills with the willingness to take the initiative in leading change as well as the ability to effectively manage change.

6. Ability to build consensus with strong negotiation, persuasion and communication skills to propose enhancements to operational processes to improve efficiency and/or effectiveness.

7. Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills necessary to engage effectively at all levels for effecting timely progress.

8. Ability to be an innovative problem solver with excellent critical thinking skills.

9. Demonstrates exemplary leadership and stakeholder management expertise.

10. Ability to hold self and others accountable to meet deadlines and achieve business goals.

**Job Profile Summary**

This role focuses on providing administrative and business support to the organization in order to achieve operational goals. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Clinical Administration duties: Long-term strategic planning, determines strategic issues and opportunities that could affect practice success, prioritizes and tracks investments across practices, allocates resources and makes decisions regarding practice growth, and develops need to accomplish the practice's vision. A management role that supervises employees focusing on tactical, operational activities within a specified area, with the majority of time spent overseeing area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and/or indirect reports. A role that directs a department or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and/or team Leaders. Responsibilities typically include: ownership of short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of the Department, problems faced are often complex and require extensive investigation and analysis, and requires ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate and influence executive leadership.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. Individual offers are determined using a comprehensive approach that considers relevant experience, certifications, education, skills, and internal equity to ensure compensation is fair, consistent, and aligned with our business goals.

Beyond base pay, Tufts Medicine provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports your health, financial security, and career growth—one of the many ways we invest in you so you can thrive both at work and outside of it.

**Pay Range****:**

 
$134,525.66 - $171,524.44

role.title: Director of Branch Operations
role.description:
**Eagle Title | Annapolis, MD**

**Reports To:** President

**Compensation Range:** Compensation is a combination of base salary plus performance-based commission tied to profitability and revenue growth across the branches.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Eagle Title is looking for a Director of Branch Operations to lead the profitability, growth, and operational excellence of Eagle Title branches (including Commercial and Builder Services Divisions).

Reporting directly to the President, this is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong business acumen, operational expertise, and a proven ability to develop high-performing leaders. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, holds branch managers accountable for growing their businesses, and builds the strategies, systems, and relationships needed for long-term success.

The right person understands that strong financial performance starts with strong leadership, clear expectations, efficient operations, and exceptional client service.

**WHAT YOU'LL LEAD**

**Branch Profitability & Growth**

* Own the profit and loss (P&L) performance of all branches, driving profitability, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
* Establish financial goals, growth expectations, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each branch.
* Hold branch managers accountable for executing strategies that grow the business, strengthen referral relationships, and achieve revenue targets.
* Regularly review branch financial and operational performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategies that deliver measurable results.

**Branch Operations & Strategy**

* Provide strategic and operational oversight of branches, ensuring consistency, accountability, efficiency, and exceptional client service.
* Support branch managers in overseeing day-to-day operations, resolving challenges, and maintaining effective workflows.
* Develop and execute branch strategies that align with Eagle Title's financial goals and long-term business objectives.
* Establish standardized processes, performance expectations, and operational best practices across locations.
* Leverage technology, data, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen efficiency, quality, and scalability.

**Leadership & Accountability**

* Lead, coach, and develop branch managers through clear expectations, regular performance discussions, measurable goals, and consistent accountability.
* Establish and monitor branch manager scorecards that track financial performance, business development activity, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction.
* Partner with Human Resources to support staffing, training, performance management, and leadership development.
* Empower branch managers to take ownership of their teams, business development efforts, and overall branch performance.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

**Collaboration & Business Performance**

* Serve as a strategic business partner to Underwriting, Post-Closing, Marketing and other operational departments to strengthen workflows, resolve challenges, and deliver exceptional client experience.
* Collaborate with the President and Sales leadership to align branch growth strategies with overall company objectives.
* Identify and address operational challenges affecting transaction quality, turnaround times, profitability, and client satisfaction.
* Strengthen communication and collaboration across departments to support successful transactions and organizational growth.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven leadership experience overseeing multiple branches, locations, or business units with responsibility for financial and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, budgeting, financial analysis, and revenue growth strategies.
* Demonstrated success driving profitability, operational efficiency, and measurable business results.
* Experience coaching, developing, and holding managers accountable for business growth and operational performance.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into actionable plans.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Experience developing and monitoring KPIs, scorecards, and operational performance metrics.
* Ability to balance financial performance, operational priorities, employee development, and exceptional client service.
* Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and leadership levels.
* Experience in title insurance, real estate settlement, or a related industry strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Experience with title production technology, including Qualia, preferred.

role.description:
**Job Title:** Global Director, Supplier Quality

**Job Location:** Southfield, MI

**What we offer:**

VeoneerSafety Systemsis the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.
 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth*.* 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

**What you'll do:**

The Global Director of Supplier Quality leads the global SQ organization, setting strategy, standards, and accountability for supplier readiness, performance, and continuous improvement.

The role combines global Supplier Quality leadership (80%) with North America Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leadership (20%).

**Key Responsibilities for Supplier Quality** (80% of role)

**Strategic Leadership & Global Deployment**

* Set global SQ strategy aligned with corporate, customer, sourcing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Define and execution of Supplier Quality Policies, Standards, Processes, Methods and Systems.
* Owner of Veoneer Supplier Manual (VSM), Supplier Quality Project (SQP) – APQP & PPAP, Supplier Non-Conformance Material (NCM) Management.
* Align cross-functional priorities, resources, and accountability; establish SQE oversight of workload, open issues, owners, overdue actions, and escalations.
* Monitor supplier quality targets, initiatives and indicators to ensure compliance to Veoneer Supplier Quality related policies, standards and reporting.

**Supplier Development & Standards Compliance**

* Oversee new supplier assessment, qualification, and development with Purchasing and Engineering; improve assessment models and ensure teams close risks and capability gaps before sourcing and production approval.
* Set common supplier requirements, risk-based audit and development expectations, and change controls; ensure existing suppliers improve capability and sustain company and customer compliance.
* Representing quality in Supplier Sourcing Board.

**Supplier Performance & Major Quality Issues**

* Lead major supplier escalations with supplier executives and cross-functional teams, ensuring containment, exposure assessment, production and customer protection, and verified permanent corrective actions.
* Drive common KPIs and improvement targets for supplier PPM, repeat defects, corrective-action aging, disruptions.
* Require leadership reviews and improvement plans for systemic issues, sharing lessons learned across suppliers.
* Supplier Scorecard (VS051 rating) and drive continuous improvement for supplier quality performance.

**Supplier APQP / PPAP & Safe Launch**

* Ensure on time and effective supplier APQP, PPAP, and Safe Launch for new programs, suppliers, and changes, including risk reviews, capability verification, and readiness-gap closure before production release.

**Quality Tools, Talent Development & Training**

* Set expectations for consistent SQE application of core quality tools, process audits, and structured problem solving to strengthen prevention and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Assess global SQ team capabilities and set development priorities with regional managers to strengthen technical expertise, expand skills, and build future leaders through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Supplier Quality talent review and succession plan.

**Regional Leadership: Engineering Quality & Operational Quality** (20% of role)

* Represent Quality Leadership team in regional activities across RDE, Manufacturing and Supplier Quality teams.
* Align regional priorities, governance, performance reviews, and escalations with global Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leaders and standards.
* Guide development and launch readiness, quality system execution, major issue resolution, and lessons learned while retaining local execution accountability.

**What you'll bring:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering.

**Experience:** Minimum 15 years in supplier quality, including supplier qualification, development, major issue resolution, and talent development. Electronics experience required; automotive SQ experience strongly preferred. Experience leading a multinational organization is preferred.

**Skills:**

* Global SQ leadership and effective matrix-team management.
* Cross-functional influence, supplier executive engagement, and timely decision-making.
* Strong supplier APQP, PPAP, change management, and Safe Launch knowledge.
* Advanced PFMEA, control plan, MSA, SPC, capability, audit, and 8D expertise; proven data-driven problem resolution and daily management.
* Strong commodity expertise for IC, PCB and/or mechanical parts is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Experience in other Quality domains is preferred

**Location:** Physical location Markham, Ontario, Canada or Southfield, Michigan; global scope across North America, Europe, India, and Asia.

**Travel:** International travel will be required 8-10 times per year.

**Reporting / Collaboration:**

* Reports to SVP Manufacturing & Quality.
* Solid-line responsibility for tech-center SQEs; dotted-line functional leadership of plant SQEs, with plant leadership retaining local operational accountability.
* Partners with Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, Industrialization, Program Management, and supplier leadership.

role.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
White Bear Lake, MN
 
 
**About Heraeus**
Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.
 
 
**About Heraeus Medevio**
Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.
 
 
To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
**What You’ll Do Every Day**

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
**Curious? Apply now!**
Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.
 
 
We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov
 
 
**Any further questions?**
If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

role.title: Director of Operations and Engineering
role.description:
**About SSI**
SS Industries is a Collegeville, PA-based manufacturer of premium Spiral and Floating Stairs. Stairs are designed and manufactured in-house using steel, aluminum, and wood, and shipped directly to customers across the U.S. and Canada. SSI is part of the MBP Group, a family of home-building products companies.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day engineering and manufacturing responsibilities at SSI. This person owns product design/execution, safety, quality, efficiency, on-time delivery, and cost. They build a strong team, keep production running smoothly through busy seasons, and drive continuous improvement.
 
 
In addition, the Director of Operations works with the SSI Leadership Team to develop and implement key company strategic efforts. They work cross-functionally with the other directors to ensure strong business performance.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead a strong safety culture where associates look out for each other and return to their homes safely.
* Own OSHA compliance, safety training, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Work with the Production Manager to ensure maximized capacity, labor, fabrication, welding, and powder coating to achieve communicated lead times, especially during peak seasons.
* Drive the Quality Team to reduce defects, rework, and customer complaints through root cause problem solving.
* Work with Customer Service and Engineering to resolve product issues quickly.
* Identify and lead projects that reduce waste and cost.
* Partner with the Purchasing Team to maintain appropriate inventory levels on raw materials like steel, aluminum, and wood to support production levels.
* Build and manage the Operations Annual Operating Plan and budget.
* Control labor, overtime, materials, and maintenance costs.
* Identify, recommend, and justify capital investments.
* Work closely with the President, Finance and the Commercial teams on forecasts, priorities, and customer commitments.
* Partner with Engineering and Marketing on the development and execution of new products and custom orders.
* Work closely with external vendors and partners to ensure consistent progress.
* Share best practices with operations leaders across the MBP Group.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in operations, with experience leading several departments, such as engineering, quality, production, or supply chain.
* 8+ years of manufacturing experience, with at least 5 years leading plant teams.
* Experience in metal fabrication, welding, or building products manufacturing.
* Strong track record improving safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Hands-on experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Proven ability to lead and develop supervisors and hourly teams, alike.
* Comfortable developing, reporting, presenting, and leading with data, KPIs, and budgets.
* Strong communication skills at every level of the organization (both internal and external).
* Can scale operations as the company grows.
* Onsite presence in Collegeville, PA

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with engineer-to-order fabrication (architectural metals, stairs and railings, millwork, structural steel or similar) and/or direct-to-consumer manufacturing.
* Has run a P&L or departmental budget and capital projects and has managed through supervisors and managers.
* Experience in a private equity-backed or multi-site company.
* Lean manufacturing experience (5S, value-stream mapping, kaizen). Lean or Six Sigma certification.
* Hands-on approach and comfortability on the shop floor.
* ERP or MRP system experience.
* OSHA 30 certification.

role.title: Director Operational Excellence Site Leader
role.description:
**Job Description**
**Honeywell Aerospace**
is a leading provider of innovative aerospace products and services. Our products and solutions are found on virtually every commercial, defense, and space aircraft in the world. We are committed to delivering cutting-edge technologies that enhance the safety, efficiency, and performance of the aerospace industry. Our aerospace business unit encompasses a wide range of products and services, including aircraft engines, cockpit and cabin electronics, wireless connectivity systems, mechanical components, and more. We are at the forefront of advancements in aviation technology, constantly pushing the boundaries to create healthier air travel, more fuel-efficient aircraft, and safer skies.
 
 
With our high-speed Wi-Fi offerings, we enable seamless connectivity for passengers and crew, enhancing the in-flight experience and enabling real-time data transmission. Our solutions also contribute to more direct and on-time flight arrivals, improving overall travel efficiency. In addition to our core products, we provide value-adding services such as maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) to ensure the continued reliability and performance of aerospace systems. Our facilities and expertise support the Federal government and agencies, further strengthening our position in the aerospace industry.
 
 
At Honeywell Aerospace, we are committed to sustainability and environmental responsibility. We strive to develop technologies that reduce emissions, improve fuel efficiency, and minimize the environmental impact of aviation. With revenues of $17.5 billion in 2025 and approximately 21,000 employees globally, we are a key player in the aerospace industry. Our dedicated team of professionals works tirelessly to introduce state-of-the-art technology solutions that drive efficiency, productivity, and safety in high-growth businesses.
 
 
As an
**Aerospace Operating System Site Leader**
here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will be a critical leader in the development and site-wide deployment for the Aerospace Operating System (AOS), driving the transformation of operational performance across the site or multi sites.
 
 
You will partner closely with Site Leader and AOS Global Operations Leader to establish the AOS roadmap, align strategic priorities, and enable scalable implementation across functions within the site including but not exclusive to planning, materials, sourcing, and quality.
 
 
As the key thought leader and change agent, this individual will coach leaders, drive method development and continuous improvement initiatives, and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes spanning procurement, planning, production, distribution, and logistics to support long-term growth, operational efficiency, and cultural transformation.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinates, prioritizes & organizes improvement events and AOS courses to create value for the unit
* Manages or leads relevant, strategic & operational business challenges
* Fosters a continuous improvement mindset with respective methods and tools
* Supports and/or orchestrates the Hoshin Kanri process for the site
* Supports and/or orchestrates productivity generation activities
* Coaches peers & key managers inside the unit on the promotion & use of AOS
* Acts as a thought leader for an Agile & Lean mindset
* Advances AOS through sharing of success stories & recognition of stakeholders
* Orchestrates, coaches & leads AOS community & key enablers
* Drives, motivates & manages AOS qualifications of employees
* Active member of the global, companywide AOS community
* Collaborate with the AOS office to execute the AOS strategy

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 8+ years of practical application of Lean Manufacturing and Operating Systems principles and tools
* 8+ years of project management experience gained through both strategic and tactic change projects
* Business fluent in local language and English
* Experience influencing and communicating effectively with frontline employees, site leadership, and senior executives, including leading cross-functional initiatives and presenting business outcomes to leadership teams.
* Ability to travel to other locations for training or project support (limited)

**WE VALUE**

* A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* A Master of Business Administration is a plus
* Experience in various areas of operations is strongly preferred, i.e. production, planning, procurement, logistics or similar
* Successful track record in leading without formal authority
* Proven experiences in driving results & coaching teams/peers across departments
* Experience in developing and sustaining networks / communities
* Leadership qualities & experience in motivating and developing diverse teams
* 8 Years of Practical experience facilitating improvement events
* Ability to Inspire & lead without authority
* Alignment to Honeywell Aerospace values, behaviors and principles, with experience and focus on customer outcomes, transformation, innovation, end-to-end ownership, and teamwork
* Ability to be an active listener and empathetic
* Experience convincing & pro-active change driver
* Passionate about learning Aerospace OS Core Methods and tools
* Results & quality orientation
* Methodical & structured way of thinking
* High analytical capability

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual agreements
 
 
**Benefits**
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
 
 

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
* Employee assistance program and educational assistance
* Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
* Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/
 
 
**POSTING TIMELINE**
The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

role.title: Director, Quality Control (QC) GMP Analytical
role.description:
Franklin Biolabs emerges from the esteemed legacy of Dr. Jim Wilson's laboratory, a beacon of innovation in vector technology for over three decades. Building on this rich heritage, Franklin Biolabs is poised to redefine the landscape of the global genetic medicines industry. As a Contract Research Organization (CRO), Franklin Biolabs offers a comprehensive suite of services spanning from discovery through clinical manufacturing. Our goal is to empower our partners by providing unparalleled solutions that drive the advancement of genetic medicines. Leveraging decades of expertise and a commitment to excellence, we bridge the gap between groundbreaking research and ensuring that transformative therapies reach those who need them most.

Franklin Biolabs is in search of a successful QC GMP Analytical Laboratory Director who combines deep scientific expertise with proven regulatory knowledge and business leadership. The individual is capable of managing complex GMP testing operations, leading regulatory inspections, driving continuous improvement initiatives, developing high-performing teams, and ensuring the delivery of accurate, reliable, and compliant analytical results that support product quality and patient safety.

The Director of QC GMP Analytical Laboratory is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and regulatory compliance of the Quality Control analytical testing laboratory supporting GMP manufacturing, product release, stability programs, method qualification/validation, and investigational/commercial products. This role ensures the generation of high-quality analytical data in compliance with FDA, EMA, ICH, USP, and applicable global regulatory requirements while maintaining inspection readiness and fostering a culture of quality, scientific excellence, and continuous improvement.

The Director provides leadership for laboratory personnel, oversees testing activities across multiple analytical platforms, manages laboratory budgets and resources, and serves as a key quality and technical representative during client interactions, regulatory inspections, and internal audits.

**Key Responsibilities**

Leadership & Laboratory Management

* Direct all QC analytical laboratory operations supporting GMP testing and product release.
* Develop and implement laboratory strategies aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and develop managers, scientists, analysts, and technical staff.
* Establish performance metrics and monitor laboratory productivity, turnaround times, and quality indicators.
* Build a culture focused on data integrity, compliance, quality, accountability, and scientific excellence.
* Manage staffing plans, succession planning, recruitment, and employee development.

GMP Compliance & Quality Systems

* Ensure laboratory activities comply with current GMP (cGMP), GLP where applicable, and data integrity requirements.
* Maintain inspection readiness for regulatory agencies and client audits.
* Lead investigations involving OOS, OOT, laboratory deviations, CAPAs, and change controls.
* Review and approve analytical reports, protocols, investigations, and technical documents.
* Ensure compliance with ALCOA+ principles for data integrity.
* Support responses to regulatory observations and inspection findings.

Analytical Testing Oversight

* Provide scientific and technical oversight for:
 + Chromatography (HPLC, UPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC)
 + Molecular assays (qPCR, ddPCR, NGS)
 + Cell-based assays and potency testing
 + Immunological assays (ELISA, MSD, flow cytometry)
 + Biophysical characterization methods
 - * Protein and peptide characterization
 * Stability studies
 * Environmental monitoring and raw material testing (as applicable)
 - Review analytical trends and implement corrective actions when necessary.
 - Oversee transfer, qualification, and validation of analytical methods.
 - Ensure timely completion of release and stability testing.
 + Regulatory & Inspection Support

 - Act as laboratory representative during:
 * FDA inspections
 * EMA inspections
 * Client audits
 * Internal quality audits
 * Accreditation assessments
 - Ensure laboratory documentation meets regulatory expectations.
 - Maintain awareness of evolving regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
 + Method Validation & Technical Excellence

 - Oversee method development, qualification, transfer, and validation activities.
 - Review protocols and reports for compliance with ICH and regulatory guidance.
 - Drive implementation of new technologies and analytical platforms.
 - Support technical troubleshooting and complex root cause investigations.
 + Operational Excellence

 - Develop and manage laboratory budgets and capital expenditures.
 - Ensure appropriate maintenance, qualification, and calibration of laboratory equipment.
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, compliance, and quality.
 - Monitor laboratory KPIs, including:
 * Right-first-time performance
 * Deviation rates
 * CAPA effectiveness
 * Turnaround times
 * Instrument utilization
 * Training compliance
 + Client & Cross-Functional Support

 - Serve as a primary technical contact for clients and stakeholders.
 - Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Process Development, and Project Management teams.
 - Support proposal development, technical assessments, and business development opportunities.
 - Present laboratory performance metrics and technical data to senior leadership and clients.

**Education and Experience**

* Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related scientific discipline preferred.
* Master's degree with significant industry experience may be considered.
* Bachelor's degree with extensive leadership experience in GMP analytical laboratories may be considered.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in GMP analytical testing.
* 5+ years in laboratory leadership or management roles.
* Experience supporting biologics, cell and gene therapy, vaccines, nucleic acid therapeutics, or pharmaceutical products.
* Demonstrated experience managing regulatory inspections and client audits.
* Experience leading method validation, qualification, and laboratory investigations.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of:
 + GMP regulations
 + FDA and EMA expectations
 + ICH guidelines
 + USP requirements
 + Data integrity regulations
 + Analytical method lifecycle management
* Expertise with one or more of the following:
 + LC-MS/MS
 + HPLC/UPLC
 + qPCR/ddPCR
 + Flow Cytometry
 + ELISA/MSD
 + Cell-based potency assays
 + Protein analytical characterization

Leadership Competencies

* Strategic thinking
* People development
* Regulatory decision-making
* Risk management
* Scientific problem solving
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Client relationship management
* Operational excellence
* Change leadership
* Continuous improvement mindset

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* GMP compliance and inspection readiness
* On-time product release testing
* Investigation closure timelines
* CAPA effectiveness
* Laboratory utilization and efficiency
* Staff engagement and retention
* Client satisfaction
* Budget performance
* Method validation success rate
* Data integrity compliance metrics

**On-Site**

* This position requires full-time on-site presence at our Discovery Labs location.

**Immunizations and Screenings**

* This position requires access to lab spaces.

**Essential Status**

* Not Applicable: The employee is not required to go on-site to perform their job functions during company closure.

**Vision**

* Ability to distinguish between different colors (normal color vision).
* Ability to see clearly at various distances.
* Adequate near vision for reading documents or lab equipment.
* Ability to focus and maintain concentration in tasks for extended periods.
* Ability to work in environments with varying light conditions.

**Company Benefits**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) Matching
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account
* Paid Time-Off
* Company Paid Holidays
* Personal Floating Holidays
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
* Life and AD&D insurance (Group & Voluntary)

role.title: Quality Improv Director
role.description:
***POSITION PURPOSE:***

The Director of Quality Improvement operates under the leadership and direction of the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) and Chief Operating Officer (COO). The CMO maintains direct clinical oversight of clinical quality improvement activities and regulatory quality programs. The Director of Quality Improvement provides organization-wide leadership for EVCHC's quality improvement program. The Director establishes the quality strategy in partnership with executive, clinical, operational and compliance leaders; converts organizational goals and regulatory requirements into measurable work plans; and leads improvement efforts that strengthen patient outcomes, safety, access, equity and care experience. The Director is accountable for reliable quality data, required clinical quality reporting, continuous improvement methods, Patient Centered Medical Home recognition, and the performance of the Quality Improvement Department.

 

***MAJOR POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS:***

**Quality Strategy and Governance**

* Lead the development, implementation and annual evaluation of EVCHC's organization-wide Quality Improvement and Quality Assurance Plan in alignment with the strategic plan, clinical standards and applicable Health Center Program requirements.

* Establish annual quality priorities, measures, targets, owners and timelines with executive and clinical leadership. Monitor progress and recommend corrective action when performance does not meet established goals.

* Lead or support the Quality Improvement Committee and related workgroups. Prepare agendas, dashboards, meeting materials, decisions and follow-up reports for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, as requested.

* Advise executive leaders on emerging quality risks, performance trends, resource needs and opportunities to improve care delivery across sites and service lines.

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, patient safety and learning throughout the organization.

**Department Leadership**

* Direct the work of the Quality Improvement Department, including recruitment, onboarding, supervision, coaching, performance evaluation, workload assignment and staff development.

* Develop departmental goals, staffing plans, procedures and budgets that support timely completion of quality priorities and reporting obligations.

* Set clear expectations for the accuracy, timeliness and usability of analyses, audits, reports and improvement support provided by the department.

* Build effective working relationships with clinical care teams, Operations, Information Technology, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, Behavioral Health, Dental and other departments involved in quality outcomes.

**Quality Measurement and Reporting**

* Oversee the collection, validation, analysis and submission of clinical quality measures and required reports, including Uniform Data System measures, population health platforms transition and readiness, HEDIS and payer measures, grant measures and internal quality indicators.

* Develop and maintain executive, provider, site and service-line dashboards that show current performance, trends, disparities, targets and improvement actions.

* Track provider and care-team performance, identify variation and care gaps, and provide leaders with actionable information while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data-use standards.

* Establish data-validation controls and documentation so that quality reports can be reconciled to source systems and used as an organization-wide source of truth. Partnering with Director of Data and IT operations for oversight on data governance committee.

* Present quality findings in clear written and verbal reports to the Board, executive leadership, managers, providers, staff, health plans and external reviewers, as appropriate.

**Performance Improvement**

* Lead Plan Do Study Act cycles, root-cause analyses and other structured improvement methods from problem definition through implementation, evaluation and sustainment.

* Partner with clinical and operational leaders to improve preventive care, chronic disease outcomes, access, continuity, patient experience, care coordination, documentation and other priority measures.
