role.title: Director of Operations / Master Orchestrator Wanted
role.description:
**The Director of Operations/Master Orchestrator** we want on our Pro Roofers Dream Team is someone who thrives on turning all the moving parts into a well-oiled machine! You are a natural leader who sees the big picture without ever losing sight of the details. Where others see obstacles, you see solutions. Where others see disorganization, you see an opportunity to build a better system.

You get a genuine sense of satisfaction from watching a team operate at its best because you've put the right people, processes, and expectations in place. You love numbers because they tell a story, and you know how to use that story to make things better. You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves, tackle a problem head-on, or have the tough conversations that keep everyone moving forward.

You're organized without being rigid and driven without losing your good nature. You know how to bring out the best in people while holding them accountable for results. You're a builder of systems, a solver of problems, and a master of follow-through. Most importantly, you take genuine pride in creating an operation that runs smoothly, profitably, and with excellence.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

* Be the driving force behind the day-to-day operations of Pro Roofers, ensuring everything runs efficiently from signed contract to completed project and final payment.
* Lead, support, and hold production teams accountable for completing jobs on time, within budget, and to our high standards of quality.
* Masterfully coordinate scheduling, material ordering, production, quality control, and billing to keep every job moving forward.
* Develop and maintain quality control processes that ensure exceptional workmanship and customer satisfaction.
* Keep a watchful eye on the production pipeline, anticipating problems and removing bottlenecks before they become costly.
* Track job costs, profit margins, and operational performance. You know your numbers and use them to make smart decisions!
* Create and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) that keep the team focused on measurable results.
* Keep our CRM accurate, organized, and functioning as a valuable management tool.
* Lead productive team meetings and individual check-ins that create clarity, accountability, and momentum.
* Build, document, and continually improve systems that make our operations more efficient and scalable.
* Embrace technology, software, and AI tools to simplify processes and help our team work smarter.
* Partner with our sales leadership to ensure a seamless transition from the sale to successful project completion.
* Cultivate a team environment built on trust, excellence, personal responsibility, and a shared commitment to success.

Qualifications

* Proven experience managing operations in the roofing or solar industry.
* A natural ability to lead people, build strong relationships, and inspire accountability.
* Exceptional organizational skills with an almost instinctive ability to identify what needs attention.
* A strong understanding of job costing, profit margins, budgets, and operational performance metrics.
* A numbers-driven mindset. You appreciate accurate data and know how to turn it into actionable improvements.
* Experience implementing and improving operational systems and procedures.
* Confidence working with CRM systems and business management software.
* An appreciation for emerging technology, including AI, and its ability to improve business efficiency.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to navigate challenging conversations with professionalism.
* A commitment to quality, consistency, and doing things right the first time.
* A proactive, solution-oriented attitude. You don't wait for someone else to fix a problem. You take ownership and get it done!
* Willingness to work long hours during the busy season.
* Agility to climb on a roof and walk the ridge.

Job Details

Position: Director of Operations

Location: Kansas City Area (On-site and in the field)

Job Type: Full-time

Compensation: 90, 000–130,000 annually, depending on experience

Competitive Compensation and Other Perks

A competitive salary that recognizes the value of your experience and leadership.

A positive, uplifting work environment focused on trust, service, excellence, teamwork, and growth.

A meaningful leadership position where your ideas, decisions, and contributions directly impact the company's success.

The opportunity to build and shape systems that support a growing and successful business.

The satisfaction of working alongside a motivated sales leader who values your operational expertise and trusts you to lead.

Professional growth opportunities as you help take Pro Roofers to the next level.

About Pro Roofers

The team at Pro Roofers brings over 20 years of residential and commercial roofing experience to the Kansas City area. We have built our reputation by delivering on our promises, doing quality work, and treating our customers and their homes with the care and respect they deserve. We have over 500 five star reviews and have earned every one of them by adhering to excellence.

At Pro Roofers, we believe that exceptional results come from exceptional people working together toward a common goal. We are guided by the principles of trust, growth, excellence, teamwork, and service.

We also understand the value of your home life and your work life, and we seek to enhance both. As part of the Pro Roofers Dream Team, your leadership will matter and your contributions will make a difference.

We're not just looking for someone to manage operations. We're looking for someone who will take ownership, build something exceptional, and take pride in the success of the entire team.

Ready to Work Your Magic? If you're the kind of leader who gets excited about building great systems, developing great people, and turning operational challenges into measurable success, we want to meet you!

To Apply: Send your resume along with a short note describing an operational process you built or improved, and the results it produced.

We can't wait to meet the next Master Orchestrator of our Pro Roofers Dream Team!

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $90,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Experience:

* Operations Coordination: 3 years (Preferred)
* Roofing: 1 year (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Blue Springs, MO 64015 (Preferred)

Ability to Relocate:

* Blue Springs, MO 64015: Relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

role.title: Director of Brokerage Operations
role.description:
**Make your next move an expert one.**

At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.

**Why Colliers?**

Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.

***\*\*this is an on-site opportunity based out of our Atlanta, GA office\* \****

 

**About the role**

The Director, Brokerage Operations will lead the effective and consistent delivery of operational excellence across the office and serve as the local integrator for the business. The role will lead through influence across a matrixed organization, coordinating local, regional and national resources to achieve business objectives around producers and the point of sale, regardless of reporting structure. The Director will oversee the day-to-day operating and administrative requirements for local business lines while maintaining clear accountability for outcomes.

As a key member of the local leadership team, the Director will organize enablement around winning business, recruiting, retention and producer effectiveness. The role will use the broader Colliers platform aggressively where it can deliver work better or more efficiently, while ensuring strong local execution and continuous improvement in service delivery.

 

**In this position, you will..**

* Lead and manage operations support employees across departments, ensuring service excellence, efficient delivery, clear accountability and continuous improvement in all service areas.
* Lead adoption of enterprise technology platforms, automation initiatives and process improvements to drive scalability, producer efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Bring strong operating and financial rigor to the business in collaboration with the local Managing Director, including P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, capital planning, financial analysis and resource allocation. Partner with Finance on transactional processes without making transactional Finance the center of the role.
* Serve as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director, supporting office revenue growth through producer recruiting, onboarding and integration, retention, producer productivity and pursuit conversion. Coordinate supporting resources and deliverables, including pitch books, recruiting materials and meeting preparation.
* Maintain an effective audit process to ensure local revenue recognition and other key controls are followed in accordance with company and GAAP guidelines.

* Partner with the local Managing Director on annual business planning, growth and market expansion, workforce planning and execution of strategic priorities, translating priorities into recommendations and action while ensuring corporate policies and procedures are followed.

* Operate proactively and decisively across a matrix, resolving issues at the appropriate level and making difficult calls rather than routinely pushing decisions upward.
* Integrate local, regional and national resources, including Client Services, analysts, People Services, Marketing, Research, IT, Operations and Finance, around producers and the point of sale. Leverage the broader Colliers platform for better, more efficient delivery while retaining clear local accountability.
* Responsible for partnering with corporate Human Resources on implementing Human Resources activities for all personnel including recruitment, selection, orientation, training, and performance management of the brokerage support team.
* Manage the administration and submission to People Services and/or Commission Payroll of all documentation for new and departing employees.
* Ensure effective workplace operations, facilities management and business continuity through appropriate delegation, vendor management and operational oversight.
* Conduct vendor product reviews and formulates expense approval decisions within the framework of corporate policies.
* Partner with Marketing on local business promotion and publicity activities, with Marketing retaining functional ownership, and oversee local office awards and recognition programs.
* Act as change and culture agent, supporting the vision and direction for the operations team by implementing new policies and procedures directed at continuous improvement and service excellence.
Other duties as required. 

 

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) and 10+ years of progressive operational, commercial or business leadership experience in commercial real estate, professional services or a similarly decentralized business, with responsibility for business planning, financial performance, talent leadership and growth strategies.
* Proven track record leading operational transformation, process improvement, change management and service delivery initiatives across multiple functions.
* Knowledge of and adherence to Sarbanes-Oxley requirements and all company policies and procedures.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen in budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, business cases, performance measurement and P&L management; understands relevant economic indicators.
* Displays service excellence in dealing with internal and external clients and partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed environment, aligning local, regional and corporate stakeholders to deliver business outcomes. Proactive and decisive, with the ability to recommend, resolve issues and make difficult decisions.
* Excellent communication, organizational and prioritization skills.
* Strong aptitude for leveraging technology, automation, reporting tools, data analytics and scalable systems and processes to improve operational performance and business outcomes.
* Able to work under pressure, deal with multiple deadlines, effectively handle stressful situations and work with minimal direction/supervision.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, composure, adaptability, accountability and resilience; builds trust across diverse teams and is effective in navigating challenging situations and strong personalities.
Strong focus on business partnership and high degree of discretion and confidentiality.

*Area/Location Specific: Atlanta, GA*

*Approximate Compensation Range for this Role: up to $195,000 per annum*

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all national* *locations. role.title: Director of Branch Operations
role.description:
**Eagle Title | Annapolis, MD**

**Reports To:** President

**Compensation Range:** Compensation is a combination of base salary plus performance-based commission tied to profitability and revenue growth across the branches.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Eagle Title is looking for a Director of Branch Operations to lead the profitability, growth, and operational excellence of Eagle Title branches (including Commercial and Builder Services Divisions).

Reporting directly to the President, this is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong business acumen, operational expertise, and a proven ability to develop high-performing leaders. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, holds branch managers accountable for growing their businesses, and builds the strategies, systems, and relationships needed for long-term success.

The right person understands that strong financial performance starts with strong leadership, clear expectations, efficient operations, and exceptional client service.

**WHAT YOU'LL LEAD**

**Branch Profitability & Growth**

* Own the profit and loss (P&L) performance of all branches, driving profitability, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
* Establish financial goals, growth expectations, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each branch.
* Hold branch managers accountable for executing strategies that grow the business, strengthen referral relationships, and achieve revenue targets.
* Regularly review branch financial and operational performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategies that deliver measurable results.

**Branch Operations & Strategy**

* Provide strategic and operational oversight of branches, ensuring consistency, accountability, efficiency, and exceptional client service.
* Support branch managers in overseeing day-to-day operations, resolving challenges, and maintaining effective workflows.
* Develop and execute branch strategies that align with Eagle Title's financial goals and long-term business objectives.
* Establish standardized processes, performance expectations, and operational best practices across locations.
* Leverage technology, data, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen efficiency, quality, and scalability.

**Leadership & Accountability**

* Lead, coach, and develop branch managers through clear expectations, regular performance discussions, measurable goals, and consistent accountability.
* Establish and monitor branch manager scorecards that track financial performance, business development activity, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction.
* Partner with Human Resources to support staffing, training, performance management, and leadership development.
* Empower branch managers to take ownership of their teams, business development efforts, and overall branch performance.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

**Collaboration & Business Performance**

* Serve as a strategic business partner to Underwriting, Post-Closing, Marketing and other operational departments to strengthen workflows, resolve challenges, and deliver exceptional client experience.
* Collaborate with the President and Sales leadership to align branch growth strategies with overall company objectives.
* Identify and address operational challenges affecting transaction quality, turnaround times, profitability, and client satisfaction.
* Strengthen communication and collaboration across departments to support successful transactions and organizational growth.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven leadership experience overseeing multiple branches, locations, or business units with responsibility for financial and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, budgeting, financial analysis, and revenue growth strategies.
* Demonstrated success driving profitability, operational efficiency, and measurable business results.
* Experience coaching, developing, and holding managers accountable for business growth and operational performance.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into actionable plans.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Experience developing and monitoring KPIs, scorecards, and operational performance metrics.
* Ability to balance financial performance, operational priorities, employee development, and exceptional client service.
* Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and leadership levels.
* Experience in title insurance, real estate settlement, or a related industry strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Experience with title production technology, including Qualia, preferred.

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Fresh & Ready Foods** is seeking a strategic and hands-on **Operations Director** to lead our Longview, TX manufacturing facility. As the site leader, this role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of production, food safety, quality, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution while driving operational excellence and developing high-performing teams.

Reporting to the Regional Director, the Operations Director will be accountable for achieving safety, quality, service, inventory, and financial objectives while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement. This highly visible leadership role requires a strong manufacturing background, a passion for people development, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced food production environment.

#### 

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership for plant operations, including production, quality, food safety, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution.
* Lead and develop managers, supervisors, and frontline teams to create a strong culture of accountability, engagement, and performance.
* Champion safety, regulatory compliance, and food safety programs, including SQF, HACCP, sanitation, and audit readiness.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimize plant performance.
* Establish and manage KPIs related to safety, quality, labor, yield, inventory, customer service, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support customer growth, new product introductions, and operational initiatives.
* Manage budgets, labor costs, inventory levels, and operational expenses to achieve financial objectives.
* Maintain a visible presence on the production floor, coaching leaders and supporting problem-solving efforts.
* Build succession plans and develop future leaders within the organization.
* Foster a culture focused on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

#### 

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, Food Science, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing, beverage manufacturing, CPG, protein processing, bakery, prepared foods, or related manufacturing environments.
* Experience managing large production teams through multiple levels of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, TPS, or similar methodologies.
* Proven track record improving safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance.
* Experience with SQF, HACCP, FDA/USDA regulations, sanitation programs, and quality systems.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, labor management, inventory control, and operational reporting.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

#### 

#### **Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a visible, people-focused manufacturing leader who enjoys building teams, developing talent, and driving operational results. They possess strong food manufacturing experience, a continuous improvement mindset, and a proven ability to lead large-scale operations while improving safety, quality, service, and profitability. Experience in high-volume food production environments is strongly preferred.

**Full-time and part-time positions offer the following benefits** to associates: Retirement Plan, Associate Shopping Program, Health and Wellness Programs, Discount Marketplace, Identity Theft Protection, Pet Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, including Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Legal Services, and Choice Auto and Home Program

role.description:
**Leading the Change in Youth Development**

At Boys & Girls Clubs of King County, we are taking youth programming to a new level. We are one of the largest Club organizations in the country, and we pride ourselves on always doing what is best for youth. As leaders in youth development, we provide a safe place for kids and teens during critical out-of-school time that is affordable for all families. Our Clubs offer life-changing programs and services to youth in greater Seattle. We prioritize a youth-centric Club experience through culturally relevant, inclusive, and diverse programming delivered by individuals committed to serving youth.

Our organization values advancing racial equity, creating safe spaces, encouraging collaboration and accountability, and seeking transparent and authentic communication. If you are passionate about youth development, love to connect with people, have a proven track record of results with youth, and want to be part of an extraordinary team, Boys & Girls Clubs of King County is right for you!!

**Opportunity Overview: CLUB OPERATIONS DIRECTOR**

Deliver excellence through leading a single or multiple Club responsibility ensuring the highest quality programs, services delivery and safe, healthy facilities for its members, employees, and the community. Recruit, coach and inspire employees to deliver a culturally relevant Club(s) Experience through diverse, inclusive programming. Achieve continuous improvement in program quality, facilities and operations and all expected metrics. Prepare, manage and achieve the Club(s) operating budget. Oversee the day-to-day management of the Club(s); its programs, employees and facilities. Participate with Club Advisory Boards and develop appropriate community engagement. Lead work with the Area Director, Club Service Center, and other Club Operations to maximize program capacities, Adelante Initiatives, to increase ADA and ensure that all safety policies are being followed.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Inspire and develop employees to live the mission, vision and values of the organization while delivering an outcome-driven club experience for youth and families. Encourage advancement of employees throughout the county to achieve larger roles and responsibilities and ability to increase compensation.
* Ensure all employees including the Operations Director, have continuous relevant trainings and expertise in all safety protocols/expectations, Race, Equity and Inclusion, exposure to all county and BGCA trainings, Affinity Groups and workshops. Inspire youth and employee voices continuously.
* Multiple Club responsibility to include one or more Licensed Childcare operations. Lead, coach and ensure all licensed program rules if applicable, protocols and expectations are being followed by directors and YDPs. Track STARS trainings/Merit Audits and annual renewals. Develop strong relationships with state and city licensors.
* Ensure that each Club provides the Support Protocol training and expectations; pertinent registration details to be updated in youth files, update of monthly meetings, providing extra support for parent meetings.
* Develop and advance strong relationships between school districts and other local community-based organizations.
* Ensure all registration processes and management of accounts are accurate and updated monthly. Lower A/Rs continuously and review results monthly with Area Director. Review and make sure that all county and BGCA measurement of metrics are consistently accurate.
* Achieve maximum capacity in all programs including elementary, teen, athletics. Lead Reach More Youth in area of responsibility. Always looking to serve more youth especially those that need us most. Lead RFP process for new Clubs.
* Achieve continuous improvement in all BGCA, state and local program measurements.
* Work with directors to achieve continuous improvement in quality of programs utilizing all relevant support.
* Provide continuous involvement in achieving financial health of each Club: efficient spending, achieve BVA goals, looking for better operational ways to achieve results.
* Ensure that physical Club is safe and healthy at all times and that appropriate maintenance is completed timely and efficient as well as large projects are communicated in a timely manner to Area Director. Create high standards for the common areas and outside of the Club. Work closely with vendors to make sure they are providing expected services in timely manner. Review all invoices for accuracy and timely payment.
* Work collaboratively with Chief Development Officer (CDO), Resource Development Team, and Area Director in fund development efforts. Support role in community centric fundraising. Work with Club Directors to develop Club Advisory Board and community partnerships.
* Report timely outcomes and utilize data to make changes that improve the outcome driven club experience.
* Enhance good public relations including speaking and presenting in public forums, building and sustaining partnerships with parents and families, stakeholders, community agencies and partners.
* Collaborate with council, committees, partner agencies and all stakeholders.
* Through effective delegation and oversight, assure effective administrative functions including data management, financial and bookkeeping files, personnel files, metric recording and reporting, and background checks.
* Maintain close, daily contact with Club staff (professional and volunteer), Club members to receive/provide information, discuss issues, explain or interpret guidelines/instructions; instruct, and advise/counsel, collaborate and partner on appropriate committees and task forces.
* Maintain close contact and work collaboratively with Area Directors, Area Director Program or Operations Leads and other Club Directors and peers.

**Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred in related field from an accredited college or university, and/or five (5) years applicable experience, preferably in Human Services, Non-Profit Management, or Public Administration.
* At least 2 years of direct management experience in a youth development setting with ability to successfully train and develop staff and volunteers.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to manage databases, collection information and pull accurate reports. (MyClubHub)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, professional presence, and strong customer service skills with the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
* Ability to support fundraising efforts of the organization.
* Knowledge of budget preparation, control, and management.
* Ability to implement, train and support youth discipline techniques through organizational youth development philosophy.

role.title: Regional Director of Operations
role.description:
Coordinated Services Management (CSM) is an established senior living management company serving nonprofit and mission-driven organizations throughout Virginia. We are seeking an experienced Regional Director of Operations to provide leadership, guidance, and operational oversight for assigned skilled nursing, assisted living and memory care communities in Virginia. This position is based in Roanoke and requires regular travel to assigned communities.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, results-oriented leader with strong operational and financial management skills, sound clinical knowledge, and a commitment to quality resident care and services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, coaching, and operational oversight to community Executive Directors and leadership teams.
* Drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, quality of care, resident satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Monitor occupancy, marketing effectiveness, staffing, budgets, and financial results, identifying opportunities for improvement and growth.
* Partner with community leadership and home office team to address operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Support leadership development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Guide strategic planning, capital improvements, and effective stewardship of community resources.
* Collaborate with nonprofit ownership Boards, presenting operational results, financial performance, budgets, and strategic recommendations.
* Support the mission, values, and long-term success of each community and its nonprofit ownership.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field.
* Licensed Nursing Home Administrator with a minimum of three years of Executive Director experience.
* Strong understanding of senior living operations, regulatory compliance, and resident care practices; clinical experience is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated success in leadership development, financial management, and operational improvement.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Multi-community leadership experience and experience with nonprofit organizations preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to travel throughout Virginia, including occasional overnight travel.

**Compensation**

Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Join CSM and make a meaningful difference in the lives of seniors while supporting the success of mission-driven communities.**

Coordinated Services Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pay: From $145,000.00 per year

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid orientation
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

* Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (Required)

role.title: Senior V-BAT Air Vehicle Operator, Deployed Operations Site Lead
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

The Senior Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) – Deployment Operations is responsible for executing and leading V-BAT flight operations in support of DoD and foreign customers in both land-based and maritime OCONUS environments. This is an operationally focused role requiring strong aviation judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to lead small teams in austere and high-visibility conditions. 

 

The Senior AVO is responsible for leading mission planning activities, performing comprehensive risk assessments, delivering pre-mission briefings, executing flight operations, and conducting structured post-flight debriefs. This role includes conducting Functional Check Flights (FCFs) and system validation as required, ensuring aircraft configuration control and logbook accuracy, coordinating with maintenance to sustain fleet readiness, and supporting overall operational discipline. The Senior AVO will mentor junior operators, serve as the on-site operational representative to customers, and travel extensively in support of deployments. 

 

This is not an entry-level flight operations role. The ideal candidate brings strong aviation fundamentals, disciplined cockpit habits, and mature operational decision-making. They must be comfortable leading deployments, briefing customers, managing risk in dynamic environments, and maintaining professionalism in high-visibility settings. The Senior AVO must balance mission execution with customer satisfaction while upholding the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence. 

Required Qualifications:

 - Minimum of 2000 documented unmanned flight hours or 1000 manned flight hours 

 - Demonstrated instructor experience (manned or unmanned aviation)  

 - FAA Private Pilot License (PPL)  

 - FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and hold a Secret DoD security clearance 

 - Ability to pass background, drug screening, and customer-required medical/dental screenings 

 - Willingness to travel up to 50–75% in support of deployments 

 - Ability to lead and operate independently in small teams under austere conditions 

 - Strong aviation judgment, decision-making, and risk management skills 

Preferred Qualifications

 - FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot License  

 - Experience operating as aircrew on manned aircraft  

 - Prior military service, particularly with overseas or deployed operations  

 - Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience  

 - Previous experience as a Site Lead or in a leadership role overseeing aviation operations

#LD

We are seeking a Director, Operations Analysis to lead a team responsible for turning operational problems into quantitative insights that shape product strategy, engineering priorities, customer engagement, and mission outcomes. This leader will manage and grow a high-performing Operations Analysis team that uses modeling, simulation, wargaming, campaign analysis, and mission-level trade studies to help determine what Hivemind should build, why it matters, and how it performs in realistic operational contexts.

This is a leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of autonomy, military operations, mission engineering, modeling and simulation, product strategy, and customer-facing analysis. The right candidate will be technically credible, analytically rigorous, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to translate complex operational questions into clear recommendations for executives, engineers, business development leaders, and government customers.

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead and manage the Hivemind Solutions Operations Analysis team, including hiring, mentoring, prioritization, performance management, and technical direction.

 - Build an operations analysis capability that directly informs Hivemind product strategy, autonomy roadmap decisions, customer pursuits, and program execution.

 - Define and execute mission analysis, campaign analysis, force-on-force studies, CONOPS evaluations, and operational trade studies across multiple Hivemind product domains.

 - Partner with Product, Architecture, Systems Engineering, Business Development, Strategy, and Program teams to translate operational problems into analytical studies and actionable product recommendations.

 - Develop analysis plans that connect mission objectives, operational assumptions, threat environments, system performance, autonomy behaviors, and measurable mission outcomes.

 - Guide the use of tools such as AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, custom simulations, and other modeling environments to evaluate mission effectiveness and operational value.

 - Establish standards for analytical rigor, model credibility, assumption tracking, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty characterization, and communication of results.

 - Create clear, executive-ready briefings that explain what was analyzed, what assumptions were made, what the results mean, and what decisions should follow.

 - Support customer engagements by developing compelling, technically grounded analysis that demonstrates the operational value of Hivemind-enabled systems.

 - Work with engineering teams to identify the autonomy behaviors, system capabilities, interfaces, performance parameters, and test data needed to improve model fidelity.

 - Help shape product requirements by connecting operational outcomes to measurable system and autonomy performance needs.

 - Build reusable analysis frameworks, scenarios, vignettes, and metrics that can scale across programs and domains.

 - Represent the Operations Analysis function in internal technical reviews, roadmap discussions, capture strategy sessions, and customer-facing meetings.

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, computer science, physics, aerospace, systems engineering, data science, or a related technical field.

 - 10+ years of relevant experience in operations analysis, mission analysis, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, military analysis, campaign analysis, or related technical domains.

 - 5+ years of experience leading teams, projects, or technical analysis efforts.

 - Experience using modeling and simulation to inform real product, system, program, or operational decisions.

 - Strong understanding of military operations, mission planning, force employment, kill chains, sensing, communications, autonomy, aircraft systems, weapons systems, or related defense concepts.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous operational questions into structured analysis plans, quantitative methods, and decision-quality outputs.

 - Experience working with engineering, product, business development, strategy, or customer-facing teams.

 - Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and customers with clarity, confidence, and analytical discipline.

 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and analysis must support real business and technical decisions.

 - U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Master’s degree or PhD in operations research, engineering, applied mathematics, data science, aerospace, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Experience with AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, Cameo, custom simulation environments, or other mission and campaign analysis tools.

 - Experience analyzing autonomous systems, collaborative autonomy, uncrewed aircraft, crewed-uncrewed teaming, electronic warfare, space systems, missile systems, maritime systems, or air combat operations.

 - Experience supporting defense product development, advanced concepts, government capture efforts, experimentation, test planning, or mission engineering.

 - Familiarity with model validation, verification, credibility assessment, sensitivity analysis, design of experiments, and uncertainty quantification.

 - Experience building analysis teams, establishing technical standards, and scaling analytical capabilities across multiple stakeholders or product lines.

 - Prior military, government laboratory, FFRDC/UARC, defense contractor, or aerospace experience.

 - Active U.S. security clearance.

What success looks like:

 - In this role, success means the Operations Analysis team becomes a trusted decision engine for Hivemind Solutions. The team’s work should not sit on a shelf. It should shape what we build, how we prioritize, how we explain operational value to customers, and how we make hard trade decisions across product lines.
 
 A successful manager will build a team that is technically rigorous, operationally grounded, fast-moving, and deeply connected to the business. They will ensure that analysis is not treated as an after-the-fact briefing function, but as a core part of product development, strategy, and customer engagement.

Why this role matters:

 - Autonomy changes what is operationally possible, but only if we understand where it creates real mission advantage. The Operations Analysis team helps answer that question. This team connects Hivemind’s technical capabilities to measurable operational outcomes, helping Shield AI make better product decisions and helping customers understand the mission impact of intelligent autonomous systems.
 
 If you want to lead a team that sits at the center of autonomy, strategy, engineering, and operational decision-making, this role is for you.

role.title: Director of Product Development & Industrialization
role.description:
At Horizon Hobby, we inspire dreams and help build memories! Our company is the leader in the global Radio Control industry, celebrating 40 years in 2025! We offer tremendous opportunities for growth and development and a full array of benefits including discounts on our products! We are currently hiring for a Director of Product Development and Industrialization at our Pro-Line office in Banning CA!
 
 
*This is a full time, on-site position at our Pro-Line facility in Banning California. Workings hours will be Monday-Friday 8am-5pm PST.*
**Typical pay for this position is $105,000-$125,000. The final offer for this position will be based on the unique experience and qualifications of the candidate selected. This position may also be eligible for a bonus not included in the base pay range.**
The Director of Product Development & Industrialization will provide strategic leadership for the development, commercialization, and industrialization of proprietary hobby products from concept through production. This role will be leading our Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization resources while overseeing the systems, processes, tooling, molds, manufacturing equipment, and technical capabilities required to deliver innovative, high-quality products to market.
 
 
This role will partner closely with Brand, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Tooling, and external partners to identify market opportunities, translate customer needs into successful products, and ensure products are designed, developed, and launched efficiently. The role balances technical excellence with business performance, ensuring product investments align with growth objectives, customer demand, profitability targets, and long-term strategic priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Innovation & Strategy
 
 

* Partner with Brand and cross-functional teams to define product roadmaps, priorities, resources, and timelines.
* Drive innovation and development investments that strengthen market position, customer satisfaction, growth, and return on investment.
* Identify and prioritize new product opportunities using customer insight, competitive analysis, market trends, and commercial potential.

Product Development Leadership
 
 

* Lead and develop Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization teams supporting proprietary products.
* Own product development from concept and engineering through validation, launch, and lifecycle management.
* Strengthen quality, scalability, execution, and organizational capability through standards, coaching, succession planning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Business & Commercial Leadership
 
 

* Monitor portfolio performance and align cross-functional priorities to achieve revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
* Contribute to portfolio planning, market expansion, long-range growth, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Provide senior leadership with business reviews, development updates, performance metrics, and recommendations.

Industrialization & Manufacturing Readiness
 
 

* Lead new-product industrialization from concept through launch, applying DFM and DFA to optimize quality, scalability, cost, and manufacturing readiness.
* Partner across Engineering, Manufacturing, Tool Room, suppliers, and development teams to resolve challenges and improve processes, tooling, and capacity.
* Track launch, readiness, quality, and productivity performance to drive continuous improvement.

Tooling, Equipment & Technology
 
 

* Define requirements and roadmaps for molds, tooling, fixtures, machinery, automation, and manufacturing technology.
* Lead capital planning and business cases that improve capability, productivity, quality, cost, and return on investment.
* Manage external tooling and manufacturing partners, strengthen internal capabilities, and maintain effective engineering data and technical documentation processes.

Supplier & Partner Management
 
 

* Build strategic relationships with domestic and international manufacturing, tooling, engineering, and supplier partners.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities and performance to improve quality, speed, cost competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.

*Success in this role requires strong leadership across innovation, engineering, manufacturing, and business functions to continuously improve speed to market, product quality, operational performance, and return on investment*
**Required**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in product management, category management, business management, product development, or a related leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience leading and developing teams.
* Demonstrated success growing a product category, business unit, or consumer product portfolio.
* Experience developing and launching successful products from concept through commercialization.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, business cases, and profitability.
* Proven ability to develop business strategies and translate them into measurable results.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Ability to travel as required for customer visits, product testing, trade shows, industry events, and supplier meetings.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the RC, hobby products, powersports, automotive aftermarket, consumer products, or related industries.
* Experience working directly with enthusiast communities, racers, influencers, or brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, new product introduction, and global sourcing environments.
* Experience using product lifecycle management (PLM) and project management systems.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasional lifting of office supplies and materials, up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on a computer.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.*
**Benefits & Other Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* HSA and FSA options
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Life Insurance and Supplemental Life Insurance
* 401(k) with a company match
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Internal Rewards
* Discounts on Products
* Additional Coverage such as accident, critical, hospital and pet insurance

*Horizon Hobby is a progressive, innovative company and, as such, is constantly reevaluating and reinventing the processes and procedures associated with each job. The essential duties and responsibilities of this position may change at any time. In addition, employees may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work necessary or important to the operation of Horizon. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected and appreciated.*
**Horizon Hobby, LLC is an equal opportunity and E-Verify employer**

role.title: Director Engineering (New Product Development)
role.description:
Conair, a member of the Piovan Group, is the leading producer of auxiliary equipment for plastics processing in the world. We make and market over 450 different products, including resin-drying systems, blenders, feeders and material-conveying systems, temperature-control equipment and granulators. Extrusion solutions include gravimetric control systems, film and sheet scrap-reclaim systems and downstream equipment for pipe and profile extrusion. Conair is also a leader in plastics process integration, engineering and installing complete manufacturing systems that help plastics processors manage their valuable raw materials, handle their critical manufactured parts, and improve their process yield.

**Purpose**

The Director of New Product Development (NPD) Engineering is responsible for leading the design and development of Conair's next generation of auxiliary equipment for plastics processing, from concept through production launch. This position leads the NPD Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Advanced Research / Co-op groups and serves as the senior mechanical engineering authority for new products. The Director drives NPD projects through Conair's stage-gate process, manages engineering schedules and deliverables, and mentors and develops a team of engineers and designers. The Director works closely with Product Management, Sustainment Engineering, Manufacturing, and Purchasing to deliver new products that meet customer, cost, quality, and compliance targets. This position is located in Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Drive NPD projects through Conair's stage-gate process from concept through launch, including requirements definition, gate deliverables, design reviews, and gate recommendations.
* Manage engineering schedules, resources, budgets, and deliverables across the NPD project portfolio, including alpha and beta prototype builds and release to production, and report status to engineering leadership.
* Serve as the technical lead and senior mechanical engineering authority for new products: set the design approach, lead design reviews and problem solving, ensure sound design practice (calculations, tolerance analysis, GD&T, materials selection, documentation standards), and identify patentable inventions.
* Lead design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA), design-to-cost, and value engineering, including designs suited to sheet metal fabrication, weldments, castings, machined and molded components.
* Plan and oversee prototype testing, verification and validation, and DFMEA with the Lab, and ensure new products meet applicable safety and regulatory requirements (e.g., UL, CE, NFPA 79).
* Partner with Product Management to translate voice-of-customer and business-case requirements into product specifications, and support product launches, including trade show display equipment.
* Coordinate mechanical, electrical, controls, and software development, and work with Purchasing and suppliers on sourcing, tooling, and cost targets, to deliver integrated, manufacturable designs.
* Transition new products smoothly into production and Sustainment Engineering with complete and accurate drawings, bills of material, specifications, and manuals.
* Mentor engineers and designers, building technical depth, design judgment, and project skills across the team, and support Conair's engineering co-op program.
* Review, hire, and train engineering staff; set goals, manage performance and workloads, and develop future technical leaders.
* Establish and track key performance metrics, such as gate schedule adherence, product cost versus target, and launch quality, and drive continuous improvement of the NPD process.
* Collaborate with Conair's engineering teams in the U.S., Italy, and India, and cultivate an environment which encourages teamwork, innovation, trust, and customer-inspired motivation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering required; Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA a plus.
* Position typically expects 12+ years of mechanical design and product development experience in industrial equipment or machinery, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams; plastics processing auxiliary equipment, extrusion, or injection molding experience strongly preferred.
* Proven record of taking new products from concept through production launch using a stage-gate or phase-gate process.
* Strong hands-on mechanical design background, including sheet metal, weldments, castings, machined and molded parts, mechanisms, pneumatics, and heat transfer, airflow, or fluid systems.
* Strong working knowledge of GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, DFMEA, and design verification and validation; familiarity with 3D CAD and PDM/PLM systems sufficient to review designs and guide the team; FEA or simulation experience a plus.
* Demonstrated DFM/DFA, design-to-cost, and value engineering results; experience designing for in-house sheet metal fabrication a plus.
* Familiarity with electrical controls, PLCs, and machine safety standards (e.g., NFPA 79, UL 508A, CE Machinery Directive).
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop engineers and designers and to manage schedules, resources, budgets, and competing priorities in a cross-functional organization; working knowledge of ERP systems.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, sound decision-making, and strong structured problem-solving (e.g., 8D, 5-Why, root cause analysis), with the ability to work effectively with customers, Product Management, and executive leadership.
* Ability to travel 10-15% of the time, including visits to customers, suppliers, trade shows, and Conair facilities, with occasional international travel.

Piovan Group is a world leader in the development and production of systems for the automation of production processes for the storage, transport and treatment of polymers, plastic, and food powders. The Group is close to its customers, on a global basis, through continuous technical assistance and support from the design phase to the installation and start-up of the system.

Customers, People, Innovation. These are the pillars of our philosophy that have led us to grow in a path that began more than fifty years ago, pursuing our development objectives with honesty, integrity, and transparency.

**Piovan Group offers an outstanding compensation and benefits package including profit sharing, bonus plans, 401(k) with company match, medical insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, health club reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, employee assistance, and employee referral bonus program.**

*Piovan Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and offers employment opportunities to all qualified persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability (except where physical or mental abilities are a bona fide occupational requirement), veteran status, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, HIV-positive status, possession of the sickle cell trait, genetic characteristics, political views, and any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws.*

role.title: Director - New Site Manufacturing-Electric Propulsion
role.description:
**Application Close Date**
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
 
 
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
 
 
This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.
 
 
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and require your commitment and detailed attention toward safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.
 
 
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
 
 
Blue Origin is scaling production of its electric propulsion systems. We are hiring a Director to own the manufacturing outcome for that product line and to carry it from development hardware into rate production.
 
 
You will be the single-threaded leader for Operations of this program: one person accountable for rate, quality, cost, and people, with full authority over the entire in-program production flow.
 
 
This is a build-it role, not a run-it role. You will define the value streams, stand up integration with support organizations, and build the team that runs the line — working concurrently with an active design program rather than behind a frozen one.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for successful manufacturing outcomes of the electric propulsion thruster line — delivery rate, quality, cost, and the people who produce it.
* Build the production organization. Define the value streams, stand up production control and manufacturing engineering, and hire and develop the leadership beneath you as the program scales.
* Own the get-to-rate plan. Define the path from development build to sustained rate production, and demonstrate cycle time at the rate-readiness gate as a committed acceptance number rather than a projection.
* Lead the transition from development build into rate production, including the qualification of tooling, processes, and work instructions required to produce repeatably at rate.
* Drive producibility into the product during design, rather than absorbing it on the floor later. Own the manufacturing view of the bill of materials as the product configuration evolves.
* Establish and own the program's working interfaces with quality, supply chain, material planning, and test operations.
* Build and manage the program's manufacturing operating budget and capital plan, owning responsibility for product delivery at cost and rate.
* Set the safety and quality culture for a new production team, and hold it as the organization grows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in an engineering or technical discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, supply chain, or operations, including 5+ years leading manufacturing organizations.
* Direct, hands-on experience taking a new product or production line from development into rate production.
* Experience carrying a product through a production-readiness or rate-readiness gate, and owning the cycle-time and capability evidence presented at it.
* Experience building an organization — defining structure, hiring leaders, and developing a team through significant growth.
* Line management of both salaried professionals and craft or technician populations.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity: making defensible assumptions and moving forward on an incomplete definition, then correcting as information arrives.
* Ability to travel frequently, up to approximately 35%, to other Blue Origin sites.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of manufacturing and operations experience.
* Propulsion, spacecraft, satellite, or other high-reliability low-volume hardware experience.
* Experience transitioning a product from low-volume, high-mix build into repeatable rate production.
* Demonstrated cycle-time or throughput improvement with measured results.
* Experience standing up production at a new or greenfield manufacturing site.
* Experience managing a build against a bill of materials that changed materially during production ramp.
* Formal lean or continuous-improvement training, with applied results on a production line.
* Master’s degree in engineering or technical field, or MBA.

**Base Pay Range For**
WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30
 
 
**Other Site Ranges May Differ**
**Culture Statement**
Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
 
 
**Export Control Regulations**
Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
 
 
**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
* Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
* Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. role.title: Quality Director
role.description:
At Oceans Behavioral Hospital DeRidder, healing is our focus. We are passionate about helping adults and seniors manage the challenges associated with anxiety, depression and other mental health issues. Utilizing proven, innovative and progressive therapies, our qualified professionals strive to promote long-term wellness through a range of inpatient and outpatient psychiatric counseling and treatment options.

The Director, Quality and Patient Safety plans, develops, implements and manages comprehensive and effective systems to monitor and evaluate the quality and appropriateness of patient services and programs in support of the organizational mission and goals. This position will work closely under the supervision of the Hospital CEO, functions as a support person in the coordination and organization of administrative processes in a high quality efficient and cost-effective manner. All duties to be done in accordance with Joint Commission, Federal and State regulations, Oceans’ Mission, policies and procedures and quality standards.

 

**Essential Functions:**

* Works with VP, Quality and Patient Safety implementing organization-wide quality programs at the hospital level.

* Facilitates the hospital Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) committee.

* Prepares an annual evaluation of the hospital QAPI plan, including process and outcomes.

* Oversees hospital-wide performance improvement (PI) projects identified through on-going data driven quality assessment.

* Coordinates the hospital’s data collection procedures and provides on-going support and education to staff regarding QAPI tools and reporting requirements; utilizes data and collaborates with leadership to set priorities and provide guidance in their development of quality improvement work plans.

* Serves as a resource to the medical staff, administrators and other staff including participation in root cause analyses, as indicated, to investigate potentially avoidable sentinel events.

* Completes assignments accurately, in a timely manner and within procedural guidelines.

* Coordinates education for QAPI principles and regulatory standards as indicated. Conducts training for staff.

* Participates in Joint Commission Accreditation process including plan of action tracking and completion.

* Performs other duties and projects as assigned by the facility administrator and corporate office.

**Requirements**

**Education / Experience:**

* Associate degree or RN diploma required.
* Healthcare experience related to clinical leadership and/or quality assessment and performance improvement.
* Behavioral health experience preferred.

**Qualifications / Skills:**

* Demonstrates proficient computer skills with MS office products and electronic QAPI software solutions.
* Ability to create and provide training programs on related quality performance topics.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and simultaneously manage multiple projects.
* Knowledge of state and federal regulatory requirements, Joint Commission Accreditation.
* CPHQ certification preferred.
* Must successfully complete CPR certification and an Oceans approved behavioral health de-escalation program.

**Work Environment:**

Subject to many interruptions. Occasional pressure due to multiple calls and inquiries. This position can be high paced and stressful; must be able to cope mentally and physically to atmosphere. Work requires spending approximately 90% or more of the time inside a building that offers protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes.

role.title: VP Manufacturing & Production
role.description:
About Us

 

Skydweller Aero Inc. is a transatlantic, cutting-edge aerospace company developing solar-powered aircraft solutions capable of perpetual flight while carrying heavy and powerful payloads. Building on technology from the longest continuous renewably powered flight program in history, this fast-growing company is creating a new class of unmanned aircraft. It combines the persistence of geosynchronous satellites with the sensing capabilities and flexibility of a large airborne platform. Skydweller Aero Inc. has its global and US headquarters in Oklahoma City, with European operations headquartered in Spain.

Role Summary

 

As Skydweller prepares to move from development toward aircraft production, we are looking for an experienced manufacturing executive to build and lead our production organization. This role is based in **Oklahoma City, OK** and reports to the Chief Operating Officer.

The Vice President, Manufacturing & Production will own all aircraft production operations: final assembly, systems integration, avionics installation, production testing, factory operations and aircraft delivery. You will lead the organization as we scale from prototype and low-rate initial production into sustained manufacturing.

We are looking for a hands-on aerospace manufacturing leader with a proven track record of building production organizations, improving factory performance and delivering complex aircraft in FAA-regulated environments.

**Why join:** Most manufacturing leadership roles optimize an existing production system. This one builds it. You will establish the manufacturing organization, develop the factory workforce, and scale production of one of the most ambitious autonomous aircraft programs in aerospace.

Responsibilities

 

**Production leadership**

 

* Lead all aircraft production and manufacturing operations.
* Drive safe, efficient and repeatable aircraft production.
* Build and lead a high-performing manufacturing organization, with clear management systems, metrics and operating rhythms.
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, quality and continuous improvement.

 

**Assembly and integration**

* Oversee final assembly, systems and electrical integration, avionics installation and aircraft completion.
* Ensure aircraft are built to engineering, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Drive production readiness and resolve manufacturing constraints and bottlenecks.

 

**Production planning and execution**

* Own execution of the Master Production Schedule.
* Lead production planning, labor allocation and resource management.
* Set capacity plans that support production-rate growth.
* Monitor factory performance and drive throughput, productivity and efficiency improvements.

 

**Production testing and acceptance**

* Lead production acceptance testing and ground test operations.
* Coordinate production readiness with Engineering, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.
* Ensure aircraft move smoothly from production through acceptance and delivery.

 

**Regulatory compliance and quality**

* Ensure compliance with FAA Part 21 production requirements and the company quality management system.
* Maintain production configuration control and manufacturing documentation discipline.
* Support internal, regulatory and customer audits and certification activities.
* Partner with Quality leadership to improve first-pass yield.

 

**Growth and scale-up**

* Develop the manufacturing infrastructure, facilities and staffing plans needed for higher production rates.
* Implement lean manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives.

 

**People leadership**

* Recruit, develop and mentor production leaders and technical staff.
* Establish workforce development and skills-training programs.
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.

 

Success Measures

You will be measured on aircraft delivery performance, production schedule attainment, factory throughput, labor productivity, manufacturing cost, quality and first-pass yield, safety, production-rate readiness, and workforce development and retention.

Required Qualifications

 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Aerospace, Operations or a related technical field.
* 15+ years of progressive aerospace manufacturing leadership experience, including 10+ years leading production organizations in aerospace, defense, aviation or another highly regulated industry.
* Proven experience scaling manufacturing from development, prototype or low-rate production to higher-rate production.
* Experience leading large, cross-functional manufacturing organizations.
* Strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, quality systems and manufacturing performance metrics.
* Experience implementing lean manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives.
* Excellent communication, leadership and organizational skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business or Operations.
* FAA Part 21 production experience and experience with certified aircraft manufacturing programs.
* Experience leading final assembly and aircraft integration organizations.
* Experience supporting aircraft certification, conformity and production acceptance.
* Background in autonomous aircraft, UAS, defense aviation or advanced aerospace systems.
* Experience building greenfield or fast-growing manufacturing operations.
* Composite aircraft manufacturing experience.
* AS9100 quality system experience.

 

Please Note

 

* **Security clearance requirement:** This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required.

* **One application per candidate:** Please apply to one position only. If you are interested in other open roles, list them in the Notes section of your application.

* **Check your spam folder:** We use BambooHR, a third-party recruiting platform, to contact candidates. Please check your spam or junk folder regularly so you don't miss our messages.

* **English CV:** Please submit your resume in English.

 

Company Benefits

 

* **Health insurance:** Medical, dental and vision coverage for all full-time employees.
* **401(k) retirement plan:** A 401(k) plan to help you save for retirement.
* **Paid time off:** Vacation, sick leave and personal days.
* **Flexible schedules:** Flexible working hours to support a healthy work-life balance.
* **Professional development:** Training, education and tuition reimbursement opportunities to help you grow your skills and career.
* **Wellness programs:** Programs that support healthy living, which may include gym memberships, nutrition counseling or stress-management classes.
* **Stock options:** Full-time employees may be eligible for stock options after one year of service.
* **Performance bonuses:** Bonus opportunities that reward individual and company performance.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Skydweller Aero Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law, subject to the security clearance requirements above.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at [email].

Privacy and AI

By applying, you acknowledge our [Applicant Privacy Notice]. We may use AI-assisted tools to help review applications, but all hiring decisions are made by people.
