role.title: Director, Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations
role.description:
We are looking for someone to join our growing team to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, CNC manufacturing turn-key machine tool solutions. This role combines technical leadership, project management, customer engagement, and team development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for taking large, turnkey manufacturing projects from initial customer requirements through engineering development, testing, implementation, and final acceptance. You will lead projects involving a wide range of CNC technologies. You will coordinate internal engineering resources, customers, machine-tool and tooling vendors, partners, and other suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and to the required technical and quality standards. The Director of Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations will be responsible for establishing project priorities, managing expectations, identifying risks, resolving technical and organizational issues, and ensuring successful project outcomes. While this is a leadership and project-management position, a strong understanding of CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing processes, machine tools, and controls is required. The successful candidate should be comfortable engaging deeply with technical teams and making informed decisions on complex manufacturing challenges when required.

**About Empire Dynamics Machinery, LLC**

Empire Dynamics was founded in 2015 in Albany, New York. Starting as a single-person consulting company serving the machine tool industry, Empire has grown into a well-recognized 10-person manufacturing engineering team serving all sectors of the CNC machining industry. Primarily through the deployment of NX CAM, Siemens Motion Control Software, and turnkey CNC solutions, we bring real world manufacturing experience to the production of real parts.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. We take pride in the CNC technology we have developed and our ability to put it to use in a practical manufacturing setting.

Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers that collectively wants to see change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

**Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Director will be accountable for ensuring these responsibilities are fulfilled, whether through direct involvement, delegation to existing team members, or the development of additional team capabilities as the business grows. The role requires both hands-on leadership and the ability to build scalable processes, teams, and organizational capabilities.

**Project Management**

* Lead complex, multi-disciplinary CNC manufacturing projects from project initiation through customer acceptance.
* Establish project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, milestones, and priorities.
* Develop and maintain project plans, resource requirements, budgets, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate engineering resources across multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and constraints, and implement corrective actions.
* Establish project priorities and ensure engineering activities remain aligned with customer and business objectives.
* Lead regular project status meetings and communicate project health to customers and internal leadership.
* Manage project changes, scope adjustments, technical issues, and customer requests.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet defined technical and customer requirements.
* Develop project documentation, status reports, action plans, and lesson-learned documentation.
* Establish and improve project management processes, standards, and best practices across the organization.

**CNC Process Engineering Leadership**

* Provide technical direction for the development of comprehensive CNC manufacturing processes.
* Oversee development of CAM programming, tooling strategies, fixturing, workholding, process parameters, and setup documentation.
* Review and approve process plans and CAM development strategies.
* Guide engineers in analyzing critical machining operations for feasibility, efficiency, and optimization.
* Oversee development of stage models, setup sheets, work instructions, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Coordinate tooling suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Support development of process outlines to distribute engineering work effectively across the team.
* Provide technical leadership during machine setup, program verification, and customer program runoff.
* Maintain awareness of current CNC machining technologies and manufacturing practices.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop CNC manufacturing engineers and technical staff.
* Assign project responsibilities based on team capabilities, project requirements, and priorities.
* Establish clear expectations for technical quality, project execution, documentation, and communication.
* Provide technical and professional mentorship to developing engineers.
* Identify training and development opportunities for team members.
* Encourage knowledge sharing and standardization across projects.
* Help establish career-development paths and technical competency expectations for the engineering team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Oversee the development of relationships with tooling manufacturers, machine-tool builders, software providers, and other technical partners.
* Manage vendor activities associated with project tooling, fixturing, machine capabilities, and software requirements.
* Establish technical requirements and deliverables for external suppliers.
* Monitor vendor performance against project schedules and requirements.
* Serve as an escalation point for technical or project-related vendor issues.

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE**

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical knowledge to effectively lead highly specialized CNC engineering projects. Experience with the following is highly desirable:

* NX CAM and CNC programming
* CAM programming and toolpath development
* CNC machine tools, including milling, turning, mill-turn, HMC, VTC, grinding, and specialty machines
* CNC machine controls, macros, probing, and advanced machine functions
* CAD modeling
* Cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and machining strategies
* Fixture design and workholding
* Manufacturing process development
* CNC machine commissioning and runoff
* NX CAM templates and productivity environments
* Teamcenter, MRL, and machining data libraries
* Software development or scripting
* Manufacturing engineering and machine-shop operations

The Director is not expected to personally perform every technical task. Rather, the position requires the ability to understand complex technical issues, establish direction, evaluate solutions, allocate resources, and ensure the engineering team delivers the appropriate solution.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, mathematics, manufacturing, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience in CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* Strong project planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
* Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

**Preferred**

Experience with:

* Managing complex, customer-facing manufacturing projects.
* Using NX CAM and Siemens manufacturing software.
* Post-processors and CNC controls.
* Leading engineering or technical teams.
* Software development or technical product development.
* Working directly with machine-tool builders, tooling manufacturers, or manufacturing suppliers.
* Developing manufacturing processes for multiple CNC machine types.
* Project management methodologies, scheduling, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Customer acceptance testing and technical implementation projects.

Knowledge of:

* Variety of CNC controllers and willing to learn new controller types
* CNC programming techniques and process
* Feeds, speeds, and cutting tool applications
* Geometry and trigonometry
* Fixture specifications, design, and work holding.

A strong sense of curiosity and problem-solving skills

Demonstrated proficiency interpreting drawing and specification requirements

**Leadership Characteristics**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Ownership: Takes responsibility for project outcomes from initiation through completion.
* Leadership: Provides clear direction while empowering technical experts to perform their best work.
* Customer focus: Understands customer objectives and translates them into practical engineering solutions.
* Technical curiosity: Enjoys learning new technologies, machines, software, and manufacturing processes.
* Communication: Clearly communicates priorities, risks, decisions, and expectations.
* Organization: Can manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and parallel workstreams.
* Problem solving: Approaches difficult technical and organizational challenges systematically.
* Continuous improvement: Looks for opportunities to improve both customer solutions and internal processes.

Albany, New York or Remote.

20% travel to customer sites, partners, or other business-related travel.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers with a collective goal to pursue change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
As the Regional Director of Food Safety & Quality Assurance, you will be responsible for overseeing and ensuring the highest standards of food safety and quality across our operations in the United States and/or Canada. You will lead a team of professionals dedicated to maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies while driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and locations.

**Duties and Responsibilities****:**

* Ensure individual plant teams are executing expected actions to meet corporate objectives
* Manages assigned plant FS-Q managers, and interacts with operations, R&D, and other relevant teams to implement the company’s strategic plan that encompasses all aspects of food safety and quality.
* Coaches plant FS-Q managers to ensure they perform according with strategic and the tactical/milestones necessary to achieve operational goals.
* Manages key customer (other than McDonald’s) QA relationships in conjunction with sales personnel.
* Work in partnership with direct manager to be in compliance with the regional McDonald’s FSQA expectations.
* Support and coach Plant FS-Q Managers for administering the department’s budget to ensure proper allocation of resources
* Assess and manages plant resources to ensure the QA and Food Safety KPI goals are achieved for the manufacturing plants under its purview.
* Ensures the food safety and quality of product and services by assessing compliance with product testing, performing internal assessments and audits of the FS-Q system and product lines, placing defective products on hold and taking corrective action
* Insures that all regulatory requirements are met including weights/measures, food safety, product claims, declarations, etc.
* Collaborates to standardize when required, QA policies/procedures to improve efficiency and reduce cost.
* Identifies and communicates FS- QA technologies to improve quality and reduce costs.
* Coaches and develops QA Managers to perform at a constantly exceptional level of performance, including but not limited to the sanitation program, compliance with the GFSI approved scheme audits; and when required acts as the plant’s SQF back-up Practitioner.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

**Education/Certifications** **and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum of five (5) years of management experience including Quality Management Systems and/or Manufacturing experience.
* Prefer experience in a bakery/dry mixing (dry blending, frozen dough and baked goods) production environment.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Proficient use of computer, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote), and other related applications or software.
* Demonstrated leadership experience and a sense of urgency and the drive to make continuous improvements
* Ability to operate at single and multi-site levels from management to “hands on” to accomplish tasks. Must be a “working manager.”
* Demonstrated ability to make and act on decisions while balancing speed, food safety, quality and risk.
* Strong background in sanitation principles and practices, GFSI approved schemes (SQF, BRC), HACCP, GMPs, Safety and SPC.
* Ability to think clearly and in a decisive manner while remaining calm under in pressure situations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in a matrix environment and build strong relationships by being transparent, reliable, and accountable. Strong interpersonal skills backed-up by strong technical knowledge are critical to success in this role.
* Must have good writing skills and be able to communicate effectively with people at all levels of the company.

**Supervisory Responsibilities****:**

* Manage multiple direct reports including but not limited to: Sr. Quality Assurance Manager, Quality Assurance Manager, Analyst.
* Work requires supervising and monitoring work performance of direct reports including making final decisions on hiring and disciplinary actions, evaluating program/work objectives and effectiveness, and realigning work and staffing assignments, as needed.
* Develop functional responsibilities of individuals that report to this position and ensure that best-in class output is created.

**Working Conditions and Physical Effort:**

* Typical work in office environment but will spend periods of time in manufacturing plants which will have exposure to unusual elements, such as dirt, dust, fumes, odors, darkness and/or poor lighting, noise and vibration. Seasonal exposure to weather elements to include, but not limited to, extreme temperatures, wetness and humidity.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Substantial travel required (up to 50%) mostly in the North America.

**Expectations:**

* Will demonstrate, promote, and exemplify the Company’s Core Values.

At C.H. Guenther, we value transparency in compensation. By providing the salary range for this role, we aim to promote fairness and help candidates make informed choices about their career. The salary range for this role is:

$142,500.00 - $228,000.00 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as geographic location.

**C.H. Guenther & Son will never offer or pay a wage or salary that is not compliant with applicable local, state, or federal pay laws, including minimum salary thresholds.**

We also offer a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, retirement savings options, flexible spending accounts, employee assistance programs, educational assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays.

For additional information about our company, go to www.chg.com.

C.H. Guenther & Son and its subsidiaries are E-Verify participating employers.

Click here for more information regarding E-verify.

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of the pre-employment screening process which includes a drug screen and review of criminal background and other records as required.

role.title: Quality Assurance, Operations Support Services & Service Delivery - Director
role.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title** Quality Assurance, Operations Support Services & Service Delivery

**Corporate Title** Director

**Location** Santa Ana, CA

**Overview**

*As a Director within Document Custody Operations, you will lead quality assurance, operations support services, and service delivery to strengthen execution, protect client and organizational interests, and improve service outcomes. You will oversee quality control, training, operational risk and controls, continuous improvement, and sustained regulatory, agency, investor, and audit readiness. As a senior operational representative and Document Custody and agency subject matter expert, you will translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into practical operating standards. You will partner across Operations, Client Services, control functions, Technology, and delivery partners to resolve complex issues and balance client service, efficiency, and custodial obligations.*

**What We Offer You**

* A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
* A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
* Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
* Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs 

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Document Custody quality assurance framework, operating standards, governance, and controls, including maker/checker reviews, segregation of duties, approvals, system validations, and evidence requirements
* Oversee independent, risk-based quality control testing, sampling, defect tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, and remediation validation; report quality performance and emerging risks to senior leadership
* Lead training and knowledge-management governance, including agency and document fundamentals, competency assessments, certification standards, cross-training, and targeted retraining informed by quality findings and audit observations
* Translate Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC), Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA), private investor, client, and custodial requirements into procedures and service expectations; guide collateral documentation, certification, endorsements, assignments, allonges, trailing documents, releases, reinstatements, exceptions, and inventory controls
* Lead operational support and client service delivery, including implementations, service levels, capacity planning, complex research, incidents, aging items, and escalations; balance responsiveness with contractual commitments, controls, cost, and risk appetite
Maintain audit and examination readiness, oversee findings and management action plans, and partner with Technology on workflow, automation, data, and reporting enhancements that deliver measurable improvements in quality, capacity, client outcomes, and resilience 

**How You’ll Lead**

* Lead and develop direct reports and matrixed teams across quality assurance, quality control, training, audit support, operational support, service delivery, and process improvement, establishing clear decision rights, accountability, and development objectives
* Partner with Operations, Client Services, and clients as a senior advisor and escalation point, ensuring service commitments are executable, controlled, and aligned with custodial obligations
Influence senior leadership, Audit, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology, vendors, and offshore partners to challenge risk decisions constructively, resolve cross-functional issues, and deliver sustainable remediation and transformation 

**Skills You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Operations Management, Mortgage Banking, or a related discipline; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered where permitted by organizational policy
* Extensive experience in document custody, mortgage banking, loan servicing, securities services, collateral management, quality assurance, operational risk, service delivery, or another highly controlled financial-services environment
* Demonstrated experience with Quality Assurance/Quality Control frameworks, control testing, issue management, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, training governance, operational reporting, and client escalation management, including support for audits, client examinations, agency reviews, regulatory assessments, or formal control testing
* Knowledge of operational risk, controls, quality management, audit readiness, remediation, and service-delivery governance, with the ability to translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into operational standards
* Working proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using dashboards, workflow tools, quality trackers, case-management systems, or operational reporting platforms
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs 

**Skills That Will Help You Excel**

* Direct working knowledge of Document Custody and FNMA, FHLMC, GNMA, private investor, collateral, certification, release, and exception requirements
* Experience leading managers, professionals, programs, or complex cross-functional operating models, with the ability to influence across functions, locations, vendors, and onshore/offshore teams
* Executive presence and effective written and verbal communication with clients, auditors, senior management, control functions, and technical subject matter experts
* Analytical judgment to identify patterns, quantify operational impacts, challenge assumptions, and make risk-informed decisions
Disciplined prioritization and follow-through when managing multiple critical issues, with timely escalation of material concerns 

**Expectations**

It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the Santa Ana office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model.

Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion.

The salary range for this position in California is $133,000 to $203,500. Actual salaries may be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration.

**Deutsche Bank Benefits**

At Deutsche Bank, we recognize that our benefit programs have a profound impact on our colleagues. That’s why we are focused on providing benefits and perks that enable our colleagues to live authentically and be their whole selves, at every stage of life. We provide access to physical, emotional, and financial wellness benefits that allow our colleagues to stay financially secure and strike balance between work and home. Click here to learn more!

Learn more about your life at Deutsche Bank through the eyes of our current employees: https://careers.db.com/life

The California Consumer Privacy Act outlines how companies can use personal information. If you are interested in receiving a copy of Deutsche Bank’s California Privacy Notice please email HR.Direct@DB.com .

**#LI-HYBRID**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Click these links to view Deutsche Bank’s Equal Opportunity Policy Statement and the following notices: EEOC Know Your Rights ; Employee Rights and Responsibilities under the Family and Medical Leave Act ; and Employee Polygraph Protection Act .

role.description:
Job Summary:
 
Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and leads production activities for assigned manufacturing facilities and/or value streams with direct accountability for safety, quality, cost, schedule attainment, and on-time delivery. Provides site-level leadership to ensure daily execution aligns with production plans, customer requirements, standard work, and business objectives. Partners cross functionally with Planning, Materials, Engineering, Quality, HR, and Manufacturing leadership to remove constraints, improve process discipline, and drive continuous improvement throughout the operation.

**Minimum Qualifications: (Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills):**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of supervisory or site leadership experience and 5–7 years of manufacturing experience preferred. In lieu of a degree, a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 8 years of supervisory or relevant manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a manufacturing site, department, or value stream with accountability for safety, quality, schedule, cost, labor planning, and daily execution.
* Experience leading production managers or production teams through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong understanding of production scheduling, capacity planning, labor utilization, material readiness, ERP/MRP discipline, and schedule attainment in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated competency with ERP systems used in manufacturing environments; IFS, SAP, Oracle, or similar systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, visual management, standard work, root cause problem solving, and Corrective Action/Preventive Action practices; Six Sigma and/or Lean certification preferred or actively pursuing.
* Ability to use operational data, reports, and KPIs to communicate performance versus goals and drive improvement in safety, quality, cost, schedule, productivity, and on-time delivery.
* Knowledge of safe work practices, OSHA requirements, incident prevention, corrective action closure, and operational organization standards.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and documentation, including schematics, assembly drawings, operational manuals, safety rules, Methods of Manufacture, and standardized work instructions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional issue resolution with Engineering, Quality, Materials, Planning, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to minimize delays and improve execution.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and leadership skills with the ability to engage peers, leaders, and employees at all levels of the organization.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office and scheduling software.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and site/value stream performance across safety, site security, quality, schedule, cost, productivity, and on time delivery.
* Maintains a safe and healthy work environment by ensuring standards, procedures, legal regulations, OSHA requirements, local regulations and company safety practices are followed.
* Leads safety culture, 5S, operational organization, corrective actions, and incident prevention activities across assigned production areas.
* Maintains a positive and accountable culture where safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost control, and customer requirements are treated as core operating priorities.
* Leads value stream team through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and disciplined execution of the operating plan.
* Owns daily and weekly production attainment by aligning labor, material readiness, equipment availability, engineering support, and production priorities to meet schedule commitments.
* Drives constraint resolution and escalates issues that impact scope, schedule, quality, cost, or customer delivery commitments.
* Identifies, contains, and follows proper procedures for non-conforming material; supports accurate tracking, timely disposition, corrective action, and closure of NCRs.
* Ensures alignment cross-functionally with Engineering, Quality, Planning, Materials, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to resolve issues, reduce delays, improve process discipline, and support continual product improvement.
* Manages controllable operating costs, labor productivity, overtime, indirect labor utilization, rework, scrap, tools, equipment, and other cost drivers within assigned areas.
* Identifies cost savings opportunities and leads continuous improvement efforts that improve safety, quality, flow, productivity, throughput, and resource utilization.
* Leverages metrics and KPIs to identify performance gaps, establish priorities, communicate progress, and promote a culture of continuous improvement across assigned departments.
* Addresses employee performance, attendance, and standards-of-work issues in partnership with HR and Manufacturing leadership.
* Works with HR and Manufacturing leadership to support personnel development, establish career paths, and maintain a sound performance evaluation process.
* Leads manufacturing-driven projects and cross-functional initiatives based on KPI performance, data review, customer feedback, field quality concerns, or operational needs.

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is on-site 5 days per week.
* Occasional travel may be required for training or meetings.
* Must be able to work flexible hours to accommodate different business needs.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

* Strong operational knowledge of manufacturing processes, maintenance, and engineering principles, with demonstrated practical application.

* Experience managing budgets, expenses, and cost performance, with solid financial and accounting understanding.

* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, 5S, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt preferred), or similar process improvement frameworks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with enterprise systems such as SAP or JD Edwards is a plus.

Disclaimer: This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the team member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

role.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, General Assembly, Fremont Central Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
**What to Expect**

The Staff Manufacturing Engineer, GA position, reporting to General Assembly Manufacturing Engineering Manager, is located at our Fremont Factory location. The primary responsibility of this role is to lead, support, and manage introductions of new manufacturing equipment and processes as well as continuous improvement of existing equipment in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This person will drive the implementation of new projects, production lines and product changes. The successful candidate is a self-starter, has strong engineering skills and leadership capabilities, and can manage a small group of engineers to execute multiple projects and priorities at the same time. This role requires working closely with Design Engineering, NPI, Quality, Production, Purchasing, Industrial Engineering, external Line builders, and other departments to take vehicle design changes and new vehicle designs from initial concept through prototype development and into full production, and to transform and adapt existing manufacturing equipment to changing requirements and conditions.

 
**What You'll Do**

* Build and lead a project team of engineers to execute a diverse roadmap of projects including new product introductions and business directives such as capacity increase and cost reduction
* Facilitate performance management, resource allocation, and engineering skill development with manager. Including performance reviews, growth, and development
* Design, procure, and fully commission equipment, specifically: stakeholder buy-in, RFQ, vendor selection, decision analysis, project workflow approvals, installation, and commissioning
* Ensure thorough and proper equipment validation and production startup through FAT, SAT, OEE, availability, complete technical documentation, and transfer of ownership success criteria
* Provide detailed assessments and critical Design For Manufacture (DFM) reviews of Product, Process and Tooling designs
* While executing projects objectively define and achieve OEE, throughput, and cycle time
* Lead all GA engineering groups both internal and external with tooling design and reviews
* Study technologies to expert-level of understanding, utilizing internal & external technical resources to fully understand, teach and lead new / newly implemented technologies
* Develop business cases and ROI studies, and communicate project justification to senior leadership
* Provide technical support, leadership, and training to engineers and cross departmental teams

 
**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or equivalent certification, or proven equivalent experience
* 8+ years of proven experience designing, implementing, and optimizing complex manual and automated manufacturing equipment & processes, preferably in the automotive industry
* Work independently with concepts and documentation from prototype to sustaining activities
* Familiarity with assembly processes, technologies, and platforms, their capabilities, and limitations
* Extensive Proficiency with 3D and 2D CAD platforms
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, and proven interpersonal skills and ability to objectively resolve conflict within a large group
* Able to work flexible hours and schedules as required

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

 

#### **Expected Compensation**

$91,600 - $316,800/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

 
Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. 
 
Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

role.title: Director of Operations - Prime Line | Bilingual (English/Spanish)
role.description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE

Join Our Community of Food People!

Job Profile Summary 
The Director, Operations - Prime Line is responsible for the overall operational performance of the Prime Line distribution network, providing strategic leadership and direction to deliver best-in-class service, safety, quality, productivity, and financial results. This role drives operational excellence across all locations, develops high-performing leadership teams, drives accountability and partners cross-functionally to execute business strategies that support growth, customer satisfaction, and long-term organizational success.

**Bilingual Requirement: Fluency in both English & Spanish is required for this position. The successful candidate must be able to effectively communicate in both languages in a professional setting to lead, develop, and support diverse teams.**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Provides strategic leadership for all Prime Line locations, establishing operational priorities and driving execution against safety, service, productivity, quality and financial objectives.

* Owns operational and financial performance across all Prime Line locations, optimizing labor, distribution, inventory flow, service levels, and operating costs to achieve business objectives and profitability targets.
* Collaborates cross-functionally to align operations with enterprise goals.
* Oversees turnaround strategies for underperforming locations and drives a culture of continuous improvement.
* Develops and executes network strategies that support growth, operational scalability, and long-term business performance.

**Talent Development & Team Leadership**

* Hires, manages, and develops high-performing Operations teams across Prime Line locations.
* Builds a high-performing leadership culture through talent development, succession planning, performance management, and leadership capability enhancement.
* Coaches and mentors leaders to promote accountability; acts quickly when performance does not meet expectations.
* Conducts performance reviews and supports succession planning and career development**.**

**Customer Experience and Operational Partnership**

* Champions initiatives that enhance customer experience through operational excellence.
* Leverages Operations Excellence insights and feedback to drive innovation in service delivery.
* Aligns operational strategies with evolving customer and Prime Line Supply Chain expectations.

* Leads initiatives that improve customer service performance, delivery execution, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Partners closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Merchandising, and Customer Service teams to ensure operational strategies align with customer expectations and business priorities.

**Accountability & Engagement**

* Ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety standards, and workplace safety expectations.
* Leads business reviews, presents performance insights to executive leadership, and develops action plans to address risks and opportunities.
* Drives associate engagement through effective leadership, recognition, and communication, fostering a culture of accountability, transparency and operational integrity.
* Leads organizational change initiatives and operational transformations to support business growth and evolving customer needs.

 

* Other duties as assigned by manager.

**SUPERVISION**:

* Directly supervises operations leadership at all Prime Line locations.

**RELATIONSHIPS:**

* **Internal**: Prime Line Leadership Team, Mergers and Acquisitions Integration Team, Field Operations, Supply Chain Planning & Replenishment, Region and Area Presidents; Area, Region and HR business partners; Program Office change resources and other Operations, Program Office, Commercial Center of Excellence and Supply Chain leaders.
* **External:** Customers, vendors, third parties and external consultants as needed.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**:

* **Onsite:** The associate in this role is expected to perform assigned responsibilities in a Prime Line office-based environment.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 10 years of progressive leadership experience in supply chain operations, including leading warehouse and/or transportation operations.
* 7 years of people leadership experience with demonstrated success leading and developing operations leaders.
* Proven track record of success in P&L ownership, strategic planning, and operational execution.
* Demonstrated success delivering results across key operational metrics, including safety, quality, productivity, and employee retention.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational complexity and influence outcomes across functions and locations.
* Strong understanding of business strategy, operating models, capacity planning, and financial principles.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business strategies.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead geographically dispersed teams and successfully develop leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to foster cross-functional collaboration and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
* Up to 75% travel.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management or other relevant field or equivalent work experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience leading multiple geographically dispersed sites.
* Experience in foodservice, distribution, logistics, or a similarly complex operating environment.
Advanced degree. 

 

This role may also receive annual incentive plan bonus and long-term incentive program.

Benefits for this role may include health insurance, pre-tax spending accounts, retirement benefits, paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, employee stock purchase plan, and life insurance. To review available benefits, please click here: https://www.usfoods.com/careers/benefits.html.

Compensation depends on relevant experience and/or education, specific skills, function, geographic location, and other factors as applicable by law (for example: state or local minimum wage thresholds). The expected base rate for this role is between

$115,000 - $175,000

role.title: Head of Operations, Space Ground Systems
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril's Space Ground Systems team builds the mission-critical software backbone that enables satellite command and control, space domain awareness, and dynamic space operations for the U.S. military and allied partners. We develop distributed backend services, APIs, and microservices that power ground C2 platforms, handling everything from satellite tasking and mission planning to high-rate telemetry processing and real-time orbital data fusion. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to join our rapidly growing Space Ground Systems team. In this role you will be responsible for all business operations for the team. Your work will vary from quick-turn operational fire-fighting, to building and redesigning processes, to leading high-impact strategic projects. This role requires you to be a trusted partner to each part of the business, and to work with and support the Space and Division leadership teams to achieve our strategic objectives.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 
 Drive day-to-day business operations for the Space Business line. This will include business planning & organization design, talent planning & people operations, real estate &facility planning, security & infrastructure compliance, proposal & legal support, and sharing the division’s narrative.

 Work with the growth team to define and synthesize the growth strategy for Space Ground Systems Business in partnership with the Space Leadership Team

 Support the growth, execution, and engineering of the business line with operational support

 Lead strategic initiatives in-line with the Business Line priorities

 Problem solve to enable the Business Line to operate as efficiently as possible and scale accordingly

 Own managing the Business Line Profit/Loss and burn rate - working closely with Anduril finance

 Build senior leader engagement and external interface strategy (e.g. conferences, press releases, partnerships)

 Build, negotiate and execute partnerships across industry

 Support Merger and Acquisition activity - identifying targets and engaging in diligence

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 10+ years of professional experience in operations

 Strong emotional intelligence and ability to solve operational problems in a way that is both data-driven and people-centric.

 High ownership with sufficient horsepower to effectively manage multiple (6+) large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Solid technical aptitude and proven ability to understand technical designs and ability to work closely and effectively with engineering teams

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at our HQ in Costa Mesa, CA

 Minimum 25% travel expected

 Able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 MBA or similar degree

 Experience working with engineers and bringing hardware/software products to market strongly preferred

 Experience in the Space Industry

 Experience working effectively in a matrix organization structure

 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field

 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: Director / Senior Director, Technical Operations
role.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with  neffy® , the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture. 



 

 THE OPPORTUNITY 

 
 The Director / Senior Director, Technical Operations will provide strategic leadership for ARS' external manufacturing and Technical Operations activities supporting the continued development, lifecycle management, and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical, business, and operational leadership with cross-functional influence and CMO management expertise to drive manufacturing excellence, scalable operations, and reliable product supply.

 This role is accountable for manufacturing strategy, CMO performance, process and technology lifecycle management, resolution of major technical issues, and execution of key Technical Operations initiatives across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the position leads complex cross-functional programs, oversees partner performance and agreements, manages departmental planning and budgets, and ensures technical, supply, regulatory, and business risks are appropriately identified, assessed, and escalated.



   ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 
 Provide leadership for Technical Operations programs and external manufacturing activities, establishing strategy, priorities, scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, and key decision points.

 Own senior-level Technical Operations relationships with key CMOs/CDMOs and other external partners; establish governance, performance expectations, escalation pathways, and accountability for delivery against manufacturing and business commitments.

 Provide technical leadership for formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, continued process verification, and manufacturing lifecycle management, as applicable.

 Oversee clinical and commercial manufacturing strategy and execution in coordination with external manufacturers and internal stakeholders; ensure appropriate Technical Operations support for critical manufacturing campaigns, product launches, and supply requirements.

 Provide senior technical review and oversight of manufacturing and process documentation, process performance, significant vendor changes, investigations, annual/product reviews, and significant deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and complex manufacturing problems; ensure robust technical investigation, root-cause analysis, effective corrective and preventive actions, continued process control, and reliable manufacturing in partnership with Quality Assurance.

 Lead technical assessments of significant manufacturing, process, component, and supplier changes and coordinate evaluation of quality, regulatory, supply, financial, and business impacts with appropriate functional stakeholders.

 Establish and review manufacturing, supply, and external partner performance metrics and KPIs, including service, quality, on-time delivery, right-first-time, cost, capacity, and other appropriate measures; drive lifecycle improvements, operational excellence, capacity planning, cost improvement, and risk-reduction initiatives across the external network.

 Lead external partner business and technical governance, including selection and strategic development of CMOs, CDMOs, suppliers, and other critical partners; establish performance expectations and governance mechanisms, oversee business reviews, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, contract and supply agreement support, and escalation of commercial or operational issues; and develop business continuity, capacity, and second-source strategies for critical manufacturing capabilities and materials.

 Represent Technical Operations on cross-functional program and leadership teams; communicate manufacturing strategy, program status, significant risks, financial implications, and recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders.

 Partner with Regulatory Affairs on CMC strategy, regulatory submissions, post-approval changes, and health authority responses; ensure manufacturing plans and technical decisions are aligned with regulatory commitments.

 Lead Technical Operations business planning and continuous improvement initiatives, including departmental budget development with Finance/FP&A, contract lifecycle management, operational process standardization, and long-range manufacturing planning.

 Provide leadership and governance for commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including 3PL and distribution partner performance, inventory and supply continuity, shipping/returns interfaces, and support of product launches and new markets.

 Oversee the commercial serialization program, including serialized packaging operations, EPCIS data exchange with trading partners and service providers, and compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements; ensure issues are appropriately escalated and resolved cross-functionally.

 Provide leadership and oversight for clinical supply operations, including clinical material planning, packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and coordination of Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities with Clinical Operations and external vendors.

 
   KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: 

 
 Broad and deep knowledge of cGMP, pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality systems, formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, lifecycle management, and applicable CMC regulatory expectations, with the technical credibility to critically challenge external partner data, conclusions, and recommendations.

 Demonstrated leadership of outsourced manufacturing relationships, complex cross-functional programs, and teams, including governance, performance management, contract/scope management, budgeting, executive-level escalation, influence without direct authority, and accountability of external partners for performance and commitments.

 Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving capability, with demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technical and business issues, balance risk, cost, supply continuity, and regulatory considerations, and make sound recommendations.

 Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and presentation skills with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels and communicate effectively with senior management and external partners.

 Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to translate budgets, forecasts, manufacturing costs, contract terms, and operational metrics into business decisions and actions.

 Experience establishing scalable Technical Operations processes and systems; proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant project, reporting, or data-management tools.

 Demonstrated knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations within an outsourced model, including 3PL management, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and clinical supply/IRT/IWRS processes.

 Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 25% to support external manufacturing partners, governance meetings, and key manufacturing activities.

 
   EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is preferred. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.

 Minimum of 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process development, CMC, or related functions, with demonstrated leadership of complex programs and external manufacturing relationships.

 Significant experience managing external CMOs/CDMOs in an outsourced operating model and supporting GMP clinical and commercial manufacturing is required.

 Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, process validation/PPQ, commercial product launch, and lifecycle management is strongly preferred.

 Experience supporting CMC regulatory strategy and submissions, major investigations and change controls, vendor/supply agreements, budget planning, and business continuity is preferred. Prior people-management or functional leadership experience is strongly preferred.

 Experience overseeing commercial distribution and 3PL partners, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and clinical supply operations including IRT/IWRS is strongly preferred; experience across multiple of these areas is preferred.

 
 
 At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.  

  



 
 The full-time salary range for this posted position is $225,000 to $275,000 and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law. 



  
 This position is also eligible for Equity, 401k matching, and our excellent benefits package including 100% employer paid Medical, Dental & Vision for employees. View the full package here:  ARS Careers Page 

 ARS Pharmaceuticals believes in Equal Opportunity for all and is committed to ensuring all individuals, including individuals with disabilities, have an opportunity to apply for those positions that they are interested in and qualify for without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. ARS Pharmaceuticals is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals so that an individual can perform their job-related duties. If you are interested in applying for an employment opportunity and require special assistance or an accommodation to apply due to a disability, please contact us at careers@ars-pharma.com 

 The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

role.title: Plant Manager Extraction - Decatur, IL
role.description:
ADM – Soy Crush
 
 
This is an exempt level position.
 
 
**Position Summary**
This key operational role is responsible for leading all aspects of the operations at a soy white flake crush processing facility with an integrated refinery. You will have a leading role in driving excellence, developing and implementing programs and procedures, and developing a manufacturing team. You set and maintain ADM’s high standards for Safety and Quality for all departments while maintaining production and efficiency excellence. A good communicator who can nurture extraordinary interdepartmental, commercial and customer relationships will be most successful. He/she will have the ability to identify and conclusively solve problems as they arise, develop and supervise capital improvement projects and maintain records in accordance with established ADM policies.
 
 
The Plant Manager reports directly to the Director of Regional Operations and leads a site with approximately 40 colleagues.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead a soy white flake crush plant and refinery.
* Develop a high performance team by engaging, coaching and developing team members, and by driving accountability and ownership at all levels.
* Responsible for environmental, health, safety, quality, efficiency and production of the plant.
* Responsible for meeting production requirements safely, reliably, and efficiently.
* Lead and support performance excellence initiatives.
* Provide technical knowledge for processes and equipment to obtain performance leveraging ADM Centers of Excellence.
* Maintain cost controls and oversee budgets in each department.
* Utilize production personnel and equipment in a safe and efficient manner to obtain maximum capacity and performance with optimum yields and quality product.
* Develop and implement a five year capital plan in alignment with the business strategy.

**Health, Safety & Environmental:**

* Maintain the license to operate by developing a strong site safety culture and by ensuring adherence to safety laws, regulations, rules and sound practices.
* Act as a role model for safety.
* Work with the Safety and Environmental Center of Excellence and the regional and local management on the continued development and implementation of environmental, health, and safety programs, policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and contribute in audits, prioritizing and tracking completion of findings.
* Ensure that unsafe behavior and conditions are corrected.
* Maintain the necessary environmental, health, and safety records and documentation.

**Sanitation/Food Safety:**

* Ensure the facility maintains world-class sanitation standards.
* Continually improve and communicate food safety/sanitation/quality programs to plant supervisors and hourly employees.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Job Description**
The Plant Manager will oversee operations which include environmental, health & safety, quality, production, maintenance, capital planning and execution in a cost-effective manner while meeting all customer requirements.
 
 
**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**
Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.
 
 

* Support, mentor and develop plant management and supervisory personnel through regular coaching and formal development tools.
* Lead all safety improvement initiatives and create a safety-based culture.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory agencies including, OSHA, EPA, HACCP and other local and regional agencies.
* Prepare monthly reports, analyze financial budgets and take corrective measures as needed.
* Maintain efficient and timely flow of all raw materials received and ingredients shipped.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts in all areas of responsibility.
* Review and lead local Capital Projects, planning process to ensure compliance and development of assets for ongoing success and improvement.
* Ensure all personnel properly trained and equipment is in good working order to meet ongoing and future business needs.
* Assure all finish product shipped is in accordance with all quality standards and specifications.
* Effectively manage and reduce energy use at facility.
* Manage local purchasing activities.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High School diploma or GED equivalent.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in a supervisory/ management position in an industrial or plant setting.
* Rendering industry experience is a definite plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred; Engineering degree is an asset.
* Labor relations background and leadership preferred.
* Detail oriented; highly organized.
* Ability to work well with internal staff.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* Self-starter; self-motivated.
* Good math and computer skills.

**Working Environment**
Occasionally = up to 20% Frequently = up to 21% to 50% Constantly - at least 51%
 
 

* Exposed to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environments such as high noise level, strong odors, and/or exposure to heat and cold: Constantly
* Exposed to bio hazardous conditions: Constantly
* Exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals which mandate attention to safety considerations: Constantly
* Exposed to Electrical hazards; risk of electrical shock: Frequently
* Handles or works with potentially dangerous equipment: Constantly

**Physical Demands**
Occasionally = up to 20% Frequently = up to 21% to 50% Constantly - at least 51%
 
 

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position: Frequently
* Must be able to move about inside/outside office or work location: Frequently
* Operates a computer and other office machinery: Frequently
* Must be able to position oneself to maintain computers in the lab, including under desks and in the server closet: Frequently
* Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder: Frequently
* Must be able to use senses to; effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions: Frequently
* Must be able to occasionally lift up to 50lbs

**About Us**
We’re one of the world’s leading practitioners of circularity, transforming materials from the animal agriculture and food industries into valuable ingredients. Ingredients that nourish people, feed animals and crops, and fuel the world with renewable energy.
 
 
**About The Team**
Darling Ingredients is an equal opportunity employer and gives consideration to qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military service, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state and local law.
