role.title: Director, Operations
role.description:
If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country,please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying.

Job area: Managerial

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**
 
In 1976, ten independent haulers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global, yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

 

**Location**: USA - Fort Worth, 9401 Hemphill St

**Division**: Solutions

**Job Posting Title**: Director, Operations

**Time Type**: Full Time

 

**SUMMARY**

The Director of Operations provides overall direction and guidance to the operational activities of the organization. Provides strategic leadership and management to Operations within a large geographic region. The Regional Director of Operations will strive to maximize growth and profitability while responsibly managing the resources of their region according to the company and client expectations and policies. Develops and implements long and short-term strategies to achieve financial and growth targets. Develops emerging talent and successors and creates a work environment that promotes the values of DSV.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for supporting the company strategy including growth and transformational initiatives.
* Develop regional strategies to align with enterprise targets.
* Ensure targets are achieved and local needs are also met.
* Plans and budgets regional financial targets.
* Responsible for ensuring results are achieved against targets.
* Ensure operational excellence within and across our core services.
* Ensures operational excellence through standardization of existing practices, risk assessment and review of key metrics.
* Provides leadership and creates an environment that fosters passion, teamwork and agility within the organization.
* Ensures initiatives are developed and executed in the selection and development of talent and creates an environment that improves associate engagement.
* Build and sustains long-term client relationships.
* Supports local, regional and global sales initiatives by partnering with key clients and delivering a high level of client focus to business initiatives.
* Plans and successfully execute start-up facilities for new business.
* Spearheads teams and partners with clients to trouble-shoot and solve existing issues or problems.
* Contributes as a key member to our sales and solutions team in winning key strategic accounts.
* Develops and implements an operations strategy tailored to our client that identifies opportunities to improve cost control and margin improvement and will lead to organic growth.
* Consistently works within a complex matrixed environment.
* Works collaboratively and establishes solid business relationships with supporting departments including but not limited to: Human Resources, Sales, and Finance.
 

**OTHER DUTIES**

* Performs special projects as required
 

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The Regional Director of Operations directly supervises General Managers.
* Responsible for overall management to achieve client satisfaction.
* Must interpret policies, purposes, and goals of the organization for subordinates.
* Responsible for performance management of direct reports.
* Builds bench strength by leading, developing and challenging operations teams to raise individual and collective performance levels by demonstrating and promoting discretionary effort.
 

**MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and/or Experience

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or logistics or equivalent fields is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ logistics operations management experience with big box", e-commerce or specialty retailers and at least 5 years’ experience as a regional operations leader managing multiple locations.
 

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and/or Experience

* Master’s degree preferred.
* Third-party logistics experience is preferred but not required.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations

* Involvement in relevant professional organizations is desirable
 

**SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES**

Computer Skills

* Strong proficiency in MS Office applications is needed.
* Working knowledge of industry WMS

Language Skills

* English (reading, writing, and verbal)

Mathematical Skills

* Intermediate mathematical, accounting, and financial skills

Other Skills

* Excellent verbal, written and visual/presentation communication skills.
* Must be adept at navigating within a matrixed organizational structure.
* Results-oriented and able to work and meet timelines.
* Ability to work well under pressure and multi-task.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a complex matrix environment across multiple levels within the organization.
* Ability to motivate and inspire others to achieve.
* Ability to question and challenge existing ways of thinking.
* Experience in a “client-centric" environment with accountability for both operations metrics and client relations.
* Must excel at and enjoy teaming with members of the operations team and client representatives to trouble-shoot and solve existing problems.
* Direct experience preparing budgets and actively participating in financial reviews with a solid understanding of standard and actual cost variances
* Has led high-performing teams. Can recruit, develop and motivate superior talent
* Possess the ability to motivate and maintain effective working relationships with staff and partners.
* Ability to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
* Successfully work to reach company goals in an environment in which a wide degree of creativity and latitude is required
* Integration experience with the supply chain industry is helpful
 

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear. The employee uses computer and telephone equipment. Specific vision requirements of this job include close vision and distance vision. May require physical effort associated with using the computer to access information, or occasional standing, walking, lifting needed to carry out everyday activities. Travel may be required for this role domestically.

 

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee rarely is exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

 

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described above are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

For this position, the expected base pay range is $180,000.00 – $200,000.00 Annual. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.

 

Information regarding DSV’s benefits offerings, including eligibility, coverage options, and plan details, is available through the DSV Benefits Showcase. Benefits, programs, and eligibility may vary by location and division in accordance with applicable state and local laws.

 

DSV is an equal employment opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, age, sex, religion, ancestry, disability, veteran status, marital status, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. If you require special assistance or accommodation while seeking employment with DSV, please contact Human Resources at hr@us.dsv.com. If you are interested in learning the status of your application, please note you will be contacted directly by the appropriate human resources contact person if you are selected for further consideration. DSV reserves the right to defer or close a vacancy at any time.

 

**DSV – Global transport and logistics**

**What moves you?**

At DSV, we move more than goods. We move careers, ambitions and opportunities.

 

With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we are the global leader in transport and logistics, and it is our people who bring our services and solutions to life every day. From frontline operations to business functions, every role contributes to keeping supply chains flowing and societies running.

 

Here, you are trusted to take ownership, act on your ideas and make decisions that create real impact. It is a place where people, careers and ideas keep moving forward. We value transparency in how we communicate and collaborate, and we win together by supporting each other, challenging each other and delivering results as a team.

 

**Start here. Go anywhere**

This is our promise of movement. A promise that your work matters, your contribution counts, and your career can move as far as your ambition takes it.

If you are looking to make an impact, grow your career and be part of something bigger, DSV is the place to be.

Visit dsv.com

#StartHereGoAnywhere #LifeAtDSV

role.title: Director, Quality
role.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!
 
 
**Job Description**
**Location:**
Simsbury, CT
 
 
**Reports to:**
VP of Operations
 
 
**Industry:**
Aerospace & Defense
 
 
**Experience Level:**
Director (15+ years)
 
 
**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**
At
**Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),**
we’ve been innovating for nearly
**200 years,**
delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.
 
 
We’re seeking a dynamic
**Director of Quality**
to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.
 
 
**The Opportunity:**
EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
 
 
This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.
 
 
**Core Competencies for Success:**

* Quality & Compliance Leadership: Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.
* Continuous Improvement & Performance: Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* Team Development & Leadership: Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* Collaboration & Influence: Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* Resilience & Adaptability: Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements

* Strong record of measurable quality improvements

role.title: Plant Director
role.description:
**At The Cheesecake Factory Bakery, We Don't Do Ordinary!**
Nothing is scaled down. Not the pride, not the fun, and definitely not the teamwork. Here, you'll lead great people, drive meaningful impact, and help shape the future of our business while supporting the bakery and restaurant teams behind the iconic cheesecakes our guests enjoy every day. That's the kind of culture that has earned us a place on Fortune's 100 Best Companies to Work For® list every year since 2014.

**The Plant Director**
provides strategic and operational leadership for a three-shift, seven-day manufacturing facility encompassing approximately 160 full-time, non-union employees. Leading all aspects of production and packaging operations, you will drive performance, efficiency, quality, and continuous improvement across scheduling, logistics, pre-scaling, mixing, depositing, baking, decorating, and packaging to support the Bakery's operational and business objectives.

They utilize excellent leadership, analytical, management, and technical skills, abilities, and behaviors to drive performance in key areas such as people, safety, quality, service, and cost, aligned with measurable objectives and the Company’s Mission, Vision, and Values. The Director also assists with business continuity in the absence of the VP of Operations.

**You’ll thrive in this position if you are:**

* **Service oriented:**
 you are a people person who is systematic and trustworthy and interacts constructively with peers or teams of various levels demonstrating strong, positive communication skills.
* **Driven by results:**
 you are conscientious and persistent about delivering timely, high-quality deliverables, and performing all job functions safely while following instructions.
* **Improvement focused:**
 you never turn off the thought “how can I do this better/faster”.
* **Pressure resistant:**
 you have ice in your veins while under pressure. Maintaining a positive outlook at work while the heat is on is never an issue for you.

**Here’s more of what you’ll get to do:**

* Maintain positive employee relations through respectful, open, and effective two-way communication at the individual and team levels.
* Partner with human resources and training departments to develop, implement, and maintain effective training and development programs that support performance goals and provide a satisfying work environment.
* Maintain a fair and professional work environment that balances business objectives with quality-of-work-life factors for employees.
* Work with Human Resources to ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies, while driving improvements in employee performance as measured by turnover rate, attendance, and feedback mechanisms.
* Oversee production planning and scheduling to optimize service and efficiency, balancing resources such as crewing, materials, and equipment with other department managers.
* Supervise the development of synchronized crewing, equipment setup, and materials preparation plans to ensure schedule attainment and optimize capacity utilization.
* Manage timekeeping, labor efficiency, and plant productivity in compliance with legal and company policies, aiming to minimize overtime and control non-productive line time.
* Collaborate with the Plant Engineer to ensure preventive and emergency maintenance efforts are effective, minimizing downtime and optimizing machine performance.
* Manage material usage to ensure minimal waste and maximum yield, while maintaining strict adherence to product quality standards and inventory management.
* Monitor spending and manage operations within approved budget levels, while driving improvements in cost performance through labor productivity, waste reduction, and yield maximization.
* Ensure disciplined compliance with product and process quality standards, food safety, and regulatory requirements, striving for “EXCELLENT” or “SUPERIOR” scores in third-party audits.
* Lead plant safety efforts, including co-chairing the Safety Steering Committee, safety inspections, and training, while driving improvements in safety performance as measured by injury frequency and workers' compensation data.
* Participate in business plan development, budgeting processes, and plant-level meetings to ensure effective communication and alignment with operational goals.
* Ability to transform the facility into a CI culture driven by people, process and equipment/technology.
* Ensure the utilization of 4-step process to drive result in sustainability which are Huddles, Daily meeting, utilization of Red Zone and Sic meetings.

**What we require:**

* Minimum of 15 years of experience in food manufacturing management, preferably in the bakery/dessert industry, with demonstrated success at the Plant Manager or Director of Manufacturing/Operations level.
* Bachelor’s degree (MBA a Plus)
* Strong experience with food safety, food process equipment, and regulations.
* Strong experience with emergency preparedness and emergency response plans and procedures.
* Familiar with regulatory and safety codes, including USDA, FDA, and OSHA regulations.
* Knowledge and demonstrated skill in lean manufacturing, Kaizen, kitting, and Six Sigma techniques.
* Prior experience with direct responsibility for a large-scale P&L.
* Strong and effective strategic management skills, including long-range planning, organizing, communicating, influencing, gathering and using information, and motivating a team to achieve results. Ability to use, and teach others to use, various analytical tools and techniques.
* Demonstrated mentoring skills.

**What we offer:**

* Eligible for annual bonus
* Eligible for annual equity grants
* Medical, Dental & Vision
* Eligible for benefits first day of the month following date of hire
* 401K with company match
* 3 weeks of vacation which increases to 4 weeks starting in your 5th year
* 5 days of sick time per year (first year prorated)
* Tuition Reimbursement of $2,500 for qualified programs
* Adoption Assistance Benefit of $2,500
* 25%-35% discount when dining as a guest
* Reusable gift card loaded annually for your dining enjoyment

**About the Company:**

The Cheesecake Factory Bakery creates over 35,000 delicious cheesecakes per day across our two facilities in Calabasas, CA and Rocky Mount, NC plus other baked products for our restaurants, international licensees, and third-party bakery customers.

The Cheesecake Factory Bakery is a subsidiary of The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated. Recognized as a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® since 2014, The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a global $3.8 billion public company with more than 370 casual dining restaurants and over 48,000 staff members.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming workplace for all. We welcome applicants from a wide variety of identities, ideas, perspectives, backgrounds and experiences to apply. The Cheesecake Factory offers reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities.

#SoCheesecake #LifeAtCheesecake

To notify of a non-compliant job posting, please send a notice to ats@thecheesecakefactory.com.

role.title: Director of Operations & Production
role.description:
**Director of Operations & Production**

**Location:**
Redwood City, CA

**Schedule:**
Full-time, onsite

**Industry:**
Precision Manufacturing

**About the Company**

An established precision component solutions provider with a significant manufacturing operation in Redwood City is seeking a Director of Operations & Production. The company serves leading customers across the medical, aerospace, and electronics industries and operates within an ISO 9001/AS9100-certified quality management environment.

The organization is committed to delivering high-quality products, strong customer service, and operational excellence. They believe successful business outcomes begin with strong employees, clear processes, and a culture of accountability.

**About the Role**

The Director of Operations & Production will oversee day-to-day operations and help drive efficiency, productivity, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across the business. This person will manage and support multiple departments, including purchasing, shipping, customer service, production planning, inventory, and operational processes.

The ideal candidate will have a strong manufacturing operations background, sharp business judgment, and experience managing cross-functional teams in a time-sensitive production environment. This role requires someone who can work closely with production leaders, customers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure operational goals are met and company processes run smoothly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily operations across purchasing, shipping, customer service, production planning, inventory, and related operational functions.
* Maintain consistent communication with customers, managers, staff, and vendors to ensure smooth company operations.
* Lead, motivate, and support teams within a fast-paced and demanding manufacturing environment.
* Partner closely with production department managers on scheduling, production execution, technical problem-solving, resource planning, and priorities.
* Develop and oversee production control processes for raw materials and shop floor production.
* Track and respond to changing customer requirements related to pricing, delivery, and production timelines.
* Support quoting activities by providing operational input for new and existing products.
* Develop, implement, and maintain quality management system protocols within operational processes.
* Improve existing processes and procedures to increase internal capacity, productivity, and efficiency.
* Ensure operational activities remain on time and within budget.
* Track staffing needs and support hiring as needed.
* Develop career development plans for direct reports and support team problem resolution.
* Manage data collection and reporting for productivity targets, cost reduction, error reduction, and customer service improvement.
* Work closely with facilities and safety teams to ensure compliance.
* Oversee raw materials and inventory accuracy.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of proven success in an operations management or director-level role.
* Experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably related to precision components, metal parts production, aerospace, medical, electronics, or similar industries.
* Strong ability to delegate responsibilities while maintaining operational control and accountability.
* Experience managing production planning, customer service, purchasing, shipping, inventory, or related operational teams.
* Knowledge of ERP systems used for production planning, work order processing, and material planning.
* Strong understanding of process improvement, operational metrics, and productivity tracking.
* Experience with human resources practices, employee relations, and employment law.
* Strong conflict management and business negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations management, engineering, business administration, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems for small to mid-sized manufacturing businesses.
* Strong IT skills and ability to work with outside managed service providers to support business needs.
* Experience with cost accounting and reporting in a manufacturing environment.

**Work Environment**

This is an onsite role based in Redwood City, CA. The role is primarily office-based with regular interaction on the manufacturing shop floor, including collaboration with production staff and occasional machine or part inspection.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
At East Trailers, we’re looking for a hands-on
**Director of Operations**
who builds strong teams and translates business priorities into safe, reliable and efficient manufacturing performance. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll lead Production, Manufacturing Engineering and Maintenance, driving daily execution and lasting operational improvements.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead manufacturing operations to meet safety, quality, delivery, productivity and cost commitments.
* Establish disciplined daily management, clear priorities and visible performance metrics across production teams.
* Align production schedules, capacity and staffing with customer demand, adapting effectively to changing volumes.
* Drive continuous improvement through standardized work, root-cause problem solving and effective corrective actions.
* Own manufacturing budget execution, improving labor efficiency and managing overtime and operating costs.
* Strengthen preventive maintenance, equipment reliability and facility readiness to support consistent production.

**What we’re looking for**

* A visible, hands-on leader who builds credibility on the shop floor and holds teams accountable.
* A strong commitment to safety, quality and disciplined execution.
* An analytical approach and the ability to turn performance data into clear actions.
* Sound judgment and timely decision-making in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
* Clear communication and effective collaboration across functions.
* The ability to develop leaders, strengthen team capabilities and sustain operational improvements.

**Experience and qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, Operations Management or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.
* 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in complex manufacturing environments.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional operations teams across production, manufacturing engineering and maintenance.
* Demonstrated results improving safety, operational stability, productivity and cost performance.
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, production planning, capacity management and structured problem solving.
* Working knowledge of OSHA requirements and manufacturing safety standards.
* Experience leading in a unionized manufacturing environment is highly preferred.
* Ability to work on-site at our Randolph, Ohio manufacturing facility.

role.title: Operations Director, CAR-T Manufacturing
role.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com
 
 
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
**Job Function**
Supply Chain Manufacturing
 
 
**Job Sub Function**
Plant Management
 
 
**Job Category**
People Leader
 
 
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Raritan, New Jersey, United States of America
 
 
**Job Description**
**About Innovative Medicine**
Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow. Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
 
 
**Learn more at**
**https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine**
We are searching for the best talent for an
**Operations Director, CAR-T Manufacturing**
to join our team in Raritan, NJ.
 
 
Are you interested in joining a team that is positively impacting patients' lives by ensuring reliable delivery of our high quality Innovative Medicine products? Apply today for this exciting opportunity to be part of the #CAR-T team!
 
 
**Summary**
The CAR-T Operations Director is a member of the Raritan CAR-T site leadership team and plays a crucial role in leading the overall operations of the 24/7 manufacturing facility. Working closely with the Site General Manager, you will contribute to the efficient and effective functioning of the manufacturing site by ensuring compliance to cGMP practices while overseeing various aspects of production, personnel, and resource management. The position will lead a team of 6-8 direct reports and a broader organization of approximately 200 shift-based personnel.
 
 
The candidate must be comfortable to working in a matrixed environment, both within Johnson & Johnson and with our collaboration partner, Legend Biotech.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership to Operations Execution and Operations Support organizations, including operators, team leaders, supervisors, investigators and trainers, fostering a positive work environment that empowers employees and promotes high-performance teams.
* Provide leadership to drive effective communication and collaboration across all relevant groups to ensure robust production, testing and release of product to patients.
* Implement KPIs and monitor production processes to ensure efficiency, quality, and adherence to production schedules.
* Drive organizational transformation, operations ramp-up and facility approvals of state-of-the-art cell therapy manufacturing facilities
* Maintain high standards of quality, compliance and safety through leadership by example.
* Build a strategy to develop existing talent through broadening experiences and commitment to delivery to the highest standards. Continue to build bench strength in the operations organization and ensure robust succession planning
* Lead operational planning to manage capacity evolution and technology integration for clinical and commercial manufacturing.
* Drive high-quality and efficiency in management of non-conformances.
* Identify and contribute to the development and execution of initiatives that drive root cause identification, continuous improvement, cost reduction, and increased productivity throughout the manufacturing plant.
* Collaborate with the EHS and Quality teams to maintain high standards of compliance, product quality and workplace safety. Foster a culture of safety, compliance, and accountability across the manufacturing plant.
* Provide representation and leadership in regulatory inspections.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**

* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably with a focus in Science or Engineering. Master’s or higher degree is preferred.

**Required**
**Experience and Skills:**

* Minimum 10 years of combined experience in cGMP manufacturing, operations management, technical transfer, process and equipment validation, quality management or related area is required
* Experience working in a sterile biological/pharmaceutical/cell therapy manufacturing environment is required
* Proven understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP’s) is required
* Strong people leadership including leading direct reports is required
* Relationship/influencing savvy required
* Communicates effectively with people at all levels, including the ability to understand their priorities, and to earn their respect and trust, along with the willingness to provide them with the best decisions in time-sensitive situations required
* Capable of dealing with ambiguity, working and leading in a matrix environment required
* Capable of thriving in a fast-paced growth situation, with ability to adapt to changing environment required
* Ability to balance day to day operational demands with the need to extend and improve the planning horizon to prepare strategically to manage future demands required
* Ability to flex schedule to maintain off-hour communication and connection with 2nd shift employees as needed

**Preferred**

* Lean and Six Sigma Certification

**Other**

* This position is located in Raritan New Jersey and may require up to 10% domestic and international travel.

For more information on how we support the whole health of our employees throughout their wellness, career and life journey, please visit www.careers.jnj.com.
 
 
*If you are under 18 years of age, you (the candidate) may need to obtain the necessary working papers or other documentation required by state law to start the assignment, as well as get a parent’s consent for the background check.*
*Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.*
*Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via*
*https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers*
*, internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.*
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Agile Manufacturing, Business Planning, Developing Others, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Inclusive Leadership, Leadership, Manufacturing Compliance, Manufacturing Safety, Organizational Project Management, Organizing, Plant Operations, Process Improvements, Strategic Supply Chain Management, Tactical Planning
 
 
**The anticipated base pay range for this position is :**
$154,000.00 - $265,650.00
 
 
**Additional Description For Pay Transparency**
Subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees are eligible to participate in the Company’s consolidated retirement plan (pension) and savings plan (401(k)).
 
 
This position is eligible to participate in the Company’s long-term incentive program.
 
 
**Benefits**
Subject to the terms of their respective policies and date of hire, employees are eligible for the following time off benefits:
 
 
Vacation –120 hours per calendar year
 
 
Sick time - 40 hours per calendar year; for employees who reside in the State of Colorado –48 hours per calendar year; for employees who reside in the State of Washington –56 hours per calendar year
 
 
Holiday pay, including Floating Holidays –13 days per calendar year
 
 
Work, Personal and Family Time - up to 40 hours per calendar year
 
 
Parental Leave – 480 hours within one year of the birth/adoption/foster care of a child
 
 
Bereavement Leave – 240 hours for an immediate family member: 40 hours for an extended family member per calendar year
 
 
Caregiver Leave – 80 hours in a 52-week rolling period10 days
 
 
Volunteer Leave – 32 hours per calendar year
 
 
Military Spouse Time-Off – 80 hours per calendar year
 
 
For additional general information on Company benefits, please go to: https://www.careers.jnj.com/employee-benefits

role.description:
**What You Will Get**

* Competitive hourly pay
* Paid weekly
* Opportunity for annual performance increase
* 401K program with employer matching
* Room for growth and career advancement
* Health insurance
* Dental & vision Insurance
* Paid life Insurance
* Paid short term disability
* Paid vacation and sick time
* 11 paid holidays
* Health & Wellness Programs
* Employee Discount Programs

**What You'll Do**

* Own overall plant operations (production, material handling, inventory, and logistics) to meet throughput, quality, and profitability targets.
* Lead safety culture: conduct/oversee daily safety meetings, enforce ARC 100 and company safety programs, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal requirements, including environmental and labor regulations.
* Plan and direct daily operations; monitor workflow and KPIs; identify and implement operational improvements and cost savings.
* Oversee maintenance and reliability: ensure preventive maintenance programs are followed, coordinate repairs and downtime planning, and verify maintenance documentation.
* Supervise, coach, and develop plant personnel; manage scheduling, timekeeping, attendance, performance feedback, and disciplinary actions as needed.
* Communicate routinely with Area Manager, Sales, and Dispatch regarding inbound/outbound materials, quantities, trucking needs, and upcoming work.
* Support customer and vendor relationships; ensure product availability and service meet expectations.
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation; stay current through training and industry best practices.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Experience: 3+ years in aggregate recycling operations or other process/production environment (5+ years and crushing plant equipment experience preferred)
* Ability to work in all weather conditions.
* Ability to stand for extended periods of time at conveyor belt operation.
* Ability to climb heights of 20 feet on a regular basis.
* Ability to lift, carry, and/or pull 50 pounds on a regular basis.
* Ability to work in dusty, wet, and loud environment.
* Required to wear safety equipment including hard hat, safety glasses, goggles, steel toed boots, ear plugs, gloves and various other similar items as required or needed.

*The statements above describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and may be modified to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.*
Arcosa Crushed Concrete is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We activate the potential of our people, care for our customers, optimize operations, integrate sustainability, and promote a results-driven culture aligned with long term value creation.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Great benefits including: Medical, Dental Vision and Life Insurance; Paid Time Off; Paid Holidays; 401k & ESOP; Profit Sharing; Tuition Reimbursement and more!**

**Salary: $90,000 - $100,000**

**Position Summary:**
The Plant Manager is a dynamic and people-focused leader responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the plant while fostering a culture rooted in human-centered leadership. This role emphasizes managing people with empathy and authenticity, celebrating their successes, and cultivating an environment of inclusion and belonging. The RSO Plant Manager is committed to growing and developing a high-performing team while driving operational excellence. Key responsibilities include managing plant operations ensuring the plant is compliant with all safety policies and procedures, driving continuous improvement, and championing Rehrig’s mission and values.

**Key Accountabilities:**

1. **Demonstrate and Ensure Human-Centered Leadership:**
 * Lead with empathy and understanding, prioritizing the well-being and development of all team members.
 * Recognize and celebrate individual and team achievements to foster a positive and motivating work environment.
 * Promote and maintain a workplace culture where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute.
 * Implement and execute the plant’s People Engagement plan
2. **Ensure Compliance with Environmental, Health, Safety & Sustainability (EHS&S):**
 * Perform frequent compliance reviews. Lock out tag out (LOTO) periodic inspections, site safety checklist, EHS&S calendar action items.
 * Perform frequent Behavior Based Safety Observations (BBSOs)
 * Perform frequent 5S inspections to ensure facility is compliant.
 * Monitor Site EHS&S Scorecard and utilize Velocity EHS to identify leading indicators.
3. **Drive Continuous Improvement:**
 * Build continuous improvement activities into the daily work at the plant by involving the team in Kaizen activity. Utilize Kaizen methodology along with other tools such as Plan Do Check Act (PDCA) and A3 to drive continuous improvement.
 * Monitor KPI Metrics to drive decision-making
 * Develop and help manage capital improvement projects
 * Manage and support site CI tracker to analyze efficacy of CI projects
4. **Maintain Operational Excellence:**
 * Oversee plant operations to ensure high standards of Quality and Productivity are consistently met to standard.
 * Operate within Site budget by managing plant resources effectively

**Qualifications:**

* Experienced in plant management or a similar leadership role for at least 3 years.
* High School diploma required or equivalent.
* Experience in driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Commitment to team development and operational excellence.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.

Why Rehrig Pacific?

Rehrig Pacific is a leading manufacturer of integrated sustainable solutions for the supply chain and environmental waste industries with a diverse customer list of industry leaders. We provide end-to-end solutions including returnable plastic products, delivery lifts and sleds, technology to track those assets, and a service team to ensure their longevity. Our team is dedicated to the values, mission, and unique culture within our organization that celebrates our people. We believe in fostering an environment where employees can be their authentic selves and know that they are viewed as integral members of the Rehrig Pacific Family.

Rehrig Pacific Company is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also here.

role.title: Director Advanced Manufacturing
role.description:
About the company

We're an EV commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Orange County, California. We design and build our medium-duty electric vehicles in-house, and next year's production is already fully sold out.

* 1,000+ vehicles built so far
* A 2,000-vehicle order from one of the largest US parcel carriers, due by end of 2027
* $650M+ raised, including a $200M+ Series recently
* Growing beyond trucks into energy storage, autonomy and defense

The role

We've sold out of trucks, and we don't want it to happen again. We're hiring a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to grow our production capacity and own how we get there.

You'll lead the team that designs, buys and launches our new lines and equipment. Your decisions will show up directly in how many trucks leave the factory each month.

What you'll do

* Lead and grow the advanced manufacturing engineering team
* Own the manufacturing strategy and capital plan for scaling production
* Take new lines and equipment from concept through design, build, install, testing and start of production
* Plan capacity so production keeps ahead of customer demand
* Run equipment and facility projects to budget and schedule, and present them to the executive team
* Work closely with vehicle engineering, supply chain and operations so new designs can be built at volume
* Bring in integrators and equipment suppliers, and manage them through delivery

What you'll bring

**Must have**

* 8+ years in manufacturing engineering, with 4+ years leading teams
* A track record of growing production capacity: new lines, factory expansions or ramping to full rate
* Hands-on experience taking equipment from specification through install, testing and launch
* Experience building and managing capital budgets
* A degree in engineering (mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, chemical or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in EV, automotive, commercial vehicles or batteries. High-volume aerospace, heavy equipment or other complex hardware also welcome.
* Start-up or scale-up experience, ideally through early production and ramp-up
* Experience building a new factory from the ground up

role.title: Director of Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
**Director of Manufacturing – Defense & Space | Confidential**

Los Angeles, Southern California – onsite

Up to $325K base (negotiable) + equity + benefits

I’m running a confidential search for a Director of Manufacturing at one of the fastest growing companies in the industry building hardware for defense and space programs.

They’ve proven the tech. Now they need someone to scale production and build the team that does it. You’ll own manufacturing end to end, from first build through to rate production, reporting directly to the COO.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead and grow the manufacturing team, including manufacturing engineering and production
* Take hardware from development builds to repeatable rate production
* Set up the factory, tooling, processes and systems to scale
* Work closely with design engineering so new products are built to be built
* Own schedule, cost and quality on the production floor
* Help shape where the factory goes next

**What you’ll bring**

* 8+ years in manufacturing, including time leading teams
* Experience scaling hardware production in aerospace, defense or space
* A track record of building teams and processes at an early-stage company
* Comfort in a fast-moving environment where you’re hands-on and strategic in the same week
* An active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one

**Why this one**

* A seat at the table at a company with real momentum
* Ownership of the whole build, not one piece of it
* The chance to build the team your way

The client’s confidential, but there’s plenty more I can share on a call. If this sounds like you, or someone you know, send me a message.

role.title: Senior Manager, Quality System & Compliance
role.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.
 
 
Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.
 
 
As the
**Senior Manager of Quality System and Quality (Regulatory) Compliance**
, you are a pivotal leader responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of our Quality Management System (QMS), oversight, and associated tools. You will lead our efforts to ensure robust compliance with national and international medical device regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP. This role is a unique blend of strategic foresight and tactical leadership, requiring a deep expertise in QMS setup and management, particularly for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), with ability to make thoughtful changes and enhance the overall QMS.
 
 
You will lead a high-performing team of quality professionals , championing a "Quality-first" culture and driving data-driven decisions. Your proven track record of navigating complex regulatory landscapes, including
**FDA, PMDA, IEC, EU MDR, and ISO regulations and standards**
, is essential to our success.
 
 
Job Responsibilities:
 
 
Quality Management System (QMS) Oversight
 
 

* Manage holistic aspects of the QMS to ensure compliance with global regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP countries’ requirements.
* Oversee the following key QMS subsystems: CAPA subsystem, Document Control, Training, Management Review, Internal Audits, and External Audit management, QMS Tool Validation, and Supplier Management.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the QMS.

Quality Compliance & Audits
 
 

* Serve as the front room or backroom lead and the primary subject matter expert (SME) for the QMS during audits, including inspections by the FDA, Notified Bodies, and other regulatory authorities.
* Prepare the organization for an appropriate level of quality compliance to U.S. and international requirements to support Heartflow’s global expansion.

Strategic Leadership & Team Development
 
 

* Lead, mentor, and scale a team of QMS professionals, fostering career growth and technical excellence.
* Champion a "Quality-first" mindset throughout the organization, through collaboration and using impactful KPIs to drive accountability and data-driven decisions.
* Collaborate with leaders and partners in R&D, Production, Regulatory, Clinical, and Product Management to integrate quality processes seamlessly, balancing compliance with business objectives.
* Manage departmental resources, including headcount and long-term strategic planning.

Skills Needed:
 
 

* Effective, clear, and concise communication skills bringing clarity to complex topics across the leadership spectrum.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and drive a collaborative quality culture through influence.
* Deep understanding of Quality System and Quality Compliance.
* Experience interacting with auditors, including Notified Body auditors and FDA Investigators.

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:
 
 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality within the medical device industry, with at least 5+ years in a leadership/management role.
* Expert-level knowledge of relevant regulations and standards, including FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of successfully leading or playing a key SME role in regulatory inspections (FDA, Notified Body).
* Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and build consensus among cross-functional senior leaders.

Preferred:
 
 

* Direct experience with AI/ML-driven SaMD and cloud-based medical device platforms.
* Familiarity with medical device cybersecurity standards (e.g., AAMI TIR57) and data privacy regulations.
* Experience with global regulatory submissions (e.g., CE Marking, PMDA).
* Experience implementing and scaling quality processes in a fast-paced and growing environment.

This position has an estimated base salary of $195,000 - $250,000, bonus, and equity. ; LI-Hybrid
 
 
Heartflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at Heartflow, including recruitment, hiring, training, relocation, promotion, and termination.
 
 
Positions posted for Heartflow are not intended for or open to third party recruiters / agencies. Submission of any unsolicited resumes for these positions will be considered to be free referrals.
 
 
Heartflow has become aware of a fraud where unknown entities are posing as Heartflow recruiters in an attempt to obtain personal information from individuals as part of our application or job offer process. Before providing any personal information to outside parties, please verify the following: A) all legitimate Heartflow recruiter email addresses end with “@heartflow.com” and B) the position described is found on our careers site at www.heartflow.com/about/careers/.

role.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
role.description:
Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 65% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!
 
 
**Job Description**
The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.
 
 
Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**
In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:
 
 
Be Curious
 
 

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots
 
 

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High
 
 

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast
 
 

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More
 
 

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations
 
 

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

**Additional Information**
Benefits:
 
 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

role.title: Director of Quality Management
role.description:
Overview:

**Select Specialty Hospital - Cincinnati**

**Critical Illness Recovery Hospital (LTACH)**

**Director of Quality Management**

 

* Bonus incentives
* Extensive onboarding and training program
* Customizable health insurance packages

**Who We Are**

Our hospital is a critical illness recovery hospital committed to providing world-class inpatient post-ICU services to chronic, critically ill patients who require extended healing and recovery. We help patients during some of the most vulnerable, painful moments of their lives – and our team plays a central role in providing compassionate, excellent care every step of the way.

Responsibilities:

We are looking for a valued employee who will be Champions of the Select Medical Way, which includes putting the patient first, helping to improve quality of life for the community in which you live and work, continuing to develop and explore new ideas, providing high-quality care and doing well by doing what is right.

* Coordinating all survey activities to assure that the facility maintains accreditation, certification, and licensure.
* Organizing monthly interdisciplinary QAPI Team meetings with activities, per QAPI Calendar
* Receiving and reviewing quarterly quality improvement reports.
* Assisting the Medical Director and Quality Program Director with development and implementation of medical staff quality improvement activities.
* Leading the hospital team in the performance of RCA, at least annually, and for every level 3-4 incident, unless otherwise indicated.
* Completing monthly quality related data entry, analysis and reporting.
* Focusing on the importance of employee training and education in the work place.
* Working with leadership team to ensure reporting requirements are met.

Qualifications:

You are passionate about providing a superior patient and employee experience. You are an inventive problem solver who thrives in a dynamic environment.

As a leader for your facility, you will collaborate with your CEO, CNO and Human Resources leader to tackle problems and enhance both the employee and patient experience.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Registered Nurse with valid state license. Legacy employees may exist with other clinical licensure.
* Requires experience in at least one of the core areas of responsibility: Quality, Survey Readiness, Risk Management, Infection Control, Employee Health and Education
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including TJC and CARF preferred.

**Preferred qualifications that will make you successful:**

* Bachelors or masters in nursing preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) preferred.

Additional Data:

role.title: Quality/CI Director
role.description:
**Job Summary**

The Quality/CI Director is responsible for overseeing the overall quality management system and lean management systems, including the continuous development, improvement & maturity, and supporting the forward vision & business objectives of the segment. This position will support with a dotted-line, 40+ plant locations, and will work under the general direction of the Regional VPs.

 

**Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

* Oversees the overall quality management systems of the business segments and their impact on our business & customers.
* Oversees the overall continuous improvement program for the business segment through standardized practices, training, meeting improvement objectives, and continuing to mature our systems and capabilities.
* Assist the plant locations in maintaining compliance with the quality management system to ISO9001 requirements and sustaining our certification status.
* Assist quality & CI training to plant quality managers/coordinators as turnover occurs.
* Drive standardization into our quality management & lean management systems, ensuring best & consistent practices.
* Assist with new methodologies & technologies which impact quality & improvements (such as software & SCADA systems).
* Support onboarding of new and strategic customers within PPAP processes.
* Provide training & training material for the CI program & initiatives. Serve as coach & mentor for improvement projects.
* Host regional CI progress meetings with each region to help support progress & best practices.
* Take initiative on developing next steps & objectives to evolve & mature the effectiveness of our systems and provide necessary training.
Provide high level analysis from data/metrics of how effective our systems are and make recommendations and/or take action for improvement. 

 

**Qualifications**

* CQE ( *certified quality engineer* ) Certification Preferred or equivalent discipline body of knowledge.
* Minimum of five years of experience in Quality manufacturing environment is required.
* Working knowledge of ISO9001 QMS systems, and preferred understanding of IATF 16949 (formerly TS) & AIAG practices.
* Working knowledge of Quality Science applications.
* High-level understanding of lean concepts & applications.
* Six Sigma Black Belt preferred
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Access. NOTE! Must be proficient with charts & statistical formulas/templates in Excel.
Manager-level leadership knowledge/experience. 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

role.title: Director of Manufacturing
role.description:
**Company Overview:**

Adams Communication & Engineering Technology (ACET), Incorporated is a Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB) system engineering and information technology firm. Incorporated in 1999, we support mission critical Information Technology (IT) business needs for clients within the intelligence community (IC), Department of Defense (DOD), Veteran Administration (VA) and for select commercial clients. ACET, Inc.’s technical, programmatic, and analytical professionals are experts in commercial technology, customized solutions, and proprietary government systems.

**The Position:**

ACET is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Director of Manufacturing** to lead all production, fabrication, assembly, and shop-floor operations at our **Havelock, NC** facility. Reporting directly to executive leadership, the Director of Manufacturing will oversee day-to-day plant performance, drive operational excellence, ensure strict adherence to DoD quality and safety standards, and partner closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to deliver defense projects on time and within budget.

**Responsibilities:**

* Direct all daily manufacturing, machining, fabrication, and assembly operations in Havelock to meet customer delivery schedules, cost targets, and quality specifications.
* Partner with Program Managers and Engineering teams to transition designs from rapid prototyping and Engineering Manufacturing Development (EMD) into Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) and full-rate sustainment.
* Enforce compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, and Department of Defense manufacturing standards, ensuring zero-defect delivery and full audit readiness.
* Lead, mentor, and schedule production supervisors, machinists, technicians, and quality personnel; foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high retention.
* Implement Lean, Six Sigma, and 5S methodologies to optimize shop-floor workflow, reduce cycle times, minimize scrap, and control overhead rates.
* Collaborate with Procurement and Contracts to manage long-lead materials, vendor bottlenecks, equipment maintenance, and capital expenditure planning.
* Maintain a safe, OSHA-compliant manufacturing environment while upholding all DoD physical security and classified material handling protocols.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related technical field (or equivalent military/industry leadership experience).
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 3–5 years in a Plant Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Director-level role within the aerospace, defense, or government contracting sector.
* Proven expertise in precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, electro-mechanical assembly, ERP/MRP systems, and reading complex engineering drawings/blueprints.
* Hands-on experience operating under ISO 9001 and/or AS9100 quality management systems.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must hold an active DoD Secret security clearance (or have the ability to obtain and maintain one).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience supporting NAVAIR, Fleet Readiness Center East (FRC East), or USMC/DoD aviation sustainment programs.
* Certification in Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt).
* Experience managing manufacturing operations within a small-to-midsize defense contractor environment, including familiarity with FAR/DFARS compliance and government-furnished property (GFP).

**Why Join ACET:**

ACET continues to expand its aerospace and aviation sustainment operations supporting multiple Department of Defense aviation platforms worldwide. This position provides the opportunity to directly shape strategic sustainment growth initiatives while supporting operational readiness and mission success across the global aviation enterprise.

**What We Offer:**

At ACET, we believe that our employees are our most valuable asset. We are committed to providing a comprehensive Total Rewards program that recognizes and supports the diverse needs of our workforce. Our offerings are designed to attract, motivate, and retain top talent while fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and well-being.

Employee benefits include the following:

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* Life insurance, AD&D, and Short- and Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) Program
* Wellness programs
* Paid Time Off
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Employee Referral Program
* Employee Assistance Program

*Please note that all compensation, benefits, and policies are subject to change at the company's discretion. While we make every effort to provide advance notice of changes, adjustments may occur based on business needs, economic conditions, and industry standards.*

**\*\*Must be US Citizen to apply\*\***

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position.

**Drug Free Workplace:**

ACET is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria are met as outlined in our policies.

**ACET is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer and VEVRAA Federal Contractor**.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
