role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Manager of Quality is responsible for establishing and leading all quality activities for a complex aerospace development program from prototype through production readiness. This role serves as the primary quality leader embedded within the program team and partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Flight Test, and Program Management to ensure products are designed, developed, tested, and transitioned to production with quality, reliability, and mission success as foundational objectives.

The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.

This position requires balancing speed of development with disciplined engineering rigor to support aggressive program schedules while ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.

What you'll do:

 - Development Quality Leadership

 - Serve as the quality leader for XBAT development.

 - Establish quality strategy, objectives, and metrics aligned with program milestones.

 - Integrate quality requirements into the product development lifecycle.

 - Ensure quality considerations are incorporated during system architecture, design reviews, verification, validation, and qualification activities.

 - Partner with Engineering leadership to identify and mitigate technical and programmatic risks.

 - Drive a culture of proactive quality and continuous improvement throughout the program.

Design & Configuration Quality

 - Ensure quality requirements are appropriately captured in product definitions, specifications, and design documentation.

 - Participate in design reviews, change control boards, and configuration management activities.

 - Ensure full configuration and traceability for all material installed into prototype aircraft.

 - Evaluate engineering changes for quality and production readiness impacts.

 - Support requirements verification and validation planning.

 - Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-quality, and design-for-reliability initiatives.

Risk Management & Reliability

 - Lead quality participation in program risk management activities.

 - Establish and maintain FRACAS processes for development and flight test phases of the program.

 - Facilitate root cause and corrective action investigations for design, manufacturing, supplier, and field failures.

 - Support reliability growth planning and execution.

 - Monitor defect trends, failure modes, and reliability metrics to identify systemic risks.

Verification, Validation & Test Quality

 - Develop quality oversight strategies for laboratory, ground, and flight test activities.

 - Ensure test results, anomalies, and nonconformances are appropriately documented and dispositioned.

 - Support qualification and certification efforts.

 - Establish processes for managing test escapes, failures, and corrective actions.

Nonconformance & Corrective Action Management

 - Lead Material Review Board activities for development hardware.

 - Establish scalable processes for nonconformance management.

 - Drive root cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.

 - Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions.

 - Track effectiveness of corrective actions through closure.

Production Readiness & Industrialization

 - Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to transition products from prototype to production.

 - Define quality requirements for production readiness reviews.

 - Support development of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and control strategies.

 - Ensure lessons learned from development are incorporated into production processes.

 - Lead quality planning activities supporting low-rate initial production and rate increases.

Quality Management System

 - Develop and implement quality processes supporting aerospace development programs.

 - Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and internal procedures.

 - Drive continuous improvement of development quality processes.

 - Support internal and external audits as required.

 - Establish scalable systems that support future production growth.

Leadership & Team Development

 - Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.

 - Recruit and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.

 - Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.

 - Promote a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.

 - Develop organizational capabilities to support future company growth.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.

 - 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, space, or other highly regulated industries.

 - 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical quality organizations.

 - Experience supporting complex product development programs from concept through production transition.

 - Strong knowledge of quality systems, engineering development processes, and aerospace manufacturing.

 - Experience leading root cause investigations and corrective action programs.

 - Experience with risk management, reliability engineering, and failure analysis.

 - Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience supporting UAV, aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology programs.

 - Experience leading quality organizations during rapid company growth.

 - Background in systems engineering, reliability engineering, or development engineering.

 - Experience with flight test programs and qualification testing.

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.

 - Familiarity with government defense programs and customer quality requirements.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

At Shield AI, we’re building advanced autonomous aircraft that are redefining what is possible, and we are looking for a Staff Quality Engineer to help ensure our products meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety. In this role, you will lead quality initiatives across the product lifecycle, driving improvements from early design and new product introduction through full-rate production.

 

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust quality systems in alignment with AS9100 standards, leading root cause investigations and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. You will partner closely with engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams to identify risks, improve process capability, and ensure consistent product quality. Your work will include supporting NPI efforts, establishing control plans and inspection strategies, and using data-driven methods to monitor and improve manufacturing performance.


As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping quality strategy, mentoring team members, and influencing cross-functional decisions without direct authority. This is an opportunity to work hands on with next generation aerospace technology and contribute directly to the delivery of highly reliable autonomous systems that will define the future of aviation.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)

 - 5+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering roles

 - Demonstrated experience leading root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions (RCA/CAPA)

 - Strong knowledge of quality systems and standards (AS9100 or similar)

 - Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) and scaling production in a manufacturing environment

 - Proficiency in statistical analysis and process control methods (SPC, capability analysis, etc.)

 - Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lean Six Sigma certification, or equivalent

 - Knowledge of design for quality principles, including DFMEA, tolerance analysis, and design reviews

 - Experience working with quality and manufacturing systems (QMS, MES, PLM) and data analysis tools

 - Familiarity with advanced inspection or test methods (metrology, NDT, automated inspection, etc.)

role.title: Director, Ops Analysis (R5036)
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shield AI is building intelligent autonomy systems for the defense of service members and civilians. The Hivemind Solutions organization applies Shield AI’s autonomy stack to mission-critical systems across air, maritime, strike, weapons, space, and collaborative autonomy domains.

We are seeking a Director, Operations Analysis to lead a team responsible for turning operational problems into quantitative insights that shape product strategy, engineering priorities, customer engagement, and mission outcomes. This leader will manage and grow a high-performing Operations Analysis team that uses modeling, simulation, wargaming, campaign analysis, and mission-level trade studies to help determine what Hivemind should build, why it matters, and how it performs in realistic operational contexts.

This is a leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of autonomy, military operations, mission engineering, modeling and simulation, product strategy, and customer-facing analysis. The right candidate will be technically credible, analytically rigorous, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to translate complex operational questions into clear recommendations for executives, engineers, business development leaders, and government customers.

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead and manage the Hivemind Solutions Operations Analysis team, including hiring, mentoring, prioritization, performance management, and technical direction.

 - Build an operations analysis capability that directly informs Hivemind product strategy, autonomy roadmap decisions, customer pursuits, and program execution.

 - Define and execute mission analysis, campaign analysis, force-on-force studies, CONOPS evaluations, and operational trade studies across multiple Hivemind product domains.

 - Partner with Product, Architecture, Systems Engineering, Business Development, Strategy, and Program teams to translate operational problems into analytical studies and actionable product recommendations.

 - Develop analysis plans that connect mission objectives, operational assumptions, threat environments, system performance, autonomy behaviors, and measurable mission outcomes.

 - Guide the use of tools such as AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, custom simulations, and other modeling environments to evaluate mission effectiveness and operational value.

 - Establish standards for analytical rigor, model credibility, assumption tracking, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty characterization, and communication of results.

 - Create clear, executive-ready briefings that explain what was analyzed, what assumptions were made, what the results mean, and what decisions should follow.

 - Support customer engagements by developing compelling, technically grounded analysis that demonstrates the operational value of Hivemind-enabled systems.

 - Work with engineering teams to identify the autonomy behaviors, system capabilities, interfaces, performance parameters, and test data needed to improve model fidelity.

 - Help shape product requirements by connecting operational outcomes to measurable system and autonomy performance needs.

 - Build reusable analysis frameworks, scenarios, vignettes, and metrics that can scale across programs and domains.

 - Represent the Operations Analysis function in internal technical reviews, roadmap discussions, capture strategy sessions, and customer-facing meetings.

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, computer science, physics, aerospace, systems engineering, data science, or a related technical field.

 - 10+ years of relevant experience in operations analysis, mission analysis, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, military analysis, campaign analysis, or related technical domains.

 - 5+ years of experience leading teams, projects, or technical analysis efforts.

 - Experience using modeling and simulation to inform real product, system, program, or operational decisions.

 - Strong understanding of military operations, mission planning, force employment, kill chains, sensing, communications, autonomy, aircraft systems, weapons systems, or related defense concepts.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous operational questions into structured analysis plans, quantitative methods, and decision-quality outputs.

 - Experience working with engineering, product, business development, strategy, or customer-facing teams.

 - Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and customers with clarity, confidence, and analytical discipline.

 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and analysis must support real business and technical decisions.

 - U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Master’s degree or PhD in operations research, engineering, applied mathematics, data science, aerospace, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Experience with AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, Cameo, custom simulation environments, or other mission and campaign analysis tools.

 - Experience analyzing autonomous systems, collaborative autonomy, uncrewed aircraft, crewed-uncrewed teaming, electronic warfare, space systems, missile systems, maritime systems, or air combat operations.

 - Experience supporting defense product development, advanced concepts, government capture efforts, experimentation, test planning, or mission engineering.

 - Familiarity with model validation, verification, credibility assessment, sensitivity analysis, design of experiments, and uncertainty quantification.

 - Experience building analysis teams, establishing technical standards, and scaling analytical capabilities across multiple stakeholders or product lines.

 - Prior military, government laboratory, FFRDC/UARC, defense contractor, or aerospace experience.

 - Active U.S. security clearance.

What success looks like:

 - In this role, success means the Operations Analysis team becomes a trusted decision engine for Hivemind Solutions. The team’s work should not sit on a shelf. It should shape what we build, how we prioritize, how we explain operational value to customers, and how we make hard trade decisions across product lines.
 
 A successful manager will build a team that is technically rigorous, operationally grounded, fast-moving, and deeply connected to the business. They will ensure that analysis is not treated as an after-the-fact briefing function, but as a core part of product development, strategy, and customer engagement.

Why this role matters:

 - Autonomy changes what is operationally possible, but only if we understand where it creates real mission advantage. The Operations Analysis team helps answer that question. This team connects Hivemind’s technical capabilities to measurable operational outcomes, helping Shield AI make better product decisions and helping customers understand the mission impact of intelligent autonomous systems.
 
 If you want to lead a team that sits at the center of autonomy, strategy, engineering, and operational decision-making, this role is for you.

role.title: Staff Engineer, Quality Assurance (R5358)
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shield AI is seeking a Quality Assurance to support the development and flight test of the X-BAT program. This role is heavily embedded with flight test and engineering operations and is responsible for ensuring test articles are properly configured, inspected, documented, and ready for safe and effective ground and flight testing.You will work closely with flight test, systems, design, manufacturing, test engineering, and program teams to identify and manage quality risks, resolve discrepancies, maintain configuration and traceability, and ensure test activities are executed in accordance with engineering requirements and approved processes.

What you'll do:

 - Support ground and flight test readiness, including hardware inspections, configuration verification, test article acceptance, and review of test documentation

 - Work directly with flight test and engineering teams to identify, document, and resolve hardware, configuration, process, and test discrepancies

 - Review engineering drawings, specifications, test procedures, work instructions, configuration records, and acceptance criteria

 - Ensure test articles meet applicable engineering, quality, safety, and configuration requirements before testing

 - Support execution of ground and flight test activities, including inspections, test point readiness, discrepancy resolution, and post-test evaluations

 - Manage nonconformances, test discrepancies, and quality records through appropriate containment, investigation, disposition, and corrective action

 - Lead or support root cause analysis and corrective actions for product, process, and test-related issues

 - Identify emerging quality risks and work with engineering and test teams to implement practical mitigations

 - Analyze test and quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve development and test processes

 - Support configuration management and traceability of developmental hardware, assemblies, and test articles

 - Ensure objective evidence and quality records are complete and support product and test requirements

 - Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, and disciplined execution in developmental test operation

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, technology, quality, or related field, or equivalent experience supporting developmental test operations

 - 5+ years of experience supporting developmental and/or operational ground or flight test 

 - Experience working directly with developmental aircraft, complex aerospace hardware, or mission-critical systems

 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, bills of materials, test procedures, work instructions, and acceptance requirements

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced developmental test environment with changing requirements and priorities

 - Willingness to work outdoors at test ranges and travel as required

 - Overtime, evening, and weekend coverage as required by flight test operations

Preferred qualifications:

 - 10+ years of experience supporting developmental or operational flight test

 - Experience with unmanned aircraft, prototype aircraft, weapons systems, or other mission-critical aerospace systems

 - Experience with flight test readiness, test article acceptance, configuration verification, or post-test inspection

 - Working knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace/defense quality requirements

 - Experience with MRB, NCR, RCCA, CAPA, and other quality processes

 - Experience with configuration management and engineering change processes

 - Familiarity with inspection and measurement methods used for aerospace hardware

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma, or related certification

role.title: Senior Staff Engineer, ML Ops (R4941)
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

 

Shield AI builds autonomy systems for defense applications, including air, maritime, and space platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

We are building the AI Factory Reference Architecture, a Kubernetes-native platform for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying next-generation AI systems.

The AI Factory serves two purposes. Internally, it powers autonomy development across Hivemind and other AI programs. Externally, it becomes the reference architecture deployed into customer environments, spanning commercial cloud, on-premise infrastructure, sovereign deployments, and fully air-gapped systems.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to help define and build this platform. You will partner closely with ML researchers, platform engineers, and autonomy teams to deliver an exceptional developer experience for training and deploying modern AI models.

Success in this role requires balancing researcher productivity, platform simplicity, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability. You will work hands-on across the stack, helping shape both the platform architecture and its implementation while staying closely aligned with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - AI Platform Development: Lead the design and implementation of the AI Factory Reference Architecture, delivering a Kubernetes-native platform for AI development, distributed training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment.

 - AI Research Enablement: Partner directly with ML researchers to understand evolving training workflows and ensure the platform supports state-of-the-art AI frameworks, foundation model development, reinforcement learning, distributed training, and emerging research workflows.

 - Developer Experience: Design self-service AI development workflows that enable engineers to move seamlessly from local experimentation to large-scale distributed execution using familiar open source tools and frameworks.

 - Distributed AI Infrastructure: Build the infrastructure required to support distributed training, simulation, inference, and reinforcement learning workloads. Evaluate and integrate orchestration, scheduling, and resource management technologies to maximize scalability and developer productivity.

 - Compute Platform: Design and optimize shared GPU infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. Improve resource utilization, scheduling efficiency, storage, networking, observability, and overall platform reliability.

 - Data & Model Lifecycle: Build platform capabilities that enable dataset management, experiment tracking, artifact management, model versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement.

 - Platform Distribution: Develop repeatable deployment and lifecycle management solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices. Support commercial cloud, customer-managed infrastructure, sovereign environments, and fully air-gapped deployments.

 - Technology Leadership: Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and establish architectural patterns that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, autonomy teams, infrastructure engineers, and product teams to ensure the platform evolves alongside customer needs and advances in AI.

Key Outcomes:

 - 

 - Engineers move from idea to distributed training in hours instead of days.

 - High GPU utilization through efficient scheduling with KAI on Kubernetes.

 - Researchers use modern AI tooling without unnecessary platform friction.

 - AI Workspaces become the standard development environment across autonomy programs.

 - Training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment operate as a unified platform.

 - The AI Factory Reference Architecture can be deployed consistently across cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped environments.

 - Platform capabilities are reusable across multiple autonomy programs and customer deployments.

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience building Kubernetes-native AI or MLOps platforms supporting distributed machine learning workloads.

 - Deep understanding of modern AI training frameworks, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and distributed training techniques.

 - Experience operating GPU-accelerated infrastructure and distributed training systems.

 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, networking, security, storage, and distributed systems.

 - Experience with GPU scheduling concepts and large-scale AI workloads.

 - Experience packaging and deploying cloud-native infrastructure using Terraform and Helm.

 - Strong software engineering skills in Python and Golang and modern cloud-native technologies.

 - Experience collaborating closely with ML researchers to translate research workflows into scalable platform capabilities.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience with Ray or other distributed AI orchestration frameworks.

 - Experience with KAI, Slurm or other GPU scheduling technologies.

 - Experience supporting reinforcement learning, simulation-driven training, robotics, or autonomy workloads.

 - Experience deploying and optimizing AI models for edge hardware.

 - Experience designing infrastructure for classified, sovereign, or air-gapped environments.

 - Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.

 - Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure projects.

Why Join Us

 - The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.
 
 As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will help build the reference architecture used internally by our engineering teams and delivered to customers building their own AI capabilities. Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.
 
 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of modern AI, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and defense, building a platform that enables the next generation of autonomy systems while leveraging the best of the open-source AI ecosystem.

Job Description:

As a Staff Composites Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution. 

What You'll Do:

 - 

 - Act as a technical leader across programs, owning the design and optimization of high-impact manufacturing processes. 

 - Drive the scale-up of our flagship product line, balancing throughput, quality, and cost. 

 - Lead the manufacturing engineering effort for launching a new production line for a larger and more capable jet. 

 - Develop CPD/Fibersim definitions & producibility assessments for composite parts.

 - Scope and deploy critical production infrastructure, including manufacturing equipment, tooling, and hardware/software systems. 

 - Engage with vendors to source and integrate capital equipment, production tools, and automation systems. 

 - Mentor engineers and production personnel to build organizational capability and technical depth. 

 - Champion cross-functional initiatives that standardize and improve manufacturing performance at scale. 

Required Qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor’s degree in  Engineering, or a related field, or relevant experience.

 - 7+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, with a focus in rapid growth environments.

 - Proficiency in CAD software (Solidwork, NX, or CATIA).

 - Experience with Composite Part Design (CPD), or Fibersim, and Generative Shape Design (GSD).

 - Experience in owning the scale of production processes in a startup or rapid-growth environment.

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing composites processes, including machining, lamination, and/or assembly.

 - Experience with process improvement methodologies, such as Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma.

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001.

 - Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as additive manufacturing or automation systems.

 - Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and data-driven decision-making in a manufacturing context.

role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Staff Electromechanical Systems Advance Manufacturing Engineer to support the manufacturing and integration of complex motion-control and mechanically actuated systems across advanced aerospace and defense platforms. This role focuses on electromechanical assemblies involving actuators, hydraulics, pneumatics, motors, pumps, and integrated mechanical/electrical subsystems. 

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced production environments and has experience developing robust manufacturing processes for highly integrated systems. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead manufacturing engineering efforts for electromechanical subsystems and assemblies 

 - Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 

 - Actuators 

 - Motors and drives 

 - Hydraulic systems 

 - Pneumatic systems 

 - Pumps and fluid systems 

 - Powertrain components 

 - Motion-control assemblies 

 - Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 

 - Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for electromechanical manufacturing issues 

 - Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  

 - Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews 

 - Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 

 - Support system integration, validation, and troubleshooting activities 

 - Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 

 - Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 

 - Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 

 - Mentor junior manufacturing engineers

Tools & skills:

 - 

 - MES & QMS systems

 - 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems

 - Supplier manufacturing processes

 - 5S/visual management

 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in experience in electromechanical systems 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Experience with:  

 - Actuators and motion systems  

 - Hydraulics and pneumatics  

 - Mechanical/electrical integration  

 - Precision mechanical assemblies 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

 - Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  

 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  

 - Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies  

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Aerospace, defense, robotics, or automotive industry experience  

 - Experience with servo systems and motor control assemblies  

 - Knowledge of GD&T and mechanical inspection methods  

 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing and production optimization 

 - Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 

 - Proficiency in CAD software

role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Staff Advance Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Define the Bill of Process and manufacturing sequence for assigned subassemblies or cells.

 - Map MBOM to operations, tooling needs, and process controls.

 - Build ergonomic workstations (height/reach zones, shadow boards, calibrated torque tools, ESD controls, POU materials).

 - Create visual, operator-ready Work Instructions with torque specs, PPE, inspection points, and MES revision control.

 - Conduct time studies, compute takt/CT, identify bottlenecks, and lead kaizen improvements.

 - Establish standardized work, visual controls, job aids, and layered audit systems; iterate with operators.

 - Capture shop-floor lessons learned defects, build issues, tooling feedback and drive root cause and corrective action.

 - Partner with Quality on in-process checks, error-proofing, and FAI readiness.

 - Implement ECOs, validate process updates, and maintain work instructions accordingly.

 - Tools & Skills: MES/QMS systems, torque analyzers, Minitab/Excel (SPC, capability, DOE), lean/5S, PFMEA, ergonomic assessment tools, Control Plans, Standard Operating Procedures. 

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Currently hold a Secret clearance required 

 - 7+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production systems, process development, or assembly engineering.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Mechatronics, or related STEM field.

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment.

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including machining, composites, avionics and/or assembly.

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001.

 - Proficiency in CAD software

 - Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as additive manufacturing or automation systems.

 - Hands-on experience with manufacturing equipment and tooling design.

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

role.title: Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Automation Equipment
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Staff Manufacturing Engineer to lead the design and implementation of production automation equipment for advanced manufacturing. This engineer will own the technical scope from process definition and analytical sizing through concept development, detailed design, system integration, FAT, installation, SAT, production ramp, and handoff. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Develop analytical models for takt time, cycle time, OEE, capacity, buffers, labor, utilities, reliability, and overall automation-system performance.

 - Research and qualify advanced automation technologies that improve manufacturability, process capability, throughput, safety, and maintainability.

 - Lead process definition, concept development, and detailed engineering design for automation cells, tooling, fixtures, robot end effectors, motion systems, material handling, guarding, and service access.

 - Develop RFQs, equipment and functional specifications, interface requirements, procedures, verification plans, and FAT/SAT acceptance protocols.

 - Define integrated mechanical, electrical, controls, robot, vision, servo-motion, recipe, traceability, fault-recovery, and Digital Factory interface requirements.

 - Own automation projects from design reviews through risk-mitigation planning, build, debug, installation, commissioning, ramp, and production handoff.

 - Execute PFMEA, control-plan development, MSA, capability studies, fault-recovery testing, FAT, SAT, and rate demonstrations.

 - Troubleshoot equipment and process failures, implement corrective actions, and improve quality, availability, MTBF, MTTR, and lifecycle support. 

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

 - 10+ years designing, developing, integrating, or commissioning industrial automation equipment.

 - Strong mechanical design experience with machinery, tooling, fixtures, GD&T, tolerance analysis, servo mechanisms, pneumatics, hydraulics, guarding, and machine safety.

 - Working knowledge of Siemens PLCs, HMIs, FANUC robots, PROFINET and PROFIsafe, machine vision, servo systems, and manufacturing-data interfaces.

 - Proficiency with Siemens NX, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar CAD tools and the ability to review electrical and controls documentation.

 - Experience leading system integrators and complex automation projects from concept through production handoff while managing technical scope, schedule, risk, and supplier performance.

 - Working knowledge of applicable OSHA, NFPA, UL, ANSI, and ISO Standards. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Experience with automated electromechanical assembly, servo-press, calibration, functional-test, hydraulic-test, or endurance-test systems.

 - Experience with automated cutting, forming, welding, cleaning, leak-test, or pressure-test equipment.

 - Experience with robotic coating, mixing and dispensing, cure-control, or inspection systems.

 - Experience with automated drilling, fastening, sealant dispensing, metrology, or large-assembly handling,  

 - Experience with Digital Factory interfaces, serialized genealogy, and equipment-data integration.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

At Shield AI, we’re building advanced autonomous aircraft that are redefining what is possible, and we are looking for a Staff Quality Engineer to help ensure our products meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety. In this role, you will lead quality initiatives across the product lifecycle, driving improvements from early design and new product introduction through full-rate production.

 

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust quality systems in alignment with AS9100 standards, leading root cause investigations and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. You will partner closely with engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams to identify risks, improve process capability, and ensure consistent product quality. Your work will include supporting NPI efforts, establishing control plans and inspection strategies, and using data-driven methods to monitor and improve manufacturing performance.


As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping quality strategy, mentoring team members, and influencing cross-functional decisions without direct authority. This is an opportunity to work hands on with next generation aerospace technology and contribute directly to the delivery of highly reliable autonomous systems that will define the future of aviation.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)

 - 5+ years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering roles

 - Demonstrated experience leading root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions (RCA/CAPA)

 - Strong knowledge of quality systems and standards (AS9100 or similar)

 - Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) and scaling production in a manufacturing environment

 - Proficiency in statistical analysis and process control methods (SPC, capability analysis, etc.)

 - Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lean Six Sigma certification, or equivalent

 - Knowledge of design for quality principles, including DFMEA, tolerance analysis, and design reviews

 - Experience working with quality and manufacturing systems (QMS, MES, PLM) and data analysis tools

 - Familiarity with advanced inspection or test methods (metrology, NDT, automated inspection, etc.)

role.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Advanced Manufacturing
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

As a Senior Staff Advance Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution.

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Define the Bill of Process and manufacturing sequence for assigned subassemblies or cells. 

 - Map MBOM to operations, tooling needs, and process controls. 

 - Build ergonomic workstations (height/reach zones, shadow boards, calibrated torque tools, ESD controls, POU materials). 

 - Create visual, operator-ready Work Instructions with torque specs, PPE, inspection points, and MES revision control. 

 - Conduct time studies, compute takt/CT, identify bottlenecks, and lead kaizen improvements. 

 - Establish standardized work, visual controls, job aids, and layered audit systems; iterate with operators. 

 - Capture shop-floor lessons learned defects, build issues, tooling feedback and drive root cause and corrective action. 

 - Partner with Quality on in-process checks, error-proofing, and FAI readiness. 

 - Implement ECOs, validate process updates, and maintain work instructions accordingly. 

 - Tools & Skills: MES/QMS systems, torque analyzers, Minitab/Excel (SPC, capability, DOE), lean/5S, PFMEA, ergonomic assessment tools, Control Plans, Standard Operating Procedures. 

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 10+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production systems, process development, or assembly engineering. 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Mechatronics, or related STEM field. 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including machining, composites, avionics and/or assembly. 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001. 

 - Proficiency in CAD software 

 - Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as additive manufacturing or automation systems. 

 - Hands-on experience with manufacturing equipment and tooling design. 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines

role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production. 

The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.  

What you'll do:

Development Program Materials Planning  

 - Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy. 

 - Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.   

 - Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy. 

 - Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule. 

 - Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans. 

 - Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.   

 - Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.   

 - Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions. 

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness  

 - Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.   

 - Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.   

 - Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.   

 - Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.   

Team Leadership  

 - Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.   

 - Establish standard work and training programs.   

 - Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.   

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.   

 - 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.   

 - Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.   

 - Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.   

 - Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.   

 - Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.   

 - Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.   

 - Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.   

 - U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.   

 - Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.   

 - Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.   

 - APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.   

 - Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.   

 - Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.   

 - Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.   

Why Shield AI:

At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.

role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Senior Lead Operational Analyst to contribute to the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s aircraft systems. In this role, you will perform analysis at the component, system, mission and campaign levels to evaluate the effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our aircraft across multiple domains, missions and applications. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and defense stakeholders to assess system performance, inform design trade-offs, and improve mission outcomes. 


This position requires a strong working knowledge of military operations, modeling & simulation (M&S), data science, and operational analysis techniques. Your analyses will directly support product decisions and customer engagements by helping demonstrate how Shield AI’s AI-powered platforms perform in realistic and contested operational environments. 

What you'll do:

 - Plan, own and execute operational analyses to assess the effectiveness of autonomous systems in representative military scenarios.

 - Develop and run modeling, simulation, and wargaming analyses to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational findings into actionable system insights.

 - Perform trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance across varying operational conditions, assumptions, and threat environments.

 - Build, modify, and analyze mission-level models using tools such as AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python, or similar M&S frameworks.

 - Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor performance, and autonomy-enabled behaviors to support mission effectiveness assessments.

 - Engage with DoD stakeholders, operators, and analysts to understand mission needs and operational constraints.

 - Contribute to the development and refinement of concepts of operations (CONOPS) for AI-enabled aircraft capabilities.

 - Monitor emerging threats and operational challenges relevant to autonomous and air combat systems.

 - Prepare technical documentation, analysis reports, and briefings for internal teams, customers, and government stakeholders. 

 - Apply modern compute and development best practices (e.g., version control, scripting, scalable compute workflows, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable analysis pipelines.

 - Be a force multiplier by coaching and developing incoming talent.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering or math domain.

 - Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation, operations research, or related defense or aerospace roles.

 - Active Secret at a minimum.  

 - Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
 
 - Experience with evaluating strategic development and analysis goals for multi-mission/multi-domain applicability.

 - Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, tools (Brawler, ESAMS, etc.), Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
 
 - Experience leading a product effort from pre-shaping to tactical deployment

 - Prior experience in systems engineering product development lifecycle (SysML or MBSE preferred)
 
 -  Experience developing technical expertise in a team to execute analyses for system design and analysis.

 - Preferred Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

ABOUT SHIELD AI:

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We’re looking for a hands-on manufacturing leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production. 

You will lead prototype build execution and the manufacturing setup of our new Seattle-area facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll build the production team, establish the factory’s operating system and deliver the readiness needed to scale aircraft production safely, reliably and efficiently. 

This role carries accountability across the full journey: turning lessons from development builds into a repeatable production system, then leading that operation against safety, quality, delivery and cost commitments. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management to make that happen. 

What you'll do:

 - Lead prototype builds and new product introduction 
 
 - Own the day-to-day execution of X-BAT prototype and development aircraft builds, including assembly, integration, rework and build support for testing. 
 
 - Partner with Program Management to establish achievable build schedules, resource plans and milestones, making constraints and trade-offs visible early. 
 
 - Work with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering through build-test-learn cycles, ensuring build issues are captured, resolved and reflected in future designs and production processes. 
 
 - Plan and execute pre-series builds to prove tooling, work instructions, material flow, process controls and workforce readiness before production ramp. 
 
 - Maintain configuration discipline and aircraft traceability throughout development builds in partnership with Engineering and Quality. 
 
 Establish the Seattle production operation 
 
 - Lead manufacturing setup and operational readiness for X-Forge 3, working with Facilities and Manufacturing Engineering on factory layout, equipment installation, commissioning and production flow. 
 
 - Recruit, develop and lead the production organization, building capable frontline leadership and a skilled aircraft assembly team. 
 
 - Own production staffing, training and capacity plans, aligning investment and workforce growth with program demand. 
 
 - Drive launch readiness across people, tooling, materials, processes and quality, with clear owners and closure plans for gaps. 
 
 - Lead the transition from prototype operations into Seattle production, ensuring build knowledge and lessons learned transfer with the work. 
 
 Deliver and scale aircraft production 
 
 - Own production execution against safety, quality, delivery and cost targets as X-BAT moves through initial production and into sustained rate. 
 
 - Establish daily operating routines, visual management and escalation processes that surface problems early and drive timely resolution. 
 
 - Improve throughput, labor productivity, first-pass quality and schedule adherence through practical Lean methods and structured problem-solving. 
 
 - Partner with Supply Chain and Planning to align material availability, supplier readiness and outsourced manufacturing with the production plan. 
 
 - Work with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality to eliminate recurring build issues and embed permanent corrective actions. 
 
 - Deploy digital manufacturing tools and appropriate automation to improve execution, traceability and scalability. 
 
 - Give leadership a clear view of production performance, launch readiness, risks and the decisions needed to maintain progress. 

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing or a related technical field. 

 - 10+ years of experience in aerospace or comparable advanced manufacturing, including at least 5 years leading production teams. 

 - Demonstrated experience leading prototype or new product introduction builds and carrying a product into sustained production. 

 - Proven ability to build and scale manufacturing operations, including workforce development, capacity planning and production systems. 

 - Experience leading complex assembly and integration operations with demanding quality, configuration and traceability requirements. 

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing readiness, tooling validation, material coordination and production launch. 

 - Track record of improving safety, quality, delivery and cost through Lean manufacturing and structured problem-solving. 

 - Ability to lead across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management, resolving competing priorities and driving clear accountability. 

 - A hands-on leadership style, with the ability to move between long-term factory planning and detailed problem-solving on the floor. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through initial and rate production. 

 - Experience establishing a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites. 

 - Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration and production test. 

 - Familiarity with aerospace quality systems, including AS9100, and digital manufacturing and traceability tools. 

 - Experience managing production interfaces with outsourced manufacturing partners and complex supplier networks. 

 - Advanced degree or relevant training in manufacturing leadership, program management or production launch.

ABOUT SHIELD AI:

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We’re looking for a hands-on quality leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production. 

You will build the aircraft quality organization and establish the quality capability for our new Seattle-area production facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll own product and process quality across prototype, pre-series and production builds, ensuring that lessons from development become effective controls as the program scales. 

This role owns the Quality Management System, quality engineering, inspection, nonconformance management and audit readiness for the X-BAT manufacturing operation. You’ll partner with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production and Supply Chain to prevent defects, resolve recurring problems and deliver aircraft that meet technical, customer and applicable regulatory requirements. 

We need a technically credible leader who can build practical, scalable systems, make sound decisions under schedule pressure and challenge senior stakeholders constructively while keeping execution moving. 

What you'll do:

 - Build quality into prototype and launch 
 
 - Lead quality planning and execution for X-BAT prototype and development builds, establishing appropriate inspection, test evidence and build records as designs evolve. 
 
 - Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering to identify product and process risks, define critical controls and build quality requirements into tooling, work instructions and test plans. 
 
 - Establish configuration and traceability controls with Engineering and Production, ensuring each aircraft’s build status, deviations and nonconformances are understood and documented. 
 
 - Capture lessons from build, integration and test issues, and drive their incorporation into design changes, manufacturing processes and future builds. 
 
 - Define quality readiness criteria for pre-series builds and production launch, validating inspection methods, process controls, workforce competence and closure of significant risks. 
 
 Establish the Seattle quality operation 
 
 - Recruit, develop and lead the quality team, building the technical capability and frontline support needed as aircraft production grows. 
 
 - Establish and maintain a lean, effective QMS for X-Forge 3, aligned with Shield AI’s wider quality framework, AS9100, ISO 9001 and applicable customer requirements. 
 
 - Lead certification readiness and internal, customer and external audits, driving timely closure and sustained effectiveness of corrective actions. 
 
 - Set up receiving, in-process and final inspection capability, including measurement equipment, calibration, training and quality records, in partnership with relevant functions. 
 
 Deliver quality at rate 
 
 - Own production quality performance, using first-pass yield, defects, rework and escapes to focus action where it improves aircraft quality and production flow. 
 
 - Lead containment, root cause analysis and corrective action for manufacturing quality issues, with clear functional ownership and verification that fixes prevent recurrence. 
 
 - Own the nonconformance and MRB process, ensuring disposition decisions follow approved technical authority and that affected hardware remains controlled. 
 
 - Partner with Supply Chain and supplier quality teams to resolve incoming quality issues and improve supplier performance before defects disrupt aircraft builds. 
 
 - Work with Engineering and Production to define acceptance evidence and ensure aircraft meet approved requirements before release. 
 
 - Use digital quality tools and manufacturing data to strengthen traceability, expose trends and reduce manual administration as production scales. 
 
 - Give leadership a clear view of quality performance, product risks and readiness; escalate or stop affected work when requirements or product integrity cannot be assured. 

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality or a related technical field. 

 - 10+ years of leadership experience in quality, product assurance or reliability within aerospace, defense technology or high-reliability manufacturing. 

 - Demonstrated success leading quality through prototype or new product introduction and into sustained production. 

 - Proven ability to build and scale quality teams and systems while supporting fast-paced development and manufacturing operations. 

 - Deep expertise in containment, root cause analysis, MRB, corrective and preventive action, and continuous improvement. 

 - Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001, with practical implementation and audit leadership experience. 

 - Experience with complex assembly, inspection, configuration control, traceability and product acceptance. 

 - Ability to influence and challenge senior leaders constructively across Engineering, Production and Supply Chain. 

 - A hands-on leadership style and sound technical judgment, balancing timely execution with clear quality standards and accountability. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through production launch and rate ramp. 

 - Experience establishing quality capability at a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites. 

 - Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration, production test and reliability improvement. 

 - Experience deploying digital quality systems, statistical process controls and data-driven defect prevention. 

 - Advanced degree in engineering, quality or a related technical discipline.

role.title: Head of Operational Excellence
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description 

The Head of Operational Excellence will lead operational excellence across Shield AI’s Group 3 UAV manufacturing in Frisco, TX (V-BAT) and Group 5 UAV manufacturing in Seattle, WA (X-BAT). Based in Frisco, this leader will create, deploy, and actively manage manufacturing KPIs and performance systems across both sites, embedding operating rhythms that improve accountability, visibility, and results. 
 
You will be responsible for instilling a culture of execution excellence, embedding structured problem-solving practices, and delivering measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, and productivity. This includes leading the development and governance of operational standards—such as visual management, 5S, and root cause analysis—while owning the manufacturing budget cycle, business rhythm, and executive reporting interface across both locations. This role partners with engineering, production, quality, and business functions to execute high-priority improvement initiatives, support V-BAT production, and establish operational excellence as X-BAT progresses through prototype and into rate production. 

Do you have the expertise and leadership to embed excellence into the fabric of autonomous defense manufacturing? 

What You'll Do:

 - 

 - Create, deploy, and actively manage consistent manufacturing KPIs and performance dashboards across both sites to drive visibility and accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity. 

 - Define, train, deploy, and continually improve operational standards across V-BAT manufacturing in Frisco and X-BAT manufacturing in Seattle, including 5S, root cause analysis, and visual management. 

 - Develop and institutionalize the manufacturing budget process across both sites, including forecasting, controls, and performance tracking. 

 - Set financial targets in collaboration with operations and finance teams and drive adherence to budget and cost goals. 

 - Lead high-impact cross-functional improvement initiatives across both sites to improve quality, delivery, efficiency, productivity, and cost performance. 

 - Prepare and coordinate senior and executive-level reporting packages for Manufacturing leadership reviews. 

 - Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to deploy Lean and continuous improvement practices, adapting execution to the needs of established production and prototype-to-rate manufacturing. 

 - Own business office functions for Manufacturing across both sites, including goal tracking, KPI dashboards, and process governance. 

 - Coach and train teams and leaders across both sites to elevate operational discipline, share effective practices, and sustain improvements. 

Required Qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or related field. 

 - Experience leading operational excellence, Lean, or business office programs within a manufacturing environment, with the ability to lead improvement across multiple sites. 

 - Demonstrated ability to design, roll out, and sustain structured operational standards and improvement systems. 

 - Strong background in budgeting, reporting, and performance management at a senior level. 

 - Excellent communication skills and experience preparing executive-level summaries and presentations. 

Preferred Qualifications:

 - 

 - Master’s degree or formal Lean Six Sigma certification. 

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or complex hardware manufacturing environments. 

 - Proficiency with digital tools for KPI visualization, reporting automation, and business process tracking. 

 - Track record of influencing change across large, cross-functional manufacturing organizations and multiple sites.
