role.title: Manufacturing Senior Manager
role.description:
**Bold Thinking. World Changing.**
At SkyWater, our ingenuity helps improve lives around the world by manufacturing U.S. made semiconductors that are essential ingredients of modern life. Automotive safety enhancements, life-saving medical devices, consumer electronics and American security require semiconductors. Working in our Minnesota headquarters, Florida, or Texas location — employees join together to improve the world.
 
 
**Explore what’s possible.**
Joining our U.S. - based team means contributing to and learning about the commercialization of some of the most exciting technologies the world has ever seen. We are turning “science fiction” into everyday reality through technologies such as superconducting, 3D integrated circuits or computer chips, carbon nanotubes, photonic logic devices, micro electro-mechanical systems and other emerging device topologies. We manufacture products for aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, consumer and industrial markets, to name a few. Our customers include emerging leaders who rely on our intellectual property security and quality manufacturing services.
 
 
**Step into the future.**
SkyWater’s values of Integrity, Excellence, Collaboration, Empowerment and Growth Mindset guide us to cultivate an empowered, learning environment. We also invest in developing highly skilled, dedicated employees — and employees who are entering the workforce for the first time, from the military, and a variety of educational backgrounds.
 
 
**Are you bold thinking? Find your place on our team and help us change the world!**
The
**Thin Films and CMP Engineering Senior Manager**
leads Thins/CMP operations in a 200 mm high-volume semiconductor manufacturing facility in Austin, Texas. This role is directly accountable for delivering measurable results in process stability, cost reduction, tool productivity, and continuous yield improvement across mature technology nodes. The ideal candidate will balance strong technical expertise with the operational leadership required to support New Product Development (NPD) and maintain reliable, high-throughput manufacturing.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of ThinFilms/CMP engineers supporting 24/7 fab operations and development.
* Support New Product Development (NPD) by partnering with design and integration teams to develop and stabilize new lithography layers and processes.
* Own and drive results for lithography processes on mature nodes, ensuring high uptime, repeatability, and yield performance against strict production KPIs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on defect density reduction, overlay control, and CD uniformity.
* Utilize structured problem-solving to contain and address process issues, ensuring timely resolution and sustained results.
* Oversee process control systems, including SPC, FDC, and other control strategies.
* Maintain and improve process documentation, recipes, and control plans.
* Support technology transfers, customer qualifications, and process improvements, taking ownership of project timelines and deliverables.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related field (advanced degree a plus).
* 8+ years of semiconductor manufacturing experience, preferably in 150 mm/200 mm fabs.
* 3+ years of leadership or supervisory experience in a production environment with a proven track record of performance management.
* Strong background in Thin Films and CMP for mature technology nodes.
* Expertise with Thin Films and CMP processes, metrology, and control.
* Experience with SPC, DOE, FMEA, and yield improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead teams and drive accountability in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, tool utilization, and cycle time reduction.
* Ability to prioritize and manage competing production demands while maintaining a results-oriented focus.
* Effective cross-functional communication with manufacturing, integration, and maintenance teams.
* Results-driven mindset with a focus on measurable yield, cost, and throughput.
* 8D and structured problem-solving mentality.

SkyWater offers an exciting environment where the brightest semiconductor minds come together to achieve exceptional results. We offer a competitive salary and an opportunity to participate in incentive plans as well as other employee financial benefits, including a 401 (k) match and life insurance.
 
 
Additionally, SkyWater offers a comprehensive benefits package which promotes a healthy life. This includes benefit eligibility day one, medical, dental, mental health benefits, vision, legal planning, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays, an on-site cafeteria, fitness facility, and self-serve market.
 
 
SkyWater complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities unless doing so would cause an undue hardship. Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. To request reasonable accommodations, to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at 952-851-5200 or Recruiting@SkyWatertechnology.com.
 
 
**EOE, including disability/vets**
We will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment or gift cards, or provide financial information before a formal offer of employment has been accepted. If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to represent our company, please verify its authenticity by contacting our recruitment team at recruiting@skywatertechnology.com before responding.

role.description:
**Welcome to the future of nuclear energy**
, where Westinghouse Electric Company is leading the field with expertise and innovation to shape the power of tomorrow. At Westinghouse, innovation is in our DNA. We are creative. We think differently. We reimagine the possible across the nuclear industry every day.
 
 
**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager of MFG Engineering Programs in our New Product Introduction group, you will be responsible and accountable to lead and deliver global nuclear fuel manufacturing project execution across Westinghouse Electric Corporation (WEC) fuel manufacturing facilities in the US, UK & Sweden operations. You will be deployed to guide progress and execution of multiple projects within our organization, based on the program needs. The Sr Manager owns the global manufacturing scope of new product introduction and is accountable to lead project execution to delivery in-full, without complaint products to our customers while meeting safety and financial goals. This position will guide interaction between Fuel Engineering, Nuclear Fuel Project Managers, Product Delivery & Commercial Managers, Product Management, Supply Chain, SIOP, Plant Manufacturing Managers, Global Quality, and Supplier or customer teams. It will also coordinate on project deliverables, issues, and resolution. Program budget accountability ranges from $1M - $20M.
 
 
You will report to the Director of New Product Introduction and support the role remotely with 25 - 35% travel between global manufacturing facilities. This position may be based in the United States, Sweden, or the United Kingdom.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Comprehend entire program scope, such as commercial, licensing, regulatory and initiate appropriate scope within the manufacturing program scope.
* Support project task-based schedules and track/report milestone progress against the program management plan.
* Deploy strategies for optimizing and streamlining legacy fuel manufacturing operations in partnership with manufacturing sites and functional leads.
* Analyze existing processes and identify value-added and non-value-added activities to solve design challenges.
* Manage project risks and opportunities to closure in partnership with functional leads and Program Managers. Identify issues, propose solutions and lead recovery plans to closure.
* Implement within project schedule and budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-savings opportunities. Communicate with partners, providing updates on project milestones, risks, critical escalations and issues.
* Present strategic project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior leadership and important partners.
* Identify areas of improvement or gaps in current processes and develop strategies to promote efficiency and productivity in new product and process introduction.
* Perform as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support project teams in new product and process development such as APQP and PPAP industry standards.
* Compare actual performance against planned performance to identify variances and help manage tasks on project planning.
* Collaborate with program team members and departments to establish plans and schedules that allocate resources to best achieve program requirements and service internal and external client or customer needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering.
* 10 -15 years related experience in Nuclear/ Automotive/ Heavy Engineering/ Metals Industry / Manufacturing / Assembly.
* Experience with project management and new product introduction into manufacturing.
* Analytical capabilities to identify critical schedule paths and improve engineering / supply chain timelines.
* Demonstrated skills in internal operational partner relationship management.
* Advance level PMI certification in Project Management.
* Experience of Engineering Component Manufacturing systems.
* Experience with engineering product development including design phases, manufacturing processes and global supply chain management.
* Familiarization with Kaizen, Lean Operations, FMEA's, DMAIC, DFMAs, POCA cycles.
* Familiarization with Microsoft Project, P6 or other scheduling software.

We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. This position may be based in multiple countries, and compensation is determined using the salary structure applicable to the employee's primary work location. The hiring range applicable to your work location will be provided in accordance with local requirements. Actual compensation will be determined based on work location, experience, qualifications and skills.
 
 
**Why Westinghouse?**
We know that to put forth your best effort, you need to be challenged and enjoy what you do in a supportive and respectful environment. We aim to maintain this balance by offering our employees the amenities, benefits and training they need to reach personal and professional goals.
 
 
**Below Is An Example Of What Employees Can Expect**

* Attractive pay
* Hybrid work opportunities
* High flexibility and autonomy
* Great health and welfare benefits
* Employee Assistance Program: confidential counseling and resources for employees, eligible dependents, and household members
* Learning and development opportunities
* Employee referral program
* We encourage our employees to participate in community service events and other team-building activities to strengthen their bonds and inspire each other.

Recruiters will provide specific benefits information that is applicable for this role

role.description:
**About us:**
At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Driven by a passion for excellence, we partner with leading Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences and Industrial companies to design, manufacture and service some of the world’s most transformative products, including advanced surgical systems, diagnostic instruments, healthcare imaging equipment, mission critical aerospace systems, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.
 
 
**When we invest in our people, we invest in building a better world.**
With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. It is our values that unite us and guide us in everything that we do, including how we operate, behave and interact to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.
 
 
Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.
 
 
As a team member, you will engage in impactful work through global collaboration and the use of emerging technologies, join an inclusive culture where every team member is valued and working toward a greater purpose, and be empowered to reach your full potential through various development programs designed to accelerate your growth.
 
 
Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. We also prioritize work-life balance and offer a variety of perks to enhance the team member experience. For more information, visit our US benefits website at usbenefits.plexus.com. Our commitment to pay range transparency fosters an equitable workplace, where everyone can feel valued. The annual compensation range for this position is stated below. The salary offered within this range will be based upon the geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level. Salary Range:
 
 
$132,500.00 - $198,700.00
 
 
**Purpose Statement:**
To provide leadership and direction to the Manufacturing Engineering team(s) from a functional perspective. Manage the Manufacturing Engineering function in line with functional specific strategies, process and systems development, people development, employee relations, plant level metrics.
 
 
**Key Job Accountabilities**

* Lead manufacturing-engineering excellence by collaborating with various functional leads to ensure engineering capability meets or exceeds manufacturing standards for quality product delivery.
* Support Program Management initiatives and activities to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Lead process/product/equipment engineering activities in compliance with Plexus Core Values to meet industry standards, regulatory and customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to site operations, establish a technology roadmap, and collaborate with corporate and regional technical teams to achieve lower costs and higher manufacturing returns.
* Responsible to exemplify and hold their team accountable to demonstrating the Plexus Core Values. Leader will focus on evaluating potential, driving succession planning, and ensuring their employees receive the development and coaching required to realize their full potential.

**Education/Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.
* Proven leadership skills and management experience.

*This document does not represent a contract of employment and is not intended to capture every possible assignment the incumbent could be asked to perform.*
We are pleased to provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities or special requirements. If you need an application accommodation, please contact us by email at GHQ.TA@plexus.com. Please include your contact information and clearly describe how we can help you. This email is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 
 
Some offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a drug screen and/or background check.

role.title: Head of Quality
role.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.
* Oversee quality indicators and operational efficiencies, implementing action plans to mitigate risks and streamline quality processes.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality organization that operates as a trusted, collaborative business partner, while driving talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
* Establish clear, consistent, and effective communication across the Quality organization and with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and business objectives.
Perform additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives as assigned 

*The above statements are intended to describe the nature of work performed by those in this job and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Nothing in this job description restricts managements right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time which reflects management’s assignment of essential functions.*

**Minimum Education, Experience and Skills**

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related area of study

**Experience:**

* At minumum15 years of pharmaceutical industry experience with at least 10 years of Quality experience, both QC and QA in biopharma/biotech in a CGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment with early and late-stage products.
* 5+ years of senior leadership experience driving Quality strategy, compliance initiatives, continuous improvement and staff development.
* Extensive experience developing, implementing and improving quality systems directly related to biologics drug substance manufacturing CGMP
* Proven track record of successfully managing and leading regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities with global health authorities with demonstrated success in leading a company through cGMP pre-approval and post-approval inspections.
* Proven ability to build and sustain a transparent, collaborative, and quality-focused culture that promotes accountability, engagement, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing organizational change within complex regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to develop staff at all levels.
Experience with developing and managing budgets. 

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory requirements and quality standards, including US FDA, EMA, PIC/S, and ICH guidelines.
* Demonstrated success in leading organizations through sound decision-making, strategic problem-solving, and effective communication at all levels of the business.
* Prior experience within a CDMO environment is strongly preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex quality and compliance matters clearly and effectively.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and support teams through crisis management, organizational transformation, cultural change, and business growth initiatives.
* Highly adaptable and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while maintaining focus on priorities and outcomes.

* Results-oriented leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.

role.title: Director of Quality
role.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Eldridge, IA – Direct Hire**

**Full time – On Site**

Productive Resources (www.productiveresources.com) is seeking a candidate to be part of our engineering team for our customer's facility in Eldridge, IA. As a member of our team, the selected candidate will be a Director of Quality who provides strategic and hands-on leadership for quality operations and is responsible for the planning, organization, direction, coordination, compliance, and control of the Company's Quality Management System. This role leads the Quality team and ensures the effectiveness of quality processes across the organization, including product and process quality, supplier quality, inspection activities, corrective actions, audit readiness, customer quality performance, and compliance with all applicable contractual, regulatory, and government requirements.

The Director of Quality is responsible for developing and leading employees, strengthening accountability, and partnering with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Executive Leadership to prevent defects, drive continuous improvement, and support the safe, compliant, and on-time delivery of mission-critical products. This position oversees departmental personnel and processes, providing coaching, direction, and support to ensure the safe and efficient execution of work while maintaining quality standards, meeting customer requirements, and effectively managing operational costs. Through strong leadership and oversight, the Director of Quality ensures quality objectives are achieved and organizational performance continuously improves.

This is a full-time position that is indefinite in duration with the opportunity of professional growth, and additional opportunities within our organization.

**Duties:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Quality managers, engineers, inspectors, supplier quality personnel, and other assigned team members.
* Establish and execute a quality strategy aligned with Company goals, customer expectations, contractual requirements, and operational priorities.
* Maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System and ensure processes remain effective, documented, implemented, and audit-ready.
* Lead internal, external, customer, registrar, and government audits; ensure findings are contained, corrected, and closed with effective corrective action.
* Own quality performance metrics and executive reporting, including product conformity, customer complaints, supplier quality, corrective action, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, and audit performance.
* Drive disciplined nonconformance control, material review, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing and Engineering to improve process capability, inspection planning, product acceptance methods, error prevention, and manufacturability.
* Oversee inspection and test activities, measurement-system controls, calibration coordination, and the integrity and retention of quality records.
* Lead supplier quality strategy, qualification, surveillance, performance review, development, and supplier corrective action.
* Ensure customer-specific, contractual, regulatory, and government quality requirements are identified, flowed down, implemented, and maintained.
* Support first article inspections, source inspections, customer returns, complaint investigations, configuration and change-control activities, and product or process validation as required.
* Build a quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, objective evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop departmental staffing, training, succession, budget, and resource plans necessary to support current operations and future growth.
* Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and executive leadership to resolve systemic issues and meet Company objectives.
* Any other duties assigned by Vice President of Operations.
 

 

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Operations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience managing quality functions and teams within a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading a multi-functional quality organization, including Quality Engineering, Inspection, Supplier Quality, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Internal Audits, and Regulatory/Customer Compliance activities.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality processes and standards.
* Experience with ISO 9001:2015 requirements, including coordinating and conducting internal audits and maintaining audit readiness.
* Proven ability to lead teams, develop talent, drive accountability, and collaborate cross-functionally to achieve quality and operational objectives.
* Strong working knowledge of NADCAP accreditation, its QMS, and quality requirements related to the special processes within Chemical Processing and Non-destructive Testing.
* Experience leading internal, customer, registrar, and government audits and responding effectively to findings.
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methods such as 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, A3, and DMAIC.
* Working knowledge of statistical process control, process capability, measurement systems, control plans, and risk-based quality planning.
* Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, supplier corrective action, and supplier development.
* Familiarity with government contracting and customer quality requirements, including FAR/DFARS and DCMA oversight, is preferred.
* Ability to translate quality data into clear priorities, executive-level metrics, and sustainable improvements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with direct engagement on the manufacturing floor and timely resolution of customer or production issues.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt are preferred.
* Must have good written and verbal communication skills while being able to motivate and manage reporting personnel, collaboration with peers, and report up to executive leadership as needed.
* Must be able to professionally coach and direct activities of a diverse team while being fair and consistent.
 

 

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* ISO Auditor Certification, Lean Six Sigma Certification, or other relevant quality management certifications.
* Experience in defense, government contracting, firearms, ammunition, aerospace, weapons systems, or another highly regulated precision manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of first article inspection, including AS9102.
 

 

**Compensation & Benefits:**

We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and excellent growth opportunities.

If you are the right person, if you have the expertise we need, submit your resume now!

role.title: Director of Quality and Accreditation
role.description:
Overview:

**East Tennessee Behavioral Health** is seeking a dynamic and experienced **Director of Quality and Accreditation** to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

**East Tennessee Behavioral Healt**h is a 90-bed inpatient treatment center serving Knoxville, Tennessee, and the surrounding communities. We provide the highest-quality care for people who have mental health concerns such as depression, anxiety disorders, and bipolar disorder and those who have co-occurring addictions. The acute inpatient treatment we offer supports adolescents, adults, and senior adults, while our outpatient programming serves adults age 18 and older.

**East TN Behavioral Health Hospital** offers an extensive array of benefits to our valued team members. Current offerings encompass:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Company-paid Basic Life & AD&D insurance
* Disability benefits
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with a company match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Discount Program
* Paid Holidays for work-life balance
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement opportunities for career advancement

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
* QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.
 + Utilize collected data regarding the outcome of activities for delivering continuously improving services.
 + Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.
 + Complete process improvement projects and incorporate the results into patient care improvements.
 + Submit quality scorecard data to Acadia corporate office as requested.
 + Coordinate the abstraction of clinical data according to Joint Commission specifications and data entry via vendor database for Inpatient Psychiatric Core Measures (ex. national quality measures such as HBIPS).
 + Identify key aspects of care relevant indicators and evaluation of data using formal and informal feedback from consumers of services and other collateral sources is aggregated and used to improve management strategies and service delivery practices.
 + Lead/coordinate data collection and analysis from all departments within the facility.
 + Prepare and present program data trends and action plans to the monthly Quality Council and quarterly to the Medical Executive Committee and the Governing Board.
* Regulatory preparedness – implement sustainable survey preparation and ongoing monitoring processes, including facility-wide auditing and early-issue identification, to maximize achievement of zero- or standard-level survey outcomes.
 + Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
 + Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
 - Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
 - Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
 - Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
 + Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
 + Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
 + Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
 + Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
 + Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
 + Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
 + Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
 + Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
 + Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.

* Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
* + Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.

role.title: Director, Quality
role.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

role.title: Director, Digital Quality
role.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
 
 
**Job Description**

**EXAMPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Set the global Digital Quality strategy and roadmap**
 + Define the target state, strategic themes, capability model, and multi-year roadmap for Digital Quality.
 + Maintain a portfolio of initiatives aligned with Quality objectives, regulatory priorities, enterprise architecture, and available investment.
 + Establish measurable outcomes, including compliance effectiveness, cycle-time reduction, right-first-time performance, user adoption, data quality, and realized benefits.
* **Lead end-to-end Quality process mapping and optimization**
 + Map current- and future-state processes across sites, regions, and GxP domains, including roles, decisions, controls, systems, data, handoffs, pain points, and performance measures.
 + Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, digitize, automate, or retire processes before selecting technology.
 + Maintain process, capability, system, and data maps to support investment decisions, integration planning, and global standardization.
 + Partner with process owners to define requirements, target operating models, controls, and adoption plans.
* **Assess and recommend new digital tools**
 + Establish a consistent intake and assessment method for digital tools, platforms, automation, analytics, and AI use cases.
 + Evaluate intended use, user need, business value, GxP impact, patient and product risk, data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, interoperability, accessibility, scalability, supplier maturity, total cost, and support model.
 + Lead market scans, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, supplier due diligence, and fit-gap assessments.
 + Recommend whether to adopt, configure, integrate, scale, defer, or reject proposed solutions based on documented evidence.
 + Prevent technology-led implementations by confirming that each tool addresses a defined process need and has measurable success criteria.
* **Establish Digital Quality governance and assurance**
 + Define decision rights, design principles, architecture guardrails, stage gates, risk criteria, and governance forums for the Digital Quality portfolio.
 + Apply risk-based lifecycle assurance based on intended use and process risk, including requirements, supplier evidence, testing, traceability, release, change control, periodic review, and retirement.
 + Set governance for AI-enabled Quality solutions, including approved use cases, human oversight, data provenance, model performance, explainability, monitoring, drift, retraining, and accountability for decisions.
 + Ensure electronic records, signatures, audit trails, integrations, master data, and reporting controls meet applicable regulatory and company expectations.
* **Drive implementation, adoption, and value realization**
 + Provide Quality leadership through product selection, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
 + Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, training, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement across global functions and sites.
 + Monitor solution performance, incidents, compliance signals, user feedback, benefits, and emerging risks throughout the lifecycle.
 + Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, budgets, resource needs, suppliers, and executive reporting.
* **Develop organizational capability**
 + Build digital literacy, process-mapping capability, product-management practices, and risk-based assurance skills across Quality.
 + Lead and develop internal staff and cross-functional teams; engage external specialists when needed.
 + Represent Quality in enterprise digital, data, AI, architecture, cybersecurity, and investment forums.
 + Monitor evolving regulations, industry practices, and emerging technologies and translate them into practical Quality standards and roadmaps.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Please see the following for the qualifications and skills we seek for this role.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in Digital Quality, Quality systems, digital transformation, computer system assurance or validation, process excellence, product management, or a related discipline.
* Experience in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, or another highly regulated life-sciences environment.
* Demonstrated experience defining strategy and delivering global digital programs across multiple functions, sites, or regions.
* Hands-on experience with process mapping, value-stream analysis, requirements definition, fit-gap assessment, and future-state design.
* Experience assessing and implementing digital platforms, SaaS solutions, workflow automation, analytics, data products, or AI-enabled tools.
* Knowledge of risk-based computer software assurance, computerized system validation, electronic records and signatures, data integrity, supplier assurance, and system lifecycle management.
* Experience establishing governance, prioritizing portfolios, preparing business cases, managing budgets, and measuring benefits.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, change-management, project, product, and vendor-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and lead multidisciplinary teams without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise recommendations and decision materials.
* Ability to travel as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Quality, life sciences, engineering, information systems, business, data science, or a related discipline.
* Experience leading an enterprise Digital Quality strategy, capability model, or multi-year transformation roadmap.
* Experience with electronic quality management, document and learning management, laboratory, manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, analytics, integration, or collaboration platforms.
* Experience conducting market scans, supplier due diligence, proofs of concept, pilots, and formal digital-tool evaluations.
* Experience applying product-management, enterprise-architecture, data-governance, or organizational change-management practices.
* Experience establishing governance for artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of cloud services, cybersecurity, privacy, integration patterns, master data, metadata, and third-party risk.
* Experience rationalizing application portfolios and supporting global process and technology standardization.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Expert understanding of global GxP Quality processes and the drug-development and product lifecycle, with the ability to connect process, data, technology, and control requirements.
* Strong knowledge of digital Quality platforms and how they support regulated business processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning risks and controls, including intended-use definition, human oversight, data provenance, performance criteria, monitoring, drift, change, and retraining governance.
* Ability to distinguish business criticality, GxP impact, and process risk and translate the assessment into proportionate assurance activities.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements, process maps, user requirements, evaluation criteria, roadmaps, and investment recommendations.
* Strong facilitation, critical-thinking, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to communicate direction, trade-offs, risks, status, and value to executives, steering committees, process owners, technical teams, and end users.

Commitment to global standardization while accommodating justified regional or functional requirements.

role.title: Production Strategy & Operations Director
role.description:
**Position Overview**

JHB Group, Inc. is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and forward-thinking Production Strategy & Operations Director to lead production planning, operational coordination, process development, and efficiency improvements within our specialty vehicle and trailer manufacturing facility.

**Successful production starts before the work begins—with planning, preparation, organization, and communication.** This leadership role focuses on creating the systems, schedules, workflows, and accountability that help teams execute complex custom manufacturing projects consistently and efficiently. Manufacturing experience is a strong advantage, but exceptional organizational and operational leadership skills are the priority.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategic Production Planning & Scheduling

* Develop and maintain master production schedules across multiple custom projects.

* Translate project requirements and delivery commitments into actionable daily, weekly, and long-term plans.

* Coordinate labor, materials, equipment, and other resources to support production priorities.

* Anticipate scheduling conflicts, capacity limitations, and bottlenecks before they affect deadlines.

* Monitor milestones and adjust plans proactively as project requirements change.

**Operational Organization & Preparation**

* Ensure drawings, work instructions, tools, equipment, and materials are ready before work begins.

* Coordinate with purchasing, inventory, engineering, and production to confirm project readiness.

* Create clear systems for tracking tasks, outstanding issues, and production status.

* Improve material staging, work-area organization, and shop readiness.

* Reduce downtime caused by missing parts, unclear instructions, and inadequate preparation.

**Process Development & Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate workflows and implement practical improvements to productivity and consistency.

* Develop, document, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).

* Establish repeatable processes and performance-tracking systems across departments.

* Identify root causes of recurring delays, rework, and wasted labor; implement lasting solutions.

* Promote continuous improvement, operational discipline, and accountability.

**Production Execution & Coordination**

* Coordinate fabrication, welding, electrical, carpentry, cabinetry, assembly, and finishing activities.

* Align work assignments with production schedules and available resources.

* Facilitate timely communication and handoffs between departments.• Identify and resolve production constraints through planning and cross-functional coordination.

* Maintain accurate visibility into progress, priorities, and upcoming requirements.

Leadership, Communication & Accountability

* Set clear expectations and priorities for production personnel and department leaders.

* Lead concise daily production meetings and weekly planning reviews.

* Hold teams accountable for schedules, productivity, quality, safety, and procedures.

* Support training, staffing coordination, and constructive performance feedback.

* Model professionalism, organization, ownership, and follow-through.

Quality & Operational Performance

* Coordinate quality checkpoints and confirm work aligns with drawings and project specifications.

* Identify recurring workmanship issues and establish corrective processes.

* Track schedule adherence, labor utilization, milestones, and production performance.

* Provide management with accurate reporting on progress, risks, and resource needs.

* Establish measurable operational goals and evaluate results.

**Required Skills & Attributes**

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Strong strategic planning, scheduling, prioritization, and project coordination abilities.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a changing environment.

* Proactive approach to anticipating needs and preventing problems.

* Demonstrated ability to implement processes, communicate expectations, and drive follow-through.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

* Proficiency with spreadsheets, scheduling tools, and operational tracking systems.

* Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions.

Preferred Experience

* Five or more years in operations management, production planning, project management, manufacturing, or a related

field.

* Experience coordinating teams and departments, developing SOPs, or improving workflows.

* Background in manufacturing, fabrication, automotive, specialty vehicles, or custom assembly.

* Familiarity with bills of materials, inventory, resource planning, and production drawings.

* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, 5S, or other continuous improvement practices.

Manufacturing experience is preferred, not required. Candidates from operations, logistics, or project planning

backgrounds with outstanding organizational and leadership capabilities are encouraged to apply.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Realistic schedules, clear project milestones, and well-defined responsibilities.

* People, parts, drawings, tools, and instructions ready before each production phase begins.• Fewer avoidable delays, bottlenecks, rework cycles, and interruptions.

* Documented processes that are consistently followed and improved.

* Clear cross-department communication and accurate management visibility.

* A more predictable, efficient, organized, and scalable production operation.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You naturally bring structure to complex environments. You enjoy organizing people and resources, creating effective systems, and thinking several steps ahead. You take ownership, follow through, and understand that successful execution depends on having the right Plan. Parts. People. in place before work begins. You are motivated not merely to keep production moving, but to make it work better every day.

**About JHB Group**

JHB Group, Inc. designs and manufactures custom mobile solutions for public safety, emergency management, government, military, and commercial customers. Our products include mobile command centers, emergency response vehicles, specialty trailers, and training simulators. In-house capabilities span engineering, metal fabrication, welding, carpentry, cabinetry, electrical systems, networking, graphics, finishing, and final assembly.

**Why Join JHB Group?**

This role offers the opportunity to shape how a specialty manufacturing operation plans, organizes, measures, and executes its work. We seek a leader who wants to build effective systems, implement improvements, and contribute directly to long-term success.

**If you are a strategic thinker, exceptional organizer, and results-driven leader who believes planning and preparation are the foundation of successful operations, we encourage you to apply.**

Pay: $74,000.00 - $84,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

This is an opportunity for a driven, hands-on leader who thrives on challenges and has the vision and determination to transform an operation and drive it to the next level.

We are a growing manufacturing company with big opportunities ahead, and we're looking for someone who wants to play a critical role in that success. This isn't a position for someone who simply wants to maintain the status quo. We need a leader who takes ownership, drives accountability, embraces change, and knows how to turn opportunities into results.

At Lake Air Products, we are proud to live by our Core Values: **Customer Focus, Passion for Performance, and Right People – Best Teams.** If you're energized by building strong teams, improving performance, and creating a culture where people and operations thrive, we'd like to hear from you!

**What You'll Do**

As Plant Manager, you will have significant influence over the performance, culture, and future direction of the New Hope operation. You will lead a team of manufacturing departments, including scheduling, stamping, assembly, and shipping/receiving, with 3-5 direct reports.

* **Own the Results:** Take full accountability for plant performance, driving measurable improvements in Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC), productivity, output, and overall operational effectiveness.
* **Drive Change & Transformation:** Identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and lead meaningful operational changes that improve performance and position the plant for long-term success.
* **Lead with an Entrepreneurial Mindset:** Think strategically, act decisively, take ownership, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.
* **Build a High-Performing Team:** Develop, coach, and hold leaders accountable while creating an environment of engagement, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* **Drive Operational Excellence:** Establish and execute continuous improvement initiatives, set clear objectives, and ensure projects deliver measurable results.
* **Manage Financial Performance:** Own plant spending and budget performance, make sound business decisions, and identify opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.
* **Invest in the Future:** Identify and justify capital investments (CAPEX), clearly communicating anticipated benefits, business impact, and return on investment.
* **Lead Through Communication:** Establish effective tier meetings, maintain clear communication across all levels, and partner with Engineering, HR, Customer Support, and senior leadership.
* **Champion Customer Success:** Ensure production priorities and operational decisions support customer expectations for quality, delivery, and service.
* **Promote a Strong Culture:** Uphold Lake Air Products' Core Values, build productive employee relationships, and partner with HR to strengthen retention and employee satisfaction.
* **Maintain Compliance:** Ensure adherence to the company's ISO Quality Management System, departmental procedures, and work instructions.

Lake Air Products Offers:

* Competitive wage
* Full benefits package
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holiday Pay
* Gym reimbursement
* Tuition reimbursement

Qualifications

* Experience in Transition Leadership: Fast Growth > 15% per year, including operational turn arounds, fast expansions, etc.
* Ability to provide technical oversight, with the understanding of metal products and processes
* Proven success in contract manufacturing, producing 1000+ SKUs for 10+ customers
* Understanding and ability to pull data and analyze metrics related to budgets, KPI's, and efficiency reporting
* Cultural change agent, with strong leadership, influencing and mentoring skills.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems within a manufacturing environment, with Epicor experience preferred

Candidates who do not meet the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements or choose not to pursue such positions are not disqualified from applying for other opportunities with Lake Air Products. Nothing in this posting should be interpreted as limiting applications based on nationality or citizenship status.*

role.title: Industrial Gases Plant Manager
role.description:
**Position Summary**

The Industrial Gases Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of an industrial gases production facility, ensuring uninterrupted production and supply of products such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, and CO₂. The role provides leadership for operations, maintenance, safety, quality, and continuous improvement while meeting business, customer, and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve safety, production, quality, and reliability targets.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, safety, and process safety management (PSM) standards.
* Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, productivity, and energy-efficiency initiatives.
* Oversee maintenance and reliability programs to maximize plant uptime and asset performance.
* Manage plant budgets, operating costs, and capital improvement projects.
* Lead, coach, and develop plant personnel, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with quality systems, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with supply chain, logistics, engineering, and commercial teams to ensure uninterrupted product supply.
* Lead root cause investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Support plant expansions, upgrades, and commissioning activities.

**Management Responsibilities**

Directly manages plant leadership and operational personnel, including maintenance, operations, and technical staff. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, disciplinary action, succession planning, and employee development.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time to meet the business needs of the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in industrial gases, chemicals, petrochemicals, refining, or other continuous process industries.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing industrial gases plant operations.
* Strong knowledge of cryogenic processes, compressors, rotating equipment, utilities, and process control systems.
* Experience with DCS/PLC systems, reliability practices, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Safety Leadership
* Operational Excellence
* Team Development
* Financial & Business Acumen
* Reliability & Asset Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication & Stakeholder Management

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* Plant availability and reliability
* Production efficiency and energy consumption
* Product quality performance
* Budget and cost management
* Employee engagement and development
* Customer supply reliability

**Reports To**: President Plants and Operation Department

**Direct Reports**: Maintenance Manager and Plant Operations Team.

**Work Environment**

This position operates primarily within an industrial manufacturing environment and office setting. The Plant Manager regularly works in and around production equipment, compressors, cryogenic systems, utilities, and other industrial process operations. The role routinely uses standard office equipment, including computers, phones, scanners, and related technology. Frequent interaction with plant employees, contractors, customers, regulatory agencies, and corporate leadership is required. Occasional travel to company facilities, customer sites, industry meetings, and training programs may be required.

**Physical Demands**

This role requires a combination of office-based and plant-floor activities. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, climb stairs and ladders, communicate effectively, and use a computer for extended periods. The position may require working in varying environmental conditions, including exposure to industrial noise, temperature fluctuations, and process equipment. The ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hard hats, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other safety equipment as required, is essential. The employee may occasionally be required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time exempt position. The Plant Manager is expected to maintain a schedule sufficient to meet business and operational needs. Due to the nature of continuous industrial operations, the position may require availability outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, emergency response situations, planned maintenance outages, and on-call responsibilities as needed.

**Work Authorization**

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must maintain eligibility to work in the U.S. throughout their employment. Appropriate documentation authorizing employment in the United States is required upon hire.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Air Water America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, military status, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. Air Water America complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws and regulations and provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and religious observances as required by law.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Plant Manager.**

**Wichita, Kansas.**

**Full-time.**

**PSC INDUSTRIES.**

**Job Summary:** 
The Plant Manager will be working for a Progressive and Growing Manufacturing Organization. The Plant Manager is responsible for general supervision of all phases of plant operations including production, materials, quality control, maintenance, receiving & shipping, daily P&L, R&D, purchasing/procurement, finance/accounting, and customer-related sales along with business development. 
 
**Main Duties & Responsibilities:** 
**Production:**

* Tracking operating efficiencies.
* Managing labor expenditures.
* Reducing scrap.
* Continuously improving production thru Kaizen events, Kanban systems, SMED workshops.
* Strong adherence to 5-S principles.
* Define, research and specify any new equipment needs.
* Specify layouts for all new tooling requirements with a focus on material utilization and profitability.

**Quality/Service:**

* Instill a facility-wide commitment to 100% on-time delivery of all products.
* Implement, follow and continuously improve corporate and facility QMS.
* Consistently reduce annual PPM rate.

**Sales:**

* Identifying new business, both organically and through new contacts.
* Visit existing customers on a regular basis to maintain positive communication with OEM buyers, production leaders, design engineers and quality engineers.
* Provide return of all requested quotes in less than 24 hours of receipt.

**Finance:**

* Create cost and payback analysis for new capital asset requests.
* Maintain facility asset list.

**Safety:**

* Demonstrate the leadership required to maintain an accident-free facility.
* Facilitate monthly safety training for all employees per corporate and OSHA requirements.

**Materials/Inventory:**

* Ensure inventory is maintained with a focus on 8 turns annually.
* Ensure all BOM are up to date and accurate per the costing process.
* Specifying new material requirements.
* Negotiating with raw material suppliers to maintain a positive costing position.

**Required Qualification & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 5+ years’ management experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience and/or understanding of the Aerospace supply industry preferred.
* Experience working within a documented quality system.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
* Experience with Lean Application Methodologies.
* CAD experience preferred.
* Understanding of the OEM market drivers and pressures preferred.
* Knowledge of converting processes and techniques preferred.
* Operational understanding of ISO/AS9100.
* Travel up to 25%.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Directly supervises all department heads in the facility**.** Responsibilities include **i**nterviewing, hiring, training, planning, directing work, appraising performance, addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Physical Demands:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and climb or balance.
