role.description:
**Position:** Director – Operations 
**Location:** North Carolina/ South Carolina 
**Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:** CEO, ZetSol Energy

**Who We Are**

ZetSol Energy is the solar manufacturing and supply chain platform built to give North American solar developers, EPCs, utilities, and independent power producers a reliable, tariff-compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing. The company is establishing a vertically integrated greenfield facility in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, producing silicon ingots, monocrystalline wafers, cells, and modules, including high-efficiency TOPCon and HJT technology, and pairs that manufacturing base with a full strategic sourcing, bill-of-materials management, quality audit, compliance, and logistics practice purpose-built for the US market.

ZetSol Energy is backed by Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform valued at over $2.7 billion that already supplies solar piles, mechanical and structural components, and modules to leading US EPCs and asset owners, and whose 2022 acquisition of Unimacts strengthened its US industrial and solar manufacturing footprint. ZetSol Energy is the next chapter of that build-out: a dedicated US-facing commercial platform launching at a moment when American solar developers are actively searching for supply chain partners who can deliver both scale and certainty.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced operations leader to lead and scale ZetSol Energy's US operations, with overall responsibility for manufacturing, factory production, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing large-scale operations, with a strong background in Supply Chain Management (SCM), logistics and manufacturing, preferably within the renewable energy, solar or industrial sectors.

This individual will be responsible for overseeing factory production, managing end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, and driving sales operations, including demand planning, order management and customer fulfilment in the US market.

The role will also involve building strong relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, logistics partners and other key industry stakeholders, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and cost optimisation.

This is a key leadership position that will play an instrumental role in building and scaling ZetSol Energy's US operations, establishing robust operational processes and driving business growth in North America.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end US operations for ZetSol Energy, covering manufacturing, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

* Manage factory production operations, including production planning, capacity utilisation, quality, productivity and timely delivery.

* Drive end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, including global sourcing, procurement, inventory management, import/export, customs clearance and distribution.

* Oversee sales operations, including demand planning, order management, customer fulfilment and coordination with commercial teams.

* Build and manage relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities, logistics partners and other key stakeholders.

* Ensure compliance with US trade regulations, import policies, tariffs and applicable industry standards while driving operational efficiency and cost optimisation.

* Build and scale the US operations team, processes and infrastructure while working closely with the leadership and manufacturing teams in India.

**Qualifications**

* 15–20 years of experience in operations, manufacturing, supply chain management and logistics, preferably within renewable energy, solar, infrastructure or industrial sectors.

* Extensive experience managing large-scale manufacturing operations, including factory production, production planning, quality and operational efficiency.

* Strong experience in end-to-end supply chain, logistics and sales operations, including global sourcing, procurement, import/export, order management and customer fulfilment.

* Strong understanding of US trade regulations, import compliance, tariffs, customs procedures and logistics frameworks.

* Established relationships with government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities and key industry stakeholders.

* Proven track record of building and managing large operational teams, vendor ecosystems and strategic partnerships, with strong commercial and cost management capabilities.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in the solar, renewable energy or energy manufacturing ecosystem.

* Previous experience leading operations for a global manufacturing or industrial organisation.

* Experience managing manufacturing facilities and cross-border operations between the US and international markets, preferably India.

* Ability to build and scale operational infrastructure in a fast-growing business environment.

**Why ZetSol Energy**

* Opportunity to play a key leadership role in building ZetSol Energy's US operations.

* Work closely with the CEO and leadership team in shaping the company's operational strategy.

* Opportunity to build and scale a large operational and supply chain ecosystem.

* Be part of a growing solar manufacturing and supply chain platform backed by Zetwerk's global manufacturing capabilities.

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Company Description**

AZZ Inc. is a leading provider of specialized products and services designed to meet the unique needs of industrial markets worldwide. With a rich history spanning several decades, AZZ has established a strong reputation for innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction.

At AZZ, our culture is defined by **trust**, **respect**, **accountability**, **integrity**, **teamwork** and **safety** ("TRAITS"). We are dedicated to our employees by fully training and equipping them and providing a safe environment to grow personally and professionally. We strive to build, maintain and create a work environment that attracts and retains employees who are high contributors, have outstanding skills, are engaged in our culture, and who embody our Company mission: to create superior value in a culture where people can grow both professionally and personally, and where TRAITS matter.

As AZZ Inc. continues to evolve and innovate, it remains committed to driving shareholder value while maintaining its reputation as a leader in industrial solutions. With a strong foundation built on decades of experience and a forward-thinking approach, AZZ Inc. is poised to continue its upward trajectory, delivering sustainable growth and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

 **Job Description**

AZZ has an opportunity for a Plant Manager at our Canton facility. Reporting to the Regional Director of Operations, this role is responsible for, but not limited to, directing and managing all plant operations with overall responsibility for production, maintenance, quality, and personnel. You are a strong leader with a track record of effectively managing, mentoring, and developing leaders. You are experienced in developing and implementing business strategies and can deliver outstanding service to both internal and external stakeholders.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Directs and manages plant operations for production, maintenance, quality, shipping and receiving and all personnel activities.
* Develops and controls profits/loss, business plans and budget restrictions.
* Implements cost effective systems for control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries.
* Establishes and monitors overall plant performance for production and quality standards while maintaining strict process controls.
* Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment. Replaces or adjusts plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Provides leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Implements and maintains preventative maintenance programs.
* Maintains and enforces OSHA and other safety regulations.
* Recommends or implements measures to motivate employees and to improve production methods, equipment performance, product quality or efficiency.
* Recommends personnel action including, but not limited to, annual evaluations, promotions, hiring and firing.
* Responsible for maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the primary direct report for all facility personnel.

 
**Qualifications** 

* 3 – 5 years of management experience **required**
* Experience in steel fabrication, metal coatings, or hot dip galvanizing **required**
* Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications, i.e., Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to effectively handle and manage confidential and sensitive information
* Knowledge of safety and OSHA rules and regulations required
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and SOPs for heavy industrial equipment

**Minimum Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree required

 
**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and bonus structure.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package.
* Retirement savings plan with company match.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development in a dynamic industry.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

#LI-Onsite

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

AZZ Inc. is a Drug Free Workplace

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

Oversee the assigned plant’s operations and maintenance delivered by the third-party operations and maintenance contractor (the Contractor) and take Company-level responsibility for safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective power generation. Protect equipment condition and monitor delivery against agreed production, availability and contractual targets. Oversee plant resources, costs, records and stakeholder interfaces from commissioning and operational handover through ongoing operation.

The Contractor retains day-to-day operational control, provides the workforce and executes routine plant activities under the agreed contract. The Plant Manager is responsible for ensuring that the Contractor delivers plant results in line with the contract, overseeing its performance, giving technical and operational instructions to its site management as the contract allows, deciding the critical matters, and intervening when safety, performance, equipment integrity or delivery is at risk.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead plant readiness for commissioning and operational handover with Projects, Technical, HSE and the Contractor, ensuring personnel, training, procedures, spares, maintenance systems and emergency plans are ready.
* Drive closure of handover gaps and punch-list items before and after operational handover.
* Review and approve production and operating plans prepared with the Contractor, considering demand forecasts, available capacity, equipment limits and project commitments.
* Monitor generation, availability, reliability, capacity factor, heat rate, fuel and auxiliary consumption and forced-outage performance against targets; require corrective and improvement actions from the Contractor and verify they achieve the intended results.
* Oversee heat rate improvement and auxiliary consumption reduction initiatives with the Contractor and Technical teams, and obtain approval for proposed modifications under the change management procedure.
* Review the effect of startup/shutdown cycles and load-following operation on equipment life, thermal fatigue and availability, and agree operating and maintenance strategies with the Contractor and OEMs accordingly.
* Hold daily operating coordination and plant performance reviews with the Contractor’s management, resolve operational conflicts and maintain plant risk and action registers.
* Review and approve preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance plans, overhaul scopes and outage schedules prepared with the Contractor, taking account of OEM guidance, asset condition, warranty terms, production commitments and approved budgets.
* Oversee gas and steam turbine lifecycle management with the Contractor and OEMs, including tracking of life-limited parts, rotor and stator life and fatigue effects, and integrate it into maintenance and capital planning.
* Oversee maintenance and repair execution for work quality, timely completion and minimum disruption to generation; require recovery plans or changes to resources or work methods when delivery is at risk.
* Lead the response to major equipment failures with the Contractor’s specialists, Company engineers and OEMs: approve containment and recovery actions, ensure root cause analysis is completed and authorize safe return to service.
* Oversee the Contractor’s management of spare parts, consumables, chemicals and lubricants; set critical stock priorities, resolve shortages, review technical specifications of purchase requests and ensure technical acceptance, proper storage and effective inventory control.
* Manage plant interfaces with Technical teams for utilities and shared equipment under the agreed responsibility split, and ensure assigned statutory inspections are completed with the responsible functions.
* Administer the plant O&M contract and hold the Contractor to its agreed scope, staffing coverage, service levels and technical obligations; address nonperformance with its management and require recovery plans within contractual authority.
* Prepare formal notices and claim inputs with relevant functions.
* Oversee warranty and warranty claim processes and technical disputes with OEMs and suppliers, including long-term service agreement matters, and manage technical communication with them.
* Verify the Contractor’s invoices, labor hours, overtime, reimbursable costs, materials and subcontractor charges against contract rates, authorized work and actual delivery; challenge unsupported charges and recommend verified services for approval through the Company’s payment approval workflow.
* Prepare the plant O&M budget and forecasts, control commitments and expenditure against the approved budget and act on variances.
* Evaluate additional work requests, maintain change and claim records and obtain O&M Director approval for decisions beyond approved budget or contractual authority.
* Ensure accurate production, fuel-consumption and customer and revenue meter records and timely plant reporting; provide validated data and technical explanations to Commercial and Finance for customer billing and contractual reconciliations.
* Identify gaps in O&M service capability and recommend alternative O&M contractors or specialist support to the O&M Director; contribute to technical scopes, contractor sourcing and proposal evaluation, and manage site transition and handover to preserve operating continuity when the Contractor changes.
* Oversee plant HSE requirements with HSE and the Contractor’s management, including work permits, energy isolation, waste controls and emergency preparedness; stop unsafe work and direct immediate containment and incident response under site procedures.
* Ensure plans are in place for high-risk process safety scenarios (gas or steam turbine trips, HRSG pressure events, plant blackout) and lead the response in a crisis.
* Promote a safety culture through visible leadership, participation in safety activities and training, and ensure that work is carried out with safety as an integral part of the job.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental permits, emission limits and monitoring and reporting requirements, in coordination with HSE and Permitting.
* Lead plant coordination with customers, grid operators and other stakeholders under agreed communication protocols, including dispatch communication and contractual availability and performance obligations.
* Ensure the plant meets grid operator and off-taker requirements for frequency, voltage, reactive power and load-change capability.
* Lead inspection and audit preparation and ensure responsible parties complete corrective actions, records and required submissions.
* Review the Contractor’s staffing and shift plans against contract requirements, require adequate competence and coverage and resolve staffing deficiencies through its management. Recruitment, payroll and employment administration remain with the Contractor.
* Ensure accurate operating, maintenance and equipment records and timely daily, weekly and monthly performance reports, including capacity utilization analysis, to the O&M Director.
* Ensure plant administrative, operating and maintenance procedures and documentation are established and aligned with applicable safety, environmental and quality management system requirements, and follow the Company’s risk management approach.
* Contribute to short, medium and long-term plant strategy, including reliability and capital investment planning, with the O&M Director.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Energy Systems, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of power generation O&M experience in natural gas-fired combined cycle plants, with responsibility for plant operations, maintenance and technical team leadership.
* Hands-on knowledge of combined cycle systems, including heavy-duty gas turbines, HRSGs, steam turbines, generators, water and steam chemistry, balance-of-plant equipment and DCS controls, with the ability to lead complex troubleshooting.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager or Maintenance Manager experience at a combined cycle plant.
* Experience with the gas turbine technology installed at the assigned plant (for example Siemens Energy or GE frame units).
* Experience planning and managing major outages and inspections (combustion, hot gas path, major overhaul) with OEMs and multiple contractors.
* Experience overseeing an outsourced O&M contractor or equivalent contract oversight, including performance management, labor-hour and invoice control, budgets and reporting.
* Experience with OEM long-term service agreements and warranty management.
* US operating experience, including independent power producers or owner-side operations.
* Working knowledge of NERC reliability requirements as applicable, environmental permit and emissions compliance, lockout/tagout and permit-to-work systems, and EHS regulations.
* Understanding of power market operations, including dispatch, availability obligations and commercial reporting to customers.
* Competence in CMMS and reporting tools; fluent English and MS Office proficiency.
* Training or certification in combined cycle O&M, leadership and team management, and problem-solving and decision-making techniques is preferred.
* Authorization to work in the United States. Ability to work at the assigned US site, travel as required.

role.description:
Job Description

applying with LinkedIn

**Job Title:** **Senior Manager Manufacturing Training**
========================================================

Req Id: 3772

Work Model: On-Site

Company: Philip Morris USA

State/Province: Virginia

Job Description:

**Together We Innovate. Together We Change.**

 

We are seeking a **Senior Manager, Manufacturing Training** to lead all salaried and hourly training across Cigarette Manufacturing (CM) and Primary, including logistics. This strategic role sets direction, clears roadblocks and owns the budget.

 

**What you will be doing:**

* Own the end-to-end training strategy for salaried, hourly technical and hourly non-technical employees, including the multi-year capability roadmap and annual priorities.
* Anticipate business and technical issues, own the consolidated training demand forecast, and make trade-offs across populations when operations shift.
* Secure leadership commitments across Operations, Engineering, Staffing, OEMs, Finance and the union, and escalate to clear resource roadblocks such as new-equipment training gaps.
* Own the training budget, approve OEM, third-party and travel spend, contract new vendors with Procurement and Legal, and manage the Technician iPad program.
* Own the training logistics standard: master schedule, training calendar and people tracker, equipment and OEM instructor scheduling, LMS records and labor agreement scheduling rules.
* Own the ISO 9001 training quality system and align all training groups to it.
* Set strategy for major initiatives such as North Pole Export, and sponsor training modernization, the innovation strategy and the Manufacturing Knowledge Center.
* Set training-wide objectives, metrics and trainer qualification standard; represent training on the Intergrated Work Systems (IWS) Education & Training Pillar.
 

**What we want you to have:**

* 10+ years in training or manufacturing operations, including leading leaders; Bachelor's required, advanced degree or professional certification preferred.
* In-depth manufacturing process and equipment knowledge, with solutions that span departments.
* Proven ability to set strategy, anticipate business issues and allocate budget.
* Influences across departments; uses candor to challenge others and change direction.
* ISO 9001, LMS and Office 365 experience (Copilot preferred); supports all shifts and works in manufacturing using Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

**As a People Leader at Altria, you are accountable for both results and the experience of your team. You drive alignment by connecting strategy to daily work, and you model collaboration by embracing diverse perspectives. By creating trust, offering feedback, and leading with authenticity, you help strengthen Altria’s culture and deliver meaningful outcomes.**

 

The starting salary is based on but not limited to experience, knowledge, and qualifications in determining compensation decisions. The Salary Range for this position is: $132,500.00 - $202,100.00.

 

**Why You’ll Love Building Your Career at Altria**

 

At Altria, we believe a great career starts with feeling supported — both at work and in life. Here’s what you’ll find here:

* **Own your time** — start with 15 days of paid time off, 13 paid holidays, and a 37.5-hour workweek so you can recharge and live fully.
* **A place where you belong** — where your ideas are welcomed, your growth is encouraged, and your impact is real.
* **Get recognized for your work** — annual merit increases and performance bonus.
* **A future you can count on** — 401(k) matching from day one; plus Deferred Profit Sharing, an annual company contribution in an amount equal to 13%–17% of your base salary.
* **Help with your goals** — get help with student loan repayment assistance, attend a conference, or gain a new certification with professional development stipends.
* **Support for what matters most** — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family.
* **Celebrating your milestones** — paid parental and bonding leave for life’s biggest moments.
* **Wellness that goes beyond work** — programs that care for your whole well-being at whatever stage you are in your life.
* **A culture that gives back** — paid volunteer days and a shared commitment to making a difference.
 

**At Altria, we offer more than benefits — we offer a career that fits your life, rewards your ambition, and celebrates your impact.**

 

This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

**Altria is a Fortune 500 company that has a leading portfolio of products for U.S. adult tobacco and nicotine consumers 21+. For decades we’ve been leaders in the tobacco industry, but the industry is evolving - and so are we. Our Vision is Moving Beyond Smoking™.**

**At Altria, we celebrate the power of diverse teams working together to shape our future. Each Altria company is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing individuals with criminal records, including formerly incarcerated individuals and individuals with conviction records, a fair chance at employment. Join us as we work together to shape a better future for adult tobacco consumers, our employees, and our shareholders.**

**Altria is the parent company of Philip Morris USA, John Middleton, U.S. Smokeless Tobacco, Helix Innovations, and NJOY. Altria complements its tobacco portfolio with equity investments in Anheuser-Busch InBev and Cronos Group.**

role.title: Senior Manager - Operations External Manufact
role.description:
**Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing**

**About the Company:**

At Horizon Organic, we’re growing a culture of passionate people driven to do good for the horizon we all share. We’re building the tomorrow we want to see. Every single day.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your skills are valued, and your contributions make a real difference. We offer diverse opportunities for career growth and development. Embark on a rewarding journey with us in shaping the future of organic dairy!

Two generations of families—and counting—have grown up on Horizon Organic® milk. From the start, as the leading organic milk producer in the U.S., Horizon has been committed to delivering innovative, nourishing dairy that growing families can rely on. In 2023, Horizon Organic became a brand of Platinum Equity. Today, Horizon works with more than 500 farmers across the U.S. to bring high-quality, certified organic milk to consumers. For more information on Horizon’s full portfolio of organic dairy products, visit Horizon.com.

**About the Job:**

We are currently looking to hire a **Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing** to join our Supply Chain Department.

Leads external manufacturing operations and network optimization activities across contract manufacturing partners. This role is responsible for ensuring external manufacturing partners deliver excellence in Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery while supporting business growth, supply continuity, and operational effectiveness. The position partners closely with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to drive execution and continuous improvement across the external manufacturing network.

The Senior Manager - Operations External Manufacturing is responsible for the operational leadership of external manufacturing partners, management of manufacturing qualifications, execution of network optimization initiatives, and oversight of manufacturing performance across assigned facilities. This role develops and implements operational strategies, establishes performance expectations, leads cross functional initiatives, and ensures external manufacturing partners deliver products safely, efficiently, and in alignment with business objectives.

*This is a hybrid position with an expectation of 3 days per week on-site in Broomfield, CO.*

**This role may be responsible for, but not limited to:**

* Lead operational management of external manufacturing partners across assigned manufacturing networks.
* Oversee manufacturing qualification activities and support successful onboarding of new external manufacturing partners.
* Manage execution of network optimization initiatives, including transitions between manufacturing partners and facility rationalization activities.
* Establish and communicate operational performance expectations across Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery metrics.
* Monitor manufacturing partner performance and ensure corrective actions are identified, implemented, and sustained.
* Champion cross-functional project teams supporting network optimization, manufacturing transitions, and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and execute strategies that improve manufacturing performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate manufacturing capabilities and identify opportunities to optimize network performance.
* Ensure manufacturing partners operate in compliance with company standards, quality requirements, and operational expectations.
* Support supply continuity planning and mitigation activities associated with manufacturing risks and constraints.
* Analyze operational performance trends and develop recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external manufacturing partners.
* Lead initiatives that improve collaboration, communication, and execution across the external manufacturing network.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership teams

*The base compensation range for this position is $125,000 - $140,000 commensurate with experience*.

**About You:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or related disciplines.
* Experience working within Consumer Packaged Goods, food, beverage, dairy, or manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects.
* Experience managing suppliers, co-manufacturer, or contract manufacturing relationships.
* Experience developing and implementing operational strategies.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and consumer packaged goods operations.
* Experience managing external manufacturing partners, suppliers, or co-manufacturers.
* Strong strategic planning and network optimization capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to evaluate complex operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Strong project management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to develop and implement operational strategies and performance improvements.
* Strong leadership and organizational effectiveness skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing external manufacturing networks.
* Experience supporting network optimization and manufacturing transition initiatives.
* Experience leading large cross-functional business projects.
* Experience working with contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting supply chain, logistics, planning, and procurement functions.
* Strong understanding of operational performance metrics and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Project management certification or formal project management training preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 25% or more as required.

role.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252)
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description:**

Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.

**What you'll do:**

Development Program Materials Planning

* Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy.
* Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule.
* Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans.
* Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.
* Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.
* Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions.

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness

* Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.
* Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.
* Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership

* Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.
* Establish standard work and training programs.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.
* Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.
* Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.
* Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.
* APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.
* Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

**Why Shield AI:**

At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.

#LI-JM1 
#LD

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

###

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Compensation Range: $167,328 - $250,992

role.description:
**Job Summary**

The Regional Operations Director leads regional performance by aligning people, processes, and financial priorities with business goals. You’ll guide operations across the region, strengthen customer service, and use clear, data-driven decisions to improve results. Your impact: By improving operational consistency and developing strong teams, you help customers receive reliable service and employees work effectively.

* Lead regional operations, business management, and strategic planning; translate priorities into clear plans and accountable execution.
* Manage profit and loss (P&L), financial management, and profit and loss analysis; use Excel data analysis to monitor performance and guide decisions.
* Direct executive-level team management, team leadership, and team management; coach managers, support team development, and provide clear managerial communication.
* Oversee project management, sales, and business development initiatives while maintaining a strong customer service focus.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and apply lean management principles to strengthen operational management and performance.

* Demonstrated leadership, management, and supervising experience in operations or business management.
* Experience with financial management, P&L oversight, and data-driven decision making.
* Ability to lead managers, develop teams, communicate with executives, and coordinate cross-functional projects.
* Knowledge of strategic management, sales, customer service, and process improvement; experience applying lean management principles is preferred.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, including proficiency in Excel data analysis.

* Employee discount

* Health insurance
* Health savings account

role.title: Senior Operations Director
role.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Operations Director to oversee business operations, strengthen financial performance, and improve organizational efficiency. This position is suited for a senior leader who understands how operational decisions affect profitability, resource allocation, and long-term business growth.

The Senior Operations Director will work closely with executive leadership, Finance, and department managers to establish operational priorities, improve internal processes, and ensure that business activities support financial and strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate brings extensive management experience, strong financial judgment, and a practical approach to solving complex operational challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Lead daily business operations and develop operational strategies that support organizational growth and financial performance.

Oversee departmental budgets, operating expenses, financial forecasts, and resource allocation in collaboration with Finance.

Monitor operational performance, profitability, productivity, and key financial indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.

Develop and implement processes that improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary costs, and strengthen organizational accountability.

Work with executive leadership to establish annual operating plans, business priorities, and performance objectives.

Evaluate financial reports, cash flow projections, operating margins, and profit and loss performance to support business decisions.

Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Finance, Human Resources, Business Development, and other operational departments.

Identify operational risks, improve internal controls, and support compliance with applicable business requirements.

Oversee vendor relationships, contract performance, procurement activities, and operational expenditures.

Introduce technology and automation solutions that improve reporting accuracy, workflow efficiency, and business performance.

Establish performance standards and management reporting procedures across operational teams.

Lead, mentor, and develop department managers while maintaining clear accountability for operational results.

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive experience in business operations, corporate management, financial operations, or related leadership positions.

At least 8 years of management experience overseeing operational teams, departmental budgets, or cross-functional business initiatives.

Strong understanding of financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and profit and loss analysis.

Demonstrated experience improving operational efficiency, managing business resources, and supporting organizational growth.

Experience developing operational strategies, managing performance indicators, and implementing process improvements.

Strong knowledge of financial reporting, cash flow management, business analytics, and operational risk assessment.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, enterprise management systems, and business intelligence tools.

Excellent organizational leadership, strategic planning, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.

A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, or a related discipline is required. An MBA or relevant advanced degree is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

You are an accomplished operations leader who understands the connection between financial discipline, operational efficiency, and business performance.

You have extensive experience managing complex operations, developing capable management teams, and improving business processes.

You are comfortable working with senior executives, evaluating financial information, and making decisions that affect organizational performance.

You bring sound financial judgment, strong leadership skills, and the ability to balance immediate operational needs with long-term business priorities.

You are focused on building efficient operations, maintaining financial accountability, and delivering measurable business results.

Pay: $206,200.00 - $256,000.00 per year

* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance

* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

role.title: Director of Virtual Operations
role.description:
We save lives while providing the opportunity for people to realize their healthy selves.:

**Director of Virtual Operations**

**Monte Nido**

**Remote**

Monte Nido has been delivering treatment for eating disorders for over three decades. Our programs offer a model of treatment that blends medically sophisticated care with a personalized treatment approach. Our work is grounded in evidence-based strategies for adults and adolescents suffering from eating disorders. We work from a multi-disciplinary treatment team approach while integrating state-of-the-art medical, psychiatric, nutritional, and clinical strategies to provide comprehensive care within an intimate home setting.

The Director of Virtual Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for Monte Nido’s virtual programs in accordance with the organization’s philosophy and mission. Reporting to the Vice President of Virtual Programs, the Director leads the Program Manager and Group Facilitation Senior Manager, establishes consistent operating standards, and ensures effective coordination across program operations, group facilitation, clinical leadership, quality, compliance, and support functions. The role is accountable for staffing and capacity planning, scheduling and coverage, attendance and census processes, documentation and clinical quality oversight, regulatory readiness, performance measurement, process improvement, and resolution of escalated operational and safety concerns. The Director translates organizational priorities into reliable execution, develops leaders, uses data to identify risks and opportunities, and advances safe, high-quality, efficient virtual care.

Schedule: Monday-Friday

Salary: $70k-$85k annually

Total Rewards::

Discover a rewarding career with us and enjoy an array of comprehensive benefits! We prioritize your success and well-being, providing:

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage (Benefits At a Glance)
* Retirement
* Company-paid life insurance, AD&D, and short-term disability
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Paid time off
* Professional development
* And many more!

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Responsibilities Include::

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 
1. Provide strategic and operational leadership for virtual program operations, translating organizational priorities into clear plans, standards, and measurable outcomes. 
2. Lead, coach, and supervise the Program Manager/Coordinator and Group Facilitation Senior Manager, including goal setting, performance management, career development, succession planning, and corrective action when needed. 
3. Establish operating expectations across program administration and group facilitation, ensuring leaders maintain consistent practices for staffing, scheduling, coverage, attendance, documentation, client engagement, and escalation. 
4. Maintain oversight of staffing models, schedules, capacity, and coverage across virtual programs; anticipate resource needs and escalate material risks with clear recommendations. 
5. Own program schedules across virtual services, including schedule design, maintenance, and communication; identify availability limitations and escalate constraints that may affect access, coverage, or continuity of care to Clinical Directors and other appropriate clinical leaders. 
6. Oversee attendance, census, engagement, discharge, outcomes, client satisfaction, and operational performance indicators; use trends to improve retention, quality, and efficiency. 
7. Ensure reliable documentation and clinical quality audit processes, including timely corrective follow-up, retraining, chart completion, required signatures, and maintenance of program records. 
8. Direct operational readiness for Joint Commission, payer, licensing, and internal audits in partnership with clinical, quality, compliance, billing, and human resources leaders. 
9. Ensure virtual-program policies, procedures, care schedules, handbooks, workflows, and telehealth standards remain current, practical, and consistently implemented. 
10. Partner with clinical and medical leaders to resolve escalated client safety, attendance, staffing, documentation, and program-quality concerns while preserving appropriate clinical decision-making authority. 
11. Partner with Clinical Directors to develop and implement quality-of-care initiatives, monitor effectiveness, address identified gaps, and support consistent standards across virtual programs. 
12. Define performance expectations for operational functions and hold leaders accountable for employee development, engagement, conduct, productivity, and consistent application of policies in partnership with Human Resources. 
13. Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve workflows, technology use, communication, service quality, and the experience of clients, families, employees, and referral partners. 
14. Communicate significant operational, safety, quality, compliance, and resource risks to the Vice President of Virtual Programs with timely analysis and recommended actions. 
15. Represent virtual operations in required leadership and management meetings and facilitate decision-making, implementation, and follow-through across stakeholder groups.

**Additional Duties and Responsibilities** 
1. Support insurance, compliance, personnel-file, referral-partner, outpatient-provider, and discharge-transition activities when operational leadership is needed. 
2. Provide executive-ready updates on virtual program performance, risks, priorities, and improvement initiatives. 
3. Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, sound judgment, and respectful communication in all interactions. 
4. Adhere to Monte Nido & Affiliates policies, procedures, telehealth etiquette, and safety standards, and ensure assigned leaders reinforce them consistently. 
5. Provide additional operational leadership and complete other duties as assigned. 
6. VIRTUAL EMPLOYEES: We have the same expectations for employees as we do for Cares. We ask that you keep your camera on and join from a private space free of noise and distractions (e.g., not from a car) when meeting with Cares or joining a clinical staff meeting. You will need a reliable video conferencing setup, including a camera, microphone, and stable, high-speed Internet connection. You must also be prepared with a backup plan in the event of technology failures. We expect you to consider your personal appearance in much the same way you would when seeing Cares in person. You must also keep your background clean and professional.

Qualifications::

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, behavioral health, business, or a related field required; master’s degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant leadership experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in behavioral health, healthcare operations, or a comparable care-delivery environment, including at least three years of people leadership. Experience leading managers, overseeing virtual operations, managing multi-program workflows, and supporting accreditation, payer, and regulatory requirements is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop managers, establish clear expectations, and drive accountability across multiple programs and functions
* Strong operational judgment, change leadership, project management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to interpret operational and quality data, identify trends, manage risk, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Knowledge of Joint Commission standards, payer requirements, patient confidentiality laws, telehealth requirements, and organizational compliance expectations.

role.title: Director, Quality Assurance
role.description:
Director, Quality Assurance - Homebased - Blue Bell and Rochester 
 

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

 
 

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

 
 

As a Director, Quality Assurance at ICON, you will ensure the quality and compliance of clinical trials, interpret regulatory requirements, and contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.

 

**What You Will Do:**

Your focus will be on driving quality assurance and compliance performance, ensuring quality, and building capability across your area (specifically Imaging and Cardiac Services).
 
 
Key responsibilities include:

 

* Serving as the QA business partner to Medical Imaging and Cardiac Services leadership and teams, providing strategic guidance on quality, regulatory compliance, and emerging risk.
* Leading the development and implementation of quality assurance strategies and processes to support clinical trial activities including establishing quality priorities with leadership and integrating quality considerations into business and operational planning.
* Conducting comprehensive quality assessments and audits to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and guidelines.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and address quality issues and implement corrective actions as needed; analyzing quality trends to identify systemic risk and preventive improvement opportunities
* Providing expert guidance and support to staff regarding quality assurance policies, procedures, and best practices.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of quality management systems and documentation. Promote a proactive culture of quality and continuous improvement.
* Establish quality priorities with IMC leadership and integrate quality considerations into business and operational planning.
* Provide strategic oversight of the risk-based IMC audit program, including internal and vendor audits.
* Represent Quality & Compliance in strategic sponsor relationships, governance, and significant quality escalations. Support the development, interpretation, and governance of quality agreements.
 

**Your Profile:**

You will bring significant quality assurance and compliance experience, with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering results.
 
 
Required qualifications and experience:

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in quality assurance within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, Medical Imaging or CRO industry, with significant experience in a leadership role.
* Extensive knowledge of regulatory requirements and guidelines governing clinical trials (e.g., ICH-GCP, FDA regulations). Knowledge of AI governance and regulations is advantageous.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex quality issues.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Strong leadership skills including cross functional management
* Willingness to travel as required (approximately 25%)

**Rewards & Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

 
 

Benefits may include:

* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
 

 

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

 
 

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

role.title: Regional Operations Director - Chicago
role.description:
### **Your Impact as a Regional Operations Director**

As a Regional Operations Director, you are a key leader responsible for the success and health of a diverse portfolio of veterinary hospitals. You will serve as the crucial link between local hospital teams and the broader Mission Pet Health network, empowering your teams to achieve excellence in both business performance and patient care.

* **Geographic Location:** This position supports our Chicago, Illinois market. Ideal candidates will reside within the greater Chicago metropolitan area or surrounding communities, with the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned hospital portfolio. Candidates must be comfortable with regional travel and maintaining a strong on-site presence to support hospital leadership teams.
* **Champion a Thriving Culture:** You'll partner with your Regional Medical Director to foster a positive, engaged, and high-performing culture across all hospitals in your region.
* **Develop Future Leaders:** You'll guide the growth of Hospital Managers and their teams, ensuring a strong pipeline of talent through effective coaching, training, and career development.
* **Drive Business Performance:** You'll have full ownership of the financial health of your region, managing P&Ls to drive revenue growth and optimize operational efficiency.
* **Build Winning Teams:** You'll lead the strategy for non-DVM recruiting and staffing, ensuring your hospitals have the talent they need to succeed.
* **Elevate the Client Experience:** You'll set the standard for exceptional client service, ensuring operational processes support a seamless and positive experience for every pet owner.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* A proven track record of successful multi-site P&L management, with a keen ability to drive financial results.
* Demonstrated success in recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams, especially in a leadership capacity.
* Exceptional leadership skills with a talent for building a positive, accountable, and solutions-focused culture.
* Excellent communication and conflict management skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences.
* Significant experience leading in a multi-site veterinary, healthcare, or customer-centric retail environment.

### **How You're Supported**

*As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.* 
 
*Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.*

##### **Competitive Compensation**

A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.

##### **Health & Wellbeing**

We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.

##### **Financial Security**

Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.

##### **Commitment to Growth**

We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.

##### **The Power of a Network**

Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.

##### **Valuable Perks**

Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

### **About Mission Pet Health**

Mission Pet Health was founded by veterinarians on the belief that local practices thrive with clinical autonomy, collaboration, and medical excellence. The organization provides world-class support to its 850+ hospital teams on a hyper-local basis so they can focus on what matters most: the medicine, their patients, and their team culture. Learn more at **missionpethealth.com**.

Driving the award-winning culture are the WAG values – **Work Together, Amaze, and Grow**. Mission Pet Health is veterinarian-led, people-focused, and on a mission to be the best place to work in veterinary medicine. We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 "Most Loved Workplace," ranked #2 in America's Top 100 and #1 in veterinary care.

role.title: Executive Director, Process Lead, Corporate Functions Operations, Enterprise Business Services
role.description:
**The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.** is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.

**Description**
---------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corporate Process Ownership & Governance**

* Lead governance for assigned corporate process domains
* Define standards, accountabilities, controls, decision rights, and escalation paths
* Partner with Global Process Owners and functional leaders to establish priorities and transformation roadmaps
* Align policies, controls, service requirements, and technology enablement across functions
* Facilitate governance forums and resolve cross-functional issues involving EBS teams and third-party providers

**End-to-End Process Design & Optimization**

* Simplify, standardize, and integrate cross-functional processes across organizational boundaries
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, process mining, and related methodologies to identify improvement opportunities
* Design processes that enhance efficiency, controls, service quality, resilience, and user experience
* Define global standards while evaluating and approving necessary local variations

**Risk, Controls, and Compliance**

* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Security, Audit, and Records Management leaders to incorporate requirements into process design
* Ensure process changes maintain effective controls and compliance standards
* Address process and control gaps through improvements in workflow, governance, tech, data, and accountability
* Support remediation of audit and operational findings

**Service Delivery & Experience**

* Improve employee and stakeholder experience through streamlined workflows, clear service models, and effective knowledge management
* Define service expectations and responsibilities across retained functions, EBS teams, and external providers
* Leverage stakeholder feedback and operational data to identify and address service gaps
* Promote self-service capabilities and user-friendly process design

**Performance & Value Realization**

* Develop and maintain a prioritized process improvement roadmap
* Define and track outcomes related to cost, productivity, service quality, control effectiveness, and risk reduction
* Establish performance measures, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms
* Support business case development and benefit realization tracking

**Digital Enablement**

* Partner with Tech and Data teams to incorporate automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work and improve data quality and transparency
* Ensure digital solutions align with business and stakeholder needs
* Promote integrated platforms and processes across corporate functions

**Transformation & Op Model Support**

* Provide process leadership for migrations, consolidations, outsourcing initiatives, and operating model changes
* Define future-state processes and support implementation, adoption, and stabilization
* Assess process, control, data, and organizational risks associated with transformation initiatives
* Ensure transitioned processes have appropriate ownership, controls, measures, and governance

**Stakeholder & Capability Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across corporate functions and EBS
* Present recommendations, trade-offs, and investment priorities in business terms
* Influence outcomes across a global matrixed organization
* Coach process leaders on governance and continuous improvement practices

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications and Competencies**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business or a relevant area of study
* 12+ years of experience in corporate functions, enterprise operations, GBS/shared services, process excellence, or large-scale transformation
* Strong understanding of corporate-function operating models, service delivery, internal controls, governance, and cross-functional dependencies
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated success standardizing and improving complex processes across functions, geographies, delivery centers, and third-party providers
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, value-stream mapping, process mining, or comparable process-improvement methodologies. Relevant certification is preferred
* Strong financial and operational judgment, analytical problem-solving, executive communication, and change leadership
* Experience with shared services, outsourcing, multi-vendor delivery, service management, and global process governance is preferred
* Ability to incorporate risk, control, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements into practical and effective process designs

**Pay Range:**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$158,650.00** to **$272,700.00**. Exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. Salary range may vary based on geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program as well as participation in the share incentive plan. In addition,

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with the possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results. In addition, The Estée Lauder Companies offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance), wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time, and many others. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is Company's policy not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. The Company will endeavor to provide a reasonable accommodation consistent with the law to otherwise qualified employees and prospective employees with a disability and to employees and prospective employees with needs related to their religious observance or practices. Should you wish to apply for this position or any other position with the Company and you believe you require assistance to complete an application or participate in an interview, please contact USApplicantAccommodations@Estee.com.

role.title: Operations Director, Palm Beach
role.description:
**The Team:** 
The Hermès Palm Beach Boutique opened in 1977 and focuses on providing extraordinary service to clients as a part of the Southern Region. This position will report to the Managing Director and will work collaboratively with the sales team and selling support teams to support the client experience in a fast-paced, luxury environment.

**The Opportunity:** 
The Operations Director is responsible for overseeing all operational functions which may include inventory control, housekeeping, maintenance and selling service associates. This position is responsible for adhering to P&L budget for all operational areas. The Director of Operations communicates trains and implements all company policies and ensures compliance. The Operations Director will create efficient processes, set parameters and implement directives to support operational efficiency and growth.

All other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

**About the Role:**

* Manages shipping and receiving department. Assess actions to be taken with receiving issues. Ensure the timely movement of merchandise and adherence to all procedural guidelines including but not limited to transfers, RTVs, damages, negative on hands etc. Through management of inventory control associates and other operational staff, ensure the organization and efficient operation of all back of house space.
* Takes part in all managerial responsibilities for efficient running of the business inclusive of overseeing and validating cash handling procedures are respected, appropriately documented and reported to Managing Director. Operations Director will contribute and work in tandem with retail management team as needed and in fair rotation. Operations Director will also assist in the absence of Managing Director and Floor Directors during Podium, vacations or in the absence of the Assistant Manager or Selling Supervisor.
* Ensure workflow of all after-sales service and craftspeople/tailors if applicable.
* Performs and prepares for all inventories and cycle counts, including reconciliations of stock discrepancies. Performs stock adjustments.
* Liaison with corporate construction and maintenance department and outside vendors with regards to any maintenance needs. Ensure building and store are maintained to company standard and all issues are addressed in a timely manner.
* Ensure functionality of all IT and phone system by communicating with corporate contacts and securing resolutions.
* Acts as a liaison with outside vendors for monthly need and or special events.
* Partners with Managing Director to manage operational team and vendors ensuring appropriate scheduling training and coaching. Manages E-time and keeps accurate record of vacation and time and attendance with HR. This includes all SSA’s, housekeeping, shipping and receiving, asset protection guards and after sales staff as appropriate for the location.
* Coordinates and prepares evacuation drills and provides training to team with regards to emergency response preparedness.
* Responsible for and oversees all operations and after-sales supply orders.
* Oversees all Staff Sales
* Trains staffs to ensure compliance with all operational policies and procedures ensuring policies are thoroughly communicated to all staff in a timely manner.
Recruits and maintains an active talent bank for any operational positions. 

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

* YES

Supervises Inventory Control, SSA and After-Sales positions. (Tailor, Maintenance, Crafts persons)

**Budget Responsibility:**

* YES

Budget guidelines are set annually. The Operations Director will be directly involved with budget expectations with regards to selling supplies, cleaning and maintenance contracts, guard service, repairs, rental equipment and kitchen supplies. They will work within the confines of the budget in partnership with the respective corporate departments. The Operations Director should identify areas for cost efficient and minimize costs when possible.

**Decision Making Responsibility:**

* YES

Assess when general repairs need to be made to the building and when electronic equipment should be upgraded or replaced in partnership with corporate offices. Determine actions to be taken when receiving issues with negative on hands. Responsible for deciding when supply orders need to be placed. Implement efficient workflow processes for after-sales tracking.

**About You:**

* 5+ years of retail management experience in a similar role; prior experience in a luxury environment preferred.
* Proficient shipping and receiving experience.
* Excellent computer skills and proficient in MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
* Strong POS and phone systems knowledge.
* Extensive building maintenance experience.
* Must work well under pressure and have the ability to multi-task with accuracy.
* Acute interpersonal skills and a collaborative management style.
* Familiarity with international parent companies a plus.
Ability to lift between 0-25 lbs. without assistance. 

The range for this position is $99,155.47 - $120,000.00 annually. Actual rates are determined based on the job, location, and individual experience.

Hermès is proud to offer a variety of benefits to support the needs of our employees and their families, including:

* Commission and bonus incentives based on sales performance
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Life Insurance and Disability
* Paid time off (annual vacation of 15 days, 11 company holidays, 3 floating holidays, 2 wellbeing days, and sick & safe time)
* Paid Parental leave and transition time
* 401(k) and Roth Retirement plan with company matching and profit sharing
* Various voluntary benefits such as flexible spending accounts, fitness reimbursement, voluntary life insurance
* Product discount and EAP resources
Access to Calm App, Health Advocate, Family Building Support and more! 

We are looking for a candidate that has a combination of the above attributes and can perform the key functions of the role with or without reasonable accommodations.

**Company Overview** 
Since 1837, Hermès has remained faithful to its artisan business model and humanist values. We place people at the heart of what we do and aspire to make a positive impact on the world. The freedom to create, the constant search for beautiful materials, the transmission of a savoir-faire of excellence and the aesthetic of functionality define the singularity of Hermès, a house dedicated to making highly-crafted, beautiful objects made to stand the test of time.

An independent, family-owned company, Hermès is dedicated to keeping production in France through its 42 workshops, The Hermès organization is also a truly global community with a network of 310 stores in 49 countries. Hermès employs more than 15,000 people worldwide with over 6,000 of the workforce being Hermès craftspeople engaged in making artisanal products, nurturing a 180+ year tradition of creativity and innovation.

At Hermès, our actions for sustainable development and corporate social responsibility are founded in values passed down by generations of humble artisans who have shaped the story of our house and the integrity of our objects. The roots of Hermès’ success and longevity lie in a sense of responsibility; a quest for authenticity and respect for time and preservation of natural resources. All at Hermès wish to leave a positive footprint on the world, a mission that’s at the heart of our commitment to progress. This narrative can be experienced in a series of shorts films “Footsteps Across the World” available on our website. Link here .

**Our Commitment** 
Family is at the heart of Hermès. At Hermès of Paris, we are committed to being a Maison for All, a home where we make efforts to generate, support and advance the values of diversity, inclusion and family both within our own walls and in the wider world. At Hermès of Paris we look to create a diverse workforce of talented and unique individuals with different backgrounds, skillsets and worldviews that will enrich our Hermès of Paris family. We support our individual team members personal and professional success through a culture that values equality, individuality and fairness and through an environment where individuals can thrive and feel comfortable being their authentic selves. Beyond the walls of our Maison, we advance our DIF values through the work that we do in partnership with our community and non-profit partners.

At Hermès of Paris, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. It is the policy of Hermès of Paris, Inc. that applicants for employment are recruited, selected and hired on the basis of individual merit and ability with respect to positions being filled and potential for promotion or transfer which may be expected to develop. Applicants are recruited, selected and hired without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, military or veteran status or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. In addition, personnel procedures and practices with regard to training, promotion, transfer, compensation, demotion, lay off or termination are to be administered with due regard to job performance, experience and qualifications, but without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, military or veteran status or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Hermès of Paris, Inc. also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, in accordance with applicable laws.

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Hermes, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, commercial information, professional or employment information, non-public education records, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. For additional details or if you have questions, contact us at privacy.us@hermes.com. Please do not submit resumes or applications to this email address.
