role.description:
Career Level Experienced Professional

Functions Operations

Salary Range Competitive salary

 

**Manufacturing Careers at Reynolds**
-------------------------------------

The organization includes three manufacturing facilities in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, Tobaccoville, North Carolina, and Clarksville, Tennessee, producing traditional combustible tobacco products, as well as new category alternatives. It takes innovative thinking and the latest technology to deliver the best results for our consumers and our business in our transformative journey of Building A Better Tomorrow™.

**Supply Network & Manufacturing Contingency Design Senior Manager**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

**Reynolds American is evolving into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.**

**To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey. Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**

**REYNOLDS AMERICAN has an exciting opportunity for a Supply Network & Manufacturing Contingency Design Senior Manager in Winston-Salem, NC**

What happens to supply when a critical manufacturing site suddenly becomes unavailable?

We're looking for a **Supply Network & Manufacturing Contingency Design Senior Manager** to help answer that question before a disruption happens.

You'll develop and maintain manufacturing contingency strategies that protect continuity of supply, volume, revenue and gross margin across a complex manufacturing network. You'll identify and qualify alternative production sites and ensure critical manufacturing locations have credible, executable recovery strategies.

**Your key responsibilities will include****:**

* Develop Manufacturing Contingency Supply Plans for critical products and technologies.
* Identify and qualify alternative manufacturing sites.
* Lead site-readiness assessments and loss-of-facility recovery planning.
* Analyse capacity, manufacturing constraints, technical capability and recovery timelines.
* Coordinate product transfers, trials and validation activities.
* Develop gap-closure plans with clear ownership and timelines.
* Partner across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Planning, Procurement, Logistics and Finance.
* Build executive recommendations around network risk, resilience and investment.
* Maintain contingency-coverage metrics and senior-leadership reporting.

**What are we looking for?**

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Engineering, Operations or related field.
* 5+ years in supply chain strategy, network design, manufacturing or business continuity.
* Strong analytical and project management capability.
* Strong cross-functional stakeholder management.
* Experience with manufacturing transfers, capacity planning, and/or risk management is highly valuable.

**WE ARE REYNOLDS AMERICAN—A member of the BRITISH AMERICAN TOBACCO GROUP**

At Reynolds American, we are committed to our Purpose of creating A Better Tomorrow. This is what drives our people and our passion for innovation. **See what is possible for you at REYNOLDS AMERICAN.**

**BELONGING, ACHIEVING, TOGETHER**

Collaboration and teamwork underpin everything we do here at Reynolds American. We know that collaborating with colleagues is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.

**SALARY AND BENEFITS OVERVIEW**

The following is a general summary of the competitive compensation and benefit plans we offer:

* 401(k) plan that offers opportunity to save on pre- and post-tax basis up to 50 percent of eligible compensation.
 + Company matches 100 percent of employee pre-tax/Roth (401k) contributions up to six percent
 + Company contributes an additional three percent to 401(k) whether employee participates or not
* Comprehensive health- and welfare-benefits package (including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drugs)
* Health Savings Account start-up contribution for employees who elect the high deductible health plan
* Flexible spending accounts for both Health Care and Dependent Care allowing employee to use pre-tax dollars to pay for qualified expenses during the calendar year
* Employee assistance program offering 8 free counselling sessions, per issue, each calendar year for employees and their dependents
* Company paid life insurance of 1x annual base pay ($50,000 minimum)
* Company paid accidental death or dismemberment insurance of 2x annual base pay ($50,000 minimum)
* Voluntary insurances offered at group rates: employee and dependent life insurance, AD&D insurance, critical illness, accident coverage, disability buy-up, and auto & home insurance
* Tuition reimbursement and student loan support
* Dependent Scholarship Programs
* Free confidential personal financial counselling service
* On-site health centers and 24/7 fitness centers at certain company locations
* A charitable giving matching grants program that enables employees to direct and double their donations to qualifying charitable organizations of their choice
* Health-care concierge service
* Volunteer service opportunities
* Extensive training opportunities
* Company vehicle for eligible employees
* Mobile phone allowance for eligible employees
* Paid Leave:
 + Sick and Personal Time (exempt employees may be excused with pay for brief absences; non-exempt employees receive up to 6 days)
 + Vacation (levels Below Senior Director receive 15 days (pro-rated during first year of service); Senior Director and Officers receive 25 days (pro-rated during first year of service)).
 + Holidays (Nine company recognized and two annual personal holidays to be used at the employee’s discretion)
 + Paid Parental Leave + temporary reduced work schedule opportunity

 + Long-Term Disability Leave
 + Jury Duty Leave
 + Military Leave
 + Released Time for Children’s Education
 + Community Outreach Leave
 + Other paid leave benefits, as required by state or local law

role.description:
### **Senior Manager, Operational Excellence - Factor US**

***This role is hybrid to our Goodyear, AZ Factor facility***

### **Company Overview**

At Factor, we are on a mission to revolutionize the way people eat by making healthy, fresh, chef-prepared meals accessible and effortless. As the market leader in the Ready-To-Eat (RTE) meal space, we eliminate the need for cooking and meal prep while delivering high-quality, nutrition-focused meals directly to millions of customers. The Factor team is diverse, high-performing, and fast-growing, offering an inspiring environment where process innovation, operational discipline, and continuous improvement thrive.

### **About the role**

The **Senior Manager, Operational Excellence** leads OpEx capability and multi-site improvement programs across Factor's US ready-to-eat fulfillment, production and distribution network. The role owns projects end to end, from charter and business case through delivery and post-mortem. It combines Lean and Six Sigma methods with senior project-management discipline.

You will serve as a lead advocate for operational transformation by partnering with and challenging business leaders to adopt systems thinking and continuous process innovation.

### **You will...**

* Lead strategic Factor operations projects in continuous improvement, change management, cost optimization and OpEx training across RTE fulfillment networks.
* Direct complex, cross-facility improvement programs, coordinating site leadership with central project teams.
* Own project governance end to end: find high-ROI opportunities, write financially justified charters and capital project justifications, negotiate resources, launch teams, track results and remove roadblocks.
* Deliver projects to demanding schedules and aggressive cost targets, often with changing requirements. Routinely assess project risks and identify alternative paths to offset them.
* Lead the cross-functional project prioritization workflow and scoping program, and facilitate the project pipeline for all stakeholders.
* Develop, improve and maintain the project management process for the organization, and ensure best practices are followed.
* Build organized project plans from complex inputs, track status across a large program, and keep accurate records through frequent iterations.
* Identify new technologies that can deliver meaningful benefits, and champion changes that drive measurable operational improvements.
* Oversee material handling equipment, automation and warehouse projects. Serve as liaison between vendors and site maintenance, operations and technology teams.
* Apply DMAIC, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping and 5-Why to eliminate root causes of operational friction.
* Lead change management and risk mitigation for key operational shifts.
* Capture and scale best practices across production and fulfillment sites.
* Mentor junior project managers, Lean practitioners and floor supervisors in complex system integrations, and provide leadership to assigned teams so key competencies are developed and maintained.
* Support COGS reporting and tool creation. Data-driven, sound bridges, and coordinate actions that reduce COGS.

### **You are...**

* **Strategic leadership:** Influences without direct authority and aligns multi-site leaders around shared operational goals.
* **Project and time management:** Delivers multi-phase process and infrastructure projects on time and within budget.
* **Organization:** Builds organized project plans from complex inputs and keeps accurate records across frequent iterations.
* **Enterprising and creative:** Starts new operational and strategic projects, and challenges conventional methods with new ideas.
* **Cross-functional collaboration**: Bridges Central Strategy, Food Safety & Quality Assurance, Logistics, Procurement and DC Operations.
* **Stakeholder facilitation:** Negotiates, facilitates and resolves conflicting priorities across local and central stakeholders.
* **Communication:** Independently manages the cadence of formal and informal communication across all levels of the organization.
* **Critical thinking:** Weighs the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions before committing.
* **Data-driven**: Interprets operational telemetry, unit economics and process-flow metrics to make decisions.
* **Coaching and mentorship:** Coaches floor supervisors, Lean practitioners and project managers with constructive, empathy-driven feedback.
* **Driven by results**: Pushes projects to completion with urgency, focused on tangible business outcomes.

### **You have...**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or equivalent management experience.
* 7+ years of experience in continuous improvement / OpEx roles within food manufacturing, RTE operations, or cold-chain logistics.
* Has led cross-facility or multi-site improvement programs.
* Hands-on use of DMAIC, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping and 5-Why.
* Master Black Belt or PMP Certification preferred.
* Extensive experience with Google Workspace.
* Experience with project management software.
* Experience utilizing AI tools and workflows.

### **Travel...**

* Travel: 25%-50% across Factor's national US fulfillment and production network

### **You'll get...**

* Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation
* Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
* Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)
* Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor\_)
* Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
* Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

role.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (FAA Repair Station)
role.description:
Chromalloy is a global engineering & solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely & reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
 
**Video:** What We Do
 
Why work at Chromalloy?
 
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem-solvers delivering world-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
 
Our Total Rewards Program is designed to support you today and in the future.
 

* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development & progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.

Eligibility for individual benefit plans may vary based on employment status.
 
 
Job Summary
 
We're looking for a Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance to lead the site Quality function and support safe, compliant, high-quality aerospace manufacturing and repair operations. This role provides leadership, direction, and coaching to ensure business goals are achieved while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, customer service, operational excellence, and employee development.
 
 
The successful candidate will lead the full Quality organization — Quality Engineers, Quality Supervisors, Lab Technicians (Cal & Met Lab), NDT, Compliance, and Inspectors — while directing quality systems, driving regulatory compliance, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 
 
Work That Matters
 
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports aviation safety and reliability. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. As a people leader, you'll play a key role in developing talent, improving processes, and delivering results that help keep aircraft flying safely around the world.
 
 
**Location:** San Diego, CA
 
**Travel:** Occasional travel required
 
**Schedule:** On-site
 
 
What You’ll Be Doing
 

* Lead, coach, and develop a multi-level Quality organization including Quality Engineers, Supervisors, Compliance, NDT, Laboratory Operations, and Inspection teams.
* Establish quality objectives, policies, and performance expectations that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Own and continually improve the site's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with AS9100, FAA, EASA, CAAC, and customer requirements.
* Lead internal audits, corrective action programs, escape management investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve product quality, process capability, and operational performance.
* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Lead customer and regulatory interactions, audits, and quality reviews.
* Develop supplier quality strategies and oversee supplier qualification and performance.
* Analyze quality metrics and trends to identify risks, drive improvements, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Provide strategic leadership for new product introduction, process validation, inspection technologies, and continuous improvement initiatives

What We’re Looking For
 

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 10+ years of aerospace or industrial gas turbine engineering, manufacturing, repair, or quality leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading large teams across multiple organizational levels.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace regulatory requirements, including FAA, EASA, and CAAC.
* Proven experience driving organizational performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective action systems, and quality management principles.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects within complex manufacturing or MRO environments.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Nice to Have
 

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Black Belt, or similar certification
* Proven leadership experience in multi-site aerospace manufacturing or MRO operations
* Bilingual English and Spanish proficiency
* Experience implementing advanced inspection technologies, automation, or digital quality systems
* Experience developing and monitoring complex project budgets, resource needs, and timelines

Leadership Expectations and Values
 

* Sets Direction: Aligns people and decisions to Chromalloy’s vision and delivers results through transparency and accountability.
* Business Leadership: Drives enterprise value through sound judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and customer focus.

role.title: Senior Director, Quality
role.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53236
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Sr. Director/Executive Director of Quality for our new highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and rigor. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Sr. Director/Executive Director of Quality leads all aspects of site Quality Control and Quality Assurance operations including QA Operations, QA Systems, QA Validation, and QC. In this role you’ll lead the site quality system and culture, batch disposition, and inspection readiness. This role owns and manages all regulatory inspections; and represents the site’s conduit for quality metrics, quality system work, and transformational quality strategy to bring Regeneron to best-in-class lean quality operations. They will oversee and preserve our quality independence from operational pressure while partnering closely with site leadership.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Own the site quality system (both QA &QC) and lead a culture of compliance, accountability, and right-first-time execution

* + QA: ops, systems, and validation owned directly alongside QC as part of a unified site quality organization

* + QC: responsible for delivering utilities, in-process and release testing, performing environmental monitoring, QC laboratory compliance, and method transfer support that enable timely, compliant batch release

* Oversee these functions OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary party responsible for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Hold batch disposition authority, ensuring compliance and timely batch release

* Own and manage all regulatory inspections ensuring the site is continuously inspection-ready and leading the site through regulatory agency inspections and customer and corporate audits

* Serve as the site's primary conduit for quality metrics, quality system work, and l quality strategy connecting site execution to enterprise quality’s vision for best-in-class lean quality operations

* Provide governance of laboratory investigations, deviations, and CAPA management across all quality sub-functions

* Lead all aspects of batch record review and disposition support, floor quality presence, and deviation management for manufacturing for Saratoga Site

* Lead all aspects of QMS administration, document control, training compliance, CAPA system administration, and audit readiness for Saratoga Site

* Build and coordinate best-in-class validation programs process, cleaning, and equipment validation grounded in FDA's three-stage process validation lifecycle (Stage 1 Process Design, Stage 2 Process Qualification/PPQ, Stage 3 Continued Process Verification), EU Annex 15, ASTM E2500 risk-based qualification, and ICH Q8–Q11 Quality by Design principles tailored to large-molecule biotech manufacturing, including PPQ support for new suite introduction

* Lead quality readiness for suites entering service, including validation, qualification, and quality system scale-up

* Partner with manufacturing, technical services, technical operations, and supply chain as a core member of the site leadership team

* Own quality's role in the digital and connected plant model, including electronic quality systems, review by exception, and data integrity by design

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing quality organization; establish high standards for performance management and accountability; perform other duties as required

* Lead a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance

* Own and manage the site’s data governance program, including data integrity standards, data ownership and accountability, lifecycle controls, and periodic review, so data is reliable from the floor to leadership reporting

* Own and manage the site’s quality management maturity, including assessing current state against enterprise and industry benchmarks, setting the improvement roadmap, and driving measurable gains in quality system performance

* Own and manage the site’s contamination control strategy, including its design, governance, and day-to-day execution across facility, equipment, process, personnel, and materials, with ongoing trending and review of effectiveness
 

 
 

**This role requires:**

* B.S in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related technical field

* + Sr. Director: 15+ years in biopharmaceutical quality, large-molecule drug substance operations and/or medical device quality including 7+ years of progressive quality leadership

* + Executive Director: 18+ years in biopharmaceutical quality, large-molecule drug substance operations and/or medical device quality experience including 7+ years of progressive quality leadership

* + Level will be determined based on experience

* Experience with batch disposition and release decision-making in a GMP environment

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$207,000.00 - $407,400.00

role.title: Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production
role.description:
**Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.**

**If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!**

—

**Who You Are:**

The Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production will lead the strategic planning, creative execution, and global production of visual merchandising activations across the Michael Kors retail network. This role is responsible for delivering innovative, brand-elevating experiences that drive customer engagement while ensuring operational excellence, fiscal responsibility, and flawless execution worldwide.

 

Working closely with Global Visual Experience, Store Design, Marketing, Creative Services, Supply Chain, and regional partners, the Senior Manager will oversee the end-to-end production lifecycle for seasonal campaigns, retail environments, windows, in-store experiences, and new store openings. This role will also lead vendor strategy, production innovation, and team development to support the continued growth of the brand globally.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and lead the global production strategy for all Visual Merchandising assets, while providing direct leadership and oversight for the North America region, ensuring alignment with brand, business, and market objectives.
* Own the performance and evolution of the global production function, including operating models, production capabilities, quality standards, vendor networks, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish scalable production processes, governance, and resource strategies that support current business priorities and future growth across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
* Serve as the strategic advisor to Visual Merchandising, Design, and Creative teams, influencing decisions related to feasibility, engineering, materials, fabrication, innovation, and investment priorities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance speed-to-market, scalability, sustainability, quality, and cost efficiency while maintaining brand integrity.
* Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and identify opportunities to simplify and modernize Visual Merchandising production process globally.

**Global Production Management**

* Lead the end-to-end production lifecycle for all global Visual Merchandising programs, including windows, props, visual tools, branded environments, animations, and special activations.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, fabrication, logistics, installation, and execution across retail, outlet, wholesale, and special project channels.
* Ensure all programs are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, craftsmanship, and brand consistency.
* Drive cross-functional project management across multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing competing priorities, business needs, and market requirements.
* Proactively identify executional risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery across regions and stakeholders.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

* Own global production budget planning, forecasting, capital investment recommendations, and overall financial performance.
* Develop cost optimization strategies and scalable sourcing models that improve efficiency without compromising quality, customer experience, or brand standards.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships with fabricators, printers, logistics providers, installation partners, and other key vendors worldwide.
* Establish vendor performance metrics, accountability measures, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure best-in-class execution.
* Evaluate production investments, operating models, and resource requirements, providing recommendations based on business impact, risk, and return on investment.

**Executive Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the senior production partner to Visual Merchandising, Store Design, Marketing, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional leadership teams.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations, business acumen, and a comprehensive understanding of brand, customer, operational, and financial priorities.
* Build alignment across functions and regions while balancing competing priorities to achieve the best overall business outcome.
* Represent the production function in senior leadership discussions, ensuring production considerations are incorporated into broader business planning.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and drive adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness globally.

**Team & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing production team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build organizational capability by developing future leaders, strengthening succession plans, and creating scalable ways of working.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operating rhythms, and development plans that enable increasing levels of ownership and autonomy across the team.
* Allocate resources strategically to ensure effective execution across a complex portfolio of global initiatives.
Create an environment where proactive problem-solving, strategic thinking, and enterprise leadership are expected at all levels. 

 

**You’ll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production Management, Design, Construction Management or a related field.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credentials preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive experience in visual production, retail marketing production, environmental design, experiential production, or related fields.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing high-performing teams in a global environment.
* Proven success leading large-scale, multi-market production programs within a premium or luxury retail organization.
* Strong expertise in project management, fabrication, print production, logistics, and installation processes.
Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets and complex vendor ecosystems. 

 

**We’d Love to See:**

* Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate creative vision into operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Expertise in vendor negotiations, contract management, and cost optimization.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen.
* Highly collaborative with experience working across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, project management platforms, and collaborative workplace tools.

—

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company’s policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, military status, disability, genetic information or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories.

role.title: DIRECTOR OF PRODUCTION
role.description:
Description:

**THE COMPANY**

For over 40 years, Aero Simulation, Inc. (ASI) has provided quality flight training devices to the US Military. ASI has successfully built numerous training systems with a primary focus on aircrew and maintenance training systems. Our current programs include, but are not limited to, the B-1 Training Systems (Air Force), E-2D Training Systems (Navy), CH-53E Training Devices (USMC), IMOMS (Coast Guard), Navigation, Seamanship, Shiphandling Trainer – NSST (Navy). To learn more about ASI visit Programs- Aero Simulation, Inc.

ASI is a 100% employee-owned engineering and manufacturing company committed to supporting the nation’s warfighters. Being 100% employee-owned directly impacts our culture: it drives our decision-making, motivates our teams, increases our productivity, improves retention and contributes to the future success of our company. Our culture is one where we work hard for our clients and for each other – and we have fun collaborating, sharing experience and expertise, and learning along the way. We strive to deliver exceptional quality, elevate client relationships, and enrich the careers and lives of our employee-owners. As Employee-Owners, we are invested in the success and continued development of each other and the company.

In addition to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), we offer a flexible work environment, generous paid time off, professional development opportunities, industry competitive compensation, and superior benefits to include medical, dental, 401k and more!

ASI is a great place to build a career and grow with a company that is dedicated to quality, service and to fostering a community of support for each and every member of the team. To learn more about this opportunity, keep reading!

**POSITION SUMMARY**

ASI is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Production to provide strategic leadership and operational oversight of its production organization. This is a key senior leadership position responsible for ensuring the successful manufacturing, assembly, integration, and delivery of ASI's advanced simulation and military training device hardware.

Based in Tampa, Florida, and reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), the Director of Production will oversee Production Control, Material Control, and Manufacturing through functional managers and department leads. The position will also provide executive oversight of Facility Management and Workplace Safety through the Facilities Manager.

The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations, developing high-performing teams, managing production capacity and resources, and delivering technical products in demanding, schedule-driven environments.

This individual will play an important role in supporting ASI's Department of Defense, U.S. military, government agency, and defense industry programs while ensuring the organization is positioned to support new business opportunities and long-term growth.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Strategic Leadership & Operational Management*

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for Production Control, Material Control, and Manufacturing.
* Establish production priorities, performance expectations, resource requirements, and organizational objectives.
* Lead through functional managers, promoting accountability, operational discipline, and effective execution.
* Ensure production operations consistently meet contractual commitments, customer requirements, program milestones, and delivery schedules.
* Partner with executive leadership to develop operational strategies supporting current programs and future business growth.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure organizational effectiveness and drive improvement.

*Production Planning & Program Execution*

* Oversee production planning, scheduling, capacity management, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent programs.
* Partner with Program Management and Engineering to translate contractual requirements and technical specifications into executable production plans.
* Ensure production readiness, including personnel, materials, equipment, facilities, documentation, and approved manufacturing processes.
* Identify and mitigate production risks that could impact cost, schedule, quality, or customer delivery.
* Support program reviews, production readiness assessments, customer meetings, and government inspections.
* Provide production estimates, labor forecasts, capacity assessments, and schedule inputs for new business proposals.

*Manufacturing & Systems Integration*

* Oversee the manufacturing and assembly of complex simulation and training device hardware.
* Ensure effective collaboration between Production and Engineering to promote manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effective designs.
* Support the integration of major simulation hardware components, including visual display systems, motion platforms, and associated subsystems.
* Ensure manufacturing activities follow approved engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), configuration requirements, and engineering change processes.
* Drive improvements in production flow, manufacturing efficiency, product quality, and delivery performance.

*Workforce Leadership & Development*

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, supervisors, manufacturing engineers, technicians, assemblers, and integration personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability standards for functional managers.

role.description:
**What to Expect**

The Senior Manager, CyberCab Reaction Injection Mold – Operations sets the vision and strategic path for the Production Maintenance & Engineering organizations. This role leads the production, maintenance, tool & die and Engineering teams and works collaboratively with cross-functional partners to achieve Safety, People, Quality, Production/Delivery, and Cost KPI targets of the organization, as well as establishing a high-performance culture.
 
 
This role is responsible for production and resource planning for all exterior panels of CyberCab, provides coaching, mentoring, and developing leaders; launching new programs successfully; and daily tactical planning and execution to achieve the build plan and meet safety, quality, rate, and cost targets. The person in this role must be capable of guiding the team through complex issues, distilling large volumes of data to solve problems, and driving day-over-day continuous improvement.
 
 
This Senior Manager provides hands-on support, leadership, and direction to both teams on all operational, team morale, and equipment-related matters. The person in this role is responsible for building teams that work cohesively and perform at the highest level, keeping Tesla’s mission and the goals of the organization in mind. Your technical judgement and Operating discipline will drive decisions with Engineering, NPI, Programs, Quality, Materials and Upstream/Downstream shops.

 
**What You'll Do**

* Set the vision and strategic path for the Production, Maintenance & Engineering organizations within Cybercab, and lead the team to achieve Safety, People, Quality, Production, and Cost KPI targets and objectives of the organization
* Drive tactical planning to achieve the production build plan with the highest safety, quality, and yield performance
* Launch new programs and lead production ramps and product design changes successfully through resource planning, program management, and partnership with the NPI, Manufacturing Engineering, and Design Engineering teams
* Work with the team to identify production bottlenecks and achieve ramp plans by addressing availability, efficiency, and yield constraints on the line. Coach and mentor the team on data collection and analysis, complex problem solving, and driving daily improvements
* Guide the team through root cause analysis, methodical problem solving, and first-principles thinking. Maintain a culture of adherence to standardized work and compliance with documented processes and procedures so that safe practices and building products to quality specification are sustained
* Lead the maintenance team on equipment availability, preventive and predictive maintenance programs, project planning, and equipment improvements based on downtime data analysis. Establish and maintain equipment spare parts to achieve availability targets and build rates
* Be entrepreneurial and make quick decisions in ambiguous situations. Build a high-performing team, set clear expectations and goals, and manage performance effectively with clear, concise feedback loops
* Maintain a strong technical understanding of product design, intent, processes, and equipment theory of operation. Identify bottlenecks, balance the line, and work closely with the engineering team to solve problems, increase availability, and drive process improvements
* Create a comprehensive strategy for Tool & Die as well as Engineering teams for strong collaboration, same goal visions and strong partnership from dies to machine parametrization
* Work with HR and other teams to improve team morale and create an environment in which team members want to come to work and perform at the highest level

 
**What You'll Bring**

* 10–12 years of leadership and manufacturing experience, preferably in the automotive industry or a highly technical manufacturing environment
* Analytical, detail-oriented, self-driven critical thinker who communicates proactively with all employees and works well in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
* Experience with process-improvement methodologies to improve efficiency, increase yield and availability, and apply design of experiments and statistical methods
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong interpersonal skills. Ability to work well under pressure, manage competing demands, juggle priorities, and meet tight deadlines with diligent follow-through
* Hands-on experience implementing lean methodologies and world-class manufacturing practices
* Ability to use structured problem-solving methods and techniques to successfully resolve production problems, such as 8D, fishbone diagrams, and 5-Why analysis
* Ability to foster close working relationships with team members, management, and cross-functional groups. Highly collaborative, with a positive impact on the team overall
* High-level leadership and decision-making skills. A strong sense of urgency and drive to succeed
* Proficiency in MS Office, Visio, CAD, SPC charts, data-analysis tools, Jira, Tableau/BI dashboards, and project-management tools as well as basic level of prompting or deep curiosity for SI learning

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

 
 
Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. 
 
Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
TerraImm, Inc. is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Director of Operations & Sales Growth to lead our sales organization, accelerate revenue growth, and strengthen overall business operations.
 
This is a key leadership opportunity for an experienced professional with a proven track record of building successful sales teams, developing effective sales strategies, and delivering measurable business results.

We are looking for a leader who knows how to motivate a team, establish accountability, identify opportunities for growth, and turn ambitious business objectives into actionable strategies.
 
The ideal candidate combines strong sales leadership, operational expertise, and a hands-on management approach.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Sales Leadership & Revenue Growth**

* Lead, develop, and manage the sales organization with a primary focus on increasing revenue, improving conversion rates, and achieving aggressive growth objectives.
* Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies designed to expand market reach, increase customer acquisition, and drive sustainable business growth.
* Establish clear sales goals, individual performance expectations, and measurable revenue targets.
* Coach, mentor, and motivate sales professionals to improve performance, strengthen sales techniques, and consistently achieve established goals.
* Evaluate sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement targeted training and development initiatives.
* Oversee sales pipeline management, lead distribution, prospect follow-up, appointment setting, and closing strategies.
* Implement effective sales processes and accountability measures to ensure consistent execution across the sales team.
* Identify opportunities to expand sales channels, improve lead generation, and strengthen customer acquisition strategies.
* Partner with marketing leadership to align campaigns, lead generation efforts, and sales objectives.

**Sales Performance, KPIs & Accountability**

* Develop, monitor, and report on key sales performance indicators, including:
 + Outbound calls and customer contacts
 + Qualified prospects and appointments scheduled
 + Estimates and proposals delivered
 + Lead-to-appointment conversion rates
 + Appointment-to-estimate conversion rates
 + Estimate-to-close conversion rates
 + Closed sales and revenue generated

**Operational Leadership & Business Efficiency**

* Develop and implement operational strategies, policies, and procedures that support business growth and scalability.
* Identify inefficiencies, streamline workflows, and implement solutions that improve productivity and service delivery.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve consistency, accountability, and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure the organization's operational infrastructure can support increased sales volume and business expansion.

**Team Development & Organizational Growth**

* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing sales professionals and operational leaders.
* Build a performance-driven culture that encourages ownership, teamwork, accountability, and professional growth.
* Lead by example through active involvement, strong communication, and a commitment to measurable results.

**Financial Performance & Executive Collaboration**

* Work closely with executive leadership and Finance & Administration to establish revenue objectives, operational budgets, and financial performance goals.
* Identify business risks and implement solutions that support sustainable growth.
* Support compliance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements, coordinating immigration-related matters with appropriate legal professionals.

 

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Proven track record of leading sales teams and achieving measurable revenue growth.
* Demonstrated success in developing and executing sales strategies, improving conversion rates, and increasing team productivity.
* Strong experience with sales pipeline management, CRM systems, forecasting, and performance reporting.
* Proven ability to coach, motivate, and develop sales professionals while maintaining high performance expectations.
* Experience establishing and monitoring sales KPIs, revenue targets, and individual performance metrics.
* Strong operational management skills, including process improvement, workflow optimization, and organizational development.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
* Experience in immigration services, professional services, consulting, or related industries is preferred but not required.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is preferred but not required.

 

The ideal candidate is a confident, proactive leader who knows how to set expectations, develop talent, measure performance, and deliver results. You understand that successful sales leadership requires more than setting goals. It requires coaching, accountability, consistent execution, and the ability to turn opportunities into revenue. You are equally comfortable analyzing performance reports, developing growth strategies, coaching a sales representative, or working alongside executive leadership to solve operational challenges.

role.title: Regional Director of Operations
role.description:
**Regional Director of Operations (LNHA) – Iowa**
=================================================

**Company:** EMY Healthcare 
**Location:** Cedar Rapids–Des Moines, Iowa Region 
**Position Type:** Full-Time 
**Work Location:** Field-Based / Multiple Skilled Nursing Facilities 
**Travel:** Regular Regional Travel Required

### **About EMY Healthcare**

EMY Healthcare is a growing healthcare organization dedicated to providing exceptional skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and long-term care services throughout the Midwest. We are committed to delivering quality care, supporting our employees, and building strong, successful facilities through hands-on leadership and operational excellence.

As we continue expanding throughout Iowa, we are seeking an experienced, motivated, and results-driven **Regional Director of Operations (LNHA)** to oversee multiple skilled nursing facilities across the Cedar Rapids–Des Moines region.

### **Position Overview**

The Regional Director of Operations will provide operational leadership, oversight, and support to approximately 5–6 skilled nursing facilities located throughout the Cedar Rapids–Des Moines corridor, with the majority of facilities concentrated in the Cedar Rapids area.

**This position requires an active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license and significant skilled nursing operational experience.**

This is a hands-on, field-based leadership position requiring regular travel between facilities. Candidates may reside in the Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Des Moines, or surrounding areas, provided they are willing and able to travel regularly throughout the assigned region.

The ideal candidate will have a proven background in skilled nursing operations, a strong understanding of regulatory compliance and financial performance, and demonstrated success leading administrators, improving facility performance, and driving operational results.

We are looking for a leader who is proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with corporate and regional leadership.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership & Facility Oversight**

* Provide direct operational oversight and support to approximately 5–6 skilled nursing facilities.
* Lead, mentor, and hold facility administrators accountable for operational, clinical, and financial performance.
* Conduct regular on-site visits to evaluate operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide hands-on support.
* Establish clear performance expectations and ensure consistent execution of company policies and operational standards.
* Assist facilities in resolving operational challenges and implementing sustainable improvements.
* Support administrator recruitment, onboarding, development, and retention.

**Financial Performance & Census Development**

* Oversee facility financial performance, including budgets, labor management, operating expenses, and profitability.
* Review financial statements, operational reports, and key performance indicators to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Work with administrators to develop and implement strategies to improve census, payer mix, and revenue.
* Monitor staffing levels, overtime, agency utilization, and labor costs while maintaining appropriate resident care.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and financial performance without compromising quality of care.

**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Improvement**

* Ensure facilities maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations.
* Partner with clinical leadership to support survey readiness, quality improvement initiatives, and corrective action plans.
* Assist administrators in addressing survey deficiencies, regulatory concerns, and operational risks.
* Promote a culture of accountability, resident-centered care, and continuous improvement.
* Support facilities through surveys, audits, and other regulatory activities as needed.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, regional clinical leadership, and corporate departments.
* Conduct regular operational meetings and follow up on action plans and performance objectives.
* Provide guidance and support during leadership transitions, operational challenges, and facility improvement initiatives.
* Communicate regularly with executive leadership regarding facility performance, challenges, and opportunities.
* Help implement company-wide initiatives and best practices across assigned facilities.

### **Qualifications**

**Required:**

* **Current, active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license. Iowa licensure preferred; candidates licensed in another state must be eligible to obtain Iowa licensure.**
* Significant experience in skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care operations.
* Previous experience as a Nursing Home Administrator, Regional Director of Operations, or comparable skilled nursing operational leadership role.
* Strong understanding of nursing home operations, regulatory compliance, financial management, staffing, and census development.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, improve operational performance, and hold facility leadership accountable.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.
* **Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the Cedar Rapids–Des Moines region.**
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

**Preferred:**

* Previous multi-facility or regional operations experience.
* Proven success improving facility financial performance, census, quality measures, and operational efficiency.
* Experience with facility turnarounds, acquisitions, or operational transitions.
* Familiarity with PointClickCare and skilled nursing operational reporting systems.
* Knowledge of Iowa nursing home regulations and survey processes.

### **What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* Health insurance and employee benefits.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Travel reimbursement.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Supportive corporate and regional leadership.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact across multiple facilities within a growing healthcare organization.

### **Work Location & Travel Requirements**

**This is a regional, field-based position covering skilled nursing facilities between Des Moines and Cedar Rapids, Iowa, with the majority of facilities concentrated in the Cedar Rapids area.**

* Candidates may reside anywhere within reasonable traveling distance of the assigned facilities.
* Regular, in-person facility visits are an essential part of the position.
* The role requires flexibility to travel throughout the assigned region based on operational needs.
* Administrative responsibilities may be completed from home when not traveling or visiting facilities.
* Travel expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy.

**This is not a fully remote position. Candidates must be comfortable maintaining an active, on-site presence across multiple skilled nursing facilities.**

### **Join Our Team**

If you are a Licensed Nursing Home Administrator with a strong background in skilled nursing operations who enjoys developing teams, improving facility performance, and making a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Join EMY Healthcare and help us continue growing while delivering **Excellence with Empathy**.

role.title: Director Operational Excellence
role.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Annual Salary: $130,000 - $160,000**

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

 

Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below:

**Corporate Social Responsibility** (https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/)

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
 
 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
 
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.
