role.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
role.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including **New York-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit**—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Role**

Amae Health is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented **Director of Growth & Operations** to lead market expansion and operational performance across our care delivery ecosystem. This leader will sit at the intersection of market growth, community partnerships, and operational excellence. This role is based in SF Bay Area, in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow.

**What You'll Work On**

* Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve day-to-day care delivery: new market launches, care model design, referral conversion, and operational scalability
* Build and implement market playbooks, workflows, and performance frameworks that enable consistent execution across locations
* Use data and frontline feedback to identify bottlenecks, then build and drive improvement initiatives with clear owners and measurable outcomes
* Lead cross-functional workstreams across clinical, ops, and product; manage alignment, communication, and rollout
* Build the systems and SOPs that turn one-off solutions into scalable standards

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in strategy, operations, or growth roles at a venture-backed startup, consulting firm, or healthcare company
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence clinical and executive stakeholders
* Experience in commercially-oriented work: market expansion, partnership operations, or growth initiatives
* Strong analytical and operational mindset with ability to translate strategy into execution
* Startup experience strongly preferred—you've navigated ambiguity and figured things out without a playbook
* Collaborative and high-EQ; you know how to move cross-functional teams without formal authority
* Interest in healthcare or behavioral health; you care about the mission
* Based in SF Bay Area; able to work in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow

**What We're Building**

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
* Precision medicine for severe mental illness, using multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data to personalize treatment.
* A clinical operating system that integrates longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer.
* New science and measurement frameworks to define what real outcomes look like in SMI.
* A health-system partnership model proving coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. **Base salary range for this role is $165,000–$200,000 per year**, adjusted to market cost; the compensation package may include equity. Total compensation includes comprehensive medical/dental/vision, unlimited PTO, parental leave, and programs built around employee well-being. We'll share specifics during the interview process.

*Amae Health is building the care platform, the precision medicine, and the frontier science that severe mental illness has never had. If you want to be part of creating something this hard and this important, something that has never been done, we'd like to talk.*

**What We Value**

* **We center care in all we do.** Empathy is not a brand value. It's how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
* **We challenge convention.** The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
* **We take the work seriously, not ourselves.** High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
* **Your job isn't done until the job is done.** We close gaps, we follow through, and we don't hide behind titles or org charts.
* **We win together and fail together.** We own outcomes as a team. We learn fast. We don't do blame.
* **We hustle with humility.** Speed matters. So does integrity. We assume best intent and stay grounded in the mission.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Job Summary**

As Director of Operations, you’ll lead business operations and turn strategic plans into coordinated, measurable work. You’ll guide leaders across teams, oversee budgets and financial performance, and strengthen processes so the organization can operate effectively as priorities evolve. This role calls for confident executive communication, sound judgment, and the ability to lead change at scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Set operational priorities and align business operations with strategic management plans.
* Lead executive-level teams and managers; build accountability through clear goals and regular performance reviews.
* Oversee budget management, forecasting, financial management, and profit and loss analysis to support informed decisions.
* Direct project and program management, operational analysis, and process improvement initiatives.
* Manage business development efforts and large-scale organizational change, communicating plans and progress with executives.
* Your impact: By improving processes and aligning resources with priorities, you help teams deliver reliable operations and give leaders clearer information for decisions.

**Skills**

* **Essential:** Senior leadership, executive leadership, operations management, business management, operational management, and supervising experience.
* **Essential:** Strategic planning, operational excellence initiatives, change management, project management, program management, and process improvement.
* **Essential:** Budgeting, executive-level budget management, forecasting, profit and loss analysis, and data-driven decision making.
* **Essential:** Verbal communication with executives, leadership, and executive-level team management.
* **Preferred:** Business development management, business development, operational analysis, and broader management experience.

Pay: From $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
**About CAMP Systems:** 
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:** 
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:** 
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

 

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director – Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

 

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer – vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com (mailto:hr@campsystems.com).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering
role.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

TransMedics is seeking a **Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering** to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.

**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**

As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.

role.description:
**Benefits:** ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Quality Management – APS is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the enterprise quality management program across all APS services. This role ensures service excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction through standardized processes, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.

This leader partners with enterprise functions and operational stakeholders to document, standardize, and scale quality-of-service delivery across current and future APS sites. Responsibilities include developing quality frameworks, policies, playbooks, training programs, and performance reporting while driving actionable improvements aligned with APS Operating System, company initiatives and industry best practices.

To design, implement, and sustain a comprehensive quality management system that enhances efficiency, performance, and consistency across APS services while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, APS Operating System, ABM standards, and client commitments. The role promotes a culture of continuous improvement and leverages technology and data to support operational excellence and client retention.

* Develop and execute an enterprise quality strategy aligned with APS Operating System, and ABM business objectives.
* Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program, including standards, governance, measurement frameworks, training, audits, and reporting.
* Establish and enforce quality control standards across all APS service lines.
* Lead audits and assessments and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, safety, environmental, and industry standards (e.g., OSHA, ISO, APPA).
* Analyze performance data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and cost performance.
* Collaborate with Client Experience and operational leaders to drive consistency and improve customer satisfaction.
* Develop KPIs and reporting to provide insights to senior leadership.
* Build training programs and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Support special projectsand additional responsibilities as assigned.

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Project Management, Facility Management, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g., Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO) preferred.
* 8–10 years of quality management experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience with enterprise systems supporting the built environment (CMMS, BAS, BMS, IWMS).
* Proficiency in data analysis and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with emerging technologies such as IoT, AI, VR, and smart building solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to lead change in a matrixed environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to travel up to 60%.

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.

 

ABM is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including disability and protected veteran status. ABM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in completing the employment application, please call 888-328-8606. We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

 

ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. E-Verify is an internet-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.

 

ABM is a military-friendly company proudly employing thousands of men and women who have served in the U.S. military. With ABM, you’ll have access to a world-class training program and ample opportunities to use the skills you developed while serving our country. Whether you’re looking for a frontline or professional position, you can find post-military career opportunities across ABM.

 

ABM directs all applicants to apply at www.abm.com/careers. ABM does not accept unsolicited resumes or submissions outside of this portal. Applicants should submit their application by clicking Apply Now.

For more information, visit www.abm.com

role.title: Director, QA Ops - Document, Training & Records Management
role.description:
Looking for a chance to make a meaningful difference in the oncology space? Taiho Oncology is on a mission: to improve the lives of patients with cancer, their families, and caregivers. Our “People first” approach means we also highly value our employees, who work relentlessly to help execute our mission. Taiho’s success is founded on ensuring we always act with accountability, collaboration, and trust. By following these guiding principles, we earn and maintain the confidence of patients, the global healthcare community, collaborators and partners, and each other. Together, we are working on cutting-edge science and growing our portfolio and pipeline across a range of tumor types to address the ongoing and evolving needs of patients. Advanced technology, a world-class clinical development organization, and state-of-the-art facilities: these and other resources empower us to innovate and touch the lives of more and more patients. It’s our work, our passion, and our legacy. We invite you to join us.
 
 
**Hybrid:** 3-days per week on-site
 
Employee Value Proposition
 
​​​​​​At Taiho Oncology, the compassion we practice for our patients extends to our team, empowering and motivating them to do their best work for those who need it most. This is an exciting opportunity to lead critical Quality systems in a dynamic, collaborative, and global cross-functional environment.
 
 
**Position Summary:** 
​​​​​​​​​The Director, QA Ops – Document, Training & Records Management is responsible for the strategy, governance, and execution of Taiho Oncology’s controlled document management, GxP training management, archival, and records-retention programs. This position leads the team responsible for day-to-day activities in MasterControl and establishes scalable processes, system capabilities, and governance that support current operations and Taiho’s future business plans. The Director partners with Quality, functional leaders, Information Technology, system owners, affiliates, and global stakeholders to maintain compliant, efficient, and inspection-ready programs.
 
 
**Performance Objectives:** 
**​​​​Strategy, Governance and Leadership:** 

* Develop and execute the long-term strategy and operating model for controlled document management, GxP training management, archival, and records retention.
* Translate Taiho’s future plans into scalable processes, systems, governance, resources, and program roadmaps.
* Establish policies, standards, performance measures, risk controls, and continuous-improvement priorities and provide recommendations to senior management.
* Lead harmonization and standardization of document and training practices across TOI and applicable affiliates and global stakeholders.
* Manage, coach, and develop the team responsible for document, training, archival, and records-management activities; maintain clear roles, capacity, cross-training, succession planning, and business continuity.

**MasterControl and Quality System Oversight:** 

* Provide business ownership, strategic direction, and governance for MasterControl document and training capabilities.
* Oversee administration of document workflows, courses, curricula, assignments, job codes, user accounts, metadata, effective dates, access, archival status, and related records.
* Partner with Information Technology and validation stakeholders on enhancements, upgrades, integrations, access controls, user acceptance testing, Computer System Assurance documentation, and maintenance of the validated state.
* Evaluate and implement capabilities needed to align MasterControl with business growth, affiliate integration, data integrity, inspection readiness, and future quality-system plans.
* Ensure procedures, user guidance, training materials, reports, and support mechanisms remain current and effective.

**Controlled Document Management:** 

* Oversee the lifecycle management of controlled policies, standard operating procedures, work instructions, forms, guidance documents, and other GxP documents from creation through retirement and archival.
* Establish standards for templates, numbering, naming, metadata, review and approval, effective dates, revision history, periodic review, document relationships, distribution, and supersession.
* Ensure controlled documents receive appropriate Quality and administrative review and that document owners resolve quality, workflow, implementation, and timeliness issues.
* Lead periodic assessment and cleanup of the controlled-document environment, including obsolete, duplicate, or floating documents and attachments.
* Provide document-management leadership and evidence support during audits, inspections, due diligence, and compliance reviews.

**GxP Training Management:** 

* Establish the strategy and governance framework for GxP training across TOI and applicable affiliates.
* Ensure training requirements, curricula, courses, job codes, assignments, and records are aligned with job responsibilities, controlled documents, organizational changes, and compliance obligations.
* Oversee onboarding, role changes, transfers, leaves of absence, and separation processes as they affect training requirements and records.
* Ensure required training is assigned, completed, tracked, documented, reported, and retained; monitor compliance and escalate material risks.
* Oversee new-hire Quality training, document creator/revisor training, instructor-led training, read-and-understand activities, assessments, and other approved training methods.
* Lead improvements that strengthen training effectiveness, learner experience, role alignment, reporting, and inspection readiness.

**Archival and Records Retention:** 

* Develop and oversee the strategy for identification, transfer, storage, protection, retrieval, retention, disposition, and migration of applicable quality records.
* Partner with Legal, Information Technology, Records Management, functional stakeholders, and Quality Assurance to establish and maintain appropriate retention requirements and controls.
* Ensure electronic and physical records, as applicable, remain authentic, complete, readable, secure, traceable, accessible, and retrievable throughout the retention period.
* Identify and remediate risks involving legacy records, decentralized repositories, inconsistent practices, obsolete formats, or system migrations.
* Maintain inspection readiness; support audits and regulatory inspections; lead remediation, CAPA, and risk-management activities related to assigned processes.
* Establish and report metrics for document timeliness, training compliance, overdue activities, processing volume, archival status, system performance, and program risk.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Education/Certification Requirements:** 

* ​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, quality, regulatory affairs, information management, business, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** 

* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated life-sciences industry.
* Significant experience in Quality Assurance, controlled document management, GxP training, archival, records retention, and regulated quality systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex cross-functional programs; experience supporting regulatory inspections and audits required.
* Experience with MasterControl document and training modules, validated computerized systems, and system implementations, upgrades, or migrations strongly preferred.
* Comprehensive knowledge of GxP quality-system principles and regulated document, training, archival, records-retention, and data-integrity practices.
* Demonstrated ability to establish strategy, governance, and future-state plans while ensuring effective and timely operational execution.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, delegation, succession planning, stakeholder management, and change-leadership skills.
* Strong project, program, risk, and regulatory management abilities, including development of metrics, management reporting, and sustainable process improvements.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, analytical, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
* Sound judgment and proven ability to define problems, analyze data, assess risk, manage competing priorities, and implement compliant, scalable solutions.
* Highly developed organizational skills, attention to detail, accountability, and commitment to collaboration and inspection readiness.
* Ability to write procedures and effectively present information to internal and external clients.​

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $202,300 - $238,000 annually. This pay range is based on the market range for positions of this type. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including annual bonus/incentive comp plans, potential long term incentive plan, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if a candidate/employee receives an offer of employment.
 
If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.
 
#Location-Princeton,NJ #Location-Pleasanton,CA #LI-Hybrid
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer Information:** Taiho Oncology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Any applicant who, because of a disability, needs an accommodation or assistance in completing an application or at any time during the application process, please email People@taihooncology.com. Taiho Oncology also provides reasonable accommodations to employees with disabilities consistent with our obligations under the law. Pursuant to applicable state and municipal Fair Chance Laws and Ordinances, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
 
 
The incumbent in this position may be required to perform other duties, as assigned.

role.title: Plant Manager II
role.description:
**Description**

**Plant Manager II**

At Pilgrim’s, *Safety Is A Condition*, which means the safety of our team members comes first - always.

Pilgrim’s is seeking a **Plant Manager II** to lead and direct overall operations of a poultry processing facility. This role is responsible for ensuring production, quality, safety, and financial objectives are achieved while maintaining operational efficiency and controlling costs. The Plant Manager II provides leadership across all plant functions, including production, maintenance, purchasing, accounting, administration, and continuous improvement initiatives, while developing high-performing teams and driving operational excellence.

The **Plant Manager II** oversees a diverse leadership team and is accountable for plant performance, regulatory compliance, team member safety, product quality, customer satisfaction, and profitability. This position partners closely with corporate and complex leadership to execute strategic initiatives, support business growth, and foster a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement. If you're a results-driven leader with a passion for people development and operational excellence, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact within one of the industry's leading food companies.

**Responsibilities & Essential Duties:**

* Directs production and ensures cost effectiveness and consistency with prescribed quality, accuracy, and performance standards.
* Maintains plant property and equipment in good condition to ensure compliance with governmental regulations and to ensure effective and economical operations.
* Prepares and submits operating reports to management to inform them of the current production status and to make recommendations to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Assures effective customer service and relations through timely delivery of quality product.
* Selects, trains, develops, and motivates manufacturing staff to maintain plant operation.
* Assures compliance of all plant operations with company policy and federal, state, and local regulations.
* May set production and processing goals for plant.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of DIRECTLY RELATED experience in a poultry processing plant.
* High School Diploma/GED; Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a related field. DIRECTLY RELATED work experience will be accepted on a year-for-year basis in lieu of the educational requirement.

**Why Work for Pilgrim’s?**

* **Schedule:** Monday – Friday with occasional weekends.
* **Benefits**: Vision, Medical, and Dental coverage begin after 60 days of employment;
* **Paid Time Off:** Sick leave, vacation, company observed holidays or, any other statutorily required paid leave;
* **401(k):** company match begins after the first year of service and follows the company vesting schedule;
* **Base salary** range of $148,818 - $186,761;
* **Discretionary Bonus:** This position is eligible to participate in the Company’s annual bonusplan, the amount of bonus varies and is subject to the standard terms and conditions of the incentive program;
* **Career Development:** Our company is dedicated to supporting professional growth by offering continuous learning opportunities and a focus on career growth through various learning and development programs;
* **Better Futures**

The Company is dedicated to ensuring a safe and secure environment for our team members and visitors. To assist in achieving that goal, we conduct drug, alcohol, and background checks for all new team members post-offer and prior to the start of employment. The Immigration Reform and Control Act requires that verification of employment eligibility be documented for all new employees by the end of the third day of work.

**About Us:** Pilgrim’s is a leading global food company with more than 62,000 team members worldwide. The company processes, prepares, packages, and delivers fresh, frozen, and value-added food products for customers in more than 100 countries. Pilgrim’s operates protein processing plants and prepared foods facilities in 14 states, Puerto Rico, Mexico, the U.K, the Republic of Ireland and continental Europe.

**Our Vision:** To become the best and most respected company in our industry creating the opportunity of a better future for our team members.

**Our Core Values Are:** Availability, Determination, Discipline, Humility, Ownership, Simplicity, Sincerity

**EOE, including disability/vets**

**Unsolicited Assistance:** Pilgrim's does not accept unsolicited assistance from any recruitment vendors for any of our open jobs. All resumes or candidate profiles submitted by recruitment vendors or headhunters to any employee at Pilgrim's or via the applicant tracking system, in any form without a valid written request and search agreement previously approved by HR, will be solely owned by Pilgrim's. No fees will be paid should the candidate be hired by Pilgrim's because of an unsolicited referral.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
***Position Summary***

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day leadership and performance of the machine shop operation. This position provides hands-on leadership across machining, production, quality, maintenance, safety, scheduling, and employee development to ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

The Plant Manager will drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, standardized work, effective production planning, and development of a high-performing manufacturing team. This individual will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to support business growth and achieve operational objectives.

***Essential Functions / Responsibilities*****:**

**Operations Leadership**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily machine shop operations.
* Manage production activities to achieve customer delivery, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Establish and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
* Ensure effective production scheduling, machine loading, labor utilization, and workflow.
* Identify and resolve production constraints, bottlenecks, and capacity issues.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet production requirements.
* Maintain strong floor presence and lead through visible, hands-on management.

**Machining & Manufacturing**

* Oversee CNC machining, manual machining, secondary operations, assembly, plating, Injection molding, deburring, inspection, and related manufacturing activities.
* Ensure equipment, tooling, fixtures, and processes are capable of meeting production requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve machining processes, cycle times, setups, tooling, and machine loading.
* Drive setup reduction, machine utilization, labor efficiency, and throughput improvements.
* Ensure adherence to standardized work and documented manufacturing processes.
* Lead Hazardous Waste Coordinator for facility.

**Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machine shop.
* Implement and sustain 5S, visual management, standard work, waste reduction, and problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, setup time, downtime, and overall manufacturing costs.
* Utilize data and KPIs to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.

**Safety & Environmental**

* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Lead safety initiatives, audits, training, and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper machine guarding, PPE, lockout/tagout, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.
* Investigate incidents and near misses and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Hold employees and leaders accountable for safe work practices.

**Quality**

* Partner with Quality to ensure products meet customer and internal quality requirements.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, defects, and customer complaints.
* Ensure operators follow documented work instructions and quality procedures.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities.
* Promote a culture of first-time quality and process ownership.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, leads, machinists, operators, and other production personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, training, cross-training, and employee development.
* Develop a flexible, multi-skilled workforce capable of supporting changing production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews and address performance issues in a timely manner.
* Foster teamwork, communication, accountability, and employee engagement.

**Maintenance & Equipment**

* Partner with Maintenance to maximize equipment availability and reliability.
* Monitor machine downtime and establish corrective action plans.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Manage capital equipment planning, justification and implementation.
* Ensure new equipment and processes are effectively integrated into production.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage operational performance against established budgets and financial targets.
* Monitor labor efficiency, overtime, scrap, rework, material usage, and machine utilization.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction opportunities.
* Support Supplier Development Activities
* Support Product Transfer activities which may include travel
* Drive capital expenditure planning and return-on-investment analysis.
* Understand the relationship between operational performance, cost, and EBITDA.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Conduct daily/weekly operational meetings and communicate priorities throughout the organization.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on production performance, capacity, quality, safety, and staffing.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Sales to resolve issues and support customer requirements.
* Escalate operational risks and develop action plans to address them.

***Physical Requirements*****:**

Required to sit, stand, bend, and lift up to 25 lbs.

***Work Environment*****:**

* Combination of Manufacturing and Office environment.
* Regular exposure to noise, dust, heat, cold and odors.

***Knowledge, Skills & Experiences*****:**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, preferably in a precision machining environment.
* 3+ years of manufacturing leadership experience with responsibility for people and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of CNC machining and machine shop operations.
* Experience with high-mix/low- to medium-volume manufacturing preferred.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience leading production teams and improving operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing safety practices and OSHA requirements.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

***Preferred Experience***

* Precision machining and tight-tolerance manufacturing
* CNC turning and milling
* Multi-axis machining
* High-mix manufacturing
* AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments
* Hazardous Waste Management

* Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* ERP/MRP systems
* Capital equipment implementation
* Continuous improvement / Kaizen
* P&L or operating-budget responsibility

role.description:
**Job Title:**

Executive Vice President, Innovation & Quality

**Department:**

Leadership

**Reports To:**

CEO

**FLSA Status:**

Full-Time, Exempt

**Location:**

Brooksville, FL (on-site)

**Travel:**

Periodic travel (approx. 10–15%)

**Direct Reports:**

Director, R&D; Regulatory & Technical Services Manager; Quality Manager

**Date Modified:**

November 2026

**About Black Diamond Coatings (BDC Brands)**

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. (BDC Brands) is a veteran- and family-owned manufacturer of premium, environmentally friendly home improvement products. Our DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands are made in the USA and distributed through Amazon, Lowe’s, The Home Depot, Walmart, plus our own e-commerce site. Headquartered in Brooksville, Florida, we operate with an entrepreneurial spirit, high integrity, and a strong belief in teamwork, continuous improvement, and excellence.

**Mission:** Creating Trustworthy Solutions Beyond Expectations.

**Vision:** Our trusted brands deliver home improvement product solutions that “WOW” our DIY and Pro customers, setting the standard for quality and innovation.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Vice President, Innovation & Quality leads R&D, product innovation, quality, and regulatory compliance across the DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands. Reporting to the CEO, this role owns BDC’s product development strategy and new-product pipeline, grows and protects our intellectual property, and owns our ISO 9001-certified quality system from formulation through shipment.

This is a builder’s role. The EVP sets technical direction, builds the team, and stays close enough to the bench to make fast, informed decisions. Innovation at BDC means shelf-ready products that win with our retail partners and customers, not open-ended research. Bold ideas are encouraged; products must be manufacturable, meet cost and quality targets, and ship on time.

**Champion BDC’s Core Values**

* Lead by example: demonstrate strong work ethic, integrity, and commitment to excellence in every interaction.
* Be resourceful and tenacious: do more with less, figure it out, and bring a relentless “will to win.”
* Stay positive as a team, communicate with honesty and respect, and hold yourself and others accountable to the BDC standard.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Innovation & Product Development**

* Set R&D strategy and own the product pipeline, aligned with company growth plans and retail partner priorities.
* Turn customer and market insight into products that outperform what is on the shelf, and expand the product line into new categories.
* Lead development of new, patentable technologies and protect BDC’s intellectual property.
* Run a disciplined, fast development process with clear go/no-go decisions.
* Improve the performance and cost of existing products, backed by solid test data.

**Quality**

* Own the quality system end to end and maintain ISO 9001 certification.
* Make quality a selling point with retail partners.

**Technical Support & Compliance**

* Oversee regulatory compliance and technical support so every product meets federal, state, and retailer requirements.

**Leadership & Partnership**

* Lead and develop the R&D, Quality, and Compliance teams through three direct reports.
* Partner with Operations to scale products from lab to full production.
* Work with Sales and Marketing on launches and retail buyer presentations.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required**

* Master’s or PhD in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of product development in coatings, sealers, adhesives, cleaners, or specialty chemical consumer products, including 5+ years leading R&D teams.
* Proven record of taking products from concept to commercial launch, including developing patentable technology.
* Experience owning a QC/QA function under ISO 9001 or an equivalent quality management system.
* Deep expertise in water-based polymer and emulsion formulation; dry-blend experience is a plus.
* Hands-on lab skills and experience scaling products from lab to full production.
* Measured results using continuous improvement methods (Six Sigma, lean, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of product regulatory requirements (SDS/GHS, VOC, EPA and state rules).
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15%.

**Preferred**

* Experience developing products for mass retail, including retailer testing and compliance.
* Category experience in home improvement, building products, or protective coatings.
* Experience building or scaling an R&D function in a growing, entrepreneurial company.
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to R&D or quality work.

**Working Conditions**

On-site role based at BDC’s lab and manufacturing facility in Brooksville, FL. Regular laboratory work, including handling chemicals with appropriate PPE; outdoor field and application testing; and time on the production floor. Periodic travel to retail partners, suppliers, trade shows, and other BDC facilities.

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

role.title: Vice President, Final Control Operations
role.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Vice President, Final Control Operations will provide overall leadership for Final Control Operations including valve field and shop testing and repair, production (new valve assembly) and valve inventory management. Responsibilities include developing and implementing strategies to enhance safety, quality, efficiency, and service levels through managing a team of Directors and Managers responsible for 100+ employees in 6 locations in the Southeast US. The role involves driving continuous improvement projects, ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards, and managing supply chain and inventory. Financial management, including budget development and cost control is essential to the success of this position. The role serves on the Control Southern Executive Leadership Team.

#### **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for daily operations and implementing companywide operational strategies with a focus on financial growth, service levels and customer satisfaction.
* Active participation and collaboration on Company Leadership Team and Strategic Council.
* Interview, hire, train and mentor a team of Directors/Managers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop and implement short-term and long-term strategies, structure, and process to achieve business results.
* Oversee planning, execution, and delivery for production/new valve assembly and services.
* Ensure quality control and compliance with industry standards.
* Provide weekly operational performance updates to the Executive Leadership Team.
* Maintain an exceptional and well communicated Safety Program.
* Oversight of warehouse operations including shipping & receiving, supply chain and inventory management.
* Develop, manage and achieve the annual operations budget and capital investment plan.
* Collaborate with other Operations Leaders from the Emerson Impact Partner Network.

#### **Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

#### **Physical Demands:**

* Periodic visits to company operation centers and customer facilities or project sites, which require adherence to safety protocols and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Typical facilities include Commercial Power Plants, Nuclear Plants, Pulp and Paper Mills, Chemical Plants, Manufacturing Plants, etc.
* Regular use of a computer, which may involve repetitive motion such as typing.
* Frequent use of the phone for communication with team members, stakeholders, and clients.

#### **Travel:**

* Overnight travel required to company operations centers currently in Chattanooga, TN; Decatur, AL; Jacksonville, FL; Lakeland, FL; Macon, GA, and Suwanee, GA
* Must be willing for overnight travels to work on site at customer
* Overnight travel may be required to attend factory and/or customer meetings as necessary.
* 50%+ travel depending on office location may be required.

#### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or industrial engineering; MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in operations management in manufacturing; experience in the valve or mechanical services industry preferred.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Knowledge of valve technology and assembly processes.
* Experience with lean manufacturing and project management.
* High Emotional Quotient for leading others.
* Experience leading Safety & Quality Programs.
* Strategic Inventory Optimization experience a plus.
* Strong financial acumen and analytical skills.

**About Control Southern**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Suwanee, Georgia, Control Southern is an integrated solutions provider that helps manufacturing plants across the Southeast run better, faster and smarter through automation and customized valve solutions. As an Emerson Impact Partner, we are the local point of contact for sales, service and applied engineering for Emerson's automation solutions in Georgia, Florida, East Tennessee and North Alabama. We are employee-owned through our ESOP, and our culture is grounded in our motto: ***When integrity leads, success follows.***

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Manufacturing Investigations
role.description:
**Job summary**
---------------

The Manager, Manufacturing Investigations, position is strategically intended to support continuous process improvement by developing and leading a team of investigators in analyzing cross-functional non-conformance events (“Deviations”), defining root cause, assessing product impact, and implementing Corrective/ Preventive actions. The Manager should possess proven technical writing and problem-solving skills as well as a desire for developing investigators in the art of problem-solving analysis. This is a direct supervisor position also responsible for the training and development of the investigators as well as for their overall performance. An understanding of Biotechnology Upstream, Downstream, and Support principles with experience in non-conformance management is ideal.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* The Manager is responsible for oversight of the Manufacturing Operations’ deviation performance. The incumbent is responsible for the assignment of the deviations, ensuring departmental deviation ownership is balanced and appropriately distributed to facilitate timely and quality closure.
* Train and mentor a team of investigators to conduct comprehensive investigations to determine root cause, product impact and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Methodically investigate and troubleshoot Manufacturing deviations using defined troubleshooting and investigational techniques. Develop and implement preventive actions to reduce the potential of recurrence or proactively prevent the occurrence of a new deviation.
* Ensure non-conformance investigations meet or exceed the rigor of internal, client and regulatory reviewers.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

* BA/BS Degree in a science field preferred (i.e., Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, etc.) or equivalent combination of education and experience; 10+ years of pharmaceutical or related work experience with emphasis on current Good Manufacturing Practices including QA, QC, Validation, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering.

Salary Range: $118,000 - $148,000

Salary range provided per current averages and expectations. The salary and job title for this opening will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience and may be outside this range. KBI has a robust total rewards strategy which includes an annual bonus structure for all employees, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid PTO and holidays, 401K matching with 100% vesting in 60 days and employee recognition programs.

 

*KBI Biopharma, Inc. is an EEO/AA employer and actively seeks to diversify its work force. Therefore, all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability or veteran status, are strongly encouraged to apply.*

I understand that no representative of KBI Biopharma, Inc. has the authority to make any assurance to the contrary.*

role.title: Sr. Manager, Operations
role.description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Operations Manager leads the machining department (approximately 60 employees) through supervisors and technical specialists. The role is accountable for safety, quality, on-time delivery, capacity utilization, productivity, and margins in a high-mix, low-volume precision CNC environment.

This is a people-and-business leadership position focused on removing barriers, driving continuous improvement, and partnering with the General Manager and Business Development to support profitable growth. Hands-on machining or CNC programming is not required.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Safety & Quality: Maintain a safety-first culture. Partner with Quality to uphold ISO standards, reduce nonconformances, and lower cost of poor quality through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Operational Performance & Capacity: Direct production through supervisors across milling, turning, and secondary operations. Improve throughput by reducing bottlenecks, setup times, downtime, and waste. Optimize capacity planning, staffing, sequencing, and preventive maintenance.
* Delivery & Customer Execution: Own on-time delivery from order release through shipment. Ensure realistic schedules, visible priorities, and proactive recovery plans. Coordinate cross-functionally with Planning, Quality, Purchasing, and Shipping.
* Financial & Margin Management: Partner with Finance and the General Manager to protect and improve gross margin through labor productivity, material yield, scrap reduction, and disciplined cost control. Monitor job costs and provide reliable data for quoting, make/buy decisions, and capital recommendations.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement: Drive adoption, accuracy, and continuous improvement of ERP/MRP and shop-floor systems. Apply Lean tools (5S/6S, standard work, SMED, value-stream mapping, Kaizen) where they deliver measurable results. Develop practical performance dashboards and management reviews.
* People Leadership & Culture: Develop supervisors, team leads, and production personnel through coaching, clear expectations, and empowerment. Build engagement, retention, skills development, and succession. Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Growth Partnership: Support Business Development with capacity assessments, customer meetings, and opportunity qualification to profitably fill available machine capacity.

**Key Performance Measures**

* Safety performance
* On-time delivery and schedule adherence
* Throughput, labor productivity, setup time, and unplanned downtime
* Capacity utilization and available capacity for new work
* Gross margin, job-cost variance, and scrap/rework costs
* ERP/MRP data accuracy and timely reporting
* Employee engagement, retention, and internal development
* Nonconformance trends and cost of quality

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience leading manufacturing teams or operations departments, preferably in CNC machining, high-mix/low-volume contract manufacturing, or precision manufacturing. Hands-on machinist or programming experience is not required.
* Demonstrated improvements in productivity, on-time delivery, profitability, and operational performance, supported by measurable results.
* Experience implementing or improving ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, job costing, and KPI reporting.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, business acumen, change management, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Practical understanding of capacity, cost drivers, scheduling, Lean methods, and ISO-based quality systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or business preferred; equivalent relevant leadership experience will be considered.

**Role Alignment**

This role manages the machining department through its supervisors and technical staff, with accountability for people development, operational performance, and continuous improvement. The Senior Operations Manager partners with the General Manager on business priorities, financial objectives, and capital recommendations, and with Business Development on customer relationships and growth.

The position does not require personally operating or programming CNC equipment. Final authority for pricing, hiring, capital spending, and related decisions will be defined by company leadership.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

role.title: Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality and Compliance
role.description:
#### **Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality & Compliance**

ProCompounding Pharmacy is seeking an experienced pharmacist to provide leadership across pharmacy operations, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and sterile and nonsterile compounding.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership position for someone who understands both the technical and operational demands of a growing 503A compounding pharmacy. The successful candidate will help strengthen our pharmacy infrastructure, develop our people, maintain regulatory readiness, and build practical systems that support quality, consistency, and continued growth.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **The Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality and Compliance will:**

* Provide leadership and oversight for pharmacy operations, quality, and regulatory compliance.
* Support sterile and nonsterile compounding operations and ensure alignment with applicable standards and regulations.
* Maintain and continuously improve the pharmacy's quality management systems.
* Oversee compliance with USP 795, 797, and 800 requirements.
* Lead preparation for regulatory inspections, accreditation surveys, and internal quality reviews.
* Manage investigations, deviations, rootcause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and related quality initiatives.
* Develop practical policies, procedures, and operating systems that improve consistency and accountability.
* Coach, develop, and support pharmacy team members and emerging leaders.
* Partner with ownership and leadership on operational priorities, risk management, and growth initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments and help ensure compliance across multiple states.

#### **Ideal Background**

#### **Strong candidates will bring:**

* Pharmacist licensure and significant experience within a 503A compounding pharmacy.
* Leadership experience involving pharmacy operations, quality, compliance, or staff management.
* Experience with both sterile and nonsterile compounding strongly preferred.
* Board Certification in Sterile Compounding Pharmacy (BCSCP) preferred.
* Working knowledge of USP 795, 797, and 800.
* Experience with inspections, accreditation, investigations, CAPA processes, and quality improvement.
* The ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical operating processes.
* Strong leadership, communication, documentation, and problemsolving skills.
* Experience working within a multistate pharmacy environment.

Experience in 503B outsourcing facilities, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or cGMP environments would be an additional advantage.

Multistate pharmacist licensure is not required.

#### **The Opportunity**

ProCompounding is a growing organization where senior leaders remain close to the work. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys building systems, solving problems, developing people, and taking ownership rather than operating within a highly layered corporate structure.

We are open to qualified candidates nationally and are willing to discuss relocation for the right individual. Experienced professionals who are ready to expand their leadership responsibilities are encouraged to apply.

#### **About ProCompounding Pharmacy**

MISSION: At ProCompounding Pharmacy, we provide personalized medications tailored to meet each individual's specific health requirements. With a commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation, we stand at the forefront of pharmaceutical compounding, bridging the gap between traditional pharmacy and cutting-edge healthcare solutions. OUR SERVICES: We specialize in compounding services, including: \* Hormone Replacement Therapy \* Pediatric Compounding \* Veterinary Compounding \* Dermatology and Wound Care \* Pain Management \* Dental Compounding \* Over the counter supplements Each service is conducted with the highest standards, using pharmaceutical-grade ingredients and state-of-the-art compounding techniques. Our pharmacists work closely with healthcare providers to develop formulations that address our patients' precise needs.

As **Operations Director**, you’ll guide business operations from strategy through execution. You’ll align teams, budgets, and processes with organizational priorities, using clear communication and data to make informed decisions. Your impact: By improving operational processes and financial oversight, you help teams serve customers effectively and support sustainable business performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operations management, strategic planning, and project management across business functions.
* Oversee profit and loss (P&L), financial management, and profit and loss analysis; use Excel data analysis to monitor performance and guide decisions.
* Direct team management, executive-level team management, and team leadership; build capability through team development and clear managerial communication.
* Advance process improvement and lean management practices to strengthen operational effectiveness.
* Partner on sales and business development priorities while maintaining a strong focus on customer service.

**Skills**

* Essential: Leadership, management, business management, strategic management, operational management, and data-driven decision making.
* Essential: Supervising experience, team leadership, and the ability to communicate priorities clearly across teams and with executives.
* Essential: Financial management skills, including P&L oversight and analysis; proficiency in Excel data analysis.
* Preferred: Experience applying lean management and process improvement methods.
* Preferred: Experience supporting sales, business development, and customer service through strategic planning and project management.

Pay: $156,300.00 - $217,900.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Life insurance
* Parental leave

Work Location: In person

role.title: Director, Commercialization Partnerships Operations
role.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

The Director, Commercialization Partnerships and Operationsserves as the primary operational and partnership role at RevMed headquarters supporting the Senior Director, Commercialization Partnerships and Operations This role is responsible for driving operational and partnership excellence, governance structure, financial tracking, and cross-functional alignment across select regional commercialization partners and territory-specific distributors. This role will also partner with regional commercial heads to support relationship management and commercial readiness across the same distribution partner(s).

By serving as the central HQ liaison, this role ensures seamless coordination between RevMed’s internal functional teams (Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Medical Affairs, Finance) and external partners including regional commercial and distribution partners to achieve commercial readiness, regulatory/MAA approval, compliant named-patient access programs, and reliable product supply for a select region.

Core Responsibilities & Scope:

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Governance Framework

* Consistent KPI Architecture**:** Establish, standardize, and monitor a unified commercial and operational KPI framework across select region/partner.
* Commercial & Non-Commercial KPIs: Forecast/order accuracy, market access, medical information metrics, performance to volume targets, order-to-cash cycle times, stockout frequency, inventory buffer levels, and lead-time adherence.
* Regulatory & Quality KPIs*:* Variances/amendment submission timelines, adherence to quality and PV agreements.
* Governance & Decision-Making: Operationalize joint governance bodies (e.g., Joint Steering Committees [JSC], Joint Commercial Committees [JCC], and Joint Operations Committees [JOC]) and joint pricing decisions.
* Define escalation pathways, charter guidelines, voting rights, and decision-making matrices (RevMed vs. Partner/Distributor) across commercial, pricing, regulatory, and supply chain domains.

Financial Reporting & Revenue Reconciliation

* Quarterly Financial Tracking: Partner with RevMed HQ Finance and Partner Commercial Operations to track, report, and analyze quarterly commercial revenue, transfer pricing, and royalty/profit-share milestones. Reconcile financial tracking on quarterly basis as necessary.
* KPI-Based Financial Reconciliation: Lead the quarterly financial reconciliation process across partners based on contracted KPIs, volume tiers, milestone achievements, and operational claw backs or bonuses.
* Commercial Dashboard Management: Maintain real-time executive dashboards reporting financial performance, sales volume, inventory valuation, and partner margin compliance.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Education: B.S./B.A. in Business, Life Sciences, Supply Chain, or Finance (MBA or advanced degree preferred).
* Experience: 8–12+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with direct experience in Alliance Management, Commercial Operations, Strategic Account Operations, or Global Program Management.
* Cross-Functional Expertise: Proven track record bridging commercial activities with technical/operations functions (Supply Chain, Quality/CMC, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Finance).
* Negotiation Experience: Demonstrated success developing, negotiating, and operationalizing licensing, distribution, commercialization or alliance agreements.
* Geographic & Regional Knowledge**:** Solid understanding of regional pharmaceutical markets, regulatory environments (regional & national competent authorities), pricing & reimbursement dynamics, and distribution models (direct vs. distributor/partner).
* Travel: Ability to travel up to 30%. Hybrid role, at minimum 2-3 days in office at Redwood City headquarters.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Oncology development, supply chain, and commercialization experience.
* Prior experience in a smaller, rapidly growing biotech or pharmaceutical company.
