role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Plant Manager**

Company: Norris Cylinder Company

Primary Location: 521 Green Cove Road SE, Huntsville, AL, 35803, USA

Workplace Type: On-site

Employment Type: Salaried | Full-Time

Function: General / Executive Management

Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled

**Main Duties & Responsibilities**

**POSITION SUMMARY** 
The Plant Manager is responsible for the facility’s overall operational and financial performance, with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and employee engagement. This role leads a team of approximately 120-150 direct and indirect manufacturing employees, including key support functions such as quality, maintenance, shipping/receiving, order management, and supplier management. The position leads steel fabrication and associated support functions and develops the people, processes, and operating discipline required to meet customer and financial objectives.

**PLANT AND FINANCIAL LEADERSHIP** 
Lead plant operations with full accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and operating profit. 
Develop and execute budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, productivity targets, and capital plans. 
Monitor financial and operating performance; address adverse results through clear corrective actions. 
Control labor costs, overtime, premium freight, scrap, rework, outside processing, downtime, and operating expenses. 
Coordinate with engineering, supply chain, commercial, finance, human resources, and other business functions.

**SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE** 
Establish safety as the plant’s highest operational priority and ensure compliance with company, OSHA, environmental, permitting, and regulatory requirements. 
Maintain effective controls for machine guarding, lockout/tagout, hot work, powered industrial trucks, overhead cranes, welding fumes, PPE, and emergency response. 
Conduct plant walkthroughs and incident reviews; ensure hazards, injuries, near misses, and environmental concerns receive timely corrective action. 
Maintain high standards for housekeeping, material storage, scrap management, aisle control, and movement of steel and heavy components.

**MANUFACTURING OPERATIONS AND QUALITY** 
Direct steel fabrication processes, including cutting, bending, rolling, forming, welding, machining, assembly, finishing, inspection, and testing, as applicable. 
Establish daily management of production schedules, staffing, equipment, materials, capacity, and customer priorities. 
Ensure employees follow approved work instructions, process parameters, quality requirements, and standard operating procedures. 
Maintain controls for steel grade, material certification, heat or lot traceability, welding procedures, fabrication tolerances, dimensional accuracy, coatings, and final testing. 
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable AWS, ASME, DOT, customer, and product requirements. 
Lead root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective action for customer complaints, nonconforming material, scrap, rework, and recurring process failures.

**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND ASSET MANAGEMENT** 
Lead Operational Excellence and Lean methods, including 5S, standard work, visual management, value-stream mapping, setup reduction, mistake-proofing, and structured problem solving. 
Maintain a prioritized improvement plan with defined owners, timelines, expected benefits, and validated results. 
Ensure facilities, equipment, tooling, fixtures, cranes, ventilation, utilities, and material-handling systems are safely and effectively maintained. 
Establish preventive and predictive maintenance programs based on equipment risk and production requirements. 
Manage capital projects from justification through installation, validation, and post-implementation review.

**PEOPLE LEADERSHIP** 
Provide direction, coaching, and development to managers, supervisors, and other plant leaders. 
Establish clear expectations and hold leaders and employees accountable for results and behaviors. 
Build capability through hiring, onboarding, training, cross-training, succession planning, and leadership development. 
Partner with Human Resources on staffing, attendance, turnover, employee relations, performance management, and workforce planning. 
Promote positive employee relations through visible leadership, consistent communication, fair treatment, and shop-floor engagement.

**KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES** 
Safety and environmental performance; on-time delivery and schedule attainment; first-pass yield, scrap, rework, and customer complaints; labor efficiency, productivity, and overtime; operating profit and conversion cost; equipment uptime; inventory accuracy; project performance; and employee turnover, attendance, training, and engagement.

 

**Qualifications**

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations management, business, or a related field. 
Seven or more years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership of managers, supervisors, or multiple manufacturing functions. 
Experience in steel fabrication, welding, machining, metalworking, heavy manufacturing, or a comparable industrial environment. 
Demonstrated responsibility for plant financial and operational performance, budgeting, production planning, quality systems, maintenance, supply chain, and Lean manufacturing. 
ISO 9001 experience and familiarity with applicable AWS, ASME, DOT, customer, or product standards preferred. 
Advanced degree, Lean Six Sigma certification, and experience with capital installations or automated fabrication processes preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** 
Strong safety leadership, manufacturing knowledge, financial judgment, and ability to translate business results into operating actions. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and organizational skills. 
Proven ability to develop leaders, build accountable teams, manage multiple priorities, and lead during operational disruptions. 
High integrity, accountability, resilience, and attention to detail.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** 
The position works in office and manufacturing environments and regularly enters fabrication, welding, machining, finishing, warehouse, and shipping areas. Exposure may include noise, heat, welding operations, fumes, dust, oils, moving equipment, and heavy materials. Required PPE must be worn. Availability to support multiple shifts, shutdowns, equipment issues, and significant customer or production concerns may be required.

**Benefits**

Benefit offerings include Medical Insurance and Prescription Drugs, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability Insurance (for eligible employees), Employee Assistance Plan (EAP), Paid Time Off (may include vacation and sick time), Retirement Program, and Other Voluntary Benefits.

role.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
**Relocation assistance is available for this position.**

**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

SENS is seeking a manufacturing engineering leader to help build and scale the organization, processes, and technical capabilities required for our next stage of growth. Supporting the expansion of existing manufacturing operations and establishing new operations at our Broomfield Systems manufacturing factory, this leader will establish the manufacturing engineering strategy, develop a multidisciplinary team, and translate business growth plans into manufacturing capacity and reliable production processes for our fastest-growing products.

This role leads manufacturing engineering, industrialization, tooling, test systems, automation, and technical production support for our systems products, with a strong emphasis on configure-to-order assembly manufacturing. Working closely with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, the Senior Manager will establish clear priorities, strengthen new product and production transfer readiness, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and equipment reliability.

A successful candidate will combine organizational leadership with practical technical judgment, building a team that can support daily production while executing the improvements and investments needed to scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Help to build and develop the manufacturing engineering organization. Assess current capabilities, define the team structure and staffing plan, recruit talent, and develop engineers and technical leaders to support SENS’s growth.
* Establish performance measures and execution discipline. Set departmental goals, review project and operational performance, communicate risks and resource needs, and hold the team accountable for measurable improvements in manufacturing readiness, capacity, productivity, and equipment reliability.
* Establish and execute the manufacturing engineering roadmap. Translate business growth, product plans, and production requirements into prioritized initiatives for manufacturing capacity, processes, tooling, test systems, automation, and equipment reliability.
* Lead manufacturing readiness for new products and production transfers. Partner with Design Engineering, Production, Quality, and Planning & Fulfillment to establish readiness criteria and ensure processes, equipment, tooling, test capability, documentation, and training are in place before production release.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes and standards. Establish consistent methods for process development, validation, work instructions, engineering changes, and production controls across manufacturing locations while accommodating product-specific requirements.
* Expand manufacturing capacity and improve productivity. Lead engineering efforts in capacity analysis, line balancing, factory layout, workflow, cycle-time reduction, and constraint elimination to support production demand and improve labor efficiency.
* Provide reliable technical support to Production. Establish clear support coverage, escalation processes, and problem-solving practices that resolve production issues promptly and prevent recurrence while maintaining progress on strategic projects.
* Guide manufacturing technology development. Lead technical specialists responsible for manufacturing test systems, production software, tooling, and automation. Prioritize investments based on safety, quality, capacity, reliability, and financial return.
* Improve production equipment reliability. Establish equipment ownership, maintenance strategies, critical spare requirements, and preventive and predictive maintenance practices in partnership with Production and technical support teams.
* Manage projects, capital investments, and departmental resources. Develop business cases, budgets, schedules, and resource plans; oversee implementation and production acceptance; and verify that projects deliver their expected operational and financial benefits.
* Partner with Design Engineering on manufacturability. Incorporate manufacturing feedback early in product development and engineering changes to improve assembly, testability, quality, serviceability, and cost.
* Drive safe processes and sustained quality improvement. Partner with EHS and Quality to incorporate risk assessment, error prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective action into manufacturing processes and equipment changes.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of manufacturing processes, work instructions, test procedures, tooling, fixtures, automation systems, and production software solutions.
* Be directly accountable for engineering project delivery, manufacturing readiness, equipment reliability, and validated improvement benefits, while sharing accountability with Production and Quality for labor efficiency and first-pass yield (FPY).

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or an additional 4 tears of manufacturing engineering experience.
* Eight or more years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, or a related technical manufacturing role.
* Three or more years of experience directly leading engineering or technical teams, including setting priorities, developing employees, allocating resources, and managing performance.
* Demonstrated success improving manufacturing performance, with measurable results in productivity, capacity, quality, cost, or equipment reliability.
* Experience developing and improving manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and production controls, including introducing new or revised products into production.
* Ability to lead engineers and technical specialists across manufacturing processes, test systems, automation, and production support, using sound technical judgment to evaluate solutions and resolve issues.
* Practical application of Lean Manufacturing and structured problem-solving methods, including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, balancing daily production needs with longer-term improvement priorities.
* Experience planning and executing manufacturing improvement or capital equipment projects, including defining scope, schedules, resource requirements, and expected business results.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into clear team priorities and communicate progress, risks, and decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in manufacturing of configure-to-order (CTO) and engineered-to-order (ETO) electrical systems such as switchgear, switchboard, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing software development, automated test systems, and data acquisition platforms.
* Experience using ERP systems such as SyteLine for BOM management, item masters, engineering changes, and manufacturing planning.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent certification.
* Experience managing departmental budgets and capital equipment projects from business case through production acceptance.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $120,000 - $175,000 is the projected annual base salary range for this role and will be determined on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 15th. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. role.title: Senior Manager, Total Quality
role.description:
**About Crown**
---------------

Crown Holdings, Inc. through it's subsidiaries, is a world leader in the metal packaging production process. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative and sustainable metal packaging solutions and products. Our clients are some of the largest and most respected companies in the world.

Crown is dedicated to building a team of highly talented, dedicated, and driven individuals. It's an exciting time to join our business because Crown offers you the opportunity to grow and develop your skills in an expanding industry.

Crown was founded with the goal of valuing and promoting sustainability and this vision continues to be essential to our long-term future.

**Job Description:**

Location:

Mid-Atlantic or Midwest, near a major airport, or close to one of the facilities.

**Chicago, IL Lancaster/Columbus, OH Connellsville, PA Weirton, WV**

Position Overview:

 

The Sr. Manager, Total Quality provides expert-level quality assurance, continuous improvement, and food safety guidance to Crown’s Food Manufacturing facilities. This role may have an emphasis on 2-piece can manufacturing, 3-piece can manufacturing, Sheet coating, and Coil coating.

Primary Responsibilities:

* Provide problem-solving leadership on technical, quality, and food safety matters relating to food can and end performance
* Provide Corporate Quality oversight of the designated plants within area of responsibility
* Provide Quality Manager training and coverage of assigned facilities during transitions and/or absences
* Ensure adherence to customer requirements, quality control plans, SQF (Safe Quality Food) requirements, and quality/ food safety policies
* Aid plants in customer complaint responses, recalls, disposition of held product, and supplier claims
* Complete food safety related customer questionnaires and documentation requests
* Analyze process performance trends, conduct hazard analyses, identify corrective actions, and enact preventive measures within area of responsibility
* Conduct audits and surveys of Crown facilities, suppliers, warehouses, and customers
* Participate as the Quality subject matter expert on any steering committees involving assigned facilities or area of responsibility
* Collaborate with other members of the Corporate Quality team as well as the company’s Manufacturing, Engineering, and Technical Service divisions to develop and implement system improvements, strategic plans, process changes, studies and projects
* Contribute to the update and development of quality and food safety procedures and policies
* Travel requirement: 50 **-** 75%

 

Job Requirements

The ideal candidate would possess the following attributes:

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Quality Management Systems, Project Management or a related Engineering discipline.
* Minimum ten (10) years hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment with proven Quality Management System oversight capability.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, whether face-to-face, via telephone, by email, or through formal correspondence
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to professionally interact with all levels of plant personnel, company management, customers, suppliers, and auditors.
* Thorough understanding of common quality, food safety, and problem-solving tools including Control Plans, SPC (Statistical Process Control), Process Capability, Pareto charts, Histograms, Gauge R&R, FMEA, HACCP, GMP’s, Continuous Improvement and Lean Six Sigma principles
* Proficiency in data interpretation, root cause investigations, problem solving, and corrective action implementation
* Background in SQF, BRC, GFSI or ISO compliance and/or auditing
* Working knowledge of manufacturing concepts related to the processes involved in the manufacture of food cans
* Knowledge of external customer requirements, processes, and expectations preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point, and Teams)
* Strong administrative, organizational, and leadership skills
* Self-motivated and eager to take the initiative, with the ability to work effectively in a team setting and as an individual
* Committed to on-going personal development and career growth
Must have a desire for achieving excellence in customer satisfaction, process and product quality and reliability 

 

Physical Requirements

* While performing the duties of this job, the associate is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands, reach with hands and arms, and may be required to balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The associate may lift and/or move up to 30 lbs.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision and ability to adjust focus. 

 

Working Conditions

* Will be required to perform job duties outside of the typical office setting in a plant environment as well as in an office.
* While performing the duties of this job, the associate may be exposed to moving mechanical parts and vehicular traffic.
* The associate may be exposed to a wide range of temperatures.
The noise level is frequently loud. 

 

* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

 

**What Crown Offers You**
-------------------------

* Strong engagement and commitment to the safety of our employees
* The opportunity to build a meaningful career
* Professional and personal development through training and work experiences

**Join us and become part of a team of professionals who are passionate about sustainable packaging!**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Working Together** Working Together is one of the five pillars that make up our Twentyby30™ program. We aim to value and respect each individual and foster an environment of inclusivity.

role.title: Chief of Staff and Strategic Operations
role.description:
**Position Summary**

LTI, a family-owned manufacturer of premium commercial foodservice equipment, is seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations leader to partner directly with the CEO and executive leadership team in driving organizational performance, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor, strategic business partner, and execution leader responsible for translating company priorities into measurable results. The position will work across all functional areas to strengthen communication, improve business processes, accelerate decision-making, and ensure critical initiatives are completed on time and achieve their intended outcomes.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on impact player who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, demonstrates exceptional business judgment, takes ownership of results, and holds themselves and others accountable. This individual must balance strategic thinking with tactical execution and possess the leadership maturity to influence executives without relying on direct reporting authority.

As LTI continues to grow, this position will play an important role in scaling the organization, strengthening leadership effectiveness, and building the operational discipline necessary for long-term success.

**Major Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Planning and Execution**

* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to develop, prioritize, and execute company-wide strategic objectives.
* Translate long-term business strategies into actionable plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, deadlines, and performance measures.
* Lead and coordinate high-priority strategic initiatives that span multiple departments.
* Monitor progress against strategic objectives, identify obstacles, and drive corrective actions to ensure timely completion.
* Provide the CEO with objective assessments of organizational performance, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure strategic initiatives remain aligned with company growth objectives, financial expectations, and organizational capabilities.

**2. Executive Leadership Support and Organizational Alignment**

* Serve as a strategic advisor and trusted business partner to the CEO.
* Function as a force multiplier by improving the effectiveness, focus, and execution capabilities of the executive leadership team.
* Coordinate cross-functional priorities involving Manufacturing, Engineering & Customer Support, Finance, Human Resources, and Business Development & Marketing.
* Facilitate executive leadership meetings, strategic planning sessions, and performance reviews to drive decisions and measurable outcomes.
* Establish clear accountability for decisions, action items, and commitments made by executive leadership.
* Identify organizational barriers, competing priorities, and communication gaps that negatively impact performance.
* Support the CEO in evaluating organizational effectiveness, leadership capacity, and future business needs.

**3. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate company-wide business processes, workflows, and operating practices to identify opportunities for greater efficiency and effectiveness.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement improvements that enhance productivity, quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, and organizational responsiveness.
* Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts involving complex operational and business challenges.
* Promote disciplined execution, process standardization, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and coordinate resources to resolve issues that impact company performance.
* Support initiatives that improve the scalability of manufacturing operations and supporting business functions.
* Ensuring improvement initiatives produce measurable business results rather than simply generating additional activities or reporting.

**4. Performance Management and Accountability**

* Develop and maintain executive-level scorecards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and strategic initiative tracking systems.
* Establish consistent processes for monitoring progress toward company objectives and departmental commitments.
* Work with executive leaders to identify performance gaps and develop appropriate corrective action plans.
* Provide the CEO and leadership team with timely, accurate, and actionable information to support decision-making.
* Establish disciplined follow-up processes to ensure projects, initiatives, and executive commitments are completed within established deadlines.
* Promote a results-oriented culture that emphasizes ownership, urgency, transparency, and accountability.

**5. Strategic Projects and Change Management**

* Assume direct leadership of high-impact projects assigned by the CEO that require coordination across multiple functions.
* Develop project plans, define deliverables, establish timelines, and coordinate resources necessary for successful execution.
* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with business growth, process improvements, technology implementation, and operational transformation.
* Evaluate project risks, resolve implementation challenges, and communicate progress to executive leadership.
* Manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and consistently meeting deadlines.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new business systems, technologies, and organizational capabilities.
* Ensure completed projects are successfully transitioned to the appropriate functional leaders for ongoing ownership.

**6. Financial and Business Performance**

* Partner with the CFO and functional executives to understand financial performance, operating results, and business trends.
* Support initiatives designed to improve profitability, productivity, cost management, and return on investment.
* Assist in evaluating business cases, capital investments, resource allocation, and strategic growth opportunities.
* Ensure major strategic initiatives include appropriate financial objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Monitor performance against established financial and operational targets and help coordinate corrective actions when necessary.
* Maintain a company-wide perspective when evaluating decisions and recommending business priorities.

**7. Leadership Development and Organizational Effectiveness**

* Support the CEO in strengthening executive leadership effectiveness, collaboration, and organizational accountability.
* Identify opportunities to improve leadership processes, decision-making practices, and communication across departments.
* Partner with Human Resources and executive leadership to support succession planning, leadership development, and organizational readiness for growth.
* Encourage a culture of constructive debate, timely decisions, and consistent execution.
* Serve as a positive role model for LTI's core values of **Humble, Hungry, and Smart**.
* Build trust and credibility at all organizational levels, including executive leadership, office personnel, and manufacturing employees.
* Help preserve LTI's family-oriented culture while introducing the structure and discipline necessary to support continued growth.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline required; MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive business leadership experience, including significant responsibility for operations, strategic planning, organizational performance, or cross-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with CEOs, presidents, business owners, or senior executive leadership teams.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial products, or a similarly complex operational environment strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, managing complex projects, and delivering measurable business improvements.
* Experience in a growing, privately held, or family-owned business environment preferred.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial statements, business performance metrics, budgeting, and operational profitability.
* Experience implementing performance management systems, operational improvements, or organizational change initiatives.

**Leadership and Professional Competencies**

* **Strategic and Analytical Thinking:** Ability to understand the broader business environment, evaluate complex issues, and translate strategy into actionable priorities.
* **Execution and Results Orientation:** Strong sense of urgency, personal accountability, and demonstrated ability to deliver results within demanding deadlines.
* **Executive Presence and Influence:** Ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* **Business and Financial Acumen:** Strong understanding of how operational decisions affect financial performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term business success.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Ability to coordinate multiple departments, build alignment, resolve conflicts, and drive shared objectives.
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Ability to quickly assess challenges, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions.
* **Project and Priority Management:** Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively from the production floor to the executive office.
* **Adaptability and Resilience:** Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where business priorities and demands may change.
* **Integrity and Confidentiality:** Demonstrated sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive business and personnel information.

**Personal Attributes and Cultural Fit**

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following characteristics:

* A highly motivated self-starter who takes initiative and requires minimal supervision.
* An impact player who is energized by challenging assignments and opportunities to make a measurable difference.
* A strong work ethic with a willingness to roll up their sleeves and personally drive execution.
* A collaborative leader who values team success over individual recognition.
* A confident but humble professional who can respectfully challenge ideas and accept constructive feedback.
* A proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues rather than waiting for direction.
* A disciplined leader who establishes priorities, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets deadlines.
* A relationship builder who earns trust through credibility, transparency, and demonstrated results.
* A leader who embraces the values and personal accountability expected within a family-owned business.

**Organizational Authority and Scope**

The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will report directly to the CEO and work collaboratively with all members of the executive leadership team.

The position will initially operate primarily through cross-functional leadership, executive influence, and authority delegated by the CEO rather than through direct supervision of existing functional departments.

Functional executives will retain accountability for their respective departments, while the Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will help coordinate company-wide initiatives, facilitate decision-making, and ensure execution of strategic priorities.

The position may assume additional operational responsibilities and direct reports as the organization grows and business needs evolve.

**Measures of Success**

Success in this position will be evaluated through demonstrated improvements in:

* Timely completion of strategic initiatives and executive priorities.
* Organizational alignment and accountability across functional departments.
* Operational efficiency, productivity, and business process effectiveness.
* Achievement of established company-wide performance objectives.
* Executive leadership effectiveness and decision-making.
* Successful implementation of high-impact business projects.
* Financial and operational improvements resulting from strategic initiatives.
* Organizational readiness to support continued growth.

**Overall Expectation:** The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations must consistently demonstrate an ability to convert business priorities into completed actions, measurable improvements, and sustainable organizational results.

role.title: Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation (REMOTE)
role.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The **Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation** provides strategic leadership and execution support for priority operational initiatives in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and Operations leaders. This role translates organizational priorities into actionable implementation plans, leads assigned cross-functional initiatives, improves operational processes, and drives sustainable improvements in how work is performed.

The Director leads efforts to move initiatives from strategy through execution by developing implementation plans, establishing timelines and accountability, coordinating cross-functional activities, identifying risks and barriers, measuring progress, and providing clear visibility to leadership. The role also partners with teams to evaluate and redesign processes, strengthen procedures and documentation, improve cross-training and operational continuity, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through technology, automation, and self-service.

This role requires demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives, managing complex projects, influencing across teams, and successfully implementing change. Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, project execution, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to drive accountability and deliver measurable results.

This role follows a hybrid work arrangement, with the majority of time worked remotely and periodic in-office requirements in our downtown Chicago office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Implementation and Project Coordination** **(40%)**

* **Develop and maintain implementation plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and action items for priority Operations initiatives.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate activities across teams and follow up on commitments, deliverables, and outstanding actions.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Track project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issues requiring leadership attention.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prepare concise status updates and other progress reporting for the COO and appropriate leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned cross-functional Operations initiatives from planning through implementation, working with department leaders to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver agreed upon outcomes.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Facilitate working sessions to clarify responsibilities, resolve implementation issues, and move work from discussion to action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with Operations leaders to advance agreed priorities, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen accountability while maintaining departmental ownership of ongoing operations.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Process Improvement (30%)**

* **Review and document selected operational processes and workflows.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work with staff to identify unnecessary steps, manual work, duplication, unclear handoffs, and other opportunities for improvement.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop practical recommendations to simplify workflows, improve consistency, and strengthen operational effectiveness.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leaders, including implementation and evaluation of results.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help develop and maintain standard operating procedures and other operational documentation.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthen cross-training and backup coverage for critical processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify appropriate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and self-service.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Change and Coordination (20%)**

* **Lead or coordinate implementation of assigned process, technology, and organizational changes within Operations, in partnership with the responsible department leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate operational activities associated with selected technology implementations and other modernization initiatives.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help ensure changes are supported by appropriate documentation, communications, training, and follow-up.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Bring together the appropriate staff and leaders when work crosses departmental boundaries.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help clarify responsibilities and handoffs when ownership is unclear.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify implementation barriers and work with the appropriate leaders to resolve or escalate them.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor recently implemented changes and help address issues affecting adoption or effectiveness.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Measurement and Reporting (10%)**

* **Establish practical measures for selected initiatives and operational improvements.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop baseline information when needed to evaluate the impact of a change.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor whether implemented changes are achieving expected results.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use available operational data and staff or candidate feedback to identify areas requiring additional attention.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Provide the COO with clear visibility into progress, risks, workload, and outstanding decisions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Initial Focus Areas:**

*(Initial assignments are expected to include)*

* **Supporting implementation of priority Operations initiatives within DANB’s strategic roadmap.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establishing a consistent approach for planning, tracking, and reporting major Operations projects.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting process improvement in selected candidate-facing areas, including Document Review, Client Services, and Certification Operations.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve workflows through process redesign and technology.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthening procedures, documentation, cross-training, and backup coverage.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting implementation of approved changes to Operations roles, responsibilities, and processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Skills and Attributes:**

* **Strong organizational and project implementation skills with consistent attention to follow-through.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ability to organize complex work into clear plans, responsibilities, timelines, and next steps.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.**
 --------------------------------------------------------
* **Effective facilitator who can help teams move from discussion to decisions and action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
 ---------------------------------------------------
* **Collaborative and skilled at building productive relationships across teams and functions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and recognize when issues require escalation.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and teams, establish accountability, and drive initiatives to completion without direct supervisory authority.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Practical approach to process improvement that avoids unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfortable learning new systems, technologies, and operational processes.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Education & Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, project implementation, process improvement, or business operations, including demonstrated responsibility for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives required.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated success leading initiatives from planning through implementation, including delivering measurable operational improvements.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience reviewing and improving business processes and workflows.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience supporting technology-enabled operational change preferred.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in certification, credentialing, assessment, associations, nonprofits, healthcare, or another regulated environment is preferred.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Physical Demands:**

Required to sit for extended periods of time; may need to walk or stand in the course of work as well as light (20-30 lbs.) to medium (30-40 lbs.) levels of lifting of supplies and/or equipment.

**Work Environment:**

Work performed in an office environment, either onsite or offsite; periodic travel to be expected (<10%)

role.title: Director, Distribution Business Process Engineering
role.description:
***If you are an internal associate, please login to Workday and apply through Jobs Hub.***

**Job Purpose**
---------------

 

The Director of Distribution Business Process Engineering leads the design and implementation of business process workflows to support operational excellence, automation, AI-enabled efficiency, regulatory compliance, and digital modernization across distribution functions. This individual leads a team of Process Engineers to eliminate operational waste, create efficiencies, automate, apply AI where it adds value, and mitigate risk. Additionally, the Director personally owns high-priority process engineering initiatives.

 

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute complex assessment and improvement projects to remove waste, reduce costs, and scale workflows, serving as an active contributor (process mapping, analysis, solution design, etc.) in addition to directing the team's work.
* Maintain a hands-on workload of priority initiatives while managing a team of Process Engineers, typically allocating approximately 50–60% of time to individual project delivery and 40–50% to people leadership and strategic partnership.
* Coach, mentor, and direct a team of Process Engineers. Responsible for all personnel actions, including hiring, performance management, development, corrective action, and termination.
* Partner with senior leaders to establish rules, workflow design, and automation priorities and connect business goals with data-driven process solutions.
* Establish and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for workflow processes and systems to measure impact and ensure efficiency.
* Build and present reports, charts, and summaries to leadership.
* Provide forecasting and other workflow analysis to support the implementation of reengineered workflows.
* Partner with business leaders to implement new and improved business processes and systems.
* Consult with the Training & Development team to develop training materials that support the implementation of reengineered processes.
* Manage the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of business rules.
* Govern process architecture repositories, ensuring all financial workflows are fully documented for internal audit and external regulators.
* Partner with SVP, Distribution Operations to develop and execute the AI strategy for distribution.
Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation to distribution workflows. Lead pilots and implementations in partnership with Technology, Compliance, and business leaders, ensuring appropriate governance, documentation, and risk controls. 

 

**Other Duties**

Performs other duties and/or projects as assigned. 

 

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Proven ability to dissect complex, cross-functional operations into visual, data-driven process maps.
* Strong understanding of process development frameworks to drive user adoption of new processes.
* Strong knowledge of Jackson’s systems and procedures.
* Strong knowledge of engineering principles, including statistics and their applications.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Power BI.
* Strong knowledge of financial services and/or insurance industry business operations.
* Expert knowledge of and/or aptitude to obtain expert knowledge of skills and business rules, which may include proficiency with: Jackson’s administrative systems, products, distributor rules, tax laws, and state and federal regulatory rules.
* Strong organization skills with an ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proven ability to accept, adapt, and positively influence the implementation of change in an ever-changing environment. Ability to lead change initiatives and communicate in a positive manner.
* Strong collaboration skills with an ability to work effectively with individuals across multiple teams to accomplish objectives.
* Strong business acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand complex business situations and exercise sound judgement.
* Excellent quantitative, analytical, decision making, and problem-solving skills with the ability to think creatively and apply solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to develop staff through coaching, training, and support.
* Ability to balance individual contributor responsibilities with people management duties, shifting between hands-on execution and coaching as team and project needs require.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with a proven ability to convey complex information in a clear and understandable manner and influence decision making.
* Strong negotiation skills.
Strong relationship management skills, both external and internal of Jackson. 

 

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required. Major in Engineering or a related stem field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, etc. preferred.
* 5+ years of relevant business process design and/or analytical experience required.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a team preferred, ideally while remaining a hands-on contributor.
* Project management experience required.
* Insurance or financial services industry experience preferred.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Job Summary**

The Director of Operations leads business operations and operations management, turning strategic plans into clear priorities and effective execution. This role guides senior leadership and executive-level teams, oversees budgets and financial performance, and advances operational excellence through data-driven decisions and process improvement. The Director also supports business development management and leads change across the organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Set strategic direction for operations and align programs and projects with business priorities.
* Lead executive-level team management, supervise managers, and communicate plans and performance clearly with executives.
* Direct budget management, forecasting, financial management, and profit and loss (P&L) analysis; use operational analysis to guide decisions.
* Identify and deliver process improvement and operational excellence initiatives, including large-scale organizational change management.
* Manage business development efforts and coordinate cross-functional programs to strengthen business performance.
* Your impact: By connecting operational analysis with practical process improvements, you help teams work more effectively and support better outcomes for the business and its customers.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ Years of demonstrated leadership, management, and supervising experience in business management, business operations, or operations management.
* Experience in strategic management, strategic planning, project management, program management, and change management.
* Experience managing budgets and financial performance, including executive-level budget management, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L analysis.
* Ability to make data-driven decisions and lead operational analysis and process improvement.
* Strong verbal communication with executives and experience guiding senior leadership or executive-level teams.
* Experience in business development and operational excellence initiatives is preferred.

Pay: Up to $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ogden, UT 84401

role.title: Senior Director Technology Operations
role.description:
### **Position:** ***Senior Director, Technology Operations***

 

Monogram Health is seeking a **Senior Director, Technology Operations** to own day‑to‑day operational leadership for enterprise technology operations, ensuring reliability, responsiveness, and a high-quality end‑user experience across Service Desk and Telecommunications platforms. This role provides focused operational ownership so enterprise delivery, enablement, and strategy can scale without diluting operational excellence.

 

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lead Service Desk and Telecommunications operations end‑to‑end.
* Own incident response, escalation paths, and operational readiness.
* Ensure consistent execution of onboarding/offboarding and access workflows.
* Accountable for CXone, RingCentral, IVR, dialers, and related platforms.
* Partner with engineering, vendors, and App Dev on stability and enhancements.
* Ensure agent and clinician experience is reliable and predictable.
* Own operational KPIs, SLAs, and support performance reporting.
* Identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement across support and telecom workflows.
* Directly lead managers and team leads across Service Desk and Telecom.
* Establish clear operating models, standards, and expectations.
* Serve as the single escalation and decision point for technology operations.

 

#### **Position Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field
* Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive experience in IT operations, service delivery, or technology infrastructure management, including minimum of four (4) years in a leadership role managing teams across Service Desk, Telecommunications, or similar operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise contact center and telephony platforms (e.g., CXone, RingCentral, IVR systems, dialers).
* Proven track record of owning and improving operational KPIs, SLAs, and support performance metrics.
* Experience with incident management, escalation frameworks, and operational readiness processes.
* Evidence of communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels.
* Healthcare industry experience preferred, particularly within health plans or value‑based care environments.

 

#### **Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is $138,000 to $182,000 and reflects the range of experience and qualifications we may consider. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location and job-related factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and internal compensation considerations. While a larger range is posted, most offers will typically fall within a narrower band based on these factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for additional compensation, including bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package.

 

#### **Benefits**

* **Comprehensive Benefits** - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts
* **Financial & Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources
* **Time Off & Leave** – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave
* **Wellness & Growth** – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts

 

#### **About Monogram Health**

Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in-home, evidence-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present - such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders.

Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home.

Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.title: Multi-Site Dental Operations Director - West Coast
role.description:
**Role Summary**

The Director / Regional Manager of Operations provides strategic leadership and oversight for multiple dental practices across a defined region. This role is responsible for operational and financial performance, compliance, staff development, and practice growth. The position serves as a key liaison between executive leadership, dentist owners, and practice teams, supporting sustainable success through mentorship, systems alignment, and goal accountability.

**Essential Role Responsibilities**

The Regional Manager ensures all operational metrics, clinical standards, and financial goals are met while driving patient experience and practice expansion.

* Lead and oversee all operations for multiple dental locations (3-7 offices) within the assigned region.

* Develop, manage, and analyze budgets and P&L statements; initiate corrective action plans as needed.

* Hire, train, and retain high-performing talent in collaboration with HR and operating dentists.

* Onboard new team members and integrate them smoothly into business workflows.

* Train and coach practice leaders and staff to meet service, clinical, and business performance benchmarks.

* Collaborate with dentist owners and clinical leads to align strategic and patient care goals.

* Review KPIs and operational data to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and develop action plans.

* Monitor and ensure adherence to internal policies, HIPAA, OSHA, and other compliance regulations.

* Design and lead scalable systems and initiatives across practices to standardize operations.

* Organize and present project plans, reports, and charters tailored to various audiences.

* Conduct regular site visits and performance reviews, support talent development and succession planning.

* Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, and continuous improvement.

* Stay current on dental industry trends, innovations, and competitive benchmarks.

* Maintain a strong presence in staff training, annual reviews, and performance conversations.

* Promote core values, patient-centered care, and professionalism in all operations.

**Role Qualification Guidelines**

***Required Role Qualifications***

* Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, or related field.

* 6–8 years of multi-site operations management in dental or healthcare.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage KPIs, and drive profitability.

* Experience with strategic planning and implementation.

* Ability to travel to San Diego a minimum of once per month.

***Preferred Role Qualifications***

* Prior Director-level or senior operations leadership experience.

* DSO or private equity-backed group practice experience.

* Experience scaling practices and implementing enterprise-wide systems.

* Bilingual (English & Spanish) Strongly Preferred

***Required Licenses or Certifications***

* Valid driver's license and ability to travel across region.

* Compliance with OSHA/HIPAA certification requirements (training may be completed post-hire).

**Core Capabilities for Success**

The following are key attributes that are necessary for successful performance in the role. These capabilities are not required for the role and individuals may not exemplify all attributes of the capabilities outlined. However, the core capabilities should receive strong consideration when determining success or identifying a successful candidate for the role.

*Individuals with capabilities in contrast with the attributes below may achieve success in the role as performance in a role can have various external influencing factors. These factors should be considered when determining if an individual is an ideal fit for the role.*

***Knowledge and Skill***

* Advanced understanding of healthcare business operations and clinical compliance.

* Strong budgeting, performance analytics, and process development knowledge.

***Talent and Ability***

* Ability to lead, influence, and hold teams accountable across multiple locations.

* High-level critical thinking, decision-making, and communication skills.

***Personality Traits***

* Strategic, driven, and collaborative.

* Adaptable leader with a growth mindset and commitment to excellence.

role.title: Director of Healthcare Operations
role.description:
### **Position Summary**

The Director of Healthcare Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across a portfolio of skilled nursing facilities (SNFs). This role is accountable for clinical quality, regulatory compliance, financial performance, and resident and family satisfaction. The Director partners with facility administrators, directors of nursing, and Home Office leadership to drive consistent standards, develop leaders, and sustain survey readiness, while keeping resident-centered care at the center of every decision.

### **Our Core Values in This Role**

* **Human First:** Lead with compassion and respect, putting people first, whether residents, families, or teammates, and build an environment where everyone feels valued, supported, and encouraged to grow.
* **Keeping the Tempo:** Maintain a steady, focused rhythm across all facilities, empowering individual initiative and driving consistent, purposeful execution of the practices that help us meet and exceed our goals.
* **Curiously Driven:** Never settle for the status quo; pursue continuous improvement, treat mistakes as opportunities to learn and grow, and challenge boundaries in pursuit of excellence in care and operations.
* **Do the Right Thing:** Act with integrity and accountability, even when no one is watching, earning the trust of residents, families, and teammates by honoring commitments and standing behind every decision.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership**

* Oversee day-to-day operations across assigned facilities, ensuring consistent execution of company policies, procedures, and standards of care
* Coach, develop, and evaluate facility administrators and department leaders, including recruitment and succession planning
* Conduct regular on-site visits, operational audits, and performance reviews
* Lead operational improvement initiatives, including workflow redesign, technology adoption, and standardization across sites

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality**

* Ensure compliance with CMS Conditions of Participation, state licensure requirements, OSHA, HIPAA, and other applicable regulations
* Maintain continuous survey readiness; lead mock surveys, plans of correction, and responses to citations, complaints, and investigations
* Monitor quality measures, including Five-Star ratings, quality measures (QMs), PDPM accuracy, infection control, falls, pressure injuries, and rehospitalization rates
* Partner with clinical leadership and compliance to support QAPI programs and risk management

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage budgets, forecasts, and financial targets for assigned facilities
* Monitor key indicators such as census, payer mix, case mix index, labor costs, agency utilization, and A/R
* Identify opportunities to improve margin through revenue optimization, expense control, and efficient staffing models
* Review monthly financials with facility leaders and implement corrective action plans as needed

**Workforce and Culture**

* Drive staff recruitment, retention, and engagement strategies, with particular attention to nursing and direct care staff
* Reduce reliance on agency staffing through sound scheduling practices, labor management, and workforce pipelines
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and compassionate care

**Census and Relationship Development**

* Support admissions and business development efforts with hospitals, physician groups, ACOs, managed care organizations, and referral partners
* Strengthen community presence and reputation to support sustainable census growth
* Address resident, family, and stakeholder concerns promptly and professionally

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, nursing, or a related field
* 7+ years of progressive healthcare operations experience, including at least 3 years in a multi-facility or regional leadership role within long-term care or skilled nursing
* Active Nursing Home Administrator (NHA) license
* Strong working knowledge of CMS regulations, survey processes, PDPM, and Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement
* Demonstrated success managing P&Ls and improving financial and quality performance
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable multi-disciplinary teams

**Preferred**

* Experience with value-based care, managed care contracts, or post-acute network participation
* Familiarity with EHR platforms such as PointClickCare or MatrixCare and workforce management systems
* Background in turnaround or acquisition integration of facilities

### **Working Conditions**

* Regional travel of approximately 90% to visit facilities
* Occasional evening, weekend, or on-call availability for emergencies, survey activity, or staffing crises

role.title: Director, Quality Engineering
role.description:
**POSITION**: Director, Quality Engineer 
 
**FULL-TIME/PART-TIME**: Full Time 
 
**LOCATION**:Bothell, WA

React Health is a fast-paced, growth-driven manufacturer and distributor of medical equipment, dedicated to supporting patients, caregivers, physicians, and healthcare providers. With a focus on respiratory and sleep health sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of products and services across acute care, non-acute care, and home medical equipment. By integrating manufacturing and distribution, React Health addresses the needs of both undiagnosed individuals and those requiring therapy after diagnosis, particularly within the sleep and respiratory care sectors. 
 
**GENERAL SUMMARY** 
The Director of Quality Engineering is a highly motivated, technically competent team builder who can establish and execute a strategic vision, multi-task in a fast-paced work environment, and deliver tangible results for the React Health facility for Class I and II products. The Director will lead and manage the Quality Engineering function to ensure operational compliance with government regulations (FDA-Quality System Regulation, and other applicable country specific regulations) and applicable standards. 
 
This position is responsible for leading and executing the Quality Engineering strategy for React Health. Responsibilities include managing the planning and implementation of the use, design and process (internal and external) risk management and integration; creation and implementation of corporate processes, process maps, procedures, and tools. 
 
A proven track record of work experience and success in Class II medical device manufacturing and distribution companies. Other essential skills include: the ability to recognize logistical problems and initiate appropriate solutions; problem-solving capability with a solid understanding of scientific data collection, analytics and management methods; and excellent interpersonal verbal and written communication skills. The position reports to the VP, Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs. 
 
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years of experience in leadership in quality/regulatory in FDA regulated company, including Supplier Quality, Design Quality and Process / Manufacturing Quality Engineering functions
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
* 15+ years’ experience with ISO 13485, ISO 14971 Risk Management, FDA’s QSR for medical devices, Relevant applicable ISO Standards, MDR, Health Canada Regulations, and other International Regulations
* Change leadership, coaching, team development, managing multiple priorities, problem solving, Project Management
* CQE certification preferred

**Preferred Education**

* Master’s degree in Engineering

**Preferred Experience**

* Knowledge of QA document processes and systems, Design of Experiments (DOE), process capability studies, failure mode and effects analysis, and statistical tools including statistical process control.
* Knowledge of domestic and international regulatory requirements (i.e. FDA, GxPs, and ISO/EN standards).
* Excellent communications and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management with the ability to drive achievement of objectives.
* Proven ability to lead a diverse team of technicians and engineers.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well with people at all levels are essential.
* Able to demonstrate strong organizational and managerial skills.
* Capability of working independently, taking ownership for the management of processes, projects and timelines.
* Ability to effectively influence affiliates, regulatory agencies, and internal and external partners to ensure that business needs are met.
* Experience in leading and managing external audits and inspections
* Excellent attention to detail and project management skills.
* Excellent written/oral communication skills required. Must be able to work effectively with diverse groups of people.

**Physical Demands**

* Requires normal visual acuity and hearing.
* Typically, employees sit comfortably to do their work, interspersed by brief periods of standing, walking, bending, carrying papers and books, and extensive periods requiring the use of computer terminals to accomplish work objectives.
* Required to sit and use their hands and fingers to handle or feel and manipulate keys on a keyboard.
* Additional skills may be required to perform additional task(s) specific to work location, department or line of business.

**Working Conditions**

* Predominantly operates in an office environment. Some work (less than 5%) requires moving and lifting of heavy networking equipment.

**DUTIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** 
Each Employee consistently demonstrates the following essential functions:

* Member of site Senior management staff, providing representation for all Quality Engineering functions and personnel.
* Direct Quality Engineering functions (Supplier Quality, Design Quality and Process / Manufacturing Quality.
* Identify and lead continuous development and implementation of Quality Engineering strategy.
* Select and maintain best practice and compliant quality systems and processes in support of the global quality policy. Monitor technological trends such as emerging standards and new technology opportunities.
* Manage the planning and implementation of the Quality Engineering functions, including the creation and implementation of corporate processes, process maps, procedures, and tools in compliance with all applicable industry, local, national, and international regulatory requirements, and standards.
* Work closely with Marketing, Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, Suppliers, and other internal and external partners to ensure an effective, efficient, and well-established Quality Engineering processes.
* Provide direction to the team responsible for pre- and post-market quality engineering activities; use, design and internal and external process risk management such as FMEAs, test method validation, process improvements, non-conformance investigation and product disposition, corrective action, complaint analysis, etc.
* Gain cross-functional consensus, where possible, to establish new processes and implement effective change management.
* Continuously seek innovative ways to improve business productivity through the introduction of new quality system technologies, methods and controls.
* Establish product quality and process metrics that effectively measure and improve performance.
* Promote best practices to design, develop and manufacture products that will meet and exceed customers’ expectations.
* Manage needs for full-time or temporary Quality Engineering resources based on work level demands and budgetary constraints. Plan and execute staffing and compensation decisions.
* Develop and effectively manage operating, staffing, and projects budgets.
* Provide leadership to ensure the Quality Engineering organization attracts coaches and mentors and retains a knowledgeable and competent staff that is effectively organized to deliver high quality service to users, meet time commitments. Foster an environment which motivates the achievement of desired business results.
* Attends and participates in departmental meetings, attends seminars and training sessions necessary to maintain appropriate level of professional competence.
* Ensures all department compliance guidelines are met.
* Provides customer focused interactions.
* Performs all duties necessary for the department as per department policies and procedures.
* Performs other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the supervisor within the scope of practice and the responsibilities in the department.

* Performs other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the supervisor within the scope of practice and the responsibilities in the department.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to accommodate individuals with disabilities to perform the basic functions of the position without compromising client care. React Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to providing a drug-free workplace. We are an Equal-Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class.
