role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
Job ID: 530934
 
 
Ash Grove is a CRH company with a legacy dating back to 1882. We combine technical expertise, safety and customer-focused solutions to deliver reliable performance for our customers. We manufacture and supply high-performance, advanced cementitious materials for the most demanding construction and infrastructure needs. With more than 2,000 people across 60 locations in the United States and Canada, we support a wide range of applications, from major infrastructure projects to the development and refurbishment of residential and non-residential buildings that support everyday life, from highways and bridges to schools and commercial buildings.
 
 
To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com
 
 
\*\*Job Summary\*\*
 
 
The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.
 
 
\*\*Job Location\*\*
 
 

* This role will work out of our plant in Midlothian, TX.

\*\*Job Responsibilities\*\*
 
 

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.

\*\*Job Requirements\*\*
 
 

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year - Bachelors Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy

\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

role.description:
**Plant Manager**

**Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facility**

Triumvirate Environmental, one of the largest environmental services firms in North America, is seeking a Plant Manager

for our Casa Grande, AZ plant.

 

 

We are looking for an experienced Plant Manager to lead our hazardous waste operations, non-hazardous waste consolidation, and recycling services in Casa Grande, Arizona. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both hazardous and non-hazardous waste management. This role requires a hands-on professional who can collaborate closely with our Vice President of Disposal Services to enhance safety, ensure compliance, and maximize hazardous waste throughput.

Triumvirate Environmental provides leading organizations in the higher education, life sciences, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing sectors with diverse services and expertise to assist them with compli
ance management. At Triumvirate Environmental, we strive to WOW both our employees and our customers. Our unique culture fosters growth, development, education, and creativity.  

 

**Responsibilities:**

 

* Oversee the Hazardous Waste, Non-Hazardous Waste, and Recycling Operations in Casa Grande, AZ.
* Ensure that all permitted activities are in full compliance.
* Ensure safety of our staff working at the plant.
* Hire and retain employees.
* Oversee construction for second phase of the facility.
* Oversee all related logistics activities.
* Establish Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) to drive competitive costs and recycling value to our clients.
* Analyze and assess industry and market dynamics on a regular basis.
* Maintain and cultivate relationships with customers and vendors; establish customer retention and growth strategies; develop multi-level/multi-discipline business relations at customer  and vendor accounts.
* Build relationships with local and state agencies (fire dept., health dept., licensing bureaus, Department of Environmental Quality, etc.)
* Advise the company on market opportunities beyond Arizona.
* Advise the company on capital expenditures necessary to advance the company’s overall objectives for the facility.
* Develop technical expertise and knowledge of the company’s services and product lines.
* Achieve annual sales and gross margin targets.
* Participate in the annual budget process and prepare product forecasts as necessary.
* Manage resolution of customer related issues.
* Provide market information and intelligence.
* Share recommendations with the executive team for new products, services and identified areas of optimization.

**Ba
sic Requirements:**

 

* Bachelors degree is required
* 10-15 years’ experience within the hazardous and non-hazardous waste business.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to build, lead team, provide direction to staff and senior management.
* Specific experience importing/exporting hazardous waste between the nations of Mexico and the United States.
* Strong technical knowledge along with financial knowledge.
* Possess negotiating, strategic, and tactical transportation, planning, warehousing and logistics, problem analysis, and creativity skills.
* Experience running national and/or international field services operations.
* Expertise in all MS suite applications with strong Excel skills.
* Strong financial acumen with excellent numerical skills.
* Experience with various hazardous waste treatment processes including but not limited to fuel blending, neutralization, stabilization, evaporation and repackaging of various waste streams.
* Must be eligible to work in the United States without future sponsorship
* Must have
 a reliable form of transportation
* Must be willing to consent to Motor Vehicle Record screening, criminal background check, pre-employment physical, and drug screen (inclusive of THC)
* Upon employment, you will be required to participate in a random drug screening program (inclusive of THC) as part of our company’s commitment to maintaining a safe and healthy work environment
* Must be able to lift 60 pounds on a regular basis

**Preferred Requirements:**

 

* Master’s degree
* Bilingual English & Spanish

 

Besides Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, we contribute to a 401k, offer a generous tuition reimbursement program, TONS of safety training for some positions with opportunities for external trainings and certifications, Mentorship & Career Succession Planning, Relocation Opportunities, Auto/Home insurance discounts, pet assistance discount plans, discounted movie passes & more!  

 

To learn more about our business, culture, and the exciting work that we are doing in the industry, find us on


LinkedIn,

Instagram (@triumvirateenvironmental), or our


website

! 

 

Triumvirate Environmental is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. As an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE), Triumvirate does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans are encouraged to apply.

At **RTX**, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

**Pratt & Whitney** is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Pratt & Whitney is seeking a Senior Manager, Model-Based Quality Deployment, to lead the deployment and adoption of Model-Based Quality (MBQ) capabilities across the organization. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for driving strategic digital transformation initiatives, accelerating implementation of advanced quality technologies, and developing organizational capabilities that support long-term business objectives.

The successful candidate will provide direct leadership to the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, with resources aligned to the module center structure including Cold Section, Hot Section, North Berwick, and Supply Chain. This position requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, organizational influence, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful deployment and sustainment of Model-Based Quality capabilities across programs, sites, and customers.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, providing direct leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
* Establish operational priorities, deployment strategies, and resource allocation plans to achieve business and organizational objectives.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of Model-Based Quality tools, technologies, and processes across engineering, quality, operations, manufacturing, and customer organizations.
* Lead cross-functional collaboration to align stakeholders, resolve barriers, and accelerate execution of strategic deployment initiatives.
* Develop team capabilities through talent development, succession planning, training, and employee engagement activities.
* Monitor deployment progress, performance metrics, and organizational adoption to ensure successful execution and sustainment.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with deployment activities while ensuring alignment with program and customer requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and advocate for Model-Based Quality, supporting enterprise digital transformation objectives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and customer focus across the organization.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10+ years of experience in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Program Management, or a related field; or an Advanced Degree and 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, technology deployments, or business transformation activities.
* Strong knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5), 3D model-based engineering practices, and manufacturing quality requirements within an aerospace or highly regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience developing and executing strategic plans in a manufacturing, quality, or engineering environment.
* Demonstrated leadership experience with direct responsibility for people development, performance management, and team execution.
* Proven ability to lead organizational changes and drive adoption of new technologies and business processes.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Demonstrated expertise in Model-Based Quality, Model-Based Enterprise (MBE), Digital Thread, or related digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading teams within aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of Pratt & Whitney quality systems, manufacturing processes, and business operations.
* Experience influencing and aligning stakeholders across multiple organizations and levels of leadership.
* Excellent project management, communication, and organizational leadership skills.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification.
* Experience supporting strategic initiatives across multiple programs, customers, sites, and supply chain partners.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and data-driven performance management tools.

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. **This position is classified as:**

**Onsite**: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

role.title: Quality Technical Director
role.description:
Own the division’s quality strategy end to end, covering product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and regulatory compliance. You’ll set the technical direction for how quality is planned, measured, investigated, and improved—so performance, safety, and compliance are consistently achieved across the business.
 
 
**What You’ll Lead**

* Build and manage a high-performing technical and quality team, defining ways of working, performance expectations, and robust escalation paths.
* Strengthen supplier performance through quality requirements, audits/assessments, and structured corrective action to reduce recurring issues.
* Drive root-cause investigations and resolution for customer quality problems, translating findings into durable process and product improvements.
* Ensure laboratory and manufacturing practices support reliable results, operational effectiveness, and measurable compliance.
* Embed continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product performance, reduce variation, and optimize quality outcomes.

This role suits a quality leader with deep technical judgment, strong cross-functional influence, and the ability to bring data, compliance requirements, and practical process control together.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
***Position Summary***

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day leadership and performance of the machine shop operation. This position provides hands-on leadership across machining, production, quality, maintenance, safety, scheduling, and employee development to ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

The Plant Manager will drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, standardized work, effective production planning, and development of a high-performing manufacturing team. This individual will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to support business growth and achieve operational objectives.

***Essential Functions / Responsibilities*****:**

**Operations Leadership**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily machine shop operations.
* Manage production activities to achieve customer delivery, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Establish and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
* Ensure effective production scheduling, machine loading, labor utilization, and workflow.
* Identify and resolve production constraints, bottlenecks, and capacity issues.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet production requirements.
* Maintain strong floor presence and lead through visible, hands-on management.

**Machining & Manufacturing**

* Oversee CNC machining, manual machining, secondary operations, assembly, plating, Injection molding, deburring, inspection, and related manufacturing activities.
* Ensure equipment, tooling, fixtures, and processes are capable of meeting production requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve machining processes, cycle times, setups, tooling, and machine loading.
* Drive setup reduction, machine utilization, labor efficiency, and throughput improvements.
* Ensure adherence to standardized work and documented manufacturing processes.
* Lead Hazardous Waste Coordinator for facility.

**Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machine shop.
* Implement and sustain 5S, visual management, standard work, waste reduction, and problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, setup time, downtime, and overall manufacturing costs.
* Utilize data and KPIs to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.

**Safety & Environmental**

* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Lead safety initiatives, audits, training, and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper machine guarding, PPE, lockout/tagout, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.
* Investigate incidents and near misses and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Hold employees and leaders accountable for safe work practices.

**Quality**

* Partner with Quality to ensure products meet customer and internal quality requirements.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, defects, and customer complaints.
* Ensure operators follow documented work instructions and quality procedures.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities.
* Promote a culture of first-time quality and process ownership.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, leads, machinists, operators, and other production personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, training, cross-training, and employee development.
* Develop a flexible, multi-skilled workforce capable of supporting changing production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews and address performance issues in a timely manner.
* Foster teamwork, communication, accountability, and employee engagement.

**Maintenance & Equipment**

* Partner with Maintenance to maximize equipment availability and reliability.
* Monitor machine downtime and establish corrective action plans.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Manage capital equipment planning, justification and implementation.
* Ensure new equipment and processes are effectively integrated into production.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage operational performance against established budgets and financial targets.
* Monitor labor efficiency, overtime, scrap, rework, material usage, and machine utilization.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction opportunities.
* Support Supplier Development Activities
* Support Product Transfer activities which may include travel
* Drive capital expenditure planning and return-on-investment analysis.
* Understand the relationship between operational performance, cost, and EBITDA.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Conduct daily/weekly operational meetings and communicate priorities throughout the organization.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on production performance, capacity, quality, safety, and staffing.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Sales to resolve issues and support customer requirements.
* Escalate operational risks and develop action plans to address them.

***Physical Requirements*****:**

Required to sit, stand, bend, and lift up to 25 lbs.

***Work Environment*****:**

* Combination of Manufacturing and Office environment.
* Regular exposure to noise, dust, heat, cold and odors.

***Knowledge, Skills & Experiences*****:**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, preferably in a precision machining environment.
* 3+ years of manufacturing leadership experience with responsibility for people and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of CNC machining and machine shop operations.
* Experience with high-mix/low- to medium-volume manufacturing preferred.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience leading production teams and improving operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing safety practices and OSHA requirements.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

***Preferred Experience***

* Precision machining and tight-tolerance manufacturing
* CNC turning and milling
* Multi-axis machining
* High-mix manufacturing
* AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments
* Hazardous Waste Management

* Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* ERP/MRP systems
* Capital equipment implementation
* Continuous improvement / Kaizen
* P&L or operating-budget responsibility

role.title: Sr. Manager Manufacturing Engineer
role.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
As a Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide and support engineering teams to drive operational excellence and innovation across our manufacturing facilities. You will provide strategic direction and technical leadership for manufacturing processes, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement projects while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, you'll optimize production efficiency, implement new technologies, and deliver solutions that enable our mission of making the world healthier, cleaner and safer. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in regulated manufacturing environments (pharmaceutical, medical device, or related industries)
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Chemical) or related technical field. Strong focus on Automation required.
* Industry certifications in Six Sigma, PMP, or related areas are beneficial
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams and facilitating organizational change
* Demonstrated success implementing automation, digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of cGMP, ISO standards and regulatory compliance requirements
* Experience with new product introductions, technology transfers and process validation
* Expertise in lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodology and practical process improvements (PPI)
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic plans aligned with business objectives
* Strong project management skills and experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with data-driven decision making
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage stakeholders at all levels
* Proficiency with manufacturing systems, automation platforms and quality tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Experience with capital project planning, budgeting and resource allocation

* **Relocation:** Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* **Work Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.
* **Pre-Employment Screening:** Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements, including a background check and drug screening, in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $155,100.00–$232,650.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

role.title: Director Destination Care Operations
role.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

The Director of Destination Care Operations drives the day-to-day operational success of CommonSpirit Health’s destination care program in partnership with clinical, financial, and internal and external stakeholders – serving patients traveling 150 or more miles for specialty care, from neighboring communities across the United States to international markets. The Director advances program performance, team excellence, and a concierge-caliber patient experience, ensuring every patient experiences frictionless care from first inquiry through return home. This role is suited to a self-driven leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and brings strong team leadership, process improvement skills, and comfort leading teams through change. The ideal candidate leads with adaptability, resourcefulness, and a collaborative spirit, and is deeply committed to delivering an exceptional experience for every destination care patient. This is an in-person, onsite role.

* Oversees the day-to-day operational performance of the destination care program, ensuring consistent and high-quality service delivery across all phases of the patient journey. Oversees referral intake and coordination workflows, ensuring timely and accurate routing, follow-up, and communication with referring providers and patients.
* Ensures patients, families, and referring partners experience seamless, concierge-caliber service from initial contact through post-discharge follow-up; conducts regular patient and family rounding to assess experience, identify service gaps and recovery opportunities, reinforce service standards, and gather patient stories that reflect the destination care experience.
* Delivers and ensures culturally informed service, communication, and care coordination across diverse domestic and international patient populations. Partners with clinical leadership and clinical advisory resources to support patient care operations and ensure the clinical needs of the destination care population are addressed. Identifies and leads process improvement and workflow optimization initiatives to advance operational efficiency, service quality, and patient satisfaction; develops and maintains operational protocols and standards that support consistent program delivery.
* Establishes and maintains documentation standards and data integrity practices across the team to support accurate program reporting, operational decision-making, and continuity of patient care. Serves as the escalation point for the team and provides availability for complex or time-sensitive situations as they arise. Manages the destination care program budget and is accountable for financial performance against established targets.
* Sets clear performance expectations, invests in professional growth, and builds and sustains a high-performing team culture grounded in service excellence, operational consistency, and continuous improvement; establishes clear standards and ensures consistent adherence across the team, addressing performance gaps directly and constructively.
* Oversees onboarding, cross-training, and workflow consistency across the program. Leads change management efforts within the team to support adoption of new workflows, service standards, and program initiatives.

**Job Requirements**

Required

* Bachelors Other Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field. and 5 or more years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare or patient services operations, upon hire and
* Experience managing and developing teams in a complex, matrixed healthcare organization, with direct accountability for program performance outcomes, upon hire and
* Experience delivering high-touch, patient-centered services for complex or high-acuity patient populations, including programs such as transplant, oncology, specialty referral, or equivalent tertiary or quaternary care settings, upon hire and
* Experience with electronic health record and hospital information systems; proficiency with productivity suites including Google Workspace and Microsoft Office., upon hire or

Preferred

* Masters Other Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Nursing, or a related field and 7-9 years 7 or more years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare or patient services operations, upon hire and
* Experience with international patient programs, embassy-sponsored care, or global sponsor coordination., upon hire and
* Clinical background including Registered Nurse (RN) licensure or equivalent clinical operations experience, upon hire and
* Experience in a dedicated destination care, international patient services, or specialty referral program at an academic medical center or large health system, upon hire and
* Experience building or expanding programs, including policy and operational protocol development, upon hire and
* Experience preparing and delivering financial and operating performance reports and presentations for leadership, upon hire and
* Experience with referral management, patient access, financial counseling, registration, or admissions workflows, upon hire and
* Experience managing program operations across multiple facilities or markets within a large health system., upon hire
* Certified Case Manager, upon hire or
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Certification, upon hire or
* Project Management Professional, upon hire or
* Registered Nurse: TX, upon hire

Where You'll Work

Baylor St. Luke’s Medical Center is an 1,045 bed facility located in the Texas medical center. A joint venture with Baylor College of Medicine, Baylor St. Luke’s is an internationally recognized leader in research and clinical excellence that has given rise to breakthroughs in cardiovascular care, neuroscience, oncology, transplantation, and more. The hospital is home to the Dan L Duncan Comprehensive Cancer Center, a nationally-accredited and NCI-designated comprehensive cancer center. Our new McNair Campus is designed around the human experience—modeled on evidence-based practices for the safety of patients, visitors, staff, and physicians. The 27.5-acre campus represents the future of healthcare through a transformative alliance focused on leading-edge patient care, research, and education.

$60.24 - $89.60 /hour

role.title: Director, Ops Analysis (R5036)
role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shield AI is building intelligent autonomy systems for the defense of service members and civilians. The Hivemind Solutions organization applies Shield AI’s autonomy stack to mission-critical systems across air, maritime, strike, weapons, space, and collaborative autonomy domains.

We are seeking a Director, Operations Analysis to lead a team responsible for turning operational problems into quantitative insights that shape product strategy, engineering priorities, customer engagement, and mission outcomes. This leader will manage and grow a high-performing Operations Analysis team that uses modeling, simulation, wargaming, campaign analysis, and mission-level trade studies to help determine what Hivemind should build, why it matters, and how it performs in realistic operational contexts.

This is a leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of autonomy, military operations, mission engineering, modeling and simulation, product strategy, and customer-facing analysis. The right candidate will be technically credible, analytically rigorous, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to translate complex operational questions into clear recommendations for executives, engineers, business development leaders, and government customers.

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead and manage the Hivemind Solutions Operations Analysis team, including hiring, mentoring, prioritization, performance management, and technical direction.

 - Build an operations analysis capability that directly informs Hivemind product strategy, autonomy roadmap decisions, customer pursuits, and program execution.

 - Define and execute mission analysis, campaign analysis, force-on-force studies, CONOPS evaluations, and operational trade studies across multiple Hivemind product domains.

 - Partner with Product, Architecture, Systems Engineering, Business Development, Strategy, and Program teams to translate operational problems into analytical studies and actionable product recommendations.

 - Develop analysis plans that connect mission objectives, operational assumptions, threat environments, system performance, autonomy behaviors, and measurable mission outcomes.

 - Guide the use of tools such as AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, custom simulations, and other modeling environments to evaluate mission effectiveness and operational value.

 - Establish standards for analytical rigor, model credibility, assumption tracking, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty characterization, and communication of results.

 - Create clear, executive-ready briefings that explain what was analyzed, what assumptions were made, what the results mean, and what decisions should follow.

 - Support customer engagements by developing compelling, technically grounded analysis that demonstrates the operational value of Hivemind-enabled systems.

 - Work with engineering teams to identify the autonomy behaviors, system capabilities, interfaces, performance parameters, and test data needed to improve model fidelity.

 - Help shape product requirements by connecting operational outcomes to measurable system and autonomy performance needs.

 - Build reusable analysis frameworks, scenarios, vignettes, and metrics that can scale across programs and domains.

 - Represent the Operations Analysis function in internal technical reviews, roadmap discussions, capture strategy sessions, and customer-facing meetings.

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, computer science, physics, aerospace, systems engineering, data science, or a related technical field.

 - 10+ years of relevant experience in operations analysis, mission analysis, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, military analysis, campaign analysis, or related technical domains.

 - 5+ years of experience leading teams, projects, or technical analysis efforts.

 - Experience using modeling and simulation to inform real product, system, program, or operational decisions.

 - Strong understanding of military operations, mission planning, force employment, kill chains, sensing, communications, autonomy, aircraft systems, weapons systems, or related defense concepts.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous operational questions into structured analysis plans, quantitative methods, and decision-quality outputs.

 - Experience working with engineering, product, business development, strategy, or customer-facing teams.

 - Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and customers with clarity, confidence, and analytical discipline.

 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and analysis must support real business and technical decisions.

 - U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Master’s degree or PhD in operations research, engineering, applied mathematics, data science, aerospace, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Experience with AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, Cameo, custom simulation environments, or other mission and campaign analysis tools.

 - Experience analyzing autonomous systems, collaborative autonomy, uncrewed aircraft, crewed-uncrewed teaming, electronic warfare, space systems, missile systems, maritime systems, or air combat operations.

 - Experience supporting defense product development, advanced concepts, government capture efforts, experimentation, test planning, or mission engineering.

 - Familiarity with model validation, verification, credibility assessment, sensitivity analysis, design of experiments, and uncertainty quantification.

 - Experience building analysis teams, establishing technical standards, and scaling analytical capabilities across multiple stakeholders or product lines.

 - Prior military, government laboratory, FFRDC/UARC, defense contractor, or aerospace experience.

 - Active U.S. security clearance.

What success looks like:

 - In this role, success means the Operations Analysis team becomes a trusted decision engine for Hivemind Solutions. The team’s work should not sit on a shelf. It should shape what we build, how we prioritize, how we explain operational value to customers, and how we make hard trade decisions across product lines.
 
 A successful manager will build a team that is technically rigorous, operationally grounded, fast-moving, and deeply connected to the business. They will ensure that analysis is not treated as an after-the-fact briefing function, but as a core part of product development, strategy, and customer engagement.

Why this role matters:

 - Autonomy changes what is operationally possible, but only if we understand where it creates real mission advantage. The Operations Analysis team helps answer that question. This team connects Hivemind’s technical capabilities to measurable operational outcomes, helping Shield AI make better product decisions and helping customers understand the mission impact of intelligent autonomous systems.
 
 If you want to lead a team that sits at the center of autonomy, strategy, engineering, and operational decision-making, this role is for you.

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

 

###

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. role.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


ABOUT SHIELD AI:

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We’re looking for a hands-on quality leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production. 

You will build the aircraft quality organization and establish the quality capability for our new Seattle-area production facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll own product and process quality across prototype, pre-series and production builds, ensuring that lessons from development become effective controls as the program scales. 

This role owns the Quality Management System, quality engineering, inspection, nonconformance management and audit readiness for the X-BAT manufacturing operation. You’ll partner with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production and Supply Chain to prevent defects, resolve recurring problems and deliver aircraft that meet technical, customer and applicable regulatory requirements. 

We need a technically credible leader who can build practical, scalable systems, make sound decisions under schedule pressure and challenge senior stakeholders constructively while keeping execution moving. 

What you'll do:

 - Build quality into prototype and launch 
 
 - Lead quality planning and execution for X-BAT prototype and development builds, establishing appropriate inspection, test evidence and build records as designs evolve. 
 
 - Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering to identify product and process risks, define critical controls and build quality requirements into tooling, work instructions and test plans. 
 
 - Establish configuration and traceability controls with Engineering and Production, ensuring each aircraft’s build status, deviations and nonconformances are understood and documented. 
 
 - Capture lessons from build, integration and test issues, and drive their incorporation into design changes, manufacturing processes and future builds. 
 
 - Define quality readiness criteria for pre-series builds and production launch, validating inspection methods, process controls, workforce competence and closure of significant risks. 
 
 Establish the Seattle quality operation 
 
 - Recruit, develop and lead the quality team, building the technical capability and frontline support needed as aircraft production grows. 
 
 - Establish and maintain a lean, effective QMS for X-Forge 3, aligned with Shield AI’s wider quality framework, AS9100, ISO 9001 and applicable customer requirements. 
 
 - Lead certification readiness and internal, customer and external audits, driving timely closure and sustained effectiveness of corrective actions. 
 
 - Set up receiving, in-process and final inspection capability, including measurement equipment, calibration, training and quality records, in partnership with relevant functions. 
 
 Deliver quality at rate 
 
 - Own production quality performance, using first-pass yield, defects, rework and escapes to focus action where it improves aircraft quality and production flow. 
 
 - Lead containment, root cause analysis and corrective action for manufacturing quality issues, with clear functional ownership and verification that fixes prevent recurrence. 
 
 - Own the nonconformance and MRB process, ensuring disposition decisions follow approved technical authority and that affected hardware remains controlled. 
 
 - Partner with Supply Chain and supplier quality teams to resolve incoming quality issues and improve supplier performance before defects disrupt aircraft builds. 
 
 - Work with Engineering and Production to define acceptance evidence and ensure aircraft meet approved requirements before release. 
 
 - Use digital quality tools and manufacturing data to strengthen traceability, expose trends and reduce manual administration as production scales. 
 
 - Give leadership a clear view of quality performance, product risks and readiness; escalate or stop affected work when requirements or product integrity cannot be assured. 

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality or a related technical field. 

 - 10+ years of leadership experience in quality, product assurance or reliability within aerospace, defense technology or high-reliability manufacturing. 

 - Demonstrated success leading quality through prototype or new product introduction and into sustained production. 

 - Proven ability to build and scale quality teams and systems while supporting fast-paced development and manufacturing operations. 

 - Deep expertise in containment, root cause analysis, MRB, corrective and preventive action, and continuous improvement. 

 - Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001, with practical implementation and audit leadership experience. 

 - Experience with complex assembly, inspection, configuration control, traceability and product acceptance. 

 - Ability to influence and challenge senior leaders constructively across Engineering, Production and Supply Chain. 

 - A hands-on leadership style and sound technical judgment, balancing timely execution with clear quality standards and accountability. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through production launch and rate ramp. 

 - Experience establishing quality capability at a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites. 

 - Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration, production test and reliability improvement. 

 - Experience deploying digital quality systems, statistical process controls and data-driven defect prevention. 

 - Advanced degree in engineering, quality or a related technical discipline. 

#LF

role.title: Chief of Staff, Production
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 About the Role

 The Chief of Staff, Production is an extension of the SVP of Production, a force multiplier who increases executive leverage across a hyper-growth organization. This role exists to create the operating structure, decision clarity, and organizational follow-through that allow the SVP to operate at the altitude the business demands.

Today, the Anduril Production organization is scaling rapidly. Problems are solved quickly because senior leaders engage directly, but that model doesn't scale. The Chief of Staff will drive the transition from an organization that depends on executive participation in every thread to one where leaders own outcomes, escalations are high-quality, and the SVP focuses on the decisions only they can make.

This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, structures chaos without slowing things down, and can absorb executive context fast enough to credibly represent the SVP's intent and standards. You are the glue between the SVP, the Production leadership team, and the rest of Anduril, down and in within the org, up and out across the company.

 What You’ll Do

 
 Context Management: Maintain continuity across every active thread, know what matters, what decisions were made, who owns what, and where escalation is needed. Triage the information overload that floods toward the SVP and proactively surface only what requires their direct engagement.

 Operating Structure: Design and drive the operating cadence for the Production organization: leadership meetings, QBRs, strategic planning cycles, internal business reviews, and cross-functional touchpoints (CDR, MRR, PDR, etc.). Build follow-through, accountability, and decision hygiene, not bureaucracy.

 Executive Filtering: Determine where the SVP must engage, where they should adjudicate, and where their directs should own resolution. Improve the quality of escalations so that when the SVP is pulled in, the issue is framed, options are clear, and a recommendation is ready.

 Executive Extension: Represent the SVP's viewpoint credibly in internal forums, cross-functional meetings, and leadership discussions. This requires deeply internalizing the SVP's standards, priorities, and decision-making patterns, not just relaying messages.

 Communications & Content: Own communications from the Production leadership team, all-hands content, email updates, and departmental rollouts. Create presentations for QBRs, executive meetings, and offsites. Translate complex operational realities into clear narratives.

 Strategic Initiatives: Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from scoping through execution. Drive strategic projects that don't have a natural owner but are critical to the organization's evolution.

 External Engagement & Events: Plan and execute VIP engagements, customer visits, investor visits, department summits, and all-hands events. Own end-to-end logistics, agenda design, and content curation.

 Organizational Development: Help leaders prepare better, escalate smarter, and own outcomes, so the organization matures from reactive to operational.

 
 Qualifcations

 
 5+ years of progressive professional experience in strategic operations, business leadership, management consulting, or directly supporting senior executives in high-growth, complex environments.

 Demonstrated success in a Chief of Staff, or similar executive leverage role, with a track record of transforming how an organization operates, not just coordinating across it.

 Technical or operational experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, advanced technology, or similar hardware-intensive industries.

 Proven ability to absorb executive context rapidly, operate with incomplete information, and accurately represent senior leadership's intent and judgment to the broader organization.

 Exceptional executive communication skills, you distill complex, ambiguous situations into clear, actionable recommendations in writing, presentations, and live conversation.

 Track record of building operating structure around fast-moving leaders, creating scalable systems, decision hygiene, and accountability without slowing the organization down.

 Self-driven and relentlessly proactive. You operate with high autonomy in ambiguous environments, see gaps before they become problems, and drive results without close oversight.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 Bachelor's degree in a Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.

 Previous success as a Chief of Staff directly supporting C-suite or SVP-level executives in defense or technology companies.

 Familiarity with production environments, manufacturing operations, or hardware development lifecycles.

 Experience in organizations with significant government relations or regulatory components.

 US Salary Range
 $220,000 — $292,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

role.title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 We are seeking an experienced and strategic  Director of Manufacturing Engineering to lead and oversee manufacturing engineering activities and systems across our flagship factory (Arsenal-1) in Columbus, OH. This senior leader will support both the development of new products and the scaling of high-volume production.
You will be responsible for driving operational performance and engineering excellence, ensuring safety, quality, delivery, and efficiency while scaling production to meet business growth objectives. Your leadership will guarantee that rigorous manufacturing processes are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality products. This role demands an innovative and adaptable approach to solving complex manufacturing challenges, driving advancements in digital tools, DfM/DfA, and automation in a highly dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be a results-oriented leader with deep expertise in lean manufacturing, process engineering, operational excellence, and team development.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Strategic Leadership 

 
 Develop and implement a long-term manufacturing engineering strategy aligned with company goals.

 Drive innovation in manufacturing processes, automation, and technology adoption to enhance efficiency and scalability for both development and high-volume production.

 Architect the requirements and roadmaps for next-generation digital manufacturing tools to improve manufacturing design, analysis, and production efficiency.

 Build systems and processes to support the manufacturing design and production of classified products in compliance with security and regulatory requirements.

 
 Team Leadership & Development 

 
 Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers and technical staff.

 Build and maintain an engaged, motivated workforce through strong leadership and communication.

 Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 
 New Product Introduction (NPI) & Scalability 

 
 Partner with R&D and product development teams to ensure seamless transition of new products from design to production.

 Drive Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles during product development, ensuring smooth scaling into production.

 
 Resource Planning 

 
 Manage budgets, resources, and staffing for the manufacturing engineering department.

 Forecast future operational and headcount needs to support scaling efforts for high-growth production environments.

 Plan for rapid response to large-scale program demands, including classified systems, with short ramp-up times.

 
 
 Required Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical), Operations Management, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA strongly preferred.

 15+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering and operations with at least 7 years in senior leadership roles.

 Strong knowledge of automation, robotics, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

 Experience in managing New Product Introduction (NPI) and scaling production for high-growth environments.

 Experience in developing, implementing, and utilizing digital manufacturing tools for design and analysis.

 Familiarity with quality systems and regulatory compliance (ISO, FDA, AS9100, etc.) preferred.

 Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES).

 Excellent leadership, interpersonal, communication, and project management skills.

 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 US Salary Range
 $190,000 — $252,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: Director of Production, Optics
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Director of Production, Optics will own all production outcomes for Optics production for the Imaging Business Line. the production organization responsible for building and delivering precision optical assemblies for advanced defense systems. This role requires both frontline technical leadership and strong people management — you will be responsible for the team, the output, and the operational health of the optical production value stream. Success demands consistent achievement across team development, on-time delivery, quality, cost, and continuous improvement, ensuring execution of mission-critical optical products.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 
 Production Ownership & Strategy: Own all production outcomes for the Optics Production across Imaging product lines, including ramp plans, headcount, and the standing up of new manufacturing lines. Develop and execute a long-term strategy to rapidly scale production volumes to full-rate production.

 Leadership & Team Management: Serve as a strategic leader and tactical do-er, driving all people and resources across production to achieve outcomes. Lead cross-functional teams (including Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing Engineering) through strong leadership, advocacy, and a consistent on-site presence, holding them accountable to meeting demands, deadlines, and goals.

 Operational Excellence: Drive processes and systems needed throughout the product development lifecycle to mature products to full-rate production. Establish and manage the team to key performance indicators (KPIs) for financial, quality, and on-time delivery to optimize manufacturing operations' impact on the business.

 Own Production Operations: Oversee the production of optical product lines, managing a team of technicians and production staff to ensure efficient assembly, test, and delivery of imaging and optical hardware. Drive daily and weekly production execution across optical assembly lines and the supporting supply base, ultimately owning all production outcomes across delivery, cost, and quality targets in the Operating plan.

 Value Stream Management: Own visibility and flow across the end-to-end value stream — from supplier material deliveries through internal optical assembly, test, and shipment. Identify bottlenecks, drive root-cause resolution, and implement process improvements to increase throughput and reduce cycle time.

 Process & Technology Advancement: Advise on development and oversee the implementation of digital technologies, from PLM and ERP to our custom MES and QMS systems, that enable our production operations to efficiently scale while meeting customer requirements. Shape corporate tools and processes to support the unique needs of aerospace production.

 Champion Quality & Safety: Ensure quality and safety standards are followed across clean room and optical assembly environments, minimizing defects and fostering a safe working environment.

 Drive Continuous Improvement: Lead 5S, Lean manufacturing, and other continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, optimize workflows, and scale production capacity.

 Strategic Communication: Provide regular updates to senior leadership on production status, risks, and resource needs. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with engineering, supply chain, quality, and program management.

 
 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Optical Engineering or a related field.

 8+ years of experience in optical or complex electro-mechanical production, with 3+ years in a senior production leadership.

 Demonstrated experience standing up, scaling and managing production of optical assemblies, precision hardware, or imaging systems — defense, aerospace, or adjacent industries strongly preferred.

 Working knowledge of optical assembly processes, clean room manufacturing environments, and optical test and inspection methods.

 Proven expertise with ERP, MRP, and MES systems, coupled with a strong understanding of Lean manufacturing, NPI, and change management (ECOs).

 Ability to interpret complex technical documentation (drawings, schematics, work instructions) and troubleshoot processes and equipment.

 Demonstrated success in employee development, coaching, and mentorship.

 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, highly organized, and detail-oriented.

 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 US Salary Range
 $220,000 — $292,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency.
