role.title: Head of Operations, Intelligence Systems
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to join our rapidly growing Intelligence Systems team. In this role you will be responsible for all business operations for the business line you support. Your work will vary from quick-turn operational fire-fighting, to building and redesigning processes, to leading high-impact strategic projects. This role requires you to be a trusted partner to each part of the business, and to work with and support the Division leadership teams to achieve our strategic objectives.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Partner to the GM — Serve as the right hand to the General Manager of Intelligence Systems, responsible for all internal operations of the business line.

 Act as COO of the business line — Drive day-to-day business operations for Intelligence Systems. This includes business planning & organization design, financial tracking, talent planning & people operations, staffing and hiring, corporate governance, go-to-market, real estate & facility planning, security & infrastructure compliance, proposal & legal support, and sharing the division's narrative — working with cross-functional partners across each of these domains.

 Lead the BizOps team — Lead the Business Operations team within Intelligence Systems, composed of a Business Execution/Services team and Business Analytics, with the potential to include Production Operations/Analytics.

 Own the bottom line — Own the business line P&L and burn rate. Partner with Finance and FP&A to track financial health against division goals, take action to keep operating expenses within budget, and recommend strategies to drive toward margin targets.

 Define growth strategy — Define the growth strategy for Intelligence Systems in partnership with the Intelligence Systems Leadership Team, and lead strategic initiatives in line with business line priorities.

 Enable the engineering mission — Support the growth, execution, and engineering of the business line with operational support.

 Scale the organization — Problem solve to enable the business line to operate as efficiently as possible and scale accordingly.

 Represent the business externally — Build senior leader engagement and external interface strategy (e.g., conferences, press releases, partnerships).

 Build partnerships — Build, negotiate, and execute partnerships across industry.

 Support M&A activity — Identify targets and engage in diligence.

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 10-15+ years of professional experience in operations.

 Strong communication skills; trusted by executives and colleagues alike — Demonstrated ability to translate and articulate thoughts clearly and simply across a wide range of roles (software engineers, finance partners, recruiters, cross-functional leadership, and executives). Communications excellence across a wide dynamic range, both written and verbal. Experience interfacing with company leadership and executives is a must, with a demonstrated ability to cultivate trust, facilitate meetings for, and engage with executives.

 Technically minded — Solid technical aptitude and proven ability to understand technical designs, and the ability to work closely and effectively with engineering teams.

 Bridges operational and analytical teams — Strong emotional intelligence and ability to solve operational problems in a way that is both data-driven and people-centric.

 High ownership and capacity — Horsepower to effectively manage multiple (6+) large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Finance literate — Comfortable owning a bottom line, reading and acting on P&L, budget, and margin data in partnership with FP&A.

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at either our Reston, VA office or our HQ in Costa Mesa, CA.

 Minimum 25% travel expected.

 Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 MBA or similar degree.

 Experience working with engineers and bringing hardware/software products to market strongly preferred.

 Experience in the intelligence community or national security mission space

 Experience leading a business operations, business analytics, or similar function

 Experience working effectively in a matrix organization structure.

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field.

 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are seeking a Head of Production to own the strategic development, operational direction, and execution of production for high-volume compute devices. In this role, you will serve as both a strategic leader and a hands-on operator, responsible for defining and driving the future success of the production portfolio and ensuring consistent, flawless execution across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturing. You will own the end-to-end relationship with contract manufacturers (CMs), lead the transition from New Product Introduction (NPI) through to sustained high-rate mass production, and build supply chain resilience — all while ensuring operational excellence, scalability, and adherence to rigorous quality and cost targets.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 Contract Manufacturer Management (High-Volume Compute)

 Production Ramps: Lead production ramps and volume transitions across multiple CM sites and geographies, ensuring on-time delivery against aggressive targets.

 
 Supply Chain Management 

 
 Supply Chain Strategy: Own supply chain strategy for high-volume production: demand/supply planning, component sourcing, inventory management, and logistics.

 Risk & Resilience: Build resilience against component shortages, single-source risk, and geopolitical or lead-time disruption.

 Component Sourcing: Partner with procurement and engineering to secure allocation of critical and long-lead components at scale.

 
 Contract Negotiation 

 
 Manufacturing Agreements: Negotiate manufacturing agreements, pricing, capacity commitments, SLAs, and cost-down roadmaps with CMs and suppliers.

 Commercial Terms: Structure commercial terms that protect margin, ensure supply, and align partner incentives with volume and quality targets.

 Cost Reduction: Drive year-over-year cost reduction through negotiation, design-for-cost, and competitive sourcing.

 
 Strategic & Operational Leadership 

 
 Executive Partnership: Serve as the production voice to the executive team and board; translate operational status, risk, and trade-offs into clear executive-level recommendations. Act as a key partner to Anduril's SVP of Manufacturing and broader Executive Leadership, contributing to company-wide production strategy and vision.

 Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Procurement, Quality, Program Management, Deployment Operations, and Finance to align production plans with company goals and ensure seamless product maturation and delivery.

 Talent & Team Building: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing production/operations organization. Attract, develop, and retain top-tier talent, fostering a culture of ownership and excellence.

 Process & Systems Excellence: Establish, mature, and continuously refine manufacturing processes, operational playbooks, and systems to enable efficient scaling and consistent quality.

 Digital Manufacturing Infrastructure: Advise on development and oversee implementation of digital technologies — including PLM, ERP, MES, and QMS — that enable production operations to scale efficiently while meeting customer requirements.

 Compliance & Standards: Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards (e.g., AS9100D) and all relevant safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 10+ years of progressive leadership in high-volume production of compute or electronics hardware (servers, data center infrastructure, or comparable devices), scaling products from prototype to full-rate production.

 Proven track record managing contract manufacturers / EMS partners at scale, including NPI-to-mass-production ramps. Direct ownership of at least one new product ramp through full-rate production.

 Deep supply chain management expertise — planning, sourcing, risk mitigation, procurement, and warehousing functions essential to high-volume hardware manufacturing.

 Demonstrated contract negotiation skill with CMs and suppliers (pricing, capacity, SLAs, cost-down).

 Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and partner with C-level leadership and the board.

 Experience managing a workforce of 100+ employees across quality, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, operations, and technicians.

 Experience managing a P&L in a production environment, including capital expenditure forecasting and resource allocation.

 Demonstrated strategic thinking and strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to understand how problems and solutions integrate within the broader organization.

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or related technical field; advanced degree a plus. Equivalent practical experience with a proven track record considered.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Experience scaling a new compute product line from launch through high-volume production (on the order of thousands of units annually).

 Global CM/supplier management experience across multiple regions.

 Background blending in-house and outsourced manufacturing models.

 Experience with complex electromechanical systems in a deeply technical industry such as aerospace, defense, consumer electronics, or data center infrastructure.

role.title: Head of Production, Imaging
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM 

The Imaging Business Line, within Mission Systems Division, is responsible for tackling the most difficult problems involving computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data. The team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software. Imaging products are deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The Imaging team is based in Lexington, Massachusetts.

We are seeking a Senior Director to coordinate all of our production operations across a variety of objectives and locations. The Head of Production owns execution, operational direction, career pathing, and production vision for a suite of Anduril products. Your job will be to provide consistent, flawless execution for a variety of products and programs.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

 
 Own all Production outcomes such as, ramp plan, Headcount, etc.

 Drive all people and resources to drive all production outcomes.

 Serve as tactical leader for Anduril’s rapidly growing production operations for a product or suite of products.

 Hold cross functional teams accountable to meeting demands, deadlines and goals to deliver the production on time and within budget.

 Drive Production, Supply Chain, and Quality, teams to build and execute upon Anduril’s 5-year strategic vision to become a next-generation aerospace and defense manufacturer, capable of full rate production.

 Deliver production outcomes as the products mature from production development to full rate production.

 Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Deployment Operations, and Program Management to execute success.

 Mature products from low rate to full rate production by driving processes and systems as needed throughout the product development lifecycle.

 Establish and manage team to financial, quality, and on-time delivery KPIs to understand how our manufacturing operations are impacting our business.

 Advise on development and oversee implementation of digital technologies, from PLM and ERP to our custom MES and QMS systems, that enable our production operations to efficiently scale while meeting customer requirements.

 Be accountable to AS9100D guidelines.

 Be a partner to Anduril Imaging leadership for Manufacturing strategy.

 
 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 
 10+  years in a Production leadership role with a track record of successfully scaling products from prototype to full rate production on the order of 1000s.

 Strong ability to work cross-functionally in an unstructured, ambiguous environment. Startup experience preferred.

 Experience with discrete production operations in a deeply technical industry such as aerospace, consumer electronics, medical, or automotive. Production engineering  manufacturing experience also a plus.

 Must have owned a new product ramp through full rate production.

 Experience managing a P&L in a Production environment.

 Experience managing workforce of at least 100+ employees across quality, supply chain, manufacturing engineering and technicians.

 Relentless drive for continuous improvement and solving high impact business problems through highly leveraged process, business systems, and data.

 Strong outcome orientation with the ability to drive initiatives from inception to implementation and adoption. Willing and able to dive into tactical execution mode to move the effort forward.

 Ability to work with a strong engineering team on a technical level.

 Positive and inspirational leader with the demonstrated ability to assess, attract and retain high-quality talent and build high-performing teams.

 Strong problem solving and analytic skills with the ability to understand how problems and their solutions fit with the wider organization and its operations.

 Bachelor of Science or higher degree in a technical discipline preferred, not required.

 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $261,000 — $346,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril’s Maritime Manufacturing Technology Team is responsible for rapidly developing and implementing manufacturing technologies, processes, and materials for cutting-edge defense hardware. The team is developing deployable static and moving surface, undersea and sea to air vehicles, and scaling these products in our new manufacturing facilities.



 ABOUT THE JOB

 We are seeking a Head of Production to join our team in Santa Ana, CA to stand up a cutting-edge manufacturing site. This role is crucial in ensuring that each initiative aligns with the company's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's success. You will build and lead the product line organization from scratch, establishing and managing manufacturing processes, quality systems, and the infrastructure needed to scale from prototype builds through full-rate production.

 As a leader in the Maritime Division, you must bear the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. Your spectrum of support will be exceptionally diverse and require you to rapidly drive aggressive deliverables to completion.

 The ideal candidate will leverage a deep expertise in large-scale manufacturing of a number of large, complex assemblies. You need to have experience in heavy fabrication, be able to lead the complex integration of different structures, and have a background spanning structural fabrication, joining and assembly across a variety of metals, alloys, and exotic materials. You need to have led an organization of hundreds, not dozens, and come from an operation comparable to the scale we are building at Anduril. You are a builder, not a caretaker.



 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 
 Own all production activity: manufacturing and production support.

 Build and lead the production organization, supporting hiring across manufacturing engineering, quality, and operations.

 Establish manufacturing processes and production infrastructure for complex electromechanical vehicles.

 Drive NPI and the manufacturing development lifecycle: Concept, Prototype, LRIP, FRP.

 Manage production budgets, schedules, and on-time delivery performance.

 Own production readiness reviews and design from the production system including production engineering.

 Coordinate with supply chain including demand planning, procurement, and warehouse operations.

role.title: Senior Manager,  Manufacturing Safety Engineering
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM 
Anduril’s Manufacturing Safety Engineering team partners across Anduril’s manufacturing, engineering, and operations organizations to ensure our production systems are safe to build, test, and sustain at scale. As an engineering discipline, we design safety into the way products are made, covering the equipment, fixtures, test stations, and work instructions on the factory floor, rather than inspecting for it after the fact. Our mandate spans the production lifecycle, from new equipment and line design through ramp and sustained operations. We apply formal risk assessment and the hierarchy of controls to identify hazards early and engineer them out, partnering closely with our Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) experts, controls and manufacturing engineers, and production leadership to keep our people safe while moving at the speed Anduril demands.

 ABOUT THE JOB 
We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Safety Engineering leader to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA to stand up and scale manufacturing safety as an engineering discipline across Anduril. This is a build role: you will create the manufacturing-safety-engineering team, define the risk-assessment framework and processes that keep our production equipment, fixtures, test stations, and work instructions safe, and drive adoption of those practices across Anduril’s manufacturing sites. As a Manufacturing Safety leader, you will apply deep expertise in machine safety, formal risk assessment, and the hierarchy of controls to engineer hazards out of how our products are built, partnering closely with EHS, manufacturing and controls engineering, and production leadership. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can set strategy and standards while remaining the senior authority on the hardest hazard problems on the floor.
This role is based in Costa Mesa, CA, and supports Anduril’s manufacturing operations, including sites at Quonset Point, RI and Atlanta, GA; travel to production sites is expected.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 
 Build, lead, and develop the Manufacturing Safety Engineering team, including hiring, leveling, mentoring, and performance management, as the discipline scales across Anduril.

 Establish and standardize the manufacturing-safety framework: risk-assessment methodology, templates, risk-acceptance criteria, safety sign-off gates, and the management-of-change process, aligned to the business.

 Grow the manufacturing-safety discipline across Anduril, driving adoption across production lines and sites and defining the standards of record, in partnership with Manufacturing, EHS, and product engineering.

 Define and communicate the discipline’s vision, goals, roadmap, and operating model, and integrate manufacturing-safety practices across all stages of production development.

 Own manufacturing-safety metrics, KPIs, and executive-level reporting; represent the discipline to leadership and to customer and defense-program stakeholders.

 Manage resource allocation and capacity planning across concurrent programs and sites, and manage budget, tooling, and external partnerships (EHS, controls integrators, certification bodies).

 Serve as the senior technical authority and final risk-acceptance escalation point for the highest-consequence manufacturing hazards.

 Lead formal machine and task-based risk assessments on production equipment, fixtures, tooling, and processes, documenting hazards, risk ratings, required controls, and residual risk.

 Review manufacturing work instructions and supporting training material for safety adequacy; author Job Hazard Analyses (JHA) and embed the required controls, PPE, and safe-work steps.

 Engineer and review production equipment such as lift fixtures and material-handling aids in partnership with EHS, and support proof-load testing.

 Assess and design safety into production test equipment.

 Apply the hierarchy of controls and prevention-through-design principles to eliminate or reduce hazards at the equipment and line-design stage.

 Define functional-safety requirements for safety-related control systems and verify their implementation.

 Partner with EHS to ensure engineering controls satisfy applicable OSHA 29 CFR 1910 general-industry requirements (machine guarding, lockout/tagout, electrical, PPE, materials handling).

 Support incident and near-miss investigations and root-cause analysis; drive corrective engineering actions and management of change.

 Proven track record building, scaling, and managing technical teams and establishing engineering processes or disciplines

 Deep expertise in formal machine and task-based risk assessment and machine safeguarding, applied across equipment, fixtures, and processes

 Strong working knowledge of applicable OSHA 29 CFR 1910 general-industry requirements (machine guarding, lockout/tagout, electrical, PPE, materials handling) as engineering controls

 Experience partnering with EHS, manufacturing, and design organizations to embed safety into equipment and production processes

 Strategic thinking with the ability to balance hands-on technical authority with organizational leadership responsibilities

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functionally at all levels

 Eligibility to pursue and maintain a U.S. security clearance, as required

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Familiarity with machine safety standards such as ISO 12100 (risk assessment and risk reduction), ISO 13849 (safety-related parts of control systems), and ANSI B11 (machine safety and safeguarding)

 Experience managing teams and programs across multiple manufacturing sites, and through periods of rapid growth (2x+ expansion)

 Track record of developing talent and promoting team members into senior and leadership roles

 Experience in high-rate or rapidly scaling aerospace, defense, or automotive manufacturing

 Executive-level communications, reporting, and roadmap presentation experience

 Active U.S. security clearance

 Strong analytical skills: labor modeling, budget analysis, and cost-per-unit tracking.

 Excellent communication and coaching skills across all levels — shop floor to site leadership.

role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Mechanical Actuation Systems  

 Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 SUMMARY - ABOUT THE TEAM / JOB 
Anduril’s Manufacturing team seeks a Staff Manufacturing Engineer. The Core Tech Manufacturing Team rapidly iterates and builds cutting-edge defense hardware, specializing in advanced mechanical actuators and motion control systems for Anduril’s sea and air vehicle platforms. This role encompasses the full manufacturing value-chain: Design for Manufacturability (DFM), specialized tooling, process optimization for precision mechanical and electromechanical assembly, vendor management, quality planning, and comprehensive documentation for high-reliability hardware.

Ideal candidates demonstrate holistic ownership in solving complex technical challenges with creative, physical solutions, personally manufactured or overseen, within fast-paced, resource-limited settings.

As Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Mechanical Actuation Systems, you will strategically drive the end-to-end manufacturing development and production of high-performance mechanical actuators, providing expert technical guidance and strategic insight to ensure robust operation and reliability in challenging sea and air vehicle environments. This role requires exceptional technical expertise and strategic problem-solving skills in DFM for complex mechanical and electromechanical systems, advanced precision assembly techniques, and rigorous test development for critical motion control components. If you are a hands-on technical expert who thrives on solving the toughest engineering challenges, delivering innovative manufacturing solutions, and elevating technical standards across the organization, then this role is for you.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 
 Serve as a primary technical driver for NPI initiatives, transitioning precision mechanical actuators and electromechanical systems from prototype to scalable production, architecting solutions for manufacturability, performance, and supply chain robustness.

 Act as the principal manufacturing interface with Design Engineering, providing critical and influential feedback for Design For Manufacturability and Assembly (DFM/DFA) specifically for actuator components and integrated systems.

 Architect, design, and oversee implementation of novel tooling, jigs, and fixturing for precision actuator assembly, alignment, and testing, setting best practices.

 Establish and continuously optimize robust, repeatable process flows for complex actuator assemblies, encompassing intricate operations like bearing installation, gear train assembly, sensor integration, and sealing, setting benchmarks for manufacturing excellence.

 Strategically define, implement, and optimize Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOM) and Routings within MES and ERP systems, specifically for actuator sub-assemblies and final product builds.

 Drive the development and standardization of comprehensive manufacturing documentation, including detailed work instructions, quality control plans, inspection requirements, and environmental test procedures for high-reliability actuators.

 Design, validate, and strategically implement robust test methodologies and equipment for critical actuator performance characteristics (e.g., torque, speed, precision) and environmental qualification (e.g., vibration, thermal, ingress protection).

 Provide deep hands-on technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and technicians during prototype builds, troubleshooting, and production validation of actuator hardware, fostering technical excellence.

 
 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.

 12+ years of progressive manufacturing or design engineering experience, specifically with precision mechanical components, electromechanical hardware, or motion control systems.

 Proven track record of driving significant technical initiatives, providing expert guidance, and mentoring engineers.

 Demonstrated expertise in delivering complex electromechanical hardware (actuators, robotics) in fast-paced, resource-constrained environments.

 Deep expertise in establishing and optimizing manufacturing environments, including MBOM creation, MES integration, and Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) for actuator production.

 Proficient with Siemens NX for CAD and Teamcenter for PLM software.

 Hands-on experience physically manufacturing hardware (e.g., precision machining, additive manufacturing, electromechanical assembly, fabrication). Personal projects in robotics or control systems a plus.

 Strong interest in manufacturing high-performance defense hardware and a commitment to continuous technical mastery.

 Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Hands-on experience with control systems, servo motors, or high-performance electromechanical components in aerospace, marine, or robotics.

 Experience with harsh environment manufacturing considerations (e.g., sealing, corrosion prevention, vibration isolation, lubrication).

 Familiarity with aerospace (e.g., DO-160, MIL-STD-810) or marine environmental testing and qualification standards.

 Software scripting (e.g., Python, MATLAB) for automation, data analysis, or testbed control.

 Experience with advanced manufacturing processes like precision grinding, gear cutting, or specialized surface treatments for critical components.

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $183,000 — $243,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: VP Production, Connected Warfare
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 
The Vice President, Production, Connected Warfare provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all production activities within Anduril's Connected Warfare organization. Connected Warfare builds the compute, comms, and infrastructure products that modern defense programs rely on a business growing toward multi-billion-dollar scale, producing integrated hardware and software products at real volume. Encompassing production planning, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and manufacturing operations, this role will be responsible for production across multiple business lines and multiple facilities. The VP orchestrates a portfolio of production programs, making resource allocation tradeoffs, and setting the Connected Warfare production strategy. This executive is responsible for driving operational excellence and production efficiency in the near term and building the production capabilities necessary to support Connected Warfare's and the company's long-term business objectives . 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 Establish and provide strategic and operational leadership across multiple production facilities - ensuring consistency in quality, cost, and delivery performance across geographies

 Lead and build the production capabilities of a portfolio of products, balancing investment, capacity, and talent allocation across product lines and production programs

 Partner with R&D, sales, and engineering teams to lead new product introduction efforts across multiple emerging product lines, developing from scratch the production lines and processes necessary to meet our customers’ requirements

 Drive division-level production strategy including facility footprint decisions, make-vs-buy analyses, capital deployment planning, and workforce sizing aligned to multi-year business forecasts. 

 Establish the operational excellence framework and continuous improvement culture across the division, leveraging lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies to reduce costs, improve yields, and increase throughput

 Establish and monitor KPIs across safety, quality, delivery, schedule, and cost to ensure performance targets are met across multiple production sites, including international expansions

 Build and develop a high-performing production organization through talent development and a strong culture of accountability

 Support capital planning, budgeting, and resource allocation for production functions across the division

 Ensure compliance with all regulatory, environmental, health, and safety requirements

 Lead capacity planning and footprint strategy, including evaluation of new facilities and/or manufacturing technologies

 Serve as a member of the division's senior leadership team, contributing to division and corporate strategic planning; represent the production organization in executive, customer, and investor contexts as appropriate

 Collaborate in a matrix environment with strong relationships and influence ability across multiple stakeholders across the business

 Lead workforce and location strategy, including labor market analysis, site selection criteria, and workforce sizing, to support new line stand-ups and geographic expansion

 
 QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred

 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, with at least 7-10 years in a senior or executive role overseeing organizations of 500+ employees; experience in a high- or hyper-growth environment

 Proven track record of leading large, complex manufacturing operations across multiple sites or locations

 Experience managing simultaneous product ramps across multiple facilities and scaling international manufacturing operations required

 Experience across all 5 pillars of production: production planning, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, operations, and quality

 Demonstrated ability to set and scale an operational excellence framework across a division, with deep expertise in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement

 Prior experience managing large budgets in the hundreds of millions of dollars and capital programs

 Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

 Experience in regulated industries (e.g., defense, automotive, aerospace, medical devices) a plus

 Direct P&L ownership in a production environment with demonstrated ability to manage financial performance at division scale

 Executive presence and sophisticated communication skills; proven ability to influence C-suite stakeholders, represent the production function externally, and shape corporate-level strategy

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $252,000 — $382,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: VP Production, Frontier Systems
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 
The Vice President, Production, Anduril Frontier Systems provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all production activities within Anduril's Frontier Systems (AFS) organization. AFS is structured as several business lines across space, intelligence, air, missile, and ground defense. AFS products run on Lattice OS, Anduril's AI-powered command and control operating system. Encompassing production planning, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and manufacturing operations, this role will be responsible for production across a multi-site footprint with facilities spanning Georgia, Mississippi, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Ohio. The VP orchestrates a portfolio of production programs across these business lines and facilities, making resource allocation tradeoffs, setting the AFS production strategy, and owning AFS's production P&L. This executive is responsible for driving operational excellence and production efficiency in the near term and building the production capabilities necessary to support AFS's and the company's long-term business objectives.


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 Establish and provide strategic and operational leadership across multiple production facilities - ensuring consistency in quality, cost, and delivery performance across geographies

 Lead and build the production capabilities of a portfolio of products, balancing investment, capacity, and talent allocation across product lines and production programs

 Partner with R&D, sales, and engineering teams to lead new product introduction efforts across multiple emerging product lines, developing from scratch the production lines and processes necessary to meet our customers’ requirements

 Drive division-level production strategy including facility footprint decisions, make-vs-buy analyses, capital deployment planning, and workforce sizing aligned to multi-year business forecasts. This person owns the division's production P&L

 Establish the operational excellence framework and continuous improvement culture across the division, leveraging lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies to reduce costs, improve yields, and increase throughput

 Establish and monitor KPIs across safety, quality, delivery, schedule, and cost to ensure performance targets are met across multiple production sites, including international expansions

 Build and develop a high-performing production organization through talent development and a strong culture of accountability

 Support capital planning, budgeting, and resource allocation for production functions across the division

 Ensure compliance with all regulatory, environmental, health, and safety requirements

 Lead capacity planning and footprint strategy, including evaluation of new facilities and/or manufacturing technologies

 Serve as a member of the division's senior leadership team, contributing to division and corporate strategic planning; represent the production organization in executive, customer, and investor contexts as appropriate

 Collaborate in a matrix environment with strong relationships and influence ability across multiple stakeholders across the business

 Lead workforce and location strategy, including labor market analysis, site selection criteria, and workforce sizing, to support new line stand-ups and geographic expansion

 
 QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred

 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, with at least 7-10 years in a senior or executive role overseeing organizations of 500+ employees; experience in a high- or hyper-growth environment

 Proven track record of leading large, complex manufacturing operations across multiple sites or locations

 Experience managing simultaneous product ramps across multiple facilities and scaling international manufacturing operations required

 Experience across all 5 pillars of production: production planning, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, operations, and quality

 Demonstrated ability to set and scale an operational excellence framework across a division, with deep expertise in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement

 Prior experience managing large budgets in the hundreds of millions of dollars and capital programs

 Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

 Experience in regulated industries (e.g., defense, automotive, aerospace, medical devices) a plus

 Direct P&L ownership in a production environment with demonstrated ability to manage financial performance at division scale

 Executive presence and sophisticated communication skills; proven ability to influence C-suite stakeholders, represent the production function externally, and shape corporate-level strategy

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $252,000 — $382,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
At **QXO**, our **Branch Managers** are business leaders responsible for driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and talent development across their locations. This role goes far beyond day-to-day branch oversight. Branch Managers own the financial performance of the business, lead teams through growth and transformation, and partner closely with cross-functional leaders to deliver exceptional results for customers, employees, and shareholders. The ideal candidate combines strong business and financial acumen with exceptional leadership capability. They understand how to manage a P&L, optimize operations, build high-performing teams, execute strategic initiatives, and lead effectively through change in a fast-paced environment.

* Lead all aspects of branch performance, including sales, operations, customer service, inventory, safety, and profitability
* Own branch P&L performance and drive sustainable revenue growth, margin expansion, expense management, and return on investment
* Analyze financial, operational, and market performance data to identify opportunities, address risks, and make informed business decisions
* Develop and execute local business strategies aligned with company objectives and growth initiatives
* Build, coach, and develop high-performing teams while creating a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement
* Lead organizational change initiatives and help teams successfully navigate evolving business priorities, systems, and processes
* Partner closely with Sales, HR, EHS, FP&A, Credit, Supply Chain, Operations, and other Centers of Excellence to achieve business objectives
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with customers, vendors, and community stakeholders
* Drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, productivity improvements, inventory optimization, and process standardization
* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational standards
* Identify and develop future leaders through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and talent development initiatives
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer needs to uncover opportunities for growth and market share expansion

**What you'll earn:**

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

**QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. It is the policy of the Company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, protected veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance submitting an application or would like to request an accommodation, please email us at careers@QXO.com to make a request.

QXO, Inc. (NYSE: QXO) is the largest publicly traded distributor of roofing, waterproofing, and related products, and the second largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials in North America. QXO is the fastest growing company in the $800 billion building products distribution industry and plans to become the tech-enabled leader by delivering best-in-class customer satisfaction and outsized returns for its shareholders. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenues within the next decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth.

role.title: Plant manager
role.description:
Job Description

Posting Start Date: 11/17/26

Offer ID: 2814

Unit: HM Clause

**Job Title:** **Plant manager**
================================

Job Location: Modesto, USA

Contract type: Permanent

Job Description:

**Company Introduction**
------------------------

#### ***“WE BUILD TRUST WITH FARMERS AROUND THE WORLD BY SUPPORTING THEM TO SUSTAINABLY IMPROVE THE QUALITY AND FLAVOR OF THEIR PRODUCTION.”***

 

**HM.CLAUSE** is a Business Unit of **Limagrain** , an international agricultural co-operative founded and managed by farmers. **HM.CLAUSE** specializes in the breeding, production, and sale of vegetable seeds. From the world market to the farmer's market, we collaborate with our customers to deliver successful solutions for the agricultural challenges of today and produce the highest quality vegetable seeds for the future. Our global team of experts and state-of-the-art research facilities enable us to work side-by-side with growers to provide the most regionally relevant and reliable vegetable seeds available.

 

*If our mission resonates with your passion, we look forward to your application.*

**Job description**
-------------------

**You will be a great fit if you have experience similar to:**

Manufacturing Leadership
 

* Lead all manufacturing operations to deliver SQCDME objectives.
* Define annual operational priorities, targets and improvement roadmaps.
* Ensure production plans are achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and service.
* Monitor plant performance through KPIs, visual management systems and operational reviews.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives across all manufacturing areas.
* Develop and maintain adequate organizational structures supporting current and future business needs.
* Ensure effective deployment of corporate manufacturing programs and standards.
* Lead crisis management and business continuity activities impacting manufacturing operations.
* Support S&OP execution and capacity planning processes to ensure alignment between demand and manufacturing capability.
* Develop and execute productivity, efficiency and waste reduction programs.

Safety, Quality and Compliance
 

* Ensure all manufacturing activities comply with company standards, local regulations and applicable legal requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture through visible leadership, employee engagement and accountability.
* Ensure completion and continuous improvement of Job Safety Analyses (JSA), risk assessments, safety tours and safety programs.
* Lead investigations related to safety, quality or environmental incidents affecting manufacturing operations.
* Ensure quality systems, procedures, audits and corrective actions are effectively deployed and sustained.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of findings.
* Ensure manufacturing operations comply with all environmental obligations and permit requirements.

People Leadership
 

* Recruit, develop, coach and retain manufacturing talent.
* Conduct performance reviews and succession planning for key positions.
* Lead regular one-on-one meetings with direct reports.
* Foster employee engagement, teamwork, accountability and continuous learning.
* Support implementation of organizational changes and transformation projects.
* Promote company values and leadership principles throughout the organization.

Financial and Asset Management
 

* Prepare, manage and control the manufacturing operating budget.
* Develop and monitor annual OPEX and CAPEX plans.
* Build business cases and investment proposals supporting business growth and operational improvements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of labor, equipment and material resources.
* Drive initiatives focused on productivity, cost optimization and financial performance improvement.
* Monitor departmental spending and ensure compliance with approved budgets.

**Job Description Continued**
-----------------------------

Site Management Responsibilities
 

* Serve as the primary site representative toward regulatory agencies, government authorities and external stakeholders.
* Ensure all site permits, authorizations and regulatory requirements remain compliant and up to date.
* Coordinate site-wide activities between Manufacturing, Laboratory, Administrative functions and Facilities.
* Chair or coordinate the site leadership governance process.
* Ensure proper site infrastructure, facility maintenance and utilities management in partnership with Facilities.
* Lead site emergency preparedness and crisis management processes.
* Ensure security programs and site access controls are maintained and effective.
* Coordinate site safety matters affecting common areas and shared services.
* Promote collaboration and alignment among all site functions to ensure overall site performance and compliance.
* Support sustainability and environmental improvement initiatives across the site.

Communication and Leadership
 

* Lead plant leadership meetings and performance reviews.
* Ensure effective communication of business objectives, priorities and results.
* Maintain strong relationships with corporate functions including Supply Chain, Quality, HR, Finance, EHS, Engineering and Commercial teams.
* Participate actively in regional and global operations forums.
* Provide timely reporting to senior leadership regarding operational performance, risks and opportunities.

**To be considered, you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, Manufacturing, Operations Management or related field.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of manufacturing or industrial operations experience.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and operational budgets.
* Experience with regulatory compliance, environmental management and site governance preferred

**Your benefits and working environment**
-----------------------------------------

**The rewards of working here:** You join an expert team of innovators and creators that collaborate with farmers around the world to sustainably enhance the taste and quality of healthy food. Our goal is to form teams that inspire and learn from each other as they work to elevate our products from seed to table. We recognize our employees as our most valued resource and work to create an atmosphere that is supportive, healthy, and progressive. We promote an environment of wellness and well-being and hybrid schedules when it is appropriate for the position. It is an important and expanding piece of our local and global mission for Diversity & Inclusion programs and support groups in the corporate world.

 

HM.CLAUSE offers a strong compensation and benefits package to its employees:

* Competitive salary
* + This position’s range is **$116,000 - $146,000**

Our total compensation and pay ranges reflect our market pay structures. As such, individual salaries or hourly rates are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: local geographical market conditions, internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as job related skills, education, and experience.

* Comprehensive Benefits Choices
* + Medical, Dental, Vision
* Work/Life Balance
* + 12 Paid Holidays per year
 + +1 Floating Holiday per year
 + Paid shutdown holidays
 + Progressive time off starting at 80-vacation hours
* Company Covered Benefits
* + Company paid Life Insurance, Long and Short-Term Disability
* Wellness Benefits
* + Family EAP, Telehealth and Mental Wellness Services
* Internal Career Progression
* + Learning Environment
 + Promotions from within
 + Paid Annual Training
 + Tuition Reimbursement
* Welcoming Environment
* + Business casual attire; open door policy
* Financial Wellness
* + 401(k) dollar for dollar Employer matching
 + Supplemental Employer Contribution Plan
 + Traditional and Roth (401k) plans options
 + Company Profit sharing in December
* Family Benefits
* + Maternity and Paternity paid time off
 + Low family medical deductibles
 + Family Planning Resources

We are a company with a supportive culture and leadership. We encourage you to be part of our journey to enhance the world’s food supply and support the farmers that grow them.

 

To view all U.S. based privacy rights and how to exercise them, click here: Privacy policy - HM Clause .

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

**The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and fingers to handle and feel. The employee is regularly required to use office equipment and computers. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

 

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

**The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**

 

While performing the duties of this job the employee may be driving cars, trucks, forklifts, or other equipment. This position will be exposed to warehouse and outdoor weather conditions. The employee may need to walk on uneven ground, work near equipment or machinery, work in a dusty environment, and may be exposed to vibration or constant movement. The noise level that is typical of this work environment is loud.

Heartline Staffing is recruiting a Director of Facilities Operations for an on-site leadership opportunity in Towson, Maryland. This position oversees the daily operations, maintenance, regulatory compliance, and long-term infrastructure planning of a complex hospital environment.

* Manage Vendor Relationships And Service Delivery Performance

* Career Development Opportunities
* Tuition Reimbursement

* On-Site In Towson, Maryland
* Hospital Facilities Operations Environment

* Hospital Engineering And Plant Operations Leadership
* Healthcare Regulatory Compliance And Life Safety Programs

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Overview**
The
**Plant Manager**
is a strategic leader entrusted with overseeing all operational activities at our Sauget, IL facility (Greater St. Louis area). Reporting to the business unit President, the Plant Manager will play a critical role in driving safety, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, and frontline obsession. You will also provide exceptional leadership and professional development to the Operations team. The successful candidate will have strong people leadership skills, the ability to easily communicate strategy and direction to all levels of the organization, a demonstrated track record of operational success, and working knowledge of Lean principles. They will constantly strive to exceed customer expectations through excellent customer service levels and customer-first customization.
 
 
Established in 1959 and headquartered in Sauget, IL, Universal Air Filter (UAF) is part of Filtration Group LLC, the world’s leading filtration company. UAF designs and manufactures custom air filters used to protect commercial equipment and electronics enclosures. With exceptional design and application knowledge and understanding of thermal management in complex equipment and cabinets, UAF is a valuable partner for global OEMs serving all types of electronics and industrial machinery end markets. Engineering design support and quick-turn, custom prototypes are provided to engineer prospects and customers operating under ambitious product development cycles. UAF filters are engineered to address the challenges of thermal management, dust contamination, airflow control, fire safety, EMI shielding, and size limitations in crowded electronic enclosures.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Reporting to the business unit President, the Plant Manager will play a critical role in driving safety, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, and frontline obsession. You will also provide exceptional leadership and professional development to the Operations team. The successful candidate will have strong people leadership skills, the ability to easily communicate strategy and direction to all levels of the organization, a demonstrated track record of operational success, and working knowledge of Lean principles. They will constantly strive to exceed customer expectations through excellent customer service levels and customer-first customization.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s of Science in Engineering or similar. Concentration in Mechanical, Civil, Systems, or Chemical Engineering strongly preferred.
* MBA/advanced degree a plus
* 10+ years of Operations experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of experience leading operations and/or supply chain teams, preferably in a batch or custom products environment
* Hands-on experience in implementing and driving sustainable performance
* Pay Salaried ($120,000)
