role.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the development and execution of the Electrical Infrastructure division's manufacturing technology strategy to support growth, operational excellence, and financial performance. This role drives the identification, industrialization, and deployment of advanced manufacturing technologies, including automation, robotics, machine vision, controls, and digital manufacturing systems. Responsibilities include developing multi-year manufacturing roadmaps, leading capital investment planning, establishing engineering and equipment standards, and overseeing high-impact manufacturing initiatives. The Director partners with Operations, Finance, and business leaders to improve safety, quality, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Its comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and datacenter markets makes it a benchmark for customers worldwide.

Bridging power from sources to pathways to touchpoints, Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division combines innovation and quality to provide leading solutions for an evolving energy landscape. Our expertly designed products enable customers to confidently address the complex needs and challenges of electrification, while enhancing everyday experiences like plugging in, switching on, and staying connected. Committed to best-in-class service at every stage, we act as a trusted partner for our customers to ensure each project's success and their continued satisfaction. Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division includes the following brands and product lines: Girtz, Avtron, Power Bus Way, Cablofil, Connectrac, Wiremold and Pass & Seymour.

Legrand, North & Central America offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short-term and long-term disability benefit plans, above-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company's incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit legrand.us.

**At a Glance**

**Legrand**
has an exciting opportunity for a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to join the
**Electrical Infrastructure division.**
This leader identifies, develops, industrializes, and scales manufacturing processes, automation, autonomation, equipment, and digital capabilities that improve safety, quality, service, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering advises, develops, and executes operational business strategies with the VP of Operations and EI division Leadership Team in support of EI growth and financial goals. Those strategies include footprint and capacity expansion, factory roles, insourcing/outsourcing, operating constraints, and growth enablement into a multiyear manufacturing technology roadmap. The role provides technical leadership for significant manufacturing investments, establishes common engineering and equipment standards, and ensures solutions are economically justified, successfully industrialized, and deliver sustained operating and financial results.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering is expected to determine when advanced technology creates differentiated value and when a simpler process, equipment, maintenance, sourcing, or product solution is more appropriate.

This position leads a focused technical organization that works through plant resources, internal partners, equipment suppliers, and qualified integrators.

**What Will You Do?**

**Manufacturing Technology Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear advanced manufacturing roadmap aligned with business strategy, factory roles, product requirements, capacity needs, and footprint plans.
* Evaluate and deploy appropriate manufacturing technologies, including automation, autonomation, robotics, machine vision, controls, advanced tooling, and digital manufacturing systems.
* Identify manufacturing capabilities the division should protect, build, standardize, modernize, source externally, or retire.
* Adapt technology strategies to differences in product complexity, volume, mix, demand stability, and operating model.

**Opportunity Portfolio and Investment Leadership**

* Build and prioritize a network-wide portfolio of advanced manufacturing, automation, and equipment-modernization opportunities.
* Define the operating loss or constraint being addressed, credible alternatives, expected business impact, investment requirement, lifecycle cost, risk, payback, and sustainment requirements.
* Determine when technology creates differentiated value and when process redesign, tooling, equipment refurbishment, maintenance improvement, outsourcing, product redesign, or another solution is more appropriate.
* Serve as the division's technical authority for significant manufacturing technology and equipment investments.
* Support footprint, make-versus-buy, capacity, and capital-allocation decisions with clear technical facts and alternatives.
* Lead the division governance process for manufacturing capital planning and deployment, providing consolidated visibility to investment requirements, approvals, timing, expenditure, implementation risk, and expected benefits.
* Partner with Operations, business General Managers, and Finance to develop and maintain a prioritized multi-year manufacturing plan.
* Monitor the deployment of approved manufacturing investments and escalate material risks involving scope, cost, schedule, technical performance, plant readiness, or benefit realization.

**Technical Industrialization and Standards**

* Establish standards for manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, tooling, data connectivity, safety, maintainability, and industrialization.
* Lead technical reviews of equipment specifications, process concepts, integrator selection, designs, risk assessments, acceptance testing, process capability, documentation, training, and critical spares.
* Ensure new processes incorporate quality at source, error-proofing, equipment reliability, operator safety, cybersecurity, and appropriate performance visibility.
* Establish preferred technology platforms, reusable equipment concepts, and qualified supplier and integrator networks where standardization creates value.

**Deployment and Sustainable Results**

* Lead the technical delivery of selected high-value, high-risk, or highly replicable manufacturing initiatives.
* Define when central AME involvement is required and when plant teams can execute within established standards.
* Establish clear ownership for technical development, plant readiness, commissioning, production ramp, and ongoing sustainment.
* Transfer solutions to plant ownership after safety, capability, reliability, training, documentation, maintenance, and performance requirements have been met.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to verify that operating and financial benefits are achieved and sustained.
* Capture lessons learned and creates replication methods for proven solutions.

**Organization and Capability Development**

* Build and develop a high-performance advanced manufacturing engineering team with the technical depth required to support the division's strategy.
* Define which capabilities should be retained internally and which should be accessed through plants, internal partners, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, or system integrators.
* Establish expectations for supplier and integrator performance, documentation, intellectual property, lifecycle support, and reuse of developed solutions.
* Develop plant technical capability to minimize long-term dependence on central resources or external partners.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Experience:**

* At least 10 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing engineering, automation, process engineering, or industrialization, including five years leading technical teams or multisite programs.
* Demonstrated experience in automation, robotics, autonomation, controls, machine vision, advanced tooling, or manufacturing data systems.
* Experience with equipment specifications, integrator management, design reviews, acceptance testing, commissioning, capability validation, and production handoff.
* Broad manufacturing-process knowledge and experience in both high-mix and higher-volume environments.
* Proven record of turning manufacturing technology investments into sustained operating and financial results.

**Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of capital economics, lifecycle cost, capacity analysis, labor impact, and benefit realization.
* Ability to translate operating losses and business requirements into prioritized technical opportunities.
* Ability to determine when advanced technology is appropriate and when a simpler operational solution will create greater value.
* Ability to translate technical complexity into clear business decisions and influence across a matrixed organization.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Finance, Product Engineering, Quality, EHS, HR, IT, Supply Chain, Lean, and PMO teams.
* Strong supplier, equipment manufacturer, and system-integrator management capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise standardization with legitimate differences across products, processes, plants, and operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical professionals, develop organizational capability, and operate effectively across multiple businesses and manufacturing locations.

role.title: Senior Manager, Additive Manufacturing Operations
role.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.
 
 
Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.
 
 
Purpose
 
 
We are seeking an exceptional, results-driven
**Senior Manager of Additive Manufacturing Operations**
to lead and scale our Factory 1 production organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for driving world-class execution across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development while shaping the future of manufacturing.
 
 
The Additive Manufacturing organization leverages proprietary, state-of-the-art systems and processes to execute metal laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), depowdering, manual and automated support removal, surface finishing, heat treatment, and inspection across multiple factory sites supporting both prototype and high-rate production.
 
 
This role is ideal for an ambitious operations leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and combines strong manufacturing fundamentals with data-driven decision making, automation, and continuous improvement. Beyond delivering daily operational performance, this leader will develop people, build scalable operating systems, and partner with engineering to industrialize new technologies that will define the next generation of manufacturing.
 
 
The ideal candidate is energized by difficult manufacturing challenges, inspires high-performing teams, and is passionate about building organizations capable of delivering exceptional results.
 
 
The Role
 
 
**Operational Leadership**

* Lead Factory 1 additive manufacturing operations to achieve world-class performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and equipment reliability.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing team while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
* Drive disciplined daily management through standard work, visual management, structured problem solving, and operational rigor.
* Optimize manufacturing flow by increasing equipment uptime, eliminating bottlenecks, improving process repeatability, and maximizing production throughput.
* Partner closely with Platform Development, Manufacturing Engineering, and Automation teams to successfully launch new equipment, technologies, and manufacturing capabilities.

**Operational Excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement across all additive manufacturing processes.
* Establish scalable operating systems that improve efficiency, stability, and manufacturing readiness as production grows.
* Utilize manufacturing data, KPIs, and analytics to drive operational decisions and prioritize improvement initiatives.
* Develop meaningful performance dashboards and operating rhythms that enable rapid identification and resolution of production issues.
* Lead initiatives to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), first-pass yield, cycle time, labor productivity, and cost per part.

**Equipment Reliability & Technical Capability**

* Continue developing the in-house Additive Manufacturing Service organization by strengthening technical capability, preventive maintenance programs, troubleshooting processes, and technician training.
* Drive reliability initiatives that maximize printer availability, reduce unplanned downtime, and improve long-term equipment performance.
* Partner with technical teams to identify recurring equipment issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.

**Performance Monitoring & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), work instructions, process controls, and quality standards.
* Monitor key operational metrics and hold teams accountable for achieving business objectives.
* Drive disciplined root cause analysis and corrective actions to eliminate recurring manufacturing issues.
* Develop clear, actionable operational reporting that enables data-driven decision making across the organization.

**Safety, Quality & Financial Management**

* Foster a safety-first culture aligned with Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) standards and best practices.
* Partner with EHS to proactively develop and implement safety initiatives that reduce operational risk.
* Ensure manufacturing processes consistently meet internal quality requirements and applicable industry standards.
* Develop, manage, and execute the Factory 1 Additive Manufacturing operating budget while balancing productivity, cost, and long-term capability investments.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.
* Demonstrated success leading complex manufacturing operations in high-performance production environments.
* Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing technical organizations.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, operational excellence, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience using manufacturing data and operational metrics to drive strategic decision making and measurable business results.
* Proven ability to execute in startup or rapidly scaling manufacturing environments while effectively navigating ambiguity and change.
* Demonstrated success improving operational performance through equipment reliability, process optimization, and organizational development.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Weld Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Leadership experience in metal additive manufacturing or other advanced manufacturing environments.
* Experience with Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) production systems.
* Experience with aerospace manufacturing standards, including AS9100 and NADCAP.
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Theory of Constraints, or similar operational excellence methodologies.
* Experience leading automation, Industry 4.0, MES, or digital manufacturing initiatives.
* Demonstrated success scaling manufacturing organizations through periods of rapid growth.

Pay Range: $156,640 USD - $215,380 USD
 
 
**What We Offer Our Regular, Full-Time Employees:**

* Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
* Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
* Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
* Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
* Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

***Equal Employment Opportunity***
*Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*
*EEO Poster*
*In order to adjust to changes in our business, it may become necessary to add, remove or modify certain duties and responsibilities, or to reassign you to another job position. From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.*
***E-Verify: Right to Work***
*Our company participates in E-Verify. E-Verify is a program that electronically confirms a candidate’s eligibility to work in the United States after completing the Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I-9). The information provided on the Form I-9 is compared to the records contained in the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) databases. This helps employers verify the identity and employment eligibility of newly hired employees.*
*Eligibility to Work Poster (English) | Eligibility to Work Poster (Spanish)*
***Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO)***
*Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO), we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*
***No agencies, no solicitations, and no calls please.***

role.description:
**SUMMARY**

Leads enterprise clinical quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and performance improvement initiatives to improve outcomes, drive operational excellence, and support strategic growth. Partners with clinical and operational leaders to establish quality standards, oversee governance and accreditation activities, implement data-driven improvement strategies, and advance innovative quality solutions that enhance organizational and client success.

**GENERAL HOURS OF WORK:** Monday through Friday (with occasional night and weekend involvement)

 

**REPORTS TO:** Chief Operating Officer

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

*Clinical Quality Leadership*

* Leads accreditation readiness, regulatory compliance, quality reporting, and corrective action planning activities.
* Leads the development and execution of enterprise-wide clinical quality, patient safety, and performance improvement strategies.
* Partners with physician and operational leaders to establish quality goals, drive accountability, and improve clinical outcomes.
* Coordinates and oversees quality improvement initiatives across all clinical programs and service lines.
* Monitors, analyzes, and reports quality performance metrics, benchmarks, and outcome trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Maintains quality policies, procedures, governance structures, and documentation standards.
* Supports clinical governance, risk management, peer review, and professional practice evaluation processes.
* Facilitates physician quality committees and multidisciplinary improvement teams.
* Promotes a culture of continuous improvement, evidence-based practice, and provider accountability for quality outcomes.

*Performance Improvement & Operational Excellence*

* Identifies workflow variation, standardization opportunities, and best practices to improve outcomes and operational performance.
* Implements and sustains process improvement efforts that reduce variation, improve reliability, and enhance patient experience.
* Partners with operational leaders to improve patient experience, clinical performance, and organizational effectiveness.

*Strategic Quality Engagement*

* Develops and executes Avel's enterprise quality and clinical transformation strategy.
* Designs and operationalizes scalable quality improvement services, frameworks, and methodologies for customers.
* Establishes quality and outcomes measurement as key components of Avel's value proposition and market differentiation.
* Serves as a trusted advisor to clients on quality strategy, patient safety, outcome improvement, and regulatory excellence.
* Identifies emerging healthcare quality trends and incorporate best practices and innovation into Avel solutions.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Health Care field required.

* Master's degree in healthcare or business administration preferred
* 10+ years of experience in medical staff office functions, quality, compliance, risk management and performance improvement required.

**ABOUT AVEL eCARE**

Avel eCare is a nationally recognized leader in virtual health, operating one of the most extensive virtual healthcare networks in the world. Based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, Avel partners with more than 650 health systems, rural hospitals, clinics, and facilities to deliver innovative telehealth solutions. Our services span Behavioral Health, Critical Care, Emergency, Hospitalist, Pharmacy, Specialty Clinic, Senior Care, and School Health — impacting nearly two million patients annually.

For three decades, Avel has been at the forefront of healthcare innovation, developing telehealth solutions that reduce costs, save time, and remove barriers to quality care. Join our mission-driven team and help reshape the future of healthcare.

"We transform access to high-quality healthcare for people and communities through integrated virtual solutions."

**VISION**

"Setting the standard for healthcare delivery by creating the nation’s most trusted Virtual Health System, through innovation and partnership."

Founded in 1948, Construction Specialties (CS) is a specialty building products manufacturer. CS provides solutions to building challenges that architects, designers, building owners, facility managers, and contractors face every day. Since inventing the first extruded louver, CS has become a global leader in all our product categories. Our products are a part of some of the most iconic buildings around the world– from the world’s tallest tower, Burj Khalifa in Dubai, to the Oculus at the World Trade Center Transit Hub in Manhattan. role.description:
**About Momentive Technologies**

Momentive Technologies applies advanced materials science to design and manufacture ultra-high-performance quartz materials, quartz crucibles, and ceramic products that are vital to a variety of high-growth end markets, including the silicon and compound semiconductor industries, electronics, and aerospace components. These solutions enable the production of logic and memory chips, power control devices and multiple systems for electric vehicles, integrated circuits, power control devices, data servers, and aerospace applications.

Recognized for the purity, performance, consistency and stability of its products, Momentive Technologies has been delivering innovative solutions for over 130 years and continues to impact emerging trends like electrification, digitalization, renewable energy and artificial intelligence. The Company, headquartered in Strongsville, Ohio, has operations across the globe and serves customers in more than 30 countries. For more information, visit www.momentivetech.com

**Director Global Quality**

The Director, Global Quality is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping and advancing quality strategy across our global organization. Serving as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, this individual will provide insight into quality performance, requirements, risks, and opportunities while driving greater consistency and excellence across operations in the United States, Germany, South Korea, China, and Japan.

This leader will champion continuous improvement, strengthen quality systems and processes, and identify opportunities to enhance both operational performance and customer satisfaction. Equally important, the Director will lead, mentor, and develop quality leaders across the regions, creating an engaged, accountable, and collaborative global Quality organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead the global Quality and QMS strategy, establishing standardized processes, governance, performance expectations, and accountability across global sites and product lines while ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, customer-specific, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish global quality standards and drive QMS harmonization, reducing unnecessary site-to-site variation and deploying common approaches for CAPA, nonconformance, change management, risk management, audits, document control, and management review.
* Lead global quality performance and continuous improvement, using quality trends, COPQ, yield, customer complaints, escapes, and systemic risk to prioritize improvement initiatives, allocate resources, and deliver sustainable improvement in quality and business performance.
* Own the global strategy for supplier and critical material quality, establishing standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, performance management, auditing, corrective action, and development to strengthen supplier capability and reduce risk to product quality and supply continuity.
* Provide leadership for significant customer, supplier, and product quality escalations, ensuring effective containment, root-cause investigation, corrective action, and systemic prevention while protecting customer relationships and business continuity.
* Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Technology, and Commercial leadership to integrate quality requirements and risk management into sourcing decisions, manufacturing strategy, new products, process changes, and capacity expansion.
* Build global quality capability and organizational effectiveness, coaching Quality Leaders, facilitating deployment of best practices across sites and product lines, and strengthening technical competency, problem-solving discipline, training, talent development, and succession planning.
* Monitor emerging customer expectations, industry requirements, technologies, and external quality practices, translating relevant developments into the global quality strategy, QMS, supplier quality approach, and continuous improvement priorities.

**Basic Qualifications**

 

* A minimum of 10 years’ of experience in Quality Assurance or similar Quality role.
* 5+ years Leadership Experience directing a Professional Team, preferably on a global level.
* Strong proficiency in ISO 9001 and AS 9100 quality standards
* Outstanding organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage many projects or programs simultaneously.
* Possess a communication style that builds strong relationships at all levels of the organization and impacts outcomes and decisions.
* Demonstrated strong analytical expertise coupled with effective presentation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
* Possess transformational leadership qualities – ability to engage, inspire, challenge and influence others and without formal authority.
* Experience in working with ERP systems, preferably SAP.
* Strong knowledge of problem solving and analytical tools such as 8-D, RCCA, SPC or similar
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, preferably chemical industry or glass industry

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Prior experience leading a global quality organization
* Expert knowledge of SAP QM functional module
* Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification
* ISO9001 and AS9001 internal auditor or lead auditor certifications

**Travel Requirements:**

* 15-20%

**Total Rewards**

Our **Director Global Quality** will earn a variable compensation including base salary and bonus. Base salary range takes into consideration experience, education, and training. Not to mention all the amazing benefits available for employee selection as well.

**Joining the Momentive team includes:**

* Medical/Prescription Drug Coverage
* Dental Coverage
* Vision Coverage
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Basic and Voluntary Life/AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Program
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Referral Program

Momentive Technologies is not just shaping materials; we're shaping the future. As a leader in the fused quartz, ceramics, and crucibles industry, we pride ourselves on innovation, precision, and excellence. When you join us, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's driving advancements in technology, research, and applications across various sectors. **APPLY NOW!**

**EEO Statement**

We treat all our associates and candidates as equals. We require all associates and managers to do so too and comply with employment laws and regulations. All personnel actions are conducted in the spirit of equal employment. We are committed to recruit, train, promote and retain associates without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

**Accessibility Guidelines**

We are committed to making the on-line application experience easy and accessible to individuals with disabilities. We are constantly making improvements to comply with the spirit of the "Americans with Disabilities Act," and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. If any of the information on the website is not accessible to you due to a disability, please contact us via phone at (440) 878-5739. Please provide the location of the inaccessible information and the format you wish to have the information presented and we will be happy to send it to you, either via your email address or a separate mailing address you provide. If you prefer, you may contact us and we will be happy to assist you with the application process.

role.title: Plant Manager - Louisville
role.description:
**Plant Manager**

**Who we are:** 
Atkore is forging a future where our employees, customers, suppliers, shareholders, and communities are building better together – a future focused on serving the customer and powering and protecting the world.

With a global network of manufacturing and distribution facilities, Atkore is a leading provider of electrical, safety and infrastructure solutions.

 

**Who we are looking for:** 
We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to be based out of Louisville, KY. Reporting to the Vice President Operations, this person will be responsible for directing and managing plant operations for extrusion processing, maintenance, quality, and shipping/receiving. This position will coordinate plant activities through the planning with departmental managers to ensure the total manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a safe, timely and cost-effective manner.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore. Experience in lean manufacturing or business system-based company is a requirement.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide direction, development and leadership for the facility and share best practices with other Plant Managers in running a safe, productive, cost-effective plant
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages and salaries.
* Participate in regular P&L reviews to ensure that budgets are met; develops and implements programs for optimal equipment utilization, equipment maintenance, and labor and material costs
* Control and minimize labor overtime, premium freight and repair expenses.
* Provide leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Maintain existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Manage capital asset maintenance.
* Implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs.
* Provide Safety and Health direction and support to personnel; ensures compliance with OSHA and environmental regulations.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Demonstrate and promote our key Atkore values of Accountability Teamwork, Integrity, Respect, and Excellence, through actions and decisions.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Advanced knowledge and experience of PVC Water pipe extrusion process preferred.
* Ability to implement Lean Manufacturing practices and drive continuous improvement.
* Six Sigma / Project Management experience.
* Excellent written and communications skills
* Computer literate. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proven experience as a mentor/developmental manager for employees
* Available to occasionally work off shift to provide training and facilitate continuous improvement initiatives to all production shifts.
* Ability to work both as a member of a team, a team leader or as an individual contributor.
* Experience managing in a matrixed, mid-to-large organization
* All associates must embrace and foster and environment that supports our core values of Integrity, Respect, Excellence, Teamwork and Accountability.

 

**Within 3 months, you’ll:**

* Complete your Atkore Immersion and training requirements.
* Understand how your job will help deliver Atkore’s strategy.
* Gain an understanding of your team.
* Have developed relationships with the key stakeholders for this role.
* Be well-versed in Atkore’s Business System and the importance of your role to daily operations.

 

**Within 6 months, you’ll:**

* Maintain and be accountable for KPI visual reporting while actively participating in Lean Daily Management activities, including GEMBA walks.
* Create and modify standardized work and ensure consistent application by all team members.
* Hire talent into your organization, coach and manage performance of your team members and compensation management responsibilities for direct reports.
* Identify ways to strengthen the team’s commitment to Atkore’s core values of Accountability, Teamwork, Integrity, Respect and Excellence.

 

**Within 12 months, you’ll:**

* Be managing an efficient plant and team that delivers Atkore’s strategy.
* Have meaningful performance conversations with your direct reports.
* Be able to resolve any issues quickly and safely.

Atkore is a seven-time Great Place to Work© certified company and a three-time Top Workplaces USA award winner! We’re committed to creating an engaged and aligned workforce driven by a collaborative culture. We consistently live the Atkore mission, strategic priorities, and behaviors, consistent with our core values.

**Join our team and align yourself with an industry leader!**

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay for this position is $128,080 - $176,110. Placement in the range depends on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, relevant experience, skills, seniority, performance, shift, travel requirements, and business or organizational needs and may change over time. Other compensation may include, but not limited to, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, commissions, stock, and other incentives.

Benefits available include:

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance
* Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* 401k
* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Any leave required under federal, state, or local law

Benefits are subject to vesting and eligibility requirements.

Applications are being accepted on an ongoing basis.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
The role of the Plant Manager is to coordinate and direct production activity through the manufacturing processes while meeting company production, quality, safety and profitability goals. In addition, the Plant Manager will apply the principles of Lean Manufacturing to direct the workforce in promoting a continuous improvement atmosphere and culture.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES and TASKS**

* Coordinate production activities for hourly employees and related salaried staff insuring all manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a timely and cost effective manner.
* Control and minimize labor overtime.
* Maintain Production Schedules and Quality Standards
* Ensure effective utilization of MRP system throughout process
* Recognize and solve problems affecting production, quality, safety and productivity.
* Apply the tools of Lean Manufacturing .
* Minimize attrition through effective hiring and coaching practices.
* Foster a culture of empowerment so that all levels of employees are engaged in continuous improvement activities.
* Help implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs. Make recommendations for facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.

* Provide direction, development and leadership to production employees through performance management tools.
* Provide effective communication to support the needs of the employees as well as the goals of the organization.
* Actively engage in all Safety initiatives to meet or exceed EH&S goals and plans.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS and EDUCATION**

* BSIE or BSME
* Minimum 8 years in manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures
* Minimum 5 years in supervisors/management position
* Strong background in MRP systems, preferably Microsoft AX that includes expertise with Material Bills, Routings and Work Standards.
* Proven success in large scale process improvement initiatives within manufacturing environment and cross functional teams
* Training in Lean Manufacturing, TPS, and Demand Flow
* Exceptional communication and proven leadership skills

**SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, LICENSES, CERTIFICATIONS, ETC:**

* Competent in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel and Outlook

### **PHYSICAL EFFORT**

* Ability to sit, stand, walk intermittently for 8 hours.
* Ability to work on a PC as required.

role.title: Senior Director of Operations
role.description:
The Senior Director of Operations oversees all aspects of operations and provides leadership to the plant managers across multiple sites in a campus environment. Overall responsibility for Production, Maintenance, Personnel Scheduling, and Safety, as well as associated responsibilities in Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Commercialization and other related areas. The Director of Operations is also responsible for establishing the campus culture, servicing business needs, and the 3-year masterplan that delivers all KPIs of Safety, Quality, Customer Service and Cost control.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee ongoing performance and efficiency of all plant functions through the establishment and monitoring of KPI's that seek to meet and/or exceed corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor plant teams, future leaders, and succession planning by partnering with plant managers and human resources.
* Responsible for strategy development based on customer support, OpEx, return on capital, transformational goals, increasing capacity and throughput and cost discipline.
* Formulates and implements manufacturing programs to maintain and improve the competitive position and profitability of the operations. Set structure and discipline in daily management and utilizing data and KPI's to drive priorities and decisions.
* Sets Fiscal Year and 90-day priorities for the plants.
* Rapidly communicate to Vice President of Operations any significant challenges or failures that may pose a risk to the business.
* Leads the development and implementation of TPM strategies that maximize operational effectiveness/performance while partnering with other divisions to develop actionable plans to improve overall operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to drive continuous improvement in safety, productivity, product quality, customer service, quality of work life, and lowering manufacturing costs.
* Works closely with sales and finance teams to ensure seamless start-ups of new products on-time and at optimized costs.
* Role models ownership, collaboration, and disciplined execution.
* Provides support and guidance in the management of product quality and ensures compliance with quality and sanitation policies, procedures, and systems to include HACCP, GMPs and the management and reduction of consumer complaints.
* Ensures all performance issues are addressed in a timely manner and all employees adhere to company policies and procedures on an ongoing basis.
* Ensure compliance with all FDA, OSHA, local regulatory agencies and auditing requirements.

Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or manufacturing or related field of study.
* Experience with plant transformation including organizational design, facility enhancement and upskilling and development of the workforce. Track record of delivering significant business KPI goals in turnaround opportunities.
* Proven leadership skills to put employees first, ability to remove barriers and promote succession planning
* Directly supervise a team of leaders who supervise leaders.
* Able to simply and effectively communicate complex issues up, down and across the organization.
* High degree of financial acumen is required with the ability to perform plant-level financial analysis.
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer skills including MS Office programs such as Outlook, Word, Excel PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical / problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to empower, motivate and inspire staff.
* Ability to lead change and execute strategic decisions.

**Preferred:**

* MBA preferred, but not required
* TPM, TQM, IWS, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing experience
* Organizational Performance Design capability

**Work Environment:**

* This position works in both office AND manufacturing floor environments.
* Evening and weekend work may be required on an as needed basis
* Travel up to 30%

*Tandem Foods is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

role.title: Director, Operations - CAM - CCM
role.description:
**Company Description**

Carlisle Companies is a leading manufacturer of building envelope products and solutions that make buildings more energy efficient, durable, and sustainable.

We deliver roofing, insulation, waterproofing, and architectural systems for commercial and residential projects using a focus on innovation and continuous improvement to solve today’s challenges.

We’re equally committed to our people, prioritizing safety, inclusion, career growth development, tuition assistance, and excellent benefits.

With manufacturing, engineering, R&D, and corporate functions across North America and globally, Carlisle offers stability, agility, and opportunity in a performance-driven culture. Do meaningful work and shape the future of building solutions; apply today and come grow with us.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary:**

Manage long-term manufacturing strategies and support day-to-day operational activities across the Edge Manufacturing Region within the Carlisle Architectural Metals (CAM) business unit. Ensure all facilities within the assigned region follow manufacturing best practices related to safety, quality, delivery, and cost. Lead teams with mutual trust, respect, and integrity while supporting profitable growth through operational efficiencies, continuous improvement, and cost reduction initiatives.

Facilities currently assigned to the region include Arden, NC, and Waukesha, WI. The scope of responsibility may change over time and is not limited to the facilities listed, as additional locations may be assigned based on evolving business needs.

Work Location: This role is listed as remote; however, it is preferred to be near one of the two Edge sites.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Drive results and regularly review metrics relating to Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost.
* Lead and mentor Plant Managers in achieving business targets and financial metrics.
* Support companies’ Lean initiatives (Carlisle Operating System) - to include Strategic projects, MDI, 5S, TPM, kaizen and best practice sharing amongst plants.
* Collaborate with sales, demand/supply planning, engineering, safety, quality, and other cross functional teams to proactively develop company-wide manufacturing product and service solutions.
* Drive consistency in structure and operational practices across recent acquisitions and as acquisitions of like businesses are made.
* Champion annual efforts to build the CAM operating and capital budgets.
* Responsible for analyzing technology, resource needs, and market demand to plan and assess the feasibility of company projects.
* Ensure facilities are following all OSHA and company required safety programs, policies, and practices, including but not limited to those activities to fully engage all team members.
* Ensure facilities safely follow all environmental rules in compliance with federal, state, and local laws and share best practices across the organization.
* Interview, hire, and facilitate training for additions to the operations leadership team.
* Provide regular performance updates to the senior leadership team.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Partitioner of Lean Manufacturing Concepts and Tools.
* Familiarity with plant processes, machinery, and maintenance, and lean manufacturing tools and concepts.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills including presentation, respectful debate, and meeting facilitation.
* Effective project, people, process, and budget management, hiring a skilled team, setting strategy for a large and diverse team.
* Effective Leadership through setting expectations and holding people accountable through appropriate praise and discipline.
* Ability to quickly gain input, make decisions, and assure alignment.
* Effective verbal and written communications
* Ability to effectively present to large groups.

* Analyze P&L or budget reports to assess business health and identify improvement opportunities.
* Create and maintain relationships with supporting departments, sales groups and various material and equipment suppliers.
* Team oriented and trusted leader.
* Performance Assessment, Feedback and Accountability.

**Education and Experience:**

* Required:
 + Bachelor’s Degree in an Engineering or Technical discipline with strong business focus. Masters preferred.
 + 7+ years of managing plant operations
 - Preferred: Experience with multi-site leadership
 + Strong analytical skills and strong working knowledge of data analysis.
 + Strong transferable knowledge of lean principles and continuous improvement tools.
 + Strong safety orientation and ability to hold team accountable.
 + Proven and effective decision-making skills.
 + Demonstrated ability to plan and manage operational processes for maximum efficiency and productivity.
 + Shown ability to set strategy and lead a large diverse team.
 + Solid communication skills both verbal and written.
 + Experience in integrating acquisitions a plus (but not required)

 **Additional Information**

**Working Conditions:**

* Primarily office-based, with regular exposure to manufacturing and production environments across multiple facilities.
* Standard business hours are Monday through Friday, with flexibility required to support operational and business needs.
* Additional hours, including evenings and weekends, may be necessary based on business demands and operational priorities.
* Approximately 40% travel required to support facility operations, business meetings, training, and other organizational needs.

**Physical Requirements:**

According to ADA regulations, reasonable accommodation will be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Frequency scale:** Occasionally (0–30%) | Frequently (31–60%) | Continuously (61–100%)

**LIFTING OR CARRYING**

* 1–10 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 11–20 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 21–40 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 41–50 LBS —**Occasionally**
* 51 OR MORE LBS — **Occasionally**

**PUSHING OR PULLING:**

* 1–40 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 41–50 LBS — **Occasionally**
* 51 OR MORE LBS — **Occasionally**

**OTHER PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* BENDING OR STOOPING — **Occasionally**
* REACHING ABOVE SHOULDER LEVEL — **Occasionally**

* DRIVING AUTOMATIC EQUIP. VEHICLES — **Occasionally**
* OPERATE MACHINERY OR POWER TOOLS — **Occasionally**
* CLIMBING (LADDERS, STAIRS, ETC.) —**Occasionally**

* WALKING — **Occasionally**
* STANDING — **Occasionally**
* SITTING — **Occasionally**
* WORKING IN EXTREME TEMPERATURES — **Occasionally**

* REPETTIVE MOTION INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO: WRISTS, HANDS AND/OR FINGERS) — **Occasionally**
* VISION — **Occasionally**
* HEARING — **Occasionally**
* DEXTERITY — **Occasionally**
* HAND EYE COORDINATION — **Occasionally**

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Used:**

* Eye protection is required on the production floor.
* Safety toe shoes (steel/composite) on the production floor.
* Other PPE as defined by management.

The employee is expected to comply with all company policies related to data security, confidentiality, and remote work standards.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We endeavor to make this site accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact careers@carlisle.com.

**INFORMATION SECURITY ALERT**

All applicants for careers with Carlisle will be submitted through this site. Carlisle will not extend job offers without prior in-person or visual correspondence and we will not ask you to provide private personal information for a background check prior to extending a job offer. For more information, please review our Privacy policy.

role.title: Precision CNC Operations Director
role.description:
**Own the rhythm of a high-precision machine shop**
---------------------------------------------------

Our client is seeking a seasoned leader to run day-to-day CNC operations in a precision manufacturing environment. You’ll guide a 30-person team of operators and engineers, elevate throughput and first-pass yield, and embed continuous improvement across the floor. Compensation: $120K–$135K.

### **What a typical day looks like**

* Walk the floor, review KPIs, and align the team to production and quality targets.
* Prioritize jobs and resources across multi-axis CNC milling, turning, and grinding centers.
* Coach and develop talent—delegating, mentoring, and building a strong pipeline of leaders.
* Tune workflows, tooling, and setups to reduce changeover time and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Advance CI initiatives using CAD/CAM optimizations and in-process probing strategies.
* Coordinate closely with engineering and quality to resolve issues at root cause.
* Manage inventory and material flow to keep schedules on track with ERP visibility.
* Ensure adherence to ISO 9001 requirements and reinforce a strong safety culture.

### **What you bring**

* Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Proven leadership managing teams in a CNC machining environment.
* Deep CNC expertise across milling, turning, and grinding operations.
* Fluency with ERP systems and modern CAD/CAM toolchains.

If you’re energized by precision, people leadership, and measurable impact, this role gives you the platform to drive results every day.

role.title: Director, Train Systems Operations - New York
role.description:
**Summary:** The Director, Train System Ops- NY is a leadership role responsible for overseeing structural planning 
for train operations and will determine planning initiatives to support strategic goals. The incumbent will 
conduct analysis of methods to improve operational objectives and enhance procedures to deliver more 
effective outcomes. This position is responsible for developing and implementing strategies to optimize 
system performance in partnership with Amtrak management to improve operational efficiency. It will also 
collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to align system operations with business objectives 
and drive continuous improvement initiatives across NJTRO. The Director, Train System Ops- NY 
requires a strong technical foundation, excellent leadership abilities, and the critical skill of effectively 
managing and prioritizing resources.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Act as liaison with Amtrak regarding emergency decisions and ensure quality assurance

measures are being implemented to benefit NJ TRANSIT Rail Operations.

* Analyzes problems, identifying alternative solutions, projecting consequences of proposed actions

in partnership with Amtrak management to minimize the impact to NJ TRANSITs on time 
performance.

* Perform a variety of routine and complex administrative, supervisory, and professional

responsibilities in providing customer focused, real -time public messaging for emergency and 
non-emergency events in coordination with Amtrak.

* Develop and implement long-term and short-term strategic plans for NJ TRANSIT systems,

aligning with the NJ TRANSIT’s Rail Operation’s goals. 

* Prepare and present reports on the on-time performance of the Northeast Corridor (NEC) and NY

Pennsylvania Station operations.

* Coordinate and attend weekly and monthly meetings with Amtrak management to ensure that

track outages do not impact NJT passenger service and ensure NJT services are protected 
during service disruptions on Amtrak territory.

**This Position Supervises:**

* New York (NY) Public Address Announcer
* Senior Manager, Train Operations
* Supervisor, Train Operations

**Education, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree (equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal

education) 

* Ten (10) years progressive managerial experience in rail operations with emphasis on train

movements, traffic control, dispatching, rail operating management of high-density railroad control 
systems.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance manuals,

technical and procedure manuals, ordinances and policies, laws, rules and regulations. 

* Ability to prepare reports and correspondence, maintain record and complete forms.
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with public safety officials,
* employees, supervisors, and the public.

**Working Environment:**

* Office and/or field

**At NJ Transit you will enjoy a competitive salary and excellent benefits package:**

* Comprehensive Family Health Insurance – Medical, Prescription, Dental, Vision
* Flexible Spending Account
* Life Insurance
* Paid Leave
* Tuition Assistance
* Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits Plan
* Retirement Plans:

 + 401(a) - Retirement plan with a 6% employer contribution
 + 401(k) - Retirement saving plan with up to an 3% company match
 + 457(b) - Deferred Savings Plan

**NJ TRANSIT is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**Learn more about NJ TRANSIT! Sign up to receive an invitation to our next live information session at** **WWW.NJTRANSIT.COM/BEST**

role.title: Sr Director, Fulfillment and Distribution Center Operations
role.description:
Why Join ADI?

At ADI, our distribution network is much more than a collection of warehouses. It is a critical competitive advantage and one of the primary drivers of our customer experience. As the Senior Director of Distribution Center Operations, you will lead a geographically dispersed network of distribution centers that serves thousands of customers across North America. This role is responsible for ensuring every facility operates safely, efficiently, and consistently while delivering exceptional service levels that support our branches, sales teams, and customers. This is a highly visible leadership position that sits at the intersection of Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and Digital Transformation. You will shape the future of ADI's distribution network through operational excellence, continuous improvement, technology adoption, workforce engagement, and strategic network initiatives. We're looking for a leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces complex operational challenges, and understands that every shipment, every inventory decision, and every associate interaction ultimately impacts the customer experience.

**Job Description**

What You'll Own

* Lead all aspects of distribution center operations across ADI's North American network, ensuring safe, scalable, and customer-focused execution.
* Establish a culture where safety, engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement are foundational expectations.
* Drive network performance across key operational metrics including service levels, productivity, quality, inventory accuracy, fulfillment speed, receiving performance, and cost efficiency.
* Partner closely with Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Merchandising, and Digital Transformation teams to improve customer experience and deliver industry leading service. • Develop and execute strategies that improve operational performance while supporting long-term business growth.
* Lead and develop a team of distribution center leaders, creating a high performance culture built on accountability, talent development, and succession planning.
* Ensure staffing, labor planning, equipment strategies, and capacity models to support current and future business requirements.
* Champion Business Excellence principles across the network while driving sustainable process standardization and continuous improvement programs.
* Lead large-scale operational transformation initiatives, including warehouse management systems, automation, labor optimization, and process redesign projects.
* Partner on network optimization initiatives including facility expansion, consolidation, new site implementation, and network design strategy.
* Drive best-in-class inventory management practices that improve inventory accuracy while supporting customer service and working capital objectives.
* Utilize operational data, analytics, and technology to identify opportunities to improve service, productivity, quality, and cost performance.
* Develop and manage operating budgets, capital investment plans, and long-range operational strategies.
* Build strong relationships with key suppliers, equipment providers, transportation partners, and service organizations that support distribution operations.
* Serve as a senior operational leader during periods of rapid growth, supply disruption, major business initiatives, and peak-volume events.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers receive the right product at the right time with exceptional consistency.
* Distribution centers operate safely while maintaining world-class productivity and quality.
* Inventory accuracy supports both customer satisfaction and strong financial performance.
* Teams are engaged, developed, and empowered to solve problems at the source.
* The network continuously evolves through automation, technology, and process improvement.
* ADI maintains a scalable distribution platform capable of supporting future growth.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 10+ years of progressive distribution, fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain leadership experience.
* Experience leading multi-site distribution operations within a complex, high-volume network.
* Demonstrated success managing large teams through multiple layers of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory management, labor planning, transportation, and fulfillment processes.
* Experience driving significant operational improvements across productivity, service, quality, safety, and cost metrics.
* Experience leading large-scale change initiatives including WMS implementations, network transformations, automation projects, or facility start-ups.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing operating budgets, labor plans, and capital investments.
* Proven ability to build cross-functional partnerships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Willingness to travel regularly throughout the distribution network.

**WE VALUE**

* Experience in change management and creating buy-in.
* Enjoyment from being collaborative and hands-on; comfortable balancing tactical execution with strategic initiatives.
* A leadership style with continuous improvement at its core.
* A history of thriving in a fast-paced and often ambiguous environment.
* A self-starter personality who maps their own direction to succeed.

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Be a part of the #1 Global Distribution Team
* Leverage your expertise to build and improve ADI's culture and processes.
* Benefits Day 1, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
Job description:

Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Operations Manager to lead and optimize daily store operations, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers and a motivating environment for team members. This role requires a proactive leader with strong management skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for retail excellence. As an Operations Manager, you will oversee all aspects of store functions, from sales and customer service to inventory control and staff supervision, driving operational efficiency and sales growth.

Duties

* Lead and manage the retail team, including hiring, training, coaching, and developing staff to achieve high performance standards.
* Oversee daily store operations such as cash handling, POS system management, merchandising, stocking, and inventory control to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Implement effective sales strategies by managing pricing, promotions, and product placement to maximize revenue.
* Supervise shift management activities, including scheduling, task delegation, and ensuring excellent customer service at all times.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions, interviews for new hires, and ongoing training to foster a knowledgeable and motivated team.
* Manage purchasing decisions, vendor relations, and inventory replenishment to maintain optimal stock levels while controlling costs.
* Enforce safety protocols, manage payroll processing, bookkeeping tasks, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Utilize management skills to analyze sales data, prepare budgets, monitor expenses, and identify opportunities for operational improvements.

Experience

* Proven managerial experience in retail store management or a similar leadership role within the retail industry.
* Demonstrated success in supervising sales teams with a focus on retail sales management and customer service excellence.
* Strong background in inventory management, POS systems operation, merchandising, and cash handling procedures.
* Experience in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding new employees, and conducting training & development initiatives.
* Knowledge of retail math including pricing strategies, budgeting techniques, and basic financial analysis.
* Bilingual or multilingual skills are highly desirable to effectively communicate with diverse customer bases.
* Previous experience with grocery or wireless sales environments is a plus; familiarity with retail industry standards is essential.

Join us as an Operations Manager to lead with energy and purpose! Your leadership will inspire your team to deliver outstanding customer experiences while driving operational success. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments — if you’re passionate about retail management and ready to make an impact, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

role.title: Operations Director - Healthcare
role.description:
**Operations Director**
=======================

**Lead the Team. Drive Growth. Make an Impact.**
------------------------------------------------

Aveanna Healthcare is seeking an experienced and motivated **Operations Director (OD)** to lead the overall operations, growth, and performance of one of our locations.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys developing teams, and knows how to balance **people, performance, growth, and operational excellence**.

As the Operations Director, you’ll serve as the leader of your branch, partnering closely with clinical, operational, recruiting, and business development teams to ensure we deliver exceptional care while meeting growth and financial goals.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead & Develop Your Team**

* Lead, coach, and support a high-performing branch team.
* Recruit and retain qualified staff.
* Establish goals, monitor performance, and complete timely performance evaluations.
* Promote employee development, accountability, and strong communication.
* Partner with area and regional leadership to keep branch priorities aligned with organizational goals.

### **Drive Branch Growth**

* Develop and implement strategies to grow the business and expand patient services.
* Maintain a strong sense of urgency around referrals, admissions, and start-of-care timelines.
* Partner with business development and referral sources to strengthen relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Monitor the referral pipeline and address barriers that could delay patient care.

### **Build Strong Relationships**

* Develop trusted relationships with patients, families, caregivers, referral partners, and community partners.
* Support patient introductions and periodic home visits when needed.
* Follow up on satisfaction surveys and identify opportunities to improve the patient and caregiver experience.
* Serve as an advocate and trusted leader for your branch team.

### **Own Operational & Financial Performance**

* Monitor branch performance, staffing, productivity, revenue, billing, collections, and expenses.
* Review financial statements and operational reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Identify ways to improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary costs, and strengthen branch performance.
* Oversee caregiver staffing and ensure service delivery expectations are consistently met.

### **Maintain Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure the branch operates in accordance with company policies, payor requirements, and applicable state and federal regulations.
* Partner with clinical leadership to address quality concerns and implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Monitor key performance indicators to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Promote a culture centered on accountability, compliance, service excellence, and quality patient care.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Associate degree or equivalent related work experience required.
* 2–3 years of management or leadership experience.
* Strong leadership and staff-development skills.
* Excellent communication, organization, and time-management abilities.
* Ability to make confident decisions and solve problems in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
* Ability to remain professional and composed in challenging situations.
* Must meet all applicable state requirements, including background checks and work authorization requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Healthcare leadership or operations experience.
* Pediatric or home healthcare experience.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* Ability to travel as needed.
* Ability to work in a variety of home and healthcare environments.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries at all times.
* Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English.
* Must meet the physical requirements necessary to perform the essential functions of the position.

**Why This Role?**
------------------

The Operations Director is more than a branch management position. You’ll have the opportunity to **build a strong team, grow the business, strengthen community relationships, and directly influence the quality of care provided to patients and families.**

If you’re a results-driven leader who enjoys developing people, solving problems, and taking ownership of business performance, this could be the next step in your career.

**Vaccination Requirements**
----------------------------

As an employer accepting Medicare and Medicaid funds, employees must comply with applicable health-related requirements in relevant jurisdictions, including required vaccinations and testing, subject to appropriate medical or religious exemptions.

*This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive listing of all duties, responsibilities, or activities required of the position. Responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.*

role.title: Director, Quality Assurance
role.description:
**About Us**
As a global manufacturer of complex aircraft engine components, Pursuit Aerospace is founded on a commitment to relentless, continuous, operational improvement and extraordinary customer service. We pride ourselves on competitive cost structure, exceptional on-time delivery, and industry-leading quality.
 
 
Pursuit Aerospace has cultivated long-term relationships with our customers around the world through respect, teamwork, technology, and trust. We are driven to develop industry leading process innovations and manufacturing techniques on behalf of our customers. Our exceptional quality is driven by a deep investment in and the daily practice of continually improving our people, processes, and products.
 
 
**About The Opportunity**
The Quality Director reports directly to the Vice President of Operations for the division and supports sites within the division. The Quality Director duties include providing onsite support, guidance, leadership, to multiple sites within the division and champions the Company’s culture of quality and is responsible for the design and achievement of goals with respect to quality of products, services and processes for the whole of Pursuit Aerospace. In addition, ensures compliance with all regulations and provides leadership and structure to all aspects of the Quality and Quality Assurance functions across all sites. Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve quality control systems designed to ensure accurate production of aerospace components consistent with established standards, customer specifications. Responsible for leading internal and external audits and ensuring compliance to the Quality Management System. Use Kaizen and single piece flow principles to ensure quality compliance at every process step. In addition to leading Quality at the Machining division level the Director.
 
 
**Location:**
Remote within the U.S, with travel up to 50%, including international
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and/or lead kaizen to continuously improve delivered product quality.
* Support site quality management at sites with any escalations internally or from customers.
* Drive quality to become a proactive internal function, addressing quality at the source.
* Partner closely with Site GMs, Site Quality Managers, and Division Leadership team.
* Mature site problem solving efforts.
* Led efforts to support AS9100 global certification.
* AS9100 Lead auditor training.
* Support escape investigations at sites.
* Formulate, document, and maintain quality control standards and on-going quality control objectives.
* Effectively communicate & present information to all levels of the organization – shop floor, direct reports, and management.
* Use and train in the following quality tools – root cause analysis and problem solving, FMEA, control plans, PPAP, APQP, System audits, SPC.
* Read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Working knowledge and development of quality systems and requirements and how they relate to business (i.e. AS9100, NADCAP).
* Identify and/or lead initiatives to improve Quality system compliance.
* Effective leadership skills and ability to influence department and peers, as well as be a team player.
* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to quality team, and will be responsible for the selection, motivation and oversight of the team for the achievement of the company goals.
* Assure all Quality staff are properly trained with the necessary equipment to yield consistent results.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline
* 10+ years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience including multi-site leadership
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis without sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or who cannot work now on a full-time basis.
* Must be able to perform work subject to ITAR/EAR regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and NADCAP special processes
* Strong command of GD&T advanced metrology tools, and data analytics/SPC tracking inside ERP systems.
* Experience aerospace manufacturing environment
* Background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action
* Experience with developing/documenting procedures.
* Excellent presentation, written, verbal and communication skills with the ability to interact and work with Employees and customers at all levels of the organization.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
* Computer proficiency (Microsoft Excel, Word Outlook, PowerPoint, and internet applications)

**Working Conditions**

* Must be able to have prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to frequently sit, stand and walk.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 pounds.
* Personal protective equipment (e.g., safety glasses and safety shoes) is required on the shop floor
* Occasional weekend and evening work may be required to accommodate priorities, deadlines, and schedules.

**Acknowledgements**
The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.
 
 
**Benefits**
Pursuit Aerospace also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements, among other things.
 
 
Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, skills, experience, and other job-related factors.
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Pursuit Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We adhere to all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
