role.title: Director, Quality Assurance
role.description:
**Director, Quality Assurance**

**Onsite in Warren, NJ**

**Full-Time**

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality Assurance is a leadership role, responsible for all aspects of the Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality for the organization. The Director of Quality Assurance will work with their direct managerial reports, as well as Executive Leadership, to ensure a continued state of compliance while promoting a strong quality culture across the organization for all products, spanning early phase development to commercialization.

This position will be expected to work in a highly collaborative, cross functional team environment, and provide expert knowledge to risk identification/mitigation, strategy and execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality to assure compliance with FDA, EU, ANVISA, TGA and other international GMP requirements for all products manufactured at company (e.g., 21 CFR Part 210 + 211, EU GMP Volume 4 Part 1).
* Provide strategic direction and leadership to ensure effectiveness of Quality Systems (e.g., CAPA, Change Management, Event Management, Supplier Quality, Internal Audit, Document Management, Risk Management, Record Review and Product Disposition, Training, Field Alert/Recall, etc.)
* Will have 6 direct reports.
* Lead and ensure execution of quality strategy for all development and manufacturing activities associated with all products manufactured by company, including external GMP contract manufacture operations or laboratories for drug substance and drug product.
* Primary contact for all inspection interactions with all domestic and ex-US regulatory authorities.
* Provide direction for escalated quality issues as they arise, determining the need for, and structuring communication for, further escalation to the Executive team and/or external parties.
* Lead strategic quality to quality relationships with business partners, suppliers, external CMOs and third-party testing laboratories.
* Ensure the company is upholding to Quality/Technical Agreements with business partners and suppliers.
* Provides input to all functions to ensure clinical trial activities are conducted in compliance with GCP regulations and internal requirements.
* Actively participate in the Site Leadership Team to drive continuous improvement activities and initiatives throughout company
* Analyze, report and present metrics where applicable to show health of system(s).
* Lead GxP inspection strategies across all auditable areas to ensure the company is in an audit-ready status at all times.
* Manage overall coaching, training, development and succession planning for the function.
* Set, manage and monitor budget for Quality Assurance, in conjunction with finance.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in chemistry, engineering, biochemistry, or related science field desirable.
* Minimum 7+ years of related work experience working in a regulated GxP industry in pharmaceutical manufacturing operation setting or service-oriented laboratory.
* Demonstrated ability to direct a function, oversee projects and teams. Minimum of 2 years overseeing direct reports.
* Minimum of 2+ years working in a managerial role with direct reports.
* Strong skillset in problem solving, strategic thinking, critical reasoning and decision making.
* Strong interpersonal skills and verbal/written communication skills.
* Excellent computer skills required (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Visio).
* Strong project management skills, strong organizational skills to maintain a high level of productivity, innovation, and priority-setting to complete assignments on time and on budget.
* Strong business acumen surrounding pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Some travel required.

role.title: Director of Quality Management - Inpatient Rehab
role.description:
**Hospital Name: Ohiohealth Rehabilitation Hospital**
**Joint venture/Partnership/Affiliation with Select Medical**
**Position:**
**Director of Quality Management**
**Location: Dublin, OH**

* Bonus incentives
* Extensive onboarding and training program
* Customizable health insurance packages

**Who We Are**
Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas
 
 
Coordinates the Medical Quality Management and Performance Improvement activities to measurably enhance the quality, process and cost effectiveness of patient and customer services rendered. Coordinates the Performance Improvement and Patient Safety programs in accordance with the guidelines and regulatory requirements of Federal and State regulations on a hospital-wide basis. Oversees operations of the Infection Control and Employee Health Programs. Develops and Reviews policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all regulatory and accrediting standards. Collects data to monitor compliance and/or trends.
 
 

* Institutes and monitors the Hospital’s CQI Processes, utilizing data analysis measuring tools. Oversight/coordination of operations of the Infection Control & Employee Health Program based upon hospital size and configuration.
* Assists with the design and compliance of quality processes/activities in the areas of clinical/medical staff PI for all applicable clinical/medical TJC /CARF/DOH standards. Assists with all assigned activities to assure that the hospital maintains accreditation, certification and licensure. Assumes leadership with the Joint Commission and DOH as well as other regulatory agencies with regard to CQI activities.
* Serves as a resource for all departments within the facility to provide guidance on designing, implementing, analyzing and reporting on Quality Improvement.
* Assists clinical areas in developing criteria, monitoring and reporting mechanisms and action documentation related to the hospital’s CQI program.
* Performs basic chart review activities with appropriate staff for outcome utilization, infection control and medical CQI indicators. Analyzes results of chart review activities with appropriate staff and confers with department staff on any case requiring special attention.
* Prepares analysis of significant PI findings pertaining to adverse drug reactions, drug usage evaluation, medical management of acute transfers and other CQI indicators.

**Minimum Qualifications**

role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
About the job

**JOB TITLE:**
Director of Quality Assurance

**REPORTS TO:**
Senior VP of Operations

**DEPARTMENT:**
Operations

**LOCATION:**
Columbus, OH

**WAGE:**
Salaried, Exempt

**WORK HOURS:**
Full-time, Variable

**TRAVEL:**
Frequent, 40–60%

**Job Summary**

The Director of Quality Assurance is responsible for providing strategic leadership and direction for all quality assurance, quality control, and quality systems functions across Plaskolite’s global operations. This role ensures the company’s products consistently meet or exceed internal standards, customer expectations and applicable regulatory requirements.

The Director of QA oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Plaskolite’s Quality Management System (QMS) to drive standardization, process capability, and operational excellence. This position works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to strengthen quality performance, enhance customer satisfaction, and promote a proactive culture of quality — aligned with the
**“One Plaskolite”**
vision of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

This position requires diligence, the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and a strong commitment to safety, teamwork, and quality—reflecting Plaskolite’s core values of
**Integrity and Improvement.**

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all quality assurance and control activities across Plaskolite’s manufacturing sites and business units.
* Develop and implement the company’s Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with ISO, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and mentor Quality Managers, Supervisors, and Engineers, building a high-performing team that supports operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Facilitate the publishing and communication of company-wide quality objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and metrics to measure and improve performance based on the input of Process Owners.
* Drive standardization of quality systems, processes, and documentation across all facilities to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Serve as the company’s primary liaison with major customers regarding quality performance, audits, and improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service and MFG sites, to address customer-specific quality requirements, audits, and documentation needs.
* Coordinate with manufacturing sites, the resolution of critical quality issues and customer complaints through data-driven root cause analysis (RCA) and effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement teams to ensure suppliers meet Plaskolite’s standards for quality, delivery, and reliability.
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering to integrate quality and reliability requirements into new products, material and manufacturing processes.
* Lead quality review meetings, providing executive-level insights on performance, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Support Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and statistical process control (SPC) methodologies to improve process efficiency and product quality.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative technologies, testing methods, and data analytics tools to enhance quality monitoring and reporting capabilities.
* Manage Corporate Quality budget, staffing, and resource allocation to ensure effective support for operational and strategic objectives.
* Represent the Quality function in cross-functional executive meetings, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Ensure that all quality functions and personnel adhere to company safety policies, environmental regulations, and ethical business practices.
* Build and maintain a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence within the Quality organization.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Operation, or Manufacturing Management, Chemistry, Polymer Science or related technical fields.
* 10–15+ years in quality, manufacturing, or operational excellence roles.
* 5–8+ years managing teams and managers

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Professional Certifications (highly valued, not required):
* ASQ Certified Quality Manager (CQM/OE)
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE)
* Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt
* ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 / ISO 14001 Lead Auditor
* Lean Manufacturing certifications
* Strategic quality planning and deployment
* Risk management and failure mode analysis (FMEA)
* Customer-facing leadership during escalations
* Change management and culture transformation
* Data-driven decision-making
* Effective communication with executives and external stakeholders

**AVAILABLE BENEFITS:**

* Sign-On Bonus
* Health Insurance 401(k) and Employer Contribution
* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Employee discount program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Voluntary Life Insurance

**About Plaskolite**

PLASKOLITE is a global leader in manufacturing of engineering thermoplastics, including Acrylic, Polycarbonate, ABS, Olefin and PETG Sheet, Extruded Profiles and PMMA Polymers. Founded in 1950, by Donald Dunn and family, PLASKOLITE has a reputation for providing the highest quality products in the industry. Our innovative thermoplastic solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including glazing, safety shields, lighting, signs and point-of-purchase displays. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with manufacturing facilities throughout North America and Europe, Plaskolite delivers superior thermoplastic sheet, profiles, and polymers to the world thru long-lasting customer relationships and hands-on customer service.

***PLASKOLITE is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. If requested, the Company will provide reasonable accommodation to otherwise qualified individuals where appropriate to allow the ++individual to perform the essential functions of the job, so long as doing so does not create an undue hardship on the business.***

**Additional Job Application Terms**

This job is part of LinkedIn’s Full-Service Hiring beta program. Eligibility is limited to candidates located in and performing services in the United States, excluding those based in Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, South Carolina, or West Virginia.

We’re committed to making our hiring process as smooth and timely as possible, and we understand that waiting to hear back can add to the anticipation. If you’re a potential fit, our team will reach out within two weeks to progress you to the next stage. If you don’t hear from us in that time, we encourage you to explore other opportunities with our team in the future, and we wish you the very best in your job search.

role.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
 
 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes
 
 
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
 
 
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time
 
 
**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
 
 
Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems is looking for a
**Director Mission Assurance 1**
to lead the Quality and Mission Assurance organization for the Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This leadership role is located in
**Roy, Utah**
. This role requires strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills to lead in a dynamic engineering and production environment. There is significant responsibility and visibility with executive leadership and the broad customer organization.
 
 
**What You'll Get To Do**

* Defines and monitors mission assurance program specifications and processes to ensure mission success of programs.
* Performs or assures quality, risk management, safety, reliability and maintainability of program achievements, subcontractors, and suppliers in accordance with contractual requirements.
* Assesses program performance and risks and determines resources to ensure mission assurance.
* Ensures the on-time delivery of high-quality products and services that meet all contractual requirements and business objectives.
* Drives the continuous improvement of people (to include training & development), products, processes, systems and services through the application of world class manufacturing to include innovative technologies, lean principles, six-sigma projects, and common best practices.
* Develops, maintains, and ensures compliance with mission assurance programs, policies, processes, procedures and that the performance and quality of products/processes conform to established standards, specifications and agency guidelines.
* Provides expertise and guidance in interpreting policies, regulatory and/or governmental regulations, and agency guidelines to assure compliance.
* Provides leadership that fosters an inclusive, motivated and engaged work culture.
* Supports the development phase of programs by assuring engineering products and processes conform to internal and customer requirements.
* Works directly with operating entities such as engineering and manufacturing to ensure that inspections, process control analyses and audits are conducted on a continuing basis to enforce requirements and compliance.
* Ensures the Quality/Mission Assurance, Manufacturing, and Engineering processes are consistent with industry capability maturity models and QMS standards (AS9100).
* Provides direct oversight in all efforts related to factory accountability and foreign object elimination practices.
* Reviews trend metrics and analyze misses in order to implement the appropriate improvements to improve performance.
* Standardizes and facilitate root cause / corrective action efforts to resolve quality issues.

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Defense Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:
 
 

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
* 401k
* Educational Assistance
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
* Paid Time Off
* Health & Wellness Resources
* Employee Discounts

This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.
 
 
**You’ll Bring These Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of related technical experience or a Masters with 8 years of experience
* Demonstrated experience developing, communicating and instituting new processes for an organization
* Experience managing people
* 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance or Mission Assurance specific roles
* 5 years of experience in metric development for process health and performance monitoring large programs/projects
* Leadership experience in both EMD and Production programs
* Active US Government Secret Clearance adjudicated in the last 6 years with ability to obtain SAP and Top-Secret Clearance

**These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have**

* 10 years Executive Leadership experience, preferably within the Aerospace and Defense industry
* NG QMS familiarity
* ISO 9001 and AS9100 familiarity
* MS or MBA degree highly preferred
* Active Top Secret Clearance

Primary Level Salary Range: $182,500.00 - $273,500.00
 
 
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
 
 
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.
 
 
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
 
 
Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

role.title: Vice President Quality Control
role.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice President, Quality Control based in the United States.**
The Vice President, Quality Control will provide strategic leadership for a global laboratory network supporting clinical development and commercial manufacturing programs. Reporting to the Chief Quality Officer, this executive will define and implement an enterprise-wide Quality Control strategy, ensuring scientific excellence, regulatory compliance, reliable data, and timely product release. The role oversees a broad range of laboratory operations across multiple sites and product modalities, while driving standardization, digital transformation, and operational performance. Working closely with senior executives, strategic clients, and regulatory authorities, the successful candidate will influence investment decisions, strengthen inspection readiness, and protect continuity of supply. This is an opportunity to shape a high-performing global organization and make a meaningful contribution to product quality and patient safety.
 
 
Accountabilities
 
 

* Define and execute the global Quality Control strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap across sites, product modalities, and development stages. Establish consistent enterprise standards, governance structures, and decision-making responsibilities while accommodating justified site-specific requirements.
* Provide executive oversight of end-to-end Quality Control operations, including analytical, biochemical, biological, microbiological, raw-material, in-process, release, and stability testing, as well as environmental and utility monitoring. Ensure laboratory capacity, priorities, and execution support program milestones, product disposition, client commitments, and uninterrupted supply.
* Govern the analytical method lifecycle from early development through transfer, qualification, validation, comparability, continued performance verification, and retirement. Ensure testing strategies and specifications evolve appropriately throughout clinical development, process performance qualification, product launch, and commercial supply.
* Establish global expectations for current good manufacturing practice, applicable good laboratory practice principles, data governance and integrity, laboratory investigations, out-of-specification and out-of-trend management, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, change control, and audit readiness. Lead enterprise-level regulatory inspection strategies and responses to critical client audits.
* Drive the global laboratory digital and technology roadmap, including laboratory information management systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, laboratory execution systems, chromatography data systems, automation, advanced analytics, and instrument connectivity. Sponsor validated technology deployment, master-data governance, cybersecurity, and adoption to improve accuracy, efficiency, and cycle times.
* Lead enterprise capacity planning, capital investment prioritization, make-versus-buy decisions, laboratory footprint strategy, and oversight of external testing partners. Align resources and contingency plans with demand forecasts, technology transfers, new product introductions, and network resilience requirements.
* Establish enterprise performance metrics and management reviews covering testing and release timelines, lead times, invalid results, out-of-specification and out-of-trend rates, investigation cycle times, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, stability execution, method performance, cost, and productivity. Promote risk-based decision-making, Lean practices, and cross-site learning.
* Act as the senior Quality Control representative for strategic clients, regulatory authorities, and executive governance. Translate complex technical and compliance risks into clear business implications, negotiate scientifically sound solutions, and ensure commitments are realistic and consistently delivered.
* Build and lead a global organization through senior leaders. Develop organizational capabilities, succession plans, technical career paths, and communities of practice while fostering scientific rigor, transparency, accountability, inclusion, and proactive risk management.
* Lead escalations and coordinated responses to significant Quality Control events, laboratory constraints, data-integrity concerns, assay failures, method or specification issues, and testing disruptions. Make or recommend risk-based decisions regarding testing strategies, product impact, remediation, and continuity of supply.
* Perform additional responsibilities in support of the broader Global Quality strategy and organizational objectives.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 15 years of progressive Quality Control experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) sector; alternatively, a Master's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience.
* At least 10 years of people-management experience, including a minimum of five years leading senior leaders with responsibility for multiple laboratories, sites, or functional areas.
* Demonstrated leadership of Quality Control operations across clinical development and commercial manufacturing, including analytical method transfer, qualification and validation, release and stability testing, microbiology, and environmental and utility monitoring.
* Proven experience managing global regulatory inspections and client audits, as well as complex out-of-specification, out-of-trend, data-integrity, and laboratory-compliance matters.
* Experience overseeing budgets, capital investment portfolios, headcount, laboratory capacity, external testing partners, and enterprise transformation initiatives within a complex, matrixed global organization.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, and client-facing skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and regulatory matters clearly and influence strategic decisions.
* An advanced scientific degree and/or a Master of Business Administration is preferred.
* Global leadership experience within a CDMO supporting biologics, vaccines, advanced therapies, or sterile manufacturing is highly desirable.
* Experience scaling Quality Control capabilities from clinical development through process performance qualification, product launch, and sustained commercial supply is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of relevant regulatory authorities, standards, and guidance, including the US Food and Drug Administration, European Medicines Agency, Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency, and Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency.
* Familiarity with International Council for Harmonisation guidelines Q2, Q5, Q6, Q9, Q10, and Q14; United States Pharmacopeia; European Pharmacopoeia; Japanese Pharmacopoeia; Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations Parts 210, 211, and 11; European Union Good Manufacturing Practice Annexes 1 and 11; and applicable data-integrity expectations.
* Experience implementing global laboratory information management systems and laboratory digitalization and automation initiatives is preferred.
* Professional credentials from the American Society for Quality, along with Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent quality and operational excellence training, are valued.

**Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $272,000–$325,000, with compensation determined by work location and relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.
* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.
* Health Savings Account option with company contributions.
* Industry-leading 401(k) savings plan.
* Insurance coverage and employee assistance programs.
* Wellness incentives designed to support overall health and well-being.
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays.
* A supportive environment that encourages personal and professional development.
* Global scope, with the role supporting sites worldwide. Compensation and benefits are governed by the location designated as the employee's home site.

**How Jobgether Works**
We use an
**AI-powered matching process**
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
 
 
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 
 
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
 
 
**Data Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
 
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

role.title: VP Operations
role.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions.
 
 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence.
 
 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
include, but not limited to the following.
 
 

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave
* Life Insurance, Identity Protection, and more!

Relocation assistance is not available. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.
 
 
Daubert Chemical Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Disability/Veteran.

role.title: Vice President of Quality
role.description:
**Vice President Quality**

**Global Product Distribution Quality**

**The Opportunity**

Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Quality, you will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies to effectively manage all global product distribution quality. In this role, you will lead the global product distribution quality organization and processes, holding quality management accountability for all captive and outsourced distribution centres across every entity worldwide.

This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Distribution Governance:**
 Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
* **Turnaround & Future-State Design:**
 Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
* **FDA & Global Regulatory Execution:**
 Act as the single accountable global executive for all distribution-related regulatory inspections, audit responses, and direct agency communications, including intensive FDA engagement.
* **Quality Systems & Digital Traceability:**
 Direct the IT partnership to optimize warehouse management systems (WMS), end-to-end product traceability, inventory controls, and nonconforming product containment.
* **Enterprise Leadership:**
 Serve as the global subject matter expert for distribution quality and contribute to enterprise-wide quality strategy as a senior member of the Global Corporate Quality leadership team.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Sitting or Recent Med-Tech VP:**
 Minimum 10 years of global organizational leadership at the Vice President level within medical devices, capital equipment, or adjacent life sciences—ready to deliver impact from day one.
* **Post-Manufacturing & 3PL Mastery:**
 Deep operational expertise in commercial, supply chain, and global distribution quality across multi-site networks (upstream supplier quality into manufacturing is out of scope).
* **Proven Remediation Track Record:**
 Demonstrated success leading quality turnarounds, organizational redesigns, and systemic remediation under active FDA scrutiny.
* **Global Trade & Customs Compliance:**
 Hands-on command of international medical device regulations, import/export laws, embargoes, import bans, and regional market-entry barriers.
* **Academic Foundation:**
 Bachelor of Science in a medical or applied science discipline

**What Sets You Apart**

You lead from the front with high energy and a clear appetite for complex turnarounds. You combine sharp analytical rigor with executive presence, enabling you to influence across commercial, supply chain, and regulatory stakeholders while building high-performing global teams.

role.title: Head of Quality Assurance
role.description:
This role offers the chance to grow with a respected Nutraceutical CDMO in a fulltime, Monday to Friday position. You’ll be joining a stable expanding company where quality is a top priority.

**Position Title**

Head of Quality

**Position Purpose and Objectives**

The Head of Quality will re‑energize and elevate the company’s quality organization, ensuring exceptional compliance, product integrity, and operational excellence across all manufacturing activities. This role is responsible for setting the strategic direction for quality systems, leading continuous improvement initiatives, and reinforcing a culture of quality throughout the organization. The successful candidate will initially oversee core quality operations with the opportunity to build and scale a high‑performing Quality team as the business grows.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Lead and strengthen all Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) functions across the nutraceutical contract manufacturing operations.
* Ensure compliance with cGMP, FDA, NSF, and other relevant regulatory and customer requirements.
* Oversee quality systems including document control, CAPA, deviations, change controls, batch record reviews, and audits.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and regulatory readiness.
* Act as the primary quality authority during customer audits, regulatory inspections, and key client interactions.
* Partner cross‑functionally with Production, R&D, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to ensure quality is integrated into all stages of product development and manufacturing.
* Champion a strong quality culture and develop future team capabilities to meet organizational growth.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required**

* Deep understanding of cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations specific to nutraceutical and dietary supplement manufacturing.
* Proven track record of leading quality systems and regulatory inspections.
* Strong technical expertise in QA/QC processes, risk management, and root‑cause analysis.
* Exceptional communication, leadership, and decision‑making skills.
* Ability to influence, collaborate, and drive high standards across internal teams and external partners.
* Strategic mindset combined with hands‑on execution and problem‑solving abilities.

**Supervisory Responsibility**

Initially leads Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions with the opportunity to expand and structure a broader Quality organization as the company scales.

**Working Conditions**

* Remote‑flexible role with required presence on‑site at U.S. manufacturing facilities.
* Travel required for audits, facility oversight, and key client or regulatory engagements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years of Quality leadership experience within the nutraceutical, dietary supplement or pharmaceutical manufacturing industry.
* Demonstrated success managing quality systems in a cGMP environment.
* Experience interacting with regulatory agencies and leading customer audits.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes and quality requirements.

**Success Factors**

* High standards for compliance, accuracy, and operational excellence.
* Ability to set and enforce strong quality expectations throughout the organization.
* Proactive, strategic, and resourceful in a fast‑growing, constantly evolving manufacturing environment.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

role.title: Director of Manufacturing
role.description:
**About the Opportunity**

CoreWise is partnering with a growing industrial equipment manufacturer to identify a
**Director of Manufacturing**
who can lead its manufacturing operations through the next phase of growth.

Our client designs and manufactures complex, engineered-to-order industrial equipment. As production demands increase, the company is looking for an experienced manufacturing leader who can build strong teams, improve operational performance, and establish the processes and structure needed to scale.

This is an opportunity for someone who understands how to grow a manufacturing operation without sacrificing safety, quality, or workmanship.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing, the
**Director of Manufacturing**
will oversee daily manufacturing operations across multiple production departments, with responsibility for production performance, labor efficiency, quality, safety, and workforce development.

We're looking for a leader who is just as comfortable on the manufacturing floor as they are developing operational strategy. Someone who understands how to identify bottlenecks, develop frontline leaders, establish accountability, and translate business objectives into measurable results.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead Manufacturing Operations**

* Oversee daily manufacturing operations, production schedules, capacity planning, and labor utilization to meet production and customer delivery commitments.
* Lead and develop production managers, supervisors, and department leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations and consistent production standards across departments.
* Improve coordination between production teams to maintain workflow and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Plan and implement multi-shift operations as production demands increase.

**Improve Operational Performance**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase throughput, improve labor efficiency, reduce costs, and expand manufacturing capacity.
* Establish and monitor manufacturing KPIs, including production output, labor efficiency, schedule attainment, rework, and on-time delivery.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable solutions.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies to standardize processes and improve performance.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes that support long-term business growth.

**Build and Develop Strong Teams**

* Coach and develop manufacturing managers and supervisors to become effective, independent leaders.
* Establish a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality workmanship.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing, succession planning, and employee development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, and supervisory coverage to meet operational needs.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, attendance, performance, and adherence to company policies.

**Champion Safety and Quality**

* Maintain a safe manufacturing environment in compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and applicable industry standards.
* Partner with Quality and Safety teams to reduce defects, rework, incidents, and operational risks.
* Ensure manufactured products consistently meet engineering specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective actions to prevent recurring production and quality issues.

**Manage Manufacturing Costs and Resources**

* Manage labor costs, overtime, productivity, and resource utilization.
* Partner with Finance and executive leadership on manufacturing budgets, capital expenditures, and cost-control initiatives.
* Evaluate equipment, facility, workforce, and technology needs to support increased production.
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing profitability through process improvements and effective resource allocation.

**Support Business Growth**

* Work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Project Management, Human Resources, and Finance to align manufacturing priorities.
* Address material availability, production readiness, and technical challenges that impact manufacturing performance.
* Support facility expansions, production transitions, and new product introductions.
* Provide executive leadership with regular updates on manufacturing performance, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

* At least 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including a minimum of 5 years in a senior management or director-level role.
* Experience leading large-scale manufacturing operations with multiple production departments, managers, and supervisors.
* A demonstrated track record of improving production output, labor productivity, operational efficiency, and manufacturing performance.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, capacity management, manufacturing cost controls, and operational KPIs.
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement initiatives, and standardized production processes.
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing reporting tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, growing manufacturing environment.
* A bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience in engineered-to-order manufacturing, industrial equipment, HVAC, electrical integration, or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience overseeing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Technical familiarity with mechanical and electrical assembly, fabrication, and equipment testing.
* Experience scaling manufacturing operations during periods of significant growth.
* Experience supporting facility expansions, operational restructuring, or manufacturing transformations.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or related continuous improvement training.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production and on-time delivery targets are consistently met.
* Manufacturing capacity and labor productivity improve.
* Rework, defects, and production inefficiencies decrease.
* Safety standards are upheld throughout the manufacturing operation.
* Production managers and supervisors take ownership of their teams and performance.
* Labor and manufacturing costs are effectively managed as production grows.
* Manufacturing processes are established that support sustainable, long-term growth.

**About CoreWise**

CoreWise is a recruiting and workforce strategy partner that connects talented professionals with growing organizations. We are managing this search on behalf of our client and will work directly with qualified candidates throughout the recruiting process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Our client is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

role.title: Director of Operations | OKC
role.description:
**General Description:**

The Director of Operations is a strategic leader who oversees the entire production lifecycle. This role is responsible for optimizing production schedules to meet customer delivery requirements and maximizing the company’s productive capacity. A key function is process management, which involves constantly analyzing and refining workflows to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance product quality. The director is also crucial to ensure customer satisfaction by guaranteeing that products are delivered on time and meet quality standards. The Director of Operations ensures that all operational components work together seamlessly to achieve business goals.

**Essential Functions:**

* Production & Process Management: Oversee the entire production process, ensuring all production schedules meet customer delivery requirements and maximize the company's productive capacity.
* Blueprint & Specification Interpretation: Read and interpret blueprints, customer purchase orders, and process specifications to guide production activities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal communication, collaborating with the Quality, Production, and Engineering Departments to address Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and ensure accuracy.
* Quality System & Audits: Develop a deep understanding of the company's quality system to effectively participate in customer quality audits and sales visits.
* Customer & Scheduling Coordination: Partner with Customer Service to prioritize jobs and adjust production schedules based on customer urgency.
* Process Improvement: Establish, document, and continuously improve production processes and schedules to meet release dates and enhance overall efficiency.
* Inventory Management: Manage and maintain optimal inventory levels to support production needs without creating excess stock.

**Competencies:**

* Leadership & Team Management: Ability to lead and manage a diverse team, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
* Operational & Technical Expertise: A strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including plating, grinding, and HVOF, with the ability to schedule work across various centers.
* Problem-Solving & Analysis: Skilled in identifying issues, analyzing root causes, and implementing effective solutions to improve operations.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interfacing with internal teams and external customers.
* Organizational & Time Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
* Ethical Conduct: Upholds high ethical standards in all business practices.
* Technical Proficiency: Computer literate with the ability to use standard office software and specialized production systems.

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

**This position is responsible for managing all shop employees, including performance management and assisting with hiring needs.**

**Required Education:**

**5-10 years of experience in production operations, including managing employees, implementing processes, and purchasing. Proven experience in production and process improvement.**

**Experience:**

**A degree in a related field is preferred but not required with sufficient experience.**

**Work Environment:**

**This role operates in both a professional office environment and on the production floor.**

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

·        Mobility and Lifting: This role requires frequent movement and the ability to lift and move objects. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The job may also require occasional sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or crawling.

·        Vision: Specific vision requirements include close vision for reading documents and labels, distance vision, and the ability to distinguish colors, as well as peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. A minimum of 20/20 vision with or without corrective lenses is required.

·        Safety Equipment: The employee must be physically able to safely utilize, and wear required PPE, such as a dust mask, steel-toe footwear, and safety glasses.

·        The role requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:**

**This is a full-time position with an expected work schedule of Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.**

**Travel:**
No travel is expected for this position.

**Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Director of Operations**

The Director of Operations is responsible for directing all aspects of manufacturing, scheduling and maintenance/engineering functions to maximize Company profits and customer satisfaction. The Director of Ops is responsible for achieving the business objectives of the Company within the budgetary, safety and productivity parameters established by the President and CEO.

**Responsibilities**

* Champions customer care in the production plant by interacting with customers and providing technical production support during all stages of the relationship from quotation and job planning to the permanent resolution of customer quality problems.
* In collaboration with the President and CEO, establishes an annual operating and capital budget for the manufacturing, scheduling and maintenance/engineering departments and manages all costs within these budgetary limits.
* In collaboration with the President and CEO, establishes annual improvement goals for manufacturing key measures, utilizing Lean Manufacturing as primary driver to accomplish goals.
* Directly responsible for maximizing profitability and driving cost out of the production and customer service process.
* Directly responsible for operating the plant in a manner that protects the health and safety of all employees, contractors, visitors, etc. and ensures compliance with the environmental laws and regulations interpreted to be applicable by the Safety Director.
* Interacts with customers and provides support during all stages of the relationship from quotation and job planning to resolution of customer quality problems.
* Responsible for supporting positive working relationship with local labor union through in depth understanding of the labor contract, fair and consistent implementation of its terms and respectful and timely response to labor relations issues.
* Completes special projects as assigned by the President and CEO.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in an Engineering, Technical or Business discipline preferred
* 10+ years of progressively more responsible positions in a manufacturing setting including experience in production, customer support, leadership, and supervisory functions
* 3-5+ years of experience within a plant leadership capacity
* Prior experience within a metal casting/foundry; gray/ductile iron preferred

role.title: Director Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing
role.description:
**Build Our Future Together**
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently looking for a Director of Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing to join our Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) team. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats. The Director owns the full filling value stream: materials management; preparation of equipment, format parts, and components; formulation of drug product and placebo; aseptic filling; and lyophilization. The Director also ensures a seamless handoff to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, syringe safety systems and autoinjector assembly, packaging, labeling, and serialization) and oversees facility cleaning and contamination control for the filling suites.
 
 
This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regenerons patients. The Director will work directly with Drug Substance and Finish manufacturing management to ensure production timelines are met and will be a key member of various management teams within IOPS.
 
 
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
 
 
**When & Where**
Location: Rensselaer, NY
 
 
Work model: Monday- Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 
 
**Discover Your Role**
Provides leadership, vision, and management to the Filling team and its supporting functions, and leads all aspects of Filling operations at the facility to manufacture commercial and clinical parenteral medicines according to approved protocols, regulations, and schedules
 
 
Directly oversees aseptic filling of drug product and placebo into vials and syringes, in liquid and lyophilized formats, including stoppering, capping, and crimping
 
 
Directly oversees formulation of bulk drug product and placebo, including solution preparation and sterile filtration
 
 
Directly oversees preparation of equipment, format parts, and components to support aseptic filling, including washing, depyrogenation, sterilization, and setup of filling lines
 
 
Directly oversees lyophilization operations, including loading, cycle execution, and unloading, as well as the management of materials and components required to support filling operations
 
 
Directly oversees cleaning and sanitization of filling suites, including Graded space (Grade AD) and Controlled Non-Classified rooms (iCNC), and supports the site contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulations (media fills)
 
 
Ensures a smooth, timely handoff of filled product to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, assembly, packaging, and labeling) in partnership with the leaders of those areas
 
 
Troubleshoots and resolves issues impeding filling deliverables, including equipment performance, line interventions, and yield; provides technical input to resolve filling and aseptic process challenges
 
 
Partners with department Directors and Project Management to implement new filling processes, including new formats, PFS and vial filling lines, formulation, aseptic filling, and lyophilization
 
 
Manages department metrics and goals, monitors performance to objectives, and drives continuous improvement initiatives essential to meeting patient and business needs
 
 
Leads the annual merit performance review process, builds departmental structure, and develops long-term staffing plans, including aseptic gowning qualification and training programs
 
 
Collaborates with department Directors to support development of the annual budget, and rapidly and accurately communicates issues to department Directors
 
 
Writes, reviews, and/or approves Standard Operating Procedures, specifications, regulatory filings, or other controlled documents as needed
 
 
Executes Quality Management System assignments (CAPA, Deviation, Investigation, Change Control, etc.)
 
 
Participates in the development and maintenance of a safe manufacturing environment and ensures that IOPS safety standards are maintained
 
 
Oversees, supports, and participates in cGMP audits of all filling areas within the facility; maintains site inspection readiness and represents the filling operation during regulatory and client audits
 
 
**This Role Requires**
BS in any of the physical or biological sciences or chemical engineering, with biopharmaceutical/biotech experience in a GMP drug product production facility, including aseptic filling experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experienceDirector: 12+ years of experience
 
 
Senior Director: 15+ years of experience
 
 
Level will be determined based on experience
 
 
Experience overseeing aseptic filling operations in a biologics manufacturing environment, including vial and prefilled syringe filling
 
 
Working knowledge of lyophilization, formulation, and aseptic technique, including barrier and isolator/RABS technologies
 
 
Working knowledge of contamination control, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulation requirements
 
 
**Experience With Multiproduct Biologics Facility Start-up Is Preferred**
Experience interacting with multiple health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)
 
 
Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.
 
 
Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.
 
 
Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed onsite. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about onsite expectations for your role and location.
 
 
As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.
 
 
For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.
 
 
Salary Range (annually)
 
 
$175,700.00 - $292,700.00

role.title: Director, Manufacturing
role.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.
 
 
**Director, Manufacturing**
**Location: Las Vegas, Nevada Reports directly to the Vice President of Manufacturing**
**Responsibilities**

* Strategy: Develop and execute a manufacturing strategy aligned with Hyve's mission and values. Continuously refine and optimize processes for maximum efficiency at the primary location and across other manufacturing sites.
* Customer engagement: Serve as a direct interface with customer business, technical and operations teams.
* Planning and delivery: Build production plans, schedules and budgets that meet demand while maintaining world-class lean manufacturing and quality standards. Ensure on time, cost-effective delivery.
* Quality: Implement and maintain rigorous quality controls throughout the manufacturing process. Align to quality standards and monitor adherence to guarantee product excellence.
* Supply chain: Partner closely with customer and factory planning teams and 3PL teams to ensure reliable continuity of supply that supports production needs.
* Cost management: Control manufacturing costs by finding savings opportunities and managing headcount and budgets effectively.
* Compliance and safety: Stay current on industry regulations, safety standards and environmental requirements. Ensure full compliance with manufacturing operations.
* Continuous improvement: Drive initiatives that improve efficiency, quality and sustainability, apply lean principles and new technologies where they fit.
* Risk management: Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to keep the operation resilient and adaptable.
* People leadership: Lead, develop and retain a multi-level manufacturing organization, building a strong bench of leaders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing, sustaining, or product, process or design engineering. Experience with data infrastructure products, from peripherals through L10 or higher, is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of NPI and manufacturing processes, quality management, and rapid factory transitions and production ramps.
* 10+ years of interaction with customers and internal executives at peer and senior levels.
* Proven record and formal training in team management, leadership and talent development.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong, data-driven problem-solving skills, including DOE, DFMEA and DFx.
* Familiarity with industry-standard manufacturing tools, shop floor control systems (MES) and operational metrics.
* A passion for environmental sustainability and commitment to Hyve's

What’s in it for you
 
 
Benefit Insurance
 
 

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Mental Health Care
* 401K with match
* Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Perks at Work
* LEAP Program
* MyFlexPay

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

role.description:
As a Director Of Operations, you will guide Engineering & Manufacturing operations for an Industrial Manufacturing company. You will set operational direction and coordinate priorities that help the business deliver its manufacturing goals. You will be both a strategic and operational leader who is hands-on with the team and communicates strongly with executives.

**Client Details**

My client is a well-established manufacturer serving highly regulated industries where quality, precision, and operational excellence are critical. The organization has built a strong reputation for engineering innovation and customer service and is investing in continued growth, operational improvements, and long-term scalability.

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for an experienced manufacturing executive to work closely with senior leadership and play a key role in driving business performance. The company offers a collaborative environment where leaders are empowered to make decisions, improve processes, develop teams, and influence company-wide strategy.

**Description**

Reporting directly into the President, you will be responsible for the following:

* Lead all day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safety, quality, delivery, and productivity targets are achieved.
* Promote and strengthen a proactive safety culture across the facility.
* Develop and execute operational strategies that support revenue growth, profitability, and overall business objectives.
* Manage manufacturing, production, inventory, and operational resources to maximize efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Establish, communicate, and monitor KPIs to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Environmental Health & Safety and Human Resources teams to maintain compliance and support organizational objectives.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and 5S initiatives throughout the facility.
* Oversee inventory management and collaborate with finance teams on operational performance initiatives.
* Maintain compliance with quality and industry standards including ISO and AS9100 requirements.
* Interface with customers and represent operational capabilities during key business interactions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop management teams while fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, and collaboration.
* Support major business initiatives, including future facility expansion and relocation efforts.

**Profile**

A successful Director Of Operations should have:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience with direct plant management responsibility.
* Strong background within precision manufacturing, machining, CNC fabrication, or machine shop environments.
* Experience leading operations within aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives; Lean Six Sigma BlackBelt preferred.
* Proven track record of driving operational excellence, productivity improvements, and financial performance.
* Experience leading strategic projects, organizational change, and complex operational initiatives.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems and manufacturing performance management tools.
* Experience supporting facility expansion, consolidation, or relocation projects is highly desirable.

**Job Offer**

* Competitive compensation.
* Comprehensive benefits plan.
* 401K with company match.
* Executive leadership position with direct exposure to senior leadership and company strategy.
* Significant influence over plant operations, business performance, and future growth initiatives.
* Opportunity to lead continuous improvement and operational transformation efforts.
* High-impact role overseeing a complex manufacturing environment serving demanding end markets.
* Strong platform for career advancement within a growing and innovative manufacturing organization.
* Collaborative culture focused on safety, operational excellence, integrity, and leadership development.
* Ability to make meaningful contributions to company growth, profitability, and long-term success.
