role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Position Summary**
The Director of Operations is responsible for leading Hughes-Treitler operations to achieve business objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer satisfaction. This hands-on leadership role provides strategic and day-to-day direction for manufacturing, materials, and operational excellence while ensuring the organization has the talent, capacity, processes, and resources required to support current demand and business growth. The Director establishes operating plans, drives accountability, builds organizational capability, and leads continuous improvement initiatives that improve performance, expand capacity, control costs, and strengthen customer responsiveness.
 
 
**Supervisory Responsibilties**

* The position has direct reports but must be able to work in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Production in support of the departmental objectives.

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop Operations teams to effectively support day-to-day execution, strategic business objectives, customer requirements, and growth plans.
* Establish operating strategies, objectives, budgets, capital requirements, material plans, labor requirements, and organizational priorities aligned with customer and business needs.
* Ensure the organization is structured and staffed with the talent, resources, and capabilities needed to meet customer quality, technical, delivery, and turnaround-time expectations.
* Partner with business leadership to achieve key performance indicators, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, throughput, backlog reduction, customer lead time, productivity, labor utilization, cost, and profitability.
* Lead the development and execution of the site Lean and Operational Excellence roadmap, using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, TPM, SIOP and daily management practices to improve flow, yield, cycle time, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and monitor operating standards, performance metrics, and management routines that drive accountability, timely problem-solving, and sustained results.
* Drive capacity planning and expansion initiatives, including capital equipment, automation, facility, tooling, staffing, and process investments required to support business growth.
* Manage operating expenses and capital investments in accordance with approved budgets; identify and execute cost-reduction and productivity opportunities.
* Ensure effective planning and control of materials, inventory, suppliers, production schedules, and labor resources to support quality, cost, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to resolve operational issues, support new product introductions, strengthen manufacturability, and meet customer requirements.
* Provide leadership for robust root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer performance.
* Participate in the development and execution of the business strategy and translate strategic priorities into actionable operating plans and measurable objectives.
* Support commercial and customer-facing activities, including operational reviews, pricing and capacity analyses, customer visits, and performance presentations.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain operations talent through performance management, career development, succession planning, cross-training, and ongoing capability building.
* Foster a culture of accountability, employee engagement, collaboration, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Author annual performance reviews and develop continuing education and advancement paths for entire department.
* Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools appropriately to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost performance, including identifying suitable use cases and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs.

**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Strong leadership, project management, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations and continuous improvement initiatives in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to establish performance metrics, analyze operating data, prioritize competing demands, and drive accountability for results.
* Proven ability to lead change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build effective work relationships.
* Strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to balance customer requirements with operational, financial, and organizational priorities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a hands-on leadership presence across the operation.
* Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and manufacturing systems; experience with SIOP or related planning processes preferred.
* Demonstrated history of successful change management and implementation of operational excellence improvements.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership and organizational skills and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization from the production floor to the executive office.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed to support business requirements.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or another related technical discipline required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience in a low-volume/high-mix, build-to-order, or engineered-products environment; experience in aerospace, defense, metal-forming, precision machining, brazing, welding, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading salaried and hourly employees.
* Demonstrated experience leading Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and continuous improvement programs with measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience driving operational planning, capital and capacity expansion, production and materials management, cost optimization, organizational improvements, and customer-facing operational reviews.

**Other**

* Due to the nature of Hughes-Treitler's programs and products, applicants must have the legal right to work in the US and additionally must be legally authorized to access export-controlled information and source code.

**Compensation**
Employee Type: Salaried
 
 
Currency: USD
 
 
Salary Minimum: 200,000
 
 
Salary Maximum: 225,000
 
 
Incentive: No
 
 
Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.
 
 
For more information on AMETEK's competitive benefits, please click here.
 
 
AMETEK, Inc. is a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales over $7.5 billion.
 
 
AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers’ most complex challenges. We employ 22,000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility. AMETEK is a component of the S&P 500. Visit https://www.ametek.com/careers for more information.
 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process should call 1 (866) 263-8359.

role.title: Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
**Position Title:**
Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

**Location:**
Milwaukee, WI

**Position Summary:**

*Join a rapidly growing and market leading manufacturer as the Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering. Under the direction of and reporting to the VP of Manufacturing, the Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the Manufacturing Engineering function and is accountable for five connected processes:*

* *Standard documentation and engineering change order (ECO) execution*
* *Manufacturing process and technology development in support of New Product Development (NPD), ensuring new products are designed for scalable, repeatable manufacturing*
* *Core technology capital equipment life cycle strategy, including the multi-year roadmap for acquiring, standardizing, deploying, and retiring manufacturing equipment for forming and finishing*
* *Manufacturing system design (MSD) including layout, line balance, material flow, and cell design*
* *Sustainment engineering in support of the value streams.*

*Core technology and MSD are developed in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing, and sustainment priorities are set with the Director of Manufacturing and the value stream leaders. The role leads the Manufacturing Team and partners with Design Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Maintenance/Continuous Improvement.*

**Responsibilities:**

Engineering Change Order (ECO) Execution & Engineering Process Standards

* Own execution of the engineering change order (ECO) process end to end — intake, cross-functional impact review, approval routing, and implementation and cutover tracking — across fabrication and assembly, delivered through the Manager, NPD & Standard Documentation and the ECO resources reporting to that manager.
* Define and maintain manufacturing engineering process standards (BOM, routing, and work-instruction data integrity; drawing and specification standards; standard work definitions) and ensure they are consistently applied across value streams.
* Partner with Value Stream/Area Managers on the floor to ensure engineering standards are followed and gaps are closed, including standard-work sustainment audits, with sustaining engineers providing technical support through the Sustainment Lead.
* Participate in engineering design reviews; evaluate and approve standards for drawings, routings, specifications, and other manufacturing engineering documents.
* Provide the engineering-standards backbone that CI initiatives draw on when Value Stream/Area Managers and sustaining engineers pursue process improvements.

New Product Manufacturing Process Development

* Serve as the manufacturing engineering technology lead within the SOP-2 stage-gate process for new product programs, with primary focus on Phases P0–P2 (Business Case, Concept Design, Design Verification) — evaluating process technology options, make/buy decisions, and automation feasibility ahead of Beta Build — delivered through the Manager, NPD and the NPD engineers.
* Partner with Design Engineering during concept and design verification to ensure new products are designed for manufacturability (DFM/DFA), influencing product design before it is locked.
* Lead process and technology piloting, proof-of-concept builds, and equipment trials for new products, validating manufacturing feasibility and supporting Beta Build (P3), Production Readiness (P4), launch, and ramp to rate; hand off to sustainment engineering and the Value Stream/Area Manager for ownership after launch.
* Own the manufacturing readiness input to the P2 CapEx approval gate — defining the equipment, tooling, and automation investment required to support each new product launch, and building the business case with Finance.
* Represent Advanced Manufacturing Engineering at QRB/PRB stage-gate reviews, ensuring manufacturing technology risk is surfaced and mitigated early in the program.

Capital Equipment Life Cycle Planning

* Develop and maintain a multi-year capital equipment roadmap for forming and finishing across fabrication and assembly, aligned to the product roadmap, capacity plan, and overall plant strategy, in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing.
* Own the technical scope and justification for Capital Authorization Requests (CARs), partnering with Finance and plant leadership on prioritization, ROI, and total cost of ownership.
* Define an equipment standardization strategy to reduce total cost of ownership, spare-parts complexity, and technician training burden across the equipment fleet.
* Plan equipment replacement, upgrade, and end-of-life timing using Operational Availability (OA) trends, maintenance cost history, and technology obsolescence risk.
* Partner with Maintenance and Continuous Improvement on the Capital Equipment OA dashboards to identify chronically underperforming assets and translate the trend data into replacement, rebuild, or upgrade decisions.
* Direct capital project execution — technology selection, specification, supplier management, factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), installation, and equipment support for lasers, presses, and controls — through the Manager, Core Technology and the forming/finishing engineers, controls engineer, and capital equipment technicians.
* Manage the Manufacturing Engineering department budget, including advanced engineering and capital planning activities and tracking actual capital spend against the annual operating plan (AOP) capital budget; support post-installation return reviews on major capital projects.

Manufacturing System Design (MSD)

* Own factory flow design — layout, line balance, material flow, and cell design — and the standard design methodology used across the value streams, developed in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing.
* Assign MSD leadership to a designated senior forming/finishing engineer under the Manager, Core Technology, and review whether dedicated MSD headcount is warranted once the workload is visible.
* Drive adoption of MSD design standards and measure results in throughput and space and labor productivity.

Sustainment Engineering (Value Stream Support)

* Own sustainment engineering for the three value streams — process stability, yield, scrap, cost-down, problem solving, and repeat-issue closure —sustaining engineers, with a dotted-line relationship to each value stream leader.
* Set sustainment priorities with the Director of Manufacturing and the value stream leaders, and decide the allocation of engineering capacity between project work and reactive support so that project time is protected.

Advanced Manufacturing Technology & Automation

* Evaluate and recommend automation, robotics, and advanced fabrication/joining technology (e.g., laser welding, automated assembly cells) to advance Company’s manufacturing capability.
* Build technology pilots and investment business cases for automation projects, then partner with the responsible Value Stream/Area Manager on implementation and sustaining support once deployed.
* Benchmark Company’s manufacturing technology against industry best practice and maintain awareness of emerging capital equipment technology relevant to the company's product lines.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance

* Lead, coach, and develop the Manufacturing Engineering team providing project management leadership through those leaders and cross-functional project teams; build succession depth for each process.
* Own a single process model across the five processes and its handoff chain — NPD, then MSD, then core technology (installation), then sustainment after launch — with ECO supporting all four; publish decision rights and the handoff model with the VP of Manufacturing, the Director of Manufacturing, and the Director of Continuous Improvement.
* Partner with Product Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance on stage-gate reviews, launches, prioritization, and risk reviews, and represent manufacturing in design decisions (DFM/DFA) and cost targets.
* Support ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 requirements for new equipment qualification and process validation (PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans) on new capital assets and ECOs.
* Follow company manufacturing best practices — Standard Work, Visual Factory, and 5S — when deploying new processes, equipment, and engineering changes.

**Key Performance Measures:**

* ECO cycle time (submission to implementation) and engineering process standards compliance across value streams.
* On-time delivery of manufacturing readiness milestones at each NPD stage gate (P0–P3).
* Operational Availability (OA) trend for newly deployed and recently replaced capital assets.
* Capital plan adherence — actual spend vs. AOP capital budget, and realized ROI on major capital projects.
* Reduction in unplanned downtime and total cost of ownership across the managed equipment portfolio.
* Sustainment results across the value streams - first-pass yield, scrap, cost-down delivered, and repeat issue closure.
* Throughput and space and labor productivity gains from manufacturing system design projects.
* Team health - retention, succession coverage, and engagement.
* Number of automation/technology pilots successfully converted to full production deployment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering (or related field); 12+ years in manufacturing/process engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams with budget responsibility, and demonstrated leadership of capital equipment, automation, and engineering change management.
* Proven experience leading new product introduction from a manufacturing engineering perspective — DFM/DFA, process validation, PPAP — within a stage-gate NPD process.
* Direct experience owning an engineering change order (ECO) process and manufacturing engineering data/process standards (BOM, routing, work instructions).
* Strong background evaluating, specifying, and financially justifying capital equipment investment and managing a capital portfolio (business cases, ROI, total cost of ownership, Operational Availability).
* Familiarity with automation and robotics technology in fabrication or assembly environments; experience with laser cutting, forming, and welding automation a plus.
* Lean manufacturing / continuous improvement experience in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing system design, layout, line balance, cell design, and standard work.

role.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
role.description:
**Job Description**
**At a Glance**
**Legrand**
has an exciting opportunity for a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to join the
**Electrical Infrastructure division.**
This leader identifies, develops, industrializes, and scales manufacturing processes, automation, autonomation, equipment, and digital capabilities that improve safety, quality, service, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.
 
 
The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering advises, develops, and executes operational business strategies with the VP of Operations and EI division Leadership Team in support of EI growth and financial goals. Those strategies include footprint and capacity expansion, factory roles, insourcing/outsourcing, operating constraints, and growth enablement into a multiyear manufacturing technology roadmap. The role provides technical leadership for significant manufacturing investments, establishes common engineering and equipment standards, and ensures solutions are economically justified, successfully industrialized, and deliver sustained operating and financial results.
 
 
The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering is expected to determine when advanced technology creates differentiated value and when a simpler process, equipment, maintenance, sourcing, or product solution is more appropriate.
 
 
This position leads a focused technical organization that works through plant resources, internal partners, equipment suppliers, and qualified integrators.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**What Will You Do?**
**Manufacturing Technology Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear advanced manufacturing roadmap aligned with business strategy, factory roles, product requirements, capacity needs, and footprint plans.
* Evaluate and deploy appropriate manufacturing technologies, including automation, autonomation, robotics, machine vision, controls, advanced tooling, and digital manufacturing systems.
* Identify manufacturing capabilities the division should protect, build, standardize, modernize, source externally, or retire.
* Adapt technology strategies to differences in product complexity, volume, mix, demand stability, and operating model.

**Opportunity Portfolio and Investment Leadership**

* Build and prioritize a network-wide portfolio of advanced manufacturing, automation, and equipment-modernization opportunities.
* Define the operating loss or constraint being addressed, credible alternatives, expected business impact, investment requirement, lifecycle cost, risk, payback, and sustainment requirements.
* Determine when technology creates differentiated value and when process redesign, tooling, equipment refurbishment, maintenance improvement, outsourcing, product redesign, or another solution is more appropriate.
* Serve as the division’s technical authority for significant manufacturing technology and equipment investments.
* Support footprint, make-versus-buy, capacity, and capital-allocation decisions with clear technical facts and alternatives.
* Lead the division governance process for manufacturing capital planning and deployment, providing consolidated visibility to investment requirements, approvals, timing, expenditure, implementation risk, and expected benefits.
* Partner with Operations, business General Managers, and Finance to develop and maintain a prioritized multi-year manufacturing plan.
* Monitor the deployment of approved manufacturing investments and escalate material risks involving scope, cost, schedule, technical performance, plant readiness, or benefit realization.

**Technical Industrialization and Standards**

* Establish standards for manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, tooling, data connectivity, safety, maintainability, and industrialization.
* Lead technical reviews of equipment specifications, process concepts, integrator selection, designs, risk assessments, acceptance testing, process capability, documentation, training, and critical spares.
* Ensure new processes incorporate quality at source, error-proofing, equipment reliability, operator safety, cybersecurity, and appropriate performance visibility.
* Establish preferred technology platforms, reusable equipment concepts, and qualified supplier and integrator networks where standardization creates value.

**Deployment and Sustainable Results**

* Lead the technical delivery of selected high-value, high-risk, or highly replicable manufacturing initiatives.
* Define when central AME involvement is required and when plant teams can execute within established standards.
* Establish clear ownership for technical development, plant readiness, commissioning, production ramp, and ongoing sustainment.
* Transfer solutions to plant ownership after safety, capability, reliability, training, documentation, maintenance, and performance requirements have been met.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to verify that operating and financial benefits are achieved and sustained.
* Capture lessons learned and creates replication methods for proven solutions.

**Organization and Capability Development**

* Build and develop a high-performance advanced manufacturing engineering team with the technical depth required to support the division’s strategy.
* Define which capabilities should be retained internally and which should be accessed through plants, internal partners, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, or system integrators.
* Establish expectations for supplier and integrator performance, documentation, intellectual property, lifecycle support, and reuse of developed solutions.
* Develop plant technical capability to minimize long-term dependence on central resources or external partners.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Experience**

* At least 10 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing engineering, automation, process engineering, or industrialization, including five years leading technical teams or multisite programs.
* Demonstrated experience in automation, robotics, autonomation, controls, machine vision, advanced tooling, or manufacturing data systems.
* Experience with equipment specifications, integrator management, design reviews, acceptance testing, commissioning, capability validation, and production handoff.
* Broad manufacturing-process knowledge and experience in both high-mix and higher-volume environments.
* Proven record of turning manufacturing technology investments into sustained operating and financial results.

**Skills/Knowledge/Abilities**

* Strong understanding of capital economics, lifecycle cost, capacity analysis, labor impact, and benefit realization.
* Ability to translate operating losses and business requirements into prioritized technical opportunities.
* Ability to determine when advanced technology is appropriate and when a simpler operational solution will create greater value.
* Ability to translate technical complexity into clear business decisions and influence across a matrixed organization.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Finance, Product Engineering, Quality, EHS, HR, IT, Supply Chain, Lean, and PMO teams.
* Strong supplier, equipment manufacturer, and system-integrator management capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise standardization with legitimate differences across products, processes, plants, and operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical professionals, develop organizational capability, and operate effectively across multiple businesses and manufacturing locations.

**About Us**
Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Its comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and datacenter markets makes it a benchmark for customers worldwide.
 
 
Bridging power from sources to pathways to touchpoints, Legrand’s Electrical Infrastructure division combines innovation and quality to provide leading solutions for an evolving energy landscape. Our expertly designed products enable customers to confidently address the complex needs and challenges of electrification, while enhancing everyday experiences like plugging in, switching on, and staying connected. Committed to best-in-class service at every stage, we act as a trusted partner for our customers to ensure each project’s success and their continued satisfaction. Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division includes the following brands and product lines: Girtz, Avtron, Power Bus Way, Cablofil, Connectrac, Wiremold and Pass & Seymour.
 
 
Legrand, North & Central America offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short-term and long-term disability benefit plans, above-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company’s incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit legrand.us.

role.title: Chief Engineer, Manufacturing
role.description:
**About Re:Build Manufacturing**

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

We hire builders. If you need a fully scoped plan before you'll move, this isn't the role. We need leaders who turn ambiguity into action, stay close to the work, and build the systems that make scale possible — fast.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. 
*(link to*
The Re:Build Way principles
*)*

**Who We Are Looking For**

We're seeking a Chief Manufacturing Engineer to lead manufacturing engineering across Re:Build's family of companies. As a key member of our Program Leadership team, you'll establish consistent manufacturing practices and process control across our sites, build a manufacturing engineering team that uses AI-based tools as a standard part of its daily work, and set the direction for our manufacturing processes, capabilities, and tools. You'll also bring a manufacturing perspective to program decisions from opportunity evaluation through production launch. The ideal candidate brings deep DFM, process planning, and statistical process control expertise, experience introducing new products into production, and the ability to lead through influence across sites and functions. They apply AI tools in their own work every day and understand both what these tools can do and where engineering judgment still has to lead.

**What You Get to Do**

* Develop and deploy consistent manufacturing methods, Lean practices, and process controls (MSA, SPC, PFMEA, control plans) across Re:Build sites
* Lead the manufacturing engineering function across sites, defining roles and competencies and developing engineers through training and mentoring
* Own the roadmap for manufacturing processes, tools, and software, and lead capability planning, make-buy analysis, and capital equipment investments
* Help our commercial team scope opportunities and estimate cost and schedule, shape early-stage programs, and serve as technical lead on our most significant pursuits
* Establish a standard approach for transitioning newly awarded programs into production
* Use designed experiments to develop robust processes, and lead root cause analysis on significant production issues

**What You Bring to the Team**

A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Industrial Engineering (Master's preferred), with 15+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, product development, and/or design engineering and demonstrated expertise in Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA). Experience introducing new products into production in manufacturing-intensive industries such as aerospace, defense, or industrial equipment, and in establishing standard methods and process controls across multiple sites or product lines. role.title: Senior Manager Manufacturing  Night Shift Operations Performance & Integration
role.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients
 
 
At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.
 
 
Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
 
 
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
 
 
Night Senior Manager Manufacturing Night Operations Performance & Integration (Continuous Improvement)
 
 
What you will do
 
 
Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role the Night Shift Senior Manager of Manufacturing at Amgen is responsible for establishing and sustaining a strong night-shift operating system that provides off-shift operational direction for Commercial Operations and for Project based Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) coverage, ensuring the right cross-functional resources are engaged, issues are escalated and resolved with urgency, and manufacturing performance is actively managed across the shift.
 
 
Partners with Engineering, Automation, QA, Technology, Maintenance, Supply Chain/Warehouse, Capital Projects.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Serve as the senior Manufacturing integration point across night-shift operations during significant operational events.
 
 
Establish and sustain the night-shift Tier structure, operating cadence, escalation model, and performance-management routines.
 
 
Coordinate Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Engineering, Automation, Maintenance, Supply Chain/Warehouse, and other site resources required to maintain safe, compliant, and reliable operations.
 
 
Drive escalation of significant resource constraints, technical barriers, competing priorities, or unresolved operational issues to appropriate site or functional leadership.
 
 
Monitor overall night-shift Manufacturing performance across production lines, including downtime, OEE, schedule attainment, recurring interruptions, escalation effectiveness, and chronic losses.
 
 
Partner with the daytime Manufacturing Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement Senior Manager and MFG process Support Senior Manager to identify, prioritize, and execute improvement opportunities across off-shift, including 5S, visual management, standard work, workplace organization, waste reduction, flow improvement, and training operating discipline.
 
 
Provide coaching and situational leadership to Front Line Managers during complex operational events
 
 
What we expect of you
 
 
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek will possess these qualifications.
 
 
**Basic Qualifications**
Doctorate degree and 2 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Masters degree and 6 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Bachelors degree and 8 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Associates degree and 10 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
High school diploma / GED and 12 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above
 
 
What you can expect of us
 
 
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.
 
 
In Addition To The Base Salary, Amgen Offers a Total Rewards Plan, Based On Eligibility, Comprising Of Health And Welfare Plans For Staff And Eligible Dependents, Financial Plans With Opportunities To Save Towards Retirement Or Other Goals, Work/life Balance, And Career Development Opportunities That May Include
 
 
A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental & vision coverage, and life & disability insurance
 
 
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
 
 
Stock-based long-term incentives
 
 
Award-winning time-off plans
 
 
Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.
 
 
Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.
 
 
careers.amgen.com
 
 
In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
 
 
Sponsorship
 
 
Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.
 
 
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
 
 
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 
 
We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities, consistent with legal requirements. Please contact us to request accommodation.

role.title: Manufacturing Quality Senior Manager
role.description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality builds and leads the quality system supporting Harris' manufacturing network. This role owns quality and certifications across multiple facilities, including the ISO 9001 and ASME (non-nuclear) certification programs, inspection and hold/release, and independent verification of VDC deliverables, so products leave Harris' shops conforming to customer, code, and specification requirements.
 
 
This role builds and leads the plant-level QA/QC team, who will report directly to it. It holds quality stop-work authority and provides independent verification across facilities. The Senior Manager partners with the Harris corporate QA/QC program, applying and extending it to manufacturing, and works with Manufacturing Operations, Engineering and VDC, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, and Safety. The role standardizes quality practices and supports certification of new facilities as the network scales.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities**
**Quality Management System & Certifications**

* Own the manufacturing certification programs, including ISO 9001 and ASME, with documentation, internal audits, and management review.
* Lead certification and recertification for new and existing facilities, including customer and third-party audits.
* Align manufacturing procedures with the Harris corporate QMS manual and manage manufacturing-specific procedures and records.
* Drive consistent quality system implementation across the network.
* Represent Harris in professional and industry organizations.

**Plant QA/QC Leadership & Inspection**

* Build, staff, and lead the plant-level QA/QC team, including roles, hiring, training, and standards.
* Establish and own inspection, verification, and hold/release processes, from receiving through final inspection.
* Define inspection plans and travelers by product and customer requirement.
* Ensure welding procedures and welder qualifications meet code, and manage calibration of inspection equipment.
* Manage third-party inspection firms and their scope, schedule, and results

* Spot-check VDC deliverables, including drawings, models, and BOMs, before they reach the shop, as an independent check on VDC's own QA/QC.
* Audit VDC's QA/QC process and record results, and raise gaps with VDC leadership.
* Track shop-found drawing, model, and BOM issues, and feed trends back to VDC and Engineering.
* Hold deliverables that fail verification until corrected.

* Own the nonconformance (NCR) process, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive actions, including supplier issues.
* Track and report quality metrics, including rework, weld repair, NCR trends, and customer complaints.
* Work with Industrial Engineering and plant leadership to turn quality data into improvements.

* Exercise stop-work authority when product, process, or documentation does not meet requirements, escalating to the SVP as needed.
* Define clear criteria for stop, hold, and release.

* Set quality requirements, inspection and test plans, and documentation for new products and projects at the production readiness gate and manage 3rd party inspection companies.
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier quality, receiving inspection, and material certifications.

* Experience with nuclear quality assurance, ASME boiler and pressure vessel code, or other code-based quality programs.

* Experience with welding, piping, structural, or modular MEP fabrication.
* Certifications such as CWI, ASQ CQE/CQA/CMQ, or Lead Auditor.
* Experience with quality and production tracking systems such as STRATUS.

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**

* The enterprise owner of the manufacturing quality system and certifications.
* The builder and leader of plant-level QA/QC across facilities.
* The authority for inspection, hold/release, and quality stop-work.
* An independent check that protects customers and Harris' reputation as the network scales.

* The owner of plant production or shop-floor output (Manufacturing Operations).

role.description:
**Build Our Future Together**
Regeneron is currently seeking a Senior Manager, Medical Device Quality Assurance (QA) to join our Medical Device QA team. This expanded leadership role will provide QA oversight across two critical functions: Combination Products Sustaining Engineering and Compliance. The position will lead a team of engineers and quality specialists.
 
 
**When & Where**
Location: East Greenbush, New York, United States
 
 
Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 
 
**Discover Your Role**
Manage, mentor, and develop quality engineering and compliance teams
 
 
Standardize, streamline, and improve processes across sustaining and compliance
 
 
Implement digital, data-driven tools for accurate, consistent, and timely reporting
 
 
Lead teams through complex, ambiguous challenges in a pharmaceutical/medical device environment
 
 
Sustaining Engineering Support:Support sustaining engineering programs through risk assessment, design change management, and maintenance of the Design History File and Risk Management File
 
 
Advice and actively participate in Design Reviews associated with combination products
 
 
Provide QA and technical support to quality engineers and project teams during ongoing maintenance of the combination product
 
 
Interact with partners and contract organizations to ensure accurate completion of project milestones, including post-commercialization activities
 
 
Combination Product Support:Act as Management Representative for the combination products QMS; own policies and procedures
 
 
Support regulatory inspections and partner audits for combination products

role.title: Sr Manager, Quality Asset Management AT
role.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com
 
 
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
**Job Function**
Quality
 
 
**Job Sub Function**
Customer/Commercial Quality
 
 
**Job Category**
Professional
 
 
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Malvern, Pennsylvania, United States of America, Raritan, New Jersey, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America
 
 
**Job Description**
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine, a member of Johnson & Johnson's Family of Companies, is recruiting for a
**Sr Manager, Quality Asset Management AT**
within Advanced Therapies.
 
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Asset Management has end-to-end accountability for the quality strategy and quality aspects from Early Development through commercialization in Advanced Therapies products.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Represents Global Quality on the Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) and Value Chain (VCT) Teams. Serves as liaison between VCT and Analytical group. Serves as the single point of Global Quality contact.
* Ensures Quality stage gate deliverables are achieved.
* Quality reviewer/approver of health authority submissions (i.e., IND, IMPD, BLA, NDA, MAA) and associated HA questions on the filings. Approves filings and questions for secondary filings. Support PAI and agency audits for the product(s) assigned.
* Defines and oversees the necessary QA resource for global and local QA of his or her assigned products.
* Leads a comprehensive Quality new product integration team that assures Quality throughout clinical, DS, DP, FF & device: development through launch.
* Leads a comprehensive Quality Sub team that assures Quality throughout clinical, DS, DP, FF & device:

+ Ensures product quality development through product lifecycle.
+ Supports the sites, represents the sites on CMC and VC teams.
+ Supports QA communication/issue resolution with External Manufacturers and Business Partners, as applicable.
+ Ensures patients get the right quality products

* Ensures standard Global Quality processes (new product introduction processes and norms) are used across sites and facilitates communication throughout Global Quality.

+ Manages preparation of the PPQS in advance of Review Board and Executive Management Review.
+ Supports preparation of the criticality analysis per schedule.
+ Ensures complaints are well managed, issues are understood, and addressed as necessary. Participate in product safety management teams to present Product Quality Complaints trends and topics. Coordinates and/or owner of complaints trend signal investigations.
+ Partners with Product Quality Owner (PQO) Value Optimize & Late Stage to complete Transfer of Ownership activities.

* Represents Global Quality on the Value Chain Teams (VCT):

+ Maintains the flow of communications between Global Quality and VCT teams.
+ Brings Quality issues to the VCT and assists with prioritization of projects and with key product decisions.
+ Supports the business continuity process including VCT strategy and BCP projects.
+ Reviews Proactive Product Quality Scans with the VCT and assures appropriate mitigating actions are defined there.
+ Prepare quality sections of Product Strategy and End-to-end Value Chain Mapping.
+ Participate in the F2F VCT meetings on PSR and VCM finalization and project prioritization.
+ Align and interface the JSC Product Strategy with other existing strategies: J&J corporate strategies, commercial strategies, R&D strategies, regulatory strategies, etc.

* Presents project updates to QM for Global Quality alignment:

+ Escalate issues when appropriate. Works with the cross functional/site teams to coordinate and hold Escalation meetings, minutes archival, follow up on actions.
+ Participates and actively engages on IMTs. Supports field/recalls as needed.

* Drives Decision making and Problem Solving:

+ Drives/coordinates decisions and makes decisions on behalf of Global Quality including sites.
+ Gives input to the development of new strategies and implements and deploys strategies. Aids in the creation of product portfolio guidelines on the control strategy for new products which will influence the development strategy and the total quality cost during commercial production. These include decisions for Design for manufacturability, quality by design versus the cost of development, time to market.
+ Aware that quality decisions made at any time during the development of new products can be revisited years later during regulatory inspections and reviews.
+ Provides Quality structure, direction and decision making to the teams (Quality, CMC and VC Team) in situations of medium risk, uncertainty and ambiguity.
+ Expected to bring creative solutions to define a compliant quality strategy with flexibility for business needs and more complex L&A deals, thus providing the best total value to the company.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* A minimum of a bachelor’s degree with a major or concentration in one of the following: Pharmacy, Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a similar technical/scientific degree concentration
* A minimum of 8 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, or biotechnology industry
* Knowledge of cGMP standards, policies and procedures
* Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries through presenting, influencing, negotiation and partnering
* Ability to quickly assimilate new technologies, perform risk assessments and develop action plans
* Flexible hours to accommodate US, EMEA and ASPAC work schedules when necessary, balancing work and personal time is required
* This position may require up to 10% of domestic and international travel as business demands

**Preferred**

* A Master’s degree or other advanced degree
* Knowledge of biotech, vaccine, and/or sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing
* Experience in technology transfer, process development and/or process validation
* In-depth understanding of quality processes/systems (e.g. change control, event handling, CAPA), risk management and manufacturing control strategies
* Experience with developing and responding to quality content of regulatory filings, inspections, and preparedness activities
* Experience in API and Drug Product stability

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.
 
 
Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers , internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.
 
 
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
**The anticipated base pay range for this position is :**
$127,000.00 - $218,500.00
 
 
**Additional Description For Pay Transparency**
Subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees are eligible to participate in the Company’s consolidated retirement plan (pension) and savings plan (401(k)).
 
 
**Benefits**
Subject to the terms of their respective policies and date of hire, employees are eligible for the following time off benefits:
 
 
Vacation –120 hours per calendar year
 
 
Sick time - 40 hours per calendar year; for employees who reside in the State of Colorado –48 hours per calendar year; for employees who reside in the State of Washington –56 hours per calendar year
 
 
Holiday pay, including Floating Holidays –13 days per calendar year
 
 
Work, Personal and Family Time - up to 40 hours per calendar year
 
 
Parental Leave – 480 hours within one year of the birth/adoption/foster care of a child
 
 
Bereavement Leave – 240 hours for an immediate family member: 40 hours for an extended family member per calendar year
 
 
Caregiver Leave – 80 hours in a 52-week rolling period10 days
 
 
Volunteer Leave – 32 hours per calendar year
 
 
Military Spouse Time-Off – 80 hours per calendar year
 
 
For additional general information on Company benefits, please go to: https://www.careers.jnj.com/employee-benefits

role.description:
**Date Posted:**
2026-11-24
 
 
**Country:**
United States of America
 
 
**Location:**
US-NY-ROME-104 ~ 104 Otis St ~ OTIS
 
 
**Position Role Type:**
Onsite
 
 
**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**
U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract.
 
 
**Security Clearance Type:**
None/Not Required
 
 
**Security Clearance Status:**
Not Required
 
 
At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.
 
 
Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
 
 
The OPM & NPI Lead serves as the primary operational leader responsible for the successful execution of both sustaining programs and New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives. This role provides leadership for a team of Operations Product Managers while ensuring operational readiness, production launch success, customer commitment attainment, and portfolio performance. Acting as the operational integrator between General Management, Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and SIOP functions, the OPM & NPI Lead drives execution across the entire product lifecycle. The role ensures new products transition effectively from development into production while maintaining delivery, cost, quality, inventory, and capacity objectives for existing programs.
 
 
Must be willing and able to travel 15% of the time.
 
 
**What You Will Do:**
*Portfolio Leadership*

* Provide operations leadership within Program Management Teams
* Lead and develop a team of Operations Product Managers
* Establish priorities and allocate resources across product portfolios
* Ensure alignment of customer commitments with manufacturing capacity
* Lead portfolio reviews and executive status reporting
* Support business growth initiatives and strategic program execution
* Develop business cases supporting investments and growth opportunities

*New Product Introduction (NPI)*

* Lead operational execution of NPI programs from concept through production stabilization
* Conduct manufacturing feasibility and producibility assessments
* Ensure readiness of labor, equipment, tooling, facilities, materials, and processes
* Lead launch readiness reviews and milestone assessments
* Manage transition from development to recurring production
* Manufacturing Operations Leadership
* Translate forecasted demand into executable manufacturing plans
* Lead recovery efforts for missed deliveries and production disruptions
* Develop capacity models and identify future resource requirements
* Manage operational risks and mitigation strategies

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experience
* 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing, operations, program management, or NPI leadership
* 5+ years of leadership experience with direct reports
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a complex manufacturing environment
* 3+ years experience managing new product introductions and production transitions
* Understanding of SIOP, capacity planning, production control, and operational performance metrics

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Business, or related discipline
* Aerospace or defense manufacturing experience
* Electron Beam Welding (EBW)
* Electro Chemical Machining (ECM)
* Precision machining and assembly operations
* Special process manufacturing
* AS9100 and NADCAP experience
* Lean Manufacturing, CORE, Six Sigma, or PMP certification
* Experience with SAP, MES/Solumina, Pelico, Power BI, Tableau, and advanced planning systems
* Experience leading operational recovery and turnaround initiatives

**What We Offer:**
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 
 
**Some of our competitive benefits package includes:**

* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, andreimbursement family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* And more!

**Learn More and Apply Now:**
**Onsite:**
Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
 
 
The next chapter of our future as an aerospace company is here, and we are excited about what this means for our employees and customers! Get onboard the Collins Aerospace Operations team and play a part in managing our innovative products from inception to delivery. The Operations team continues to grow and aims to strengthen the connection of Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain and Environment, Health & Safety (EH&S) across Collins Aerospace. In this dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to network across our businesses and functions, all while improving the productivity, quality and efficiency of our operations worldwide.
 
 
At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibility. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other -- propel us all higher, again and again. Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.
 
 
***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***
The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.
 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.
 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.
 
 
This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.
 
 
RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.
 
 
*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

role.title: Director, Operational Excellence
role.description:
**Job Title**
Director, Operational Excellence
 
 
**Agency**
Texas A&M University
 
 
**Department**
Strategy and Business Services
 
 
**Proposed Minimum Salary**
Commensurate
 
 
**Job Location**
College Station, Texas
 
 
**Job Type**
Staff
 
 
**Job Description**
**A Glimpse of the Job**
The Director, Operational Excellence provides strategic leadership and oversight for the Operational Excellence program. Directs the development and implementation of division-wide process improvement strategies, methodologies, governance frameworks, and performance measures that enhance operational effectiveness and service delivery. Leads a centralized Operational Excellence function while providing strategic guidance and oversight to embedded Operational Excellence resources across multiple divisions. Partners with senior leaders to identify opportunities for process optimization, organizational effectiveness, service improvements, and change initiatives that advance the university's mission and strategic priorities.
 
 
**Essential Duties**
**Operational Excellence Strategy, Governance & Leadership**

* Develops and executes the strategic vision, goals, and operating model for the Operational Excellence function
* Establishes governance structures, methodologies, standards, tools, and performance metrics for operational excellence initiatives
* Provides leadership and direction for division-wide continuous improvement efforts and organizational effectiveness programs
* Ensures alignment of priorities with institutional strategic objectives and administrative service goals
* Evaluates organizational performance and identifies opportunities to improve effectiveness, efficiency, service quality, and resource utilization

**Leadership of Operational Excellence Workforce**

* Provides oversight, coaching, and professional development for Operational Excellence staff, including analysts and embedded resources
* Establishes workforce strategies, competency models, career pathways, and development programs for staff
* Promotes consistent application of process improvement methodologies, analytical approaches, and change management practices across all teams
* Fosters collaboration and knowledge sharing among central and embedded Operational Excellence resources
* Monitors workload distribution, resource allocation, and organizational capacity to support strategic initiatives

**Consulting & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Serves as a trusted advisor to executive and administrative leadership on process improvement, organizational effectiveness, change management, and service enhancement strategies
* Leads the assessment of complex operational challenges and facilitates the development of sustainable solutions
* Oversees high-impact improvement initiatives across administrative and operational functions
* Facilitates executive-level discussions and cross-functional collaboration to remove barriers and improve organizational performance
* Recommends strategic operational changes supported by data, analysis, and stakeholder engagement

**Project Intake, Prioritization & Portfolio Management**

* Establishes and manages project intake and prioritization processes for Operational Excellence initiatives
* Evaluates requests for support and aligns resources based on organizational priorities, risks, and anticipated impact
* Monitors the progress, outcomes, and performance of projects and initiatives
* Provides executive reporting regarding project portfolios, organizational improvements, and return-on-investment measures
* Ensures appropriate coordination among stakeholders, project teams, and embedded Operational Excellence resources

**Stakeholder Engagement, Change Leadership & Communication**

* Builds collaborative relationships with campus leadership, functional experts, and administrative partners
* Promotes a culture of continuous improvement and service excellence throughout the organization
* Leads communication strategies that support organizational change and operational transformation initiatives
* Represents Operational Excellence initiatives to university leadership and governance groups
* Shares best practices, successes, and lessons learned to expand adoption of improvement principles and tools

**What You Need Know**
**Salary**
: Commensurate based on expereince
 
 
**Cover Letter/Resume:**
A cover letter and resume will assist us in our review of your application materials. These can be uploaded on the application under CV/Resume.
 
 
**Required Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Ten years of experience in relevant fields

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading an operational excellence, continuous improvement, organizational effectiveness, or business transformation function
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide process improvement and organizational change initiatives
* Experience building and developing high-performing professional teams
* Experience managing a portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives
* Experience utilizing data, metrics, and performance measures to drive organizational decision-making
* Lean Six Sigma, Project Management Professional (PMP), or similar professional certifications preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Knowledge of continuous improvement, organizational effectiveness, and change management principles and methodologies
* Skill in strategic planning, analysis, and problem-solving, including the ability to evaluate complex organizational issues, identify improvement opportunities, and develop data-informed solutions aligned with institutional priorities
* Ability to lead and develop high-performing teams, including coaching, mentoring, workforce planning, performance management, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability
* Skill in building collaborative relationships and influencing stakeholders, including the ability to effectively communicate with executive leadership, facilitate cross-functional initiatives, and achieve consensus among diverse constituent groups
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and resources in a complex organization, including the use of metrics, performance measures, and project portfolio management practices to achieve desired outcomes

**Other Requirements And Factors**

* This position is security sensitive
* This position requires compliance with state and federal laws/codes and Texas A&M University System/TAMU policies, regulations, rules and procedures
* All tasks and job responsibilities must be performed safely without injury to self or others in compliance with System and University safety requirements

**Instructions to Applicants:**
Applications received by Texas A&M University must either have all job application data entered or a resume attached. Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume’ or use a LinkedIn profile to pre-populate the online application.
 
 
All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.
 
 
Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.

role.title: Director of Operational Excellence $25K Sign On and $10K Relocation
role.description:
Pay Range:$65.73 - $92.22 $25K Sign On and $10K Relocation for qualified hire!
 
 
The Director of Operational Excellence leads SEARHC’s improvement function, translating annual operating plan priorities into measurable, sustainable operational results. Reporting directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence, the Director supervises Associate Program Managers, Program Managers, and Senior Program Managers, develops improvement and change capabilities, balances team assignments and capacity, and oversees delivery quality and benefits measurement. This hands-on leader personally leads selected complex transformations and partners with executive sponsors and operational owners to diagnose problems, redesign processes, implement change, and sustain results. The Senior Program Manager level expands advanced program leadership capacity while the Director remains accountable for the function and continues direct involvement in transformational projects. The Director works with the PMO through one integrated portfolio and common reporting approach. The System Director retains enterprise direction and executive alignment; operational sponsors retain accountability for operational decisions, resources, and sustained performance.
 
 
SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.
 
 
Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.
 
 
**Key Essential Functions And Accountabilities Of The Job**

* Leads the Operational Excellence team and translates approved annual operating plan priorities into a coordinated improvement work plan; personally leads selected highly complex efforts while maintaining capacity for staff leadership and development.
* Integrates related improvement work across functions and operational owners; develops coherent transformation approaches, resolves cross-workstream dependencies, and coordinates supporting projects with the PMO through shared portfolio processes.
* Advises sponsors on competing approaches, sequencing, risks, and tradeoffs; facilitates difficult cross-functional decisions and escalates resource and priority decisions through established governance without assuming executive approval authority.
* Synthesizes complex operational, quality, service, and financial information with specialist partners; establishes credible baselines and benefits measures, examines performance variation, and evaluates outcomes, unintended effects, and sustained benefits.
* Assigns improvement work, balances team capacity, and oversees plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and delivery quality within approved priorities and resources; partners with the PMO on common reporting and escalates capacity and priority tradeoffs to the System Director.
* Leads change-impact assessment, stakeholder alignment, readiness, and adoption planning for complex transformations; partners on communication and training and verifies that new practices are used across affected operations.
* Leads advanced performance diagnosis, workflow and operating-model redesign, structured testing, and implementation; establishes standard work, measurement ownership, review routines, and transition plans with operational owners to sustain results.
* Develops executive-level updates, governance materials, and strategic implementation reporting for leaders and decision-making bodies.
* Supervises, coaches, and develops improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels; establishes role-appropriate performance expectations, evaluates performance, supports recruitment and onboarding, and builds reusable improvement and change methods to strengthen team capability and consistency.
* Demonstrates SEARHC’s values and supports work that advances the organization’s mission, vision, strategic plan, and operating plan.
* Other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities
 
 
This position reports directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence and directly supervises improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels. Responsibilities include staff performance management, coaching and development, assignments, workload balancing, and delivery oversight in accordance with organizational policies. Senior Program Managers provide technical coaching and program leadership; the Director retains personnel and assignment authority across all levels. The System Director retains enterprise direction, executive alignment, and escalation of enterprise priority and resource decisions.
 
 
**Additional Details**
**Education, Certifications, and Licenses Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, nursing, or a related field
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare, operational improvement, program management, or project management experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
* Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, or a related field preferred
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, change management, or similar improvement methodology training/certification preferred

**Experience Required**

* Six to eight or more years of experience in healthcare operations, program management, project management, quality improvement, or operational improvement, including independent leadership of complex, ambiguous, enterprise-wide improvement programs with measurable and sustained results
* Experience advising executive sponsors, integrating changes across multiple operational owners, facilitating consequential cross-functional decisions, and supervising and developing professional staff
* Demonstrated advanced expertise in performance diagnosis, process redesign, change adoption, benefits measurement, and sustainment across complex healthcare operations, with experience managing staff performance, assignments, and workload

**Knowledge of**

* Healthcare operations, workflow design, and advanced performance improvement principles
* Advanced improvement methods, including process mapping, root cause analysis, structured testing, performance variation, operating-model redesign, and outcome, process, and balancing measures
* Project and program management practices, including planning, tracking, risk management, issue escalation, and cross-functional integration across large or interdependent initiatives
* Data analysis, reporting, and use of healthcare operational and performance metrics to support executive decision-making
* Advanced change-impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, readiness and adoption measurement, capability building, standard work, sustainment, and shared governance principles
* Regulatory, accreditation, and compliance considerations that affect healthcare operations and process redesign
* Staff supervision, performance management, professional development, workload planning, and improvement practice management

Skills in
 
 

* Building effective working relationships with leaders, providers, staff, and cross-functional teams, including senior leaders, governance participants, and executive stakeholders
* Facilitating complex meetings, work sessions, governance discussions, decision-making, and follow-through across multiple stakeholders
* Using standard business software and healthcare information systems to organize work, analyze information, and communicate effectively
* Communicating clearly and effectively in written, verbal, presentation, and executive reporting formats
* Coaching and developing improvement professionals, setting clear expectations, balancing assignments, and providing constructive performance feedback

Ability to
 
 

* Facilitate complex problem-solving, support conflict resolution, and help remove high-level operational barriers to execution across enterprise or highly interdependent initiatives
* Influence without direct authority, foster collaboration, and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, tradeoffs, and execution plans
* Analyze complex issues, develop practical recommendations, and support implementation of operational change across multiple functions or enterprise priorities
* Work effectively with people from diverse disciplines, backgrounds, and perspectives
* Adapt to changing organizational priorities, healthcare environments, and operational demands while maintaining momentum across complex initiatives

**Position Information**
Work Shift:Exempt
 
 
*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*
