role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Job Summary**

The position of **Plant Manager** is responsible for directing, coordinating, and managing the overall facility operation in conjunction with the customer’s production requirements. Ensure facility production objectives are achieved at the lowest cost consistent with IATF16949 quality requirements. Delegate production leadership responsibilities to achieve the desired objectives set forth in the corporate business plan while maintaining compliance to Federal, State, and Local Safety and Environmental regulations and laws.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plant Operation
 + Coordinate with the operations manager in the execution of production schedules based on sales requirements and plant capacity.
 + Coordinate and communicate with leadership team and department managers in meeting production goals while focusing on continuous improvement and cost reduction initiatives.
 + Schedule manufacturing activities based on customer releases to minimize inventory.
 + Ensure orders are released in chronological order (FIFO) unless circumstances dictate a change in customer needs.
 + Ensure all “work in process” is properly tagged in accordance with procedures and instructions.
 + Receive and review daily shift reports from leadership team and address areas of concern.
* Ensure the production floor is well equipped, well maintained and efficiently designed
 + Per the IATF16949 requirements, ensure that production floor is equipped with proper work instructions and procedures to carry out production activities.
 + Ensure properly maintained equipment and appropriate trained personnel are available to carry out these activities.
 + Work with operations, program management, and process engineering teams to ensure new programs and process changes are implemented within designated launch plan requirements.
 + Support new program launches and engineer changes that may include floor layouts, staffing, quality and/or tooling requirements.
 + Provide continuous review of departmental processes to improve overall efficiencies.
 + Ensure facility management, making sure the facility meets all production operation requirements.
* Adherence to established policies, processes and procedures
 + Work with leadership team to enforce written policies and procedures to ensure consistency and fairness while maintaining a healthy and safe work environment.
 + Review and approve recommendations of subordinates in matters of position changes and promotions.
 + Work with leadership team to identify and record any issues relating to process failures, policy or procedure violations, or quality system failures
 + When and where required, assist leadership team with attendance management, performance management and corrective action of employees.
* Assist with implementation and compliance of all health, safety, environmental and quality control plans
 + Work with quality department to ensure adherence to the IATF16949 quality standards and corporate quality best practices.
 + Review and disposition of nonconforming products.
 + Assist in providing solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
 + Ensure consistency with implementation and adherence of the company health, safety and environmental policies and processes.
 + Ensure compliance with Federal, State and Local regulatory requirements such as OSHA, EPA, etc.
 + Be visible, assume leadership, and assist in developing and initiating an effective health and safety attitude. Participate and initiate in continuous safety training.

**Qualifications**

* Education
 + Minimum Required: Associates Degree or Technical Accreditation
 + Preferred: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Administration or equivalent
* Experience
 + Minimum Required: 5+ years working in a production environment
 + 2+ years working in a manager or supervisory role in manufacturing/production environment
 + Preferred: 5+ years working in a managerial role in a manufacturing/production environment
* Must have and maintain a valid Driver’s License
* Strong technical background and a general understanding of a manufacturing/production process
* Fluent in English (verbal, reading, writing)
* Must be team-oriented and have excellent communication, organizational and computer literacy skills
* Requires a high level of professionalism and strong work ethic
* Preferred: Familiarity with TS16949 or IATF 16949, Quality Audits, and Environmental Management System and OSHA Requirements

**Working Conditions**

The following working conditions are present or expected on a daily basis:

* Manufacturing/production floor environment with a presence on the production floor required for at least 50% of daily work time.
* Frequent exposure to industrial manufacturing, automotive vehicles, weather elements, chemicals and robotics.
* Personal protective equipment must be worn at all times on the production floor.

**IMPORTANT NOTE**

The organization reserves the right to change, amend or disuse this job description at any time. This document is intended to provide an overview of the required responsibilities and qualifications.

#### **Education**

Preferred

* Associates or better

#### **Licenses & Certifications**

Required

* Drivers License

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.title: Plant General Manager
role.description:
At Cavco Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ CVCO), our 7000 team members are at the heart of everything we do. We design and produce quality, affordable factory-built homes. We are also a leading producer of park model RVs, vacation cabins and factory-built commercial structures. In addition to providing competitive pay and benefits, we provide opportunities for development and upward mobility, while investing in the communities we serve. Our values are our foundation. We’re constantly striving to diversify our teams to ensure we have the best and brightest talent. We’re deeply committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where each person can contribute.

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Cavco is seeking an experienced and strategic leader within the manufactured housing industry to oversee and direct overall plant operations. The General Manager is responsible for ensuring business objectives are achieved professionally, ethically, and in accordance with company policy and core values. The General Manager has a responsibility to influence core values by demonstrating them. Safety and Quality will be emphasized as priority over throughput and demonstrated in business planning through measurable annual results. Additionally, the General Manager is responsible for decisions which influence operational results including but not limited to profitability, plant direction, product mix and pricing. The General Manager has the management responsibility and authority for the total operation of an individual plant. He/she is accountable for results, development of KPIs, and continuous improvement. Relocation assistance may be offered for qualified candidates willing to relocate for the role.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

The General Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and compliance of the plant. Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

* **Asset Protection & Controls**
* Ensure all company assets are properly safeguarded and that effective internal controls are established and maintained.
* **Quality Assurance**
* Ensure the plant consistently produces code-compliant, high-quality homes. Conduct periodic inspections of plant output to validate adherence to quality standards.
* **Business Planning & Execution**
* Collaborate with department heads to develop the annual business plan narrative. Ensure operations are aligned with and meet business plan objectives on a daily, weekly, monthly, and annual basis.
* **Regulatory Compliance**
* Maintain full compliance with all local, state, and federal laws and regulations, including those related to product construction, employee health and safety, and recordkeeping.
* **Team Leadership & Development**
* Ensure employees are competent and aligned with company core values. Conduct annual performance reviews for direct reports and administer compensation fairly and equitably based on performance.
* **Customer Engagement**
* Actively cultivate and maintain strong customer relationships. Regularly visit customers to ensure satisfaction and that company operating objectives are being met.
* **Legal & Risk Management**
* Coordinate with the Regional Vice President (RVP) and Cavco Compliance Department regarding any potential or actual legal matters, including service-related issues. Promptly report and forward any legal documents received for proper handling and recordkeeping.
* **Financial Performance & Accountability**
* Review monthly budget versus actual performance with department heads to ensure alignment and maximize profitability. Identify issues, implement corrective actions, and ensure appropriate follow-up.
* **Leadership & Culture**
* Guide, coach, and motivate team members to achieve business plan objectives. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* **Process Improvement**
* Establish high expectations through strong processes across all areas of management. Focus on improving processes before addressing personnel changes.
* **P&L Management**
* Manage plant profit and loss performance to meet or exceed budget expectations. Understand and optimize the impact of product mix, pricing, and specifications on financial results.
* **Capital Planning**
* Collaborate with department heads to identify capital expenditure needs and develop supporting documentation for investments in systems, equipment, and processes that drive continuous improvement.

 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in the manufactured housing or related industry required.
* Proven leadership and supervisory experience required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and support multiple teams in consistently achieving production goals.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including the ability to support, motivate, and develop team members. Must demonstrate empathy, openness to feedback, and willingness to both provide and receive direction.
* Demonstrated capability to coach and develop people leaders, including functional managers, with a focus on building their ability to lead, coach, and develop their own teams.
* Ability to successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening.
* Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.title: Aggregate Plant Manager
role.description:
**Why Join Our Team?**

At Quikrete, we foster a positive and collaborative work environment where teamwork and cooperation are at the forefront. As a Plant Manager, you will be the driving force behind directing and supervising manufacturing operations at our plant, ensuring the highest level of product quality while optimizing production efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

**What We Offer:**

* **Work-Life Balance:** We understand the importance of achieving your professional goals without compromising your personal life.
* **Career Growth:** Join an industry leader renowned for world-class design, manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution. This is an opportunity to propel your career forward.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We provide a comprehensive benefits package with customizable options that meet your needs and those of your family.

**About the Role:**

* As a Plant Manager, you will be responsible for:
* Provide leadership and direction to a team of 15-20 employees. This includes selection, development, and evaluation of personnel to ensure a technically competent and highly motivated workforce.
* Oversee the entire manufacturing process, from receipt of materials to shipping. You will utilize our facilities, equipment, and personnel to achieve the highest level of product production while ensuring safety and quality standards are met at the lowest possible cost.
* Develop and maintain high plant standards of safety and work conditions, administer safety programs, and ensure compliance with all safety regulations, including stormwater tests and Pollution Protection Plans.
* Effectively communicate organizational policies and procedures and provide daily direction to various staff functions, including production scheduling, administration, inventory management, order process, and transportation.
* Possess a deep understanding of all manufacturing processes and production equipment.
* Analyze monthly metrics related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and inventory.
* Stay current with Interstate Commerce Commission and Department of Transportation regulations, as well as customer and government agency specifications.
* Coordinate directly with internal and external customers on orders, routes, specifications, pricing, and shipping to ensure the production of high-quality products in line with profit goals and strategies.
* Ensure all quality procedures are adhered to and documented in compliance with company policies.
* Maintain proper inventory levels to support the local market and make necessary adjustments as required.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5 years of supervisory or leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Operating Systems.
* Broad knowledge of business functions, including safety, quality, production operations, accounting, inventory management, cost control/profit and loss management, and shipping.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset.
* Broad technical knowledge of product and production methods.
* If you are a seasoned leader with a track record of success in manufacturing operations, possess a deep understanding of safety and quality standards, and are looking for a new challenge, we encourage you to apply for the Plant Manager position. Your expertise will be instrumental in maintaining and improving our production processes.

**Ready to Apply?**

The process is simple. Click on the “apply” button to get started. Good luck!

#QKAG

QUIKRETE® is an equal opportunity employer committed to developing a workforce with well-qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, status with regard to public assistance or any other characteristic/status protected by law. QUIKRETE® is a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact the QUIKRETE® Recruiting team at *accommodationsforhiring@quikrete.com*.

role.title: Senior Manager, Project Management - External Manufacturing
role.description:
Rezolute is a pre-commercial ultra-rare disease company focused on significantly improving outcomes for individuals with hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinism (HI). Our fully human monoclonal antibody therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is designed to treat all forms of HI and has shown substantial benefit in clinical trials and real-world use for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI) and tumor hyperinsulinism (tHI).

**Position Summary**

Rezolute is seeking a proactive, execution-focused project management professional to coordinate external manufacturing programs as the company advances toward commercial manufacturing.

The Senior Manager, Project Management - External Manufacturing will manage integrated plans, communications, and deliverables across technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, process characterization, process validation, and commercial readiness. Working with internal functional leads and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs), this individual will align schedules, supplier commitments, and cross-functional dependencies with Rezolute’s Plan of Record (POR), supply requirements, and business priorities.

This role owns project coordination and follow-through, not technical oversight. External Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), Quality Assurance (QA), and designated functional experts retain responsibility for technical strategy, scientific assessments, manufacturing process decisions, and quality approvals.

### **Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

Integrated Project Planning and Execution

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans for external Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) programs, defining scope, deliverables, owners, milestones, dependencies, and target dates.

* Align project baselines and supplier commitments with the POR, supply requirements, and approved priorities.

* Monitor critical-path activities and progress against plan; coordinate recovery actions for overdue or at-risk commitments with functional owners and suppliers.

* Assess scope, schedule, and resource changes with accountable stakeholders and route proposed changes through established approval processes.

Communications and Cross-Functional Coordination

* Serve as the project management point of contact between Rezolute teams and CDMOs, facilitating cross-functional coordination and timely communication of changes.

* Lead internal and supplier project meetings, using focused agendas to address progress, upcoming deliverables, dependencies, and decisions required.

* Maintain and distribute meeting records and action items with clear owners and due dates; drive follow-through to closure.

Workstream and Milestone Coordination

* Coordinate manufacturing and milestone readiness by tracking prerequisites, including material availability, documentation, internal reviews, and supplier deliverables.

* Integrate technical and quality review timelines into project schedules, including protocols, reports, and master or electronic batch records.

* Track schedule dependencies associated with change controls, deviations, investigations, and other quality-system activities in partnership with QA and technical owners.

* Coordinate handoffs from development and validation activities to routine commercial manufacturing, tracking agreed deliverables, receiving owners, and outstanding actions.

Risk, Issue, and Decision Management

* Maintain risk, issue, assumption, decision, and dependency logs, including accountable owners and required completion dates.

* Work with functional leads and suppliers to assess execution risks and track mitigation actions and residual risks.

* Facilitate issue resolution and escalate unresolved items or pending decisions, clearly communicating timing requirements and potential project impacts.

Reporting, Scope, and Project Controls

* Provide dashboards and leadership updates showing milestone performance, forecast completion dates, critical-path activities, risks, and decisions or intervention required.

* Partner with External Manufacturing leadership, Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Business, and Procurement to define milestones, deliverables, assumptions, and timelines in supplier scopes of work.

* Support project-level financial tracking with budget owners, including planned work, supplier milestones, and the budget and schedule impacts of scope changes.

* Improve project management tools, reporting practices, and lessons-learned processes across the external manufacturing network.

### **Qualifications/Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, engineering, business, project management, or related discipline.

* Minimum of seven years of relevant biopharmaceutical industry experience, including responsibility for managing cross-functional projects involving CDMOs or other external manufacturing partners.

* Demonstrated ability to manage integrated schedules, critical-path activities, risks, and changing priorities across multiple workstreams.

* Experience coordinating technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, process characterization, process validation, or commercial manufacturing readiness activities.

* Working knowledge of biopharmaceutical manufacturing and cGMP requirements sufficient to understand project dependencies and engage effectively with technical and quality teams.

* Strong meeting facilitation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills, including communication with external partners and senior leadership.

* Ability to translate technical discussions into clear project actions, decisions, and schedule implications while respecting functional decision-making authority.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to drive accountability and prioritize independently in a matrixed environment.

* Proficiency in Smartsheet or comparable project management software and Microsoft Teams, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience supporting late-stage biologics programs transitioning to commercial manufacturing.

* Experience coordinating DS and/or DP manufacturing projects across multiple external partners.

* Experience working in a small to mid-sized biotechnology company.

* Experience tracking project budgets, supplier scopes of work, and change requests.

Core Competencies:

* Project Planning and Controls: Creates practical plans that connect workstreams and support timely delivery.

* Execution and Accountability: Establishes ownership and follows through on commitments.

* Communication and Collaboration: Builds productive relationships and keeps internal and external teams aligned.

* Risk and Issue Management: Anticipates challenges, coordinates mitigation, and escalates appropriately.

* Adaptability and Prioritization: Adjusts plans as circumstances change while maintaining focus on program objectives.

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for Senior Manager - Project Management External Manufacturing role could range from $165,000 to $180,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience and geographical location of the selected candidate.

Qualifying employees are eligible to participate in benefit programs such as:

* Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision)

* Disability, Life & Long-Term Care Insurance

* Holiday Pay

* Tracking Free Vacation Program

* 401(k) Plan Match

* Educational Assistance Benefit

* Fitness Center Reimbursement

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against applicants due to race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status, or on the basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

role.title: Quality Engineering Sr Manager - L6
role.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Manages those who apply quality principles in the areas of: design, incoming material, production control, product evaluation, program performance, reliability, inventory control, and/or research and development as they apply to product or process quality for make and/or buy products. Performs technical evaluations including product requirements, specifications, models/designs, drawings and procedures. Collaborates with program management, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and customers on quality related issues to ensure quality standards are in place. Engages in product failure investigations, material review board decisions and corrective/preventive action. Ensures corrective measures meet acceptable reliability standards and/or are compliant with requirements. Develops strategies and systems designed to improve internal and/or supplier performance and productivity. Evaluates quality systems for deficiency identification and correction. Designs and analyzes inspection and testing processes, mechanisms and equipment; conducts product quality tests, performs statistical analysis to assess products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications. Engages in supplier selection process and maintain certification programs.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college
* 10 years of leadership experience
* 8 years flightline/flight test operations experience
* Quality experience - either in a quality organization or with significant exposure to quality processes
* Ability to travel

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Prior leadership experience in a unionized workforce environment
* AS9100/9110 experience
* Ability to interpret military service guidance
* Understanding of DCMAI 8210.1 (all revisions)
* Demonstrated ability to work in a blended environment with contractor & gov’t personnel - both military and civilian
* Experience developing BOE through negotiation and contract award
* Interpersonal skills required to develop effective working relationships
* Excellent presentation skills/ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $178500.00 - $331500.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

role.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)** 
 **OR**
* **Remote in United States**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

role.title: Senior Manager, US Quality Operations
role.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

As production grows, we need clear evidence that each spacecraft meets its requirements and a quality system that helps teams find and resolve risks early.

We are looking for a **Senior Manager, Quality Operations** to lead US quality for satellite buses and payloads from incoming material through building, test and acceptance. You will build a pragmatic system and lead engineers and inspectors close to the floor. You have independent authority to hold work or withhold readiness concurrence and to escalate unresolved mission risk. This is a hands-on leadership role in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.

**What you will do:**
=====================

* Lead US quality engineers and inspectors across supplier, receiving, production and test coverage. Set training, inspection points and delegated authority.
* Own fit-for-stage quality controls for document and configuration records, serial and lot traceability, calibration, nonconformances, corrective action and acceptance packages.
* Define risk-based controls for critical characteristics and supplier parts. Work with Supply Chain on qualifications, escapes, containment and verified corrective action.
* Make quality status visible through yield, repeat defects, escapes, NCR aging and acceptance-record completeness. Use trends to improve controls with Manufacturing and Engineering.

role.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering - Workplace Integration (General Assembly)
role.description:
As a leader of a multi-disciplinary team of manufacturing engineers, you will be instrumental in launching new products and capacities at Rivian, transforming innovative ideas into tangible realities. This role sits at the intersection of product design, validation, factory design, and launch, ultimately delivering Rivian's best ideas into the hands of our customers. You will be responsible for leading and developing a motivated team of manufacturing SMEs in supporting all Rivian vehicle products and factories. This position is located at our Plymouth, MI headquarters or Georgia facility and will require significant travel to our manufacturing facilities in Normal, IL, and future locations. This role reports directly to the Director of Manufacturing Engineering in General Assembly.

 

* Lead a team of manufacturing engineers responsible for designing and executing workstation design aligned with lean manufacturing principles. Workstation design supports overall plant metrics of 90 - 95% utilization and greater than 50 value added elements. Start to finish ownership of workstation design from virtual build through launch.
* Support Rivian manufacturing lines and sites and cover factory layout, manufacturing technology selection, equipment design, process design, etc.
* A special focus of this team will be advancing Rivian’s manufacturing technology and innovation roadmap
* Conduct virtual builds, support design validation builds of next generation products and provide Design for Manufacturing and Assembly feedback, collaborating with vehicle architecture, design, software, and other upstream partners
* Define and execute launch and ramp strategies, collaborating with launch, operations, RPS, quality and design responsible teams
* Deliver production documentation such as JES, PFMEA, Control Plans etc.
* Develop and implement processes, standards and workflows to improve team efficiency
* Actively mentor and grow manufacturing engineers and managers through technical leadership, translate vision into action, inspiring from ideation to execution
* Actively engage in value engineering, challenge assumptions and break the status quo

 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or similar technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in an engineering role related to manufacturing engineering, DFMA, product optimization, manufacturing process or equipment development
* Expertise in manufacturing and industrial engineering principles (OEE, cycle time analysis, DVA, Cp/Cpk, GR&R, ergonomics, DOE, quality control, equipment selection, ROI, error proofing, supply chain & logistics)
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems using first principles, challenge assumptions and biased towards action
* Proven technical leader that can lead and influence cross-functional teams launching new products, lean manufacturing workstations and material flow processes
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, ability to concisely summarize and escalate complex topics
* Experienced working within 2D & 3D CAD environments, simulation tools and other digital tools in the field of engineering

role.title: Manufacturing Technical Services Senior Manager - Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD)
role.description:
**Job Description**

**General Summary**
-------------------

The Manufacturing Technical Services Senior Manager provides technical leadership for commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD) at external manufacturing partners. The role is accountable for overseeing technical services activities across the commercial manufacturing lifecycle, including manufacturing readiness, process performance, technical investigations, change management, process improvement, and supply-risk mitigation.

The Senior Manager partners with Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and CDMOs/CMOs to ensure manufacturing processes are robust, compliant, reliable, and capable of supporting product supply. The role leads complex cross-functional technical workstreams and develops technical talent within the Manufacturing Technical Services organization.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Lead Manufacturing Technical Services support for assigned commercial manufacturing programs and external manufacturing partners.
* Establish technical plans and priorities to support manufacturing readiness, commercial production campaigns, product supply, and lifecycle-management objectives.
* Provide technical oversight during manufacturing execution; lead escalation and resolution of complex process, equipment, yield, and manufacturing-performance issues.

role.title: Senior Manager – Industrial Data & Manufacturing Systems Integration
role.description:
Are you looking to power the next leap in the exciting world of advanced electronics?Do you want to help solve problems that drive success in the rapidly evolving technology and connectivity landscape? Then bring your problem-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics.
 
 
AtQnity, we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high-tech industries – we’re a tight-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting-edge technology possible. We value forward-thinking challengers, boundary-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us.
 
 
Senior Manager, Industrial Data& Manufacturing Systems Integration
 
 
**Function:** Integrated Operations& Technology, Digital TechnologyLocation: Wilmington, Delaware, Hybrid (other US Qnity locations may be considered)Travel: Approximately 20–30%Scope: Global, multi-site, and multi-vendor
 
 
Role Summary
 
 
The Senior Manager, Industrial Data& Manufacturing Systems Integration will own the enterprise agenda for industrial data and Level 3 integration across our global manufacturing network.
 
In this role, you will identify, develop, implement, and support two connected sets of systems:
 
 

* The historian and industrial data platform, including EMS/BMS, manufacturing intelligence, advanced analytics and AI, and digital twin capabilities
* The Level 3 integration and middleware layer that supports the platform, including equipment connectivity, edge gateways, orchestration, external-system integration, and twin synchronization

The mandate is to make data contextualization and a standardized edge gateway pattern work at scale. You will bring the architectural judgment needed to make platform decisions and the leadership required to align Manufacturing, Engineering, IT/OT, and external partners. Deep tool expertise will be provided by subject matter experts and specialist hires.
 
 
The Core Challenge
 
 
This role must protect plant-critical data flows and proprietary in-house assets, including custom drivers, tag structures, and site analytics, while establishing sufficient standardization across contextualization models, namespaces, edge patterns, integration contracts, and security.
 
Success requires sound judgment and trusted relationships with plants, engineers, and vendors. The right approach will balance enterprise standards with legitimate local requirements rather than applying a blanket rule such as “everything moves to the cloud” or “nothing leaves the plant.”
 
 
Core Capabilities
 
 
Selection for this role will be based on the following five capabilities, balanced across technical and people leadership. We expect sound architectural judgment, not hands-on expertise in every tool.
 
 
1. Technical Leadership of the Industrial Data and Integration Landscape
 
 
Own the platform decisions, including historian versus lakehouse, integration hub versus custom code, the appropriate edge pattern, and where contextualization should occur.
 
You will frame options; evaluate cost, latency, security, supplier risk, and intellectual property value; engage subject matter experts effectively; and take accountability for the outcome.
 
 
2. Implementing and Supporting Systems in an Operating Plant
 
 
Modernize historians, interfaces, and connectivity that plants rely on continuously without creating data gaps, breaking genealogy, or introducing silent changes to trusted data.
 
You will also establish stable, 24x7 support with clearly defined service levels, controls, and change-management practices.
 
 
3. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
 
 
Build early sponsorship with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Quality, Facilities, IT/OT Security, Data& AI, and site leaders across three regions.
 
Explain contextualization, edge technology, and digital twins in terms of business outcomes for audiences ranging from executives to the shop floor. Communicate risks, challenges, and changes early and clearly.
 
 
4. Collaboration Across IT, OT, and External Partners
 
 
Industrial data operates at the intersection of IT and OT and between internal teams and external suppliers.
 
Maintain OT-grade standards for segmentation, edge design, and change control while building effective partnerships with Controls, OT Security, subject matter experts, system integrators, and vendors.
 
 
5. Followership and Change Leadership Across Sites
 
 
Our Wilmington, Cheonan, and Hsinchu sites differ in regulatory requirements, engineering culture, and language. Common standards may encounter legitimate local concerns.
 
Build strong teams, determine what must be standardized and what may remain local, bring sites through the change, and stand behind both decisions.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
Vision, Strategy, and Architecture
 
 

* Establish the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and ISA-95-aligned reference architecture for the industrial data platform and Level 3 integration layer.
* Govern a fit-for-purpose framework that determines what belongs in the historian, cloud platform, edge environment, integration hub, or custom code.
* Establish data contextualization as an enterprise capability by owning the common asset model, Unified Namespace, and contextualization standards across equipment, process, quality, energy, and facilities data.
* Standardize a secure, outbound-only edge gateway pattern for connectivity, protocol translation, buffering, and edge processing, enabling new equipment and sites to connect efficiently.

Historian and Data Platform Ownership
 
 

* Identify, implement, and support enterprise historians, such as AspenTech InfoPlus.21, including tag governance, retention, high availability, and migration.
* Develop and operate cloud data platforms, including Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, for time-series, contextualized, and EMS/BMS data, with governed data products and access controls.
* Deliver manufacturing intelligence, AI, and digital twin capabilities using platforms such as Seeq, Siemens Insights Hub, Cognite Data Fusion, and Azure Digital Twins.
* Establish the industrial knowledge model and appropriate responsible-AI controls.

Level 3 Integration, Edge, and Middleware Ownership
 
 

* Deploy and support equipment connectivity and edge gateways using technologies such as PTC Kepware, Litmus Edge, Ignition, and Azure IoT Operations across OPC UA, MQTT, SECS/GEM, and Modbus.
* Build and operate the Unified Namespace and contextualization layer using technologies such as HighByte Intelligence Hub, HiveMQ, and MQTT/Sparkplug B.
* Own orchestration and external-system integration using platforms such as Boomi and MuleSoft across MES, historians, digital twins, ERP, PLM, QMS, LIMS, and WMS, including twin synchronization.
* Ensure OT cybersecurity, data governance, and 24x7 resilience for data flows that are critical to shop-floor operations.
* Apply relevant standards and architectural models, including IEC 62443 and Purdue/DMZ principles.

Delivery and Support
 
 

* Own the complete system lifecycle, from business case development through design, implementation, hypercare, and ongoing support.
* Establish service levels, CI/CD practices, and OT-grade change control.
* Manage scope, budget, risk, and benefits across concurrent global rollouts.
* Coordinate platform suppliers, system integrators, and managed-service partners.

Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement, and Team Development
 
 

* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Facilities, IT/OT Security, MES, and Data& AI.
* Communicate technology strategy, business value, risks, and progress to executive stakeholders.
* Lead change management and adoption at each site.
* Build and develop a global team of architects, engineers, and product owners.
* Add subject matter experts and specialist capabilities where deeper technical expertise is required.

Required Qualifications
 
 
These qualifications represent minimum thresholds and are not the sole basis for selection.
 
 

* 8 or more years of experience in manufacturing IT/OT, including the delivery and support of historian, industrial data, MES, or OT integration systems in semiconductor, electronics, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Five or more years of experience leading distributed teams and multi-vendor programs with accountability for budgets and business benefits.
* Strong command of ISA-95, the Purdue model, contextualization and asset modeling, edge gateway architecture, OPC UA, MQTT, and OT security, with the ability to set direction and effectively challenge technical experts.
* Demonstrated stakeholder engagement and communication skills across audiences ranging from executives to the shop floor.
* A record of building teams and leading change across multiple sites.
* Commercial experience with RFx processes, contracts, licensing, and vendor governance.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications
 
 
The following qualifications may strengthen an application but do not replace the core capabilities and are not intended as initial screening requirements.
 
 

* Experience delivering at least one historian, data-platform, or integration modernization within an operating plant without loss of data continuity.
* Experience taking at least one greenfield or significant new-site deployment through implementation and into stable support.
* Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, or specialty materials.
* Working proficiency in Korean or Mandarin.
* Experience with technologies such as AVEVA PI, Seeq, Cognite Data Fusion, HighByte Intelligence Hub, PTC Kepware, or Databricks.
* Experience delivering an enterprise-scale Unified Namespace, digital twin, or manufacturing AI capability.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, SAFe, TOGAF, ISA/IEC 62443, Microsoft Azure, or Databricks.
* Experience in regulated-quality environments, including ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or GxP.
* Master’s degree or MBA.

Technical Environment
 
 
You will identify, develop, implement, and support the systems below while reshaping the technology landscape over time.
 
Many sites currently rely on in-house tools and point-to-point connections. You will determine what should be standardized, rationalized, migrated, or retained where it provides proprietary value. You are expected to understand how the components fit together and make sound platform decisions. Specialist depth will be provided by subject matter experts.
 
 
Historian and Data Platforms
 
 
**Technologies you may encounter or help select:** 

* Wonderware
* AspenTech InfoPlus.21
* Microsoft Fabric
* Databricks

Manufacturing Intelligence and AI
 
 
Technologies and capabilities you may encounter or help select:
 
 

* Seeq
* Siemens Insights Hub
* Azure AI and Copilot
* EMS/BMS energy and facilities data

Digital Twin and Knowledge Model
 
 
**Technologies and approaches you may encounter or help select:** 

* Cognite Data Fusion
* Azure Digital Twins
* ISA-95 asset hierarchies
* Industrial knowledge graphs

Edge Gateways and Equipment Connectivity
 
 
**Technologies and protocols you may encounter or help select:** 

* PTC Kepware
* Litmus Edge
* Ignition
* Azure IoT Operations
* OPC UA
* SECS/GEM
* Modbus
* PLC, DCS, and SCADA environments

Data Contextualization and DataOps
 
 
**Technologies and approaches you may encounter or help select:** 

* HighByte Intelligence Hub
* HiveMQ
* MQTT/Sparkplug B
* Unified Namespace
* ISA-95 asset models

Enterprise Integration
 
 
**Technologies and systems you may encounter or help select:** 

* Boomi
* MuleSoft
* MES
* SAP
* PLM
* QMS
* LIMS
* WMS

Standards and Security
 
 
**Standards and frameworks you may apply:** 

* ISA-95
* Purdue model
* IEC 62443
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework
* OPC UA companion specifications
* SEMI E30 and E164

Living the Qnity Values
 
 
At Qnity, success is measured not only bywhat we achieve, but also byhow we achieve it.
 
 

* Customer: Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, solve business challenges, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
* Innovation: Continuously improve processes, technologies, and ways of working.
* Speed: Act with urgency, focus, and precision to move work forward and deliver results.
* People: Build trusted relationships, collaborate across teams, and inspire positive change.

Join ourTalent Community to stay connected with us!
 
 
Qnity is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation to search or apply for a position, please visit our Accessibility Page for Contact Information.
 
 
Qnity offers a comprehensive pay and benefits package. To learn more visit theCompensation and Benefits page.
 
 
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance our recruitment process.
 
The Pay range for this role is $108,500.00 - $170,500.00 Annual
 
**How Base Pay is Determined:** Qnity has job leveling frameworks that help organize roles based on progressive levels of responsibility, proficiency and qualifications. Each role has an associated pay range (or an established pay rate for some roles) based on the competitive market in each country where we operate. Each individual’s pay is based on a variety of factors, including their role and the associated pay range for that role, their geographic location (i.e., country, state, metropolitan area), as well as their skills, experience, education and certifications, and performance.

role.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, QUALITY MANAGEMENT (TRANSIT)
role.description:
***Metro’s mission is to provide a world-class transportation system that enhances the quality of life for all who live, work, and play within LA County.***

**Description**
---------------

Directs and administers quality management programs in design, construction, and start-up operations of major Metro capital projects. The Director leads Metro’s quality management program for major transit capital projects, overseeing quality during design, construction, testing, and start-up of rail lines, stations, tunnels, and systems. They will also directs a team of agency and consultant quality professionals, oversees contractor quality control programs, and makes sure projects are delivered to standard and ready for safe operation.
 
 
Recruitment Timelines: Interviews are projected to be scheduled for the week of **December 14,** **2026****.** These dates are subject to change. We encourage you to monitor your governmentjobs.com profile and emails for the latest updates.

**Examples of Duties**
----------------------

* Schedules, plans, coordinates, and directs training, certification, team-building, and continuous improvement activities for all construction projects
* Establishes and monitors short- and long-range goals, budgets, schedules, and strategies for quality and continuous improvement programs
* Ensures quality requirements are included in all contracts for services, procurements, and construction
* Reviews and approves consultant/contract personnel/vendor quality programs and qualifications of responsible staff
* Identifies quality problems, then recommends and monitors solutions
* Analyzes and develops appropriate quality staff levels within engineering management and construction management contracts
* Directs the development and implementation of policies and procedures for quality and continuous improvement, including development, implementation, and maintenance of quality program manual; enforces quality program guidelines, standards, and procedures
* Reports to management on quality program performance measures and effectiveness
* Advises staff and management on quality concerns and solutions
* Participates in vendor contract negotiations for consultant and as-needed personnel; negotiates and manages consultant contracts
* Represents Metro with outside agencies and trade and professional organizations
* Authorizes stopping work or shipments that do not meet quality standards
* Supervises, trains, mentors, and motivates assigned staff
* Communicates and implements safety rules, policies, and procedures in support of the agency's safety vision and goals; and maintains accountability for the safety performance of all assigned employees

May be required to perform other related job duties

 

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

A combination of education and/or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the essential functions of the position. Additional experience, as outlined below, may be substituted for required education on a year-for-year basis. A typical combination includes:
 
 
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction, Architecture, or a related field; Master's Degree in a related field preferred

**Experience**

* Five years of relevant management-level experience in administering Total Quality Management programs for major capital projects

**Certifications/Licenses/Special Requirements**

* ASQ (American Society of Quality) Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence preferred
* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job-related essential functions
* Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) preferred

**Preferred Qualifications**

Preferred Qualifications (PQs) are used to identify relevant knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) as determined by business necessity. These criteria are considered preferred qualifications and are not intended to serve as minimum requirements for the position. PQs will help support selection decisions throughout the recruitment. In addition, applicants who possess these PQs will not automatically be selected.

The following are the preferred qualifications:

* Experience managing quality assurance and quality control programs for the design and construction of rail transit, bored tunnels, underground stations.

* Experience overseeing quality during systems integration, testing, and start-up of rail transit systems, such as traction power, train control, and communications.

* Experience leading quality oversight of contractors on projects delivered through alternative methods, such as Design-Build (DB), Construction Manager/General Contractor (CM/GC), or Public-Private Partnership (P3).

* Experience developing and auditing quality management systems aligned with Federal Transit Administration (FTA) Quality Management System Guidelines or International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001.

**Essential Knowledge**
-----------------------

**Knowledge of** (defined as a learned body of information that is required for and applied in the performance of job tasks)

* Theories, principles, and practices of quality management and improvement and standards related to rail design, construction, and start-up operations
* Inspection and materials/systems testing principles and techniques
* Contract negotiation and administration
* Applicable local, state, and federal, laws, rules, and regulations governing requirements and standards of quality management for a public transportation agency
* Modern management theory

**Skill in** (defined as the proficient manual, verbal, or mental utilization of data, people, or things)

* Planning, organizing, and directing the work of quality management functions
* Establishing, implementing, and monitoring short- and long-range goals, budgets, schedules, and strategies for quality and continuous improvement programs
* Determining strategies to achieve goals
* Establishing and implementing relevant policies and procedures
* Analyzing situations, identifying problems, recommending solutions, and evaluating outcomes
* Exercising sound judgement and creativity in making decisions
* Communicating effectively orally and in writing
* Interacting professionally with elected officials, the Board of Directors, and outside representatives
* Mediation and negotiation

**Ability to** (defined as a present competence to perform an observable behavior or produce an observable result)

* Manage sensitive information
* Represent Metro before the public
* Understand, interpret, and apply laws, rules, regulations, policies, procedures, contracts, budgets, and labor/management agreements
* Make financial decisions within a budget
* Plan financial and staffing needs
* Supervise, train, mentor, and motivate assigned staff
* Travel to offsite locations
* Read, write, speak, and understand English

**Special Conditions**

* This job specification is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or requirements
* The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job
* Metro provides reasonable accommodation to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions
* This classification is at-will and the incumbent serves at the pleasure of the hiring authority
* Contributes to ensuring that the Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) policies and programs of Metro are carried out

**Working Conditions**

* Typical office situation
* Close exposure to computer monitors and video screen

**Physical Effort Required**

* Sitting at a desk or table
* Operate a telephone or other telecommunications device and communicate through the medium
* Type and use a keyboard and mouse to perform necessary computer-based functions
* Communicating through speech in the English language required

(AHM)

Metro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, ancestry, national origin, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, religion, age, veteran status, or disability. Learn more about Metro’s Equal Employment Opportunity Program. Metro does not deny participation in the application process to anyone with prior justice system involvement, in line with Fair Chance hiring practices.

 

**Selection Procedure**

Applicants who best meet job-related qualifications will be invited to participate in the examination process that may consist of any combination of written, performance, or oral appraisal to further evaluate job-related experience, knowledge, skills and abilities.

 

**Application Procedure**

To apply, visit Metro's website at www.metro.net and complete an online Employment Application.
 
Computers are available to complete online Employment Applications at the following Metro locations:
 
 
**METRO Headquarters, Employment Office** 
**One Gateway Plaza** 
**Los Angeles, CA 90012** 
**Open: Monday through Friday, 8am-4pm** 
**(Closed Sat & Sun)**

 

**Metro Talent Hub** 
**8501 S. Evermont Place** 
**Los Angeles, CA 90044** 
**Open: Monday through Friday, 9am-5pm** 
**(Closed Sat & Sun)**

**East Los Angeles Customer Center** 
**4501 B Whittier Blvd**

**Open: Tuesday through Saturday, 10am to 6pm** 
**(Closed Sun & Mon)**

 

**Wilshire/Vermont Customer Center** 
**3183 Wilshire Blvd, Ste 174**

**Open: Monday through Friday, 10am-6pm** 
**(Closed Sat & Sun)**

 

**Rosa Parks Customer Center**

**Open: Monday through Friday, 6am to 6:30pm** 
**(Closed Sat & Sun)**

 

**Telephone:** (213) 922-6217 or persons with hearing or speech impairments can use California Relay Service 711 to contact Metro.
 
 
**All completed online Employment Applications must be received by 5:00 p.m. on the closing date. Late applications will not be considered.**

* Open to the public and all Metro employees

This job bulletin is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Employees may be required to perform other related job duties.

 

***\*Please refer to the applicable benefit type (Regular or Temporary)\****

**BENEFITS FOR REGULAR EMPLOYEES**

Benefits cover probationary or regular full-time (working at least 40 hrs/week) employees of Metro.
 
 
We offer a range of high-quality medical, dental and vision plan options as well as health care spending accounts for you and your family. Metro will cover a significant portion of your health care premiums.
 
 
**Medical/Dental/Vision Plan** - Employee has the choice of 3 separate medical plans and 3 dental plans. A separate vision plan is included in each medical plan.
 
 
**Group Life Insurance** - PTSC pays for an amount equal to your annual salary, rounded up to the nearest $1,000. Minimum amount of life insurance is $30,000.
 
 
**Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance** - PTSC provides $50,000 coverage for each employee. Additional voluntary coverage in amounts up to $500,000 is available at favorable premium rates.
 
 
**Long-Term Disability Insurance** - 100% employer paid. Provides employees with a minimum income of 60% of earnings after six months of disability. Buy up or buy down options available.
 
 
**Holidays** - 12 days a year: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans' Day, Cesar E Chavez, Juneteenth,Thanksgiving Day, Day After Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.
 
 
**Time off with Pay (TOWP)** - Compensates employees who are on approved absence from work for reasons such as illness, injury, medical and dental appointments, personal business, vacation, or observance of (a) religious holiday.
 
Years of Service Annual Accrual
 
Hire date - 5 years 20 days
 
Beginning of 6th - 10th year 25 days
 
Beginning of 11th - 15th year 30 days
 
Beginning of 16th + years 35 days
 
 
**Pension Plan** - PTSC retirement plan is the Public Employees' Retirement System (PERS). Vesting is five (5) years. Minimum retirement age is 52, based on the 2% at 62 formula.
 
 
**Other Benefits**: Transportation passes for employees and/or eligible dependents; Medicare; Tuition reimbursement; credit union membership; SDI; Deferred Compensation Plan; 401(K) Thrift plan; EAP; Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts; Flexible work schedules; and Jury Duty Pay.
 

**BENEFITS FOR TEMPORARY EMPLOYEES**

**Temporary (Contingent) employees are eligible for the following benefits only:**

* Kaiser medical insurance
* Public Pension Plan
* 457/401K Plan
* Flex Spending
* Paid Sick Time
* Fare Media
* Rideshare Subsidies
* Metro One Fitness membership

For more information on the Benefits Enrollment for Contingent Employees, please visit LA Metro’s Pension & Benefits website at benefits.metro.net

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

The Senior Manager, Quality and Safety is responsible for leading the local execution of Mass General Brigham Community Division strategy, infrastructure, processes, and performance improvement efforts across patient safety, risk management, quality, and clinical compliance. This role oversees and supports the implementation of standardized best practices, safety and quality programs, regulatory readiness activities, and performance improvement initiatives that advance safe, reliable, high-quality care. 
 
The Senior Manager serves as a key local administrative leader and partners closely with system and site leadership, clinical teams, the local ACMO, risk/safety leaders, infection prevention, compliance, legal, data and analytics teams, and other stakeholders to execute both short- and long-term goals for Quality, Patient Safety, Risk Management, and Clinical Compliance programs. 
 
This position is responsible for translating system strategy into local execution while also providing strong bidirectional communication between the site and system teams regarding local risks, emerging trends, operational needs, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities. 
 
Because this is a leadership role in an active change-management environment, the Senior Manager must demonstrate flexibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and openness as the scope and needs of the role continue to evolve over time. 
 
Essential Functions 
 
Quality, Safety, and Risk Strategy Execution 
 

* Execute MGB Community Division strategy for patient safety, risk management, quality, and clinical compliance at the local site, ensuring alignment with standardized system processes, priorities, policies, and performance expectations.

 

* Support the buildout of local safety, quality, risk, and compliance infrastructure, including standardization in training, workflows, governance, reporting structures, and response processes that are in line with MGB.

 

* Collaborate with system and site leadership to execute long- and short-term goals for Quality, Patient Safety, Risk Management, and Clinical Compliance programs.

 

* Provide essential input to MGB leadership regarding strategy, infrastructure, policy development, performance improvement plans, and local operational needs to support high-quality care delivery.

 
Patient Safety and Risk Management 
 

* Execute MGB patient safety plans, including safety event reporting, event analysis, mitigation planning, and follow-up on safety-related concerns.

 

* Implement standardized risk management strategies, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities align with and strengthen the organization’s approach to patient safety.

 

* Implement and support use of the systemwide safety event reporting system.

 

* Support systemwide and local safety events, including recalls, shortages, and other issues that may impact patient safety.

 

* Partner with site Risk/Safety/PFR leaders and clinical teams to develop prospective solutions and performance improvement actions in response to safety events.

 

* Leads the development and delivery of patient safety and risk management training using culture‑of‑safety data, safety event trends, and systemwide priorities to promote continuous improvement, staff engagement, and safe, reliable care practices across all departments.

 

* Completes, within three (3) months of hire, High Reliability Organization (HRO) training, including Level 3, Fact Gatherer, and Process Facilitator, and integrates HRO principles into oversight of safety event analysis, improvement strategy, and organizational learning.

 
Quality Performance and Improvement 
 

* Serve as the local administrative leader responsible for executing quality performance and improvement programs at the site.

 

* Ensure adherence to MGB standardized processes for quality measurement, prioritized quality goals, quality strategy, and performance improvement activities.

 

* Provide proactive and reactive quality performance improvement planning in partnership with local clinical teams, department leaders, and floor-based teams.

 

* Lead the planning, implementation, and evaluation of process changes and performance improvement activities.

 

* Effectively communicate goals, strategic priorities, accountability expectations, and improvement plans to clinicians and operational leaders, engaging them as partners in achieving quality and safety outcomes.

 

* Serve as the senior local site manager responsible for Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) planning, documentation, and updates for board quality committee and/or patient care assessment committee needs.

 
Clinical Compliance and Regulatory Readiness 
 

* Serve as the senior local administrative manager responsible for clinical compliance activities, including tracer activity, site preparedness, monitoring, and adherence to standardized compliance processes.

 

* Build and support the local implementation of the MGB clinical compliance program, ensuring standardized processes, staff training, procedures, and governance are in place.

 

* Monitor institutional compliance with Joint Commission standards and other applicable regulations, and advise system leadership regarding areas requiring improvement.

 

* Lead or support proactive and reactive clinical compliance activities, including risk assessments, improvement plans, regulatory interpretation, and implementation of needed process changes.

 

* Serve as the senior clinical compliance manager responsible for management and performance during expected and unexpected regulatory visits, including but not limited to The Joint Commission, DPH, DMH, and CMS.

 

* Oversee submission of required documentation and reports to relevant accrediting and regulatory bodies, including DPH, DMH, TJC, BORIM, and MedSUN, and complete submissions directly when front-line support is not available.

 

* Liaise with system and site teams, clinicians, corporate compliance, and the Office of General Counsel regarding compliance issues, regulatory requirements, site visits, and areas of overlap.

 
Data, Analytics, Reporting, and Dashboards 
 

* Partner with MGB data and analytics teams to ensure reporting to CMS, other regulatory bodies, private payer contracting entities, external benchmarking organizations, and quality/safety reporting programs is timely and accurate.

 

* Understand data provided by system teams and use knowledge of local practices and culture to identify opportunities for improvement, emerging risks, and areas requiring local or system-level attention.

 

* Advise in the development of local and system-level dashboards related to quality performance, clinical compliance, patient safety, and improvement priorities.

 

* Analyze trends and emerging risks, communicate findings to local teams and system leaders, and support improvement planning based on available data.

 

* Prepare reports and presentations as needed for site leadership, system leadership, regulatory bodies, committees, and other stakeholders.

 
Collaboration and Local Leadership 
 

* Partner with the local ACMO and clinical teams to implement system goals, site-level improvements, and accountability processes.

 

* Liaise with infection prevention and control teams to monitor performance, respond to data, and support actions to reduce risk of infections to patients.

 

* Maintain strong organizational relationships and work effectively within a matrixed healthcare environment.

 

* Provide strong bidirectional communication between the system and site, including distribution of pertinent data, analytics, priorities, concerns, and operational feedback.

 

* Ensure recommended improvements are implemented and partner with local leadership to support accountability.

 
Staff Management and Department Operations 
 

* Manage, supervise, and support assigned quality, safety, risk, and/or compliance staff, including recruitment, interviewing, training, orientation, remediation, and performance evaluation.

 

* Establish development plans for staff and support ongoing professional growth, role clarity, and accountability.

 

* Manage departmental operations and budget responsibilities as assigned, including fiscal planning and budgetary recommendations.

 

* Oversee local training and educational programs related to quality, safety, risk, and clinical compliance as needed.

 

* Perform all other duties as assigned and requested.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree Related Field of Study required or Bachelor's Degree Patient Safety Leadership required and Master's Degree Nursing preferred 

 

**Experience**

 

* 3-5 years of safety, risk management, and patient family relations experience required.
* 3-5 years of experience leading process improvement and initiatives and managing teams required.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed healthcare organization preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

 

* Support the build out of safety/risk/PFR infrastructure, ensuring standardization in training, processes, and safety responses that are in line with MGB.
* Executes the MGB safety plans including those around event analysis, safety event reporting/management/mitigation.
* Implement the standardized risk management strategy, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities both align to and augment our approach to patient safety.
* Implement the system-wide safety event reporting system.
* Support as needed for system wide safety events such as recalls, shortages, and other events that impact safety.
* Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices to identify areas of opportunity for improvement of patient safety as well as communicate to the system areas that are at risk.
