role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
Job ID: 531039

Exempt

Oldcastle, a CRH company, is reinventing what's possible in building solutions. We are the leading provider of innovative outdoor living products and utility infrastructure solutions for the water, energy, and communications markets throughout North America. We're a trusted and strategic partner to engineers, contractors, distributors, specifiers, retailers, and homeowners alike as the manufacturer of precast concrete, polymer concrete, and plastic infrastructure products. Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies.

Oldcastle Infrastructure - Built For Life from Oldcastle Infrastructure on Vimeo.

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager is the senior leader on site and is responsible for everything that goes on inside the fence-line and is the driver of the production process. We look to the Plant Manager to build a collaborative environment between operations, sales, engineering, accounting, and transportation. This dynamic leader will be pushing continuous improvement in workplace safety, production efficiency, product cost, and customer service.

**Job Location**

This position will be located at our plant in Sweetwater, TN.

**Job Responsibilities**

 

* Ensure the plant employees and guests on site comply with safety and environmental practices – lead by example and build a safety first culture.
* Lead production scheduling to meet customer needs including timely delivery.
* Develop a keen focus on customer service and proactive communication across the team.
* Partner with the engineering team to ensure proper drawings and designs are being used during the manufacturing process.
* Purchase material/services to successfully operate the facility.
* Successfully hire, supervise, orient, train and retain operations/product staff.
* Promote and maintain a clean workplace that is “tour-ready” at all times.
* Ability to read drawings, plan production tasks from those drawings, and coach employees to produce product correctly.
* Ability to operate some of the standard tools on the plant floor such as overhead cranes, hand tools, batch plant, etc. While the Plant Manager will not be asked to operate these things continuously, having some of these skills will make him/her a better coach and troubleshooter.
* Be a leader and coach leadership. Motivate crews during morning huddles. Lead effective Mid-Day meetings. Coach Leads on how to set expectations on a whiteboard and have them followed. Lead inventory counts. Promote safety best practices in meetings with other Plant Managers.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by the General Manager as deemed appropriate and necessary by them.

**Job Requirements**

 

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Engineering or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of experience working in a leadership role in an industrial manufacturing environment
* Experience with precast/concrete or building materials is a plus
* Proven track record of developing, leading and maintaining a continuous improvement mindset at the plant
* Ability to work on your feet for the majority of the day in a production/plant environment subject to areas that are unheated and/or non-air conditioned
* Ability to work with computer as necessary (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, AX)
* Ability to lead and direct other individuals and work with other group leaders

**What CRH Offers You**

 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

**About CRH**

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!

Oldcastle Infrastructure, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.

EOE/Vet/Disability

CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

role.title: Director of Operations - Restaurants
role.description:
Director of Operations – Dave’s Hot Chicken

**Position:** Director of Operations

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** Restaurant / Multi-Unit Operations

About the Role

Dave’s Hot Chicken is looking for a highly motivated, results-driven **Director of Operations** to lead and support our growing restaurant operations.

This position is responsible for driving operational excellence across multiple locations while developing strong leaders, building a high-performance culture, delivering an exceptional guest experience, and achieving financial results.

We are looking for a leader who understands that great restaurant operations start with **great people**. The Director of Operations will work closely with General Managers and restaurant leadership teams to create accountability, consistency, and a culture where team members feel supported, challenged, recognized, and given opportunities to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and oversight for multiple Dave’s Hot Chicken locations.
* Ensure restaurants consistently execute Dave’s Hot Chicken operational standards, food quality, cleanliness, hospitality, and brand expectations.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and provide clear, actionable feedback to leadership teams.
* Identify operational opportunities and develop plans to improve restaurant performance.
* Ensure restaurants are properly staffed and prepared to execute at a high level.
* Maintain strong standards for food safety, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance.

People & Leadership Development

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing General Managers and restaurant leaders.
* Build a strong pipeline of future General Managers, Area Leaders, and other operations leaders.
* Create individualized development plans for key leaders and high-potential team members.
* Hold leaders accountable while providing the coaching, tools, and resources necessary for them to succeed.
* Recognize outstanding performance and create a culture where accomplishments are celebrated.
* Ensure leaders are actively developing their teams rather than simply managing daily operations.
* Promote a culture of respect, communication, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Financial Performance

* Take ownership of restaurant sales, profitability, labor, food cost, controllable expenses, and overall financial performance.
* Analyze P&L statements and restaurant performance reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Develop action plans to improve underperforming locations.
* Partner with restaurant leadership to increase sales while maintaining appropriate labor and cost controls.
* Establish clear performance expectations and follow up consistently on results.

Guest Experience

* Ensure every restaurant delivers a consistently outstanding guest experience.
* Monitor guest feedback and identify recurring opportunities.
* Coach restaurant leaders on hospitality, speed of service, order accuracy, food quality, and restaurant cleanliness.
* Ensure guest concerns are handled quickly, professionally, and appropriately.

New Restaurant Openings & Growth

* Support new restaurant openings, including staffing, training, leadership development, and operational readiness.
* Build leadership benches ahead of organizational growth.
* Help establish scalable systems and processes as the organization adds locations.
* Partner with senior leadership to develop strategies that support long-term growth.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

* 7+ years of progressive restaurant operations leadership experience.
* 3+ years of successful multi-unit leadership experience.
* Experience overseeing multiple high-volume restaurant locations.
* Proven ability to develop General Managers and build leadership pipelines.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&L management, labor, food cost, sales building, and profitability.
* Demonstrated ability to improve restaurant performance and hold teams accountable for results.
* Experience supporting new restaurant openings is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication, coaching, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance **people, operations, guest experience, and profitability**.
* Willingness to travel regularly between restaurant locations.
* Must be willing to work weekend, nights and availability to travel.

The Leader We Want

We are looking for someone who:

* **Leads from the front** and is comfortable spending significant time inside the restaurants.
* Builds relationships and earns the trust of their teams.
* Sets high expectations without losing sight of the people responsible for delivering the results.
* Develops leaders instead of simply giving directions.
* Recognizes and rewards great performance.
* Communicates clearly and follows through on commitments.
* Makes decisions based on both operational data and what is actually happening inside the restaurants.
* Takes ownership and expects the same from their leadership team.
* Understands that sustainable financial performance comes from strong operations, strong leadership, and engaged teams.
* Is passionate about building a winning culture while growing the Dave’s Hot Chicken brand.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means:

**Great People. Great Restaurants. Great Guest Experiences. Strong Financial Results.**

The Director of Operations will be expected to build restaurants where team members want to work, leaders have opportunities to grow, guests want to return, and the business consistently delivers strong results.

Why Join Dave’s Hot Chicken?

This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a rapidly growing restaurant brand. You will have the ability to influence operations, develop future leaders, support restaurant growth, and help create a culture built around accountability, recognition, development, and operational excellence.

**Dave’s Hot Chicken is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Who is Taco Bell?

Taco Bell is a leading Mexican-inspired quick service restaurant brand that is a part of Yum! Brands, Inc. which includes Pizza Hut and KFC. Founded on innovation and passion with Glen Bell bringing tacos to the masses in a world of hot dog and hamburger stands in 1962, today we have nearly 7000 restaurants in the United States and over 400 restaurants in 27 countries outside of the United States. The future holds 2,000 more restaurants across the globe within the next decade. It's easy to see we're in the business of making tacos, but at heart, we're a business that's fueled by the Live Mas energy and passion of people serving people.

What is "Live Mas"?

Equally important to the job role and responsibilities is making sure the Director of Operations can represent the amazing Live Mas! culture that is Taco Bell. At Taco Bell, we embrace breakthrough thinking and innovative ideas that continue to differentiate us from our competitors. We have a maniacal focus on our customers, never follow, and always celebrate the accomplishments of our people. If you want to have fun serving great food to our customers, we would love to meet with you.

This leader has up to 3 area coaches as direct reports compiling 12 restaurants. role.title: Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence
role.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

The Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence will lead a new enterprise team that brings inventory back to plan and keeps it there. The role installs a standard inventory management system at Teledyne sites: control of the material coming in, sound stocking policy and planning, and regular reviews that turn data into decisions. The Director leads the program and works hands-on at one site at a time, starting in our defense businesses.

A key part of this role involves partnering with Segment leadership, site General Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to set standard work, build site capability, and deliver sustainable business results, supporting enterprise objectives for working capital, on-time delivery, and margin.

**This role requires up to 75% travel. Due to the extensive travel involved, candidates may be based anywhere within the United States.**

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead standard site assessments of planning maturity, part-level inventory, and forecast accuracy, and partner with site leadership to prioritize and execute improvement opportunities.
* Set and deploy baseline standard work for every site, including weekly action on MRP messages for open purchase orders, receiving to plan, monthly inventory forecast reporting, and documented decisions on excess, obsolete, and aged WIP inventory.
* Drive inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives across the organization. Lead tactical controls on open purchase orders and receipts first, then structural fixes to safety stock, min/max settings, inventory entitlement, and planning.
* Own the guiding metric: material and labor going into inventory vs. cost of goods shipped, tracked monthly and forecast a year ahead, so sites act before inventory builds.
* Establish and implement enterprise inventory policies, standards, and governance, including decision rights for buying ahead of demand, keeping excess, and disposing of obsolete material.
* Run the monthly enterprise inventory review with senior leadership, using KPI dashboards to monitor every site, identify gaps, and drive accountability.
* Co-lead each site’s weekly material exception review and monthly General Manager inventory review, then coach site leaders to run them on their own.
* Strengthen SIOP, demand forecasting, and make-to-stock or make-to-order decisions with site planning teams, from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment.
* Leverage AI-enabled technologies, automation, and advanced analytics to improve inventory decisions, reporting, and business performance.
* Capture what works at each site in a standard playbook and share best practices across the enterprise.
* Lead and develop a team of one Manager and two Inventory Analysts working two sites at a time.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Materials Management, or Operational Excellence, including site-level operations or supply chain leadership.
* APICS CPIM or CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing and global business environments.
* Ability to travel up to 75%, including extended on-site periods during site engagements, to work with site teams, run operational reviews, and develop site leaders across Teledyne business units.

**Qualifications and Competencies**

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives and deliver measurable inventory and working capital results.
* Deep knowledge of materials management and supply chain planning, including MRP, open purchase order management, safety stock and inventory policy, SIOP, and demand forecasting.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Standard Work, and Root Cause Problem Solving.
* Experience deploying and sustaining business systems or enterprise operating models across multiple sites or business units, with hands-on factory and supply chain experience.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Passion for continuous improvement, emerging technologies, AI-enabled business transformation, and operational excellence.

* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills, including leading site teams without direct authority.
* Experience utilizing KPI dashboards, operational scorecards, and performance management systems.
* Experience working in ERP systems (SAP preferred) and across multiple ERP environments.

**Due to the type of work performed and facility access requirements, applicants must be a "U.S. Person" (U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee).**

**Salary Range:**

$170,900.00-$227,900.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.

role.title: Director of Operations (Boston, MA)
role.description:
About Mendocino Farms
 
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
 
Our Core Values and Mantras
 

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

We are Mendocino Farms, a unique, fast-casual restaurant concept breaking all the old paradigms of the restaurant business. At Mendocino Farms, we exist to sell more than just sandwiches, we sell happy. We are where the neighborhood comes together over inspired sandwiches and soulful salads made from thoughtfully sourced ingredients. Our name comes from legendary Mendocino County, a town known for pioneering the slow food movement and sustainable farming. At Mendo, we make daily decisions that reinforce our values of being trailblazers, learning and growing, building a ‘we’ culture, winning the day for our guests and our team members to ultimately, selling happy!
 
SUMMARY
 
As a DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS for Mendocino Farms you will lead a team of restaurant operators focused on operational excellence. You will be responsible for leading, managing and developing our operators throughout the Boston Area. You’ll be an active member of the Operations Leadership Team and help to shape operations strategy as well as ensure that the company’s strategic initiatives come to light in your market.
 
The right candidate is a proven leader and operator, familiar with high growth environments, skilled at managing a P&L, is an excellent communicator, sets a high bar for him/herself, and is adept at developing talent. If you are someone who thrives in a critical leadership position and gains personal satisfaction when sharing knowledge and driving operational excellence, then this is a great role for you.
 
This role will be based in the Greater Boston area and will require travel for training, and periodic travel to Los Angeles.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
 

* Manage field operations teams to deliver on our mission of Selling Happy
* Monitor and drive flawless execution in day-to-day operations; visit our restaurants often to ensure that all aspects of the business meet established guidelines and standards across all dayparts and parts of the week.
* Hire, train, develop, retain and evaluate leadership talent to create and maintain high performing teams that reduce turnover, create succession & growth and ensure that our top talent is ready to take on additional responsibilities.
* Assist with the development of strategic and tactical plans for the market and ensure the completion of each, holding individuals accountable to assigned tasks.
* Monitor all aspects of the business in-person and by using the various methods and reporting tools available (Daily sales reports, score cards, guest insights, labor and food cost tools), and then use the data and personal observations to coach and re-established goals.
* Develop and execute plans and initiatives that consistently achieve and beat the company's desired sales and profitability targets for both existing and newly established operations.
* Champion the operating culture by delivering a high level of system-wide operations execution that exceed guest expectations in each restaurant, every shift, every time; build a culture of accountability to financial and operational standards.
* Ensure flawless opening, execution and results of new restaurant openings by playing an active role during pre and post opening.
* Develop and maintain relationships across the company to ensure productive partnerships with various cross functional business partners and disciplines at Base Camp
* Deliver consistently on the company's goals and KPI’s
* Exhibit leadership by example through effective coaching, motivating and reinforcing the company's operating principles and core values while maintaining a high level of visibility with company operations.
* Demonstrate progress through analysis and forecasting and presentation of conclusions and recommendations to the executive team.
* Ensure compliance with all local laws and regulations as well as company policy as it relates to the running of your market especially as it relates to food safety and labor laws
* Maintain a strong industry network and local market knowledge for our brand.
* The role requires responding to critical and urgent, non-routine operational matters and emergencies outside of standard business hours. When on approved PTO, there is the option to delegate emergency coverage to a colleague.

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** 

* 7+ years of successful restaurant management/leadership operations experience required.
* Previous senior leadership experience leading large restaurant teams in a geographically dispersed operations environment
* Demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others.
* Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
* Familiar with Microsoft Office, and experience with using Excel.
* High performance teams and a strong team player
* Skill in assessing and prioritizing multiple tasks, projects, and demands
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Physical Requirements:** 

* Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
* Sitting / standing 8-14 hours.
* Hand use: single grasping, fine manipulation, pushing and pulling
* Work requires the following motions: bending, twisting, squatting, and reaching

There is no “I” in Mendo
 
Mendocino Farms is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. Mendocino Farms will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring requirements.
 

* This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & FAIR CHANCE EMPLOYMENT STATEMENT
 
Mendocino Farms is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

role.title: Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations
role.description:
**Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations**
--------------------------------------------

**Location:** Warren, MI 
**Work Model:** On-Site 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:**General Manager

**About SLPT**
--------------

**SLPT** is a manufacturing organization committed to delivering quality, reliability, and operational excellence for our customers. Located in Warren, Michigan, we take pride in building a culture where safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement drive everything we do.Our success starts with our people. We believe the best results come from empowered leaders who are willing to take ownership, develop talent, solve challenges, and continually raise the bar for performance. From the production floor to the leadership team, we foster an environment where employees are respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally.As we continue to invest in our operations, technology, and workforce, we are seeking leaders who are passionate about manufacturing excellence and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in shaping plant culture, driving continuous improvement, developing future leaders, and ensuring we consistently deliver exceptional results for our customers.

**Why Join SLPT?**
------------------

* Lead a high-impact manufacturing operation with significant responsibility and visibility.
* Influence plant strategy, operational performance, and business growth.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful results.
* Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
* Develop and mentor employees while building a culture of accountability, engagement, and success.
* Join an organization that values strong leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.

**At SLPT, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our people, our customers, and the future of our manufacturing operations.**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? We are seeking an experienced **Plant Manager**to lead all aspects of our Warren, Michigan manufacturing operation. In this role, you will oversee safety, quality, production, delivery performance, cost management, and employee development across a 24-hour operation.You will play a key role in driving operational excellence, implementing Lean Manufacturing initiatives, and developing high-performing teams while ensuring customer expectations and business objectives are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership experience, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering results in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across multiple shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, environmental standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Oversee production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, warehousing, and logistics functions.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximize Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor plant financial performance, including labor costs, operating expenses, inventory, maintenance spending, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support successful new product launches by partnering with engineering, quality, materials, and program management teams.

role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements.
 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site’s AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification.
 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense).
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
• Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
 
• Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
 
• Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
 
• Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
 
• Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
 
• Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
 
• Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
 
• Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
 
• Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
 
• Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
 
• Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
 
• Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
 
• Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.
 
 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
 
• 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
 
• Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
 
• Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS**

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.

Salary Range: $140,000 USD - $180,000 USD

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

View our Privacy Policy

role.title: Director, Quality
role.description:
**Job Description:**
Saab's Aeronautics Business is seeking a highly engaged, motivated and experienced
**Director of Quality**
to develop and lead a world-class aerospace quality organization.
 
 
The ideal candidate possesses strong leadership skills, the ability to identify process improvement opportunities and significant experience in developing and executing integrated strategies in manufacturing operations. They bring strong analytical, strategic, and relationship-building capabilities, along with a proven track record of developing next-level quality leaders. This position will be based in West Lafayette, IN.
 
 
**Responsibilities will include:**

* Employee management and engagement and compliance to relevant standards/requirements.
* Work collaboratively with Program Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production to maximize efficiencies, achieve objectives, and improve overall safety and product quality in the business.
* Develop a strong relationship with Saab’s Global Aeronautics Business Area team and continually develop and improve global and local processes.
* Manage transfer of technology programs for products moving from Sweden to the US.
* Ensure proper staffing to effectively perform all responsibilities. This includes having the right skill mix to cover all areas of responsibility in global operations.
* Keep management and others informed of significant issues or developments.
* Support other departments/functions as needed to ensure operational efficiencies.
* Develop quality team via internal and external educational and experiential opportunities.
* Provide costing data to support proposal efforts.
* Resolve external quality issues. This may include direct government and/or customer contact, interaction with the program management team, or others close to the issue to resolve and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Work with peers in the management team to establish quality improvement strategies and plans.
* Ensure internal audits of existing processes are being performed and changing/evaluating as necessary to continually meet/exceed customer expectations.
* Perform formal root cause analysis on product/process related issues.
* Utilize risk assessment tools (e.g., PFMEAs) to identify actions to reduce risks.
* Lead key improvement projects, providing leadership in developing practical solutions to complex problems.
* Improve processes using Kaizen, process mapping, 6s, or other lean tools.
* Identify trends and process variations for future improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance across all areas of responsibility.

**Compensation Range:**
$165,700 - $223,800
 
 
The compensation range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Saab, Inc. considers factors including (but not limited to) the role and associated responsibilities, location, and market and business considerations, as well as the candidate's work experience, key skills, and education/training.
 
 
**Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Quality or related discipline is required. Master’s degree is a plus.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Aerospace or Defense.
* 5+ years in a Quality management role in Aerospace or Defense.
* Lean training and experience / certification a plus.
* A proven track record of implementing improvements.
* Experience with customer (USG) interaction and problem resolution.
* Strong analytical, prioritizing, interpersonal, problem-solving, presentation, budgeting, project management skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in AS9100 Quality Systems in an Aerospace or Defense company.
* Ability to develop and maintain collaborative relationships with peers and colleagues across the organization, as well as internal and external clients.
* Ability to form partnerships with foreign national partners in order to maximize results.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team to achieve strategic goals.
* Experience with the development and production of aerospace systems required.

**Citizenship Requirements:**
Must be a U.S. citizen. Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
 
 
**Drug-Free Workplaces:**
Saab is a federal government contractor and adheres to policies and programs necessary for sustaining drug-free workplaces. As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screen.
 
 
**Benefits:**
Saab provides an excellent working environment offering professional growth opportunities, competitive wages, work-life balance, a business casual atmosphere and comprehensive benefits.
 
 
Highlights include:
 
 

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance for employees and dependents
* Generous paid time off, including 8 designated holidays
* 401(k) with employer contributions
* Tuition assistance and student loan assistance
* Wellness and employee assistance resources
* Employee stock purchase opportunities
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

**About Us:**
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. In the U.S., Saab delivers advanced technology and systems, supporting the U.S. Armed Forces and the Federal Aviation Administration, as well as international and commercial partners. Headquartered in Syracuse, New York, the company has business units and local employees in ten U.S. locations.
 
 
Saab is a company where we see diversity as an asset and offer unlimited opportunities for advancing in your career. We are also a company that respects each person’s needs and encourage employees to lead a balanced, rewarding life beyond work. Saab values diversity and is an Affirmative Action employer for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Saab is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran, disability status, or any other federal, state, or locally protected category.

role.description:
Location: 203A Log Canoe Circle, Stevensville, MD 21666
 
 
Shift Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday
 
 
Pay Range: $135,000 -175,000 + Bonus Eligibility!
 
 
**Hydrasearch,**
a proud affiliate of The Dixon Group, is looking for a
**Director of Quality Assurance**
to join our team in
**Stevensville, MD**
! The Director of Quality Assurance will lead the organization's quality management strategy and ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. This role is responsible for overseeing quality assurance programs, driving continuous improvement initiatives, managing quality personnel, and partnering with operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to maintain high standards of product quality and operational excellence.
 
 
**At Hydrasearch, we value the contributions of our Military Veterans and proudly employ our nation’s heroes. Veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.**
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance function across the organization.
* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with AS9100D and ISO 9001, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Establish quality objectives, metrics, and reporting processes to drive continuous improvement.
* Oversee internal audits, external audits, and customer quality assessments.
* Manage corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs and root cause analysis initiatives.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership to improve product and process quality.
* Analyze quality data and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Lead customer complaint investigations and resolution efforts.
* Develop and drive supplier quality programs. Actively work with vendors to address quality concerns.
* Build, mentor, and develop quality personnel and future leaders within the organization.
* Support new product introduction activities by ensuring quality standards are incorporated into design and manufacturing processes.
* Prepare and present quality performance updates to executive leadership.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field required; Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within manufacturing, maritime & aerospace defense, industrial, or related industries required; experience supporting defense, military, or government-contract manufacturing environments preferred.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality teams and managing direct reports.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100D & ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits.
* Demonstrated success implementing continuous improvement programs and driving measurable results.
* Experience with root cause analysis methodologies and corrective action processes.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and statistical process control methodologies is a plus!
* This hands-on leadership position requires extensive maritime and aerospace defense quality experience, strong knowledge of industry standards and regulations, and proven success managing external audits and compliance initiatives.

**What We Offer**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family
* Competitive salary
* Bonus programs
* 401K retirement plan
* Training opportunities
* Tuition reimbursement
* Paid vacation, PTO, and holidays
* Gym reimbursements, and more!

**Who We Are:**
Hydrasearch is a U.S. manufacturer specializing in fluid-transfer and control systems for maritime, aerospace, and defense applications. Since its founding in 1962, Hydrasearch has developed capabilities in hose assemblies, valve fittings, and customer machined parts, often to meet MIL-SPEC and naval standards.
 
 
**Join us and be a part of a team that values your contributions and supports your goals!**
**We do not provide sponsorships to work in the United States.**
The Dixon Group is an equal opportunity employer. It is the Company's policy and practice to recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals, as well as to administer all personnel actions, compensation, and benefits, without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, ancestry or national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, veteran status, military service, or any other factors protected by applicable law. This policy extends to all employees and applicants and to all aspects of the employment relationship.
 
 
The Dixon Group is committed to protecting the privacy rights of its employees and job applicants to the fullest extent required by applicable law. To that end, personal information will be collected solely for those legitimate business purposes recognized by law, and then maintained in a manner consistent with all applicable laws and regulations pertaining to document retention requirements. The Dixon Group does not sell personal information to third parties, and does not share such personal information with third parties except when authorized by law to do so (e.g., in response to a lawful subpoena; mandatory tax reporting; etc.)
 
 
Please contact us at (410) 778-2000 or hr@dixonvalve.com if you need help to participate fully in the application process.

role.title: Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance
role.description:
**Business Unit:**
Miltope Corporation

**Location:**
Hope Hull, AL

This position is an exempt salaried role that normally works a 9/80 work schedule. Non-duty hours work may be required based on business needs.

**Who YOU are and what YOU can become:**

You are a high-performing strategist with a commitment to excellence, attention to detail, and a knack for identifying areas of improvement. You are looking for a role that serves a noble purpose: supporting our nation's warfighters.

**Who WE are and where WE are going:**

At ST Engineering North America Government, Miltope Corporation, we apply technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives. Our dedication to excellence has earned us a reputation for quality and trust as a global technology, defense, and engineering group. Our diverse portfolio spans aerospace, smart city, defense, and public security.

**What YOU will do:**

Miltope Corporation is seeking an experienced aerospace quality and regulatory compliance executive to lead the company's Quality organization and ensure continued compliance with applicable Department of War, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), and customer requirements.

This position is responsible for the development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of quality management systems supporting, but not limited to:

* FAA Part 21 Production Approval operations.
* FAA Part 145 Certified Repair Station operations.
* EASA Part 145 Approved Maintenance Organization operations.

The Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance will serve as the senior independent authority for quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality system effectiveness across production and repair station operations.

Reporting directly to the CEO/President, this individual will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Repair Station management to ensure regulatory requirements are implemented, monitored, and maintained.

The successful candidate must establish an effective quality culture while possessing the technical knowledge and operational experience necessary to engage directly in regulatory matters, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality System Leadership**

* Maintain responsibility for quality management system effectiveness and compliance supporting FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 operations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, and EASA Part-145 requirements.
* Maintain and oversee Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.
* Ensure regulatory requirements, approved procedures, and customer-specific quality requirements are communicated and implemented.
* Monitor regulatory changes and evaluate their impact on operations, procedures, and approvals.
* Serve as the primary Quality representative in regulatory compliance matters and coordinate with designated Accountable Managers and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure organizational responsibilities, delegated authorities, and quality reporting relationships are clearly defined.

**FAA and EASA Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee FAA Production Approval compliance, including organizational controls, production conformity, quality assurance, and product traceability.
* Oversee FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality control activities, ensuring compliance with applicable manuals and Operations Specifications.
* Ensure EASA Part-145 compliance monitoring requirements are implemented and maintained.
* Ensure the designated EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager has the independence, authority, resources, and organizational access necessary to perform assigned responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, surveillance activities, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.
* Maintain effective relationships with FAA, EASA, and other regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely notification, investigation, and resolution of reportable quality and regulatory issues.

**Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain an effective internal audit program covering production, repair station operations, suppliers, and supporting business functions.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, investigation, and resolution of nonconformances and audit findings.
* Maintain an effective corrective and preventive action (CAPA) process, including root cause analysis and verification of effectiveness.
* Monitor quality performance metrics, identify adverse trends, and drive improvement initiatives.
* Ensure controls for material acceptance, inspection, product conformity, nonconforming material, configuration management, calibration, and quality records.
* Oversee supplier quality management, including qualification, monitoring, and corrective actions.
* Drive a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance.

**Organizational Leadership and Executive Accountability**

* Report directly to the CEO/President on regulatory compliance, quality performance, significant risks, and corrective actions.
* Maintain independence from Manufacturing, Operations, and Repair Station production functions when performing quality oversight and compliance monitoring.
* Escalate significant quality and regulatory compliance concerns directly to executive leadership.
* Establish appropriate quality-related authority, including initiating product or maintenance holds and preventing release or return to service when requirements have not been satisfied, consistent with approved procedures and delegated authority.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement and sustain corrective actions.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality organization to ensure technical competency, staffing, and succession planning.
* Provide executive management with objective assessments of quality system effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in defense or aerospace quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing a quality organization or regulatory compliance function.
* Demonstrated experience within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing organization holding a Part 21 Production Approval.
* Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.
* Working knowledge of EASA Part-145 requirements, including compliance monitoring and organizational independence.
* Experience managing regulatory audits, responding to findings, and coordinating corrective actions with FAA, EASA, and customer representatives.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace quality management systems, including AS9100, AS9110, or equivalent standards.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA systems, supplier quality, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical procedures and controls.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, regulatory authorities, customers, and employees at all levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience overseeing multiple regulatory approvals or certifications within a single organization.
* Experience with aerospace manufacturing and component repair/maintenance operations.
* Experience serving as or directly supporting a Part 21 Accountable Manager, FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, or EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager.
* Experience with AS9100/AS9110 certification audits and aerospace customer audits.
* Experience implementing and maintaining risk-based quality systems and safety management processes.
* Experience managing quality organizations across multiple facilities or operating locations.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Independence, integrity, and willingness to address difficult quality and regulatory issues.
* Ability to influence executive leadership and operational management.
* Strong technical judgment and understanding of aviation product safety and airworthiness.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing compliance issues.
* Ability to balance regulatory requirements with practical business and operational considerations.
* Hands-on leadership style and willingness to engage in the details.

**Measures of Success**

* Sustained compliance with FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 requirements.
* Successful completion of regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.
* Timely and effective resolution of audit findings and corrective actions.
* Effective quality system performance and reduction of recurring nonconformances.
* Strong organizational understanding of quality responsibilities and regulatory requirements.
* An independent, empowered Quality organization that supports business performance while protecting product conformity, airworthiness, and regulatory compliance.

**Please contact:**
Human Resources at hr@miltope.com

It takes diverse talent to solve real-world problems. ST Engineering/Miltope Corporation is deeply committed to building a workplace community where inclusion is valued and everyone feels welcomed. We are proud to consider all qualified applicants for employment. Miltope is an equal opportunity employer.

Miltope Corporation is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. To request an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.

**Built**

Keel was formed by bringing together three industry leaders combining generations of hands-on expertise in steel fabrication, shipbuilding, aerospace, and defense manufacturing.
 
 
That means when you join Keel, you’re joining a team backed by decades of proven craftsmanship and real-world results.
 
 
We build ships, defense systems, aerospace components, and heavy steel structures that serve critical missions — and we do it with pride.
 
 
**Your Mission**
The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and compliance governance for multiple heavy fabrication plants producing structural weldments, assemblies, and machined components for the Nuclear Navy. This role ensures full alignment with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, and customer specific requirements.
 
 
**Explore The Depth Of The Role**

* Provide strategic leadership for quality operations across three South Carolina fabrication facilities supporting U.S. Navy shipbuilding and defense manufacturing programs.
* Ensure all products meet contractual, technical, regulatory, NAVSEA, and quality requirements while driving continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and product performance.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary quality interface for customers, government representatives, auditors, and regulatory agencies, leading quality reviews, audits, corrective actions, and performance discussions.
* Direct all quality assurance, quality control, inspection, test, dimensional verification, NDT, welding quality, and supplier quality activities across the region.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics including First-Time Quality (FTQ), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), defect escapes, rework, audit findings, and inspection cycle time.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate recurring nonconformances and improve manufacturing performance.
* Drive operational excellence through improved inspection efficiency, resource utilization, process standardization, and deployment of risk-based quality methodologies.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to proactively prevent defects and improve overall manufacturing effectiveness.
* Build and sustain a culture where quality, compliance, workmanship excellence, and customer focus are integrated into daily operations at all levels of the organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead Quality Managers, Engineers, Supervisors, Auditors, and Inspectors while building organizational capability and succession plans.
* Other related duties as assigned.

**Requirements**
**Mission Readiness:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related technical discipline; Master's Degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in shipbuilding, defense, defense manufacturing, heavy fabrication, aerospace, or similar industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-site quality organizations.
* Root cause analysis and corrective action applied to nonconformances and recurring defects
* Quality auditing, including internal, supplier, and customer audit planning, execution, and follow-up
* Data analysis and reporting using quality metrics, dashboards, and tools such as Excel, Power BI, and ERP/QMS software
* Contract and technical document review, including drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection plans
* Executive-level presentation and negotiation skills for customer meetings, corrective action reviews, and dispute resolution
* Quality Management Systems: AS9100, ISO 9001, Navy QA requirements, nonconformance management, and CAPA
* Welding and NDT Oversight: Weld procedures, inspection methods, and material traceability in accordance with NAVSEA requirements
* Supplier Quality: Qualifying, auditing, and developing suppliers; preventing counterfeit or nonconforming material
* Regulatory and Contract Compliance: Government source inspection, DCMA surveillance, and audit readiness
* Continuous Improvement and Leadership: Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and developing quality talent
* Track and report cost of quality (prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure) and drive reductions in rework and scrap
* Support program pricing, proposals, and forecasts with accurate quality labor and resource estimates
* Evaluate the cost, schedule, and risk impact of quality decisions, such as rework, repair, and corrective action investments

**Travel Requirements**
Between facilities as needed
 
 
**Physical Requirements**

* May be required to stand, walk, sit, reach/pull/push with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel regularly.
* May lift or carry 50lbs. Weights exceeding 50lbs will require mechanical means to maneuver.

* Execute with Excellence and Velocity

role.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location:**
Springhill, TN or St. Louis, MO

**Position:**
Full-Time | Department Leadership Team

**Company Overview**

Our client is an established, growing manufacturing company specializing in custom-engineered components and solutions. With multiple manufacturing locations, the organization is committed to operational excellence, exceptional customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Quality to lead and oversee all aspects of quality management across a multi-location manufacturing organization.

This position serves as the company's senior quality leader, with overall responsibility for developing and executing the corporate quality strategy, maintaining the existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, and leading the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification.

The Director of Quality will provide leadership, direction, and professional development to all Quality Department personnel, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.

The ideal candidate will have extensive manufacturing quality experience, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record of developing quality systems, improving operational performance, and building high-performing teams.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership & Management**

* Provide company-wide leadership and oversight of all quality-related activities across the organization's manufacturing operations.
* Lead, mentor, develop, and manage the corporate Quality Department, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.
* Establish and execute the company's quality strategy, objectives, policies, and performance standards.
* Foster a proactive culture of quality, accountability, problem-solving, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Sales, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to ensure quality objectives align with business and customer requirements.
* Develop organizational capabilities, staffing plans, and employee training programs to support current operations and future growth.

**Quality Management Systems & Certification**

* Maintain and continuously improve the company's existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, ensuring ongoing compliance, audit readiness, and successful maintenance of current certification.
* Develop and manage a comprehensive IATF 16949 certification roadmap, including gap assessments, implementation milestones, resource requirements, training, internal audits, and certification readiness.
* Ensure the company's Quality Management System (QMS) is enhanced to satisfy IATF 16949 requirements and applicable customer-specific quality standards.
* Lead and execute the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification within established timelines.
* Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of quality systems and processes across all manufacturing locations.
* Oversee internal, external, customer, and certification audits, ensuring ongoing compliance and successful certification.
* Serve as, or provide leadership to, the company's Lead Auditor and internal audit teams.
* Ensure effective management of corrective and preventive actions, nonconformances, documentation, calibration, and quality records.
* Lead management reviews and ensure ongoing QMS effectiveness and organizational accountability.

**Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish, monitor, and drive improvements in company-wide Quality KPIs, including customer complaints, internal and external PPM, cost of poor quality, scrap, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives designed to reduce defects, improve manufacturing performance, and strengthen customer satisfaction.
* Lead complex problem-solving and root cause investigations using methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagrams, FMEA, and statistical analysis.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality tools to proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to establish effective process controls, inspection standards, and preventive quality measures.
* Oversee product nonconformance management, containment, material disposition, and corrective action activities.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Serve as the senior quality representative for key customer relationships, audits, escalations, and quality-related concerns.
* Ensure timely, professional resolution of customer complaints and implementation of sustainable corrective actions.
* Manage the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), working closely with internal Quality and Business Development teams to ensure timely completion of customer approvals and achievement of new business launch schedules.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities and ensure compliance with customer-specific quality requirements.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Purchasing to establish supplier quality expectations, manage supplier performance, and resolve supplier-related quality issues.
* Support new customer onboarding, new product launches, and manufacturing process changes to ensure quality requirements are achieved.
* Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to continuously improve quality performance.

**Strategic & Operational Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute long-term quality improvement plans aligned with the organization's growth objectives.
* Establish standardized quality processes, reporting, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
* Support business expansion, new manufacturing capabilities, and potential acquisitions through quality system assessments and integration.
* Evaluate and recommend investments in inspection equipment, measurement technology, automation, and quality management systems.
* Prepare and present quality performance reports, improvement plans, certification progress, and key initiatives to executive leadership.
* Promote a safe work environment and ensure quality-related activities support company safety standards.
* Perform other quality-related leadership responsibilities as required.

**Experience & Education Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and significant manufacturing quality leadership experience.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including at least 3–5 years in a quality management or leadership position.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and/or plant-level quality personnel.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 Quality Management Systems, implementation, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or maintaining ISO 9001-certified Quality Management Systems.
* Experience supporting or leading IATF 16949 implementation, certification preparation, or certification audits.
* Lead Auditor experience with ISO 9001 or IATF 16949.
* Proven success improving quality performance, reducing defects, managing customer complaints, and implementing effective corrective actions.
* Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 8D, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Experience managing customer and third-party quality audits.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, ERP/MRP systems, and quality-related software.
* Ability and willingness to travel between manufacturing locations and customer or supplier facilities as necessary.

role.title: Director Production
role.description:
**Requisition ID: 273234**
**Locations: Bishopville**
**Schedule: Start time 6:30AM Monday - Friday, weekends/holidays per business needs.**
Click here to experience a Day in the Life of our Teammates !
 
 
**Uncap Your Potential at America's Largest Coca-Cola Bottler — Pour Your Passion into Purpose!**
We're more than beverages—we're building meaningful careers and vibrant communities. Join our team where your talent meets purpose, and every teammate directly shapes our success.
 
 

* Career Growth: Clear pathways to advance and develop your career
* Competitive Benefits: 401(k) match + health coverage + employee stock purchase plan
* Purpose-Driven: Create meaningful impact in the communities you serve
* Professional Development: Dedicated training + personalized mentorship

**Join us - your refreshing new chapter starts here!**
**Job Overview**
The Director, Production will ensure that manufacturing processes run reliably and efficiently; through the management of production processes, planning and organizing production schedules, assessing project and resource requirements, and ensuring that health and safety regulations are met. T he Director will oversee the organizing of repair and routine maintenance of production equipment in collaboration with the Maintenance Manager, as well as supervising the work and leading relevant training sessions. As well as coordinate the activities of the production, maintenance, and quality assurance departments to ensure effective execution of the weekly production schedule. The Director also ensures the effective utilization of resources including staffing, equipment, and materials.
 
 
****Duties & Responsibilities****

* Conduct daily line performance review meetings with representatives from all departments to ensure production KPIs are being met and to identify potential issues impacting productivity
* Prioritize maintenance work orders in conjunction with the maintenance manager and supports team meetings to address issues that affect production line performance
* Collaborate with the Product Supply Planning team to manage raw material inventory and production schedules and ensure that production is scheduled in such a manner as to minimize downtime and maximize productivity
* Conduct daily reviews and ensure production is scheduled to avoid out-of-stock situations by resolving any issues as to consumer complaints and customer feedback; ensure cross-functional communication within the plant is timely and effective and drives efficient and effective resolutions to deliver satisfaction to both internal and external customers
* Review P&L statement weekly to ensure accuracy and manages budget for all production supplies; review daily raw materials yield reporting, investigate and resolve inventory variances; review weekly labor reporting to manage labor and ensure overtime is minimized
* Manage, lead, and motivate a team to deliver results by communicating company goals and deadlines. Engage and develop teammates through effective performance management, coaching, and training. Implement continuous improvement methods and embody company purpose and values to inspire servant leadership

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* 3-5 years of food and beverage industry experience required
* Experience with supervising associates in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to plan and execute complex projects
* Strong communication skills
* Successful background in change management and building a winning culture
* Successfully build cross-functional relationships and have a strategic vision
* Ability to lead, manage and develop a team
* Advanced PC skill - MS Office Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SAP
* Ability to stand for extended periods of time, walking manufacturing floor, climbing stairs, and lift up to 25lbs

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (4 years)
* Knowledge acquired through 3 to up to 5 years of work experience

**Preferred Qualifications**
Food Industry, Supply Chain, Business, or equivalent experience may be acceptable
 
 
****Work Environment****
Office Environment
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer - All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
